title: The Godfather
S: salami, provolone, olives and roast peppers laid out like the garden party

Roast two red capsicums black over a flame, sweat in a covered bowl, peel and dress with garlic, red wine vinegar and oil. Platter with folded finocchiona and sopressa, wedges of aged provolone, Sicilian green olives and grissini wrapped in prosciutto.
for all those oranges on screen, every one a warning

Segment 4 blood or navel oranges over a bowl to catch the juice. Shave 1 fennel bulb and half a red onion paper thin, toss with the segments, black olives, fennel fronds, the juice, good olive oil, flaky salt and chilli flakes.
the kind of starter Clemenza would order without looking at a menu

Cut cleaned squid tubes into rings, soak 30 minutes in buttermilk. Dredge in half fine semolina, half flour with salt and pepper, fry at 190C for 90 seconds in small batches. Lemon wedges and a quick marinara for dipping.
M: fry the garlic, tomatoes and paste, brown the sausage and meatballs, a splash of wine, a little sugar

Fennel sausage and pork and beef meatballs browned hard, then slow-simmered in San Marzano gravy with garlic and red wine, over rigatoni with pecorino. Mix 400g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated pecorino and a pinch of salt; form 12 meatballs. Brown in olive oil with 3 fennel sausages cut into chunks; set aside. Soften 1 diced onion, add 3 sliced garlic cloves and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Stir in 800g tinned tomatoes and 200ml water. Return meat, cover partly and simmer gently 60 to 90 minutes, stirring and adding water if needed. Check meatballs are cooked through. Boil 400g rigatoni, toss with sauce and serve with the meat and another 30g pecorino.
lemon and capers, the best veal in the city, so Sollozzo says

Pound veal escalopes to 4mm, season, dust in flour. Sear 60 seconds a side in butter and oil, rest on a plate. Deglaze with white wine, add lemon juice, capers and stock, reduce, swirl in cold butter, return the veal and parsley.
W: take the cannoli, it's the one thing everyone remembers

Drain 500g fresh ricotta overnight in muslin. Beat with 80g icing sugar, orange zest and vanilla, fold in mini choc chips. Pipe into bought cannoli shells just before serving so they stay crisp, dip the ends in crushed pistachio, dust with icing sugar.
K: the straw bottle on the table, and the oranges that turn up before every hit

Chianti steeped with sliced oranges, lemon, a cinnamon stick and a splash of brandy, topped with soda over ice. Slice 2 oranges and 1 lemon into a large jug. Add 1 cinnamon stick, 60ml brandy and 40g caster sugar and muddle gently for 30 seconds. Pour in 750ml Chianti, stir until the sugar dissolves and refrigerate for 2 hours. Just before serving, add 300ml chilled soda water and stir once. Pour over ice into tumblers with a slice of orange in each.
T: Family first. Cannoli second.
D: A mafia patriarch hands the family business to his reluctant youngest son.
P: Pour the Chianti when the wedding band starts up in the opening scene.

title: The Godfather Part II
S: fried in the oil that started the family business

Cook arborio in stock with saffron and parmesan, spread on a tray and chill overnight. Cook 300g arborio rice in 900ml stock with a pinch of saffron until thick, stir in 40g parmesan and chill overnight on a tray. Brown 150g beef mince with 50g frozen peas and 2 tbsp passata. Wrap golf balls of rice around a spoon of filling and a cube of mozzarella. Roll in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 100g breadcrumbs, and fry at 175C until deep gold.
ham, roast pork, swiss and pickles, pressed flat for the Havana trip

Split slider rolls, smear with mustard, layer leg ham, sliced mojo pork, Swiss and dill pickle. Brush tops with butter and press in a heavy pan over medium heat, a second pan on top, until the cheese melts and the bread crisps.
for the lakeside compound where it all goes cold
Flake 2 hot-smoked trout fillets, blitz half with 150g cream cheese, crème fraîche, lemon and horseradish, fold the rest through for texture. Dill and cracked pepper, water crackers on the side.
M: ricotta and a mozzarella crust, the kind of thing a young family stretches over a week

Cook ziti 3 minutes short of done. Toss with a slow tomato and Italian sausage sauce, layer with ricotta seasoned with parmesan, nutmeg and parsley, top with torn mozzarella. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until blistered.
garlic, citrus, black beans and rice for New Year's Eve in Havana

Marinate pork shoulder overnight in sour orange (or orange and lime), a whole head of garlic, cumin and oregano. Roast at 160C for 4 hours until it pulls, then crisp at 220C. Black beans with sofrito and white rice.
W: the sponge iced like Cuba, cut and shared around the table

Bake a vanilla butter sponge in a slab tin. Cut into a rough island shape, cover with a thin crumb coat then pale green buttercream. Pipe "Happy Birthday" across it and slice at the table while everyone talks business.
K: Fredo would ask for a banana in his

Shake 60ml white rum, 25ml fresh lime and 15ml sugar syrup hard with plenty of ice, double strain into a chilled coupe. Make sugar syrup by dissolving 60g caster sugar in 60ml hot water and cooling. For each drink shake 60ml white rum, 25ml fresh lime juice and 15ml syrup hard with plenty of ice, then double strain into a chilled coupe. Makes four, with 240ml rum and about 4 limes.
T: The family business goes international.
D: Michael tightens his grip on the empire while young Vito's rise plays out in old New York.
P: Serve the mains when the story moves to Havana for New Year's Eve.

title: The Godfather Part III
S: chickpea fritters, salt and lemon, for the trip back to Sicily

Whisk 250g chickpea flour into 750ml salted water, cook stirring for 10 minutes until thick. Spread 1cm thick on an oiled tray, set, cut into squares and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Lemon and salt.
sweet and sour Sicilian eggplant on toast

Fry cubed eggplant until golden, then soften celery and onion. Add tomato, capers, green olives, a spoon of sugar and red wine vinegar, simmer 10 minutes, fold in the eggplant. Cool, spoon onto toasted baguette with basil.
Rockmelon at room temperature, cut into long wedges and skinned. Drape with prosciutto di Parma, a crack of pepper and a drizzle of good olive oil.
M: hand-rolled in the kitchen while the family looks the other way

Bake 1kg floury potatoes, rice while hot, cool slightly, work in 1 yolk, salt and about 250g 00 flour until just smooth. Roll ropes, cut, cook until they float. Burnt butter with sage until nutty, parmesan.
eggplant, tomato and ricotta salata, straight from Sicily
Fry thick eggplant slices in olive oil until deep gold. Simmer garlic, San Marzano tomatoes and basil 20 minutes. Toss rigatoni with sauce and eggplant, grate ricotta salata heavily over the top.
W: ricotta and candied orange, eaten carefully in the opera box
Beat drained ricotta with icing sugar, cinnamon and chopped candied orange peel. Fill bought shells at the last minute, ends in chopped candied orange and pistachio.
K: a drink in the Palermo opera house before Cavalleria rusticana

Limoncello and prosecco over ice with a splash of soda, a strip of lemon peel and a sprig of fresh mint. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice. Pour 40ml limoncello into each, then top each with 90ml chilled prosecco and 30ml soda water. Stir once gently so you keep the bubbles. Peel 4 wide strips of zest from 1 lemon, twist each over a glass to release the oil and drop it in. Finish with a small sprig of mint.
T: The past never stays buried.
D: An ageing Michael Corleone tries to buy his way into legitimacy through the Vatican.
P: Hold the cannoli until the opera in the final act, and keep an eye on who made them.

title: Goodfellas
S: Paulie's razor blade garlic, sliced so fine it melts in the oil
Slice garlic as thin as you can on a mandoline, sweat in olive oil over low heat until soft and barely golden. Spoon over grilled ciabatta rubbed with tomato, salt and torn basil.
front row table, walked in through the kitchen

Poach peeled prawns 2 minutes in salted water with lemon and bay, ice bath. Marie Rose with whole-egg mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, hot sauce and brandy. Iceberg, prawns, sauce, paprika, lemon wedge, in coupes.
Thick-cut Genoa salami and sharp provolone, pepperoncini, marinated mushrooms and a loaf of seeded Italian bread torn by hand.
M: veal, beef and pork, and go easy on the onions like Vinnie

Mix equal veal, beef and pork mince with milk-soaked bread, egg, pecorino, parsley and garlic. Brown, then into a tomato sauce built on razor-thin garlic and a little onion. Simmer 90 minutes, serve with spaghetti.
the 3am dinner at Tommy's mum's, after the boys turn up late and hungry

Season thin porterhouse or rump, sear hard and rest. In the same pan, garlic, oregano, chilli and a tin of crushed tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes. Return the steak to warm through, crusty bread for the sauce.
W: a hot Brooklyn summer on the corner
Simmer 200g sugar with 500ml water and lemon zest, cool, add 250ml lemon juice. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours until fluffy. Serve in paper cups.
K: Bamboo Lounge Scotch and ginger highball
the drink of choice at the Bamboo Lounge

Blended Scotch over big ice with honey-ginger syrup and fresh lemon, topped with cold soda and a curl of lemon peel. Make the syrup: simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and 30g sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Fill 4 highball glasses with large ice cubes. Add 45ml Scotch, 15ml ginger syrup and 10ml lemon juice to each and stir for 10 seconds. Top each with 120ml chilled soda water, stir once and finish with a curl of lemon peel.
T: As far back as I can remember, I always wanted seconds.
D: A Brooklyn kid works his way up the mob ladder, from the cab stand to the Lufthansa heist.
P: Plate up the mains when Paulie starts slicing garlic in the prison kitchen.

title: A Bronx Tale
S: bar food from Sonny's place, Chez Bippy

Big green olives stuffed with sharp provolone, crumbed and fried until crackling, with lemon aioli and a dusting of chilli. Drain 24 large pitted green olives and pat dry. Cut 80g sharp provolone into small sticks and push one into each olive. Roll in 40g plain flour, dip in 1 beaten egg, then coat in 80g fine breadcrumbs. Heat oil to 180C and fry in two batches for 2 minutes until deep golden, then drain. Stir the zest and juice of half a lemon and 1 crushed garlic clove into 100g mayonnaise. Dust the olives with chilli flakes and serve with the aioli.
Cut eggplant into fingers, salt 30 minutes, pat dry. Flour, egg, panko mixed with parmesan, fry at 180C until golden. Warm marinara for dipping.
eaten on the stoop while the street corner singers warm up
Cut pizza dough into strips, tie knots, prove 30 minutes, bake at 230C for 12 minutes. Toss straight from the oven in garlic butter with parsley and parmesan.
M: gravy and meatballs at the neighbourhood boss's table
Brown pork and beef meatballs and a few pork ribs, then simmer in tomato sauce with garlic and basil for 2 hours. Toss rigatoni with sauce, meat on a platter.
wrapped in paper for the bus route
Grill Italian sausages, then soften sliced capsicum and onion in the same pan with oregano. Pile into a long roll with provolone, wrap in baking paper to steam 5 minutes.
W: a box from Belmont's bakery for Sonny
Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar, vanilla and mini choc chips, piped into bought shells right before serving, ends in crushed pistachio.
K: Short espresso in a demitasse with 15ml anisette or sambuca on the side to pour in, a curl of lemon peel.
T: The saddest thing in life is a wasted dinner.
D: A bus driver's son is torn between his honest father and the neighbourhood boss.
P: Do the car door test before dessert comes out.

title: Once Upon a Time in America
S: hot mustard, Lower East Side street food
Mash potatoes with onion cooked low in schmaltz or butter, salt and white pepper. Wrap in rolled puff pastry, egg wash, bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Hot English mustard.
Lower East Side herring and rye bites
the Lower East Side streets where Noodles and the boys grow up

Pickled herring on buttered dark rye with sour cream, red onion, dill and a sliced dill pickle for crunch. Cut 6 slices dark rye into quarters and toast lightly. Butter each piece thinly. Drain 250g pickled herring fillets and cut into 24 bite-sized pieces. Mix 100g sour cream with 1 tsp lemon juice and a pinch of pepper. Spoon a little sour cream onto each toast, top with herring, a slice of dill pickle and a few rings of very thinly sliced red onion. Finish with chopped dill.
Slice day-old bagels thin, brush with oil, bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Whip cream cheese with chives and lemon zest, lox on the side.
M: slow braised with onions and gravy
Season brisket, sear hard, then braise at 150C on a bed of sliced onions with stock, tomato paste and paprika for 4 hours, covered. Rest, slice against the grain, reduce the juices to gravy.
eaten in the speakeasy back room
Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until soft and glistening. Pile high on seeded rye with yellow mustard. Full sour pickle on the side.
W: sponge, whipped cream and a cherry, try not to eat it on the stairs
Line paper cups with a disc of sponge, pipe whipped cream stabilised with a little mascarpone and vanilla high in a swirl, top with a maraschino cherry.
K: Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups
the speakeasy behind Fat Moe's, Prohibition in full swing

Rye whiskey shaken hard with lemon, sugar syrup and egg white, poured into china teacups with a few drops of bitters. Make sugar syrup by dissolving 50g caster sugar in 50ml hot water, then cool. Shake in two rounds: 120ml rye whiskey, 60ml lemon juice, 40ml sugar syrup and 1 egg white, first without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 china teacups. Add 2 drops of aromatic bitters to the foam on each and serve straight away.
T: Fifty years of friendship, one very long dinner.
D: Four Lower East Side street kids grow into Prohibition gangsters, and one of them betrays the rest.
P: Bring the charlotte russe out when young Patsy sits on the stairs and eats the one he bought for Peggy.

title: Carlito's Way
S: fried green banana fritters with seasoned beef from El Barrio
Grate green bananas and taro, season with annatto oil and salt. Spread on baking paper, fill with beef picadillo, roll into logs and fry at 175C until crisp.
Soak salt cod 24 hours, changing the water, flake. Whisk flour, baking powder, water, garlic and coriander into a loose batter, fold in the cod, fry flat spoonfuls at 180C until lacy.
Fry green plantain chunks at 160C until soft, smash flat, fry again at 190C. Salt and spoon over garlic, lime and olive oil mojo.
M: slow roast pork shoulder with crackling, rice and pigeon peas
Stab pork shoulder all over, rub with garlic, oregano, adobo and vinegar, marinate overnight. Roast at 160C for 5 hours skin up, then 230C to crackle. Arroz con gandules alongside.
mashed plantain, pork crackling and garlic
Fry green plantain chunks, mash in a mortar with garlic, olive oil and crushed pork crackling. Pack into a bowl and turn out. Prawns sautéed in garlic butter with stock poured around.
W: caramel and coconut, for the beach postcard Carlito keeps
Caramelise 150g sugar into a ring tin. Blend condensed milk, coconut milk, evaporated milk and 5 eggs, pour over, bake in a water bath at 160C for 50 minutes. Chill overnight and turn out.
K: El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch
Carlito's club El Paraiso, and the paradise he keeps planning to run to

Dark rum shaken with pineapple, fresh lime and a little spiced syrup, served long over ice with grated nutmeg. Make spiced syrup by simmering 50g brown sugar, 50ml water and 1 cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, stir together 180ml dark rum, 360ml pineapple juice, 60ml lime juice, 40ml spiced syrup and 4 dashes aromatic bitters. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and pour the punch over. Grate a little nutmeg on top and garnish with a lime wheel.
T: One last score, then paradise.
D: A Puerto Rican ex-con swears he's going straight, but his old life won't let him go.
P: Have dessert on the table before the Grand Central finale.

title: Donnie Brasco
S: cured meats and giardiniera on the card table
Capicola, soppressata and mortadella with homemade giardiniera: cauliflower, carrot, celery and chilli blanched 1 minute then packed in vinegar, oil and oregano for 2 days.
Butterfly green prawns, sauté hot in olive oil with sliced garlic and chilli, white wine and butter to finish, parsley. Bread for the pan.
Slice firm mozzarella into fingers, freeze 20 minutes, double crumb with Italian seasoned breadcrumbs, fry at 180C for 90 seconds.
M: for the Japanese restaurant scene where nobody takes their shoes off
Reduce soy, mirin, sake and sugar to a glaze. Sear sirloin hard, brush with glaze in the last minute, rest and slice. Steamed rice and blanched greens.
Braciole: flatten beef topside, layer with garlic, parsley, pecorino and pine nuts, roll and tie. Brown with meatballs, braise 2 hours in tomato sauce. Serve with the pasta.
W: Beat 750g drained ricotta with 150g sugar, 4 eggs, lemon zest and vanilla. Bake at 160C in a lined tin for 60 minutes, cool in the oven. Dust with icing sugar.
K: Sonny Black's social club, where everyone drinks Scotch

Blended Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and aromatic bitters, served over a big ice cube with a cherry and orange peel. Put 4 heavy tumblers in the freezer for 15 minutes. Into a jug of ice pour 200ml blended Scotch, 80ml sweet vermouth and 8 dashes aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold, then strain into the tumblers over a large ice cube each. Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass, drop it in and add a cocktail cherry.
T: Forget about it.
D: An undercover FBI agent gets too close to the tired hitman who vouches for him.
P: Before the mains, explain all the meanings of "forget about it" to the table.

title: Mean Streets
S: charred and sliced, straight from the street feast
Grill Italian sausages over high heat until blistered, slice thick, toss with charred onion and capsicum, toothpicks and hot mustard.
Squid rings soaked in buttermilk, dredged in semolina and flour, fried at 190C for 90 seconds, salt and lemon.
Roast capsicums, peel and slice, marinate in garlic, vinegar and oil. Pile onto grilled garlic bread with torn basil.
M: Grill sausages, soften capsicum and onion with oregano in the fat, pile into crusty rolls with a spoon of tomato sauce.
as hot as Johnny Boy's temper
Fry garlic and plenty of dried chilli in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Toss penne through with pasta water, parsley and pecorino.
W: powdered sugar, straight from the street feast
Choux or yeasted dough dropped by the spoon into 175C oil, fried golden, tossed in a paper bag with icing sugar. Eat hot.
K: San Gennaro red wine with white peaches
the San Gennaro feast, poured from a jug the old Italian way

Chilled light red poured over sliced white peaches and left to soak, served in tumblers with the boozy fruit spooned in. Halve and stone 3 ripe white peaches, then slice thinly into a large jug. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp caster sugar and leave 10 minutes. Pour over 750ml light Italian red, such as Lambrusco secco or a young Chianti, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Serve in tumblers with a spoonful of peach in each. Eat the peaches last.
T: Sins in the street. Penance at the bar.
D: A small-time hood in Little Italy tries to keep his reckless friend Johnny Boy out of trouble.
P: Hit play on the jukebox and pour a round when Johnny Boy walks into Tony's bar.

title: Casino
S: Ace runs the Tangiers, so it had to be
Baked clams topped with bacon, capsicum, garlic butter and crumbs until crisp and bubbling. Steam 1kg clams until they open and remove the top shells.
Blitz spinach, parsley, spring onion, butter, breadcrumbs and a splash of aniseed liqueur. Top shucked oysters, grill hot for 3 minutes until bubbling.
M: Dry-brine rib eye on a rack overnight. Sear in a smoking pan, baste with butter, thyme and garlic to 54C inside, rest 8 minutes. Creamed spinach on the side.
Split lobster tails, brush with garlic and paprika butter, grill flesh up for 6 to 8 minutes until just opaque. Lemon and drawn butter.
W: count them, every one the same
Whisk 300g flour, 150g sugar, 2 tsp baking powder; combine with 2 eggs, 250ml buttermilk and 90g melted butter. Spoon into 12 cases and press exactly 10 blueberries into each. 190C for 20 minutes.
K: Stir 60ml gin with 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds, strain into a frozen martini glass, olive or a twist.
T: Every muffin gets the same number of blueberries.
D: A meticulous Vegas casino boss and his volatile enforcer mate lose their grip on the Tangiers.
P: Bring out the muffins and count the blueberries before anyone takes one.

title: Scarface
S: the lunch counter Tony walked out of
Soft sweet egg rolls with mustard, ham, roast pork, Swiss and pickle, buttered and pressed in a hot pan until flat and crisp.
camp food from under the freeway, before the green card

Thick béchamel with finely chopped serrano ham and nutmeg, chilled overnight, served hot on a paper plate with lime wedges. Melt 60g butter, stir in 70g plain flour for 2 minutes, then whisk in 500ml warm milk and cook 8 minutes until very thick. Stir in 100g finely chopped serrano ham and a pinch of nutmeg. Spread on a tray, cover and chill overnight. Roll into 16 logs, dip in 2 beaten eggs and 100g fine breadcrumbs, and fry at 180C until golden.
garlic mojo, Little Havana's side order
Fry green plantain at 160C, smash flat, fry again at 190C. Garlic, lime and oil mojo over the top, flaky salt.
M: shredded beef with capsicum, rice and black beans
Simmer flank steak with bay and onion 2 hours, shred. Sofrito of onion, capsicum and garlic, add cumin, oregano, tomato, olives and the beef with some broth, simmer 20 minutes. Rice and black beans.
the nightclub where Tony makes a scene
Eye fillet seared to medium rare and rested, king prawns in garlic butter, béarnaise of tarragon reduction, yolks and clarified butter.
W: The World Is Yours guava pastelitos
read it off the blimp over Miami

Cut puff pastry into squares, top with a slice of guava paste and a spoon of cream cheese, cover, seal, egg wash, sugar. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 4 squares each. Put a 30g slice of guava paste and a teaspoon of cream cheese in the middle of 4 squares, using 120g guava and 100g cream cheese in total. Cover with the other squares, press the edges with a fork, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
K: Tony's booth at the Babylon, before it all goes sideways

Muddle mint gently with 20ml sugar syrup and 25ml lime, add 50ml white rum and crushed ice, top with soda. Dissolve 60g caster sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. For each drink, gently muddle 8 mint leaves with 20ml syrup and 25ml lime juice in a tall glass, add 50ml white rum and fill with crushed ice. Top with soda water and stir. Makes four with 200ml rum and about 4 limes.
T: The world is yours. So is the last croqueta.
D: A Cuban refugee claws his way to the top of Miami's underworld.
P: Serve the mains when Tony first walks into the Babylon Club.

title: The Untouchables
S: Crisp fried risotto balls with a melting mozzarella middle, served with warm tomato sauce. Cook 300g arborio rice in 1L stock to a firm risotto, stir in 50g parmesan and cool completely.
Capone's banquet table, before the bat comes out
Platter of folded salami, mortadella and prosciutto with marinated artichokes, roast peppers, bocconcini and good bread, laid out banquet style down the middle of the table.
Chicago's own pickled peppers piled on toast
Chop hot giardiniera (pickled peppers, celery, carrot and cauliflower in oil) finely, pile onto toasted baguette rounds over a smear of ricotta.
M: Roast seasoned topside to rare, chill and shave thin. Warm in a jus of beef stock, garlic, oregano and black pepper. Pile into rolls, dip the whole sandwich, hot giardiniera on top.
Buttery cornmeal dough pressed up a deep tin. Mozzarella slices first, then a layer of raw Italian sausage, then chunky crushed tomato with oregano and parmesan. Bake at 220C for 35 minutes.
W: Little fried ricotta doughnuts tossed in icing sugar, light and soft in the middle. Mix 250g ricotta, 2 eggs, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon, then fold in 150g self-raising flour.
K: Stir 60ml rye, 10ml sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds, strain over a big cube, orange twist.
T: Never bring a knife to a gunfight. Bring a fork.
D: Eliot Ness and a hand-picked team take on Al Capone in Prohibition Chicago.
P: Pour Ness his drink at the very end, when he's finally earned one.

title: Prizzi's Honor
S: olives, salami and marinated mushrooms for the reception
Marinate button mushrooms (blanched 1 minute) in oil, lemon, garlic and parsley overnight. Platter with salami, olives and marinated artichokes.
Chilled saffron risotto rolled around a cube of mozzarella, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold. Marinara for dipping.
Zucchini batons tossed in flour then dipped in a light batter of flour and sparkling water, fried at 185C, salt and lemon.
M: Ziti in slow sausage sugo layered with seasoned ricotta and mozzarella, baked at 200C until blistered.
Veal escalopes pounded thin, floured and seared 60 seconds a side, pan sauce of white wine, lemon, capers and stock, cold butter whisked in.
W: Amaretti: whisk 2 egg whites stiff, fold in 250g almond meal, 200g sugar and almond extract. Roll in icing sugar, bake at 170C for 15 minutes until crackled.
K: the toast at the Prizzi wedding where Charley first spots Irene

Fresh white peach purée topped slowly with cold prosecco in flutes, with a squeeze of lemon to keep it bright. Peel and stone 2 ripe white peaches. Blend with 2 tsp lemon juice and 1 tsp caster sugar until smooth, then chill for 30 minutes. Spoon 40ml purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Top slowly with 120ml prosecco each, pouring down the side of the glass. Stir once with a long spoon and serve straight away.
T: Love, honour and a very complicated wedding.
D: A Brooklyn mob hitman falls for a woman who turns out to be in the same line of work.
P: Serve dessert at the wedding, when Charley first spots Irene.

title: Analyze This
S: three toppings, talk about your feelings between bites
Toasted baguette three ways: whipped ricotta and honey, tomato and basil, and chicken liver pâté with fig.
the Miami wedding Vitti's crew keeps interrupting

Squid rings soaked 30 minutes in buttermilk, dredged in semolina and flour, fried at 190C for 90 seconds. Slice 500g squid tubes into rings and soak in 250ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Mix 100g fine semolina and 100g plain flour with plenty of salt. Toss the drained squid through and fry at 190C in batches for 90 seconds. Salt and serve with 2 lemons cut into wedges.
comfort food for a man in crisis
Mozzarella sandwiched in crustless white bread, dipped in egg and milk, then crumbs, shallow-fried golden.
M: big plate, no talking about the panic attacks
Crumbed veal fried golden, topped with marinara, mozzarella and parmesan, grilled until bubbling. Spaghetti on the side.
for Ben's wedding that keeps getting crashed
Chicken thighs browned, braised with white wine, rosemary, lemon and green olives for 35 minutes.
W: what Vitti tells his shrink, and what you'll tell the cook

Drained ricotta with icing sugar and orange zest piped into shells at the last minute, chocolate ends. Drain 500g fresh ricotta for 2 hours, then beat with 80g icing sugar and the zest of 1 orange. Melt 50g dark chocolate and dip the ends of 8 cannoli shells, then let set. Pipe the filling in just before serving.
K: for when a patient turns up at 3am

Equal parts gin, bitter red aperitif and sweet vermouth stirred over ice, big cube, orange slice. For each drink, stir 30ml gin, 30ml bitter red aperitif and 30ml sweet vermouth over ice for 20 seconds and strain over a big ice cube in a tumbler. Add a slice of orange. Makes four with 120ml of each.
T: Therapy, but make it Italian.
D: A mob boss having panic attacks secretly books in with a nervous psychiatrist.
P: Serve dessert when Paul tells Ben "you, you're good".

title: Mickey Blue Eyes
S: Cured meats fanned out, bocconcini dressed with basil and oil, marinated artichokes, and button mushrooms roasted with garlic and thyme at 200C for 15 minutes.
Crustless white bread with cucumber and butter, egg and cress, smoked salmon and cream cheese, cut in fingers.
Michael's cover story, Mickey Blue Eyes from Kansas City

Ricotta ravioli dipped in egg and Italian breadcrumbs, fried at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp, parmesan and warm marinara to dip. Dip 400g fresh ricotta ravioli in 2 beaten eggs, then in 120g breadcrumbs. Fry at 180C in batches for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then drain. Shower with 30g grated parmesan and serve with 300ml warm passata seasoned with salt and oregano for dipping.
M: Gina's dad's restaurant, where the family drops in

Purge clams, steam open with garlic, chilli and white wine, tossed through linguine and brought to the table in the pan. Soak 1kg clams in salted water for 30 minutes to purge. Gently fry 4 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli in 60ml olive oil, add the clams and 150ml white wine, cover and steam 4 minutes until open. Cook 400g linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan juices and toss with chopped parsley and more olive oil.
the mob dinner Michael can't get out of
Chicken breast pounded thin, floured, egged and crumbed, fried golden, topped with marinara, mozzarella and parmesan and grilled until bubbling.
W: Michael's accent lesson, say it slower

Whisk 4 yolks with 100g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone then 4 whites whipped stiff. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g caster sugar until pale, then fold in 500g mascarpone and 4 egg whites whipped stiff. Mix 300ml strong espresso with 3 tbsp marsala. Dip 24 savoiardi biscuits quickly and layer with the cream in a dish. Dust with 2 tbsp cocoa and chill overnight.
K: Auction house gin and elderflower collins
for Michael, a very nervous English auctioneer

Gin shaken with elderflower cordial and lemon, topped with soda over ice with ribbons of cucumber and fresh mint. Peel 8 long ribbons from 1 Lebanese cucumber and curl two into each of 4 tall glasses, then fill with ice. Shake 160ml gin, 60ml elderflower cordial and 60ml lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds. Strain over the glasses and top each with 100ml soda water. Add a sprig of mint and serve.
T: Marry the girl. Marry the family.
D: An English auctioneer discovers his fiancée's family runs with the mob.
P: Serve the mains when Michael tries to do the Kansas City accent.

title: The Pope of Greenwich Village
S: prosciutto, melon and bocconcini, what Charlie plates up every night
Prosciutto draped over ripe rockmelon wedges, bocconcini dressed with basil oil (basil blitzed with oil and salt) and cracked pepper.
the boss nobody crosses, Paulie least of all

Steam clams open, remove top shells, top with breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano, parmesan and olive oil, grill until golden. Steam 1kg clams with a splash of water in a covered pan until they open, about 4 minutes, and discard any closed ones. Remove the top shells. Mix 60g breadcrumbs, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 30g grated parmesan and 3 tbsp olive oil. Top each clam and grill for 3 minutes until golden.
Paulie's racetrack pepper and egg rolls
for a day at the track with Paulie's racehorse

Soft rolls stuffed with eggs scrambled through sweet fried capsicum and onion, pecorino and chilli, wrapped in paper. Thinly slice 2 red capsicums and 1 onion and fry in 3 tbsp olive oil over medium heat for 15 minutes until soft and sweet. Whisk 8 eggs with 30g grated pecorino, salt and pepper. Pour over the capsicum, then stir gently over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until just set. Split 4 soft long rolls, fill with the eggs, add chilli flakes and cut each in half.
M: Charlie's restaurant, before the big plan
Clams steamed open in garlic, chilli and white wine, linguine finished in the juices, parsley.
the dish Charlie plates while dreaming of his own place
Veal floured and seared, set aside. Mushrooms browned in the pan, marsala and stock reduced by half, cold butter whisked in, veal back to warm through.
W: whisked at the table, the way Charlie dreams of running his own place
Whisk 4 yolks, 60g sugar and 80ml marsala over simmering water for 6 to 8 minutes until thick and tripled. Serve warm over berries.
K: Paulie always has a plan, never the money

Bitter red aperitivo and sweet vermouth over ice, topped with cold soda and a fat slice of orange. Fill 4 tumblers with ice. Pour 40ml bitter red aperitivo and 40ml sweet vermouth into each glass and stir for 10 seconds. Top each with 80ml chilled soda water and stir once more. Cut 1 orange into thick half-moons and tuck one into each glass. Serve before the mains, the way Charlie would.
T: Big plans. Small cousins. Bad luck.
D: Two cousins working in a Village restaurant plan a safe job that goes sideways.
P: Pour the wine when Paulie gets caught skimming and loses them both their jobs.

title: Miller's Crossing
S: Hard-boil eggs 9 minutes, peel, pack into a jar with hot brine of vinegar, sugar, salt, beetroot juice and peppercorns. Pickle 3 days in the fridge.
Leo's greeting when Tom walks in

Sear chicken livers pink, deglaze with brandy, blitz with butter, thyme and shallot until silky, set under clarified butter. Trim 400g chicken livers and sear in butter for 2 minutes a side until still pink. Add 2 chopped shallots and thyme, then 40ml brandy and let it bubble off. Blitz with 150g soft butter until silky, season and press into a dish. Pour over 50g melted clarified butter and chill 4 hours. Serve with 8 slices toasted rye.
it's a question of ethics, Johnny says

Puff pastry with egg, aged cheddar, parmesan and cayenne, folded, cut, twisted, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush 2 sheets puff pastry with 1 beaten egg. Scatter one sheet with 80g grated aged cheddar, 30g grated parmesan and a pinch of cayenne, lay the other on top and press. Cut into 1.5cm strips, twist each and bake at 220C for 12 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: put the record on and let it simmer low

Brown lamb neck chops, layer with onion, carrot and potato, add stock and a bottle of stout, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Brown 1.2kg lamb neck chops in batches. Layer in a heavy pot with 2 sliced brown onions, 3 carrots in chunks and 800g potatoes in thick slices. Pour over 375ml stout and 300ml beef stock, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours until tender. Finish with chopped parsley.
talk about ethics while you eat it
Crumble Italian sausage into olive oil and brown, add garlic, chilli and a splash of cream and tomato, toss with penne and parmesan.
W: Layer buttered stale brioche with raisins soaked in Irish whiskey, pour over custard of 4 eggs, milk, cream and sugar, rest 30 minutes, bake at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: Tom Reagan's hot Irish whiskey toddy
Tom never puts his glass down, whatever the weather

Irish whiskey with honey, lemon and hot water, a clove-studded lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick to stir. Boil 600ml water. Stud 4 lemon wheels with 3 cloves each. In each of 4 heatproof glasses, put 45ml Irish whiskey, 1 tbsp honey and 15ml lemon juice. Top each with 150ml just-boiled water and stir until the honey dissolves. Float a studded lemon wheel on top, add a cinnamon stick and serve hot.
T: What's the rumpus?
D: A cool-headed advisor plays rival gang bosses against each other in a Prohibition-era town.
P: Plate up when Tom goes back into the woods looking for his hat.

title: Bugsy
S: Warm buckwheat blini 5 minutes at 180C, top with a spoon of crème fraîche, salmon roe or caviar and snipped chives.
the classic forties supper club starter
Prawns poached and iced, hung over coupes of shredded iceberg, Marie Rose with a splash of brandy, paprika and lemon.
the 1940s Hollywood crowd Ben ran with
Little gem lettuce cups filled with chopped chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, egg, tomato and blue cheese, a spoon of red wine vinaigrette over the top.
M: flambéed tableside, like the opening night
Flatten scotch fillet, sear hot, set aside. Shallot and garlic in butter, flame with brandy, add Dijon, Worcestershire, stock and cream, reduce, steak back in.
Halve cooked lobsters, dice the meat. Make a sauce of shallot, white wine, fish stock, cream, Dijon and gruyère, fold in the lobster, pile back into shells, gratinate.
W: raspberry cream for the hotel's namesake
4 whites whipped with 220g caster sugar, cornflour and vinegar, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven. Top with cream folded with crushed raspberries.
K: Gin, fresh lime and soda water over ice, crisp and sharp, the cocktail of the era.
T: He dreamed up Las Vegas. Then he blew the budget.
D: A charismatic gangster builds the Flamingo hotel in the Nevada desert.
P: Serve dessert when the Flamingo finally opens its doors.

title: Get Shorty
S: Bones should have left Chili's leather jacket alone

Crisp crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre, a Little Havana bakery classic. Melt 60g butter, cook 80g flour for 1 minute and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Stir in 200g finely chopped ham and nutmeg, chill 3 hours. Shape 20 logs, roll in egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C until golden.
the studio meetings Chili talks his way into
Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and baby cos with green goddess: blitz mayo, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, anchovy and lemon.
Chili's Miami, before he heads out to LA
Puff pastry squares filled with guava paste and cream cheese, brushed with egg, baked at 200C for 18 minutes and dusted with sugar while hot.
M: he knows exactly how a scene should go
Sirloin seared hard and rested, sliced. Pan sauce: shallot sweated in the fat, red wine reduced, cold butter whisked in. Double-fried frites.
Rows of chopped chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese on cos with red wine vinaigrette.
W: the schlock horror producer who needs one good script

Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge, a handful of caramel popcorn (popcorn tossed in brown sugar and butter caramel, baked to set) and salted peanuts. Pop 40g popcorn kernels. Melt 50g butter with 80g brown sugar, toss through the popcorn and bake at 150C for 10 minutes to set. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop 8 balls of vanilla ice cream into four bowls, pour over the fudge and top with the popcorn and 50g salted peanuts.
K: Chili's whole acting lesson in two words

45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper, rolled between tins, celery stick. For each drink, put 45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, 10ml lemon juice, 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce, 2 dashes hot sauce and a pinch each of celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice. Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times, strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Makes four.
T: Look at me. Now pass the dip.
D: A Miami loan shark goes to Hollywood to collect a debt and ends up producing a movie.
P: Serve the mains when Chili starts pitching his movie idea.

title: The Freshman
S: the secret supper club where the menu is the scandal

Salami, mortadella and provolone with roasted capsicum, marinated artichokes and a loaf of seeded Italian bread torn at the table. Arrange 100g salami, 100g mortadella and 150g provolone on a board. Add 2 roasted red capsicums cut into strips and 200g marinated artichokes. Tear a loaf of seeded Italian bread at the table.
Carmine's Little Italy, where every deal starts at the table

Steamed clams on the half shell under garlic, oregano, parmesan and lemon breadcrumbs, grilled until crisp and bubbling. Purge 1kg vongole in cold salted water for 30 minutes, then steam in a covered pan with 100ml white wine for 3 to 4 minutes until open. Discard any that stay shut and remove top shells. Mix 60g breadcrumbs, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 30g grated parmesan, chopped parsley, lemon zest and 3 tbsp olive oil. Press onto each clam. Grill on high for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Serve with lemon wedges.
Tender squid rings in a light crisp coating, with lemon and marinara. Slice 500g squid tubes into rings, soak in 200ml milk for 20 minutes and toss in 120g flour mixed with 2 tbsp semolina and salt.
M: an offer Clark can't quite refuse

Thin veal floured and seared in butter, pan sauce of marsala, mushrooms and stock reduced and finished with cold butter. Dust 600g veal escalopes with seasoned flour and sear in 20g butter and a little oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside. Brown 250g sliced button mushrooms in the pan, add 150ml marsala and 150ml beef stock and reduce by half. Whisk in 40g cold butter, return the veal and warm through.
roast chicken, nothing endangered on this menu
Dry-brine a chicken overnight, butter and lemon under the skin, roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C until 72C in the thigh. Rest 15 minutes, roast potatoes in the fat.
W: a box from Little Italy for the drive back to campus
Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar, vanilla and mini choc chips, piped into shells just before serving, pistachio ends.
K: Carmine's table, where the glasses never stay empty

Italian amaro and prosecco over ice with a splash of soda and a slice of orange, bittersweet and easy to drink. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice. Add 50ml Italian amaro to each glass, then 90ml chilled prosecco and 30ml soda water. Stir once gently. Cut 1 orange into thin wheels and slide one into each glass. Serve straight away while the bubbles are lively.
T: Some lessons aren't taught at film school.
D: A film student gets a job with a man who looks a lot like Vito Corleone.
P: Serve the mains when the Gourmet Club menu gets read out.

title: Moonstruck
S: warm bread from Ronny's bakery, the Cammareri Bros. ovens

Thick olive oil focaccia dimpled with rosemary and flaky salt, baked crisp-bottomed and torn warm at the table with peppery oil. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 10g salt and 400ml warm water into a wet dough. Cover and rise 2 hours. Oil a 30 x 20cm tin with 60ml olive oil, tip in the dough and stretch to the corners. Rest 30 minutes, then dimple deeply with oiled fingers. Scatter with rosemary leaves and flaky salt and drizzle with 30ml oil. Bake at 230C for 22 to 25 minutes until deep golden.
Loretta's breakfast: a red capsicum ring and an egg in toast
Cut a hole in thick white bread, fry in butter, drop a thick ring of red capsicum in the pan with an egg inside it, cook until the white sets. Salt and pepper.

Thin salami and provolone, olives warmed with orange peel and fennel seed, and roasted capsicum dressed in garlic oil. Char 2 red capsicums under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, then cover in a bowl for 10 minutes. Peel, slice and dress with 1 sliced garlic clove, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Warm 200g mixed olives in 1 tbsp oil with 2 strips orange peel and 1 tsp fennel seeds for 3 minutes. Arrange with 100g thinly sliced salami and 100g provolone on a platter.
M: the restaurant where the whole family keeps running into each other
Linguine with clams steamed open in garlic, chilli and white wine, finished in the juices with parsley and olive oil.
Thin chicken breast floured and seared, lemon, white wine and butter pan sauce with capers and parsley.
W: Drained ricotta with icing sugar and orange zest piped into shells at the last minute, chocolate-dipped ends.
K: Loretta's family, bottle of wine and a full moon
Amaretto shaken with lemon and egg white until frothy, poured over ice with a cherry.
T: Snap out of it and eat.
D: A Brooklyn widow falls for her fiancé's angry baker brother under a big full moon.
P: Bring out the bread when Ronny is in the bakery basement.

title: Big Night
S: Primo's kitchen, every grain treated with respect
Chilled saffron risotto rolled around mozzarella and peas, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold.
red, white and green, the tricolore from the big night
One base risotto split three ways: tomato and basil, parmesan and butter, and pea and mint purée. Serve side by side in one shallow bowl.
the opening course of the big night
Prosciutto and bresaola laid flat, bresaola dressed with lemon, oil and rocket, marinated eggplant, peeled roast capsicum, olives and warm bread.
M: the giant baked pasta drum, sliced at the table

Line a buttered dome with thin pasta dough. Layer ziti in ragù with salami, boiled egg, provolone and tiny meatballs, fold the dough over, bake at 180C for 1 hour, rest 30 minutes, turn out and cut like a cake.
the main event, or pork belly if your oven is small
Score pork belly skin, dry overnight in the fridge, rub with salt and fennel seed. Roast at 160C for 2.5 hours, then blast at 240C until it crackles.
W: Heat 500ml cream, 100ml milk, 80g sugar and a split vanilla pod, bloom 2 gelatine leaves, whisk in, pour into moulds, set 6 hours. Turn out with berries.
K: the brothers' nightcap in the kitchen after the big night

Short, strong espresso corrected with a splash of grappa, a little sugar stirred through and an almond biscuit on the saucer. Make 4 short espressos with 18g of finely ground coffee each, or brew 200ml very strong stovetop coffee. Pour into 4 small cups. Stir 1 tsp caster sugar into each cup, then add 20ml grappa. Serve each on a saucer with an amaretti biscuit, the way you would finish a long night in the kitchen.
T: One night to save the restaurant.
D: Two Italian brothers bet everything on one huge dinner to save their struggling restaurant.
P: Bring out the timpano when the dinner guests hold their breath.

title: Raging Bull
S: rice balls from Jake's Italian neighbourhood
Leftover risotto rolled around a cube of mozzarella, crumbed, fried at 180C until golden, served with warm marinara for dipping.
Bronx devilled eggs with crisp pancetta
Jake's Miami club years, working the room between tables

Jammy-yolked eggs piped with mustard and mayo filling, topped with crisp pancetta, paprika and chives. Lower 6 eggs into boiling water, cook 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel. Fry 6 slices pancetta in a dry pan for 4 minutes until crisp, drain and crumble. Halve the eggs, mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and pepper. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Top with pancetta, smoked paprika and snipped chives.
the nightclub where it all falls apart
Prawns poached and iced, with a sharp cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon.
M: cooked properly this time, nobody gets yelled at
Dry-brine porterhouse overnight, sear in a smoking pan, baste with butter and garlic, pull at 52C, rest 8 minutes.
Brown meatballs, sausage and pork neck bones, simmer in tomato sauce with garlic and basil for 2 hours, rigatoni.
W: from the Bronx bakery on the corner
Beat 750g drained ricotta, 150g sugar, 4 eggs, lemon zest and vanilla, bake at 160C for 60 minutes, cool in the oven, icing sugar.
K: Jake's Miami nightclub years, telling jokes from the stage

Golden rum with orange, pineapple and lime, a splash of grenadine, served long over crushed ice with an orange slice. In a jug, stir 180ml golden rum, 240ml orange juice, 240ml pineapple juice, 60ml lime juice and 30ml grenadine. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice, pour the punch over and finish each with an orange slice and a cocktail cherry on a pick.
T: Fight hard. Eat harder.
D: Boxer Jake LaMotta's rise and fall, inside the ring and out.
P: Serve the steak when Jake starts complaining his steak is overcooked.

title: Saturday Night Fever
S: Grilled Italian sausage with sweet capsicum and onion, cut into bites and served on sticks.
gravy and cheese at 2am after the club
Crisp fries smothered in hot beef gravy and melted mozzarella, under the grill for a minute.
M: fold them together and keep walking, like Tony
New York pie: cold-fermented dough stretched thin, thin tomato sauce, low-moisture mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at the oven's max. Cut big, stack two, fold.
the family dinner where someone always gets a slap
Pork and beef meatballs with soaked bread, egg and pecorino, browned, simmered in tomato sauce for an hour, spaghetti and more pecorino.
W: Crumble butter cake with cream cheese frosting, roll balls, chill, dip in white chocolate, roll in silver cachous.
K: a round at the bar of the 2001 Odyssey disco

Blended whisky shaken with lemon and sugar syrup, topped with lemonade and soda over ice, finished with a lemon wheel. Dissolve 40g caster sugar in 40ml hot water and cool. Shake 180ml blended whisky, 60ml lemon juice and 40ml of the syrup with ice for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 ice-filled highball glasses. Top each with 60ml lemonade and 60ml soda water, stir once and add a lemon wheel.
T: Strut in. Fold your slice. Strut out.
D: A Brooklyn paint shop worker lives for Saturday nights on the 2001 Odyssey dance floor.
P: Serve the slices during the opening walk down 86th Street.

title: My Cousin Vinny
S: the grits cross-examination, nobody can cook them that fast
Stone-ground grits whisked into boiling salted milk and water, stirred low for 25 minutes until creamy. Finish with butter and sharp cheddar.
Slice green tomatoes 1cm, salt 10 minutes, dip in buttermilk then seasoned cornmeal, fry at 180C. Remoulade of mayo, mustard, capers and hot sauce.
the diner where Vinny tries to order breakfast
Grated frozen butter into self-raising flour, buttermilk, fold and cut, bake at 220C. Brown sausage meat, add flour, then milk, simmer thick with plenty of pepper.
M: the corner store where the whole mess started
Pound thin steaks, dredge in seasoned flour, buttermilk, flour again, shallow-fry until crisp. Cream gravy from the pan with flour, milk and black pepper.
Vinny's hunting trip with the DA
Brown venison or beef mince with onion, garlic and capsicum, add chilli powder, cumin, tomato and kidney beans, simmer 90 minutes. Cornbread alongside.
W: Wazoo, Alabama, ticking clock and all
Juicy blackberries baked under a soft biscuit topping, served warm with cream. Toss 750g blackberries with 100g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a dish.
K: Southern style in Wazoo, Alabama, so sweet your teeth hurt

Strong black tea sweetened with fresh peach syrup and lemon, poured over ice with peach slices and mint. Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 120g caster sugar and 150ml water for 10 minutes, mash lightly and strain, keeping the syrup. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1 litre just-boiled water for 5 minutes and remove. Stir in the peach syrup and juice of half a lemon, then chill for 2 hours. Serve over ice with fresh peach slices and mint.
T: Two yutes walk into a diner.
D: A Brooklyn mechanic turned lawyer defends his cousin in a small Alabama town.
P: Serve breakfast during the grits cross-examination.

title: Things to Do in Denver When You're Dead
S: Jimmy's video business for the dying
Boil eggs 10 minutes, whip yolks with mayo, Dijon and pickle juice, pipe back in, paprika and chives.
Colorado green chile, with chips for dunking
Roasted green chiles chopped and stirred into melted white cheese with milk and garlic, served hot with corn chips for dunking.
M: the diner booth where the job gets planned
Thin beef patty on rye with Swiss and slow-cooked onions, griddled in butter until crisp outside and melted inside.
ham, capsicum and onion, the city's own breakfast
Sauté diced ham, capsicum and onion, add 3 beaten eggs, fold with cheddar when just set.
W: Colorado dessert for Jimmy's last good night
Puffed little fried pastry pillows, split open and drizzled with honey and a pinch of cinnamon, the Denver diner way.
K: White rum blended thick with pineapple, coconut cream and ice, served with a toasted coconut rim and a cocktail umbrella. Toast 30g desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden, cool on a plate. Wet the rims of 4 glasses with a lime wedge and dip in the coconut. Blend 200ml white rum, 240ml pineapple juice, 160ml coconut cream, 30ml lime juice and 4 cups ice until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses, add a pineapple wedge and a cocktail umbrella.
T: Boat drinks.
D: A reformed crook pulls together an old crew for one last job that goes wrong.
P: Pour boat drinks every time someone says "boat drinks".

title: The Departed
S: with oyster crackers, the Boston way
Render bacon, sweat onion and celery, add diced potato, clam juice and thyme, simmer, add chopped clams and cream for the last 3 minutes. Oyster crackers.
Wholemeal flour, bicarb, salt and buttermilk mixed into a soft round, cut with a deep cross, baked at 220C for 35 minutes, thick slices with salted butter.
Clam meat soaked in evaporated milk, dredged in corn flour and plain flour, fried at 185C for 60 seconds. Tartare and lemon.
M: the Irish pub where the crew drinks
Flathead or cod dipped in a batter of flour, cornflour and ice-cold lager, fried at 180C. Triple-cooked chips, mushy peas with mint, malt vinegar.
Cooked lobster tossed lightly with mayo, lemon and celery, piled into butter-toasted split-top rolls, chives.
W: Two genoise layers sandwiched with vanilla crème pâtissière, glossy dark chocolate ganache poured over the top.
K: Costigan's bar order, a natural diuretic, and the bartender's remark

Cranberry juice shaken with fresh lime and a little orange, topped with soda over crushed ice, vodka optional if you need to keep your cover. Shake 400ml cranberry juice, 60ml lime juice, 60ml orange juice and 20ml sugar syrup with ice for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 short glasses filled with crushed ice. Top each with 50ml soda water and add a lime wedge. For the grown-up version, add 30ml vodka to each glass before topping.
T: Two rats. One city. Plenty of chowder.
D: A cop goes undercover with Boston's Irish mob while a mob mole rises in the police.
P: Serve the mains when Costigan and Sullivan figure out who the other one is.

title: Road to Perdition
S: Diner grilled cheese with quick pickles
the roadside diners across Illinois where Sullivan and his son stop

Sharp cheddar grilled cheese fried in butter until crisp, cut into fingers and served with sweet dill bread-and-butter pickles. Thinly slice 2 Lebanese cucumbers and 1 small onion. Heat 150ml white vinegar, 100ml water, 60g sugar, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp mustard seeds until dissolved, pour over and cool for 30 minutes. Butter 8 slices white bread on the outside, fill with 200g sliced cheddar and fry over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Cut into fingers and serve with the pickles.
the old couple who take them in
Rye sourdough warmed at 180C for 8 minutes, salted butter and apple butter (apples cooked down slowly with cider and cinnamon).
Warm Irish soda bread with a craggy crust, torn and served with salted butter and sharp cheddar.
M: Slow-simmered corned beef sliced thick with buttery cabbage, carrots and potatoes and hot mustard. Simmer a 1.5kg corned silverside with an onion, 2 bay leaves and 6 peppercorns for 2.5 hours.
the diner stops on the run
Poach chicken thighs, make a velouté with the stock, butter and flour, add peas, carrot and thyme, top with puff pastry, bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: farmhouse style, like the old couple would serve
Deep-dish apple pie with a slice of sharp cheddar melted on top in the last 5 minutes.
K: the Rooney wake, 1931, whiskey poured freely for the dead

Hot strong coffee with Irish whiskey and brown sugar, under a thick collar of lightly whipped cream. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft ribbons, so it just holds its shape. Brew 600ml strong coffee. Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out. Add 2 tsp brown sugar and 40ml Irish whiskey to each glass, then 150ml coffee, and stir until dissolved. Pour the cream gently over the back of a spoon to float on top. Do not stir.
T: Every father wants better for his son.
D: A mob enforcer and his son go on the run across Depression-era Illinois.
P: Serve dessert at the diner stop on the road to Perdition.

title: Ghostbusters
S: green spinach and artichoke dip, corn chips for scooping
Wilt spinach, squeeze dry, chop with marinated artichokes, fold into cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella and parmesan with garlic. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling.
in honour of the big guy
Big marshmallows on skewers, toasted over a flame until the outside blisters. Dip in melted dark chocolate and crushed biscuits.
there's something in the fridge, and it isn't the eggs
Whip yolks with mayo, Dijon and a drop of green colouring, pipe back into whites, chives on top.
M: long enough for the whole crew
Pork and beef meatballs baked then simmered in marinara, packed into a long roll with provolone and grilled until melted.
dumplings and fried rice eaten out of the boxes on the desk
Fried rice with day-old rice, egg, lap cheong, spring onion and soy in a smoking wok. Pan-fried pork dumplings alongside.
W: giant marshmallows, toasted until they melt down
Big marshmallow toasted, sandwiched between digestive biscuits with a square of milk chocolate. Under the grill for 30 seconds if there's no fire.
K: Blitz ice with lime cordial and lemonade until slushy, a drop of green colouring.
T: Slime included. Ghosts not.
D: Three out-of-work scientists open a ghost removal business in a Manhattan firehouse.
P: Crack the drinks when Ecto-1 rolls out of the firehouse for the first time.

title: Ghostbusters II
S: beetroot and feta, flatbread for scooping
Roast beetroot, blitz with feta, Greek yoghurt, garlic, lemon and dill until hot pink. Warm flatbread.
the slime makes the toaster dance
Toast crumpets until the holes are crisp, brush with butter whipped with honey and a pinch of salt, cut into quarters.
Mini bagel pizzas with hot salami
fuel for Dana's long days restoring paintings at the museum

Toasted mini bagels with oregano tomato sauce, hot salami and bubbling mozzarella, baked crisp and finished with chilli honey. Halve 8 mini bagels and toast lightly. Mix 150g passata with 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of salt and spread over the cut sides. Top with 100g sliced hot salami and 150g grated mozzarella. Bake at 220C for 8 to 10 minutes until bubbling and the edges are crisp. Warm 2 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over before serving.
M: Liberty hot dogs with green relish
for the walk up Fifth Avenue behind the Statue of Liberty

Griddled franks in steamed buns with mustard, bright green pickle relish, diced onion and a hot sauerkraut topping. Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes, then griddle on a hot pan for 3 minutes until blistered. Finely chop 2 dill pickles and half a green capsicum, mix with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp white vinegar for the relish. Warm 200g sauerkraut in a small pan. Steam 8 hot dog buns over the frank water for 1 minute. Fill with franks, mustard, relish, diced onion and sauerkraut.
slow paprika beef for the Carpathian painting
Chuck browned, onions cooked down, sweet and hot paprika, caraway, tomato and stock, braised 2.5 hours. Sour cream and egg noodles.
W: it wobbles and reacts to music
Pink lemonade set with gelatine (4 leaves per 500ml) in a jelly mould. Play something upbeat while you turn it out.
K: Pink lemonade over ice with a scoop of raspberry sorbet.
T: Bad vibes. Good dip.
D: Five years on, the Ghostbusters find a river of pink slime under New York.
P: Bring dessert out when the Statue of Liberty starts walking.

title: Do the Right Thing
S: the wall of fame watches you eat
Strips of pizza dough tied in knots, proved 30 minutes, baked at 230C for 12 minutes, tossed hot in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.
the only cool thing on the block on the hottest day of the year

Ice-cold watermelon and salty feta on skewers with mint, finished with lime juice and a chilli salt sprinkle. Cut 1kg chilled seedless watermelon into 3cm cubes and 200g firm feta into 2cm cubes. Thread onto 16 skewers, alternating with small mint leaves. Mix 1 tsp flaky salt, half a tsp chilli flakes and the zest of 1 lime. Squeeze the lime juice over the skewers, sprinkle with the chilli salt and serve straight from the fridge.
for when the fire hydrant gets opened
Blend watermelon with lime juice and a little sugar syrup, strain, pour into moulds with sticks and freeze at least 6 hours.
M: pepperoni and extra cheese, straight from the wall of fame
New York pie on a hot steel at max heat: thin sauce, low-moisture mozzarella, pepperoni, oregano. Cut big.
ham and provolone, the corner men's lunch
Long roll split, leg ham and sharp provolone layered, shredded lettuce, tomato and onion, dressed with olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
W: for the heat on the block
Shave or crush ice into cups, soak with homemade cherry syrup: cherries simmered with sugar and lemon, strained.
K: Da Mayor and his cold beer on the hottest day of the year

Frosty lager topped with fresh homemade lemonade in chilled glasses, a lemon wheel and plenty of ice. Make lemonade by stirring 100ml lemon juice, 80g caster sugar and 300ml cold water until dissolved. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Half-fill each glass with ice-cold lager, about 180ml, then top with 100ml of the lemonade. Add a lemon wheel and serve straight away.
T: Hottest day of the year. Coldest drinks in the house.
D: Tensions boil over at Sal's pizzeria on the hottest day of a Brooklyn summer.
P: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie makes his first delivery.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
S: Roll pizza dough thin, spread sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella, roll up, slice and bake at 220C for 15 minutes.
Channel 3 news, live from the sewers
Strips of pizza dough tied in knots, proved 30 minutes, baked at 230C for 12 minutes, tossed hot in garlic butter and parmesan.
he is a rat, after all
Aged cheddar, brie and gouda at room temperature for an hour, crackers, grapes and a drizzle of honey on the brie.
M: one for each brother, Mikey calls the toppings

Four bases: pepperoni, mushroom, supreme, and one with everything left in the fridge. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 balls and stretch thin. Spread each with pizza sauce, using 400ml in total, and 400g grated mozzarella across all four. Top one with pepperoni, one with sliced mushrooms, one with pepperoni, mushroom and capsicum, and one with whatever is left. Bake each on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting for 8 minutes.
Casey Jones hockey stick hot dogs
Foot-long franks griddled until blistered, in long buttered rolls with yellow mustard and onions fried slowly until soft and brown.
W: choc chip base with candy toppings
Press choc chip cookie dough into a pizza tray, bake at 180C for 15 minutes, top with melted chocolate and sweets.
K: April O'Neil, reporting live from the sewer

Fresh green apple juice and lime topped with soda, bright green and sharp. Blend 3 green apples with the juice of 2 limes and 200ml water and strain. Divide over ice in 4 glasses and top with soda water.
T: Four brothers. Four pizzas. Zero leftovers.
D: Four mutant turtle brothers and their rat sensei take on the Foot Clan from the sewers of New York.
P: Order the pizza when it gets delivered down the drain.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
S: scooped straight from the research canister

Mash avocado with lime juice and salt, fold in finely diced red onion, coriander and chilli, press plastic wrap on the surface until serving. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes and salt. Fold in half a finely diced red onion, a handful of chopped coriander and 1 chopped red chilli. Press plastic wrap on the surface until serving so it stays green. Serve with 300g corn chips.
the turtles never stop at one pizza
Split mini bagels topped with pizza sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, grilled until bubbling. Split 12 mini bagels and spread each half with pizza sauce.
Keno, the pizza delivery kid who joins the fight

Pizza dough rolled around tomato, pepperoni and mozzarella, sliced into scrolls and baked golden with a garlic butter glaze. Roll 500g pizza dough into a 40 x 30cm rectangle. Spread with 120g pizza sauce, then scatter 100g sliced pepperoni and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Place on a lined tray and bake at 220C for 15 to 18 minutes until golden. Brush with 30g butter melted with 1 crushed garlic clove and parsley.
M: pizza for every meal in the turtles' new hideout

Toasted sub rolls loaded with beef meatballs in pizza sauce, pepperoni and melted mozzarella, grilled until bubbling. Mix 500g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g parmesan, salt and pepper, and roll 16 meatballs. Brown in oil for 5 minutes, add 400g pizza sauce and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through. Split 4 sub rolls, toast lightly, fill with meatballs, sauce and 50g pepperoni, and top with 200g grated mozzarella. Grill for 3 minutes until melted.
never pay full price for late pizza

Thin base with tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni, fresh pineapple and sliced jalapeño, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rest 2 balls of pizza dough, about 500g, at room temperature for an hour. Stretch thin, spread with 200ml pizza sauce and top with 250g grated mozzarella, 100g pepperoni, 200g fresh pineapple pieces and 1 sliced jalapeño. Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting for 8 minutes.
W: Tokka and Rahzar mint choc shakes
two mutant babies, one shake each

Blend 3 scoops of mint choc chip ice cream with 200ml cold milk until thick, pour into chilled glasses. Blend 12 scoops mint choc chip ice cream, about 750ml, with 800ml cold full cream milk until thick and smooth. Pour into four chilled tall glasses and serve with straws.
K: Ooze canister lime and kiwi slushie
a safe batch of ooze, nothing mutagenic in it

Kiwifruit, lime juice and lemonade blitzed with ice into a bright green slush, served with a fat straw. Peel and chop 4 kiwifruit. Blend with 60ml lime juice, 2 tbsp honey and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Add 400ml cold lemonade and pulse twice to mix without losing the fizz. Pour into 4 glasses, add a lime wheel and serve with thick straws.
T: Go ninja, go ninja, go eat.
D: The Turtles return to stop Shredder from making new mutants with the last of the ooze.
P: Bring out the snacks when the Turtles start the rap in the club.

title: Spider-Man 2
S: Strips of pizza dough tied in knots, proved 30 minutes, baked at 230C for 12 minutes, tossed in garlic butter and parsley.
from the cart on Peter's walk to class
Mashed potato with fried onion and pepper wrapped in thin dough, brushed with egg, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden, mustard on the side.
J. Jonah wants pictures, not excuses
Toasted bagels with a thick schmear of cream cheese, lox, capers and thinly sliced red onion.
M: Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and cupping pepperoni, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
for when Peter finally comes home for dinner
Butter-rubbed chicken roasted at 220C then 180C, root vegetables in the pan, gravy from the drippings.
W: butter and syrup for her boy
Buttermilk batter with whipped egg whites folded through, cooked in butter until bubbles set, stacked high with maple syrup.
K: Cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
T: Thirty minutes or it's free.
D: Peter Parker struggles to balance his life, his job at Joe's Pizza and being Spider-Man.
P: Order the pizza when Peter races across the city on a delivery.

title: Spider-Man
S: Bone Saw egg and cheese rolls
three minutes in the ring, then breakfast

Soft rolls with fried eggs, melted American cheese and a shake of salt, pepper and hot sauce, wrapped in foil the way the corner bodega does it. Split 4 soft rolls and toast lightly. Fry 8 eggs in 20g butter, breaking the yolks, and lay 2 slices American cheese over each pair to melt. Stack into the rolls with salt, pepper and a dash of hot sauce, wrap each in foil for 2 minutes so it all steams together.
turkey and cranberry for the awkward Osborn dinner
Slider buns toasted, warm sliced roast turkey, a spoon of cranberry sauce and a crisp square of baked stuffing in each.
Chilled risotto rolled into balls around a cube of mozzarella, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in chipotle and lime, grilled and sliced, in warm tortillas with shredded cabbage and sour cream whisked with lime.
Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested. Stuffing baked alongside, gravy from the pan juices, roast potato and pumpkin.
W: Uncle Ben's advice, served with syrup

Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in butter until bubbles set, stacked and drowned in maple syrup. Whisk 250g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Add 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 40g melted butter and rest 15 minutes. Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan over medium heat until bubbles set, then flip. Stack high and pour over 150ml maple syrup.
K: J. Jonah wants pictures, you want a drink

Lime juice and cherry syrup over ice, topped with soda water and a cherry. Squeeze 4 limes. Into each of 4 tall glasses of ice pour 30ml lime juice and 30ml cherry syrup, top with 200ml soda water, stir once and drop in a maraschino cherry and a lime wedge.
T: With great snacks comes great responsibility.
D: A bitten teenager becomes Spider-Man and faces the Green Goblin.
P: Serve the snacks at the wrestling match where Peter wins his first prize money.

title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
S: nuts and chocolate, the overpriced stuff
Roast mixed nuts with butter, brown sugar and rosemary, mix with chocolate-coated almonds and pretzels.
Prawns poached 2 minutes and iced, on shredded iceberg with Marie Rose sauce, a dusting of paprika and lemon wedges.
charged straight to Dad's credit card
Triple-decker toast with sliced chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, cut into quarters and pinned with toothpicks, served under a silver cloche if you have one.
M: a whole one, delivered to the car, just like Kevin
Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato with salt and oregano, low-moisture mozzarella, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into eight.
Macaroni in a Gruyère and cheddar béchamel, folded through with butter-poached lobster, buttered crumbs on top, baked.
W: Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, caramel, whipped cream, nuts, sprinkles and a cherry, piled high.
K: winter in Central Park with the pigeon lady
Cloudy apple juice warmed slowly with cinnamon sticks, cloves, orange peel and a little brown sugar, served steaming in mugs.
T: Room service. Charge it to Dad.
D: Kevin boards the wrong plane and ends up alone at a fancy New York hotel with Dad's credit card.
P: Order room service when Kevin gets his own suite.

title: Elf
S: Boil 200ml maple syrup with 40g butter to 120C, pour over popcorn, toss fast, spread on a tray to set and break into clusters.
Dip pretzel rods two-thirds into melted white chocolate, roll straight away in crushed candy canes, set on baking paper.
paper-thin sugar cookies for the store
Sugar cookie dough rolled thin, cut into snowflakes, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white.
M: maple syrup, chocolate and sweets, only for the brave
Spaghetti tossed in butter and maple syrup, topped with chocolate sauce, marshmallows and crushed sweets.
Buddy's first walk through the city
Franks simmered then griddled, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, onions cooked down in tomato and warm sauerkraut.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, cooled, domed with cream cheese frosting and rolled in shredded coconut.
K: Buddy congratulates the diner on the world's best cup of coffee

Hot chocolate milk with a shot of coffee and maple syrup, topped with whipped cream, mini marshmallows and crushed candy cane. Heat 800ml milk with 100g chopped milk chocolate and 3 tbsp maple syrup, whisking until smooth and steaming. Stir in 200ml strong coffee, or leave it out for the kids. Pour into 4 mugs, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream, a handful of mini marshmallows, a drizzle of maple syrup and crushed candy cane.
T: Four food groups. All of them sugar.
D: A human raised by Santa's elves goes to New York to find his real father.
P: Pour coffee when Buddy finds the world's best cup of coffee.

title: Taxi Driver
S: the cabbies' hangout at the end of every shift
Cut russets into thick chips, rinse, blanch at 140C for 6 minutes, rest 20 minutes, fry at 185C until crisp. Salt and a shaker of white vinegar on the table.
for a man who barely eats, laid out like a cab driver's dinner
Saltine crackers with slabs of sharp cheddar at room temperature, half-sour pickles cut in spears and a smear of hot English mustard.
M: Rare roast beef warmed in gravy and piled on toast, with mash and buttered peas, New York diner style.
Iris's diner breakfast with jam toast
the coffee shop breakfast where Travis tries to talk Iris into going home

Fried eggs, crisp bacon and golden hash browns with buttered toast spread with strawberry jam and a sprinkle of sugar, Iris style. Grate 600g washed potatoes, squeeze very dry in a tea towel and season. Fry in 3 tbsp oil as 4 flat cakes over medium heat for 6 minutes a side until crisp. Meanwhile fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp and keep warm. Fry 8 eggs in butter. Toast 8 slices white bread, butter, spread with strawberry jam and sprinkle with caster sugar. Plate everything together.
W: his breakfast of white bread and peach brandy, made properly
Butter thick white bread, layer with sliced peaches soaked in brandy and brown sugar. Pour over 4 eggs whisked with 500ml milk and vanilla, rest 20 minutes, bake at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: the night shift, and the peach brandy Travis pours over everything

Strong drip coffee with a nip of peach brandy and brown sugar, topped with a spoon of lightly whipped cream. Brew 800ml strong drip coffee using 50g ground coffee. Lightly whip 100ml thickened cream until just thick. Into each of 4 diner mugs put 1 tsp brown sugar and 30ml peach brandy, then pour in 200ml hot coffee and stir. Spoon a little cream on top and serve straight away.
T: Late shift. Black coffee. Long night.
D: A lonely Vietnam vet driving a night cab grows unhinged on New York's streets.
P: Pour the coffee when Travis sits with the other cabbies at the all-night diner.

title: The Warriors
S: the boardwalk at the end of the line
Cut potatoes with a crinkle cutter, rinse, blanch at 140C, fry at 185C until gold, salt and serve in paper cones with malt vinegar.
waiting at home by the beach
Soak clam strips in evaporated milk 10 minutes, dredge in half corn flour, half plain flour with salt, fry at 185C for 60 seconds. Tartare and lemon.
the cheapest hot dinner on the long ride home
Mashed potato and caramelised onion wrapped in pastry, baked at 200C until golden and crisp, eaten hot with deli mustard.
M: Chilli sauce: fine beef mince stirred into water so it stays loose, onion, chilli powder, cumin, paprika and tomato paste, simmered 45 minutes. Over griddled franks with mustard and raw onion.
the hero shop at the end of the line
Thinly sliced steak chopped on a hot griddle with onions, melted cheese folded through, stuffed into long hero rolls with lettuce, tomato and mayo.
W: Toffee apples: boil 400g sugar, 100ml water and a splash of vinegar to 150C, add red colouring, dip skewered apples, set on baking paper. Bought fairy floss alongside.
K: the soda fountain by the Coney Island station
Chocolate syrup and malted milk powder whisked into cold milk with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, blended until thick.
T: Make it home to Coney before the dogs go cold.
D: A Coney Island gang fights its way home across New York after being framed for murder.
P: Serve the dogs when the gang finally sees the ocean at Coney Island.

title: Midnight Cowboy
S: ham and cheese out of the little glass doors
Leg ham and Swiss on white with mustard butter, crusts off, cut into quarters, wrapped in wax paper.
the cheap diner breakfasts Joe Buck counts his coins for

Hot cinnamon sugar doughnut holes, fried to order, with a little pot of coffee custard for dunking. Mix 250g self-raising flour, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg, 150ml milk and 30g melted butter into a soft dough. Roll into 24 small balls. Fry at 170C for 3 minutes until golden and cooked through, then roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 300ml custard with 2 tsp instant coffee dissolved in 1 tbsp hot water and serve warm for dipping.
M: all they could afford in the squat
Brown sliced franks in a pot, soften onion, add tinned beans, smoked paprika, a spoon of molasses and mustard, simmer 20 minutes. Toast on the side.
Butterfly prawns, flour, egg, then panko mixed with shredded coconut, fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Sweet chilli and lime.
W: Boil 2 whole oranges for 1 hour, blitz, mix with 6 eggs, 250g sugar, 250g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder, bake at 180C for 1 hour.
K: Ratso's dream of sunshine in Florida

Coconut water, pineapple and fresh lime shaken with a little coconut cream, poured over ice with a pineapple wedge and white rum on the side. Shake 400ml coconut water, 300ml pineapple juice, 60ml lime juice and 60ml coconut cream with ice for 15 seconds until frothy. Strain into 4 ice-filled tall glasses. Add 30ml white rum to each glass for a boozy version. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a lime wheel.
T: Big city. Small bank balance.
D: A naive Texan hustler and a sickly con man scrape by together in New York.
P: Serve the mains when Joe and Ratso plan their bus trip to Florida.

title: Dog Day Afternoon
S: chant optional, the crowd outside the bank
Caramelise 2 onions for 40 minutes, cool, stir into sour cream and cream cheese with chives and salt. Thick-cut ridged chips.
sent in to feed the hostages behind the counter
Long hero rolls stacked with ham, salami, provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato and oil and vinegar, cut into wedges for passing around.
for the crowd outside the barricade
Pizza dough knots proved 30 minutes, baked at 230C for 12 minutes, tossed in garlic butter and parsley.
M: delivered to the door, the delivery kid becomes a star
Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato with salt and oregano, low-moisture mozzarella and pepperoni, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
salami and provolone, it's stinking hot in the bank
Long roll with Genoa salami, sharp provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato and onion, dressed with oil, red wine vinegar and oregano.
W: Simmer 200g sugar with 500ml water and lemon zest, cool, add 250ml lemon juice, freeze in a tray and scrape every 30 minutes for 3 hours.
K: Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt
for the cops sweating on the barricade outside the bank

Ice-cold lager poured over fresh lime in a glass with a chilli salt rim, sharp and salty for a stinking hot afternoon. Mix 1 tbsp flaky salt with half a tsp chilli powder and the zest of 1 lime on a plate. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 chilled glasses and dip in the chilli salt. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each glass, add 2 ice cubes, then pour in a cold 375ml bottle of lager slowly.
T: Pizza for the hostages.
D: A bank robbery in Brooklyn turns into a hot, chaotic media circus.
P: Order the pizza when it gets delivered to the bank.

title: Serpico
S: Toasted bagels with a thick schmear of cream cheese, lox, capers, red onion and dill.
the box on the squad room desk that Frank won't take for free
