Bakery yeast doughnuts warmed and dipped in a maple and brown butter glaze, finished with a pinch of flaky salt. Brown 40g butter in a small pan until nutty, about 3 minutes. Whisk in 150g icing sugar, 60ml maple syrup and 1 tbsp milk until smooth and pourable. Warm 8 plain yeast doughnuts at 160C for 2 minutes. Dip the tops into the glaze, set on a rack for 10 minutes and sprinkle with a few flakes of salt.
the free lunch Frank insists on paying for
Hot pastrami sliced thin, piled high on rye with deli mustard, a pickle on the side.
M: Frank pays for his own lunch, unlike the rest of the precinct
Steam sliced pastrami until glossy, pile into a long roll with Swiss, coleslaw and Russian dressing (mayo, tomato sauce, horseradish, pickle).
he lives in the Village and cooks for himself
Fry sliced garlic and dried chilli in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes, toss penne through with pasta water, parsley and pecorino.
W: Soft cake-like vanilla cookies baked at 180C for 12 minutes, flat side iced half with vanilla fondant icing, half with chocolate.
K: Village vanilla iced coffee, paid for
Frank's Greenwich Village life, cash on the counter every time

Cold-brewed coffee with vanilla syrup and creamy milk over ice, a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top. The night before, stir 80g coarse ground coffee into 800ml cold water and refrigerate 12 hours, then strain through a paper filter. Simmer 50g sugar with 50ml water and half a tsp vanilla extract for 1 minute and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml coffee, 15ml syrup and 80ml milk to each. Top with a small scoop of vanilla ice cream.
T: One honest cop. No free sandwiches.
D: An honest New York cop blows the whistle on police corruption.
P: Serve the mains when Frank turns down the free meal at the deli.

title: The French Connection
S: Popeye eating a slice in the cold while Charnier dines in style across the road

Crisp-bottomed tray pizza with tomato, mozzarella, oregano and chilli, cut into slices you can eat standing up in the street. Press 500g pizza dough into an oiled 30 x 40cm tray and rest 20 minutes. Mix 200g passata with 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 tsp dried oregano and salt and spread over the dough. Top with 250g grated mozzarella and 20g grated parmesan. Bake at 240C for 15 minutes until the base is crisp and the cheese is browned. Finish with chilli flakes and cut into 12 slices.
the fancy meal across the road
Sear chicken livers pink in butter, flame with cognac, blitz with butter, thyme and shallot, set under clarified butter. Cornichons and warm baguette.
Cake doughnuts tossed in cinnamon sugar with drip coffee in paper cups, eaten in the car.
M: the meal Popeye watches through the window
Sirloin seared hard and rested, béarnaise (tarragon reduction, yolks, warm clarified butter) and hand-cut frites fried twice.
Charnier's home port of Marseille, where the film opens

Firm white fish, prawns and mussels in a saffron, fennel and tomato broth, with toasted baguette and garlicky rouille. Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced fennel bulb and 3 garlic cloves in 3 tbsp olive oil for 10 minutes. Add a pinch of saffron, 400g tinned tomatoes, 1 litre fish stock and a strip of orange peel, and simmer 20 minutes. Add 500g firm white fish chunks for 4 minutes, then 12 green prawns and 500g mussels, covered, for 3 minutes until open. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and a pinch each of saffron and cayenne. Serve with toasted baguette.
W: the French dessert across the street
Caramel set into ramekins, vanilla custard of 4 eggs, 2 yolks and 500ml milk poured over, baked in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes, chilled and turned out.
K: a taste of Charnier's Marseille, where the heroin deal begins

Aniseed pastis with almond orgeat syrup and ice-cold water, turning cloudy and pale in a tall glass of ice. Put 30ml pastis and 15ml orgeat syrup into each of 4 tall glasses. Add 3 ice cubes, then slowly pour in 150ml chilled water and watch it turn cloudy. Stir once. Serve with a jug of cold water on the side so everyone can adjust the strength.
T: Pick your feet, grab a slice.
D: Two hard-nosed New York narcotics cops chase a French smuggling ring.
P: Serve the steak frites when Charnier sits down to dinner while Popeye freezes outside with his pizza.

title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
S: breakfast in the transit dispatch room
Puff pastry squares with a sweetened cream cheese centre, folded corners, baked at 200C for 16 minutes and drizzled with thin icing.
Bakery jam doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes and rolled straight away in caster sugar.
Gesundheit sesame lavash with whipped feta
paper-thin, for Mr Green, the hijacker with the cold

Paper-thin lavash brushed with oil, salt and sesame, baked crisp and snapped into shards, with lemony whipped feta for dipping. Brush 4 sheets lavash with 3 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with 2 tbsp sesame seeds and flaky salt. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp, cool and snap into shards. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and scatter with chilli flakes.
M: Long roll with sliced turkey, Swiss, shredded iceberg, tomato and mayo, wrapped tight in paper.
Whole chicken simmered 2 hours with carrot, celery, onion and dill, strained, meat back in, egg noodles.
W: Crescent-rolled cream cheese pastries filled with apricot jam, walnuts and cinnamon. Rub 225g butter and 225g cream cheese into 280g flour and chill 1 hour.
K: Mr Green's honey lemon whisky toddy
for Mr Green, whose sneeze gives the whole game away

Hot whisky with honey, lemon and fresh ginger, topped up with boiling water and stirred with a cinnamon stick. Thinly slice a 3cm piece of ginger. Into each of 4 heatproof glasses put 40ml whisky, 1 tbsp honey, 15ml lemon juice and two slices of ginger. Top each with 150ml just-boiled water and stir until the honey dissolves. Add a lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick and serve hot.
T: Subway hostage. Snacks on the platform.
D: Four men hijack a subway train and demand a ransom from the city.
P: Serve the snacks when Garber hears the sneeze.

title: Escape from New York
S: Cabbie has been driving that island for years and never stops to eat

Thin strips of topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, smoked paprika and chilli, dried low in the oven until chewy. Freeze 600g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tsp garlic powder. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry, lay on racks over trays and dry at 75C with the oven door slightly open for 3 to 4 hours until leathery but still bendy.
eating out of tins in a city with no shops
Sardines in oil on saltine crackers with a squeeze of lemon, hot sauce and parsley.
cooked over the drum fires on Manhattan's empty streets

Crisp corn and spring onion fritters spiked with jalapeño, fried in spoonfuls and served with smoky chipotle sour cream. Mix 150g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 125ml milk into a thick batter. Fold in 400g corn kernels, 3 sliced spring onions, 1 chopped jalapeño and salt. Shallow-fry heaped tablespoons in 1cm hot oil for 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain. Stir 1 chopped chipotle in adobo into 150g sour cream and serve alongside.
M: Beef chuck in chunks browned hard, braised 2.5 hours with onion, chipotle, cumin, oregano, tomato and kidney beans. Cornbread on the side.
whatever the Duke's crew could find on the island
Smoky sausage, potato, carrot, cabbage and beans simmered together in a big pot with stock and paprika until thick, scooped into tin mugs.
W: the kind of thing you'd stash in your pocket on Manhattan prison island

Chewy golden syrup oat slice baked in a tin and topped with a thick layer of dark chocolate and flaky salt. Melt 150g butter with 3 tbsp golden syrup and 100g brown sugar. Stir in 250g rolled oats and a pinch of salt, then press firmly into a lined 20cm square tin. Bake at 180C for 20 minutes until golden. Melt 150g dark chocolate, spread over the warm slice and sprinkle with flaky salt. Cool, chill for 1 hour and cut into 16 bars.
K: Clear corn whiskey shaken with lemon and sugar and served over ice in jam jars.
T: Get in. Get the President. Get dinner.
D: Snake Plissken has 24 hours to rescue the President from Manhattan, now a prison island.
P: Serve the mains when the Duke rolls up in his chandelier car.

title: King of New York
S: Frank's suite on his first night out
Prawns poached and iced, hung on glasses of shredded iceberg, cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon.
Pork and chive dumplings pan-fried until the bottoms crisp, a splash of water and a lid to steam, black vinegar and chilli oil dip.
M: Rib eye seared and rested, peppercorn sauce of cracked pepper, brandy, stock and cream, frites.
the hospital he's bankrolling in the South Bronx
Chicken brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside.
W: the only dessert in this town
Base of crushed biscuits and butter. 900g cream cheese beaten with sugar, sour cream, 4 eggs and lemon zest, baked in a water bath at 150C for 70 minutes, cooled in the oven, chilled overnight.
K: the party in Frank's Plaza suite on his first night out

A bitters-soaked sugar cube and a splash of cognac in each flute, topped with brut champagne and a twist of lemon. Put a sugar cube in each of 4 flutes and shake 2 dashes of aromatic bitters onto each. Add 15ml cognac to each glass. Top slowly with 120ml chilled brut champagne, letting the sugar fizz. Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass and drop it in.
T: Uptown deals. Downtown appetite.
D: A gangster returns from prison and tries to take over New York's underworld.
P: Serve the mains when Frank checks back into the Plaza.

title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
S: Mixed nuts and pumpkin seeds tossed with soy, a little honey and sesame, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes.
Raymond's choc chip ice cream sandwiches
Raymond and his ice cream truck in the park

Soft brown butter choc chip cookies sandwiching vanilla ice cream, edges rolled in sprinkles and frozen firm. Brown 115g butter and cool. Beat with 100g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 190g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb and 120g choc chips. Roll 16 balls and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Cool completely. Sandwich a scoop of vanilla ice cream between pairs, roll the edges in sprinkles and freeze for 1 hour.
Edamame boiled 4 minutes in salted water, tossed with flaky salt and a drop of sesame oil.
M: Chicken thighs seared skin down, glazed in a reduction of soy, mirin, sake and sugar, sliced over short grain rice with pickled ginger and spring onion.
Pork and beef meatballs browned and simmered in tomato sauce for an hour, spaghetti, parmesan.
W: the only flavour on Raymond's truck
Blend 400ml coconut cream, 200ml thickened cream and 120g sugar with toasted coconut, churn or still-freeze, stirring every hour.
K: the quiet samurai on his rooftop with the pigeons

Whisked matcha poured over honey lemonade and ice, green and bitter-sweet, with a lemon wheel and fresh mint. Whisk 2 tsp matcha powder with 100ml water at 80C until frothy. Stir 60ml honey into 100ml warm water, then add 100ml lemon juice and 500ml cold water. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the lemonade, then float the matcha on top. Add a lemon wheel and mint and stir at the table.
T: Silent. Loyal. Hungry.
D: A hitman who lives by the samurai code works for an ageing mob crew.
P: Serve dessert when Ghost Dog swaps books with Pearline.

title: Die Hard with a Vengeance
S: the counter at Zeus's electrical shop in Harlem

Chewy brown sugar caramel packed with roasted salted peanuts, set in a slab and topped with milk chocolate and flaky salt. Line a 20cm square tin. Heat 200g brown sugar, 100g butter, 150ml cream and 2 tbsp golden syrup, stirring, then boil 6 to 8 minutes to 118C. Stir in 200g roasted salted peanuts and pour into the tin. Cool 30 minutes, spread with 150g melted milk chocolate and sprinkle with flaky salt. Chill 2 hours and cut into squares.
Buttermilk-soaked chicken thigh pieces dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 175C until crisp, served on hot waffles with butter and honey spiked with hot sauce.
grabbed on the run between riddles
Pastry turnovers filled with curried beef mince, turmeric pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
M: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll
Crisp bacon, a fried egg with a broken yolk and American cheese melted on top, in a buttered toasted kaiser roll, salt, pepper and ketchup.
Lamb shoulder roasted with oregano and lemon, shaved thin and crisped in a pan, on rice with tzatziki, tomato, onion and warm pita.
W: Butter cake topped with a thick cinnamon crumble, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, icing sugar.
K: fill one jug and solve the puzzle
Fresh lemonade (lemon juice, sugar syrup, cold water) in a big jug, with a 5 and a 3 litre jug to work out exactly 4 litres.
T: One very long day in New York. Snacks for the road.
D: John McClane and a Harlem shopkeeper race around the city solving a bomber's riddles.
P: Pour drinks when McClane gets the water jug puzzle.

title: Léon: The Professional
S: Léon's French roots, simple and exact

Crusty baguette with thick cultured butter, shaved ham and cornichons, cut into bites the Paris café way. Warm 1 baguette at 200C for 5 minutes and cool slightly. Split lengthways and spread both sides generously with 80g soft cultured butter. Lay 200g thinly sliced leg ham inside, add 8 sliced cornichons and a little cracked pepper. Close, press firmly and cut into 12 pieces. Serve with Dijon on the side.
the plain lunch of a man who owns one plant and one chair
Mixed olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, thyme and a crushed garlic clove, cornichons and pickled onions alongside.
the back room of Tony's restaurant in Little Italy

Torn bocconcini and sweet cherry tomatoes dressed in bright basil oil, flaky salt and black pepper, with grilled bread. Blitz 1 bunch basil leaves with 80ml olive oil and a pinch of salt until bright green. Tear 300g bocconcini and halve 250g cherry tomatoes. Arrange on a plate, spoon over the basil oil and finish with flaky salt and cracked pepper. Brush 8 slices ciabatta with oil, grill 2 minutes a side and serve alongside.
M: the French touch, for a man of very simple habits

Ham and Gruyère toasted sandwich spread with Dijon, topped with béchamel and more Gruyère, baked until golden and blistered. Melt 30g butter, stir in 30g plain flour for 1 minute, then whisk in 300ml milk and simmer 3 minutes. Add nutmeg, salt and 50g grated Gruyère. Spread 8 slices thick white bread with Dijon, fill 4 with 200g ham and 100g Gruyère and close. Top with the béchamel and 50g more Gruyère. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, then grill for 2 minutes until blistered.
the restaurant back room where the jobs are handed out
Spaghetti pomodoro: garlic gently cooked in oil, San Marzano tomatoes crushed by hand, simmered 25 minutes, finished with basil and a knob of butter, parmesan.
W: his plant, which always gets the window
Layer chocolate mousse (melted dark chocolate folded into whipped cream and whipped egg whites) with crushed chocolate biscuit "soil" in small terracotta-style cups, a mint sprig planted on top.
K: Léon drinks milk, two litres at a time

Ice-cold milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, malted milk powder and honey, poured into tall frosted glasses. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp honey until thick and smooth. Pour into the frosted glasses and dust each with a little more malt powder.
T: Quiet man. Loud appetite. Lots of milk.
D: A solitary hitman takes in a 12-year-old girl after her family is killed.
P: Pour a glass of milk every time Léon does.

title: Inside Man
S: Mini pizzas on rounds of rolled pizza dough with tomato, mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni, baked at 230C for 8 minutes.
Mash potato with onion fried slowly in butter, salt and white pepper, wrap in puff pastry logs, egg wash, bake at 200C for 25 minutes, hot mustard.
lunch for the cops on the barricade
Chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt, cumin and coriander, griddled and chopped over yellow rice, white sauce and hot red sauce on top.
M: for the fixer who makes problems go away
Sirloin seared hard, rested and sliced thin, piled on toasted ciabatta with onions caramelised for 30 minutes, rocket and horseradish cream.
for the hostages in matching painters' suits
Long roll with Italian cold cuts (salami, capicola, mortadella), provolone, lettuce, tomato, onion, oil and red wine vinegar.
W: from the Italian bakery round the corner
Three almond sponge layers coloured green, white and red, sandwiched with apricot jam and topped with dark chocolate, chilled and cut into small squares.
K: fuel for the long negotiation outside the bank

A double espresso poured over tonic, ice and fresh orange, bitter, bright and fizzy enough to keep you sharp. Brew 4 double espressos and let them cool for 5 minutes. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a thin orange slice each. Pour 150ml chilled tonic water into each glass. Slowly pour a double espresso over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Stir at the table.
T: The perfect heist needs a perfect lunch.
D: A clever bank robbery in Manhattan becomes a battle of wits with a sharp detective.
P: Serve the pizza when the hostages get their delivery.

title: Money Train
S: grabbed on the subway station shift
Small pastry half-moons filled with spiced beef and olives, crimped and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
eat them quick, before the Torch turns up

Mixed nuts tossed in honey, sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, roasted at 170C for 15 minutes, stirred as they cool so they don't clump. Toss 300g mixed nuts with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp caster sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway. Keep stirring as they cool so they don't clump.
round, gold and stamped like a subway token
Shortbread rounds pressed with a token-sized cutter and a cut-out middle, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, brushed with edible gold.
M: Beef mince and onion chopped together on a hot griddle with salt and adobo seasoning, American cheese melted through, into a hero roll with lettuce, tomato, mayo and ketchup.
Grace, the cop they both fall for, and her Puerto Rican cooking
Brown chicken thighs, then sofrito (onion, capsicum, garlic, coriander), annatto, rice, olives, capers and stock. Chicken back on top, covered, 25 minutes.
W: a Puerto Rican bakery by the station
Flaky puff pastry squares filled with guava paste and cream cheese, glazed with syrup. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 8 squares each.
K: a whole train full of fare money, too tempting for Charlie

Cold lager with lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire in a chilli-salted glass, served brown-paper-bag style. Mix 1 tbsp flaky salt with 1 tsp chilli powder. Rub a lime wedge around 4 glass rims and dip in the salt. Add ice, 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 4 dashes hot sauce and 2 dashes Worcestershire to each glass. Top each with a 375ml cold lager, stir gently and slip the glasses into small paper bags.
T: Last train of the night. Snacks for the platform.
D: Two foster brothers, both transit cops, plan to rob the train that collects subway fares.
P: Pour drinks when the money train pulls into the station.

title: After Hours
S: Bagel paperweight bites with chive schmear
Kiki's plaster bagel-and-cream-cheese paperweights, but edible

Toasted mini bagels piled with chive and black pepper cream cheese, smoked salmon and a sprinkle of everything seasoning. Halve 8 mini bagels and toast until golden. Beat 250g cream cheese with 2 tbsp milk, 3 tbsp snipped chives and plenty of black pepper. Pipe or spread thickly onto the bagels. Top with 150g smoked salmon, a few capers and everything bagel seasoning made from sesame, poppy seeds, garlic flakes and salt.
the angry mob chasing Paul in the ice cream truck

Vanilla soft serve in crisp cones, dipped in setting chocolate and rolled in crushed peanuts and rainbow sprinkles. Soften 1 litre vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 40ml coconut oil and cool to room temperature. Pipe the ice cream into 8 cones with a large star nozzle and freeze for 20 minutes. Dip the tops into the chocolate, then straight into 50g crushed roasted peanuts or sprinkles. Freeze 5 minutes to set.
M: the bartender who owes Paul a favour
Thick hand-formed chuck patty, seasoned at the last moment, griddled to medium, cheddar, raw onion and pickles on a toasted bun.
Three toasted slices: roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, chips on the side.
W: Vanilla butter cake covered in a thick, matte white seven-minute frosting (egg whites and sugar whisked over a bain-marie), roughly smoothed like plaster.
K: the bartender at the Terminal Bar, and Paul still can't get home

Bourbon shaken with lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky, served over ice with bitters and a cocktail cherry. Dissolve 50g caster sugar in 50ml hot water and cool. Shake 180ml bourbon, 90ml lemon juice, 60ml syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 ice-filled rocks glasses. Add 2 drops aromatic bitters to each foam and a cocktail cherry.
T: It's after midnight. Do you know where your dinner is?
D: A word processor's night out in SoHo spirals into one bizarre disaster after another.
P: Serve the bagels when Kiki shows off her bagel and cream cheese paperweights.

title: Premium Rush
S: Melt butter, honey and brown sugar, stir through oats, chopped dates, peanuts and seeds, press into a tin, bake at 170C for 25 minutes, cool before cutting.
Steamed bao filled with char siu: pork neck marinated in hoisin, honey and five spice, roasted at 200C and glazed, chopped.
M: Wilee's halal cart chicken over rice
one hand on the bars, eaten between drops

Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, oregano, cumin and coriander, griddled and chopped, over turmeric rice with shredded lettuce, white sauce (mayo, yoghurt, vinegar, sugar, pepper) and hot sauce. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon, oregano, cumin and coriander for an hour. Griddle and chop. Cook 300g rice with 1 tsp turmeric. Mix 100g yoghurt, 100g mayo, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and pepper. Serve on shredded lettuce with hot sauce.

Crisp-bottomed pork and cabbage dumplings steamed under a lid, with black vinegar, ginger and chilli oil for dipping. Salt 200g finely chopped wombok for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 400g pork mince, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 32 gow gee wrappers and pleat shut. Fry in 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath, add 80ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes. Serve with black vinegar mixed with shredded ginger and chilli oil.
W: Brown butter choc chip cookies, dough rested overnight, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, flaky salt.
K: Wilee's bike has no brakes, so drink fast

Blend banana, frozen berries, oats, peanut butter, milk and a shot of espresso until smooth. Blend 2 bananas, 250g frozen berries, 40g rolled oats, 2 tbsp peanut butter and 800ml milk until completely smooth. Add a shot of espresso for anyone riding through traffic. Pour into four tall glasses and drink straight away.
T: No brakes. Fast food.
D: A bike messenger races across Manhattan with a package someone will kill for.
P: Serve the mains when Wilee hits the first red light and keeps going.

title: 16 Blocks
S: Jack's stop at the liquor store before the walk starts

Pork belly skin roasted until it shatters, tossed in vinegar salt and served with pickled onions and hot mustard. Score the skin of 1kg boneless pork belly, pat dry and refrigerate uncovered overnight. Rub with 1 tbsp malt vinegar, then 1 tbsp salt. Roast skin up at 160C for 90 minutes, then 240C for 25 minutes until puffed and crackling. Rest 10 minutes, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle with flaky salt mixed with a splash of malt vinegar. Serve with pickled onions and hot English mustard.
the Chinatown hideout where they lie low
Pork dumplings pan-fried in a little oil until the bottoms crisp, then a splash of water and a lid for 4 minutes. Dip of soy, black vinegar and fine ginger matchsticks.
M: Beef mince and onion chopped on a griddle, American cheese melted through, on a hero with lettuce, tomato and mayo.
Spiced chicken thighs griddled and chopped over yellow rice with white sauce, hot sauce, lettuce and pita.
W: he wants to open a bakery and make birthday cakes
Two layers of chocolate butter cake sandwiched and covered in chocolate buttercream, candles on top.
K: Bodega iced coffee with condensed milk
Jack needs it, badly, for a long walk to the courthouse

Strong coffee poured over ice and sweetened condensed milk, stirred until creamy and cold, with a pinch of cinnamon. Brew 600ml strong coffee using 60g ground coffee and cool for 10 minutes. Spoon 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of 4 glasses. Fill with ice, then pour 150ml coffee into each. Stir well until creamy and dust with a little cinnamon.
T: Sixteen blocks. One long lunch.
D: A worn-out cop has to escort a talkative witness 16 blocks to court.
P: Serve dessert when Eddie talks about opening a bakery.

title: Frequency
S: Beef chilli spooned into baked wonton cups, cheddar on top, back in the oven for 3 minutes.
Miracle Mets pretzels with beer mustard
the 1969 World Series, the Miracle Mets on the radio

Warm ballpark soft pretzels glossy from a bicarb bath, coarse salt on top, with a sharp beer and wholegrain mustard dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 300ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour. Shape 8 pretzels. Boil each for 30 seconds in 2 litres water with 60g bicarb, drain, sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 220C for 12 to 14 minutes. Mix 100g wholegrain mustard, 2 tbsp lager and 1 tbsp honey for the dip.
M: the shift dinner for the whole crew
Beef and pork ragù simmered 2 hours, layered with pasta sheets, ricotta and béchamel, mozzarella on top, baked at 180C for 45 minutes, rested 20.
watching the Series on the radio
Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
W: Granny Smiths with sugar, cinnamon and a little flour in a double crust, egg wash, baked at 190C for 50 minutes.
K: the 1969 World Series on the radio at the firehouse

Cold lager topped with fresh homemade lemonade and mint in frosted glasses, easy drinking for nine innings. Stir 100ml lemon juice, 80g caster sugar and 300ml cold water until the sugar dissolves. Chill 4 glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass and top with 100ml lemonade. Add a sprig of mint and a lemon wheel.
T: Father and son. Same radio. Same pizza.
D: A cop talks to his firefighter father across 30 years through an old ham radio.
P: Serve dinner during the 1969 World Series broadcast.

title: The Adjustment Bureau
S: from the cart beside the bus stop
Mixed nuts tossed with honey, butter, sugar and a pinch of cinnamon, roasted at 170C until glossy, poured into paper cones.
keep your hat on, it opens the doors

Toasted baguette slices with whipped goat's cheese (beaten with a little cream), warm honey, thyme and cracked pepper. Cut half a baguette, about 150g, into 8 slices. Toast at 200°C conventional for 5 to 7 minutes until golden. Beat 120g soft goat's cheese with 30ml thickened cream until light. Warm 30g honey gently for 30 seconds. Spread the cheese on the toast, drizzle with warm honey and finish with 1 tsp thyme leaves and 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper.
the hotel bathroom where they first meet
Thick cucumber rounds with smoked salmon, a dot of crème fraîche whipped with lemon, dill and black pepper.
M: the date they're not supposed to have
Sirloin seared hard and rested, sliced, with shallot and red wine butter melting over the top and double-fried frites.
Lobster tails cut through the shell, sautéed with garlic, chilli and cherry tomatoes, white wine, linguine finished in the sauce.
W: the plan says it melts in the middle

Melt 125g dark chocolate with 125g butter, whisk in 2 eggs, 2 yolks and 60g sugar, fold in 30g flour, bake buttered moulds at 200C for 10 minutes. Butter four 150ml moulds using 10g extra butter. Heat the oven to 200°C conventional. Melt 125g dark chocolate with 125g butter gently and cool slightly. Whisk 2 whole eggs and 2 yolks with 60g caster sugar until pale. Stir in the chocolate mixture, then fold in 30g plain flour. Divide among the moulds and bake for 10 minutes until the edges are set and centres remain soft. Rest 1 minute, loosen the edges and carefully turn onto plates. Serve immediately.
K: election night, win or lose, the night David meets Elise

Gin shaken with lemon and sugar syrup, poured into flutes and topped with brut champagne and a long lemon twist. Dissolve 40g caster sugar in 40ml hot water and cool. Shake 120ml gin, 60ml lemon juice and 40ml syrup with ice for 10 seconds. Strain evenly into 4 chilled flutes. Top each with 90ml cold brut champagne, pouring slowly. Finish with a long strip of lemon peel.
T: Fate has a plan. So does dessert.
D: A politician falls for a dancer while mysterious men try to keep them apart.
P: Serve the snacks when David meets Elise on the bus.

title: The Out-of-Towners
S: rationed between George and Gwen through one very long night

Buttery shortbread fingers baked pale and crisp, sandwiched with raspberry jam and dusted with icing sugar. Beat 200g soft butter with 100g icing sugar until pale. Mix in 250g plain flour and 50g cornflour to a soft dough. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick all over and bake at 160C for 25 to 30 minutes until pale golden. Cut into 24 fingers while warm and cool in the tin. Sandwich pairs with 120g raspberry jam and dust with icing sugar.
the flight that gets diverted to Boston, and nothing left to eat on board

Little cocktail franks glazed in honey, mustard and brown sugar until sticky, speared on toothpicks with pickled onions. Simmer 500g cocktail franks in water for 3 minutes and drain. In a frying pan melt 20g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Add the franks and toss over medium heat for 5 minutes until sticky and glazed. Serve on toothpicks with cocktail onions.
the only food they find all night
Franks simmered with onion until plump, in steamed buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in paper.
M: the hotel they're trying to reach
Diced apple, celery and grapes with toasted walnuts in a dressing of mayo, lemon and a little crème fraîche, on butter lettuce.
breakfast in the room at last
Rib eye seared and rested, two fried eggs, crisp hash browns (grated potato squeezed dry, fried in butter) and buttered toast.
W: Baked New York cheesecake, water bath at 150C for 70 minutes, chilled overnight, strawberries on top.
K: Stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds, strain into a frozen glass, olive.
T: Every possible thing goes wrong.
D: An Ohio couple's trip to New York becomes a night of non-stop disasters.
P: Serve dessert when George finally gets to eat something.

title: C.H.U.D.
S: Soup kitchen cheddar and onion rolls
the Reverend's shelter on the Bowery, ready for dunking into the stew

Soft pull-apart rolls baked with sharp cheddar and caramelised onion, brushed with butter and served warm. Fry 1 sliced onion in 20g butter for 15 minutes until golden. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 300ml warm milk and 30g melted butter, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour. Knead in the onion and 100g grated cheddar, shape 12 rolls and pack into a tin. Rise 30 minutes, top with 50g more cheddar and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Rounds of pizza dough topped with tomato and mozzarella, a crosshatch of pepperoni strips for the grate, baked at 230C for 8 minutes.
Crumbed dill pickle chips with ranch
sour from the barrel, downtown on the Lower East Side

Sliced dill pickles crumbed in panko and fried crisp, with cool garlic and herb ranch for dipping. Slice 4 large dill pickles into 5mm rounds and pat very dry. Toss in 50g plain flour, dip in 1 beaten egg, then coat in 80g panko. Fry at 180C in batches for 2 minutes until golden, then drain. Mix 100g sour cream, 50g mayonnaise, 1 crushed garlic clove, chopped chives and dill, and a squeeze of lemon for the ranch.
M: Beef chuck browned, braised with onion, carrot, celery, tomato paste and stock for 2.5 hours, potatoes for the last hour. Crusty bread.
W: Soft apple cider cake doughnuts tossed in cinnamon sugar. Reduce 500ml apple juice to 125ml.
K: Lime cordial with tonic water, which glows under a black light.
T: Don't go down the drain.
D: Something is coming up out of the sewers of New York.
P: Serve the soup when the Reverend's soup kitchen opens.

title: Big
S: eat it off the cob with both hands, like Josh
Blanch baby corn 2 minutes, then char on a hot griddle with butter, chilli and lime salt. Eat it like a corn cob.
the fancy party snack Josh spits straight back out
Water crackers with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, the fancy party snack Josh can't handle.
M: MacMillan party crab cakes with remoulade
the MacMillan Toys company party where Josh takes on the baby corn

Golden crab cakes packed with sweet crab, bound with a little mayo and crumb, with a sharp caper remoulade and lemon. Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, chopped parsley, lemon zest and 60g panko. Shape 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade mix 120g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 chopped cornichons, 1 tsp Dijon and lemon juice. Serve with salad leaves.
Josh and Billy loose in the city
Simmer franks in water with onion, then griddle until blistered. Steamed buns, yellow mustard, sauerkraut and onions cooked down in tomato paste and vinegar.
W: big enough to play like the floor piano
Brown butter choc chip dough pressed into a pizza tray, baked at 180C for 18 minutes, still soft in the middle, piano keys piped on in icing.
K: a New York fountain drink for a kid in a grown-up's body
Chocolate syrup, cold milk and soda water stirred hard in a tall glass until it foams up.
T: Grown-up food for a kid at heart.
D: A 12-year-old wishes to be big and wakes up as a grown man working at a toy company.
P: Serve the snacks when Josh eats baby corn like a tiny corn cob at the company party.

title: Splash
S: Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon, cracked pepper and a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette.
Cape Cod, where they first meet
Flathead strips dredged and dipped in a beer batter (flour, cornflour, cold lager), fried at 180C. Chips double-fried. Paper cones, tartare and lemon.
Fruit market corn and zucchini fritters
Allen's wholesale fruit and veg business

Crisp corn, zucchini and herb fritters fried golden, with whipped feta and lemon for dolloping on top. Grate 2 zucchini, salt for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 200g corn kernels, 2 spring onions, mint, 100g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 50g crumbled feta. Shallow-fry spoonfuls in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes a side. Blitz 150g feta with 80g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest and serve on the side.
M: drawn butter, shell optional, Madison eats it all
Cook live or raw lobster in boiling salted water 8 minutes per 500g, split, grill flesh-side with garlic butter for 2 minutes. Drawn butter and lemon.
fuel for Madison's big-city shopping spree

Poached chicken folded with mayo, celery, grapes and fresh tarragon, piled into buttery croissants with crisp lettuce. Poach 600g chicken breast in barely simmering salted water for 15 minutes, rest in the liquid 10 minutes, then cool and shred. Mix with 120g mayonnaise, 2 diced celery sticks, 100g halved grapes, 2 tbsp chopped tarragon, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Split 4 large croissants, line with butter lettuce and fill with the chicken salad.
W: Blue jelly (butterfly pea tea, sugar and gelatine) set in glasses with layers of coconut panna cotta, gummy fish on top.
K: the swim back to the ocean
30ml vodka, 20ml blue curaçao and lemonade over ice, lemon wheel.
T: Fresh from the ocean. Mostly.
D: A New York produce man falls in love with a mermaid who comes ashore to find him.
P: Serve the lobster when Madison eats it whole at the restaurant.

title: Three Men and a Baby
S: the surprise left outside the loft, note included

Golden fried sesame prawn toasts cut into triangles, served in a cloth-lined wicker basket with sweet chilli sauce. Blitz 300g peeled green prawns with 1 egg white, 1 tsp ginger, 1 spring onion and a pinch of salt. Spread on 6 slices of white bread, press in 4 tbsp sesame seeds, cut into triangles and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

Crisp homemade parmesan breadsticks with a vivid roast beetroot and chickpea hummus for dunking. Mix 250g plain flour, 4g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 40g grated parmesan, 2 tbsp olive oil and 150ml warm water, knead 5 minutes, rest 30 minutes. Roll into 24 thin sticks and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp. Blitz 250g cooked beetroot, 400g drained chickpeas, 2 tbsp tahini, 1 garlic clove, lemon juice and 3 tbsp olive oil until smooth.
Thin-sliced day-old bagels brushed with oil, baked crisp at 180C for 12 minutes, with cream cheese whipped with chives and lemon.
M: Sirloin seared and sliced thin, onions caramelised for 30 minutes, Swiss melted on top, horseradish mayo on toasted sourdough.
Bachelor pad sweet and sour pork
the classic bachelor takeaway, before baby Mary turns up

Double-fried crisp pork in a glossy sweet and sour sauce with pineapple, capsicum and onion, over steamed rice. Cut 600g pork shoulder into 3cm pieces, toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 egg, then coat in 80g potato starch. Fry at 170C for 4 minutes, rest, then again at 190C for 1 minute. Stir-fry 1 capsicum and 1 onion for 2 minutes. Add 200g pineapple pieces, 80ml tomato sauce, 60ml rice vinegar, 50g sugar and 100ml water, thicken with 1 tsp cornflour. Toss the pork through and serve with rice.
W: smooth, no lumps, Peter reads her the boxing news while it cools

Heat 500ml milk with a split vanilla pod, pour onto 4 yolks whisked with 60g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, return and stir until thick. Heat 500ml milk with a split vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 60g caster sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, pour on the hot milk, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick. Serve warm, or chill with plastic pressed on the surface.
K: the 3am feeds, test it on your wrist first

Cold milk shaken with bourbon, vanilla and a little sugar until frothy, served over ice with fresh nutmeg on top. Shake 160ml bourbon, 400ml cold full cream milk, 40ml sugar syrup and half a tsp vanilla extract with ice for 15 seconds until frothy. Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and grate nutmeg over the top. For a no-booze version, leave out the bourbon and add a spoon of honey.
T: Three bachelors. One baby. Zero clue.
D: Three party-loving bachelors suddenly have to look after a baby left on their doorstep.
P: Serve dessert when the guys sing the baby to sleep.

title: Working Girl
S: Staten Island ferry egg and cheese rolls
Tess's commute on the Staten Island ferry every morning

Soft rolls with buttery folded eggs, melted cheddar and crisp bacon, a dash of hot sauce, wrapped in foil for the ferry. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and pepper and cook gently in 20g butter, folding into soft curds. Split and butter 4 soft rolls, toast cut side down. Fill with eggs, 4 slices cheddar and bacon, add a dash of hot sauce, wrap in foil and rest 2 minutes so the cheese melts.
prawn on cucumber, and she's not invited
Thick cucumber rounds topped with a poached prawn, a dot of Marie Rose and a sprig of dill, served cold on trays.
the big pitch in the boardroom
Golden crab cakes bound with a little mayo and breadcrumb, with lemon and a quick tartare.
M: Seared sirloin sliced over cos with blue cheese, cherry tomatoes and red onion, red wine vinaigrette.
Tess's own neighbourhood, a long way from Wall Street

Crumbed chicken fried golden, topped with marinara, mozzarella and parmesan and grilled until bubbling, with buttered spaghetti. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Coat in flour, beaten egg, then 120g breadcrumbs mixed with 30g parmesan. Shallow-fry 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked. Top each with 3 tbsp marinara and 50g sliced mozzarella and grill 3 minutes until bubbling. Simmer 400g passata with garlic and basil for the marinara. Serve with 320g spaghetti tossed in butter.
W: Vanilla butter cake split and layered with raspberry jam and Swiss meringue buttercream, chilled and cut in tall slices.
K: the ferry in from Staten Island
Bourbon stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters, served up with a cherry. Stir 60ml bourbon, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes bitters with ice for 30 seconds.
T: A head for business. An appetite for dinner.
D: A Staten Island secretary takes over her boss's deal while the boss is laid up.
P: Serve the mains when Tess crashes the Trask wedding to talk business.

title: The Secret of My Success
S: Ham, cheddar and pickle on buttered white bread, crusts off, cut into fingers and wrapped in wax paper.
Corn kernels in a batter of flour, egg, milk, spring onion and baking powder, shallow-fried in spoonfuls, sour cream dip.
the boardroom he talks his way into
Warm buckwheat blini at 180C for 5 minutes, top with a curl of smoked salmon, crème fraîche, dill and a crack of pepper.
M: Dry-brined rib eye seared hard, basted with butter, thyme and garlic, pulled at 54C, rested 8 minutes, sliced.
Buttermilk-brined chicken in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside, mashed potato and gravy.
W: home on the farm in Kansas
Double-crust apple pie with cinnamon, egg wash and sugar, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, vanilla ice cream.
K: the weekend party where everyone's in the wrong bedroom
Stir 60ml gin with 10ml dry vermouth on ice, strain into a frozen glass, lemon twist.
T: Mailroom by day. Executive by night.
D: A Kansas farm boy works in the mailroom by day and poses as an executive by night.
P: Serve the mains when Brantley changes from mailroom clothes to his suit in the lift.

title: Brewster's Millions
S: Prawn cocktail for the whole hotel
Monty's shout, enough for every guest
Prawns poached 2 minutes in salted water with lemon and bay, iced, on shredded iceberg with Marie Rose and a dusting of paprika.
Warm buckwheat blini at 180C for 5 minutes, top with crème fraîche, a generous spoon of caviar or salmon roe and snipped chives.
the minor league team Monty plays for

Little franks in soft buns under beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, ballpark style. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water, and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Simmer 12 cocktail franks 3 minutes. Split 12 mini hot dog buns, add a frank, spoon over the chilli and top with 100g grated cheddar and diced onion. Grill 1 minute to melt.
M: the most expensive burger in town
Wagyu patty, aged cheddar, truffle mayo and a sheet of edible gold leaf, on a toasted brioche bun.
Eye fillet seared to medium rare, half a lobster tail grilled with garlic butter, béarnaise.
W: for the most expensive postcard ever sent
Shortbread (butter, icing sugar, flour, rice flour) rolled 6mm, cut into rectangles with a pinking cutter, baked at 160C for 20 minutes, a little stamp design piped on top.
K: Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar

Brut champagne poured over a bitters-soaked sugar cube with a splash of orange liqueur and a twist of orange. Drop a sugar cube into each of 4 flutes and shake 2 dashes aromatic bitters onto each. Add 15ml orange liqueur to each glass. Top slowly with 120ml chilled brut champagne. Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
T: Spend thirty million in thirty days. Start with dinner.
D: A minor league pitcher must spend $30 million in 30 days to inherit $300 million.
P: Order the most expensive thing on the menu when Monty books his hotel suite.

title: Quick Change
S: Grimm's disguise for the bank job
Cut the tops off cherry tomatoes, scoop, fill with feta whipped with basil and lemon, a basil leaf on top. A red nose for every guest.
so close to getting out of the city

Oven-crisp chicken wings tossed in chilli, lime and honey butter, finished with coriander and extra lime. Pat 1kg chicken wings dry, toss with 1 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Roast on a rack at 220C for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp and cooked through. Melt 30g butter with 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the zest and juice of 2 limes. Toss the wings through and scatter with coriander.
Flaky golden pastry turnovers filled with spiced beef, thyme and scotch bonnet, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
M: for a city that won't let you leave
Kaiser rolls with sliced turkey, Swiss, lettuce, tomato, mayo and mustard, salt and pepper, wrapped tight in paper and cut in half.
the final stop before the plane
Franks simmered with onion, then griddled, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, sweet relish and diced onion.
W: Vanilla sponge split and filled with jam and buttercream, covered in white buttercream, a clown face piped on with a maraschino cherry for the nose.
K: a toast to finally leaving New York

Bourbon muddled with mint, lemon and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint sprig. In a shaker, muddle 12 mint leaves and 4 lemon wedges with 40ml sugar syrup. Add 180ml bourbon and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Double strain into 4 glasses filled with crushed ice. Top with a fat sprig of mint and serve with short straws.
T: The bank job was easy. Leaving New York is hard.
D: Three bank robbers can't find their way out of New York.
P: Serve the mains when the cabbie who speaks no English drives them nowhere.

title: Trading Places
S: Devils on horseback: prunes stuffed with almonds, wrapped in streaky bacon, baked at 200C for 15 minutes.
the commodities crash on the trading floor
Orange juice blended with ice and a splash of vodka into a slush, served in shot glasses.
Philadelphia, home of Duke and Duke
Shaved scotch fillet and onion fried on a flat-top, provolone melted through, on halved mini rolls.
M: Standing rib roast salted the day before, roasted low at 120C to 52C, rested, blasted at 260C for a crust, jus and horseradish.
best kept out of the beard
Side of smoked salmon on a board with warm blini, crème fraîche, capers, finely diced red onion and dill.
W: Orange butter cake (zest beaten into the butter and sugar) baked at 170C for 45 minutes, glazed with orange juice concentrate boiled with sugar.
K: fresh orange juice, the real winner
Half fresh orange juice, half chilled sparkling wine in flutes.
T: One dollar bet. One very big swap.
D: Two rich brothers make a bet that swaps a snob and a street hustler's lives.
P: Serve the mains during the New Year's Eve train party.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
S: Fried deli pickles with mustard mayo
the famous deli scene, pickles on every table

Half-sour pickle spears in a crisp rye-flour batter, fried hot and served with a sharp deli mustard mayo. Cut 4 half-sour or dill pickles into spears and pat very dry. Whisk 80g plain flour, 40g rye flour, half a tsp paprika and 150ml cold soda water into a batter. Dip the spears and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp, then drain. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp yellow mustard and 1 tsp pickle brine for the dip.
Mash potato with onion fried slowly in butter, salt and white pepper, wrap in puff pastry, egg wash, bake at 200C for 25 minutes, hot mustard.
Harry spitting grape seeds out the car window on the drive to New York

Grapes roasted with thyme and balsamic until jammy, piled on whipped ricotta toasts with honey and black pepper. Toss 400g red grapes with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp balsamic and 4 thyme sprigs and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until blistered. Slice 1 baguette into 16 rounds, brush with oil and bake 8 minutes until crisp. Whip 250g ricotta with 1 tbsp honey, lemon zest and salt. Spread on the toasts, top with the grapes and finish with honey and cracked pepper.
M: Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until glossy and soft, pile high on seeded rye with yellow mustard, a full sour on the side.
dressing on the side, everything on the side
Ham, turkey, Swiss, egg, tomato and cucumber on iceberg, with every element in its own little bowl.
W: Apple pie à la mode, her way
heated, ice cream on the side, strawberry if you have it
Apple pie warmed at 180C for 10 minutes, strawberry ice cream on the side, whipped cream if you don't.
K: Chocolate syrup in a tall glass, 100ml cold milk, then soda water blasted in hard and stirred to a foam head. No egg, no cream.
T: Order whatever she's having.
D: Over 12 years, two friends argue whether men and women can ever just be friends.
P: Serve mains when they get to Katz's Deli.

title: Annie Hall
S: catch them first, they will escape
Cooked lobster chopped and folded with mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled onto toasted buttered brioche rounds.
the Easter ham at the Wisconsin family dinner
Bake a small leg ham scored and glazed with brown sugar, Dijon and pineapple juice at 180C for 40 minutes, basting twice. Cube and skewer with fresh pineapple.
Flaky pastry rounds filled with mashed potato and fried onion, baked golden. Mash 800g boiled potatoes with 2 onions fried slowly in 40g butter, salt and pepper.
M: the escaping kind, retrieved from behind the fridge
Boil lobsters in water as salty as the sea, 8 minutes per 500g. Split, crack the claws, drawn butter (butter melted and skimmed of solids) and lemon.
Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until glossy. Soft white bread spread with mayo, lettuce, tomato, the pastrami piled high. Alvy would want rye and mustard.
W: Alvy's city, which he will never leave
Biscuit and butter base. 900g cream cheese beaten with sugar, sour cream, 4 eggs and lemon zest, baked in a water bath at 150C for 70 minutes, cooled in the oven, chilled overnight.
K: Alvy's health food lunch in LA, alfalfa sprouts and all

Fresh cucumber and lime juice shaken with mint and honey, topped with sparkling water over ice. Blend 1 chopped Lebanese cucumber with 60ml lime juice, 2 tbsp honey and a handful of mint until smooth, then strain. Fill 4 glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons. Pour 60ml of the mix into each and top with 150ml sparkling water. Add a mint sprig.
T: La-di-da. Pass the lobster.
D: A neurotic comedian looks back on his relationship with the free-spirited Annie.
P: Serve the mains when the lobsters escape behind the fridge.

title: Manhattan
S: the restaurant where the film opens, with everyone talking at once
Toast baguette slices brushed with oil. Top half with whipped ricotta, lemon zest and honey, half with marinated mushrooms, thyme and parmesan.
for the bench by the bridge at dawn

Toasted bagels, cream cheese whipped with a splash of milk, lox, capers, red onion sliced paper thin and dill. Whip 250g cream cheese with a splash of milk until light. Split and toast 4 bagels. Spread thickly, then layer with 200g smoked salmon, a few capers, paper-thin red onion and dill sprigs. Cut in half and serve on a board.
M: Isaac and Tracy watching old movies

Kung pao chicken: thigh pieces in soy and cornflour, flash-fried with dried chillies and Sichuan pepper, sauce of black vinegar, soy, sugar and Shaoxing, roasted peanuts and spring onion. Rice in the cartons.
Dry-brined New York strip seared hard and basted with butter and thyme, rested, with creamed spinach and a red wine sauce.
W: Isaac's list, right up there with Tracy's face

Biscuit crumb base, dense cream cheese filling with lemon and vanilla, baked low and slow at 150C, cooled in the oven, chilled overnight. Crush 200g plain biscuits with 80g melted butter, press into a 20cm tin and bake 10 minutes at 160C. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs, 150g sour cream, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon. Pour in, bake at 150C for 60 minutes, cool in the oven with the door ajar and chill overnight.
K: Stir 60ml rye, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds, strain into a chilled coupe, cherry.
T: New York in black and white. Dessert in colour.
D: A twice-divorced comedy writer works out who he really loves.
P: Serve dessert as the Gershwin opening fades.

title: Tootsie
S: between takes on the hospital soap

Egg and cress, ham and mustard, and cucumber with cream cheese on soft white bread, crusts off, cut into triangles. Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, mash with 2 tbsp mayo and a handful of cress. Spread 150g cream cheese on bread and layer with thin cucumber. Use 12 slices soft white bread in total, cut off the crusts and cut into triangles.
the weekend at Julie's dad's farm
Aged cheddar, a soft washed rind and farmhouse butter with oatcakes, apple slices and a jar of chutney.
Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip
Sandy's audition for the role she didn't get

Smoky roast red capsicum blitzed with feta, Greek yoghurt and chilli, served with seeded crackers. Char 2 red capsicums under a hot grill for 15 minutes, cover for 10 minutes, then peel and seed. Blitz with 150g feta, 100g Greek yoghurt, 1 garlic clove, half a tsp chilli flakes and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and serve with 200g seeded crackers.
M: Dry-brined chicken with butter and lemon under the skin, roasted at 220C then 180C, rested, potatoes roasted in the fat.
Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until glossy, pile on seeded rye with yellow mustard, a full sour on the side.
W: Julie's kitchen on a weekend off
Cream scones (self-raising flour, cream, sugar) baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split, filled with macerated strawberries and softly whipped cream.
K: the lunch where George first meets Dorothy

Smoky black tea brewed strong, served in glasses with lemon slices and a spoon of jam on the side, the Russian way. Brew 4 tsp loose black tea in 1L just-boiled water for 4 minutes, strain into 4 glasses. Serve with lemon slices and a small dish of cherry jam on the side for stirring in, the Russian Tea Room way.
T: He's not a she. But she can cook.
D: An out-of-work actor dresses as a woman to win a role on a soap opera.
P: Serve the mains when Dorothy demands the script be changed.

title: You've Got Mail
S: the cash-only line at the deli where Joe rescues Kathleen

Warm buckwheat blini topped with crème fraîche, salmon roe and snipped chives, with a squeeze of lemon. Warm 24 cocktail blini on a tray at 180C for 5 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of half a lemon and a pinch of salt. Spoon a little onto each blini, top with half a tsp salmon roe and snipped chives. Serve straight away with lemon wedges.
the party where Joe and Kathleen meet face to face and argue

Thick cucumber rounds topped with dill cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and a crack of black pepper. Cut 2 telegraph cucumbers into 1.5cm rounds and pat dry. Beat 150g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped dill and the zest of half a lemon. Pipe or spoon onto each round. Top with a curl of smoked salmon from 200g, a couple of capers, a dill sprig and cracked pepper.
Kathleen's neighbourhood on the Upper West Side
Mini bagels toasted, spread with cream cheese whipped with finely sliced spring onion and cracked pepper.
M: Turkey, brie and cranberry on sourdough, pressed in a hot pan until the brie melts.
Joe turns up with daisies when she's sick
Whole chicken simmered 2 hours with carrot, celery, onion, dill and peppercorns, strained, meat shredded back in, egg noodles.
W: the date at the cafe that she sits through alone
Baked New York cheesecake, chilled overnight, sliced and served with fresh strawberries macerated in a little sugar.
K: a coffee order with lots of decisions
Double shot of decaf, milk steamed to 60C with a deep foam cap, served in a tall cup.
T: Bouquets of sharpened pencils. Plates of cheese.
D: Two bookshop rivals fall for each other over anonymous email.
P: Serve the snacks when Joe sits down at Kathleen's cafe table.

title: Sleepless in Seattle
S: Flake hot-smoked salmon into cream cheese and crème fraîche with lemon, dill, capers and horseradish. Bagel chips.

Sweet crab bound with a little mayo, mustard and crumb, seasoned with paprika and celery salt, fried golden with tartare. Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, half a tsp each of celery salt and paprika, chopped parsley and 60g panko. Shape 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 3 minutes a side. Mix 120g mayonnaise with chopped cornichons, capers, dill and lemon for tartare.
listening to the late night call-in show
Pop kernels in coconut oil, toss with brown butter (butter cooked until nutty) and flaky salt.
M: the Seattle waterfront near Sam's houseboat

Flathead in crisp lager batter with double-cooked chips, lemon, and a quick dill tartare on the side. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, simmer 6 minutes, drain and dry. Fry at 160C for 5 minutes, then rest. Whisk 150g plain flour, 50g cornflour, 1 tsp baking powder and 300ml cold lager. Dip 600g flathead fillets in flour, then batter, and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry chips again at 190C until golden. Serve with lemon and tartare.
Roast salmon fillet with herb crust, steamed greens and lemon butter, nothing that'll set Walter off sneezing.
W: the Empire State date on Valentine's Day
Brown butter sugar cookie dough rolled 5mm, cut into hearts, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, iced in red and white royal icing.
K: Seattle, the coffee city, where Sam and Jonah live on the water

Strong coffee and dark chocolate over ice with cold milk, under whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 400ml strong coffee and stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp sugar until melted. Cool for 15 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 100ml of the mocha and 150ml cold milk to each. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and dust with cocoa.
T: Meet me at the top of the Empire State.
D: A widower's son calls a radio show and a woman across the country falls for his dad.
P: Serve dessert when they finally meet on the observation deck.

title: Ghost
S: Oda Mae's tarot card cheddar crackers
the candlelit parlour of Oda Mae Brown, fake psychic

Crisp sharp cheddar and rosemary crackers cut into tarot-card rectangles, with fig jam and a wedge of blue cheese. Pulse 150g plain flour, 100g cold butter, 150g grated sharp cheddar, 1 tsp chopped rosemary and a pinch of cayenne until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 30 minutes, roll 3mm thick and cut into 5 x 8cm rectangles. Prick and bake at 180C for 14 minutes until golden. Serve with 120g fig jam and 150g blue cheese.
Cornmeal batter with spring onion and a little sugar, dropped in spoonfuls into oil at 180C until golden, honey butter for dipping.
Grill baguette slices, rub with a cut garlic clove, top with diced ripe tomato dressed with basil, salt and good olive oil.
M: Brown crumbled Italian sausage with sliced fennel and garlic, deglaze with white wine, splash of cream, toss with rigatoni and parmesan.
her sisters crowded round the table
Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, garlic and stock, potatoes for the last hour, gravy from the juices.
W: Free-form galette: shortcrust rolled into a rough circle, filled with sliced apples, sugar and cinnamon, edges folded by hand, baked at 200C for 40 minutes.
K: Molly's studio, late at night at the pottery wheel

Pinot noir warmed gently with orange, cinnamon, star anise and a little honey, served steaming in mugs. Pour 750ml pinot noir into a saucepan with 2 strips orange peel, the juice of 1 orange, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 star anise, 4 cloves and 3 tbsp honey. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add a thin orange slice to each.
T: Ditto.
D: A murdered banker's ghost tries to protect his girlfriend with the help of a fake psychic.
P: Serve dessert when the pottery wheel scene starts.

title: Wall Street
S: the power lunch Gekko doesn't bother eating
Finely chop chilled eye fillet by hand, mix with shallot, capers, cornichon, Dijon, Worcestershire and a yolk. Toasted brioche.
Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon and a sharp red wine and shallot dressing.
Sushi rice seasoned with rice vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into salmon and tuna nigiri, plus cucumber maki, with wasabi and pickled ginger.
M: Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard, basted with butter and rosemary, rested. Peppercorn sauce of brandy, stock and cream.
Bud's dad, honest work at the airline
Thick chuck patty seasoned at the last moment, griddled to medium, cheddar melted on top, lettuce, tomato and pickles on a toasted bun.
W: the office birthday on the trading floor
Biscuit base, cream cheese beaten with sugar, eggs and lemon, baked in a water bath at 150C for 60 minutes, sour cream topping baked 10 minutes more.
K: in Gekko's office, where greed is good
Stir 60ml bourbon, 10ml sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice, strain over a big cube, orange twist.
T: Lunch is for wimps. Dinner is not.
D: A young stockbroker gets seduced by a ruthless corporate raider.
P: Serve dinner when Gekko gives the "greed is good" speech.

title: Arthur
S: the engagement party Arthur drinks his way through

Thin rye cut into squares, buttered, topped with smoked salmon, a dot of crème fraîche whipped with lemon, dill and cracked pepper. Butter 6 slices rye bread and cut into small squares. Top with 200g smoked salmon. Whip 100ml crème fraîche with lemon zest and put a dot on each, then add a dill sprig and cracked pepper. Serve cold.
Warm buckwheat blini at 180C for 5 minutes, top with crème fraîche, caviar or salmon roe and snipped chives.
Hobson the butler, keeping Arthur's world properly civilised

Crustless white bread with herbed cream cheese, paper-thin cucumber and peppery cress, cut into neat fingers. Peel and very thinly slice 1 telegraph cucumber, salt lightly for 10 minutes and pat dry. Beat 150g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped dill, lemon zest and pepper. Spread over 12 slices white bread. Top 6 with cucumber and a punnet of cress, close with the rest and press gently. Cut off the crusts and slice into 4 fingers each.
M: Arthur's big news, met with a very dry reply

Topside seasoned and roasted at 200C to 52C inside, rested, sliced thin, Yorkshire puddings and gravy. Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C until 52C inside, about an hour, and rest 20 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk, pour into very hot oiled tins and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock and pan juices.
Linda, the waitress who shoplifted a tie

Corned beef, Swiss and sauerkraut on rye with Russian dressing, fried in butter until crisp and melting. Mix 80g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish and 1 tbsp chopped gherkin for the dressing. Butter 8 slices rye on one side. On the unbuttered side spread dressing, then layer 400g sliced corned beef, 200g drained sauerkraut and 8 slices Swiss. Close and fry over medium heat for 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and melted.
W: 600ml cream infused with vanilla over 6 yolks and 80g sugar, baked in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes, chilled overnight, caster sugar torched to amber.
K: Arthur drinks whatever's open, and champagne is always open

Crème de cassis in a chilled flute, topped with brut champagne and a fresh raspberry dropped in. Chill 4 flutes in the freezer for 10 minutes. Pour 15ml crème de cassis into each glass. Tilt each flute and top slowly with 120ml chilled brut champagne so it doesn't foam over, then let it settle. Drop a fresh raspberry into each glass so it bobs in the bubbles and serve straight away, before the fizz fades.
T: Rich, tipsy and very funny.
D: A playboy millionaire must choose between his fortune and the working-class woman he loves.
P: Serve dessert when Hobson says something devastatingly dry.

title: Coming to America
S: Thin fries soaked in cold water, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C until golden, salt straight away.
Beef patties from the corner shop
the shop next door to the barbershop in Queens
Golden pastry turnovers filled with spiced beef mince, curry powder and thyme, baked until flaky.
for the royal bathers in Zamunda
Rosewater sugar cookie dough rolled thin, crushed dried rose petals pressed on top, baked at 170C for 9 minutes until just crisp.
M: two beef patties, special sauce, sesame seed bun
Two thin smashed patties, American cheese, shredded iceberg, diced onion, pickles and special sauce (mayo, sweet relish, mustard, paprika, vinegar) on a three-piece sesame bun.
Chicken brined in buttermilk and hot sauce, double-dredged, fried at 165C, then brushed with hot honey butter so it shines.
W: the McDowell's dessert menu, totally original
Puff pastry squares filled with apple cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, folded, crimped, egg washed, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
K: Blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk until thick.
T: A prince walks into a burger joint in Queens.
D: An African prince goes to Queens to find a bride and takes a job at a fast food joint.
P: Serve the burgers when the Big Mick comes out at McDowell's.

title: Men in Black
S: Edgar's place upstate, before the bug arrives
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and melted butter baked in a hot cast-iron pan at 210C for 20 minutes, cut in wedges with honey butter.
Chocolate pudding (milk, sugar, cocoa, cornflour, dark chocolate) set in small cups, crushed chocolate biscuit dirt and gummy worms.
Black beans blitzed with garlic, lime, cumin and chipotle, topped with feta and coriander. Corn chips.
M: the lunch K never gets to finish
Warm pastrami piled on rye with Swiss cheese and deli mustard, toasted in a pan until the cheese melts, pickles on the side.
the cart outside the agency's front door
Franks simmered with onion then griddled, in steamed buns with yellow mustard and onions cooked down in tomato paste.
W: Cake crumbs with cream cheese icing rolled into balls, dipped in white chocolate, silver lustre.
K: the bug in Edgar's skin, demanding sugar water

Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup blitzed with ice into a sharp, very sweet slush, with mint and lemon wheels. Dissolve 150g caster sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with 150ml lemon juice, 300ml cold water and 4 cups ice until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, add a lemon wheel and mint sprig and serve with spoons and straws.
T: Protecting Earth from the worst snacks in the universe.
D: A New York cop joins the secret agency that polices aliens living on Earth.
P: Serve the drinks when Edgar starts demanding sugar water.

title: Men in Black II
S: Rounds of pizza dough topped with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 230C for 8 minutes.
for Frank, who sings in the car
Brown butter cookie dough shaped into rounds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, pug faces piped on with melted dark chocolate.
the worms are back on the coffee machine
Chocolate pudding (milk, sugar, cocoa and cornflour whisked until thick) set in cups, topped with crushed biscuit and gummy worms.
M: Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and crumbled sausage, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
the other thing on the menu at Ben's
Pizza dough folded over ricotta, mozzarella, ham and basil, crimped shut, baked at 230C for 15 minutes, marinara for dipping.
W: the worms live on coffee and doughnuts
Glazed coffee doughnuts with a sticky espresso icing. Mix 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp strong espresso and 10g melted butter until smooth.
K: the worm guys live on coffee

Espresso blended thick with vanilla ice cream, milk and a little caramel, topped with cream and gummy worms on the rim. Brew 4 espressos and cool for 10 minutes. Blend with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 300ml cold milk and 2 tbsp caramel sauce until thick and smooth. Whip 300ml thickened cream to soft peaks. Pour the shakes into 4 tall glasses, top with the cream and drizzle with a little more caramel. Hang 2 gummy worms over each rim.
T: Back in black. Still hungry.
D: Agent J has to bring a neuralysed K back to stop an alien queen.
P: Serve dinner when Frank the pug sings in the car.

title: Big Trouble in Little China
S: Wang's family restaurant, before everything goes sideways
Mix pork mince with garlic chives, ginger, soy, Shaoxing and sesame oil, pleat into gyoza wrappers. Pan-fry until the bottoms crisp, add water, lid on for 4 minutes. Black vinegar and chilli oil dip.
Score squid, cut into strips, toss in potato starch with salt, white pepper and five spice, fry at 190C for 90 seconds. Wok-toss with fried garlic, sliced chilli and spring onion.
the Chinatown kitchen where it all starts
Pork, cabbage and mushroom rolled in spring roll wrappers, fried at 180C until crisp, sweet chilli and soy for dipping.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with hoisin, honey, soy, five spice, red fermented bean curd and garlic overnight. Roast at 160C covered for 90 minutes, uncover, glaze and blast at 220C until sticky and charred.
Fry pork mince with ya cai and Sichuan pepper until crisp. Sauce of sesame paste, chilli oil, black vinegar and soy in the bowl, thin wheat noodles on top, then the pork and spring onion.
W: Whisk egg whites, sugar, flour, melted butter and vanilla to a thin batter, spread 8cm circles, bake at 180C for 6 minutes, fold around a paper fortune while hot.
K: Egg Shen's bottle for the trip below Chinatown

Plum wine shaken with lemon, ginger syrup and egg white, served over ice with a pickled plum or a cherry. Simmer 50g sugar, 50ml water and 20g sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Shake 240ml plum wine, 60ml lemon juice, 40ml ginger syrup and 1 egg white without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and garnish with a pickled plum or cherry.
T: Something big is cooking in Chinatown.
D: A loudmouth truck driver gets dragged into a magical underworld battle in San Francisco's Chinatown.
P: Serve the ribs when Jack drives the Pork-Chop Express into Chinatown.

title: The Last Dragon
S: eaten one piece at a time, like Leroy at the movies
Popcorn tossed in melted butter with furikake and a pinch of sugar. Serve with chopsticks and see who gives up first.
Shredded cabbage, carrot, shiitake and glass noodles stir-fried with soy and white pepper, cooled, rolled tight in spring roll pastry, fried at 180C. Sweet chilli.
the fortune cookie factory where Leroy looks for the master
Thin vanilla batter spread in circles, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded around a fortune while hot.
M: Fortune cookie factory chicken lo mein
the fortune cookie factory where Leroy looks for the master

Fresh egg noodles tossed in a smoking wok with chicken, bean sprouts, spring onion and oyster sauce. Slice 500g chicken thigh, toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Blanch 500g fresh egg noodles 1 minute and drain. Stir-fry the chicken in a smoking wok with 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Add 2 garlic cloves, 1 sliced carrot and 200g bean sprouts for 1 minute, then noodles, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss 2 minutes and finish with spring onions.
Chicken thigh chunks in potato starch batter, double-fried, tossed in a sauce of dried chilli, garlic, ginger, soy, black vinegar, sugar and stock. Rice.
W: Glutinous rice flour, sugar and coconut milk steamed into dough, wrapped around cubes of mango and whipped cream, dusted in cornflour.
K: Steep dried chrysanthemum flowers with a little rock sugar for 5 minutes, chill and serve over ice.
T: Find the glow. Then find the dumplings.
D: A young martial artist in Harlem searches for the master who can teach him the final level.
P: Serve dinner when Leroy eats popcorn with chopsticks at the cinema.

title: Crocodile Dundee
S: the only bush tucker everyone will actually eat
Score pork belly skin, dry uncovered in the fridge overnight, salt heavily, roast at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C for 40 until it puffs and crackles. Cut into shards.
King prawns marinated in garlic, chilli, lemon zest and oil, skewered and grilled hot for 90 seconds a side, lemon myrtle butter brushed on at the end.
Wally's shout at the hotel bar in the middle of nowhere

Mince cooked with onion, Worcestershire, tomato sauce and stock, thickened, cooled, baked in shortcrust bases with puff lids at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 500g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and 250ml stock, thicken and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
M: that's not a knife, this is the carving tool

Barramundi fillets skin scored and dried, grilled skin down until crisp, flipped for 1 minute, brought out with a big hunting knife. Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp lemon myrtle and spoon over.
Thin rump seared hard, on toasted Turkish with caramelised onion, a fried egg, beetroot, tomato, lettuce, cheese and barbecue sauce.
W: home, a long way from New York
Butter sponge cut into squares, dipped in thin chocolate icing (icing sugar, cocoa, butter, milk), rolled in desiccated coconut.
K: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
the Walkabout Creek pub, where the yarns get taller every round

Dark rum poured over ice and spicy ginger beer with plenty of fresh lime, in a tall frosty glass. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml chilled ginger beer. Slowly pour 45ml dark rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.
T: That's not a snack. This is a snack.
D: A legendary bushman from the Top End takes on New York.
P: Pour a beer when Mick first sees a bidet in the hotel.

title: Crocodile Dundee II
S: Mick's camp in the Top End
450g self-raising flour, salt, 60g rubbed-in butter and milk to a soft dough, shaped and baked at 200C for 30 minutes (or in a camp oven in the coals). Butter and golden syrup.
Wally minding the pub while Mick's in New York

Thick beef sausages grilled slowly, rolled in white bread with fried onions and tomato sauce. Grill 8 thick beef sausages slowly over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often. Fry 2 sliced onions until soft and golden. Wrap each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.
Kakadu plum or green mango diced with chilli, lime, red onion and coriander, corn chips or grilled flatbread.
Kakadu plum powder or green mango@Produce
M: Mick's fishing method, even in New York harbour

Whole barramundi stuffed with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in foil (or paperbark) and cooked over coals for 20 minutes. Stuff a 1.5kg whole barramundi with lemon slices, a sliced knob of ginger and a bunch of coriander. Dot with 50g butter and wrap well in foil. Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning once.
Rump seared hard and rested, sliced, on toasted Turkish with caramelised onion, melted cheddar, beetroot and barbecue sauce.
W: 4 whites whipped with 220g caster sugar, cornflour and vinegar, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, cream, passionfruit and mango.
K: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic
back in Mick's Top End country after the ambush

Gin over ice with tonic, a lemon myrtle sugar rim and fresh lime, sharp and cold for a hot night in the bush. Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with 1 tsp ground lemon myrtle on a plate. Run lime around 4 glass rims and dip. Fill with ice, add 45ml gin and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml tonic water. Add a lime wheel.
T: From New York back to the bush.
D: Mick takes Sue home to the Top End while drug dealers chase them.
P: Serve the mains when Mick sets up his bush ambush.

title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
S: the Greek diner where they wait tables
Hand-cut chips double-fried, tossed while hot with dried oregano, lemon zest and crumbled feta, Greek diner style.
Grilled cheese sandwiches with cheddar and a little Dijon, griddled in butter, cut into soldiers.
Fozzie tries to hibernate in the woods, and a bear needs supplies

Crunchy cornflakes coated in bubbling honey butter, baked in paper cases until golden and set. Melt 90g butter with 80g sugar and 2 tbsp honey and bubble for 1 minute until frothy. Pour over 4 cups cornflakes and stir until coated. Spoon into 20 paper patty cases on a tray. Bake at 150C for 10 minutes until golden, then cool completely so they set crunchy.
M: Three slices of toast: turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, chips on the side.
Pete's big Greek salad with souvlaki
Pete's diner, big tomato, big olives, very Pete

Chunky tomato, cucumber, capsicum, kalamatas and a slab of feta with oregano, served with grilled lemon chicken skewers. Marinate 600g diced chicken thigh in 3 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp dried oregano for 30 minutes, thread onto 8 skewers and grill 10 minutes, turning. Cut 4 tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 1 green capsicum and half a red onion into chunks. Add 100g kalamatas, top with a 200g slab of feta, sprinkle oregano and dress with oil and red wine vinegar.
W: the wedding that might be real
Two layers of vanilla butter cake sandwiched and covered in Swiss meringue buttercream, half tinted pink and half green, piped flowers.
K: Greek yoghurt blended with milk, honey, banana and ice into a thick frothy shake with a sprinkle of cinnamon. Peel and slice 2 ripe bananas. Blend with 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 cup ice for 45 seconds until thick and frothy. Taste and add a little more honey if needed. Pour into 4 tall glasses, drizzle each with a little more honey and dust with ground cinnamon. Serve with straws.
T: Lights, camera, crab cakes.
D: Kermit and the gang go to New York to put on a Broadway show.
P: Serve dessert at Kermit and Piggy's wedding.

title: Annie
S: the good version, with brown sugar
Oats cooked slowly in milk with a pinch of salt, topped with brown sugar caramelised under the grill and a spoon of cream.
the staff's welcome song for Annie
Bake vol-au-vent cases crisp, fill with chicken and mushroom in a thyme cream sauce. Blanched asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto alongside.
the movie night out at Radio City
Pop kernels in coconut oil, toss with melted butter and fine salt while hot, serve in paper cones.
M: the first dinner at the mansion
Dry-brine a chicken overnight, tarragon butter under the skin, roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C to 72C in the thigh. Pan gravy, roast potatoes and buttered peas.
Chicken thighs in a curry of onion, ginger, garlic, garam masala, tomato and yoghurt, simmered 30 minutes, basmati rice.
W: ice cream for everyone, Warbucks shouts
Hot fudge of dark chocolate, cream and golden syrup poured over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, whipped cream, toasted almonds and a cherry.
K: Mansion ginger beer and orange punch
the mansion staff's party drinks in 1933

Spicy ginger beer with fresh orange juice, lime and mint, served from a punch bowl over plenty of ice. In a large jug, combine 400ml orange juice, 60ml lime juice and a handful of torn mint.
