Add ice, then pour in 800ml chilled ginger beer and stir gently. Add orange slices and serve in glasses with a mint sprig.
T: From the orphanage to the mansion, with dessert.
D: An orphan is invited to spend a week with billionaire Oliver Warbucks.
P: Serve the snacks when Annie arrives at the Warbucks mansion.

title: Newsies
S: a penny snack on the street corner
Pretzel dough shaped, 30 seconds in a baking soda bath, coarse salt, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.
Corn boiled 5 minutes, then charred on a grill and rolled in butter and salt.
the boys' breakfast before they head out to sell the papes

Soft milk buns rolled with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked golden and glazed with vanilla icing. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 50g sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm milk, 1 egg and 50g soft butter, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour. Roll to 40 x 30cm, spread with 60g butter and 100g brown sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Roll up, cut 12 buns and rise 30 minutes. Bake at 190C for 22 minutes. Glaze with 120g icing sugar mixed with milk and vanilla.
M: Franks griddled until blistered, in soft steamed buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in newspaper.
the boys' dinner at the lodging house
Lamb neck chops browned, layered with potato, onion and carrot, stock poured over, braised covered at 160C for 2 hours. Parsley.
W: Puff pastry squares filled with apple cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, folded, egg-washed and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
K: a penny drink at the 1899 strike rally

Sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses until it fizzes up into a creamy foam. Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses. Slowly pour 250ml chilled sarsaparilla over each, letting the foam rise and settle before topping up. Add a second small scoop, serve with long spoons and straws.
T: Extra, extra, eat all about it.
D: Newsboys go on strike against Pulitzer in 1899 New York.
P: Serve the mains when the strike starts.

title: An American Tail
S: Crisp grated potato and onion pancakes with sour cream and apple sauce. Grate 6 medium potatoes (about 800g) and 1 onion and squeeze out the liquid.
little meat pies from the old country
Yeasted dough wrapped around beef, onion and dill filling, fried or baked at 200C until golden.
the Mousekewitz family's taste of the old country

Potato and cheese dumplings boiled then fried in butter with golden onion, served with sour cream and dill. Mash 500g boiled potatoes with 100g grated cheddar and salt. Cut 24 rounds from 2 sheets fresh pasta or use gow gee wrappers, fill each with a spoon of potato, fold and press shut. Boil in batches for 3 minutes until they float. Fry 1 sliced onion in 40g butter until golden, add the dumplings and toss 2 minutes. Serve with 150g sour cream and dill.
M: Beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato simmered in beef stock with a splash of vinegar and dill, sour cream on top.
Mama's cheese blintzes with berry sauce
Mama Mousekewitz's cooking, carried from Shostka to New York

Thin crêpes rolled around sweet lemon ricotta, fried golden in butter and served with warm berry sauce and sour cream. Whisk 150g plain flour, 3 eggs, 350ml milk and a pinch of salt. Cook 8 thin crêpes in a buttered pan, one side only. Mix 400g ricotta, 100g cream cheese, 50g sugar and lemon zest. Fill the cooked side, fold into parcels and fry in 30g butter for 2 minutes a side. Simmer 300g frozen berries with 2 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes and serve with sour cream.
W: a Hanukkah sweet from back home in Shostka

Honey, oil, eggs, brown sugar, coffee and spices beaten into flour, baked at 170C for 50 minutes. Whisk 250g honey, 125ml oil, 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar and 125ml strong coffee. Fold in 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder and 2 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a lined tin and bake at 170C for 50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
K: the samovar's on while Papa plays violin

Black tea brewed strong and poured into glasses with lemon slices and a spoonful of jam to sweeten. Brew 4 tsp black tea in 1L just-boiled water for 4 minutes and strain into 4 heatproof glasses. Add a slice of lemon to each and serve with 100g raspberry jam for stirring in instead of sugar.
T: No cats in America. Plenty of cheese.
D: A young mouse emigrates to New York and gets separated from his family.
P: Serve the cheese when Fievel arrives in New York.

title: Oliver & Company
S: Cocktail franks simmered 5 minutes, then glazed in a hot pan with Dijon and honey until sticky, served on toothpicks.
Goldfish-shaped cheese crackers: cheddar, butter and flour rolled, cut into fish, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
a street cart snack for a New York winter

Chestnuts scored and roasted until the shells curl, peeled warm and tossed in sage brown butter with flaky salt, served in paper cones. Heat the oven to 220C. Cut a cross into the flat side of 500g chestnuts and soak them in water for 15 minutes. Roast on a tray for 20 to 25 minutes until the shells curl back. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes, then peel while warm. Melt 40g butter in a pan with 6 sage leaves until it smells nutty, toss the chestnuts through, season with flaky salt and serve in paper cones.
M: Jenny's lemon and thyme roast chicken

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme, crunchy potatoes cooked in the drippings, buttered green beans and a quick pan gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and 6 thyme sprigs, rub with 30g soft butter and salt. Roast 20 minutes, then drop to 180C. Add 1kg peeled, quartered potatoes tossed in oil around the bird and roast another 50 minutes until the thigh juices run clear. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour and 300ml chicken stock into the pan juices for gravy. Boil 300g green beans 3 minutes and toss in butter.
Franks simmered then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with mustard, chopped onion, relish and warm sauerkraut.
W: Shortbread dough rolled 6mm, cut into cat shapes, baked at 160C for 18 minutes, iced orange with little whiskers.
K: a kitten's favourite, warmed up for the humans

Full cream milk warmed with honey, cinnamon and vanilla, frothed until foamy and dusted with nutmeg, served in mugs with a cinnamon stick. Pour 1 litre full cream milk into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Warm over medium heat for 5 minutes until steaming but not boiling. Remove the cinnamon stick and whisk hard or use a frother until foamy. Pour into 4 mugs, dust with a pinch of grated nutmeg and add a fresh cinnamon stick to each.
T: Why should I worry? Dinner's ready.
D: A homeless kitten joins a gang of dogs in New York.
P: Serve the hot dogs when Oliver and Dodger raid the hot dog cart.

title: Kate & Leopold
S: Leopold's candlelit rooftop, set with proper manners
Baguette sliced thin on the bias, brushed with oil and toasted. Top with whipped goat's cheese, a few slices of poached pear and a drizzle of honey and thyme.
Leopold refuses to lie about the diet margarine in the ad
Three butters on a board: cultured, salted Irish, and brown butter whipped with honey. Warm sourdough and radishes with flaky salt.
M: roast fish, white linen and manners
Whole snapper scored, stuffed with lemon, fennel and dill, roasted at 220C for 25 minutes. Beurre blanc (shallot, white wine and vinegar reduced, cold butter whisked in) and new potatoes.
Kate's steak frites with red wine butter
the late nights at the ad agency

Sirloin seared hard and rested, sliced, with shallot and red wine butter melting over the top and double-fried frites with sea salt. Reduce 150ml red wine with 1 finely chopped shallot until 2 tbsp remain, cool, then mash into 100g soft butter with parsley and salt. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Season 4 sirloin steaks (250g each) and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest 5 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp and salt them. Slice the steak and top with the butter.
W: an 1876 dessert that still holds up
Melt 200g dark chocolate with 30g butter, whisk in 4 yolks, fold in 4 whites whipped to soft peaks with 40g sugar, then 150ml whipped cream. Set in glasses 4 hours.
K: Red wine with brandy, orange and soda water over ice, the way a Victorian party served it.
T: A duke from 1876 discovers modern margarine.
D: A duke time-travels from 1876 to modern New York and falls for an ad executive.
P: Serve dinner when Leopold sets up the rooftop dinner.

title: Hitch
S: the jet ski date to Ellis Island
Grilled ciabatta rubbed with garlic, topped with chopped tomato, basil and a little red onion dressed in olive oil and salt.
Allergy-safe whipped feta and baba ganoush
Hitch's allergy, and his swollen face

Whipped feta with lemon and chilli oil beside smoky baba ghanoush, scooped up with warm oven-baked pita chips. Not a prawn in sight. Heat the oven to 220C. Prick 2 eggplants and roast 40 minutes until collapsed, then scoop the flesh and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 crushed garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest until smooth, then drizzle with 1 tbsp chilli oil. Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, brush with olive oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp.
he spills them all down his front
Pork and veal meatballs braised in tomato sugo, on soft rolls with melted provolone and basil. Napkins essential.
M: Rib eye steak frites with béarnaise
the proper date dinner he coaches Albert through

Rib eye seared and basted with butter, rested, served with tarragon béarnaise and double-fried frites with sea salt. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with 1 chopped shallot and tarragon to 1 tbsp, then whisk with 3 egg yolks over simmering water and slowly beat in 180g melted butter for the béarnaise. Season 4 rib eye steaks and sear 3 minutes a side, basting with butter and thyme, then rest 8 minutes. Fry the chips at 190C for 3 minutes and salt.
the safe choice, no shellfish anywhere near it
Chicken breast pounded thin, floured and seared, pan sauce of white wine, lemon, capers and butter, over angel hair.
W: Fat strawberries dipped in glossy dark chocolate, drizzled with white chocolate and finished with crushed pistachios, set on baking paper. Wash and fully dry 500g large strawberries, leaving the green tops on. Melt 200g dark chocolate in a bowl over simmering water. Dip each strawberry two thirds of the way in, let the excess drip off, and lay on baking paper. Sprinkle with 30g crushed pistachios. Melt 50g white chocolate and drizzle across in thin lines with a spoon. Chill 20 minutes until set.
K: the Hitch effect, bubbles for the big date

Gin shaken with fresh lemon and sugar syrup, topped with cold brut sparkling wine in a flute and finished with a long lemon twist. Chill 4 flutes. Shake 120ml gin, 60ml fresh lemon juice and 40ml sugar syrup with ice for 10 seconds. Strain evenly into the flutes. Top each with about 90ml cold brut sparkling wine, pouring slowly so it doesn't foam over. Twist a long strip of lemon peel over each glass and drop it in.
T: Every dinner date needs a coach.
D: A dating coach helps men woo women but struggles with his own love life.
P: Serve the snacks when Hitch has his allergic reaction.

title: Serendipity
S: Smoked salmon blini and prosciutto figs
the last pair of black cashmere gloves

Blini with smoked salmon, crème fraîche and dill, plus figs wrapped in prosciutto with blue cheese, laid out on black slate. Warm 16 cocktail blini at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a spoon of crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a crack of pepper. Quarter 6 fresh figs, press a small piece of blue cheese into each, then wrap with a strip of prosciutto. Drizzle the figs with 1 tbsp honey and serve both on a dark board.
Molasses gingerbread spiced with ginger, cinnamon and cloves, baked in a tray at 170C, cut into squares with a lemon glaze.
Score chestnuts with a cross, soak 20 minutes, roast at 220C for 20 minutes until the shells curl, wrap in a towel 5 minutes, peel warm.
M: the dinner they could have had years earlier
Sirloin seared and basted with butter and thyme, rested, peppercorn sauce of brandy, stock and cream, double-fried frites.
Waldorf club sandwich with Waldorf salad
the lift ride test at the Waldorf

Triple-decker of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut, served with a Waldorf salad of apple, celery, grapes and walnuts. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices white sandwich bread. Spread with mayo and build each sandwich as toast, 100g sliced roast chicken, lettuce, toast, 2 bacon rashers, sliced tomato, toast. Pin with skewers and cut into four triangles. For the salad, toss 2 diced red apples, 2 sliced celery sticks, 150g halved grapes and 60g toasted walnuts with 3 tbsp mayo and a squeeze of lemon.
W: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 2 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp sugar and 100ml milk, cool. Blend with 250ml milk and 3 cups of ice until slushy. Whipped cream and shaved chocolate.
K: the Waldorf elevators on a winter night
Cranberry juice warmed with orange slices, cinnamon and cloves, served hot in mugs.
T: Frozen hot chocolate. Fate decides.
D: Two strangers meet over the last pair of gloves and leave it to fate to bring them back.
P: Serve dessert when they first sit down at the dessert cafe.

title: Die Hard
S: smoked salmon blini on silver trays
Warm blini topped with crème fraîche, curls of smoked salmon, salmon roe and dill, passed around on a tray.
Nakatomi salmon and tuna sushi platter
it's a Japanese company Christmas party

Salmon and tuna nigiri with cucumber and avocado maki on seasoned sushi rice, served with wasabi, pickled ginger and soy. Rinse 400g sushi rice until clear, cook with 480ml water, then fold through 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Slice 200g sashimi salmon and 200g sashimi tuna. Shape 16 small oblongs of rice, dab with wasabi and top with fish. Lay rice on 3 nori sheets, add cucumber and avocado strips, roll tight with a mat and cut each into 8. Serve with soy and pickled ginger.
nuts and a cold drink in the back of the limo
Cashews and almonds roasted with butter, rosemary, brown sugar and cayenne, served warm in a crystal bowl.
M: Al Powell lives on snack cakes, you don't have to
Topside rubbed with mustard and pepper, roasted at 200C to 52C, rested and shaved thin. Soft rolls, horseradish cream, rocket and pickled onions.
John never got his shoes back on

Flathead in a light beer batter, fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, pico de gallo and chipotle mayo. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold lager and a pinch of salt. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips, dust in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Dice 2 tomatoes, half a red onion and a handful of coriander with lime juice for pico de gallo. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with shredded cabbage, fish, pico and chipotle mayo.
W: Vanilla sponge baked in a slab, cut into fingers, split and piped with marshmallow cream (whipped egg whites with hot sugar syrup), wrapped in baking paper.
K: Argyle shows off the limo bar on the way in

Bourbon stirred over ice with brown sugar syrup and orange bitters, poured over one big cube with a flamed strip of orange peel. Make syrup by dissolving 2 tbsp brown sugar in 2 tbsp hot water. In a jug with ice, stir 240ml bourbon, 4 tsp of the syrup and 8 dashes orange bitters for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into 4 heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim with it and drop it in.
T: Welcome to the party. Bring a plate.
D: An off-duty New York cop takes on terrorists in an LA skyscraper on Christmas Eve.
P: Serve the canapés when the Nakatomi Christmas party is in full swing.

title: Die Hard 2
S: the snack bar at Dulles on Christmas Eve
Buttermilk biscuits split warm and filled with thin slices of salty ham and a smear of mustard butter.
stuck at the airport on Christmas Eve

Wings dried and baked until crackling, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, served with blue cheese dip and celery sticks. Pat 1.2kg chicken wings dry, toss with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge for a few hours. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 120ml hot sauce and toss the wings through. Mix 100g crumbled blue cheese with 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with 4 celery sticks cut into batons.
Bake small potatoes, halve, scoop, brush with butter, crisp at 220C, fill with cheddar and bacon, bake again, sour cream and chives.
M: Virginia pulled pork rolls with slaw
Virginia barbecue, eaten standing up between fights

Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow cooked until it pulls apart, tossed in tangy vinegar sauce and piled into soft rolls with crunchy slaw. Rub 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Roast covered at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Simmer 150ml apple cider vinegar, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp chilli flakes and 2 tbsp tomato sauce for 3 minutes and toss through the shredded pork. Mix shredded cabbage and carrot with 3 tbsp mayo and a splash of vinegar. Pile into 8 soft rolls with the slaw.
everyone's stuck at the gate waiting on his plane

Beef chuck and mince browned, braised 2.5 hours with onion, chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans. Brown 600g diced beef chuck and 400g mince. Add 1 onion, 2 tbsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin, then 2 tins tomatoes. Braise 2.5 hours, adding 2 tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.
W: Gingerbread dough (butter, brown sugar, golden syrup, ginger, cinnamon) rolled, cut into planes and snowflakes, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, iced.
K: another Christmas Eve, how does it happen twice

Rich homemade eggnog of milk, cream, egg yolks and nutmeg, spiked with bourbon, chilled and served in tumblers with fresh nutmeg grated over. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 80g caster sugar until pale. Warm 500ml milk and 250ml cream with a pinch of nutmeg until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks. Return to the pan and stir over low heat for 4 minutes until it coats a spoon, without boiling. Cool, stir in 120ml bourbon and chill 2 hours. Pour into tumblers and grate fresh nutmeg on top.
T: Same thing happens to the same guy twice.
D: John McClane fights terrorists who've taken over a snowed-in Washington airport on Christmas Eve.
P: Serve dinner while Holly's plane circles overhead, running out of fuel.

title: Lethal Weapon
S: Soft milk bread rolls proved twice and baked golden, brushed with melted honey butter and finished with flaky salt, served warm in a basket. Warm 250ml milk with 40g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar to blood heat, then add 7g dried yeast and 1 egg. Mix into 500g bread flour with 1 tsp salt and knead 8 minutes. Prove 1 hour until doubled. Shape into 12 balls in a greased tin and prove 30 minutes more. Bake at 190C for 18 minutes. Melt 30g butter with 1 tbsp honey, brush over the hot rolls and sprinkle with flaky salt.
crackers and whatever's left in his fridge
Saltine crackers with slabs of sharp cheddar, folded salami and pickled jalapeños, served straight off a chopping board.
Warm crab and cream cheese dip with a cheddar crust, scooped up with crackers. Mix 250g cream cheese, 150g sour cream, 2 tsp Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon.
M: the family jokes about her cooking, make yours better
Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, carrot, celery and tomato paste, deglazed with red wine, stock and thyme, braised at 150C for 3 hours. Mash.

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy, with sage cornbread stuffing, roast sweet potato and a proper pan gravy. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2 litres water with 100g salt and 50g brown sugar. Pat dry, rub with butter and roast at 170C for about 75 minutes until it reads 70C inside, then rest 15 minutes. Mix 300g crumbled cornbread with 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks softened in butter, chopped sage, 1 egg and 200ml stock, and bake 30 minutes. Roast 800g sweet potato wedges alongside. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: fifty candles, he's too old for this
Chocolate butter cake baked in two layers at 170C for 35 minutes, filled and covered in chocolate buttercream, fifty candles if you have the nerve.
K: beer from the little fridge, drunk on the sand

Ice-cold lager mixed with lime, hot sauce, Worcestershire and tomato juice in a chilli salt-rimmed glass, finished with a lime wedge. Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in the chilli salt, then fill with ice. Into each glass add 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 4 dashes hot sauce and 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce. Top each with a 375ml bottle of cold lager poured slowly and stir once. Garnish with lime wedges.
T: Too old for this? Not for dessert.
D: A reckless LA cop is partnered with a family man about to turn fifty.
P: Serve the mains at Roger's birthday dinner, when Riggs meets the family.

title: Lethal Weapon 2
S: they always get his order wrong
Thin fries soaked, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, salted. Check the bag before you leave, Leo would.
Biltong sliced thin across the grain, with dried peaches and macadamias roasted at 170C for 8 minutes with salt.
M: Leo wants his order right this time

Two smashed beef patties with melted American cheese, onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce on a toasted soft bun, wrapped in paper. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls of 100g. Heat a heavy pan or flat grill until smoking. Add a ball, smash it flat with a spatula and season. Cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip, top with a slice of cheese and cook 1 minute more. Toast 4 buns cut side down. Stack two patties on each bun with finely diced onion, sliced pickles, mustard and tomato sauce, then wrap tightly in baking paper for 2 minutes to steam.
Coiled boerewors (or thick spiced beef sausage) grilled over coals, in rolls with tomato and onion relish (onion, tomato, chilli and a little sugar simmered 20 minutes).
W: Murtaugh is mortified by his daughter's commercial
Vanilla cupcakes with swirls of pastel buttercream and sprinkles, the brightest ones you can make.
K: Roger's ginger and lime lager shandy
a cold one from Roger's fridge

Cold lager topped with ginger beer and fresh lime over ice in tall glasses, garnished with lime wheels and a sprig of mint. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze half a lime into each. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass, then top with 150ml ginger beer and stir gently once. Garnish each with a lime wheel and a sprig of mint. Serve straight away while it's still fizzing.
T: Diplomatic immunity doesn't cover dessert.
D: Riggs and Murtaugh take on South African diplomats running drugs under diplomatic immunity.
P: Serve the snacks when Leo Getz says okay, okay, okay.

title: Lethal Weapon 3
S: the hockey game Riggs and Murtaugh get to
Franks simmered then griddled, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, sweet relish and chopped onion.
Leo's open home smoked trout and quiches

Cucumber rounds topped with whipped cream cheese, smoked trout and dill, alongside warm bacon and leek mini quiches, like a real estate open house. Heat the oven to 180C. Press 12 shortcrust rounds into a mini muffin tray. Fry 2 diced bacon rashers with 1 sliced leek until soft and divide between the cases. Whisk 2 eggs with 100ml cream and 40g grated gruyère, pour in and bake 18 minutes. Beat 150g cream cheese with lemon zest, pipe onto 16 thick cucumber rounds and top with flaked smoked trout and dill.
the opening scene that brings the building down
Popcorn tossed with melted butter, garlic powder and finely grated parmesan, piled high in a bowl.
M: Chicken thighs simmered with onion, celery, carrot and thyme, shredded back into a creamy broth, fluffy dumplings (self-raising flour, butter, milk) spooned on top and steamed 15 minutes.
they compare scars, you compare sauce

Pork ribs dry-rubbed and cooked low and slow in foil, then glazed under the grill with two sauces, a sweet bourbon one and a hot chipotle one. Rub 2 racks pork ribs (about 2kg) with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp garlic powder. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 3 hours. For the sweet sauce, simmer 150ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp bourbon and 1 tbsp honey for 5 minutes. For the hot sauce, blend 150ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Unwrap, brush one rack with each sauce and grill 5 minutes until sticky and charred.
W: Lemon drizzle loaf: butter, sugar, eggs, flour and lemon zest baked at 170C for 50 minutes, soaked with lemon juice and sugar while hot.
K: Eight days to go whiskey sour

Bourbon shaken hard with lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until frothy, poured over ice with a dash of bitters and a cocktail cherry. Add 240ml bourbon, 120ml fresh lemon juice, 80ml sugar syrup and 2 egg whites to a shaker without ice and shake hard for 15 seconds to foam. Add a big handful of ice and shake again for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over fresh ice. Shake 2 dashes of aromatic bitters onto the foam of each and add a cocktail cherry.
T: Eight days left. Make every meal count.
D: Days from retirement, Murtaugh gets pulled into one last case with Riggs and Lorna.
P: Pour drinks during the retirement countdown.

title: Lethal Weapon 4
S: Pork and prawn siu mai: pork mince, chopped prawn, shiitake, ginger and soy in open wonton wrappers, steamed 8 minutes, a dot of carrot on top.
Murtaugh's smoked trout dip and crackers
the fishing trip on Roger's boat

Hot-smoked trout flaked into cream cheese with lemon, dill and horseradish, topped with capers and served with crisp water crackers. Remove the skin and bones from 200g hot-smoked trout and flake it. Beat 200g softened cream cheese with 2 tbsp sour cream, the zest and juice of half a lemon, 2 tsp horseradish and 2 tbsp chopped dill. Fold the trout through, keeping some chunks, and season with pepper. Spoon into a bowl, scatter with 1 tbsp capers and extra dill, and serve with water crackers.
Leo's back, and he will not stop talking
Wonton wrappers cut in triangles, fried at 180C until puffed, tossed in salt and five spice, sweet chilli dip.
M: Chinatown, where Uncle Benny runs things
Duck pricked, dried overnight, rubbed with five spice and salt inside, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, glazed with honey and soy for the last 15. Pancakes, cucumber and hoisin.
a fishing boat should mean fish for dinner

Whole snapper scored and stuffed with lemon, garlic and herbs, grilled over hot coals until the skin blisters, with charred lemon and garlic butter. Score 2 whole snapper (about 800g each) three times on each side, rub with oil and salt, and stuff with lemon slices, 2 sliced garlic cloves, parsley and dill. Grill over medium-hot coals or a barbecue for 8 to 10 minutes a side until the flesh flakes at the bone. Grill 2 halved lemons cut side down. Melt 60g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley and spoon over the fish.
W: Leo talks too much, his fortune says so
Thin vanilla batter in circles, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded around a paper fortune while hot.
K: Chinatown, where Uncle Benny runs things

Gin and lychee syrup over ice, topped with spicy ginger ale and lime, garnished with a whole lychee and a sliver of fresh ginger. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice. Add 45ml gin and 30ml lychee syrup to each, plus a squeeze of lime. Top with 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once. Thread a lychee onto a cocktail pick with a thin slice of fresh ginger and lay it across each glass.
T: The family gets bigger.
D: Riggs and Murtaugh take on a Triad gang smuggling people into LA.
P: Serve the Chinese food when Uncle Benny turns up.

title: Beverly Hills Cop
S: banana bread bites for the stakeout car

Mash 3 overripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, an egg and vanilla, fold in 200g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt, bake at 170C for 55 minutes. Slice thick and toast in butter.
Harrow Club smoked trout brioche toasts
the private club Axel talks his way into

Toasted brioche rounds with crème fraîche, smoked trout and chives, plus grapes rolled in goat's cheese and crushed pistachios. Cut 16 rounds from 4 thick slices of brioche and toast at 180C for 6 minutes. Top each with crème fraîche, a flake of smoked trout and snipped chives. Wrap 16 seedless grapes in a thin layer of soft goat's cheese, roll in 50g finely crushed pistachios and chill 15 minutes. Serve both on a tray.
home turf, a long way from Beverly Hills
Cocktail franks in mini buns topped with a loose beef chilli (fine mince, onion, chilli powder, cumin, a little water simmered 45 minutes), mustard and raw onion.
M: Detroit coney dog with loose beef chilli
chilli, onion and mustard, the Motor City way

Natural casing franks griddled, tucked into steamed buns with a ladle of loose beef coney chilli, yellow mustard and plenty of diced white onion. Brown 400g fine beef mince in a pan, breaking it up very fine. Add 1 finely diced onion, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 250ml water and simmer 40 minutes until thick and loose. Griddle 8 natural casing franks for 6 minutes until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli, a stripe of mustard and diced white onion.
the steak sandwich Axel puts on someone else's tab
Sirloin seared hard and sliced thin, caramelised onion, Swiss and horseradish mayo on a toasted brioche roll, fries on the side.
W: with the banana that didn't go in the tailpipe
Split banana, three scoops (vanilla, chocolate, strawberry), hot fudge, crushed pineapple, strawberry sauce, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: Axel blags his way into the Beverly Palm

White rum blended with pineapple, coconut cream and lime until frosty, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Add 180ml white rum, 360ml pineapple juice, 200ml coconut cream, the juice of 1 lime and 3 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Garnish each with a pineapple wedge on the rim and a cocktail cherry.
T: Detroit attitude. Beverly Hills prices.
D: A wisecracking Detroit cop goes to Beverly Hills to solve his best friend's murder.
P: Serve the bananas when Axel stuffs them up the cop car's exhaust.

title: Beverly Hills Cop II
S: Rodeo Drive bacon and gruyère quiches
Axel crashing the Beverly Hills party circuit

Bite-size shortcrust cases filled with smoky bacon, caramelised onion, gruyère and a just-set egg custard, finished with chives. Heat the oven to 180C. Cut 24 rounds from 3 sheets of shortcrust pastry and press into mini muffin trays. Fry 3 diced bacon rashers with 1 thinly sliced onion for 10 minutes until golden and divide between the cases with 80g grated gruyère. Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml cream, salt and pepper, pour into the cases and bake 15 minutes until just set. Top with snipped chives.
Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and sugar snaps on ice with green goddess dressing (mayo, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, anchovy, lemon).
a taste of Detroit's Hamtramck, a long way from Beverly Hills
Potato and cheese dumplings boiled then pan-fried in butter with onions, sour cream on the side.
M: Axel moves into a house that isn't his
Rib eye steaks and corn on the cob over hot coals, chimichurri (parsley, oregano, garlic, chilli, vinegar, oil) and a big potato salad.
Room service club sandwich and fries
room service on someone else's account

Triple-decker toasted club of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles with hot salted fries. Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, and salt them. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread and spread with mayo. Layer each sandwich toast, 100g sliced roast chicken and lettuce, toast, 2 bacon rashers and sliced tomato, toast. Pin each with 4 skewers, cut into 4 triangles and serve with the fries.
W: a nod to the first film
Split banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: Billy Rosewood, always up for the ride

Tequila and fresh orange juice poured over ice, with grenadine sinking to the bottom for the sunrise, finished with an orange wheel and cherry. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml tequila and 150ml fresh orange juice to each and stir. Slowly pour 15ml grenadine down the inside of each glass so it sinks and fades up through the juice. Don't stir again. Garnish each with an orange wheel and a cocktail cherry.
T: Back in Beverly Hills.
D: Axel returns to LA to hunt the gang that shot Captain Bogomil.
P: Serve dessert when Axel bluffs his way into the Playboy Mansion party.

title: Beverly Hills Cop III
S: Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of bicarb, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.
Theme park churros with chocolate dip

Choux dough piped in long ridged lengths, fried crisp and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with a thick hot chocolate dipping sauce. Bring 250ml water, 50g butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour, cool 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and stir in 150g dark chocolate for the dip.
grab one before Axel climbs the broken ride

Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Serve with mustard.
M: Uncle Dave's theme park turkey legs
the friendly old man who built Wonder World

Turkey drumsticks brined overnight in salt, brown sugar and smoked paprika, smoked or roasted at 150C for 2 hours until the meat pulls from the bone. Dissolve 80g salt and 80g brown sugar in 2L water with 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Brine 4 turkey drumsticks overnight. Pat dry, rub with more paprika and roast at 150C for 2 hours until the meat pulls easily from the bone.
Axel's home town, crispy cheese edges and all

Thick airy dough baked in an oiled tin with cheese right to the edges for lacy crisp corners, pepperoni underneath and rich tomato sauce striped on top. Mix 400g bread flour, 300ml warm water, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp oil into a wet dough and prove 2 hours. Press into a well-oiled 23 by 33cm tin and prove 30 minutes. Lay 100g pepperoni over, then 350g cubed mozzarella and cheddar mixed, pushing it hard against the tin edges. Bake at 250C for 15 minutes until the edges are dark and crisp. Spoon 250ml warm passata cooked with garlic and oregano in two stripes on top.
W: Toffee apples: sugar, water and a splash of vinegar boiled to 150C, red colouring, apples dipped and set. Bought fairy floss alongside.
K: the queue on a hot day

Blue raspberry syrup blitzed with lemonade, lime and plenty of ice until slushy, poured tall with a striped straw and a few frozen raspberries. Add 120ml blue raspberry cordial, 400ml lemonade, the juice of 1 lime and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blitz in short bursts for 30 seconds until fine and slushy, adding more ice if it's thin. Drop a few frozen raspberries into 4 tall glasses, pour the slushie over and serve with straws straight away.
T: The theme park ride from hell.
D: Axel tracks a counterfeiting ring to a Southern California theme park.
P: Serve the snacks when the Spider ride gets stuck.

title: 48 Hrs.
S: there's a new sheriff in town
Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and cayenne, served in a tin bucket.
Reggie's last lunch on the inside

Bologna and American cheese on white bread with yellow mustard, griddled in butter under a heavy pan until golden, crisp and melted. Spread 8 slices white bread with yellow mustard on one side. Build 4 sandwiches with 3 slices bologna and 2 slices American cheese each. Butter the outsides. Cook in a pan over medium heat with another heavy pan pressed on top for 3 minutes a side until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut into triangles and serve with dill pickles.
the city where it all goes down
Warm a sourdough round at 200C, tear and serve with salted butter whipped with roasted garlic.
M: Jack's 3am bacon, eggs and hash browns

Thick bacon rendered crisp, eggs fried in the fat, golden hash browns of grated potato fried in butter, buttered toast and hot sauce. Grate 800g potatoes and squeeze out as much water as you can in a tea towel, then season. Fry in 40g butter and 2 tbsp oil in 4 flat patties for 6 minutes a side until deep golden. Fry 12 thick bacon rashers until crisp and keep warm. Fry 8 eggs in the bacon fat, basting the tops. Toast and butter 4 slices of bread and serve with hot sauce.
Fennel, onion and garlic in olive oil, tomato, white wine and fish stock, then crab, clams, mussels, prawns and firm fish in order of cooking time. Sourdough.
W: Reggie's release, with a pay cheque waiting
One-bowl chocolate cake (flour, sugar, cocoa, oil, buttermilk, hot coffee) baked at 170C for 35 minutes, fudge icing.
K: A shot of bourbon alongside an ice-cold long neck, with a dash of bitters and orange peel in the shot glass for good measure. Chill 4 long neck lagers until icy. Pour 30ml bourbon into each of 4 shot glasses, add a dash of aromatic bitters and twist a small strip of orange peel over each. Serve each shot with a cold beer. Sip the bourbon and chase it with the beer, or drop it in if it's that kind of night.
T: Forty-eight hours. Eat fast.
D: A rough cop gets a convict out of prison for 48 hours to help catch a killer.
P: Pour drinks when Reggie walks into Torchy's redneck bar.

title: Another 48 Hrs.
S: Boiled eggs pickled pink in spiced vinegar with beetroot, straight from the jar on the bar.
the snacks in Jack's beat-up car
Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and pepper overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: eaten on the stakeout in the car

Thick chuck patty griddled to medium, sharp cheddar melted under a lid, sticky grilled onions, pickles and mustard mayo on a toasted bun. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties 2cm thick, pressing a dimple in the middle. Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until soft and brown. Season the patties just before cooking and griddle 4 minutes a side on high heat. Top each with 2 slices cheddar, add a splash of water to the pan and cover for 1 minute to melt. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp mustard. Toast 4 buns and build with sauce, patty, onions and pickles.
San Francisco, where the case plays out
Bacon, onion, celery and potato, clams and their juice, cream and thyme, ladled into hollowed toasted sourdough rounds.
W: Flaky puff pastry cases filled with a wobbly, just-set sweet egg custard, baked until the tops blister in spots, served warm. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 12 rounds and press into a greased muffin tin. Dissolve 80g caster sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Whisk in 3 eggs, 80ml evaporated milk and 1 tsp vanilla, then strain into a jug. Fill the cases three quarters full. Bake 10 minutes, then drop to 180C and bake 10 to 12 minutes more until the custard is just set with a slight wobble. Cool 10 minutes before lifting out.
K: Jack Cates' rye and ginger highball

Rye whiskey over ice, topped with spicy ginger ale, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of bitters, served long in a heavy highball glass. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice. Pour 45ml rye whiskey into each, then add a squeeze of lemon and a dash of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold ginger ale and give one gentle stir. Garnish with a long strip of lemon peel.
T: Same pair. More hours.
D: Jack Cates needs Reggie again to catch a dealer called the Iceman.
P: Serve dinner when the prison bus crashes.

title: Tango & Cash
S: Bologna, yellow mustard and American cheese on white bread, griddled in butter under a weight until crisp.
Marinated beef grilled hot and chopped small, in warm corn tortillas with onion, coriander, salsa verde and lime.

Cold cooked prawns on crisp cucumber rounds with sriracha lime mayo and coriander, served beside mini tomato and basil bruschetta. Peel 16 cooked king prawns and halve lengthways. Cut 2 Lebanese cucumbers into thick rounds. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 2 tsp sriracha and lime zest. Top each cucumber round with a dot of mayo, a prawn half and a coriander leaf. Slice half a baguette thin, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes, rub with garlic and top with diced tomato, basil, salt and olive oil.
M: Rib eye dry-brined, seared hard, basted with butter and thyme, pulled at 54C, rested, sliced.
the slop they break out to get away from

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, thick slices on buttery mash with minted peas. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape into a loaf in a lined tin. Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, spread over and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Cook 300g frozen peas 3 minutes and toss with butter and mint. Rest the loaf 10 minutes before slicing.
W: the club where Tango's sister dances
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, piped with pink buttercream and covered in sprinkles.
K: Tango, the best-dressed cop in LA

Rye whiskey stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters until ice cold, strained into chilled coupes with a dark cocktail cherry. Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer. Fill a jug with ice and add 200ml rye whiskey, 80ml sweet vermouth and 8 dashes aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the coupes and drop a cocktail cherry into each. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
T: Two cops. One shower. Zero patience.
D: Two rival LA cops are framed and have to break out of prison together.
P: Serve the mains when the armoured RV rolls out.

title: Red Heat
S: Herring fillets in a sour cream, dill and red onion sauce on buttered dark rye.
the Georgian dealer Danko chases all the way to Chicago

Boat-shaped khachapuri filled with molten cheese, a runny egg and butter stirred through at the table. Roll 500g pizza dough into 4 ovals, fill with 200g mozzarella mixed with 200g crumbled feta and fold the edges into boat shapes. Bake at 230C for 12 minutes, crack an egg into each and bake 4 minutes more. Add a knob of butter and stir at the table.

Soft yeasted buns stuffed with beef mince, onion, rice and dill, fried golden and served hot with sour cream for dipping. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm milk and 1 egg into a soft dough and prove 1 hour. Fry 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion until browned, then stir in 100g cooked rice, 3 tbsp chopped dill, salt and pepper and cool. Divide the dough into 12, flatten, fill and pinch closed. Rest 15 minutes, then fry at 175C for 3 minutes a side. Serve with sour cream.
M: Danko's partner, who talks all the way through dinner

Strips of eye fillet seared fast and set aside, mushrooms and onion browned, paprika, mustard and stock reduced, sour cream stirred in off the heat, beef back in. Sear 600g eye fillet strips fast in batches and set aside. Brown 300g mushrooms and 1 onion, add 1 tsp paprika, 1 tbsp Dijon and 250ml stock and reduce. Stir in 200g sour cream off the heat, add the beef back. Serve over 400g egg noodles.
Ridzik's Chicago deep dish sausage pizza

Buttery cornmeal crust pressed up a deep tin, layered with mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomato sauce, topped with parmesan and baked golden. Mix 350g plain flour, 50g cornmeal, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 60g melted butter and 230ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Press into a greased 25cm deep tin, up the sides. Layer 250g sliced mozzarella, then 400g Italian sausage meat pressed into a flat layer. Simmer 400g crushed tomatoes with garlic and oregano for 10 minutes and spread on top. Scatter 40g grated parmesan and bake at 220C for 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
W: Russian layers for the Soviet cop
Honey dough (honey, butter, sugar, eggs, bicarb, flour) rolled into thin discs, baked 6 minutes each, layered with sour cream and condensed milk cream, crumbs on the outside, rested overnight.
K: Danko's cranberry mors and vodka cooler
a taste of home for the Soviet cop

Russian-style mors of simmered cranberries, honey and lemon, chilled and poured over ice with vodka and soda, garnished with frozen berries. Simmer 300g frozen cranberries with 600ml water and 4 tbsp honey for 10 minutes, crushing the berries. Strain, add the juice of 1 lemon and chill. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 40ml vodka and 120ml mors to each, top with 60ml soda water and stir. Garnish with a few frozen cranberries and a lemon slice.
T: Moscow toughness. Chicago appetite.
D: A stone-faced Soviet cop teams up with a smart-mouthed Chicago detective.
P: Pour the vodka when Danko orders his first drink in Chicago.

title: Turner & Hooch
S: Cypress Beach on the California coast
Grated Monterey Jack baked in small piles at 200C for 7 minutes until lacy and golden, cooled into crisps, with salsa.
the seafood plant at the centre of the case

Prawns sizzled in olive oil with sliced garlic, chilli, white wine and butter, finished with parsley and lemon, crusty bread for the pan juices. Peel and devein 800g green king prawns, leaving the tails on. Heat 80ml olive oil in a large pan with 6 sliced garlic cloves and 1 sliced red chilli until the garlic just colours. Add the prawns and cook 2 minutes, turning. Add 80ml white wine and 30g butter and bubble 1 minute until the prawns are pink. Toss with chopped parsley and lemon juice. Serve with a warm sliced baguette.
for Hooch, who eats everything anyway
Parmesan crackers cut into bone shapes: flour, butter, parmesan and an egg, rolled 4mm, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
M: Steak, and the bone for Hooch
T-bone seared and finished at 200C, rested, with garlic butter, roast potatoes and green beans.
Cypress Beach beer-battered fish and chips
a coastal town built around its seafood plant

Flathead in a crisp beer batter, fried golden, with double-fried chips, homemade tartare with capers and gherkins, and lemon wedges. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour and 50g cornflour with 300ml cold lager and a pinch of salt. Dust 8 flathead fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with chopped capers, gherkins, parsley and lemon juice for tartare.
W: Vanilla ice cream with whipped cream, crushed shortbread and a drizzle of salted caramel (sugar cooked amber, cream and salt).
K: Turner's neat-freak breakfast, before Hooch moves in

Fresh blood orange and orange juice topped with cold sparkling wine in chilled flutes, with a twist of orange peel. No slobber allowed. Squeeze 4 blood oranges and 2 regular oranges and strain the juice into a jug. Chill. Pour 60ml of juice into each of 4 chilled flutes, tilting the glass. Top slowly with cold sparkling wine. Garnish each with a thin twist of orange peel. If blood oranges are out of season, use all regular oranges and a splash of pomegranate juice.
T: Neat freak meets slobbery dog.
D: A fussy small-town detective inherits a slobbering dog who witnessed a murder.
P: Serve the mains when Hooch wrecks the car.

title: Stakeout
S: the rations in the surveillance van
Cake doughnuts warmed for 2 minutes, then shaken in a paper bag with cinnamon sugar until coated.
Chris and Bill's game for the long nights, name that film

Pretzels, peanuts, cereal squares and sunflower seeds tossed in butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder, baked at 130C for 45 minutes. Toss 150g pretzels, 150g peanuts, 150g cereal squares and 50g sunflower seeds with 60g melted butter, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp garlic powder. Bake at 130C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool before bagging up.

Hot-smoked salmon flaked onto rye crispbread with crème fraîche, pickled red onion, dill and a squeeze of lemon. Slice half a red onion very thin and cover with 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Break 16 rye crispbreads in half. Spread each with crème fraîche, top with a flake of hot-smoked salmon from 250g, a few pickled onion rings and a sprig of dill. Squeeze lemon over and crack black pepper on top.
M: the dinner Chris shouldn't be eating
Chicken enchiladas: shredded chicken in corn tortillas, red chilli sauce, cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes.

Cod fillets in a crisp lager batter, fried golden, with double-fried chips, lemon, malt vinegar and a chunky caper tartare sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour and 50g cornflour with 300ml ice-cold lager and salt. Dust 700g cod fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with chopped capers, gherkins and dill. Serve with lemon and malt vinegar.
W: surveillance treats for the night shift
Yeasted dough proved an hour, rolled into balls, fried at 175C for 2 minutes, rolled in cinnamon sugar while warm.
K: Bill keeps watch while Chris crosses the road

Strong hot coffee with brown sugar and Irish whiskey poured into mugs, topped with lightly whipped cream floating on top. Brew 800ml strong coffee. Stir 4 tsp brown sugar and 160ml Irish whiskey into the hot coffee and pour into a warmed thermos if you're on the move. Lightly whip 150ml thickened cream until just thick but still pourable. Pour the coffee into 4 mugs and float the cream on top by pouring it over the back of a spoon.
T: Watch the girl. Eat the doughnuts.
D: Two Seattle cops on surveillance duty, and one falls for the woman they're watching.
P: Serve the snacks when Bill and Chris start their movie trivia game.

title: Kindergarten Cop
S: snack time for the whole class
Cheddar cut into little squares with crackers, apple slices tossed in lemon so they don't brown, and cherry tomatoes, packed into lunch boxes.
for the class pet, who stays in his cage
Diced mango, pineapple, strawberries and grapes in cups with a squeeze of orange and a mint leaf.
Astoria smoked salmon dip and rye crackers
the Oregon coast town where he hides out

Hot-smoked salmon flaked into cream cheese with lemon, dill and capers, kept chunky, with rye crackers and cucumber sticks for dunking. Flake 200g hot-smoked salmon, removing any skin and bones. Beat 200g softened cream cheese with 2 tbsp sour cream, the juice of half a lemon and 2 tbsp chopped dill. Fold the salmon and 1 tbsp chopped capers through, keeping some chunks. Season with pepper. Serve in a bowl with rye crackers and 2 Lebanese cucumbers cut into sticks.
M: Kimble's undercover school in Astoria, Oregon

Firm white fish cut into fingers, flour, egg and panko, shallow-fried until golden, served on a school lunch tray. Cut 600g firm white fish into fingers. Dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g panko and shallow-fry for 2 minutes a side. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, toss in oil and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Serve with tartare and 300g peas.
Kimble's rump steak and loaded spuds
the cop part of the job

Rump steak seared hard and rested, sliced over a crunchy green salad, with baked potatoes loaded with sour cream, cheddar and chives. Prick 4 large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 60 minutes. Season 4 rump steaks (250g each) and sear in a smoking pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes. Toss cos lettuce, cucumber and cherry tomatoes with olive oil and lemon. Split the potatoes and load with sour cream, grated cheddar and chives. Slice the steak and serve.
W: and what does he do, ask the class

Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, iced with bright buttercream in primary colours and topped with sprinkles. Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, tint in primary colours, swirl on and add sprinkles.
K: Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, cocoa and malted milk powder until thick and frothy, topped with whipped cream and chocolate sprinkles. Add 600ml cold milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa powder, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp caster sugar to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 glasses. Top each with a swirl of whipped cream and a pinch of chocolate sprinkles and serve with straws.
T: It's not a tumour. It's lunch.
D: A tough cop goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher in Astoria, Oregon.
P: Serve the snacks when Kimble blows the whistle in class.

title: Police Academy
S: Whisk cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, pour into a hot buttered cast iron pan, bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
the bar the cadets accidentally wander into
Oysters on ice with a shallot mignonette and lemon, or grilled with garlic butter for the nervous.
M: Tackleberry would eat it standing up
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash.
W: the class of eighty-four makes it
Vanilla slab cake with buttercream, piped with a police badge and "Graduates" in blue icing.
K: the bar the cadets accidentally wander into

Vodka and blue curaçao shaken with fresh lemon, topped with cold lemonade over ice and finished with a lemon wheel and a cherry. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Shake 160ml vodka, 80ml blue curaçao and 60ml fresh lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds. Strain evenly into the glasses. Top each with about 120ml cold lemonade and stir once. Garnish with a lemon wheel and a cocktail cherry.
T: Cadets, report to dinner.
D: A bunch of misfits sign up for the police academy.
P: Serve the mains when the cadets end up at the Blue Oyster bar.

title: Bad Boys
S: Thick béchamel with finely chopped ham and nutmeg, chilled overnight, rolled into logs, egg and crumb, fried at 180C until golden.
South Beach prawn fritters with lime mayo

Chopped prawns in a light batter with capsicum, onion, celery and chilli, fried in spoonfuls until crisp, with a zesty lime and chilli mayo. Finely chop 400g peeled green prawns. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 125ml milk into a thick batter. Fold in the prawns, half a finely diced red capsicum, half a diced onion, 1 diced celery stick, 1 chopped chilli and salt. Drop tablespoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Mix 120g mayo with the zest and juice of 1 lime and a pinch of cayenne.
Very ripe plantains sliced on the bias, fried in oil at medium heat until caramelised and soft, flaky salt.
M: Mike and Marcus swap Cuban sandwich
Marcus playing Mike, Mike playing Marcus, same order

Cuban bread (or a soft long roll) with mustard, mojo pork, leg ham, Swiss and pickles, buttered and pressed until crisp and flat. Marinate 700g boneless pork shoulder overnight with juice of 1 orange and 1 lime, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cumin and 1/2 tsp salt. Put in a covered roasting dish with 100ml water and roast at 160°C conventional for about 3 hours until tender; rest 20 minutes and shred. Split 4 long soft rolls and spread with 40g yellow mustard. Fill with the pork, 120g leg ham, 120g Swiss cheese and 80g sliced dill pickles. Butter the outsides with 30g butter and press in a hot sandwich press for 5 minutes, until crisp and flat and the filling is piping hot.
Miami jerk chicken with rice and peas

Chicken thighs marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, garlic and lime, grilled slowly until charred, with coconut rice and kidney beans. Blend 4 spring onions, 1 scotch bonnet, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp allspice, 1 tbsp thyme leaves, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and the juice of 2 limes. Coat 1kg chicken thighs and marinate overnight. Grill over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through. Simmer 300g rice with a 400ml tin coconut milk, 200ml water, a drained 400g tin kidney beans and a thyme sprig, covered, for 18 minutes.
W: Biscuit crust baked 10 minutes. Whisk 400g condensed milk, 4 yolks and 120ml lime juice with zest, bake at 160C for 15 minutes, chill, whipped cream.
K: Mike's apartment, the one Marcus has to pretend is his

Mint muddled gently with sugar syrup and lime, white rum and crushed ice, topped with soda. Gently muddle 24 mint leaves with 60ml sugar syrup and 60ml lime juice in a jug, avoiding shredding the mint. Add 180ml white rum. Divide between four glasses filled with 500g crushed ice. Top with 400ml soda water and stir gently. Garnish with 4 mint sprigs.
T: Whatcha gonna eat?
D: Two Miami narcotics detectives swap identities to protect a witness.
P: Serve dinner when Marcus has to pretend to be Mike.

title: Rush Hour
S: Foo Chow prawn and bamboo dumplings

Plump prawn dumplings with bamboo shoot, ginger and sesame, folded into wonton wrappers, steamed and served with chilli oil and black vinegar soy. Finely chop 400g peeled green prawns with 60g bamboo shoots, 1 tsp grated ginger, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornflour and a pinch of salt. Place a teaspoon in the centre of each of 24 wonton wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Steam on baking paper in a bamboo steamer for 7 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp black vinegar and 1 tbsp chilli oil for dipping.
Cabbage, carrot, shiitake and glass noodles stir-fried, cooled, rolled in spring roll pastry, fried at 180C. Sweet chilli.
Wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce and butter, ranch dip.
M: the Chinatown restaurant where it all kicks off
Beef chow fun: wide rice noodles wok-fried hot with marinated beef, bean sprouts, spring onion, dark and light soy.
Carter's fried chicken and mac plate
fried chicken and greens, Carter's order

Buttermilk fried chicken with a crunchy spiced crust, smoky braised greens with ham hock and a bubbling baked mac and cheese. Soak 1kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with hot sauce and salt. Simmer 1 smoked ham hock in 1.5 litres water for 1 hour, add 2 bunches shredded kale or silverbeet and 2 tbsp vinegar and braise 30 minutes. Toss chicken in 250g flour with paprika, garlic powder and pepper, fry at 165C for 14 minutes. Cook 300g macaroni, stir into a sauce of 40g butter, 40g flour, 600ml milk and 200g cheddar, top with more cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: crack them open over the case
Thin vanilla batter in circles, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded around paper fortunes while hot.
K: Vodka shaken with chilled jasmine tea, lychee syrup and a squeeze of lime, strained into coupes with a whole lychee dropped in. Brew 1 jasmine tea bag in 120ml hot water for 3 minutes and cool. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Shake 160ml vodka, the tea, 80ml lychee syrup and the juice of 1 lime with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and drop a lychee into each.
T: Two cops. One case. Several misunderstandings.
D: A Hong Kong inspector and a loudmouth LA cop team up to find a kidnapped girl.
P: Serve the mains when Lee walks into the Foo Chow restaurant.

title: Rush Hour 2
S: Carter's first trip to Hong Kong, eating everything

Shortcrust or puff pastry cases filled with egg custard (eggs, milk, sugar syrup, evaporated milk), baked at 200C for 15 minutes until just set. Dissolve 70g caster sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Whisk in 3 eggs, 80ml evaporated milk and 40ml full cream milk, then strain. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets puff pastry and press into a greased patty tin. Fill three quarters full and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight wobble.
Hong Kong pork and prawn siu mai

Open-topped dumplings of pork mince, chopped prawn, shiitake and ginger, steamed until juicy, topped with a dot of carrot and served with chilli soy. Soak 4 dried shiitake in hot water for 20 minutes, then chop finely. Mix with 300g pork mince, 150g chopped green prawns, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp cornflour. Cup 20 round wonton wrappers in your hand, fill and squeeze into open baskets. Top with finely diced carrot. Steam 8 minutes over boiling water. Serve with soy and chilli oil.
Salt and pepper prawns: shell-on prawns dusted in potato starch, fried at 190C, tossed with fried garlic, chilli and spring onion.
M: Ricky Tan's Hong Kong roast goose
the triad boss's table in Lee's home town

Roast duck (goose is hard to find): five spice and salt inside, skin dried overnight, glazed with maltose or honey, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes. Rub the cavity of a 2kg whole duck with 2 tsp five spice and 1 tsp salt, and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry the skin. Brush with 2 tbsp honey loosened with hot water and roast at 180C for 90 minutes, brushing again twice. Rest 15 minutes and chop through the bone. Serve with 150ml plum sauce and 2 cups jasmine rice.
Red Dragon casino prime rib plate
Carter's big night in Las Vegas

Garlic and herb-crusted beef rib roasted pink and carved thick, with red wine gravy, creamy horseradish, crispy roast potatoes and buttery corn. Rub a 1.5kg boneless beef rib roast with 3 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C for about 50 minutes until 54C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg halved potatoes in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock. Boil 4 corn cobs 6 minutes and butter. Serve with horseradish cream.
W: Cook sago pearls until clear, rinse, chill. Blend mango with coconut milk and evaporated milk, fold in sago, top with diced mango and pomelo.
K: strong and sweet, pulled through a cloth
Brew strong black tea for 5 minutes, strain through a fine cloth twice, add evaporated milk and sugar. Hot or over ice.
T: Hong Kong. Vegas. Repeat.
D: Carter and Lee chase a counterfeiting ring from Hong Kong to Las Vegas.
P: Serve the mains when they hit the Red Dragon casino.

title: Point Break
S: after a dawn surf with Bodhi

Crispy beer-battered fish in small soft tortillas with lime slaw, chipotle mayo and fresh coriander, with extra lime wedges to squeeze. Cut 500g firm white fish into strips. Whisk 120g plain flour with 180ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Dip the fish and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Warm 12 small flour tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.
King prawns skewered with garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals 90 seconds a side.
M: Pork and beef meatballs simmered an hour in marinara, packed into long rolls with provolone, grilled until melted. Two each.
Bonfire whole snapper with chilli lime
Bodhi's crew around the beach bonfire

Whole snapper slashed and rubbed with garlic, chilli, lime and coriander, grilled over hot coals until charred, with coconut rice and a green mango salad. Blend 3 garlic cloves, 2 red chillies, a bunch of coriander stems, the zest and juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 2 tbsp oil. Slash 2 whole snapper (800g each) and rub the paste inside and out. Grill over medium-hot coals 8 to 10 minutes a side. Simmer 300g jasmine rice with 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water, covered, for 15 minutes. Toss shredded green mango, mint, peanuts and lime juice for salad.
W: Split banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, strawberry sauce, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: Tequila shaken with fresh lime, orange liqueur and agave, poured over ice in salt-rimmed glasses with a lime wheel. Rub the rims of 4 tumblers with lime and dip in flaky salt, then fill with ice. Shake 180ml tequila, 90ml fresh lime juice, 60ml orange liqueur and 30ml agave syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain over the ice and garnish each with a lime wheel. Mix a jug ahead for the esky if you're out on the sand.
T: Surf, rob, eat, repeat.
D: An FBI agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfing bank robbers.
P: Serve the meatball subs when Johnny Utah orders two.

title: Speed
S: Bus stop soft pretzels and honey mustard
Jack's morning coffee stop before the bus blows up

Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed until crisp outside, with a sweet and sharp honey mustard dip. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush 4 large soft pretzels with 30g melted butter and sprinkle with coarse salt. Warm on a tray for 5 to 6 minutes until the outside crisps. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayo until smooth. Serve the pretzels torn into pieces with the dip.
what do you do, eat them before they go cold

Corn chips layered with cheddar, jalapeños and black beans, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, then sour cream and salsa. Spread a 300g bag of corn chips on a tray. Scatter over a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with sour cream and a jar of salsa.
Hard pretzels and roasted peanuts tossed with butter and smoked paprika, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
M: the streets of LA at full speed
Carne asada: skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, grilled hot, chopped, in doubled corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.
W: Fifty mile an hour ice cream sandwiches

Soft choc chip cookies sandwiched with a thick slab of vanilla ice cream, edges rolled in sprinkles, frozen hard for an hour. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream for 5 minutes. Sandwich a thick scoop between two soft choc chip cookies, using 8 cookies for 4 sandwiches. Roll the edges in sprinkles, wrap in baking paper and freeze for an hour.
K: her first day driving the bus
Iced coffee: cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
T: Keep it above 50.
D: A bomb on a city bus will explode if it drops below 50 miles per hour.
P: Serve the mains when the bus jumps the freeway gap.

title: Last Action Hero
S: Pop kernels in coconut oil, toss with brown butter (butter cooked until nutty) and flaky salt, serve in striped paper bags.
Whiskers the cartoon cat cheddar crackers
the cartoon cat detective at the station

Crisp sharp cheddar crackers cut into cat shapes, brushed with egg and sprinkled with smoked paprika, baked golden and served with a tomato relish. Pulse 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 100g plain flour and a pinch of salt in a processor until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes. Roll 4mm thick, cut into cat shapes and place on a lined tray. Brush with beaten egg and dust with smoked paprika. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Cool on the tray and serve with tomato relish.
Danny's New York, outside the Pandora
Mashed potato and onion wrapped in pastry, baked until golden and served hot with yellow mustard.
M: Thick rib eye dry-brined, seared, finished at 200C to 54C, rested, with garlic butter and a loaded baked potato.
Movie world pepperoni and basil pizza
in the movies, every pizza is perfect

Thin cold-fermented crust with crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and crisp cupped pepperoni, blistered at full heat and finished with fresh basil and chilli honey. Mix 500g pizza flour, 325ml water, 2g dried yeast and 10g salt, knead 5 minutes and refrigerate 24 hours. Divide into 4 balls and bring to room temperature for 2 hours. Heat the oven with a pizza stone or steel at the highest setting for 45 minutes. Stretch each base thin, spread with crushed tomato, 70g torn mozzarella and pepperoni. Bake 6 to 7 minutes. Finish with basil and a drizzle of honey warmed with chilli flakes.
W: Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge (dark chocolate, cream, golden syrup), whipped cream, salted peanuts and a cherry.
K: the kid in the cinema seat

Vanilla ice cream blended with cold milk, cocoa and malted milk powder into a thick shake, topped with whipped cream and crushed malt balls. Add 500ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa powder and 4 tbsp malted milk powder to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Top with whipped cream and a handful of crushed chocolate malt balls. Serve with wide straws and long spoons.
T: Jack Slater. Pass the popcorn.
D: A kid with a magic movie ticket gets pulled into the world of his favourite action hero.
P: Serve the popcorn when Danny crashes into Jack Slater's movie.

title: Demolition Man
S: from the scraps below the city, beef, don't ask

Small beef patties smashed with thin onion pressed into the meat, griddled crisp with American cheese, on slider buns with mustard and pickles. Absolutely no rats. Divide 500g beef mince into 12 balls. Slice 1 onion paper thin. Put a ball on a smoking hot griddle, pile on some onion and smash flat with a spatula. Season and cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip so the onion cooks underneath, top with a quarter slice of cheese and cook 1 minute. Serve on 12 toasted slider buns with mustard and pickles.
Shell-shaped pasta (conchiglie) boiled, dried, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in chilli salt. Three per person.
Future fast food chips and salsa
the only restaurant left after the franchise wars
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C, salted, with a roasted tomato salsa (charred tomato, onion, garlic and jalapeño blitzed with lime).
M: Fine dining beef tacos with pico de gallo

Crisp-shelled tacos of spiced beef, shredded iceberg, aged cheddar and pico de gallo, plated like fine dining with lime crema and tweezered coriander. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp oregano, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 125ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Warm 12 crisp taco shells at 180C for 5 minutes. Dice 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and coriander with lime and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with lime zest. Fill each shell neatly and line up on a long white platter.
Big chuck patty seared hard with fried onions, cheddar and barbecue sauce on a toasted bun. Spartan says it's the best burger he's had in years.
W: Layered jelly: three flavours of jelly set one on top of the other in a slab tin, cut into perfect cubes, served on a white plate.
K: the polite future, where nothing stronger is allowed

Muddled cucumber and mint with elderflower cordial and fresh lime, topped with chilled sparkling water and served in coupes with a cucumber ribbon. Muddle half a Lebanese cucumber, chopped, with 8 mint leaves and the juice of 1 lime in a jug. Add 80ml elderflower cordial and stir. Strain into 4 coupe glasses over a small ice cube each. Top with 600ml cold sparkling water. Shave thin cucumber ribbons with a peeler and fold one into each glass.
T: In the future, every restaurant is a taco restaurant.
D: A cop from 1996 is defrosted in a polite future where every restaurant belongs to the same taco chain.
P: Serve the mains when Spartan goes to the fancy future fast food dinner.

title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
S: the Angels game where Frank calls the plays
Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes and salted hot, served in paper bags.
Franks simmered with onion, then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with yellow mustard and sweet relish.
M: Franks griddled, in buns with a loose beef chilli (mince, onion, chilli powder, tomato simmered 45 minutes), grated cheddar and onion. Eat over a napkin.
the reception for Her Majesty that Frank ruins

Topside roasted pink and carved thin, with puffed Yorkshire puddings cooked in smoking dripping, crisp roast potatoes and a rich gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with mustard, salt and pepper and roast at 200C until 52C inside, about 60 minutes, then rest 20 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g plain flour and 200ml milk and rest. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil at 200C for 45 minutes. Heat 1 tsp dripping in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin at 220C until smoking, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and 400ml beef stock.
W: Ninth inning malt and fudge ice cream cups

Vanilla ice cream rippled with hot fudge sauce and crushed malted honeycomb, scooped into paper cups with salted peanuts and a wooden spoon. Soften 1 litre vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes. Heat 100ml cream until steaming and stir in 100g dark chocolate and 1 tbsp golden syrup until smooth, then cool. Ripple half the fudge through the ice cream with 80g crushed chocolate honeycomb and refreeze 1 hour. Scoop into 4 paper cups, spoon over the rest of the warm fudge and scatter with salted peanuts.
K: Fresh lemon juice, sugar and vodka blitzed with ice into a frozen lemonade, served in plastic cups with a lemon wheel and a striped straw. Make syrup by dissolving 100g caster sugar in 100ml hot water and cool. Blend the syrup with 150ml fresh lemon juice, 160ml vodka, 200ml cold water and 4 cups of ice for 30 seconds until slushy. Pour into 4 cups, garnish with lemon wheels and serve with straws.
T: Surely you can't be serious. Pass the nuts.
D: Bumbling cop Frank Drebin tries to stop an assassination of the Queen at a baseball game.
P: Serve the snacks when Frank goes undercover as the umpire.

title: Airplane!
S: Dry-roasted peanuts and almonds in small packets, a pinch of sugar and salt, warmed in the oven for 5 minutes.
for the crew who skipped the fish
Cheddar cut into cubes, crackers, green grapes and cocktail onions threaded on toothpicks, laid out in neat rows on a tray like an old airline service.
he has a drinking problem, it ends up everywhere but his mouth

Twice-baked almond and orange biscotti, crisp enough to dunk, served with small cups of espresso topped with a spoon of whipped cream. Whisk 2 eggs with 150g caster sugar, then mix in 250g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, the zest of 1 orange and 100g whole almonds. Shape into 2 logs on a lined tray and bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice 1cm thick on an angle and bake again at 150C for 10 minutes a side. Brew 4 espressos and top each with a spoon of whipped cream.
M: Sirloin seared hard, rested, peppercorn sauce, mashed potato and green beans, served on an airline-style tray.
for anyone who didn't choose the fish

Slow-simmered beef and pork ragù layered with pasta sheets, nutmeg béchamel and mozzarella, baked until bubbling and golden at the edges. Brown 500g beef mince and 250g pork mince, add 1 diced onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick and 2 garlic cloves, then 125ml red wine, 700ml passata and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Simmer 2 hours. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g flour, whisk in 700ml milk and cook until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan. Layer ragù, fresh lasagne sheets and béchamel three times in a dish, top with 200g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20 minutes before cutting.
W: on the flight to Chicago, in a little square
Baked New York cheesecake in a slab tin, cut into neat squares, a cherry on each.
K: the coffee pot that keeps coming down the aisle

Fresh espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and a touch of sugar syrup until foamy, strained into chilled coupes with three coffee beans. Brew 4 shots of espresso and cool for 5 minutes. Add the espresso, 160ml vodka, 80ml coffee liqueur and 20ml sugar syrup to a shaker full of ice. Shake very hard for 15 seconds to build the foam. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and float 3 coffee beans on each.
T: Fish or the steak? We had the lasagne.
D: A former pilot with a drinking problem has to land a plane when the crew gets food poisoning.
P: Serve the mains right after the fish course takes out the crew.

title: Con Air
S: Honey-roasted peanuts tossed with chilli flakes and a little smoked salt, warmed at 160C for 5 minutes, in small paper bags.

Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, brown sugar, smoked paprika and black pepper, slow-dried in the oven until chewy with a sticky, smoky bite. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tsp garlic powder. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
the crash landing on the Strip
Prawns poached and iced on shredded iceberg in martini glasses, spicy cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and hot sauce.
M: the stop at the abandoned airfield

Thick chuck patty griddled to medium with melted cheddar, crisp bacon, sticky grilled onion and smoky barbecue mayo on a toasted brioche bun. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties 2cm thick. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 15 minutes. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Season the patties and griddle 4 minutes a side on high heat, then top with 2 slices cheddar each, add a splash of water and cover 1 minute. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Toast 4 brioche buns and build with sauce, patty, bacon and onions.
Sirloin seared hard, rested and topped with garlic butter, baked potato split and loaded with sour cream and chives.
W: put the bunny back in the box
Vanilla cake cut and assembled into a bunny, covered in white buttercream and shredded coconut, pink ears, presented in a box.
K: Cyrus the Virus, running the plane

Bourbon muddled with lemon wedges, mint and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint sprig on top. In a shaker, muddle 1 lemon cut into 8 wedges with 12 mint leaves and 60ml sugar syrup. Add 200ml bourbon and a scoop of ice and shake for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Top each with a big sprig of mint, slapped between your hands first to wake it up.
T: Put the bunny back in the box.
D: A paroled Army Ranger on a prison transport plane gets caught up in a hijack.
P: Serve dessert when Poe finally hands over the bunny.

title: The Rock
S: Sourdough warmed at 200C for 8 minutes, torn, with salted butter and a dish of olive oil and dukkah.
San Francisco, looking out at the island

Creamy chowder of clams, bacon, potato, onion and thyme, ladled into small hollowed sourdough rolls toasted crisp, with oyster crackers on top. Steam 1kg clams in 250ml white wine until open, then remove the meat and strain the juice. Fry 4 diced bacon rashers, add 1 onion, 2 celery sticks and 2 diced potatoes and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam juice, 300ml milk and thyme, and simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Add 200ml cream and the clams. Hollow 4 small sourdough rolls, toast at 200C for 8 minutes and fill.
the cable car chase down the hill
Prawns sautéed hot in olive oil with sliced garlic and chilli, finished with butter, white wine and parsley, sourdough for the pan juices.
M: San Francisco cioppino and garlic toast
the city's own seafood stew, across the bay from the Rock

Fennel, garlic and chilli simmered in tomato and white wine with prawns, mussels, clams and snapper, served with charred garlic sourdough.
