Soften 1 sliced fennel bulb, 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil with a pinch of chilli flakes. Add 250ml white wine, 400g crushed tomatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 500g clams and 500g mussels, cover 3 minutes, then 400g snapper chunks and 12 green prawns for 4 minutes more until everything is cooked. Finish with parsley. Grill thick sourdough slices rubbed with garlic and olive oil.
steak, after thirty years locked up
Dry-brined rib eye seared and basted with butter, thyme and garlic, rested, with béarnaise and double-fried frites.
W: the cable car chase through the city
Melted dark chocolate and butter whisked into sugar and eggs, flour and toasted walnuts folded in, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, flaky salt on top, cut into squares.
K: Mason's taste, earned the hard way

Single malt Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters over ice, strained into chilled coupes with a cherry and a twist of orange. Chill 4 coupes. Fill a jug with ice, add 200ml single malt Scotch, 80ml sweet vermouth and 8 dashes aromatic bitters and stir for 30 seconds until icy. Strain into the coupes. Drop in a cocktail cherry and twist a strip of orange peel over each glass.
T: Welcome to the Rock.
D: An FBI chemist and a former SAS man break into Alcatraz to stop a rogue general.
P: Serve the snacks when Mason gets his haircut at the Fairmont.

title: Face/Off
S: Erewhon cheddar, apple and chutney stacks

Crisp water crackers stacked with aged cheddar, thin green apple slices and spiced tomato chutney, finished with cracked pepper, served on a steel tray. Slice 200g aged cheddar into thin squares. Core 2 green apples, slice thin and toss with lemon juice. Lay 24 water crackers on a steel tray. Top each with a slice of cheddar, a slice of apple and half a teaspoon of tomato chutney. Crack black pepper over and scatter with thyme leaves.
the final showdown in the church
Thin rye squares buttered, topped with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, dill and a crack of pepper.
Castor could eat a peach for hours
Ripe peaches cut into wedges, drizzled with warm honey and lime juice, torn mint and a pinch of flaky salt.
M: Archer family lemon thyme roast chicken
Castor, as Sean, sitting down at the family table

Dry-brined chicken with lemon and thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden, with pan-roasted potatoes and carrots and a gravy from the juices. Salt a 1.8kg chicken all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Mash 50g soft butter with lemon zest and thyme and push it under the breast skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes with 800g halved potatoes and 4 carrots tossed in oil around it. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick.
lobster and champagne, he takes over the life
Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic and parsley butter, grilled flesh up for 6 to 8 minutes, lemon and a green salad with a sharp vinaigrette.
W: Sliced peaches with sugar, lemon and cinnamon under a buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 35 minutes.
K: Castor could eat a peach for hours
White peach purée topped with chilled prosecco in tall flutes. Sparkling peach juice for the kids.
T: Two faces. One dinner.
D: An FBI agent swaps faces with a terrorist to stop a bombing.
P: Serve the mains when the prison boots go on.

title: Cliffhanger
S: the ranger hut, waiting out the storm

Smoked trout whipped with cream cheese, lemon, dill and horseradish, spread thick on rye crackers with pickled red onion on top. Flake 250g hot-smoked trout, removing any skin and bones. Blitz half with 200g cream cheese, the juice of half a lemon, 2 tsp horseradish and pepper, then fold in the rest of the trout with chopped dill so it stays chunky. Slice half a red onion thin and soak in 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with a pinch of sugar for 20 minutes. Spread thick on rye crackers and top with the pickled onion.
the thermos at the ranger hut

Roast pumpkin soup with onion, garlic and stock, blitzed silky and finished with cream, poured from a thermos into mugs with toasted pepitas. Heat the oven to 200C. Toss 1kg diced pumpkin with oil and salt and roast 30 minutes until caramelised. Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in butter for 5 minutes, add the pumpkin and 750ml chicken stock and simmer 10 minutes. Blitz until smooth and stir in 100ml cream. Toast 40g pepitas in a dry pan for 3 minutes. Pour the soup into a warmed thermos and scatter pepitas on each mug.

Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, brown sugar, Worcestershire and cracked pepper, slow-dried in the oven until chewy, packed for the climb. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp cracked black pepper and 1 tsp garlic powder. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
M: Rescue station chuck chilli with cornbread
the rescue station after a long day

Chunks of beef chuck braised with chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans until tender, with sour cream, cheddar and warm buttered cornbread. Brown 1.2kg beef chuck in 3cm chunks in batches in a heavy pot. Add 2 diced onions and 4 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes, then 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 800g crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150C for 2.5 hours. Stir in a drained 400g tin kidney beans for the last 20 minutes. Bake a cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and cheddar.
Rump steak rubbed with salt, pepper and rosemary, grilled over hot coals 4 minutes a side, rested on a board. Potatoes wrapped in foil with butter and baked in the coals for 45 minutes.
W: a hundred million in suitcases, scattered over the peaks

Thin pastry rolled around apples, raisins, cinnamon and buttery breadcrumbs, baked at 190C until golden, icing sugar and cream. Toss 4 sliced green apples with 60g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 50g raisins and 40g breadcrumbs fried in 20g butter. Layer 8 sheets filo, brushing each with 60g melted butter, pile the apple along one edge and roll up. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes, dust with icing sugar and serve with 200ml cream.
K: the ranger who swore he'd never climb again

Dark rum stirred into hot water with spiced butter and brown sugar, for the grown-ups. Beat 80g soft butter with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg and cloves. Put a heaped tablespoon in each of 4 mugs with 45ml dark rum and top with 150ml boiling water. Stir until melted.
T: Hang on to your dinner.
D: A mountain rescue climber battles thieves in the Rocky Mountains.
P: Serve the mains when the money cases fall from the plane.

title: Under Siege
S: Ryback's galley, before it all kicks off
Soft milk rolls: bread flour, milk, butter, sugar, yeast and an egg, proved twice, baked at 190C for 18 minutes, brushed with butter and flaky salt.
a taste of the captain's birthday dinner

Toasted baguette rubbed with garlic, spread with saffron and chilli rouille and topped with a poached prawn, fennel fronds and lemon zest. Soak a pinch of saffron in 1 tbsp hot water. Whisk 1 egg yolk with 1 crushed garlic clove, the saffron water, a pinch of chilli and 1 tsp lemon juice, then slowly whisk in 150ml olive oil until thick. Poach 16 peeled green prawns in simmering salted water for 2 minutes and cool. Slice a baguette into 16 pieces, toast at 200C for 6 minutes and rub with garlic. Spread with rouille, top with a prawn, fennel fronds and lemon zest.
the giant cake with a surprise inside
Vanilla sponge cut into small squares, split and filled with jam and cream, dusted with icing sugar.
M: the captain's birthday meal he was cooking

Fennel, leek, onion and garlic softened in olive oil with saffron, orange peel and tomato, fish stock simmered 20 minutes. Add firm fish, mussels and prawns in order, serve with rouille and toasted baguette.
Navy galley glazed meatloaf and mash

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick over buttery mash with peas and onion gravy. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 80ml milk. Mix with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape in a lined loaf tin. Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar, spread on top and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Fry 1 sliced onion, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 300ml beef stock for gravy. Cook 300g frozen peas.
W: the surprise is that it's just cake this time
Two-layer vanilla butter cake with Swiss meringue buttercream, piped navy-style with "Happy Birthday Captain" in blue.
K: a sailor's drink aboard the Missouri

Dark rum and white rum shaken with lime, grapefruit and honey syrup, poured over crushed ice with a lime wheel and a dusting of nutmeg. Dissolve 2 tbsp honey in 2 tbsp hot water. Shake 90ml dark rum, 90ml white rum, 60ml fresh lime juice, 60ml grapefruit juice and the honey syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Add a lime wheel to each and grate a little nutmeg on top.
T: Just a cook.
D: A navy cook fights the terrorists who've taken over his battleship.
P: Serve dinner when Casey Ryback reveals he's just a cook.

title: Hot Shots!
S: cooked on a hot stomach, we used a pan
Quail eggs fried in butter on small toasted brioche rounds with a sliver of crisp bacon and chives.
Airbase soft pretzels with beer cheese

Warm soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, served with a hot, smooth cheddar and lager dip and a pot of grainy mustard. Brush 4 large soft pretzels with 30g melted butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 200ml lager and 100ml milk until thick. Off the heat, stir in 200g grated sharp cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon and a pinch of cayenne until smooth. Serve the pretzels with the cheese dip and wholegrain mustard.
that call sign was always a bad idea
Thick-cut chips blanched at 140C, fried at 185C, salted, with aioli (garlic, yolk, lemon and oil whisked) for dipping.
M: the pilots' cook-up on the flight line
Rib eye steaks grilled hot, corn on the cob, coleslaw with a creamy vinegar dressing.
Sizzling hot plate bacon and egg rolls
the famous hot stomach, we used a pan

Thick bacon rendered crisp and eggs fried in the fat with runny yolks, stacked in toasted milk buns with cheddar, rocket and smoky barbecue sauce. Fry 8 thick bacon rashers over medium heat for 8 minutes until crisp, then keep warm. Fry 4 eggs in the bacon fat, basting the whites with hot fat until set but leaving the yolks runny. Split and toast 4 milk buns. Lay a slice of cheddar on each bottom bun so it softens, then add rocket, 2 rashers of bacon, an egg and a spoon of barbecue sauce.
W: Sweet shortcrust cases blind-baked, filled with vanilla custard (milk, cream, eggs, sugar), baked at 150C until just set, nutmeg on top.
K: Vodka and fresh lime over ice, topped with spicy ginger beer in chilled copper or steel mugs, with a mint sprig and lime wheel. Chill 4 copper or steel mugs in the freezer for 15 minutes, then fill with ice. Add 45ml vodka and 15ml fresh lime juice to each mug. Top each with 150ml cold, spicy ginger beer and stir once from the bottom. Garnish each with a lime wheel and a sprig of mint slapped between your palms to release the oils.
T: Top pilots, terrible jokes.
D: A hotshot pilot battles his past and a very bad mission.
P: Serve the mains during the bacon and eggs scene on Ramada's stomach.

title: Dragnet
S: Button mushrooms filled with cream cheese, garlic, parmesan and herbed breadcrumbs, baked until bubbling and golden on top. Heat the oven to 200C. Pull the stalks from 20 button mushrooms and chop them finely. Mix the stalks with 150g softened cream cheese, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 40g grated parmesan and chopped parsley. Fill each mushroom cap. Mix 30g breadcrumbs with 1 tbsp melted butter and press on top. Bake 15 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Friday's desk, all strictly by the book

Yeasted doughnut holes fried golden and fluffy, dipped warm in a thin vanilla glaze that sets glossy, served in neat rows on a plain plate. Warm 180ml milk with 30g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar, add 7g yeast and 1 egg, then mix into 350g plain flour with a pinch of salt. Knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into 30 small balls and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 2 minutes, turning, until golden. Whisk 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp milk and 1 tsp vanilla, dip the warm doughnuts and set on a rack.

Beef smashed thin on a smoking griddle, cheddar melted under a lid, with pickles, mustard and a slick of burger sauce on soft slider buns. Divide 500g beef mince into 12 balls. Heat a griddle or heavy pan until smoking. Smash each ball flat with a spatula, season and cook 2 minutes until crusty. Flip, add a quarter slice of cheddar, splash in a little water and cover for 30 seconds. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for sauce. Toast 12 slider buns and fill with sauce, patty, pickles and mustard.
M: Friday's LA diner meatloaf and gravy

Beef and pork meatloaf with a tangy tomato glaze, cut into thick slices over creamy mash and smothered in rich brown onion gravy. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 1 grated onion, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape in a lined loaf tin, spread with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Fry 1 sliced onion in butter until brown, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 350ml beef stock and simmer until thick.
Slow-braised pork shoulder crisped in the pan, in warm tortillas with onion, coriander and lime.
W: Thick vanilla custard set between two sheets of puff pastry, topped with plain white icing and cut into neat squares.
K: Just the facts cold brew tonic
Friday takes his coffee black, and nothing extra

Strong cold brew coffee poured over ice and topped with tonic water and a squeeze of orange, sharp, bitter and fizzing. The night before, stir 100g coarsely ground coffee into 800ml cold water in a jug, cover and leave in the fridge for 12 to 16 hours. Strain through a paper filter. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in 150ml tonic water each, then slowly pour 100ml cold brew over the top so it layers. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
T: Just the facts. And the food.
D: A by-the-book cop and his slacker partner take on a cult in LA.
P: Serve dinner when Friday and Streebek go undercover at the PAGAN ceremony.

title: Running Scared
S: the beat they walk every day
All-beef franks, poppy seed buns, mustard, relish, onion, tomato, pickle spear, sport peppers and celery salt.
Chopped prawn in a batter of flour, egg, milk, capsicum, onion and celery, fried in spoonfuls at 180C, lime mayo.
M: the bar they want to buy

Snapper strips grilled with lime and chilli in charred corn tortillas, with crunchy cabbage, sweet mango salsa and a cool lime crema. Toss 700g snapper fillets with the zest and juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, salt and 2 tbsp oil. Grill on a hot plate for 2 to 3 minutes a side, then flake into chunks. Dice 1 mango, half a red onion, 1 red chilli and coriander and dress with lime. Mix 150g sour cream with lime zest and juice. Char 12 corn tortillas and fill with shredded cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.
Topside roasted rare, shaved thin, warmed in garlic and oregano jus, piled into rolls, dipped, hot giardiniera.
W: the bar in Key West they dream about
Biscuit crust, filling of condensed milk, yolks and lime juice baked at 160C for 15 minutes, chilled, whipped cream.
K: 45ml rum, 30ml pineapple, 30ml orange, 15ml lime and a dash of grenadine over ice, grated nutmeg.
T: Two Chicago cops. One more week.
D: Two Chicago cops planning to retire to Key West get pulled into one last case.
P: Serve the mains when they daydream about Key West.

title: Back to the Future
S: Hand-cut chips blanched at 140C, fried at 185C until crisp, salted and served in a red-checked paper boat.

Soft pretzel bites dipped in a bicarb bath and baked deep brown, tossed in garlic butter and bright green parsley salt, with a cheddar dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2 litres water with 60g bicarb soda and dip the bites for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Blitz a big handful of parsley with 1 tsp salt until bright green. Toss the bites in 40g melted butter with 1 crushed garlic clove, then the green salt.
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in cheddar, parmesan and cayenne, folded, cut into tall strips, twisted, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.
M: griddled onions, pickles and a slice of American
Thin onions pressed into a beef patty on a hot griddle, smashed, flipped, American cheese on top, pickles and mustard on a toasted bun.
eggs, bacon and toast, ideally not cooked by a robot arm

Thick bacon rendered crisp, basted fried eggs, grilled tomatoes, smoky baked beans and buttered toast, with dog food strictly not included. Fry 8 thick bacon rashers over medium heat for 8 minutes until crisp and keep warm. Grill 4 halved tomatoes cut side down in the bacon fat for 4 minutes. Warm a 420g tin of baked beans with 1 tsp smoked paprika. Fry 8 eggs in the remaining fat, spooning hot fat over the whites until set. Toast and butter 4 thick slices of bread and serve everything on hot plates.
W: ocean blue frosting for the dance
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, piped with ocean blue buttercream, topped with sugar pearls and a gummy fish.
K: Vanilla ice cream blended thick with cold milk, chocolate syrup and malted milk powder, poured into tall glasses with whipped cream and two straws. Add 12 scoops vanilla ice cream, 800ml cold milk, 8 tbsp chocolate syrup and 8 tbsp malted milk powder to a blender, working in two batches if needed. Blend 30 seconds until thick but pourable. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses, top with whipped cream and a sprinkle of malted milk powder, and serve each with two straws.
T: Great Scott, that's a good burger.
D: A teenager accidentally travels back to 1955 and has to get his parents to fall in love.
P: Serve the mains when Marty walks into Lou's Cafe in 1955 and asks for a sugar-free drink.

title: Back to the Future Part II
S: Curly fries: potatoes cut on a spiraliser, soaked 30 minutes, dried well, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in smoked paprika salt.
fifty years of results in one book

Crisp parmesan and rosemary crackers rolled thin and cut into little book shapes, baked golden and served with a fig and onion jam. Rub 60g cold butter into 120g plain flour, then mix in 80g finely grated parmesan, 1 tsp chopped rosemary and a pinch of salt. Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to bring it together and chill 20 minutes. Roll 3mm thick and cut into 4 by 6cm rectangles. Score a line down the middle of each like a book spine. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Serve with fig jam.
Flour tortillas cut into board shapes, fried at 180C, tossed in salt and beetroot powder for colour, guacamole.
M: a tiny pizza blown up to full size
Bake mini pizzas for the reveal, then serve a full-size New York pie: thin sauce, low-moisture mozzarella and pepperoni on a hot steel at max heat.
Biff's Paradise steak and lobster mac

Rib eye seared and butter-basted with peppercorn sauce, beside a gooey cheddar macaroni with butter-poached lobster folded through. Salt 4 rib eye steaks the night before. Cook 300g macaroni. Melt 40g butter, stir in 40g flour, whisk in 600ml milk and cook until thick, then add 200g cheddar and the pasta. Poach 2 raw lobster tails, cut into chunks, in 60g butter for 4 minutes and fold through. Sear the steaks 3 minutes a side, basting with butter, and rest 8 minutes. Add 2 tbsp brandy, 1 tbsp cracked pepper and 150ml cream to the pan and reduce.
W: Blue jelly set in glasses with gummy sharks suspended halfway, whipped cream waves on top.
K: Strawberry milkshake: 3 scoops strawberry ice cream, fresh strawberries and milk blended thick.
T: Hoverboards and hydrated pizza.
D: Marty and Doc jump to 2015 to save Marty's future kids, then have to fix 1985.
P: Serve the mains when Lorraine puts the tiny pizza in the hydrator.

title: Back to the Future Part III
S: Boiled eggs pickled bright pink in spiced vinegar and beetroot, halved and served on rye with mustard, dill and flaky salt. Boil 8 eggs for 9 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Bring 250ml white vinegar, 250ml beetroot juice from a tin, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp peppercorns and 1 bay leaf to the boil. Pack the eggs and the tinned beetroot slices into a clean jar, pour over the hot brine and refrigerate for 3 days. Halve and serve on buttered rye with a dab of mustard, dill and flaky salt.
Corn boiled 5 minutes, charred on the grill, rolled in butter, salt and smoked paprika.
the new schoolteacher who arrives by train
Crisp apples sliced and tossed in lemon, served with Greek yoghurt whipped with honey and cinnamon for dipping.
M: smoked brisket, beans and cornbread at the 1885 festival

Salt and pepper brisket smoked low and slow until it wobbles, sliced thick with molasses baked beans and buttery skillet cornbread. Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper. Smoke or roast at 120C for about 10 hours until it reaches 95C inside, wrapping in baking paper at 70C. Rest 1 hour, then slice. Simmer 2 drained tins cannellini beans with 1 diced onion, 3 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard and 250ml stock for 45 minutes. Bake cornbread mix in a buttered hot pan at 200C for 20 minutes.
beef and beer, slow over the forge
Beef chuck browned, onion and carrot, a bottle of dark ale and stock, braised at 150C for 3 hours.
W: the pie at the festival dance
Double-crust apple pie with cinnamon and nutmeg, egg wash and sugar, baked at 190C for 50 minutes.
K: Lemon, ginger, a pinch of chilli and honey topped with ginger beer, served very cold.
T: Great Scott, it's 1885.
D: Marty heads to the Old West to stop Doc from being shot in the back.
P: Pour the drinks when Marty walks into the Palace Saloon and asks for water.

title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
S: the lure that started a friendship
Homemade peanut butter chocolate buttons: peanut butter, icing sugar and butter rolled into small discs, dipped in coloured candy melts.
Halloween caramel popcorn and lolly mix
the trick or treat walk in disguise

Crunchy oven-baked caramel popcorn tossed with chocolate buttons, jelly lollies and roasted peanuts, piled into a big bowl like a trick or treat haul. Pop 120g popcorn kernels and tip into a large roasting tray. Melt 100g butter with 200g brown sugar and 3 tbsp golden syrup, boil 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb soda and a pinch of salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool, break up and toss with 150g chocolate buttons, 150g jelly lollies and 80g roasted peanuts.
E.T. builds his phone from a talking toy
Cheese crackers cut into letters with small cutters: cheddar, butter and flour, rolled thin, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
M: the pizza Elliott was waiting on when he heard something in the shed
Pepperoni pizza on a hot steel at max heat, cut into squares for the family.
Elliott's toasted ham and cheese triangles
the day he frees the frogs

Leg ham, Swiss cheese and a smear of mustard butter toasted in a pan until golden and melting, cut into triangles with crunchy apple slaw. Mash 60g soft butter with 1 tsp mild mustard. Butter the outsides of 8 slices of white bread. Fill each pair with 2 slices leg ham and 2 slices Swiss cheese. Toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted, pressing down with a spatula. Toss 2 grated apples and 1 grated carrot with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Cut the toasties into triangles and serve with the slaw.
W: Melted milk chocolate in cupcake liners, a spoon of sweetened peanut butter, more chocolate on top, chilled to set.
K: E.T. raids the fridge and Elliott feels it at school

Ice-cold root beer poured over big scoops of vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, foaming up to the top, with long spoons and straws. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream to each glass. Slowly pour 250ml cold root beer down the side of each glass so the foam rises without spilling over. Top with a drizzle of chocolate syrup and serve straight away with long spoons and straws.
T: Phone home. Order in.
D: A boy hides a stranded alien in his house and helps him get home.
P: Lay out a trail of peanut butter chocolates when Elliott lures E.T. into the house.

title: Short Circuit
S: need more input, so make a lot of it
Pop a big batch in coconut oil, toss half with butter and salt, half with parmesan and cracked pepper, and keep it coming.
Crisp fried rolls filled with pork, cabbage, carrot and soy, straight out of a food truck window.
the Oregon coast where Stephanie lives

Toasted hazelnuts set in a thin amber caramel with butter and a pinch of bicarb for crunch, snapped into shards and finished with flaky salt. Toast 200g hazelnuts at 180C for 10 minutes, rub off the skins and roughly chop. Line a tray with baking paper. Cook 250g caster sugar, 80ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup in a heavy pan without stirring until deep amber, about 10 minutes. Stir in 30g butter, half a tsp bicarb soda and the nuts. Pour onto the tray, spread thin, sprinkle with flaky salt and cool 30 minutes before snapping.
M: Stephanie's truck, fried onions on everything
Two thin patties smashed on a hot griddle with onions pressed into the meat, American cheese, pickles and mustard on a toasted bun.
the lab canteen before the escape

Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, smothered with beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, with a stripe of mustard. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Griddle 8 franks for 6 minutes until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli and grated cheddar, then grill 1 minute to melt. Top with diced onion and mustard.
W: Blackberries tossed with sugar and lemon under a buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 35 minutes, vanilla ice cream.
K: Fresh lemon juice and raspberries muddled with sugar syrup, topped with soda water over crushed ice and finished with mint and lemon wheels. Muddle 150g raspberries with 80ml sugar syrup in a jug until pulpy. Stir in 120ml fresh lemon juice. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice and divide the raspberry mix between them. Top each with 150ml cold soda water and stir gently. Garnish with a lemon wheel and a mint sprig.
T: Number 5 is alive. Need more input.
D: A military robot struck by lightning comes alive and hides out with a food truck owner.
P: Serve the snacks when Number 5 starts speed-reading every book in the house.

title: The Fifth Element
S: delivered through the window by boat
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until the bottoms crisp, steamed under a lid, chilli oil and black vinegar dip.
Leeloo's sticky soy and honey drumsticks
she eats like she's never eaten before

Drumsticks marinated in soy, honey, garlic and ginger, roasted until sticky and lacquered, scattered with sesame seeds and spring onion. Mix 4 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp honey, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss 8 chicken drumsticks in it and marinate 2 hours or overnight. Roast on a lined tray at 200C for 40 minutes, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and cooked through. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds and 2 sliced spring onions.
Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime on skewers, served on ice with a sweet chilli dip.
M: hot and fast, handed through the window with chopsticks
Thick wheat noodles stir-fried in a smoking wok with pork, cabbage, carrot, spring onion, soy, oyster sauce and a splash of Shaoxing.
fresh udon or thick wheat noodles@Deli
Diva's opera night chilli garlic crab
the Fhloston Paradise dinner during the Diva's song

Blue swimmer crabs steamed and cracked, tossed in a wok with garlic, chilli, butter and parsley, served with crusty bread for the juices. Clean 4 blue swimmer crabs, remove the top shells and cut each body in half. Steam for 8 minutes until orange. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp oil in a wok, add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 2 sliced red chillies and fry 1 minute. Add the crab, a splash of white wine and the juice of 1 lemon and toss 2 minutes until coated. Finish with chopped parsley and serve with a warm baguette and crackers for the claws.
W: Butterfly pea flower tea sweetened and set with gelatine, a layer of coconut panna cotta beneath. Squeeze lemon on top and watch it turn purple.
K: Ice-cold gin stirred with dry vermouth and a splash of olive brine, strained into frozen glasses with a skewer of three green olives. Put 4 martini glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Fill a jug with ice and add 240ml gin, 40ml dry vermouth and 30ml green olive brine. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the frozen glasses. Thread 3 green olives onto each of 4 cocktail picks and rest one in each glass.
T: Multipass. Multi-course.
D: A cab driver in future New York helps a mysterious woman save the universe.
P: Serve the noodles when the flying noodle boat pulls up to Korben's window.

title: I Am Legend
S: from the corn he grows in the park
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C, salted, with a fresh corn and tomato salsa.
Pantry stash grilled peaches and honey

Tinned peach halves grilled cut side down until caramelised, served warm with honey yoghurt, toasted almonds and a pinch of cinnamon. Drain 2 tins peach halves (800g) and pat dry. Heat a griddle pan over high heat, brush with a little butter and grill the peaches cut side down for 4 minutes until charred and caramelised. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey. Toast 40g flaked almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes. Serve the warm peaches with the yoghurt, almonds and a dusting of cinnamon.
M: Central Park charred corn chicken bowls
from the corn he grows in the park

Smoky grilled chicken thighs over rice with charred corn, black beans, chilli lime butter, parmesan, avocado and coriander. Toss 800g chicken thighs with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, salt and oil. Grill 4 cobs of corn over hot coals for 10 minutes until charred, then grill the chicken 5 minutes a side. Cook 300g rice. Mix 40g soft butter with chilli flakes and lime zest. Cut the corn from the cobs and toss with the butter. Build bowls with rice, sliced chicken, corn, a drained 400g tin black beans, avocado, grated parmesan and coriander.
cut one for Sam, the best dog in New York
Sirloin seared in a hot pan, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, rested and sliced. Keep a plain piece for the dog.
W: rationed sweets in a locked-down house

Creamy baked rice pudding with lemon peel and a nutmeg skin on top, made from what keeps in the pantry, served warm with jam. Heat the oven to 150C. Butter a 1.5 litre baking dish. Stir 100g short grain rice, 60g caster sugar and 1 litre full cream milk together in the dish and add a long strip of lemon peel. Grate nutmeg over the top and dot with 20g butter. Bake 2 to 2.5 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes, until thick and creamy with a golden skin. Rest 10 minutes and serve warm with a spoon of raspberry jam.
K: the bottle Robert keeps in the lab

Bourbon muddled with tinned peach, lemon and mint, shaken hard and poured over crushed ice with a peach slice and mint sprig. Drain a 410g tin of sliced peaches, keeping 60ml of the syrup. Muddle half the peach slices with the syrup, the juice of 1 lemon and 10 mint leaves in a shaker. Add 200ml bourbon and ice and shake 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Garnish each with a peach slice and a mint sprig.
T: Last man in New York. Last tin of peaches.
D: A scientist and his German shepherd may be the last people left in New York.
P: Serve the snacks when Robert and Sam go hunting deer in Times Square.

title: The Terminator
S: Sarah's diner, ketchup bottle on every table
Thin fries soaked, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, salted, served with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.
the club where it all goes down
Corn chips layered with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, sour cream and salsa.
Tiki Motel peanut butter cracker stacks

Buttery crackers sandwiched with whipped honey peanut butter, half dipped in dark chocolate and sprinkled with flaky salt, like a vending machine raid done right. Beat 150g smooth peanut butter with 2 tbsp honey and 30g soft butter until fluffy. Spread on 20 round butter crackers and top with another 20 to make sandwiches. Melt 150g dark chocolate. Dip each sandwich halfway into the chocolate, lay on baking paper and sprinkle with flaky salt. Chill 20 minutes until set.
M: Thick chuck patty griddled to medium, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles on a toasted bun.
holed up at the Tiki Motel

Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in peppery spiced flour and fried crisp, served in a paper-lined bucket with hot sauce and pickles. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp pepper. Lift the chicken from the buttermilk, dredge well and rest 10 minutes. Fry in batches at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack and serve with hot sauce and pickles.
W: the pie case at Sarah's diner
Pitted cherries (fresh or frozen) with sugar, lemon and cornflour in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes.
K: Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre

Dark rum over ice with a full lime squeezed in, topped with cold cola and finished with a dash of bitters, a proper eighties club drink. Cut 2 limes into quarters. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice and squeeze 2 lime quarters into each, dropping the shells in. Add 45ml dark rum to each glass and a dash of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold cola and stir once.
T: I'll be back. With dessert.
D: A cyborg assassin is sent back from 2029 to kill Sarah Connor.
P: Serve the mains when Sarah's waitress shift goes wrong at Big Jeff's.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
S: Sarah's old friend in the desert

Flour tortillas filled with refried beans, melted cheddar and jalapeños, toasted in a dry pan until crisp, cut into wedges with salsa and sour cream. Spread 4 flour tortillas with 400g refried beans, scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced pickled jalapeños, then fold in half. Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges and serve with 200g tomato salsa and 150g sour cream.
the drive south to Enrique's camp
Golden shortcrust half moons filled with cumin-spiced beef, chopped boiled egg and green olives, baked until crisp.
M: Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and cumin, grilled hot, sliced, in corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.
Galleria food court double smash burger

Two thin patties smashed on a smoking griddle with American cheese, pickles, shredded lettuce and tangy burger sauce, wrapped tight in paper. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp relish and 1 tsp mustard for sauce. Heat a griddle until smoking, add the balls and smash flat with a spatula. Season and cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip and top with cheese for 1 minute. Toast 4 buns. Stack two patties on each with sauce, shredded lettuce and pickles, then wrap in baking paper for 2 minutes.
W: Ridged churros fried crisp and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with a thick, warm dark chocolate sauce for dunking. Boil 250ml water with 30g butter and a pinch of salt, beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball and cool 5 minutes, then beat in 1 egg. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream and stir in 150g dark chocolate until smooth for dipping.
K: Tequila, fresh lime and orange liqueur blended with ice into a frosty slush, poured into salt-rimmed glasses with a lime wheel. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt. Add 180ml tequila, 90ml fresh lime juice, 60ml orange liqueur, 40ml sugar syrup and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until smooth and slushy. Pour into the glasses and garnish each with a lime wheel. Serve immediately before it shatters into puddles.
T: Hasta la vista, baby.
D: A reprogrammed Terminator protects young John Connor from the liquid metal T-1000.
P: Serve the mains when the Terminator walks into the biker bar to borrow some clothes.

title: Predator
S: Thin-sliced topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and dried chilli, slow-dried until chewy with a slow-building heat. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp cayenne and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but bendy. Cool and store airtight.
Black beans blitzed with garlic, cumin and lime, topped with crumbled feta, coriander and green chilli. Corn chips.
the tracker who senses it first
Green plantains sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 175C until crisp, salted with lime zest.
M: grilled hard and fast before the chopper
Rump steak rubbed with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, grilled over high heat, rested, chimichurri.
Val Verde achiote chicken, rice and beans

Chicken thighs braised in achiote, orange and sofrito until tender, with black beans, white rice and sweet fried plantain. Fry 1 diced onion, 1 diced red capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in oil for 8 minutes. Add 1 tbsp achiote paste, 1 tsp cumin, the juice of 2 oranges and 200ml chicken stock. Add 1kg chicken thighs, cover and simmer 35 minutes until tender. Cook 300g rice. Warm a drained 400g tin black beans with a pinch of cumin. Slice 2 ripe plantains on the angle and fry in oil until caramelised.
W: cover yourself in it, he can't see you
Dense mud cake baked at 160C for 70 minutes, ganache poured over and dragged with a fork like mud.
K: back at base, if you make it

Dark rum, passionfruit, pineapple and lime shaken with a dash of grenadine, poured over crushed ice and topped with grated nutmeg. Shake 180ml dark rum, 120ml pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit, 60ml fresh lime juice and 20ml grenadine with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Grate a little nutmeg on top of each and garnish with a pineapple wedge.
T: Get to the chopper. Then get to dinner.
D: An elite rescue team gets hunted by an alien in the Central American jungle.
P: Serve the snacks when Dutch and Dillon do that famous handshake.

title: Aliens
S: Cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, buttermilk, eggs and melted butter poured into a hot buttered pan, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, cut into squares.
spread them across the table, fingers optional
Pizza dough rolled into long thin sticks, brushed with oil, rolled in sesame and salt, baked at 220C for 12 minutes until crisp.
M: breakfast for the marines, served at dinner
Beef and pork mince with soaked breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour, mash.
the marines' first meal after cryosleep

Flour tortillas stuffed with chorizo, soft scrambled eggs, crispy potato, cheddar and salsa, rolled tight and toasted in a hot pan until golden. Dice 400g potatoes and fry in oil for 12 minutes until crisp. Slice 2 chorizo sausages and fry until the fat runs. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and scramble softly in 20g butter. Lay out 4 large flour tortillas and fill each with potato, chorizo, egg, 30g grated cheddar and 2 tbsp salsa. Fold in the sides, roll tight and toast seam side down in a dry pan for 2 minutes a side.
W: Vanilla panna cotta set in a round mould, turned out, with candied orange peel strips as legs fanned around it.
K: strong enough to get you out of cryosleep

Strong cold brew poured over ice and sweet condensed milk in tall glasses, stirred until creamy, with a pinch of cinnamon on top. The night before, stir 100g coarsely ground dark roast coffee into 800ml cold water, cover and refrigerate 12 to 16 hours, then strain through a paper filter. Spoon 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of 4 tall glasses. Fill with ice, pour 180ml cold brew into each and stir until creamy. Dust with a pinch of cinnamon.
T: Game over, man. Dinner's on.
D: Ripley returns to the alien planet with a squad of colonial marines.
P: Serve the snacks at the marines' breakfast on the Sulaco.

title: Alien
S: the last meal before it all goes wrong
Cold sesame noodles: thin wheat noodles tossed in sesame paste, soy, black vinegar, chilli oil and garlic, cucumber and spring onion on top.
for the cat, or for you

Crisp sharp cheddar crackers cut into little fish shapes, sprinkled with smoked paprika and sea salt, baked golden and served by the handful. Pulse 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 100g plain flour and a pinch of salt in a food processor until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes. Roll 4mm thick, cut into small fish shapes and lay on a lined tray. Dust with smoked paprika and sea salt. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp. Cool on the tray.
Seeded crackers spread with cream cheese whipped with lemon zest, topped with tinned smoked oysters, cracked pepper and a few chives.
M: big bowls around the table, everyone talking at once
Pork and vegetable stir-fry with noodles: pork strips, cabbage, carrot, capsicum, soy, oyster sauce and ginger in a smoking wok, piled into bowls.
the escape shuttle, just Ripley and Jonesy

Beef mince browned hard with onion, garlic, chilli and cumin, simmered with tomato and kidney beans until thick, with sour cream, cheddar and crusty bread. Brown 800g beef mince hard in a heavy pot in two batches. Add 2 diced onions and 3 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 800g crushed tomatoes, a drained 400g tin kidney beans and 250ml beef stock. Simmer 90 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar and crusty bread.
W: Red velvet cake (buttermilk, cocoa, vinegar, red colouring) baked in a dome, filled with raspberry jam that bursts out when cut, cream cheese frosting.
K: the crew wakes up to coffee round the table

Strong coffee blended with dark chocolate, milk and ice until frothy, poured tall and topped with whipped cream and shaved chocolate. Brew 300ml strong coffee and stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp brown sugar until melted, then cool. Blend with 400ml cold milk and 2 cups of ice for 20 seconds until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses, top with whipped cream and shave dark chocolate over the top.
T: In space, no one can hear you crunch.
D: A spaceship crew is hunted by a deadly creature that boarded with them.
P: Serve the mains at the crew dinner, before Kane starts feeling unwell.

title: RoboCop
S: Popcorn tossed in butter, salt and a heavy dusting of nacho cheese powder (cheddar powder, paprika, garlic).
Smoked salmon on rye with crème fraîche and dill, and mini cucumber cups filled with whipped feta.

Cocktail franks in soft mini buns topped with loose beef coney chilli, yellow mustard and finely diced white onion, served by the trayful. Brown 300g fine beef mince, breaking it up very fine. Add 1 finely diced onion, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 30 minutes until loose and thick. Simmer 24 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Split 24 mini hot dog buns and warm at 180C for 3 minutes. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli, mustard and diced onion.
M: Natural casing franks griddled, steamed buns, loose coney chilli, yellow mustard and diced white onion.
Murphy's mushroom soup and cheese toasties
the baby food paste they feed him at the station

Silky mushroom soup blitzed with thyme and cream until smooth as paste, served with crisp gruyère and onion toasties for dunking. Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in 40g butter. Add 600g sliced mushrooms and cook 10 minutes until browned. Add 800ml chicken stock and thyme and simmer 20 minutes. Blitz until smooth and stir in 150ml cream. Butter 8 slices sourdough, fill with 150g grated gruyère and thin sliced onion, and toast in a pan for 3 minutes a side. Cut into fingers for dunking.
W: get them before they get you
Chocolate cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, topped with a tall swirl of marshmallow meringue torched into a mushroom cloud.
K: the gang's hangout before the shootout

Ice-cold lager served with a shot of rye whiskey on the side, with a dash of bitters and a lemon twist in the shot. Chill 4 cans or bottles of lager until icy and 4 shot glasses in the freezer. Pour 30ml rye whiskey into each shot glass with a dash of aromatic bitters and a small twist of lemon peel. Serve each shot alongside a cold lager poured into a chilled glass. Sip and chase.
T: I'd buy that for a dollar.
D: A murdered Detroit cop is rebuilt as a cyborg law enforcer.
P: Serve the snacks every time I'd buy that for a dollar comes on the TV.

title: Total Recall
S: Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C, tossed in vinegar powder, salt and paprika for a red Mars dust.
Last Resort red salsa loaded nachos

Corn chips layered with spiced black beans, cheddar and jalapeños, baked until melted, then piled with smoky red salsa, sour cream and coriander. Heat the oven to 200C. Warm a drained 400g tin black beans with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika, lightly crushing them. Layer 250g corn chips on a tray with the beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños in two layers. Bake 8 minutes until melted. Blitz 3 roasted tomatoes, 1 chipotle in adobo, half an onion, lime and salt for salsa. Top the nachos with salsa, sour cream and coriander.
Roast red capsicums until black, peel, blitz with toasted walnuts, pomegranate molasses, garlic, cumin and chilli (muhammara). Warm flatbread.
M: Venusville smoky red beans and rice
the cheap eats in the Mars mining quarter

Red kidney beans simmered with smoked sausage, onion, celery, capsicum and Cajun spice until creamy, over fluffy white rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Brown 300g sliced smoked sausage in a heavy pot. Add 1 diced onion, 2 celery sticks and 1 green capsicum and cook 8 minutes. Stir in 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp Cajun seasoning and 2 bay leaves. Add 2 drained 400g tins kidney beans and 600ml chicken stock and simmer 40 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken. Cook 300g long grain rice. Serve the beans over rice with sliced spring onion and hot sauce.
red lentils, red capsicum, red everything
Red lentil and capsicum stew with onion, garlic, smoked paprika, tomato and stock, simmered 25 minutes, yoghurt on top.
W: Crisp-shelled marshmallowy pavlova piled with whipped cream, fresh raspberries and a glossy red berry sauce, finished with mint. Heat the oven to 150C. Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp white vinegar. Spread into a 20cm round on baking paper, drop to 120C and bake 75 minutes, then cool in the oven. Simmer 150g frozen raspberries with 2 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes and cool. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 250g raspberries, the sauce and mint.
K: the bar where Quaid meets Melina

Vodka shaken with fresh blood orange, orange liqueur and lime until ice cold, strained into chilled coupes the colour of Martian dust. Chill 4 coupes. Squeeze 3 blood oranges to get about 160ml juice. Shake 160ml vodka, the blood orange juice, 40ml orange liqueur and 20ml lime juice with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupes and garnish each with a thin blood orange wheel. If blood oranges are out of season, use orange juice and a splash of grenadine.
T: Get to Mars. Then get to dinner.
D: A construction worker discovers he might be a secret agent from Mars.
P: Serve dinner when Quaid finally gets to Mars and walks into Venusville.

title: Blade Runner
S: the street stall in the rain
Pork and cabbage gyoza pan-fried until crisp, steamed under a lid, soy and rice vinegar dip with chilli oil.
Gaff leaves one behind every time
Rice paper sheets cut into small triangles, fried at 180C for a few seconds until they puff, tossed in shichimi and salt.
Neon salmon and avocado inside-out rolls

Inside-out rolls of salmon, avocado and cucumber, coated in bright tobiko and toasted sesame, sliced and served with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger. Rinse 400g sushi rice, cook with 480ml water, then fold in 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Lay half a nori sheet on a mat covered in cling film, spread with rice and flip so the rice is underneath. Lay strips of 250g sashimi salmon, avocado and cucumber along the middle and roll tight. Roll in 50g tobiko and sesame. Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife.
M: Deckard's noodle bar prawn tempura udon
Deckard asks for four, he gets two

Thick udon in a hot dashi broth seasoned with soy and mirin, topped with crisp prawn tempura, spring onion and a pinch of shichimi. Heat 1.6 litres water with 2 tsp dashi powder, 4 tbsp soy sauce and 3 tbsp mirin to a simmer. Whisk 100g plain flour, 1 tbsp cornflour and 180ml ice-cold soda water until just mixed. Dip 12 peeled green prawns in flour, then the batter, and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp. Cook 4 packets fresh udon for 2 minutes and divide between bowls. Ladle over the broth and top with prawns, spring onion and shichimi.
Pork belly braised in soy, mirin and sake until tender, sliced over ramen in a chicken and pork broth with a jammy soy egg, nori and spring onion.
W: fold them up like Gaff's unicorn
Sesame tuile batter (egg white, sugar, flour, melted butter) spread thin, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded into shapes while hot.
K: his bar tumbler, alone in the apartment

Japanese whisky poured over a tall glass packed with ice, topped with very cold soda water and finished with a strip of lemon peel. Pack 4 tall glasses to the top with ice and stir with a bar spoon for 10 seconds to chill the glass, then pour off any water. Add 45ml Japanese whisky to each and stir 10 times. Top slowly with 150ml very cold soda water, pouring down the spoon to keep the bubbles. Stir once and squeeze a strip of lemon peel over each glass.
T: Noodles in the rain.
D: A burnt-out cop hunts escaped replicants in a rainy future Los Angeles.
P: Serve the noodles when Deckard sits down at the street noodle bar in the rain.

title: Spaceballs
S: Princess Vespa's hair bun cheese gougères
the royal hairdo, in cheese puff form

Light, crisp choux puffs baked with gruyère and a pinch of mustard, piped into coiled buns and served warm from the oven. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, then beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time with 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Stir in 120g grated gruyère. Pipe 30 small coils onto lined trays and sprinkle with more cheese. Bake 22 minutes until puffed and golden.
Pretzel rods dipped in melted chocolate and striped with coloured candy melts in a plaid pattern.
Spaceballs the snack, sold by Yogurt
Cereal squares, pretzels, peanuts and mini marshmallows tossed in butter and honey, baked at 140C for 20 minutes.
M: the cheesiest pizza you can make
Deep pan pizza loaded with four cheeses (mozzarella, provolone, parmesan, cheddar), pepperoni and sauce, baked at 220C for 20 minutes until molten.
Moon diner corned beef hash and eggs
the roadside diner on the moon, with an unexpected guest

Diced potatoes fried crisp with onion and shredded corned beef, two runny fried eggs on top, chives, hot sauce and buttered toast. Boil 800g diced potatoes for 6 minutes and drain well. Fry in 3 tbsp oil and 30g butter for 12 minutes until golden. Add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes, then fold in 400g shredded cooked corned beef and press flat for 5 minutes to crisp the bottom. Fry 8 eggs. Serve the hash topped with two eggs each, chives, hot sauce and buttered toast.
W: for the wise old master Yogurt
Greek yoghurt whipped with honey and vanilla, layered with crunchy granola and fresh berries in tall glasses.
K: Perri-Air sparkling lime and mint cooler
a can of fresh air from Planet Druidia

Fresh lime and mint muddled with sugar syrup and cucumber, topped with ice-cold sparkling water and served tall, as precious as a can of air. Muddle 12 mint leaves, 4 slices cucumber and 60ml sugar syrup in a jug. Add the juice of 3 limes and stir. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and divide the mix between them. Top each with 150ml cold sparkling water. Garnish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.
T: May the schwartz be with your snacks.
D: A space hero and his half-dog sidekick rescue a princess from the Spaceballs.
P: Serve the pizza when Pizza the Hutt appears.

title: Independence Day
S: Potatoes sliced 1.5mm on a mandoline, rinsed and dried, fried at 170C in batches, tossed in salt and a little green chilli powder.
Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate, then scattered with red and blue sprinkles and popping candy before it sets.
he's been ready for them for years

Topside sliced thin and marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, chilli and smoked paprika, slow-dried until chewy and smoky. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp chilli flakes and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Marinate the beef overnight in the fridge. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, unwrapped and glazed under a hot grill. Charred corn, potato salad with mustard dressing.
W: Vanilla slab cake covered in whipped cream, blueberries in the top corner for stars, rows of halved strawberries for stripes.
K: Bourbon stirred into fresh lemonade with crushed strawberries and blueberries, poured over ice in mason jars with a lemon wheel and mint. Make lemonade by stirring 150ml fresh lemon juice and 120ml sugar syrup into 500ml cold water. Lightly crush 100g strawberries and 50g blueberries in the bottom of 4 jars. Fill with ice, add 45ml bourbon to each and top with the lemonade. Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.
T: Welcome to Earth. Welcome to dinner.
D: A ragtag group of humans fights back against invading aliens on the 4th of July.
P: Serve the mains when the President gives his big speech.

title: Armageddon
S: AJ and Grace's honey animal crackers
the most famous animal crackers in movie history

Crisp honey and vanilla butter biscuits cut into little animals, baked golden and served by the bowlful, ready for a walk up someone's arm. Beat 125g butter with 80g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then mix in 250g flour. Roll thin and cut with small animal cutters. Bake at 170C for 10 minutes until pale golden. Cool on a rack and pile into a bowl.
Harry's rig in the middle of the ocean
Topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, black pepper and brown sugar, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: Oil rig chuck chilli with cornbread

Beef chuck chunks braised with onion, garlic, chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans until tender, with sour cream and warm buttered cornbread. Brown 1.2kg beef chuck in 3cm chunks in batches. Add 2 diced onions and 4 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes, then 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 800g crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150C for 2.5 hours. Stir in a drained 400g tin kidney beans for the last 20 minutes. Bake cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream.
steak, mash and gravy before launch
Rib eye seared and rested, buttery mash and onion gravy (onions cooked down, flour, beef stock).
W: Animal crackers dipped in melted pink and white candy melts with sprinkles, served with a bowl of whipped cream.
K: the crew's list of demands before launch

Bourbon over ice topped with spicy ginger beer, fresh lime and a dash of bitters, served long and cold in heavy highball glasses. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice. Add 45ml bourbon and the juice of a quarter lime to each, plus a dash of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold ginger beer and stir once from the bottom. Garnish with a lime wedge.
T: Drilling for dessert.
D: Oil drillers are sent into space to blow up an asteroid heading for Earth.
P: Serve dessert when AJ does the animal cracker scene.

title: Galaxy Quest
S: Fan expo smoky garlic nut mix

Mixed nuts and pretzels tossed in butter, Worcestershire, garlic and smoked paprika, slow-baked until crunchy and served warm in paper cups. Heat the oven to 140C. Melt 50g butter with 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt. Toss with 300g mixed nuts and 150g pretzels until coated. Spread on a lined tray and bake 30 minutes, stirring twice, until toasted and dry. Cool 10 minutes and serve in paper cups.
the planet with the rock monster
Seeded crackers broken into jagged shards, with tapenade of black olives, capers, anchovies, garlic and lemon blitzed coarse.

Soft pink marshmallows made with fresh raspberry purée, cut into cubes and rolled in icing sugar and cornflour, sweet, tangy and wobbly. Blitz and sieve 150g raspberries. Sprinkle 20g powdered gelatine over 100ml of the purée to bloom. Boil 300g caster sugar, 2 tbsp glucose syrup and 100ml water to 120C. Melt the gelatine mix and pour it into a mixer bowl, then pour in the hot syrup with the beaters running and whisk 10 minutes until thick and fluffy. Spread in a lined 20cm tin dusted with icing sugar and cornflour. Set 4 hours, then cut and roll in more dusting.
M: Beef and bean chilli simmered 90 minutes with onion, chilli and tomato, sour cream and cheddar.

Toasted triple-decker of roast turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, cut into quarters and pinned with toothpicks, salted chips on the side. Bake 800g frozen chips at 220C for 20 minutes and salt them. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread and spread with mayo. Build each sandwich as toast, 100g sliced turkey and lettuce, toast, 2 rashers bacon and sliced tomato, toast. Pin each with 4 toothpicks and cut into quarters. Serve with the chips.
W: by Grabthar's hammer, you will have seconds
Fudgy brownies with melted dark chocolate and butter, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pulled while the centre still wobbles.
K: the colours of the NSEA Protector

Blue curaçao syrup, pineapple and fresh lime topped with fizzy lemonade over ice, finished with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail cherry. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 30ml non-alcoholic blue curaçao syrup, 60ml pineapple juice and a squeeze of lime to each. Top each with 150ml cold lemonade and stir gently so it stays bright blue. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cocktail cherry on a pick.
T: Never give up. Never surrender. Never skip dessert.
D: TV sci-fi actors are mistaken for real heroes by actual aliens.
P: Serve the mains when the Thermians arrive at the fan convention.

title: The Matrix
S: Mouse swears it tastes like the real thing

Crunchy clusters of oats, puffed wheat, honey, brown butter and toasted seeds, baked golden and broken into chunks, much better than the ship's gruel. Heat the oven to 160C. Brown 60g butter in a pan until nutty, then stir in 80g honey and 40g brown sugar. Toss with 200g rolled oats, 50g puffed wheat, 60g mixed seeds and a pinch of salt. Press firmly onto a lined tray and bake 25 minutes until golden. Cool completely on the tray, then break into clusters.
he knows it isn't real, he eats it anyway
Rump cut into cubes, seared hard in a smoking pan with butter and garlic, toothpicks and a peppercorn dip.
the green code falling down the screen
Lavash brushed with oil and herb salt (parsley and dill blitzed with salt), cut into long thin strips, baked crisp.
M: juicy and delicious, real or not
Sirloin dry-brined, seared and basted with butter and thyme, rested, sliced, with red wine sauce.
I used to eat there, really good noodles

Wheat noodles tossed with spicy pork mince, sesame and chilli oil sauce, Sichuan pepper and blanched bok choy, topped with crushed peanuts and spring onion. Fry 400g pork mince in 1 tbsp oil until crisp, then add 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine. Mix 3 tbsp tahini, 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar, 3 tbsp chilli oil, 1 tsp sugar, 1 crushed garlic clove and half a tsp ground Sichuan pepper. Cook 500g fresh wheat noodles and 4 halved baby bok choy for 2 minutes. Divide the sauce between 4 bowls, add the noodles and bok choy, top with pork, peanuts and spring onion and toss.
W: freshly baked, she knew you'd want one
Brown butter choc chip cookies, dough rested overnight, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, flaky salt.
K: Red pill or blue pill gin fizz
take the red pill or the blue, choose carefully

Two gin fizzes shaken with lemon and topped with soda: red with raspberry and cranberry, blue with blue curaçao. Everyone picks one. For 2 red drinks, shake 90ml gin, 30ml lemon juice, 30ml raspberry syrup and 60ml cranberry juice with ice and strain into 2 ice-filled glasses. For 2 blue drinks, shake 90ml gin, 30ml lemon juice, 30ml blue curaçao and 15ml sugar syrup with ice and strain into 2 ice-filled glasses. Top all 4 with 80ml soda water and add a lemon wheel.
T: Red pill or blue pill.
D: A hacker discovers the world is a simulation and joins the fight against the machines.
P: Serve the snacks when Neo first eats the gruel on the Nebuchadnezzar.

title: Jurassic Park
S: Brown butter sugar cookie dough wrapped around a chocolate egg, shaped into ovals, baked at 175C for 12 minutes, speckled with cocoa and gold dust.
Nedry's smuggling kit, hidden in plain sight

Crustless finger sandwiches of smoked chicken, avocado, cream cheese and chives on soft white bread, stacked into a tin and kept cold. Mix 150g cream cheese with 2 tbsp snipped chives and lemon zest. Mash 1 avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread 8 slices soft white bread with the cream cheese. Top 4 slices with mashed avocado and 250g sliced smoked chicken, then close with the other 4. Press lightly, trim the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers. Stack in a tin, cover and chill 20 minutes.
clever girl, in the long grass
Flour tortillas cut into curved claw shapes, brushed with oil, salt and smoked paprika, baked at 200C for 8 minutes. Guacamole.
M: the lunch where Grant, Sattler and Malcolm argue with Hammond
Herb-crusted rack of lamb roasted at 220C to 55C, rested, with a crushed pea and mint purée and roast baby potatoes, plated like a fancy park restaurant.
the T. rex gets the goat, you get the ribs

Pork ribs rubbed with brown sugar, paprika and garlic, wrapped and baked until tender, then glazed with smoky barbecue sauce under a hot grill. Mix 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Rub over 2 racks pork ribs (about 2kg). Wrap each rack tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush thickly with 250ml barbecue sauce mixed with 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar and grill under high heat for 5 minutes until sticky and charred. Rest 5 minutes and cut between the bones.
W: Three scoops of vanilla bean ice cream in a chilled coupe with hot fudge and crushed honeycomb, served slightly too soft like the freezers are off. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Leave 1L vanilla ice cream out for 10 minutes so it softens a little too much. Scoop three each into chilled coupes, pour over the fudge and scatter crushed honeycomb.
K: Ripple glass lime and mint iced tea

Chilled black tea sweetened with honey and shaken with fresh lime and mint, served in tall clear glasses on the table so you can watch them ripple. Brew 4 black tea bags in 1 litre boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 4 tbsp honey. Cool and chill 2 hours. Muddle 12 mint leaves with the juice of 2 limes in a jug, add the tea and stir. Fill 4 tall clear glasses with ice, pour in the tea and garnish with lime wheels and mint.
T: Spared no expense on dessert.
D: A dinosaur theme park goes wrong when the power goes off.
P: Serve dessert when Hammond eats melting ice cream in the dark visitor centre.

title: Coneheads
S: Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C in batches, salted. Make far more than you think you need.

Mini waffle cones filled with creamy poached chicken salad with celery, chives and toasted almonds, topped with a cherry tomato point. Poach 500g chicken breast in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred finely. Mix with 120g mayo, 2 tbsp sour cream, 2 finely diced celery sticks, 2 tbsp chives, 30g chopped toasted almonds, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Chill 20 minutes. Just before serving, spoon into 12 mini waffle cones and top each with a cherry tomato.
Thick onion rings soaked in buttermilk, dipped in beer batter, fried at 185C until puffed.
M: the family dinner in suburban New Jersey
Two smashed patties, American cheese, pickles and onion on toasted buns, stacked on a platter.
the backyard barbecue in New Jersey

Thick beef sausages and lemon garlic chicken thighs grilled over coals, with buttered corn on the cob and a creamy mustard potato salad. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in 2 tbsp oil, 2 crushed garlic cloves, lemon zest and salt for 1 hour. Boil 1kg baby potatoes until tender, halve and dress warm with 100g mayo, 1 tbsp Dijon, chopped spring onion and dill. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and the chicken over medium coals for 15 to 20 minutes, turning. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes and brush with butter.
W: obviously, what else would it be
Soft-serve style vanilla ice cream piped high into waffle cones, dipped in chocolate magic shell (dark chocolate melted with coconut oil).
K: A big jug of cold lager and fizzy lemonade with fresh lemon and lime squeezed in, poured over ice, made in mass quantities. Chill 4 bottles lager (375ml) and 1.25 litres lemonade until very cold. Fill a large jug with ice and add 2 lemons and 1 lime cut into wedges, squeezing them as they go in. Pour in the lager and lemonade together, slowly so it doesn't foam over. Stir once and pour into 4 big glasses, topping up as needed.
T: Consume mass quantities.
D: An alien couple from Remulak lives undercover in suburban New Jersey.
P: Serve the snacks when the Coneheads consume mass quantities.

title: Tremors
S: Chang's Market spiced nuts and crackling

Crunchy oven-baked pork crackling with chilli salt, served beside hot honey and cayenne roasted peanuts, the way a desert general store should. Score 600g pork rind finely, rub with 2 tsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge for 2 hours. Pat dry and roast at 230C for 30 minutes until blistered and crisp, then break into pieces and toss with chilli salt. Toss 250g raw peanuts with 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cayenne, salt and 1 tbsp oil and roast at 180C for 12 minutes, stirring once.
Topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and pepper overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: Rump steaks and thick sausages grilled over coals, baked beans simmered with onion and molasses, coleslaw with a creamy vinegar dressing.
tinned beans and franks from the bunker

Smoky franks browned and simmered with onion, beans, molasses, mustard and smoked paprika until thick and glossy, with warm buttered cornbread. Slice 8 franks into coins and brown in a pot with 1 tbsp oil. Add 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp American mustard and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 2 drained 400g tins cannellini beans and 250ml stock and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Bake cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: gummy worms coming up through the dirt
Chocolate pudding set in cups, crushed chocolate biscuit dirt on top, gummy worms poking out.
K: Val and Earl's bourbon iced tea
the beer they never get to finish, so try this

Strong sweet tea chilled and mixed with bourbon, fresh lemon and peach, poured over ice in jars from the esky in the back of the truck. Brew 4 black tea bags in 800ml boiling water for 5 minutes and stir in 4 tbsp honey. Cool and chill. Slice 1 peach and 1 lemon. Fill 4 jars with ice and peach and lemon slices. Add 45ml bourbon to each and top with the tea. Stir and serve with a squeeze of lemon.
T: Underground and hungry.
D: The residents of a tiny Nevada town fight giant underground worms.
P: Serve the snacks when Burt and Heather defend their basement.

title: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids
S: Rice bubble treats pressed into a big ring mould (marshmallows melted with butter, cereal stirred through), one giant loop to share.
the one they sleep on overnight
Two big dark chocolate cookies sandwiched with a thick layer of vanilla buttercream (butter, icing sugar, vanilla), cut into wedges.
the backyard toy that becomes a shelter

Firm, bright fruit jelly blocks in red, yellow and blue, cut into bricks with little cream studs piped on top, ready to stack. Make 3 packets of different coloured jelly, each with half the usual water (about 250ml boiling water) plus 2 tsp extra powdered gelatine, so they set firm. Pour each into a separate lined 20cm square tin and chill 4 hours. Cut into 2 by 4cm bricks. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and pipe two rows of small dots on each brick as studs.
M: Juicy beef burgers grilled over coals with melted cheese, lettuce and tomato on toasted buns, with buttered corn on the cob and a crunchy green salad. Mix 800g beef mince with salt and pepper and shape into 4 patties. Grill over hot coals 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheese to each for the last minute. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, and brush with butter. Toss cos lettuce, cucumber and cherry tomatoes with a dressing of 3 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp vinegar and 1 tsp mustard. Toast 4 buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, patty and sauce.
Buttermilk pancake batter cooked as one huge pancake in a big pan, cut into wedges, butter and syrup.
W: camping out in the grass jungle
Toast marshmallows over a flame and squash them with squares of milk chocolate between two plain biscuits.
K: Fresh watermelon blitzed with lemon juice and sugar syrup, strained and topped with soda water over ice, with lemon wheels and mint. Blitz 800g seedless watermelon chunks until smooth and strain through a sieve into a jug. Stir in 120ml fresh lemon juice and 80ml sugar syrup. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour the watermelon lemonade two thirds of the way and top with soda water. Garnish with lemon wheels and mint.
T: Giant snacks for tiny kids.
D: A scientist accidentally shrinks his kids and the neighbours' kids to the size of ants.
P: Serve the snacks when the kids ride the ant.

title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
S: San Dimas mall cinnamon pretzel bites
the history class field trip to the San Dimas mall

Soft pretzel bites baked deep brown, rolled in butter and cinnamon sugar, with a sweet cream cheese icing dip, straight from a food court stall. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Dip in 2 litres boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss in 50g melted butter, then 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Beat 100g cream cheese with 80g icing sugar and 2 tbsp milk for the dip.
So-crates, a snack from ancient Greece
Feta cubes and mixed olives marinated in olive oil with lemon zest, oregano and chilli, with crusty bread.
England, way back, with the princesses
Turkey drumsticks brined overnight in salt and brown sugar, roasted at 160C for 90 minutes, glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard for the last 15.
M: Chicken braised with tomato, mushrooms, garlic and white wine, the dish named for one of Napoleon's battles, with crusty bread.
So-crates, picked up in ancient Athens

Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken skewers grilled until charred, in warm pita with tzatziki, beside a chunky Greek salad with a slab of feta. Cube 800g chicken thighs and marinate 1 hour in 3 tbsp olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tsp dried oregano. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning. Grate 1 cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 200g Greek yoghurt, garlic and dill. Chop 3 tomatoes, the rest of a cucumber, half a red onion and 1 green capsicum with olives, top with 150g feta, oregano and oil. Warm 4 pita.
W: huge, everything on it, Napoleon's challenge
A trough of ice cream: vanilla, chocolate and strawberry scoops, every topping in the house, bananas, whipped cream, cherries.
K: the phone booth that travels through time

Purple grape juice and lime topped with fizzing soda water over a scoop of vanilla ice cream, foaming up into a most excellent spider. Mix 600ml cold grape juice with the juice of 1 lime. Add a big scoop of vanilla ice cream to each of 4 tall glasses. Pour 150ml of the grape mix over each, then slowly top with 100ml cold soda water so it foams up. Serve straight away with long spoons and straws.
T: Be excellent to each other.
D: Two slackers travel through time to pass their history report.
P: Serve dessert when Napoleon takes on the Ziggy Piggy at the waterslide park.

title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
S: Five seeded crackers per person, each topped differently: cream cheese, pâté, cheddar, smoked salmon and fig.
Swiss meringue piped into saucer shapes, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, a dot of lemon curd underneath.
M: sculpt it like Roy, gravy runs down the sides
Floury potatoes riced and beaten with hot milk and lots of butter, piled into a tall mountain, onion gravy poured over the top.
the family dinner that goes off the rails

Dry-brined chicken with thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden and crisp, with buttered peas and carrots and a simple pan gravy. Salt a 1.8kg chicken all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Mash 50g soft butter with thyme leaves and push it under the breast skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Boil 4 sliced carrots for 6 minutes and 300g frozen peas for 3, then toss in butter.
W: Chocolate cake stacked tall, covered in chocolate buttercream with vertical ridges dragged in with a fork.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with ripe strawberries, topped up with chilled water in a big jug over ice with mint. Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with 120ml sugar syrup until smooth and strain into a large jug. Stir in 150ml fresh lemon juice and 700ml cold water. Add plenty of ice, sliced strawberries and lemon wheels. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a mint sprig.
T: Something's out there. Something's in the mash.
D: A power line worker becomes obsessed with a mountain after a UFO encounter.
P: Serve the mains when Roy sculpts the mashed potatoes at dinner.

title: Star Wars
S: Mos Eisley cantina smoky snack mix
a wretched hive of scum and villainy

Pretzels, rice crackers, roasted chickpeas and mixed nuts tossed in butter with smoked paprika, garlic, chilli and brown sugar, baked crunchy. Toss 100g pretzels, 100g rice crackers, 100g roasted chickpeas and 150g mixed nuts with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp garlic powder, a pinch of chilli and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 150C for 25 minutes, stirring twice.
Pork and beef meatballs baked at 220C for 15 minutes, simmered in a creamy mushroom and Dijon sauce so they come out grey, one thumb dent for the superlaser.
M: grilled pork sausage, roast pork, pepper slaw and peppercorn sauce in pita

Grill pork sausages, slice roast pork, warm thick pita. Slaw of cabbage, carrot and black pepper in a light mayo dressing. Peppercorn sauce: cracked pepper, shallot, stock and cream reduced. Wrap it all tight.
Tatooine lamb, apricot and chickpea stew

Lamb shoulder braised with cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, tomato, chickpeas and dried apricots until tender, over fluffy couscous with mint. Brown 1.2kg lamb shoulder chunks in batches. Add 2 diced onions and 3 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp ground coriander, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 400g crushed tomatoes, 500ml stock, a drained 400g tin chickpeas and 100g dried apricots. Cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours. Pour 300ml boiling stock over 300g couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff with butter and serve with mint.
W: Soft vanilla blancmange tinted pale blue like the milk Luke drinks at home, chilled in glasses and topped with crushed shortbread. Whisk 60g cornflour into 100ml of 800ml full cream milk until smooth. Heat the rest of the milk with 80g caster sugar until steaming, then whisk in the cornflour mix and stir over medium heat for 4 minutes until thick. Off the heat, add 1 tsp vanilla and a drop of blue food colouring. Pour into 4 glasses and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed shortbread.
K: Blend cold milk (or coconut milk) with frozen pineapple, a little dragon fruit, a squeeze of lime and a drop of blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue.
T: A long time ago, in a dinner far, far away.
D: A farm boy joins a rebellion to rescue a princess and destroy the Death Star.
P: Serve the blue milk at the Lars homestead breakfast table.

title: The Empire Strikes Back
S: Shaved ice packed into cups, soaked with homemade blue raspberry syrup (raspberries simmered with sugar, strained, a drop of blue).
warm on the inside, which beats the outside

Flaky hand pies packed with chuck braised in stout with mushrooms and thyme, baked golden and served with a sharp horseradish and mustard dip. Brown 600g diced chuck in batches, add 1 diced onion and 200g sliced mushrooms, then 1 tbsp flour, 330ml stout, 200ml beef stock and thyme. Cover and simmer 2 hours until thick and tender, then cool. Cut 8 rounds from 4 sheets shortcrust for bases and 8 lids from 2 sheets puff. Fill, seal, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Mix 100g sour cream with 2 tsp horseradish and 1 tsp Dijon.
Warm spinach and artichoke dip with cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella and parmesan, baked at 190C for 20 minutes. Corn chips.
M: root veg in the hut, Yoda style
Parsnip, carrot, swede, celeriac and potato simmered in a rich vegetable stock with thyme, bay and a spoon of miso, finished with parsley. Crusty bread.
a fancy dinner table, with Vader waiting at the end of it

Seared eye fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and golden puff pastry, carved pink with red wine jus and buttery mash. Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over and brush with Dijon. Cook 400g finely chopped mushrooms with 2 shallots and thyme until dry. Lay 8 slices prosciutto on cling film, spread with the mushrooms, roll the beef up tight and chill 20 minutes.
