Wrap in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and chill 20 minutes. Bake at 220C for 25 minutes until 52C inside and rest 10 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock for jus. Serve with mash.
W: Slab of vanilla ice cream frozen hard in a loaf tin, coated in dark chocolate shell, sliced thick.
K: Peach nectar and orange juice topped with sparkling water, the colour of the clouds over Cloud City.
T: The dinner strikes back.
D: The rebels flee to the ice planet Hoth and Luke trains with Yoda.
P: Serve the stew when Yoda cooks rootleaf stew for Luke.

title: Return of the Jedi
S: for Jabba's cackling sidekick, who'd steal them anyway

Buttermilk-brined chicken thigh nuggets in a garlic paprika crust, fried crisp and tossed in chilli salt, with a herby green mayo for dipping. Cut 700g chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and soak in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Mix 200g plain flour with 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika and pepper. Dredge the chicken and fry at 170C for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Toss in salt mixed with a pinch of chilli flakes. Blitz 120g mayo with a handful of parsley, chives and lemon juice for the dip.
crumbed prawns, because Jabba eats frogs live
Butterflied prawns in flour, egg and panko, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, sweet chilli and lime.
A bowl of mixed berries and cherries tossed with a little honey and mint, with a pot of whipped mascarpone.
M: roast chicken with a honey glaze, Han was almost on the menu
Whole chicken spatchcocked, roasted at 220C for 40 minutes, glazed with honey, garlic and thyme for the last 10. Roast root vegetables.
a big slab of everything, served before the Sarlacc pit

Salt and pepper brisket smoked low until it wobbles, sliced thick with sticky barbecue sauce, tangy slaw, pickles and soft white bread. Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper. Smoke or roast at 120C for about 10 hours until 95C inside, wrapping in baking paper once it reaches 70C. Rest 1 hour. Shred quarter of a cabbage and 1 carrot and toss with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Slice the brisket thick and serve with barbecue sauce, the slaw, dill pickles and white bread.
W: Bubbling mixed forest berries under a crunchy oat, hazelnut and brown sugar crumble, served warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Heat the oven to 180C. Toss 750g frozen mixed berries with 80g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 120g plain flour until crumbly, then stir in 60g rolled oats, 50g chopped hazelnuts and 100g brown sugar. Scatter over the berries and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
K: Cold milk blended with frozen pineapple, lime and a drop of blue spirulina until smooth.
T: Endor picnic.
D: The rebels launch an attack on the second Death Star.
P: Serve the snacks at the Ewok village celebration.

title: The Iron Giant
S: Soft cocoa cakes sandwiched with fluffy marshmallow and vanilla cream, rolled in crushed choc-coated peanuts for a bit of scrapyard crunch. Beat 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 1 egg, then add 150g plain flour, 30g cocoa, half a tsp bicarb and 120ml buttermilk. Pipe 24 small rounds onto lined trays and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter with 100g icing sugar, then fold in 100g marshmallow fluff and 1 tsp vanilla. Sandwich the cakes with the filling and roll the edges in 50g crushed chocolate-coated peanuts.
Hogarth's mum works at the diner
Mini apple pies in a muffin tin, shortcrust cases filled with spiced apple, lattice tops, baked at 190C for 25 minutes.
Dough of flour, sugar, eggs, almonds and orange zest shaped into a log, baked at 170C for 25 minutes, sliced, baked again 10 minutes a side until crisp.
M: Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg and onion, tomato glaze, baked at 180C for an hour, mash and peas.
W: the Giant would eat the tray too

Golden peanut brittle smashed into jagged sheets like scrap from Dean's yard, with flaky salt and a silver dusting of edible lustre. Line a tray with baking paper. Heat 300g caster sugar, 120ml liquid glucose and 80ml water in a heavy pan to 150C on a sugar thermometer. Take off the heat and quickly stir in 250g roasted peanuts, 20g butter and 1 tsp bicarb soda. Pour onto the tray and spread thin. Sprinkle with flaky salt and brush lightly with silver edible lustre. Cool 30 minutes, then smash into jagged shards.
K: one sip of Dean's espresso and Hogarth is off the walls

Vanilla ice cream blended with a shot of espresso, milk and malt, poured thick and topped with whipped cream and chocolate-covered coffee beans. Brew 2 shots espresso and cool, or use decaf for younger kids. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp malted milk powder for 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Top each with whipped cream and a few chocolate-coated coffee beans, or chocolate sprinkles for the little ones.
T: Eats metal. Prefers pie.
D: A boy befriends a giant robot that eats metal.
P: Serve the mains when Hogarth hides the giant in Dean's junkyard.

title: Batman
S: the Joker's gallery visit, before the paint goes everywhere

Beetroot and gin-cured salmon on rye with horseradish crème fraîche, pickled shallot and a splash of green herb oil, splattered like the gallery. Two days ahead, mix 100g salt, 80g sugar, 1 grated raw beetroot and 2 tbsp gin and pack around a 400g salmon fillet. Cover, weigh down and refrigerate 48 hours, then rinse and slice thin. Blitz a bunch of parsley with 80ml oil and strain. Slice 1 shallot thin and soak in 2 tbsp vinegar. Cut 4 slices rye into 16 squares, spread with crème fraîche mixed with horseradish, top with salmon and shallot, and splash herb oil on the plate.
Popcorn tossed half in purple-tinted white chocolate and half in green, mixed together in a big bowl.
Bat-shaped chips and black bean dip
for the Batwing flying past the moon
Corn tortillas cut with a bat-shaped cutter, fried at 180C, salted, with black bean dip blitzed with garlic, lime and chipotle.
M: Alfred serves roast beef at the very long table
Rib of beef salted overnight, roasted at 120C to 52C inside, rested and blasted at 260C for a crust. Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and red wine jus.
the old-world delis of Gotham's back streets

Piled-high corned beef, tangy sauerkraut and melted Swiss on rye with house Russian dressing, griddled in butter until crisp, with dill pickles. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp horseradish, 1 tbsp chopped pickles and a dash of Worcestershire for Russian dressing. Spread over 8 slices rye. Layer 4 slices with 125g shaved corned beef each, 60g drained sauerkraut and 2 slices Swiss cheese, then close. Butter the outsides and cook in a pan over medium heat with a weight on top for 4 minutes a side until crisp and melted. Halve and serve with pickles.
W: purple and green frosting, a little unhinged
Chocolate cake covered in purple buttercream with green piped swirls and a big crooked smile drawn across the top.
K: Alfred keeps the manor running, very properly

Earl Grey infused gin shaken with lemon, honey and egg white into a silky sour, served in fine coupes with a twist of lemon. Steep 2 Earl Grey tea bags in 200ml gin for 1 hour, then remove. Dissolve 3 tbsp honey in 2 tbsp hot water. Shake the gin, 100ml fresh lemon juice, the honey syrup and 2 egg whites hard without ice for 15 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and twist lemon peel over each.
T: Gotham turns 200. The Joker brings the balloons.
D: Batman faces the Joker as Gotham City celebrates its 200th birthday.
P: Serve dessert when the Joker throws his parade with the balloons.

title: Batman Returns
S: the Penguin eats his fish raw, we'll smoke ours
Dark rye buttered, topped with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, capers and dill, cut into fingers.
a little fish for the cat in the house

Whitebait tossed in seasoned flour and fried shatteringly crisp, with lemon, chilli salt and a black garlic aioli, piled high in paper cones. Rinse and pat dry 500g whitebait. Toss in 100g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika, salt and pepper and shake off the excess. Fry in batches at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp. Mash 2 cloves black garlic into 120g mayo with a squeeze of lemon. Toss the whitebait with chilli salt and serve in paper cones with lemon wedges and the aioli.
Score chestnuts with a cross, soak 20 minutes, roast at 220C for 20 minutes until the shells curl, wrap in a towel 5 minutes, peel warm.
M: Pork loin with crackling: score and dry the skin overnight, salt, roast at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C to 63C inside. Apple and sage sauce, roast potatoes.
his lair under the Gotham Zoo

Flathead in a crisp beer batter with double-fried chips, minty mushy peas and caper tartare, wrapped in newspaper like a Red Triangle Circus handbill. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Simmer 400g frozen peas 4 minutes, then mash with 30g butter and chopped mint. Whisk 150g plain flour and 50g cornflour with 300ml cold lager. Dip 700g flathead fillets in flour, then batter, and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with capers, gherkins and lemon for tartare.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with white buttercream, a tiny sugar Christmas tree on top and shredded coconut snow.
K: Selina's saucer of milk, grown up
Brandy, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla shaken with ice, strained into a coupe, grated nutmeg on top.
T: Christmas in Gotham. Penguins welcome.
D: Batman takes on the Penguin and Catwoman at Christmas time.
P: Serve the snacks when the Gotham Christmas tree lights up.

title: Superman
S: Corn boiled 5 minutes, charred on a grill, rolled in butter, salt and a little smoked paprika.
Perry White's newsroom running on sugar

Fluffy yeasted doughnuts fried golden and dipped in a vanilla glaze, half finished with red and blue sprinkles for the man in the cape. Warm 180ml milk with 30g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar, add 7g yeast and 1 egg and mix into 350g plain flour with a pinch of salt. Knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll 1.5cm thick, cut 10 rings and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 1 minute a side. Whisk 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp milk and 1 tsp vanilla, dip the warm doughnuts and finish half with red and blue sprinkles.
lime green, keep it away from the guest of honour
Lime jelly made firm with extra gelatine, set in a slab, cut into jagged crystal shards, piled on a plate with whipped cream.
M: Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside. Mashed potato and gravy.

Lobster meat folded through a rich sauce of shallot, white wine, cream, Dijon and gruyère, piled back into the shells and grilled bubbling and golden. Halve 2 cooked lobsters lengthways, remove the meat and cut into chunks, keeping the shells. Soften 2 finely chopped shallots in 30g butter, add 100ml white wine and reduce by half. Stir in 200ml cream and 1 tsp Dijon and simmer 3 minutes until thick, then add 60g grated gruyère and the lobster. Spoon back into the shells, top with 30g more gruyère and grill 4 minutes until golden. Serve with lemon and a green salad.
W: white and icy, like the crystals
Swiss meringue piped into tall jagged crystal shapes, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, dusted with a little edible glitter.
K: Espresso shaken with malted milk syrup and poured over ice and cold milk, topped with sweet cold foam and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 4 shots espresso. Stir 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp brown sugar into the hot coffee until dissolved, then cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, then pour the coffee over. Whisk 100ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar until just thick but pourable, spoon on top and dust with cocoa.
T: You'll believe a man can fly. And cook.
D: A baby from Krypton grows up to become Superman in Metropolis.
P: Serve the mains when Superman catches Lois on the helicopter.

title: The Rocketeer
S: the diner shaped like a bulldog
Thick onion rings soaked in buttermilk, dipped in beer batter, fried at 185C until puffed.
Coconut prawns: prawns in flour, egg and coconut panko, fried at 180C, with pineapple salsa.
Chaplin Field egg and bacon rolls

Soft milk rolls stuffed with creamy egg salad, crisp bacon, chives and a pinch of paprika, wrapped in wax paper like a pilot's lunch. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and chop. Mix with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard, 2 tbsp chives, salt and pepper. Grill 6 bacon rashers until crisp and crumble. Split 8 soft milk rolls, fill with egg salad, scatter with bacon and a pinch of paprika. Wrap each in wax paper and twist the ends.
M: Thick patty griddled to medium with melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato, pickles and a tangy special sauce on a toasted bun, double-fried chips alongside. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties and season. Griddle 4 minutes a side, add 2 slices cheddar each and cover 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Fry the chips at 190C for 3 minutes and salt. Toast 4 buns and build with sauce, lettuce, tomato, patty and pickles.
Jenny's big night out at the club
Chicken thighs marinated in pineapple juice, soy, ginger and garlic, grilled and glazed with the reduced marinade, coconut rice.
W: Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and a cherry, a sparkler lit at the table.
K: Bulldog Cafe root beer malt float
the counter at the Bulldog, after a good flight

Ice-cold root beer poured over vanilla ice cream in frosted mugs, with a spoon of malt powder stirred through for a creamy, foamy top. Put 4 mugs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream and 1 tsp malted milk powder to each. Slowly pour 250ml cold root beer down the side of each mug so the foam rises without spilling. Serve with long spoons and straws.
T: Flying high. Eating well.
D: A stunt pilot finds a jetpack and fights Nazi spies in 1938 Los Angeles.
P: Serve the mains when Cliff and Peevy eat at the Bulldog Cafe.

title: Dick Tracy
S: Breathless Mahoney sings at the Club Ritz
Devilled eggs (yolks whipped with mayo and Dijon) topped with salmon roe, and blanched asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto.
Tracy's trench coat in pastry form
Gougères: choux pastry (water, butter, flour, eggs) with gruyère and a pinch of turmeric for yellow, piped and baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
The Kid's diner fried pickle chips
the Kid's diner on the corner

Dill pickle chips in a crunchy cornmeal and panko crust, fried golden and served with a yellow mustard and buttermilk ranch for dunking. Drain 300g dill pickle chips and pat very dry. Whisk 2 eggs with 100ml buttermilk. Mix 60g cornmeal, 60g panko, 1 tsp paprika and pepper. Dip the pickles in flour, then the egg, then the crumb. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Mix 100g sour cream, 50ml buttermilk, 1 tbsp yellow mustard, chopped dill and chives with salt for the dip.
M: his usual order, between radio calls

Beef chuck braised low and slow with onion, carrot, red wine and stock until it falls apart, with buttery potatoes and a glossy gravy. Season a 1.5kg chuck roast and brown it all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 4 carrots in chunks and 3 garlic cloves. Pour in 250ml red wine and 500ml beef stock, add thyme and bay, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Lift out the meat and veg and boil the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour slurry until glossy.
eaten at the head of the table, like a boss
Pork and beef meatballs with soaked bread, egg and parmesan, browned, simmered an hour in San Marzano tomato sauce with basil, tossed with spaghetti, more parmesan.
W: Blind-baked shortcrust, lemon curd filling (lemon juice, zest, sugar, yolks, cornflour, butter), Italian meringue piled high and torched.
K: Breathless's table at the Club Ritz

Gin shaken hard with fresh lime and lime cordial until frosty, strained into chilled coupes with a thin lime wheel. Chill 4 coupes in the freezer for 15 minutes. Shake 200ml gin, 60ml fresh lime juice and 40ml lime cordial with plenty of ice for 15 seconds until the shaker frosts over. Strain into the coupes and float a thin lime wheel on each.
T: Big Boy's buffet.
D: A square-jawed detective takes on Big Boy Caprice's gangsters.
P: Serve the mains when Big Boy holds court at the Club Ritz.

title: The Mask
S: the hottest spot in Edge City
Coconut prawns (flour, egg, coconut panko, fried at 180C) with sweet chilli, and thin plantain chips fried crisp, on a silver tray.
the Mask twists balloon animals for the cops

Crisp sharp cheddar crackers cut into poodles, giraffes and dachshunds, dusted with smoked paprika, with a smoky tomato chutney for dunking. Pulse 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 100g plain flour and a pinch of salt until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes. Roll 4mm thick and cut with small animal cutters. Lay on a lined tray, dust with smoked paprika and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Cool on the tray and serve with tomato chutney.
the green face, in pastry form
Choux (water, butter, flour, eggs) beaten with gruyère and blitzed basil and spinach, piped and baked at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed.
M: Stanley's lunch break from Edge City Bank

Double smashed patties with melted cheddar, grilled onions, pickles and a smoky green chilli mayo on a toasted bun, as loud as a zoot suit. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 finely chopped pickled green chilli and a pinch of smoked paprika. Smash each ball flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and top with cheddar for 1 minute. Toast 4 buns and stack two patties each with onions, pickles and the green chilli mayo.
the dog gets the mask too
Rump steak seared hard and rested, garlic butter melting on top, double-fried chips. Milo gets the trimmings.
W: Bananas caramelised in butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, flambéed with dark rum at the table and spooned hot over vanilla ice cream with toasted pecans. Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a wide pan until bubbling. Add 4 bananas halved lengthways and cook 2 minutes, spooning the sauce over. Pour in 60ml dark rum and carefully light it with a long match, standing back. When the flames die down, spoon the bananas and sauce over 4 bowls of vanilla ice cream and scatter with 40g toasted pecans.
K: 30ml melon liqueur, 30ml vodka, lemonade and lime over ice, cocktail umbrella.
T: Smokin'.
D: A meek bank clerk finds a magic mask that turns him into a wild cartoon trickster.
P: Serve the snacks when the Mask dances at the Coco Bongo.

title: X-Men
S: Oats, puffed rice, honey, butter and peanut butter pressed into a tin, chilled and cut into bars.
the Canadian bar where Logan fights

Peanuts roasted with maple syrup, chilli, smoked paprika and sea salt until glassy and crunchy, served warm in a tin bucket on the bar. Heat the oven to 170C. Toss 400g raw peanuts with 3 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast 15 to 18 minutes, stirring twice, until deep golden. Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool 10 minutes so the glaze hardens. Break up and serve in a bucket.
Red and green grapes picked off the stem, rolled in lime juice and a little caster sugar, spread on a tray and frozen solid.
M: the cage fight bar in Canada
Double-fried chips, cheese curds and hot beef gravy poured over so the curds just soften.
Xavier's School lemon thyme roast chicken
the school's dinner table in Westchester

Dry-brined chicken with lemon and thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden, with crunchy roast potatoes, garlicky green beans and pan gravy. Salt a 1.8kg chicken and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Push 50g butter mashed with lemon zest and thyme under the breast skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, with 1kg halved potatoes in oil around it. Rest 10 minutes. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with butter and 1 sliced garlic clove.
W: Vanilla ice cream frozen extra hard in chilled bowls, a hot chocolate sauce poured over at the table so it sets into a shell.
K: Logan's rye and maple old fashioned
Logan's drink in the bar, no conversation

Canadian rye whisky stirred with maple syrup and bitters over one big ice cube, finished with a flamed orange twist. In a jug with ice, stir 240ml Canadian rye whisky, 4 tsp maple syrup and 8 dashes aromatic bitters for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into 4 heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over each glass, rub the rim and drop it in.
T: Mutants welcome.
D: Professor X and his students take on Magneto's Brotherhood.
P: Serve the snacks when Logan arrives at the school.

title: Watchmen
S: he eats them cold straight out of the tin
Cannellini beans warmed in olive oil with garlic, rosemary and chilli, crushed a little, piled on grilled sourdough. Serve one tin cold on the side for authenticity.
the Indian diner on Rorschach's corner

Shredded onion and chilli in a spiced chickpea batter, fried into crisp tangled bhajis with mint yoghurt and a sharp tamarind chutney. Thinly slice 3 onions and mix with 1 chopped green chilli, a handful of coriander, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp turmeric, half a tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 150g chickpea flour and about 80ml water to make a thick batter that coats the onions. Drop rough spoonfuls into oil at 175C and fry 4 minutes until crisp. Mix 150g yoghurt with chopped mint and serve with tamarind chutney.
M: Salt, pepper and smoked paprika brisket smoked low until it wobbles, sliced thick with pickles, white bread and a black coffee barbecue sauce. Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt, 2 tbsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Smoke or roast at 120C for about 10 hours until 95C inside, wrapping in baking paper at 70C. Rest 1 hour. Simmer 250ml barbecue sauce with 80ml strong black coffee and 1 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes. Slice the brisket thick and serve with the sauce, dill pickles and white bread.
the Indian diner Rorschach goes to
Chicken thighs in a curry of onion, ginger, garlic, garam masala, tomato and cream, simmered 30 minutes, basmati and naan.
W: yellow icing, one drop of red jam
Vanilla sugar cookies rolled 5mm, cut into rounds, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, iced yellow with a smiley face and a splash of jam.
K: Dan's kitchen late at night, Archie waiting downstairs

Coffee-infused bourbon stirred with maple and chocolate bitters over a big ice cube, finished with an orange twist and three coffee beans. Steep 2 tbsp coarsely ground coffee in 240ml bourbon for 30 minutes, then strain through a paper filter. In a jug with ice, stir the bourbon with 4 tsp maple syrup and 8 dashes chocolate or aromatic bitters for 30 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over one large cube each. Twist orange peel over each and float 3 coffee beans.
T: Who watches the snacks?
D: Retired superheroes investigate the murder of one of their own.
P: Serve the beans when Rorschach eats them cold from the tin.

title: Kick-Ass
S: Popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed while hot with melted butter, finely grated parmesan and cracked black pepper, in paper bags.
Bodega bacon, egg and cheese rolls
Dave's walk to school through New York

Soft rolls stuffed with folded fried egg, crisp bacon and melted American cheese, salt, pepper and hot sauce, wrapped in foil like the corner store does it. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Whisk 6 eggs with salt and pepper and cook as a thin omelette in 20g butter, folding it into 4 squares. Lay 2 slices American cheese on each square to melt. Split and toast 4 soft rolls, add the egg and cheese, then the bacon and a good shake of hot sauce. Wrap each in foil for 2 minutes so everything melts together.

Sweet rockmelon cubes wrapped in prosciutto with basil, a drizzle of aged balsamic and cracked pepper, on picks like a penthouse party. Peel and seed half a rockmelon and cut into 20 cubes. Tear 10 slices of prosciutto in half lengthways. Wrap each melon cube in a strip of prosciutto with a small basil leaf tucked inside and spear with a cocktail pick. Arrange on a platter, drizzle with 1 tbsp aged balsamic and olive oil and finish with cracked black pepper.
M: Atomic Comics New York pepperoni slice

Big thin-crust New York slices with garlicky tomato sauce, mozzarella and crisp pepperoni, folded to eat, with chilli flakes, parmesan and hot honey. Mix 500g bread flour, 325ml water, 2g yeast, 10g salt and 1 tbsp oil and refrigerate 24 hours. Divide into 2 balls and rest at room temperature for 2 hours. Heat the oven with a pizza steel at its highest setting for 45 minutes. Stretch each into a 35cm base, spread with 150ml passata mixed with garlic and oregano, top with 200g grated mozzarella and pepperoni. Bake 7 minutes. Cut into big slices and serve with chilli flakes, parmesan and hot honey.
the treat Big Daddy promises Mindy
Two thin patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles and burger sauce on toasted buns, double-fried chips alongside.
W: Mindy's reward for doing her training
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge (dark chocolate melted with cream), whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry in a tall glass.
K: Deep purple grape juice shaken with lime and fresh ginger, topped with soda over frozen grapes, served in small tumblers with a purple straw. Freeze 200g red grapes for 2 hours. Grate 2cm fresh ginger and squeeze the juice through a sieve into a jug. Add 500ml grape juice and the juice of 1 lime and stir. Fill 4 small tumblers with frozen grapes, pour in the grape mix and top each with 60ml soda water.
T: No powers. Just snacks.
D: A teen with no powers becomes a superhero and teams up with Hit-Girl and Big Daddy.
P: Serve the mains when Kick-Ass meets Hit-Girl.

title: The Incredibles
S: Puffed corn tossed in butter, cheddar powder, smoked paprika and a pinch of mild chilli, baked until toasty and orange like a baby on fire. Heat the oven to 160C. Melt 50g butter and toss with 150g puffed corn snacks. Mix 3 tbsp cheddar cheese powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp garlic powder and a small pinch of mild chilli powder, and shake it over the corn until coated. Spread on a tray and bake 5 minutes until toasty. Cool 5 minutes before serving.
Grapes picked off the stem, rolled in lime juice and caster sugar, spread on a tray and frozen solid for at least 3 hours.
Prawns butterflied, dredged in flour, egg and panko mixed with coconut, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, mango and chilli dip.
M: the dinner that turns into a fight
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and peas.
the fancy villain dinner Bob gets with Mirage

Eye fillet seared and rested with a glossy balsamic beef jus, creamy garlic potato gratin and buttered green beans with toasted almonds. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream warmed with 2 crushed garlic cloves, salt and thyme, and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Season 4 eye fillet steaks (200g each), sear 3 minutes a side and rest 5 minutes. Add 400ml beef stock and 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar to the pan and reduce to a glaze, then whisk in 20g butter. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with butter and 30g toasted flaked almonds.
W: Dark chocolate torte (chocolate, butter, eggs, sugar, almond meal) baked at 160C for 35 minutes, glazed with ganache, perfectly plain.
K: ice cold, super suit or not

Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and mint blended with lots of ice into a frosty slush, topped with fizzy lemonade and a lemon wheel. Add 150ml fresh lemon juice, 120ml sugar syrup, 10 mint leaves, 200ml cold water and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, leaving a little room, and top each with a splash of cold lemonade. Garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.
T: No capes. Plenty of dinner.
D: A family of undercover superheroes comes out of hiding to save the world.
P: Serve the mains at the chaotic family dinner.

title: The Avengers
S: Stark Tower seared tuna and wasabi bites
drinks at the top of the tower, before Loki arrives

Sesame-crusted tuna seared rare on crisp cucumber with wasabi mayo and pickled ginger, beside mini Yorkshires stuffed with rare beef and horseradish. Roll 300g sashimi tuna in sesame seeds and sear 30 seconds a side, then slice. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp wasabi. Top 16 thick cucumber rounds with mayo, tuna and pickled ginger. Whisk 2 eggs, 100g flour and 125ml milk, pour into a hot oiled mini muffin tin and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Fill with sliced rare roast beef and horseradish cream.
after the battle, round the corner from the shawarma place

Silky tahini hummus topped with sizzling cumin-spiced lamb mince, pine nuts and chilli oil, with warm flatbread for scooping. Blitz 2 drained 400g tins chickpeas with 100g tahini, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon, salt and 80ml ice water for 3 minutes until very smooth. Fry 250g lamb mince in oil until crisp, adding 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp paprika. Toast 30g pine nuts. Swirl the hummus onto a plate, spoon the hot lamb over, add pine nuts, chilli oil and parsley. Warm 4 flatbreads.
Mixed nuts tossed in honey, butter, thyme and sea salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon and lemon, grilled and sliced. Warm flatbread, toum (garlic, oil, lemon emulsified), pickles, tomato and parsley.
W: Sugar cookie rounds iced in concentric red and white rings with a blue centre and white star.
K: Ginger beer stirred with honey and lemon over ice, or real mead for the grown-ups.
T: Shawarma after the battle.
D: Earth's mightiest heroes team up to stop Loki's invasion of New York.
P: Serve the shawarma during the end credits, when the team eats in silence.

title: Iron Man
S: Dice sashimi tuna, dress with soy, sesame oil, lime and spring onion. Spoon onto wonton squares fried at 180C until crisp, a dot of smashed avocado and toasted sesame.
Dough of flour, Greek yoghurt, salt and baking powder rolled thin, cooked in a dry hot pan until blistered, brushed with garlic butter, hummus alongside.
M: the first thing he wants after the cave
Two smashed patties with American cheese, onion, pickles, mustard and ketchup on a soft toasted bun.
Pepper's dinner after a long day of Tony

Dry-brined rib eye seared and butter-basted, rested and sliced with punchy chimichurri and crisp smashed baby potatoes with garlic and rosemary. Salt 4 rib eye steaks and refrigerate uncovered overnight. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes with garlic and rosemary. Chop a bunch of parsley, 1 tbsp oregano, 2 garlic cloves and 1 red chilli and mix with 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Sear the steaks 3 minutes a side, basting with butter, and rest 8 minutes.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with a circle of blue buttercream and a white centre piped like the reactor.
K: Tony's bar in the Malibu workshop

Blended Scotch shaken with lemon and honey ginger syrup, poured over a big cube and finished with a float of smoky single malt and candied ginger. Simmer 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp water and 2cm sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Shake 200ml blended Scotch, 80ml fresh lemon juice and the syrup with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers over one large cube each. Float 10ml peaty single malt on each and garnish with a piece of candied ginger.
T: I am Iron Man. I am also hungry.
D: A billionaire weapons maker builds a suit of armour after being held captive.
P: Serve the cheeseburgers when Tony asks for one after getting home.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
S: Green plantains shaved thin and fried crisp, tossed in lime, chilli and smoked salt, with a creamy pickled jalapeño and coriander dip. Peel 3 green plantains and slice very thin on a mandoline. Fry in batches at 175C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Toss hot with the zest of 1 lime, half a tsp chilli powder and smoked salt. Blitz 150g sour cream with 3 tbsp pickled jalapeños, a handful of coriander and lime juice for the dip.
a pig who is also Spider-Man
Puff pastry spread with tomato, rolled up with ham, pineapple and mozzarella, then sliced into spirals and baked golden.
Beef mince chopped on the griddle with onions and melted American cheese, stuffed into hero rolls with lettuce, tomato, ketchup and mayo.
M: eaten like a hero who's let himself go
Double cheeseburger with crisp bacon, battered onion rings and barbecue sauce on a toasted bun, eaten in sweatpants.
the safe house under Aunt May's shed

Tall, fluffy buttermilk pancakes with whipped egg whites folded through, stacked with crispy bacon, salted butter, berries and warm maple syrup. Whisk 300g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Mix 450ml buttermilk, 2 egg yolks and 50g melted butter, stir into the dry mix and rest 15 minutes. Whip 2 egg whites to soft peaks and fold through. Cook ladlefuls in butter over medium heat until bubbles set, then flip. Grill 8 bacon rashers. Stack with butter, berries, bacon and maple syrup.
W: Brown butter choc chip cookie dough rested overnight, scooped big, baked at 180C for 11 minutes so the middles stay soft, flaky salt on top.
K: Miles's mum's Christmas, minus the rum
Coconut milk, condensed milk and evaporated milk blended with cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla, served ice cold in small glasses.
T: Anyone can wear the mask.
D: Teenager Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and meets spider-heroes from other universes.
P: Serve the snacks when Miles takes his leap of faith off the building.

title: The Breakfast Club
S: Salmon and avocado maki with salmon nigiri, soy, wasabi and pickled ginger, packed neatly into a bento box like it's Saturday detention at Shermer High. Rinse 400g sushi rice, cook with 480ml water, then fold through 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Lay rice over 3 nori sheets, add strips of salmon and avocado, roll tight with a mat and cut each into 8. Shape 8 small rice oblongs, dab with wasabi and top with sliced sashimi salmon. Pack into 4 bento boxes with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger.
the wrestler's lunch, three sandwiches deep

Toasted triple-decker of leg ham, Swiss and cheddar with mustard mayo and pickles, cut into fingers, with crunchy apple slices on the side. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard. Toast 12 slices white bread. Build 4 stacks of toast, sauce, 50g leg ham and a slice of Swiss, toast, sauce, 50g leg ham, a slice of cheddar and pickles, then toast. Press lightly, cut each into 3 fingers and pin with toothpicks. Slice 2 apples and toss with lemon juice to serve alongside.
he has no lunch, so share yours
A plate of crackers, cheese and salami left in the middle for anyone who forgot.
M: soup in a thermos, PB and J with the crusts cut off
Tomato soup (roasted tomatoes, onion, garlic and stock blitzed with cream) in a thermos, peanut butter and jam sandwiches with the crusts cut off.
her sugar and cereal sandwich, if you dare

Thick brioche dipped in vanilla custard, crusted in crushed sweet cereal and fried golden in butter, with whipped cream, berries and maple syrup. Whisk 4 eggs, 250ml milk, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of cinnamon. Crush 120g sweet corn cereal into coarse crumbs. Dip 8 thick slices brioche in the custard for 20 seconds a side, then press both sides into the cereal. Fry in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and crunchy. Serve with whipped cream, berries and maple syrup.
W: Melted dark chocolate and butter whisked into sugar and eggs, flour folded in, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pulled while the middle still wobbles.
K: Andrew's carton of milk, upgraded for Saturday detention

Fresh strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream and cold milk until thick and pink, topped with whipped cream and a fresh strawberry. Hull 250g strawberries, keeping 4 for garnish. Blend the rest with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 500ml cold milk and 1 tbsp caster sugar for 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses, top with whipped cream and a strawberry on the rim, and serve with straws.
T: Five strangers. One detention. Plenty of snacks.
D: Five very different students spend a Saturday detention together.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone unpacks their lunch.

title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
S: the ball game, where Ferris catches a foul ball

All-beef franks in steamed poppy seed buns dragged through the garden: mustard, bright relish, onion, tomato, pickle spear, sport peppers and celery salt. Simmer 8 all-beef franks for 5 minutes. Brush 8 hot dog buns with water, sprinkle with poppy seeds and steam 2 minutes until soft. Put a frank in each bun and top in this order: yellow mustard, sweet relish, chopped white onion, 2 tomato wedges, a dill pickle spear, 2 pickled peppers and a pinch of celery salt.
the snooty maître d' who doesn't believe him
Tiny gougères (choux with gruyère) piped and baked at 200C for 20 minutes, split and filled with a spoon of whipped goat's cheese and chives.
a slice of the Chicago day out
Buttery cornmeal dough pressed into a mini muffin tin, mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomato, baked at 210C for 18 minutes.
M: grilled sausages, peppers and onions, the reservation he steals
Italian sausages grilled slowly, capsicum and onion softened in the fat with oregano, piled into crusty rolls with hot mustard.
sauce on top, the Chicago way

Buttery cornmeal crust pressed up a deep tin, layered with mozzarella and a slab of fennel sausage, with chunky tomato, oregano and parmesan on top. Mix 350g plain flour, 50g cornmeal, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 60g melted butter and 230ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Press into a greased 25cm deep tin, up the sides. Layer 250g sliced mozzarella, then 400g Italian sausage meat pressed flat. Simmer 400g crushed tomatoes with garlic and oregano for 10 minutes and spread on top. Scatter 40g parmesan and bake at 220C for 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
W: lunch booked under the name Abe Froman
Choux pastry piped into small puffs, baked at 200C until hollow, filled with vanilla cream and topped with warm chocolate sauce.
K: lunch at Chez Quis as the Sausage King of Chicago
Fresh lemon and sugar topped with sparkling mineral water, served in wine glasses like a fancy lunch.
T: One day off. Make it delicious.
D: A high schooler fakes sick for a day of adventure in Chicago with his best mate and girlfriend.
P: Serve the mains when Ferris gets a table at Chez Quis as the Sausage King of Chicago.

title: Sixteen Candles
S: Ginny's wedding, the reason everyone forgot
Smoked salmon on cucumber rounds and mini quiches (shortcrust cases, egg, cream, ham and chives baked at 180C for 15 minutes).
Shermer High dance cinnamon pretzel bites
the geek in the gym at the school dance

Soft pretzel bites dipped in a bicarb bath and baked deep brown, rolled in butter and cinnamon sugar, with a warm salted caramel dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes, cut into 3cm bites and dip in 2 litres boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss in 50g melted butter, then 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Warm 150ml store-bought caramel sauce with a pinch of salt for dipping.
he's having a very big night
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until the bottoms crisp, a splash of water and a lid for 4 minutes, soy and black vinegar dip.
M: the house is full of grandparents

Beef chuck braised for hours with onion, carrot and stock until it falls apart, with buttery potatoes and a rich gravy from the pot. Season a 1.5kg chuck roast and brown it all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 4 carrots in chunks and 3 garlic cloves, then 750ml beef stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste, thyme and bay. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Lift out the meat and veg and thicken the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water.
the reception after the very strange wedding
Chicken thighs browned, braised with white wine, mushrooms, thyme and a splash of cream for 35 minutes. Rice pilaf.
W: make a wish over it, finally
Two layers of vanilla butter cake baked at 170C for 30 minutes, filled and covered in pink strawberry buttercream, exactly sixteen candles.
K: the punch bowl at the dance

Pineapple, orange and cranberry juice with passionfruit, lime and fizzy lemonade, poured over ice with floating orange slices and frozen berries. In a big punch bowl, mix 500ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice, 300ml cranberry juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Chill. Just before serving, add 1 litre cold lemonade, plenty of ice, 1 sliced orange and 150g frozen mixed berries. Ladle into cups.
T: Everyone forgot. Except dessert.
D: Samantha's family forgets her 16th birthday because of her sister's wedding.
P: Serve dessert at the very end, when Jake has the birthday cake waiting.

title: Pretty in Pink
S: Iona's Trax counter pink candied almonds
Iona's counter at the record store

Almonds roasted in a crackly raspberry sugar coat with a pinch of sea salt, tumbled with salty pretzels into a bowl by the record player. Heat 100g caster sugar and 50ml water until dissolved, then add 250g whole almonds and stir over medium heat for 8 minutes until the sugar crystallises and coats them. Keep stirring until some of the sugar melts glossy again. Off the heat, toss with 2 tbsp freeze-dried raspberry powder and a pinch of salt. Spread on baking paper to cool, then mix with 100g salted pretzels.
pink and sweet, like his big moment
Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate tinted pink with freeze-dried raspberry powder, spread to set.

Seasoned sushi rice rolled around salmon, cucumber and Japanese-style mayo with a hit of sriracha, sliced and served with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger. Rinse 400g sushi rice, cook with 480ml water, then fold through 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp sriracha. Spread rice over 4 nori sheets, lay strips of 300g sashimi salmon and cucumber and a line of spicy mayo along the middle, then roll tight with a mat. Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife and serve with soy, wasabi and ginger.
M: Beef chuck braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, garlic and stock, potatoes for the last hour.

Toasted triple-decker of roast turkey, crisp bacon, avocado, lettuce, tomato and lemon mayo, pinned and cut into triangles with shoestring fries. Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes and salt. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with lemon zest. Toast 12 slices white bread. Build each club as toast, mayo, 100g sliced turkey and lettuce, toast, mayo, 2 rashers bacon, sliced avocado and tomato, toast. Pin with 4 toothpicks and cut into triangles.
W: pink and white, cut and stitched together like her dress
Half vanilla, half strawberry sponge baked side by side, joined with buttercream, covered half pink and half white with a piped seam.
K: the prom Andie walks into on her own
Cranberry and pineapple juice with lemonade and orange slices in a big glass bowl, frozen raspberries floating on top.
T: Pink lemonade. Obviously.
D: A girl from the wrong side of town falls for a rich kid, while her best mate Duckie pines for her.
P: Serve the snacks when Duckie dances on the record shop counter.

title: Wayne's World
S: Fluffy little yeasted doughnuts fried golden, rolled in caster sugar and piped full of raspberry jam, served warm in a cardboard box. Warm 180ml milk with 30g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar, add 7g yeast and 1 egg and mix into 350g plain flour with a pinch of salt. Knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into 20 balls and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 2 minutes, turning, until golden. Roll in caster sugar while warm, then poke a hole in each and pipe in raspberry jam.
headbanging in the back seat of the Mirthmobile

Big batch of popcorn tossed in butter, cheddar powder, chilli and smoked paprika, mixed with salty pretzels and passed round the back seat. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake over medium heat until the popping slows. Melt 60g butter and pour over the popcorn. Mix 4 tbsp cheddar cheese powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and half a tsp chilli powder and toss through until coated. Mix in 100g small pretzels and serve in a big bowl.
Wayne refuses to do product placement, while holding the box
Mini pepperoni pizzas on rounds of dough, baked at 230C for 8 minutes, presented to the camera with a cheesy grin.
M: eaten in Garth's Pacer, label facing out

Pepperoni and mushroom pizza: thin sauce, low-moisture mozzarella, pepperoni and sliced mushroom, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares. Stretch 500g dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 minutes and cut into squares.

Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, pickled jalapeños, diced onion and a stripe of mustard. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 25 minutes. Griddle 8 franks for 6 minutes until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli and grated cheddar and grill 1 minute to melt. Top with jalapeños, diced onion and mustard.
W: Choux dough piped in rings onto baking paper, fried at 180C until puffed, dipped in a thin honey glaze.
K: Cold cola poured over vanilla ice cream with a splash of cherry syrup, foaming up in a big glass with a cocktail cherry on top. Chill 4 big glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add 15ml cherry syrup and 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Slowly pour 250ml cold cola down the side of each glass so the foam rises without spilling. Top with a cocktail cherry and serve with straws, label facing the camera.
T: Party time. Excellent.
D: Two metalhead friends get their public access cable show picked up by a slick producer.
P: Serve the snacks when Bohemian Rhapsody comes on in the Mirthmobile.

title: Clueless
S: Cher keeps her dad off the fatty food

Toasted baguette rounds with whipped lemon ricotta, cold-smoked salmon, pickled red onion, capers and dill, a crack of black pepper on top. Slice 1 baguette into 20 thin rounds, brush with 2 tbsp olive oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes until crisp. Beat 200g ricotta with the zest of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Thinly slice half a red onion and soak it in 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with 1 tsp caster sugar for 15 minutes. Spread each round with ricotta, top with a fold of 200g smoked salmon, a few onion rings and capers, then finish with dill and pepper.
the party in the Valley Cher crosses the freeway for

Corn chips with guacamole (avocado mashed with lime, onion, coriander and chilli) and a fresh salsa of diced tomato, onion and lime. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes, finely chopped onion, coriander and a little chilli. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion and lime juice for salsa. Serve both with a 300g bag of corn chips.
Soft pretzels brushed with melted butter, rolled in cinnamon sugar, warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, with a cream cheese icing dip.
M: Mel's grilled snapper with salsa verde
Cher's orders for her dad, grilled fish and no fat

Snapper fillets grilled skin side down until the skin crackles, a sharp parsley, caper and lemon salsa verde, and a crunchy green salad with avocado. Pat 4 snapper fillets (about 160g each) dry and score the skin. Chop 1 bunch parsley, half a bunch mint, 1 tbsp capers and 1 garlic clove, then mix with 100ml olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Heat a heavy pan over high heat with 1 tbsp oil, lay the fish in skin side down, press for 10 seconds and cook 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute. Toss 150g mixed leaves, 1 sliced Lebanese cucumber and 1 sliced avocado with a little of the salsa. Serve the fish with salsa verde spooned over.
way harsh, Tai, but she's a project

Sushi rice in bowls with salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger, soy and sesame dressing. Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Top bowls with 400g sliced sashimi salmon, sliced avocado, cucumber, 200g edamame and pickled ginger. Dress with soy mixed with a little sesame oil.
W: pretty from far away, a big mess up close

Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, cooled, piped with pastel strawberry and vanilla buttercream and finished with sprinkles. Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, blend some with mashed strawberry for pink, pipe and add sprinkles.
K: Rodeo Drive mango and strawberry smoothie

Ripe mango, strawberries and banana blitzed with fresh orange juice and ice into a thick, bright sunset smoothie, served in tall glasses with striped straws. Peel and chop 1 large mango and hull 250g strawberries. Put them in a blender with 1 banana, 500ml cold orange juice, 100g Greek yoghurt and 2 cups of ice. Blend on high for 45 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses, perch a strawberry on each rim and serve with striped straws.
T: As if.
D: A popular Beverly Hills teen plays matchmaker and gives a new girl a makeover.
P: Serve the mains when Cher gives Tai her makeover.

title: Dazed and Confused
S: the hangout with the pool tables

Salted peanuts and pretzel twists roasted in chilli butter, smoked paprika and a little brown sugar until glossy and crunchy, served warm in paper cups. Melt 50g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce. Toss with 250g salted roasted peanuts and 150g pretzel twists on a lined tray. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring once halfway, until the coating is dry and glossy. Cool for 10 minutes so they crisp up, then tip into paper cups.
the party under the moon tower
Thick-cut chips with French onion dip: onions caramelised slowly for 40 minutes, cooled, folded into sour cream with salt and chives.
peanut butter pretzels for the seniors' paddles
Pretzel rods dipped in smooth peanut butter warmed with a little honey, then half-dipped in melted milk chocolate, set on baking paper.
M: Texas salt and pepper brisket with pickles
Texas in 1976, the last day of school

Brisket rubbed with coarse salt and cracked pepper, roasted low for ten hours until it wobbles, sliced thick on white bread with pickles, onion and barbecue sauce. Rub a 2.5kg beef brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked black pepper and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast fat side up on a rack at 120C for 9 to 10 hours until the thickest part reaches 95C. Wrap in foil and baking paper and rest 1 hour. Slice thick against the grain and serve on soft white bread with sliced dill pickles, thin raw onion and 250ml smoky barbecue sauce.
Thin beef steaks dipped in seasoned flour and egg, shallow fried Texas style and smothered in peppery cream gravy.
W: Last day of '76 sweet tea ice blocks

Strong black tea sweetened while hot, lemon juice stirred in, cooled and frozen in moulds with sticks for at least 6 hours. Steep 4 black tea bags in 750ml boiling water for 5 minutes. Stir in 100g sugar while hot, add the juice of a lemon and cool. Pour into ice block moulds, add sticks and freeze at least 6 hours.
K: the keg party out at the moon tower

Ice-cold lager poured over lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire in a chilli salt rimmed glass, a lime wedge on the side. Mix 1 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a saucer. Rub the rims of 4 pint glasses with a lime wedge and dip in the salt. Fill with ice. Add to each glass 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 3 dashes hot sauce and 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce. Top each slowly with 330ml cold lager, stir once and serve with a lime wedge.
T: Last day of school. Nobody's going home.
D: On the last day of school in 1976, Texas teens party at the moon tower.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone gathers at the Moon Tower party.

title: Napoleon Dynamite
S: kept in your pocket for later
Grate parboiled potatoes, squeeze dry, season with salt and onion powder, shape into little cylinders, freeze 30 minutes, fry at 180C until golden and crisp.
Bake small potatoes, halve and scoop, brush with butter, crisp at 220C, fill with cheddar and bacon, bake again, sour cream and chives.
M: cheese, tortilla, done properly in a pan
Flour tortillas filled with grated cheddar and Monterey Jack, folded, cooked in a dry pan over medium heat until golden and melted. Salsa and sour cream.
Uncle Rico's rump steak and corn
the steak Rico throws at Napoleon from the van

Rump steak seared hard in a smoking pan, rested and sliced, with corn on the cob in paprika butter and a pile of crispy smashed potatoes. Season 4 rump steaks (about 220g each) with salt and pepper 30 minutes ahead. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and roll in 50g butter mixed with 1 tsp paprika. Sear the steaks in a smoking hot pan with 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side for medium rare, rest 5 minutes, slice and serve with the corn and potatoes.
W: Vanilla cake baked in a dome with a hollow centre filled with lollies, covered in bright buttercream stripes so it spills when cut.
K: FFA blue ribbon chocolate malt shake
Napoleon judges the milk at the FFA contest

Cold full cream milk blended thick with chocolate ice cream, malted milk powder and a pinch of salt, topped with whipped cream and chocolate shavings. Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and a pinch of salt in a blender. Blend for 30 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate 20g dark chocolate over each.
T: Tater tots, gosh.
D: An awkward Idaho teen helps his friend Pedro run for class president.
P: Serve the tater tots when Napoleon pulls some out of his pocket in class.

title: The Lost Boys
S: the murder capital of the world
Thin fries soaked, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, tossed with garlic salt and parsley, in paper cones.
Frog brothers' roast garlic bean dip
the vampire hunters stock up on garlic

Silky cannellini dip loaded with a whole head of roasted garlic, lemon and olive oil, topped with chilli oil and parsley, with toasted pita chips. Wrap 1 whole garlic bulb in foil and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Cut 3 pita breads into wedges, brush with olive oil and bake for 8 minutes until crisp. Squeeze the soft garlic into a food processor with 2 drained 400g tins cannellini beans, the juice of 1 lemon, 60ml olive oil and salt, then blitz until smooth with a splash of water. Spread in a bowl and top with 1 tbsp chilli oil and chopped parsley.
Baguette split, spread with butter mashed with lots of garlic, parsley and salt, wrapped in foil and baked at 200C for 12 minutes, then opened for 3.
M: the noodles that look a lot like worms
Lo mein: fresh egg noodles wok-tossed with chicken, cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts, oyster sauce, soy and sesame. Fried rice alongside.
dinner at Grandpa's place in Santa Carla

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky brown sugar tomato glaze, sliced thick over buttery mashed potato with minted peas and gravy. Mix 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread over the top. Bake at 180C for 60 minutes and rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Cook 400g frozen peas with mint and butter. Slice the meatloaf over the mash with peas and gravy.
W: Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of bicarb, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.
K: Holy water cucumber and lime fizz
the squirt guns full of holy water

Crushed cucumber, lime and mint shaken with a little sugar syrup and topped with soda water, served in small glass bottles with a cross on the label. Muddle half a Lebanese cucumber, chopped, with the juice of 3 limes, a handful of mint and 60ml sugar syrup in a jug. Strain into 4 small glass bottles or tall glasses filled with ice. Top each with 150ml chilled soda water and a thin cucumber ribbon. Draw a little cross on paper tags and tie them round the necks.
T: Sleep all day. Party all night.
D: A teenager moves to Santa Carla and falls in with a gang of teenage vampires.
P: Serve the noodles when David makes Michael see his rice as maggots.

title: Stand by Me
S: the night in the woods on the hike
Big marshmallows toasted on sticks over the fire until blistered, dipped in melted dark chocolate and pressed between digestive biscuits.
Milo Pressman's junkyard and his dog
Ham and cheddar on buttered white bread with mustard and a few pickles, wrapped tight in wax paper for the walk.
the campfire debate over the one food you'd eat forever

Soft cherry gummies made with real cherry juice and gelatine, rolled in sour sugar, the kind of lolly the boys argue about by the fire. Heat 250ml cherry juice with 80g caster sugar until dissolved. Sprinkle 30g powdered gelatine over 100ml cold cherry juice, leave 5 minutes, then stir into the hot juice until clear. Add 1 tbsp lemon juice and pour into a lightly oiled 20cm square tin. Chill 3 hours until firm. Cut into squares and roll in 50g caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp citric acid.
M: camping out by the tracks for the night

Smoky franks charred in a hot skillet, tucked into soft buns with sticky onion relish, mustard and crunchy pickles. Slice 3 onions thinly and cook in 30g butter over low heat for 25 minutes until jammy, then add 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp cider vinegar and cook 2 minutes more. Score 8 franks and cook in a hot cast iron pan for 6 minutes, turning, until blistered. Warm 8 hot dog buns in the pan. Fill each bun with a frank, a spoon of onion relish, mustard and sliced pickles.
the ground beef Gordie buys at the general store
Beef mince seasoned with salt and pepper, shaped into thick patties, cooked over coals or a hot pan, eaten in bread with fried onions.
W: the pie-eating contest, minus the ending
Blueberries with sugar, lemon and cornflour in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled before slicing.
K: the general store before the long walk

Ice-cold sarsaparilla poured slowly over vanilla ice cream in chilled glasses so it foams to the top, with a long spoon and a straw. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each glass. Pour 300ml cold sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each glass, letting the foam settle before topping up. Serve straight away with a straw and a long spoon.
T: The summer we went looking for dinner.
D: Four boys set off on a hike to find a dead body.
P: Serve dessert when Gordie tells the pie-eating contest story at the campfire.

title: Dirty Dancing
S: Kellerman's devilled eggs and salmon rye
the guests' dining room at Kellerman's

Creamy devilled eggs dusted with paprika next to rye toasts with dill cream cheese and smoked salmon, served on a silver tray like 1963. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, salt and a dash of hot sauce, pipe back in and dust with paprika. Toast 6 slices rye bread and cut into quarters. Mix 125g cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest, spread on the toasts and top with 150g smoked salmon and a sprig of dill.
Ice-cold watermelon cut into thick wedges, topped with crumbled feta, torn mint, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of flaky salt.
Staff cabin onion dip and pretzels
the after-hours dance party in the staff cabins

Pretzels and salty potato chips with a dip of slow-caramelised onions folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives and a dash of Worcestershire. Slice 2 brown onions thinly and cook in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown and jammy. Cool and chop finely. Beat 250g sour cream with 100g cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and salt, then fold in the onions and chopped chives. Chill 30 minutes. Serve with 200g pretzels and a 170g bag of potato chips.
M: Brisket braised at 150C for 4 hours on onions with stock, tomato paste and paprika, sliced, with the juices.
where the real dancing happens after hours

Two thin beef patties smashed on a hot griddle with American cheese, onion, pickles and mustard in a toasted soft bun, with a pile of crinkle-cut chips. Bake 750g frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls. Heat a griddle or heavy pan until smoking, smash each ball thin with a spatula, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and lay a slice of American cheese on top for 1 minute. Toast 4 burger buns. Stack two patties in each bun with finely diced onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.
W: she carried a watermelon, now she gets to eat one
Blend watermelon with lime and sugar syrup, strain, churn or freeze and scrape every 30 minutes.
K: the end of summer show at Kellerman's

Pineapple and orange juice with fresh ginger, lime and ginger ale over ice, loaded with sliced fruit and mint in a big glass punch bowl. Grate a 3cm piece of ginger into a punch bowl with the juice of 2 limes and 1 tbsp caster sugar and stir to dissolve. Add 1L pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice and chill for 1 hour. Just before serving add 1L cold ginger ale, a tray of ice, 1 sliced orange, a handful of pineapple chunks and torn mint.
T: Nobody puts dessert in a corner.
D: A teen falls for the dance instructor at a family resort in the Catskills.
P: Serve dessert at the final dance.

title: Fast Times at Ridgemont High
S: delivered straight to Mr. Hand's class
Rounds of pizza dough topped with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 230C for 8 minutes, served in a pizza box.
Food court pretzels with cheddar sauce

Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed until crisp outside, with a hot, smooth cheddar sauce and yellow mustard for dunking. Brush 4 soft pretzels with 30g melted butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk in a saucepan until steaming, then take off the heat and stir in 200g grated cheddar and half a tsp mustard powder until smooth. Pour into 4 paper cups and serve with the pretzels and a squeeze of yellow mustard.
Captain Hook flathead bites and chips
Brad's job at the fish and chips shop, in the pirate hat

Flathead strips in crisp beer batter with skin-on chips, chunky tartare sauce and lemon, served in paper cones like the shop on the strip. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, drain, then fry again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 200g plain flour with 1 tsp baking powder, salt and 300ml cold beer. Cut 500g flathead fillets into strips, dust in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, dill and lemon juice. Serve in paper cones with lemon wedges.
M: Spicoli orders pizza straight to Mr Hand's class

A big New York style pie with tangy tomato sauce, stretchy mozzarella, cupped pepperoni and mushrooms, finished with chilli flakes, oregano and parmesan. Put a pizza steel or stone in the oven at the highest setting for 45 minutes. Stretch 2 balls of pizza dough (250g each) into thin 30cm rounds. Spread each with 100g crushed tomato seasoned with salt, oregano and garlic. Top with 125g grated mozzarella, 60g sliced pepperoni and 80g sliced mushrooms. Bake each for 7 to 8 minutes until blistered. Finish with grated parmesan, oregano and chilli flakes and cut into big slices.
the burger joint at the mall
Thick chuck patty, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles on a toasted sesame bun, fries alongside.
W: Food court brown butter choc chip cookies
the cookie stand at the food court

Big soft cookies made with brown butter dough rested overnight, chunky with dark choc chips, crisp at the edges and gooey in the middle. Cook 150g butter until it smells nutty and goes golden, then cool for 15 minutes. Beat with 200g brown sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 250g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb soda, a pinch of salt and 200g dark choc chips. Cover and chill overnight. Scoop 10 big balls onto lined trays and bake at 180C for 11 minutes, then cool on the tray for 10 minutes.
K: the mall food court, all summer
Strawberries blended with milk, vanilla and ice into a frothy food court shake.
T: Dude, that's my pizza.
D: A year in the life of students at Ridgemont High in California.
P: Serve the pizza when Spicoli has it delivered to history class.

title: Grease
S: Double-fried shoestring fries smothered in beef chilli and melted cheddar sauce, topped with diced onion and pickled jalapeños, in red-checked paper boats. Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and soak 1 hour, then dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, drain, then at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp and salt them. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 onion, add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder and 200g tomato passata and simmer 15 minutes. Warm 200ml evaporated milk and melt in 150g grated cheddar. Pile fries into paper boats with chilli, cheese sauce, diced onion and jalapeños.
Danny's sad song at the drive-in

Fresh popcorn coated in crunchy butter toffee with a pinch of sea salt and roasted peanuts, served in striped paper bags like the drive-in snack bar. Pop 120g kernels in 2 tbsp coconut oil in a covered pot, shaking, and tip into a large bowl. Melt 100g butter with 150g brown sugar and 3 tbsp golden syrup, boil 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb soda and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn with 100g roasted peanuts and toss well. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break up.
Pink coconut ice: desiccated coconut, condensed milk and icing sugar pressed in two layers, one tinted pink, set and cut into squares.
M: the hangout where Frenchy dreams of beauty school
Thin smashed patties, American cheese, onion, pickles, mustard and ketchup on a soft toasted bun, 1950s style.
the dancing hot dog cartoon at the drive-in

Griddled franks in steamed buns smothered in beef chilli, yellow mustard, diced onion and grated cheddar, served in paper trays with a stack of napkins. Brown 400g beef mince in a pan, add 1 diced onion, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and 250ml tomato passata and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes, then sear on a hot griddle until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns over the frank water for 1 minute. Fill each bun with a frank, a spoon of chilli, mustard, diced raw onion and 100g grated cheddar between them.
W: the dream sequence at the Frosty Palace
Vanilla ice cream, strawberry sauce, hot fudge, whipped cream and a cherry in a tall sundae glass.
K: Cherry syrup and cola poured over a scoop of vanilla ice cream in a tall glass, a cherry on top.
T: Grease is the word. Burgers are the meal.
D: Two summer lovers meet again at Rydell High.
P: Serve the burgers at the Frosty Palace.

title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
S: the motel room they're forced to share
Salted peanuts, pretzels, chocolate bars and beef jerky tipped into a bowl, like the motel vending machine.
Del's sample case of curtain rings
Onions sliced into rings, soaked in buttermilk, dipped in beer batter, fried at 185C until puffed and golden.
Truck stop smoky pepper beef jerky
the long haul across the Midwest

Thin strips of topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and smoked paprika, dried slowly in the oven until chewy, finished with cracked pepper. Freeze 600g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick with the grain. Mix 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp cracked black pepper. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry, lay on wire racks over trays and dry at 75C with the oven door slightly open for 3 to 4 hours until leathery but bendy. Cool and store in a jar.
M: they finally make it home for Thanksgiving
Turkey breast brined and roasted at 170C to 70C, sliced, in soft slider buns with cranberry sauce, a square of baked stuffing and a spoon of gravy.
the bus ride to St Louis after the train dies

A thick chuck patty griddled to medium with melted cheddar, grilled onions, pickles and mustard in a toasted bun, with a stack of beer-battered onion rings. Shape 700g chuck mince into 4 thick patties and season well. Cook 1 sliced onion on the griddle with butter for 10 minutes. Griddle the patties 4 minutes a side, lay a slice of cheddar on each and cover for 1 minute. Toast 4 burger buns. Build with grilled onions, pickles and mustard. Serve with 500g frozen beer-battered onion rings baked at 220C for 15 minutes.
W: Roast pumpkin purée whisked with eggs, brown sugar, cream, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes. Whipped cream.
K: Home for Thanksgiving apple cider punch
Neal finally walks in the door for Thanksgiving

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange, spiked with bourbon for the grown-ups, served warm in mugs with a cinnamon stick. Put 1.5L cloudy apple juice, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 1 sliced orange and 2 tbsp brown sugar in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer and keep it there for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into a jug. Pour into 4 mugs, add 30ml bourbon to each adult mug, and serve with a fresh cinnamon stick.
T: Three days to get home. Snacks for every leg.
D: An ad man and a chatty shower curtain ring salesman try to get home for Thanksgiving.
P: Serve the snacks when Del pulls out his shower curtain rings.

title: National Lampoon's Vacation
S: Family Truckster sweet and salty trail mix
chips and lollies in the back seat

Honey-roasted peanuts, pretzels and cornflakes baked in butter and brown sugar, tossed through with chocolate buttons and dried cranberries for the back seat. Melt 60g butter with 60g brown sugar and 2 tbsp honey. Toss with 200g peanuts, 150g pretzel twists and 60g cornflakes on a lined tray with a pinch of salt. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway. Cool completely, then toss through 150g chocolate buttons and 100g dried cranberries. Pack into paper bags or a lidded box.
Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes, mustard.
Kansas cheese and chive corn fritters
the drive through Kansas corn country

Sweet corn fritters with cheddar and chives, fried crisp and golden, with a smoky chipotle sour cream for dipping. Mix 2 cups corn kernels (from 3 cobs) with 150g self-raising flour, 2 eggs, 125ml milk, 100g grated cheddar, chopped chives and salt. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Drop in heaped tablespoons and fry 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper. Mix 200g sour cream with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime for dipping.
M: Burnt ends: brisket point cubed, smoked or roasted, tossed in sweet barbecue sauce and brown sugar, back in the oven until sticky.
W: the park, finally, if it's open

Crisp apples on sticks dipped in glassy red toffee that cracks when you bite it, with a bag of fairy floss on the side. Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C, then add a few drops of red colouring. Dip and twirl the apples and set on baking paper. Serve with a bag of fairy floss.
K: the Family Truckster across the country

Fresh lemon juice and strawberries blended with sugar syrup and topped with soda water, poured from a big ice-packed thermos into tin cups. Blend 250g strawberries with 150ml lemon juice (about 5 lemons) and 150ml sugar syrup until smooth. Strain into a jug. Add 1L cold water and 500ml soda water and stir. Pour into a large thermos packed with ice or a jug full of ice, with sliced strawberries and lemon.
T: Holiday road. Holiday food.
D: The Griswolds drive cross-country in the Family Truckster to get to Walley World.
P: Serve the snacks when they finally reach Walley World and find it closed.

title: The Blues Brothers
S: Aretha's diner, where Matt quits the band to rejoin
Cornmeal and flour with buttermilk, egg, grated onion and a pinch of sugar, spooned into 175C oil and fried until golden. Hot sauce butter to dip.
behind the chicken wire, both kinds of music
Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and cayenne, served in a tin bucket.
M: Jake's order at the Soul Food Cafe
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, double-dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside. Pile them high, all four.
Soul Food Cafe smothered chops and greens
Aretha's diner, where Elwood just wants dry white toast

Thick pork chops browned and simmered in onion gravy, with smoky ham hock collard greens and buttered white toast to mop the plate. Simmer 1 smoked ham hock in 1.5L water with 1 onion for 60 minutes. Add 2 bunches shredded silverbeet or kale, 1 tbsp cider vinegar and chilli flakes and cook 20 minutes. Season 4 thick pork chops, dust in flour and brown in oil 3 minutes a side, then remove. Cook 2 sliced onions in the pan 8 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 500ml chicken stock. Return the chops, cover and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with the greens and buttered toast.
W: Sister Mary Stigmata keeps a ruler handy
Plain Scottish shortbread cut into dead-straight fingers, pricked in neat rows and dusted with sugar.
K: Soul Food Cafe peach sweet tea
four fried chickens need something cold alongside

Strong black tea brewed with sugar and ripe peaches, chilled hard and poured over ice with lemon and mint, a proper Southern diner jug. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 120g caster sugar. Blend 2 ripe peaches (or 400g tinned peaches, drained) with 250ml cold water and strain into the tea. Add 500ml cold water and chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over glasses of ice with lemon slices and a sprig of mint.
T: We're on a mission from food.
D: Two brothers reunite their blues band to save their childhood orphanage.
P: Serve the mains when they walk into the Soul Food Cafe.

title: Rain Man
S: Cubes of cheddar, salami and cherry tomato speared on toothpicks, laid out in neat rows of exactly ten.
Pecan cheddar cheese balls on toothpicks
everything in neat rows, the way Raymond likes it

Bite-size balls of sharp cheddar, cream cheese, spring onion and Worcestershire rolled in toasted pecans, each speared on a toothpick and lined up in rows. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g finely grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely chopped spring onions, 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce and a pinch of cayenne. Chill 30 minutes until firm. Toast 100g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes and chop finely. Roll the mix into 24 small balls and coat in the pecans. Chill 1 hour, push a toothpick into each and line them up in neat rows.
Caesars Palace after the card counting
Prawns poached and iced, piled on crushed ice with cocktail sauce and lemon, buffet style.
M: maple syrup on the table before the pancakes
Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in butter until bubbles set, stacked. The maple syrup goes on the table first. Non-negotiable.
Vegas sirloin with loaded baked potato
the high-roller night in Vegas after the card counting

Thick sirloin seared hard and finished with garlic butter, a jacket potato loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives, and creamed spinach. Rub 4 potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 60 minutes. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and stir into 150ml cream simmered with garlic and nutmeg. Season 4 sirloin steaks and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, add 40g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. Split the potatoes and load with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives.
W: Fresh strawberry jelly with vanilla cream
Raymond's routine, the same dessert done the same way

Ruby jelly set from real strawberry purée, layered in glasses with sliced strawberries and topped with vanilla bean cream and a crumble of shortbread. Blend 500g hulled strawberries with 100g caster sugar and the juice of 1 lemon, then strain. Soak 4 gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes, squeeze and dissolve in 150ml of the purée warmed in a pan. Stir into the rest of the purée and pour into 4 glasses over a few sliced strawberries. Chill 4 hours. Whip 200ml cream with 1 tsp vanilla paste and 1 tbsp icing sugar, spoon on and crumble 2 shortbread fingers over.
K: the maple syrup goes on the table before the pancakes

Bourbon shaken hard with real maple syrup, lemon and mint, poured over crushed ice and finished with a slice of apple. Put 8 mint leaves, 15ml maple syrup and 20ml lemon juice in a shaker for each drink and press gently with a muddler. Add 50ml bourbon and a scoop of ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 rocks glasses packed with crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig and a thin apple slice. Totals are 200ml bourbon, 60ml maple syrup and 80ml lemon juice.
T: Maple syrup on the table before the pancakes.
D: A selfish car dealer discovers he has an autistic brother.
P: Serve the pancakes with the syrup on the table before the pancakes arrive.

title: Dumb and Dumber
S: chips eaten in a van shaped like a dog
Potato chips, cheese puffs and dog-bone shaped pretzels tipped into a big bowl for the road.
Thick onion rings soaked in buttermilk 30 minutes, dipped in beer batter, fried at 185C until puffed and golden, salted.
Petey's seeded crackers and herb cream
for Petey, whose head has fallen off

Homemade seeded crackers loaded with sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, with a cream cheese whipped with chives, dill and lemon for dipping. Mix 60g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 30g chia seeds, 60g plain flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil and 200ml water. Stand 15 minutes, then spread very thin between sheets of baking paper. Bake at 160C for 45 minutes, peel off the top sheet, and bake 15 minutes more until crisp. Snap into shards. Beat 250g cream cheese with chopped chives, dill, lemon zest and pepper.
M: spiked for Sea Bass, mild for you
Beef patty griddled with cheddar, topped with beef chilli and pickled jalapeños. Keep a jar of hot sauce for anyone who wants Sea Bass's version.
Aspen room service surf and turf
lobster and the works on someone else's money

Grilled lobster tails in garlic parsley butter beside seared sirloin, with crunchy double-cooked chips and a bowl of béarnaise to share. Cut 800g potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then at 190C for 3 minutes. Split 4 lobster tails and brush with 60g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and parsley, then grill flesh side up 6 to 8 minutes. Season 4 small sirloin steaks and sear 3 minutes a side, then rest. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar over simmering water, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter and chopped tarragon. Serve together.
