W: Vanilla sugar cookies cut into snowflakes, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white with silver cachous.
K: Aspen ski lodge after the slopes
Dark chocolate melted into hot milk, whisked frothy, whipped cream and marshmallows.
T: Pretty bird.
D: Two dim-witted friends drive cross-country to return a briefcase to a woman in Aspen.
P: Serve the hot chilli burgers when Harry and Lloyd spike Sea Bass's burger at the truck stop.

title: Tommy Boy
S: the kitchen's closed, Tommy wants wings
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, blue cheese dip and celery.
chocolate and peanut butter, Ohio's own sweet
Peanut butter, butter and icing sugar rolled into balls, chilled, dipped in dark chocolate leaving a round of peanut butter showing.
Fat guy in a little coat sausage rolls
the jacket rips at the seams

Herby pork sausage rolls wrapped in pastry that's a size too small, so the filling bursts out the seams, with smoky tomato relish. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated onion, 1 grated carrot, 1 tbsp chopped sage and 40g breadcrumbs. Cut 3 sheets puff pastry in half. Lay a sausage of filling along each, wrap so the edges only just meet and press loosely so they split in the oven. Brush with beaten egg and cut into 4 pieces each. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 200g tomato relish.
M: Beef simmered loose with tomato, cinnamon, cumin, allspice and a square of dark chocolate for 90 minutes, ladled over spaghetti and buried in finely grated cheddar.
for the factory crew in Sandusky

Beef sausages and cheeseburgers off the grill, with charred corn in chilli butter and a creamy potato salad, the way you feed a factory floor. Boil 1kg washed potatoes until tender, cool, cut up and toss with 150g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 chopped spring onions and dill. Shape 500g beef mince into 4 patties. Grill 8 thick beef sausages over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning. Grill the patties 4 minutes a side with a cheddar slice on top. Grill 4 corn cobs 10 minutes and brush with 40g butter mixed with chilli flakes. Serve with buns and sauces.
W: Sweet-sour cherries baked in a crisp shortcrust under a woven lattice top, served warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Toss 800g pitted cherries (frozen is fine) with 150g caster sugar, 3 tbsp cornflour and the juice of half a lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and fill with the cherries. Cut 2 more sheets into strips and weave a lattice on top, then brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes until bubbling. Cool 1 hour and serve with vanilla ice cream.
K: Tommy and Richard on the road selling brake pads

Ice-cold lager topped with homemade fizzy lemonade of fresh lemon and sugar syrup, served in chilled pint glasses with a lemon wheel. Mix 120ml fresh lemon juice with 100ml sugar syrup and chill. Chill 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Pour 30ml of the lemon mix into each glass, add 165ml cold soda water, then top slowly with 330ml cold lager each. Stir once and add a lemon wheel. Use extra soda water and lemon for anyone driving.
T: Fat guy in a little coat.
D: A dim but lovable heir hits the road with a grumpy salesman to save the family brake pad business.
P: Serve the wings when Tommy talks the diner waitress into reopening the kitchen.

title: Groundhog Day
S: Tip Top Cafe silver dollar pancakes
the diner Phil goes to every single day

Little buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter until golden, stacked high with whipped maple butter, crisp bacon bits and a drizzle of warm maple syrup. Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt with 375ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 40g melted butter. Rest 15 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp maple syrup. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Cook tablespoons of batter in a buttered pan over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes a side. Stack, top with the maple butter and bacon bits, and pour over warm maple syrup.
the festival in the town square
Cake doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes, then shaken in a paper bag with cinnamon sugar until coated.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon, a dash of hot sauce and paprika, piped back into the whites.
M: pancakes, eggs, bacon, toast and pie, everything at once
Bacon rendered crisp, fried eggs, a short stack, buttered toast and a slice of pie, all on the table at the same time.
the town's Groundhog Day party at the end of the night

Golden roast chicken with sage and onion stuffing, creamy mashed potato, buttered green beans and a rich pan gravy, small-town dinner dance style. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with salt the night before. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the thigh reaches 75C, and rest. Mix 150g breadcrumbs with 1 onion softened in 50g butter, chopped sage, 1 egg and stock, then bake in a dish for 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Steam 300g green beans.
W: Phil orders it with everything else

Whisk 10 egg whites with cream of tartar to soft peaks, add 150g sugar, fold in 120g cake flour sifted with 150g icing sugar, bake in an ungreased tube pan at 175C for 40 minutes, cool upside down. Berries and cream.
K: Rita's sweet vermouth on the rocks
Rita's order at the bar, with a twist, to world peace

Sweet red vermouth poured over a big block of ice with a long twist of orange peel and a dash of bitters, exactly as Rita orders it. Put one large ice block in each of 4 rocks glasses. Pour 75ml sweet red vermouth over each and add a dash of aromatic bitters. Peel 4 long strips of orange zest, twist each over the glass to release the oil, rub round the rim and drop in. Stir twice. Totals are 300ml vermouth and 1 orange. Raise a glass to world peace.
T: Same breakfast. Every day.
D: A weatherman relives the same day over and over in Punxsutawney.
P: Serve the breakfast feast when Phil gorges at the diner.

title: Pulp Fiction
S: Vincent's Amsterdam story, the little differences
Beef sliders smashed thin, American cheese, onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayo the European way, on soft buns.

Mini beef patties glazed in sticky homemade teriyaki with charred pineapple, cheddar and a sriracha mayo in soft slider buns, skewered with a toothpick. Simmer 80ml soy sauce, 80ml mirin and 2 tbsp brown sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy. Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and season. Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred and cut each into 3. Cook the patties on a hot griddle 2 minutes a side, brush with teriyaki and add a small square of cheddar. Mix 80g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp sriracha. Build in 12 slider buns with pineapple and mayo.
Thin fries soaked an hour, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, salted, served in red-checked paper boats with ketchup and mustard.
M: Thick chuck patty brushed with teriyaki (soy, mirin, sugar reduced), grilled pineapple ring, cheddar and lettuce on a toasted bun.
Vincent's order at Jack Rabbit Slim's, bloody as hell

Sirloin seared hard and served properly rare, with skin-on fries, a little pot of peppercorn sauce and a crisp iceberg wedge with blue cheese dressing. Season 4 sirloin steaks an hour ahead. Fry 800g frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest 5 minutes. In the same pan, cook 1 chopped shallot and 1 tbsp crushed peppercorns, add 30ml brandy and 150ml cream and simmer 2 minutes. Cut 1 iceberg into wedges and spoon over 120g blue cheese mixed with 80g sour cream.
W: the opening scene at the diner, before the robbery
Buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter, stacked with butter and maple syrup, a side of crisp bacon.
K: vanilla, and it really is worth it
Blend 3 scoops vanilla bean ice cream with 120ml cold full cream milk until just thick enough for a straw to stand up. Whipped cream and a cherry.
T: Five dollar shakes. Worth every cent.
D: Interlinked stories of LA gangsters, boxers and a briefcase.
P: Serve the shakes at Jack Rabbit Slim's.

title: The Big Lebowski
S: League night chilli con queso nachos
league night with Walter and Donny

Corn chips under a hot chilli con queso of cheddar, tomato and green chilli, with pickled jalapeños, sour cream and coriander, served in cardboard trays. Cook 1 diced onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add 1 diced green chilli, 1 tsp cumin and 1 diced tomato and cook 3 minutes. Add 375ml evaporated milk and bring to a simmer, then stir in 200g grated cheddar off the heat until smooth. Divide 250g corn chips between 4 cardboard trays, pour over the queso and top with 40g pickled jalapeños, sour cream and coriander. Serve straight away.
it really tied the room together

Crisp lavash rectangles striped with smoked paprika, cumin and sesame like the Dude's rug, served with a whipped feta and lemon dip. Cut 2 lavash sheets into 12 rectangles and brush with 1 tbsp olive oil. Sprinkle half a tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp ground cumin and 10g sesame seeds in alternating stripes. Bake at 180C for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp, then cool. Blitz 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 tbsp olive oil until smooth for dipping.
the Dude buys half-and-half in his dressing gown

Ricotta and cream cheese whipped silky with a splash of cream, swirled with hot honey and cracked pepper, with warm grilled sourdough fingers. Beat 300g ricotta, 100g cream cheese and 2 tbsp cream until very smooth, about 2 minutes, with a pinch of salt and lemon zest. Warm 3 tbsp honey with half a tsp chilli flakes. Slice half a sourdough loaf into fingers, brush with olive oil and grill or toast 2 minutes a side. Spread the ricotta in a shallow bowl, drizzle with the hot honey and finish with plenty of cracked black pepper.
M: Walter, Donny and the Dude between frames
Two thin patties smashed on a hot griddle, American cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce, double-fried chips.
snacks at the lanes between frames

Griddled beef franks in toasted buns smothered with beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar, raw onion and mustard, eaten in a booth by the lanes. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 400g tinned tomatoes and 400g drained kidney beans, and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Simmer 8 beef franks for 5 minutes, then sear on a griddle until blistered. Toast 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli, 100g grated cheddar between them, diced raw onion and mustard.
W: Coffee liqueur ice cream cookie sandwiches
the Dude's White Russian, turned into dessert

Brown butter choc chip cookies sandwiched with vanilla ice cream rippled with coffee liqueur, edges rolled in crushed chocolate-coated coffee beans. Brown 150g butter, cool, then beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg. Mix in 250g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb soda and 150g choc chips and chill overnight. Bake 16 small balls at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream, ripple through 60ml coffee liqueur and refreeze 1 hour. Sandwich scoops between cookies, roll the edges in 50g crushed chocolate-coated coffee beans and freeze 30 minutes.
K: 45ml vodka and 20ml coffee liqueur over ice in a rocks glass, topped with 30ml cream (or half and half), stirred lazily.
T: The Dude abides. So does the White Russian.
D: A laid-back bowler gets mixed up in a kidnapping case.
P: Serve a White Russian every time the Dude makes one.

title: Fargo
S: Welcome to Brainerd, home of Paul Bunyan

Cheese curds dipped in a light beer batter, fried at 185C for 60 seconds until puffed, ranch dip of sour cream, mayo, dill and chives. Whisk 120g flour with 200ml cold lager. Dip 300g cheese curds and fry at 185C for 60 seconds until puffed. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill and chives for ranch. Serve hot.
Minnesota hotdish, made in a muffin tin

Beef mince and onion in a creamy mushroom sauce, baked in muffin tins under crunchy tater tots and melted cheddar, with tomato relish. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 150g sliced mushrooms. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 200ml milk and 100ml cream and simmer 5 minutes until thick, with salt, pepper and a dash of Worcestershire. Spoon into 12 greased muffin holes. Top each with 3 or 4 frozen tater tots and a pinch of grated cheddar from 100g. Bake at 210C for 25 minutes until the tots are crisp. Serve with tomato relish.
Marge is eating for two at the buffet

Dill pickles, green olives, radishes, celery and carrot sticks on ice with a sour cream and dill dip. Arrange dill pickle spears, green olives, radishes, celery and carrot sticks on a tray of ice. Mix 200g sour cream with chopped dill and salt for a dip. Serve it like a church buffet, you betcha.
M: Marge and Norm at the all-you-can-eat buffet

Topside roasted pink and carved thin, with rich gravy, buttery mashed potato, sweet corn and soft dinner rolls, buffet plates piled high. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with oil, salt and pepper. Sear in a hot roasting tin, then roast at 200C for 40 to 45 minutes until 52C inside. Rest 20 minutes, then carve thin. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 400ml beef stock. Heat 400g frozen corn with butter. Serve with warm dinner rolls.
Firm white fish (walleye or flathead) in a beer batter, fried at 180C, chips, coleslaw and tartare.
W: any pie will do at the buffet

Granny Smith apples baked with cinnamon and brown sugar in a flaky shortcrust under a lattice, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Peel and slice 1kg Granny Smith apples and toss with 120g brown sugar, 2 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp cornflour and the juice of half a lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and fill. Weave a lattice from 2 more sheets cut into strips, brush with egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest 30 minutes and serve with ice cream.
K: Norm's mallard makes the three-cent stamp

Strong hot coffee whisked with melted dark chocolate and milk, poured from a thermos and topped with maple whipped cream. Brew 500ml strong coffee. Heat 500ml milk in a saucepan until steaming and whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp brown sugar until smooth. Stir in the coffee and pour into a warmed thermos. Whip 150ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp maple syrup to soft peaks. Pour into 4 mugs and spoon the cream on top.
T: Oh ya.
D: A car salesman's plan to have his wife kidnapped goes horribly wrong in snowy Minnesota.
P: Serve the buffet when Marge and Norm hit the buffet.

title: Psycho
S: ham and cheese on white, under the stuffed birds
Leg ham and Swiss on buttered white bread with mustard, crusts off, cut into neat triangles, milk on the side.
from the house on the hill
Small onions peeled, brined overnight, packed in hot spiced vinegar with sugar and peppercorns, pickled a week.
M: the lunch-hour hotel room in Phoenix, lunch left uneaten

Seared minute steak with caramelised onions, Swiss cheese and horseradish mayo on toasted rye, with a pile of shoestring fries and dill pickles. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes until golden. Fry 600g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Season 4 minute steaks and sear in a smoking pan 1 minute a side. Lay a slice of Swiss cheese on each and cover for 30 seconds. Mix 80g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp horseradish. Toast 8 slices rye bread and build with mayo, steak and onions. Serve with fries and pickles.
Chicken simmered in a creamy broth with vegetables and fluffy herb dumplings. Simmer 1kg chicken thighs with carrots, celery, onion and 1.5L stock for 30 minutes, shred the meat and add 100ml cream.
W: white, swirly and hard to look at
Swiss meringue piped into tall swirls, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven. Raspberry coulis drizzled over.
K: Norman brings Marion sandwiches and milk in the parlour

Cold full cream milk shaken with brandy, vanilla and a little sugar syrup until frothy, served over ice with freshly grated nutmeg. For each drink, shake 120ml cold full cream milk, 45ml brandy, 15ml sugar syrup and a few drops of vanilla extract with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 small glasses over a large ice cube and grate nutmeg over the top. Totals are 480ml milk, 180ml brandy and 60ml sugar syrup. Leave the brandy out for a plain vanilla milk.
T: A boy's best friend is his mother. A guest's best friend is supper.
D: A thief on the run checks into a remote motel run by a troubled young man.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Norman brings Marion supper in the parlour.

title: Rosemary's Baby
S: she insists you drink it every day
Fresh ginger, turmeric, lemon and honey blitzed with apple juice and strained, served in shot glasses. No tannis root.

Hand-chopped eye fillet with shallot, capers, cornichons, Dijon and Worcestershire, topped with a raw egg yolk and served with crisp potato crisps and toast. Chill 400g very fresh eye fillet in the freezer for 20 minutes, then chop very finely by hand. Mix with 1 finely diced shallot, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 4 chopped cornichons, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, a dash of hot sauce, chopped parsley, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 rounds on cold plates and set an egg yolk on each. Serve straight away with thin toast and potato crisps.
the welcome party in the old building
Chicken livers seared pink, flamed with brandy, blitzed with butter and thyme, set and spread on toasted baguette with fig jam.
M: Rosemary's rare rib eye with frites
Rosemary can't stop eating meat barely cooked

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and pulled rare, sliced over golden frites, with garlic butter and a watercress salad sharp with Dijon dressing. Salt 2 rib eye steaks (about 450g each) and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 800g frozen frites at 220C for 25 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute, until 48C inside, about 6 minutes. Add 40g butter and 2 garlic cloves, baste for 1 minute, then rest 8 minutes. Toss 100g watercress with 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar and 3 tbsp olive oil. Slice the steak and serve.
a Manhattan club sandwich between auditions
Three toasted slices: roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, potato chips.
W: with the chalky undertaste, ours is smooth
Melt 200g dark chocolate with butter, whisk in yolks, fold in whites whipped with sugar, then whipped cream, set 4 hours in small cups.
K: Fresh ginger and lemongrass steeped in boiling water for 5 minutes, honey and lemon.
T: Don't eat the chocolate mousse.
D: A pregnant woman suspects her neighbours have sinister plans for her child.
P: Serve dessert when Minnie brings round her chocolate mousse.

title: Night of the Living Dead
S: whatever's in the cupboard while the boards go up

Saltine crackers piled with tinned sardines mashed with lemon and parsley, sharp cheddar, and a quick pickled red onion, laid out on a chopping board. Thinly slice 1 red onion and soak it in 80ml white vinegar with 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Drain 2 x 110g tins sardines and mash lightly with the juice of half a lemon, chopped parsley and pepper. Slice 150g sharp cheddar. Top 24 saltine crackers with sardine, a slice of cheddar and a few pickled onion rings and lay them out on a chopping board.
Barbara and Johnny's visit to their father's grave

Egg and cress, and ham and mustard on buttered white bread, crusts off, wrapped in wax paper like a 1968 picnic. Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 20g mayonnaise. Stir in 10g chopped cress. Butter 8 slices white bread with 25g softened butter. Use four slices to make two egg-and-cress sandwiches. Use the other four for two sandwiches with 80g leg ham and 10g Dijon mustard. Trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into four small pieces. Wrap in wax paper for a 1968-style picnic and serve four pieces each.
Popcorn tossed half in melted butter and fine salt, half in butter, cracked black pepper and black sesame.
M: Harry wants the cellar, Ben wants upstairs

Beef chuck browned, onion, carrot and potato, stock and thyme, braised covered at 160C for 2.5 hours. Cut 800g beef chuck into chunks and season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper. Brown in 1 tbsp neutral oil in a heavy casserole for 8 minutes, in batches. Add 1 chopped brown onion, 2 chopped carrots, 500g potato chunks, 500ml beef stock and 4 thyme sprigs. Cover and braise at 160°C conventional for 2.5 hours, stirring once, until the beef is tender. Serve with 200g crusty Italian bread for soaking up the stock.
Ben's beef and bean chilli with cornbread
Ben pulls up at the farmhouse in a truck

Beef mince chilli simmered with cumin, chilli and kidney beans, ladled into bowls over sour cream and cheddar, with hot buttered cornbread on the side. Brown 700g beef mince in batches. Cook 1 diced onion and 3 garlic cloves 5 minutes, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp smoked paprika, then 2 x 400g tins tomatoes and 400g drained kidney beans. Simmer 45 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 300ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter, pour into a hot buttered pan and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and cheddar.
W: what's left in the farmhouse pantry

Tinned peach halves baked under a golden cinnamon biscuit topping until bubbling, served warm with a jug of cold pouring cream. Drain 2 x 825g tins peach halves, keeping 100ml syrup. Toss the peaches with the syrup and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 80g cold butter into 200g self-raising flour, 60g caster sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon, then mix in 120ml milk to a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls over the peaches, sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 190C for 30 minutes until golden. Serve warm with 300ml pouring cream.
K: the long night boarded up in the farmhouse

Strong stovetop coffee sweetened with brown sugar and a nip of Irish whiskey, topped with lightly whipped cream so it floats. Brew 800ml strong coffee in a stovetop pot or plunger. Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out. Put 2 tsp brown sugar and 30ml Irish whiskey in each glass, pour in 200ml hot coffee and stir to dissolve. Whip 150ml thickened cream until just thick enough to pour, then float it over the back of a spoon. Skip the whiskey for anyone who wants it plain.
T: They're coming to get you, Barbara.
D: Strangers barricade themselves in a farmhouse as the dead rise.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone boards up the windows.

title: Halloween
S: for the horror movie marathon on TV
Popcorn tossed in butter and salt, then caramel on half, baked at 120C for 45 minutes.
Sharp cheddar, cream cheese, smoked paprika and Worcestershire shaped into a pumpkin, rolled in more paprika, a capsicum stem on top. Crackers.
trick or treat on the street in Haddonfield

Thick dark and milk chocolate cups filled with salty peanut butter fudge, set in paper cases and piled into a pumpkin bowl by the door. Melt 300g milk chocolate with 100g dark chocolate. Spoon a teaspoon into each of 16 mini paper cases and chill 10 minutes. Mix 150g smooth peanut butter with 50g icing sugar, 20g soft butter and a pinch of salt. Roll into 16 small discs and press onto the set chocolate. Cover with the remaining chocolate, sprinkle with flaky salt and chill 1 hour until firm.
M: Laurie carves the jack-o'-lantern with Tommy

Rigatoni tossed with roast pumpkin, crumbled pork sausage, crispy sage and parmesan in a garlicky brown butter sauce, chilli flakes on top. Dice 800g pumpkin, toss with oil and salt and roast at 210C for 25 minutes. Squeeze 400g pork sausages from their skins and fry in olive oil until browned and crumbly. Add 60g butter and a handful of sage leaves and cook until the butter browns and the sage crisps, then add 2 sliced garlic cloves. Boil 500g rigatoni, keeping a cup of water. Toss the pasta with the sausage, pumpkin, 60g grated parmesan and splashes of water. Finish with chilli flakes.
Beef and bean chilli simmered 90 minutes, served in small hollowed pumpkins roasted at 200C for 30 minutes, sour cream and cheddar.
W: with a white mask of whipped cream
Roast pumpkin purée whisked with eggs, brown sugar, cream and spices, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes, whipped cream piped as a pale mask.
K: Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel for 15 minutes, served hot.
T: The night he came home. The night we ate everything.
D: An escaped killer returns to his hometown to stalk babysitters on Halloween night.
P: Serve the snacks when Laurie starts babysitting Tommy.

title: The Thing
S: cards, pool and chess in the rec room
Corn chips layered with beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, sour cream and salsa.
Thick white toast spread right to the edges with salted butter while hot, cut into soldiers.
MacReady's drink of choice, in a lolly

Soft butter caramels cooked with cream and golden syrup, finished with a splash of Scotch and a pinch of flaky salt, wrapped in baking paper. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Put 200g caster sugar, 250ml cream, 80g butter and 80g golden syrup in a heavy saucepan and stir over medium heat until dissolved. Boil without stirring until it reaches 120C on a thermometer, about 15 minutes. Take off the heat, stir in 30ml Scotch and half a tsp salt, and pour into the tin. Sprinkle with flaky salt, cool 3 hours, cut into squares and wrap in paper.
M: thick and hot for a base snowed in for winter
Beef chuck in chunks browned, onion, garlic, chipotle, cumin, tomato and beans, braised 2.5 hours. Cornbread.

Beef chuck braised slowly with potato, carrot and onion in a rich tomato and stout gravy, ladled thick into bowls with crusty bread and butter. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in oil. Cook 2 onions and 3 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 375ml stout, 500ml beef stock, thyme and bay. Return the beef, cover and cook at 160C for 2 hours. Add 600g potatoes and 3 carrots in chunks and cook 45 minutes more until tender. Season and serve with crusty bread and butter.
W: red and wobbly, like the blood in MacReady's test
Bloom gelatine leaves in cold water, dissolve in warm raspberry purée sweetened with sugar and a squeeze of lemon, strain, pour into shallow glass dishes and set 4 hours. Fresh raspberries on top.
K: MacReady pours his Scotch into the chess computer

Blended Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters over ice until silky cold, strained into chilled glasses with a cocktail cherry, blood red. Chill 4 coupe or rocks glasses. For each drink, stir 60ml blended Scotch, 25ml sweet red vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with plenty of ice in a jug for 20 seconds. Strain into the glasses and drop in a cocktail cherry. Totals are 240ml Scotch, 100ml vermouth and 4 cherries. Serve over one big ice block for anyone who likes it on the rocks.
T: Trust no one. Not even the dip.
D: Researchers in Antarctica face a shape-shifting alien that imitates its victims.
P: Serve the snacks when MacReady runs the blood test.

title: Let the Right One In
S: Beef and pork mince with soaked breadcrumbs, grated onion, allspice and egg, rolled small, browned in butter, finished in a cream and beef stock sauce. Lingonberry jam.
Eli solves Oskar's puzzle cube overnight

A Swedish-style aged cheese tart with a crisp butter pastry, cut into neat cubes and topped with crème fraîche, dill and a little salmon roe. Line a 20cm square tin with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and blind bake at 190C for 15 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs with 250ml cream, 200g grated aged hard cheese (or vintage cheddar), salt and white pepper. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 30 minutes until just set. Cool completely, then cut into 16 cubes. Top each with a dab of crème fraîche, a dill frond and a few pearls of salmon roe.
Oskar's after-school snack alone at the kitchen table

Rye crispbread spread with cold salted butter, shaved aged hard cheese and cucumber sliced paper thin, a grind of white pepper and a few dill fronds on top. Build just before serving so it stays crisp.
M: a Blackeberg winter supper in the flat

Swedish hash of crisp diced potato, smoked ham and onion fried in butter, topped with runny fried eggs, pickled beetroot and parsley. Dice 1kg waxy potatoes into 1cm cubes and parboil 4 minutes, then drain and steam dry. Fry in 40g butter and 2 tbsp oil in a big frying pan for 15 minutes until crisp. Add 2 diced onions and 300g diced smoked ham and cook 8 minutes more. Season well. Fry 4 eggs in butter until the whites set. Serve the hash topped with the eggs, 200g sliced pickled beetroot and chopped parsley.
prawns, dill and mayo on buttered toast
Cooked prawns chopped and folded with mayo, crème fraîche, dill, lemon and a little horseradish, piled on butter-fried bread, roe on top.
W: where Oskar meets Eli in the snowy courtyard

Cardamom-scented yeasted dough rolled with butter, sugar and cinnamon, cut, knotted, proved, baked at 220C for 10 minutes, pearl sugar on top. Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 75g sugar, 300ml warm milk and 75g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 100g butter, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cinnamon. Cut strips, knot and prove 30 minutes. Brush with egg, add pearl sugar and bake at 220C for 10 minutes.
K: tapped through the bedroom wall to Eli

Blackcurrant juice warmed with cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and orange, served steaming in small glasses with raisins and blanched almonds at the bottom. Put 1L blackcurrant juice, 250ml cloudy apple juice, 1 cinnamon stick, 6 crushed cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 2 strips orange peel and 2 tbsp brown sugar in a saucepan. Heat gently to just below a simmer and hold for 15 minutes. Strain. Put a few raisins and 2 blanched almonds in each of 4 heatproof glasses and pour over the hot glögg.
T: Invite her in. Then dinner.
D: A bullied boy in 1980s Stockholm befriends a mysterious girl who turns out to be a vampire.
P: Serve the snacks when Oskar and Eli work on the puzzle cube.

title: The Babadook
S: Pop-up book crackers and olive tapenade

Lavash crackers baked folded like an open book, with a jet black olive and anchovy tapenade and a whipped feta for the white pages. Cut 2 lavash sheets into 16 rectangles, score each down the middle, brush with olive oil and salt and drape over a rolling pin so they bake half open. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Blitz 200g pitted kalamata olives, 4 anchovies, 1 garlic clove, 1 tbsp capers, lemon juice and 60ml olive oil to a paste. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt. Serve both with the crackers.
a top hat, a dark coat, a pop-up book

Kernels popped in a lidded pot with a little oil, tossed hot in melted butter, heaps of cracked black pepper, grated parmesan and fine salt. Pop 120g kernels in a lidded pot with 2 tbsp oil. Toss straight away in 50g melted butter, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 40g finely grated parmesan and fine salt so it all sticks while the corn is hot.
Samuel's party with his cousin Ruby

Fresh white bread spread right to the edges with soft butter, pressed face down into a plate of hundreds and thousands, crusts trimmed and cut into triangles. Make it close to serving so it stays soft.
M: Lamb shanks browned, braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, red wine, tomato and rosemary. Mash.
Amelia up all night with the TV and no sleep

Sourdough toasted in butter with vintage cheddar, a smear of Dijon and shaved leg ham, the outside crusted with parmesan, with tomato chutney for dipping. Butter one side of 8 slices sourdough. Mix 250g grated vintage cheddar with 2 tbsp mayonnaise. Lay 4 slices buttered side down, spread with Dijon, top with the cheese mix and 150g shaved leg ham, and close. Sprinkle 30g finely grated parmesan onto the buttered outsides. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until deep golden. Rest 1 minute, cut and serve with 150g tomato chutney.
W: A proper Aussie jelly slice with a buttery biscuit base, a tangy condensed milk and lemon middle and a wobbly raspberry jelly top. Press 250g crushed biscuits and 125g melted butter into a tin. Dissolve 1 tbsp gelatine in 60ml hot water, mix with 395g condensed milk and the juice of 2 lemons and spread over. Set, then pour over 1 cooled packet of raspberry jelly and chill.
K: Dook dook dook honey brandy nightcap
three knocks, then finally some sleep

Full cream milk warmed with honey, vanilla and cinnamon, finished with a nip of brandy and a grating of nutmeg, served in mugs before bed. Warm 800ml full cream milk in a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick and half a tsp vanilla extract until steaming, without boiling. Leave to infuse 5 minutes and remove the cinnamon. Whisk until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, add 20ml brandy to each, and finish with grated nutmeg. Leave the brandy out for the kids.
T: If it's in a word or in a look, you can't get rid of dessert.
D: A grieving mother and her son are haunted by a sinister storybook creature.
P: Serve dessert when Amelia reads the pop-up book.

title: It Follows
S: the Detroit road their parents said not to cross

Cocktail franks simmered 5 minutes, tucked into split mini rolls, topped with a spoon of beef chilli simmered with cumin and paprika, a stripe of yellow mustard and finely diced raw onion. Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, add 150ml water and simmer 20 minutes. Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Tuck into split mini rolls, spoon over chilli, add mustard and diced onion.
Jay floating in her backyard pool

Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives, served with thick ridged potato chips. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes until jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.
the Detroit suburbs the film lives in

Thick, airy pan pizza with crunchy caramelised cheese edges, cupped pepperoni and stripes of chunky tomato sauce on top, cut into small squares. Press 500g pizza dough into an oiled 23 x 33cm tin and prove 1 hour. Push the dough to the corners, cover with 80g sliced pepperoni, then 300g cubed mozzarella right to the edges so it touches the tin. Bake at 250C for 14 minutes until the edges are dark and crisp. Simmer 300g crushed tomatoes with garlic, oregano and a pinch of sugar for 15 minutes and spoon over in two stripes. Cut into 16 squares.
M: the trip out to the lake to get away from it

Crisp beer-battered flathead in warm corn tortillas with lime slaw, pickled onion, avocado crema and a hit of hot sauce. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with salt for 20 minutes. Shred a quarter red cabbage and toss with lime juice and coriander. Blitz 1 avocado with 100g sour cream and lime. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold beer and salt. Cut 600g flathead into strips, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, crema and hot sauce.
driving the Detroit suburbs all night
Pork marinated with garlic, oregano and lemon, griddled and sliced, wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion and chips.
W: a slow summer with nowhere to go
Soft chocolate cookies baked at 175C for 9 minutes, cooled, sandwiched with a thick slice of vanilla ice cream, rolled in mini choc chips and frozen an hour before serving.
K: the public pool, lamps plugged in all round

Lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water in a big jug, sliced lemon and plenty of ice. Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add sliced lemon and plenty of ice and pour into four glasses.
T: Walk, don't run, to the buffet.
D: A young woman in Detroit is followed by something that only ever walks towards her.
P: Serve the snacks when the gang heads to the public pool for the last stand.

title: The Witch
S: the corn crop William can't save
Cornmeal, flour, baking powder, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, poured into a smoking hot buttered cast iron pan and baked at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter alongside.
Caleb's red apple, the one from the woods
Crisp red apples sliced thin and tossed in lemon, fanned out with sharp aged cheddar, walnuts toasted at 170C for 8 minutes and a drizzle of honey.
the hens in the yard on the edge of the woods

Eggs baked in buttered ramekins over cream, wilted spinach and smoky bacon, with thyme and cracked pepper, and buttered sourdough soldiers to dip. Fry 100g diced bacon until crisp. Wilt 150g spinach in the pan and squeeze dry. Butter 4 ramekins and divide the bacon and spinach between them. Add 1 tbsp cream to each, crack in an egg, season and add a pinch of thyme. Stand in a roasting tin with hot water halfway up and bake at 180C for 12 to 14 minutes until the whites set. Serve with 4 slices buttered sourdough toast cut into soldiers.
M: the goat in the yard, or lamb if goat's a step too far
Goat or lamb shoulder in big pieces browned hard, onion, carrot and garlic softened, stock, thyme and bay, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until it falls apart. Barley bread.
Colonial ham hock and barley pottage
what a farm family lives on through a New England winter

A thick farmhouse pottage of pearl barley, split peas, leek and root vegetables simmered in smoky ham hock stock, with the meat pulled back through. Rinse 150g pearl barley and 150g green split peas. Simmer 1 smoked ham hock in 2.5L water with bay leaves for 90 minutes. Lift out the hock, add the barley and peas and simmer 40 minutes. Add 2 sliced leeks, 1 diced turnip, 2 diced parsnips and 2 carrots and simmer 25 minutes more. Shred the ham back in, season with pepper and parsley, and serve with crusty bread and butter.
W: from the orchard, honey and spice
Apples cored, filled with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped dates, a splash of cider in the dish, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, basted twice. Pouring cream.
K: Cloudy apple juice simmered gently with cinnamon sticks, cloves, star anise and strips of orange peel for 15 minutes, strained and ladled into mugs.
T: Wouldst thou like to eat deliciously?
D: A Puritan family in 1630s New England falls apart after their baby vanishes at the edge of the woods.
P: Serve the mains when Black Phillip shows up in the yard.

title: Train to Busan
S: the snack you grab before the train leaves

Seaweed rolls of sesame rice packed with egg ribbon, pickled radish, carrot, spinach and bulgogi beef, sliced into rounds and brushed with sesame oil. Cook 400g short grain rice and season with 1 tbsp sesame oil and salt. Fry 200g thinly sliced beef with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sugar. Cook 3 beaten eggs into a thin omelette and slice into strips. Blanch 200g spinach, squeeze and season with sesame oil. Julienne 1 carrot and quickly fry. Spread rice over 5 nori sheets, lay the fillings and strips of yellow pickled radish across, roll tightly, brush with sesame oil and slice.
the high school team's road trip snack

Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C, tossed in gochujang, soy, honey and garlic glaze with sesame seeds. Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch. Fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest 5, then fry at 190C until very crisp. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp honey and 2 crushed garlic cloves until glossy. Toss and scatter with sesame seeds.
Cylinder rice cakes soaked 20 minutes, simmered in anchovy stock with gochujang, gochugaru, sugar and fish cake until glossy and thick, spring onion over the top.
M: Busan dwaeji gukbap pork and rice soup
dwaeji gukbap, the dish Busan is known for

Milky pork bone broth with tender sliced pork, ladled over rice with spring onion, chilli paste and garlic chives, kimchi and salted prawns on the side. Blanch 1.5kg pork bones in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain and rinse. Cover with 3L fresh water, add 1 onion, 6 garlic cloves and a knob of ginger, and boil hard for 3 hours, topping up, until milky. Add 600g pork belly for the last 60 minutes, then slice. Strain the broth and season. Pour over bowls of cooked rice with the pork, spring onion and chives. Serve with kimchi and gochujang.
KTX to Busan kimchi fried rice
quick and hot, Seoul Station to Busan

Cold rice fried in a smoking pan with chopped aged kimchi and its juice, bacon, gochujang and butter, pressed to crisp on the bottom, topped with a fried egg and nori. Fry 150g chopped bacon until crisp, then add 300g chopped kimchi and a splash of its juice. Add 4 cups cold cooked rice from 300g jasmine rice, 1 tbsp gochujang and 30g butter, and press flat to crisp the bottom. Top each bowl with a fried egg and torn nori.
W: the birthday trip to see her mum in Busan

Sweet yeasted dough rested an hour, filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped peanuts, pressed flat in an oiled pan and fried until the sugar melts inside. Mix 300g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm water and rest an hour. Mix 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 40g chopped peanuts. Fill 8 balls of dough with the mix, seal and press flat in an oiled pan. Fry until golden and the sugar melts inside.
K: Ripe banana blended with cold full cream milk, a little honey and a pinch of salt, strained and served very cold.
T: Next stop: dinner.
D: Passengers fight to survive a zombie outbreak on a high-speed train from Seoul to Busan.
P: Serve the snacks as the train pulls out of Seoul station.

title: Get Out
S: Rose's rainbow cereal bars, milk apart
Rose's late-night snack, cereal and milk kept apart

Crunchy rainbow fruit cereal set in brown butter and marshmallow, cut into bars and served with tall glasses of cold milk on the side. Melt 60g butter in a large pan and cook until it smells nutty. Add 300g marshmallows and a pinch of salt and stir until melted. Take off the heat and fold in 180g coloured fruit cereal quickly. Press into a lined 20cm square tin with a buttered spatula. Cool 1 hour, then cut into 16 bars. Serve with 4 tall glasses of cold milk, kept separate.
the Armitages' guests on the lawn
Blinis topped with crème fraîche, cold-smoked salmon, dill and lemon zest, and cucumber rounds with whipped goat's cheese and chives, laid on silver trays.
M: Butterflied lamb leg marinated overnight in garlic, rosemary, lemon and olive oil, grilled over high heat to 55C, rested 15 minutes, sliced with salsa verde.
the family dinner where Jeremy gets too loud

Herb-buttered roast chicken with crispy smashed potatoes, honey-glazed carrots and a pan gravy, the polite country house dinner that goes very wrong. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 50g butter mashed with thyme, garlic and lemon zest, under and over the skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until 75C in the thigh, and rest. Boil 1kg baby potatoes, smash on a tray with oil and salt and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Roast 500g baby carrots with 1 tbsp honey and butter. Make gravy with the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Missy stirring her tea with a silver spoon
Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm cream with sugar and a split vanilla bean, set in teacups for 4 hours, a spoon of berry compote on top. Serve with a silver spoon.
K: Missy's spiced Earl Grey milk tea
stirred slowly with a silver spoon

Earl Grey brewed strong with cinnamon and cardamom, sweetened with honey and finished with hot frothed milk, served in fine teacups with a silver spoon. Bring 600ml water to the boil with 1 cinnamon stick and 4 crushed cardamom pods and simmer 3 minutes. Take off the heat, add 4 Earl Grey tea bags and steep 4 minutes, then remove. Stir in 2 tbsp honey. Heat 400ml milk until steaming and whisk until frothy. Pour the tea into 4 teacups, top with the milk and serve with a silver teaspoon to stir.
T: Sink into dessert.
D: A young Black man visits his girlfriend's family for the weekend and uncovers something horrifying.
P: Serve the cereal when Rose eats her coloured cereal with the milk in a separate glass.

title: Hereditary
S: Crustless finger sandwiches of egg and cress, cucumber and cream cheese, and ham and mustard, cut into exact little squares and stood up like a model.
Annie's tiny model rooms, built to scale

Tiny squares of aged cheddar, brie and blue arranged like rooms on a board, with mini lavash crackers, quince paste, grapes and honeyed walnuts. Toss 80g walnuts with 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt and bake at 180C for 8 minutes, then cool. Cut 150g aged cheddar, 150g brie and 100g blue cheese into small neat squares. Arrange them in a grid of little rooms on a large board, with 100g quince paste cut into cubes, 1 small bunch grapes, the walnuts and a packet of mini lavash crackers in the hallways.
nothing with nuts in this house

Crisp baked crackers made from sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, with a beetroot dip. Mix 80g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 2 tbsp chia, 250ml water and salt and stand 15 minutes.
M: the dinner where everything comes out

Dry-brined roast chicken with crisp skin, roast potatoes, buttered greens and a sharp lemon and thyme pan gravy, served at a very quiet table. Salt a 1.8kg chicken all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 45 to 50 minutes until the thigh hits 75C, and rest 15 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in 60ml oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Make gravy with the juices, 1 tbsp flour, 300ml stock and lemon. Steam 300g green beans with butter.
Chicken thighs, mushrooms and leeks in a white wine and cream sauce, topped with puff pastry, egg washed and baked at 200C for 30 minutes until puffed.
W: Charlie can't have nuts, so this one has none
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 35 minutes, glazed with ganache. Check every label for nuts.
K: Joan teaches Annie the séance by candlelight

Shiraz steeped with dark cherries, orange and cinnamon, lifted with brandy and a splash of soda, poured over ice in heavy glasses. Put 300g pitted cherries (frozen is fine), 1 sliced orange and 1 cinnamon stick in a jug. Add 750ml Shiraz, 60ml brandy and 2 tbsp caster sugar and stir to dissolve. Chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add 300ml soda water and stir. Pour into 4 heavy glasses over ice with some of the fruit in each.
T: Family dinner is mandatory.
D: After their grandmother dies, a grieving family uncovers what she left behind.
P: Serve the mains at the family dinner where nobody holds back.

title: A Quiet Place
S: Lettuce leaf chicken and rice cups
the Abbotts serve dinner on leaves, no clattering plates

Soft butter lettuce cups filled with sticky rice, poached chicken, cucumber and herbs, dressed with a lime and fish sauce dressing and crushed peanuts. Poach 500g chicken breast in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, rest, then shred. Cook 200g jasmine rice. Mix the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 sliced red chilli. Separate 2 butter lettuces into cups. Fill each with rice, chicken, sliced Lebanese cucumber, mint and coriander, spoon over the dressing and finish with 50g crushed roasted peanuts.
Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, with a soft cheese dip of cheddar melted into evaporated milk.
the corn silo, minus the danger

Mini cornbread muffins with sweet corn kernels and cheddar, baked golden and split warm with whipped honey butter. Mix 150g fine cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, half a tsp salt and 1 tbsp sugar. Whisk in 300ml buttermilk, 1 egg, 60g melted butter, 150g corn kernels and 60g grated cheddar until just combined. Spoon into a buttered 24-hole mini muffin tin and bake at 200C for 12 to 14 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm bites.
M: caught at the river by the waterfall where they can talk
Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and garlic, wrapped in foil with butter, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, opened at the table. New potatoes on the side.
a pot that cooks without a sound

Beef chuck braised for hours in red wine and stock until it falls apart, with soft buttery mash so nothing at the table makes a crunch. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck with 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks for 8 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock, thyme and bay. Return the beef, cover and cook at 160C for 3 hours. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash very smooth with 80g butter and 150ml warm milk. Spoon the beef over the mash.
W: Yolks whisked with sugar and cornflour, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat until thick, vanilla added, chilled in cups with poached pears.
K: the waterfall, the one place they can speak

Chilled sparkling water poured gently over cucumber ribbons, crushed mint and lime with a touch of elderflower cordial, so nothing clinks. Shave 1 Lebanese cucumber into ribbons with a peeler. Lightly crush a handful of mint with the juice of 2 limes and 60ml elderflower cordial in a jug. Add the cucumber and 1L chilled sparkling water slowly. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice rather than cubes so they stay quiet, pour over and top with a mint sprig.
T: Don't make a sound. Not even when you chew.
D: A family lives in silence on a farm to avoid blind creatures that hunt by sound.
P: Serve the mains when the family eats dinner off leaves instead of plates.

title: Sinners
S: opening night at Smoke and Stack's place

Fine cornmeal and flour mixed with buttermilk, egg, grated onion and a pinch of sugar, rested 10 minutes, spooned into 175C oil and fried golden. Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, a pinch of sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk and rest 10 minutes. Spoon into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce to dip.
a taste of the Mississippi Delta

Catfish strips soaked in buttermilk and hot sauce, crusted in seasoned cornmeal and fried crisp, with a Cajun remoulade and lemon. Cut 500g catfish or flathead fillets into strips and soak in 250ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce for 30 minutes. Mix 150g fine cornmeal, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp each salt, paprika and garlic powder and half a tsp cayenne. Dredge the fish and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp Dijon, chopped gherkins, capers, paprika and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges.
Annie keeps garlic close, and she knows why
Thick slices of white bread spread with butter mashed with a whole head of roasted garlic, parsley and salt, toasted at 200C until crisp at the edges.
M: Delta red beans and rice with sausage
feeding the crowd on the juke joint's opening night

Red kidney beans simmered slow with smoked sausage, ham hock, capsicum, celery and Cajun spice, ladled over fluffy white rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Brown 400g sliced smoked sausage in a large pot. Add 1 onion, 1 green capsicum and 2 celery sticks, diced, and 3 garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes. Add 2 tsp Cajun seasoning, 2 x 400g tins drained kidney beans, 1 small smoked ham hock and 1L chicken stock. Simmer 75 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken. Shred the ham back in. Serve over 300g cooked long grain rice with spring onion and hot sauce.
a plate to keep Delta Slim playing all night

Thick pork chops seasoned, floured and browned, then simmered 40 minutes in an onion gravy made from a dark roux, chicken stock and thyme. Season, flour and brown 4 thick pork chops. Make a dark roux with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions, then 500ml stock and thyme. Simmer the chops in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g long grain rice.
W: something sweet to close out the night
Roasted sweet potato mashed smooth with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: the twins come home from Chicago with stock

Dark Irish stout poured in two stages for a thick creamy head. Tilt each glass and pour the stout three-quarters full, let it settle for a minute, then top up slowly for a tight head. Allow 2 cans or bottles per person.
T: Open the juke joint. Close the doors.
D: Twin brothers come home to 1930s Mississippi to open a juke joint, and something comes knocking.
P: Serve the mains when the juke joint opens for the night.

title: Shutter Island
S: Teddy seasick on the ferry out of Boston

Sweet lobster meat in lemony mayonnaise with celery and chives, piled into buttered, toasted brioche slider buns with a pinch of paprika. Chop 400g cooked lobster meat (or cooked prawns) into chunks. Mix with 80g mayonnaise, 1 finely diced celery stick, chopped chives, the zest and juice of half a lemon, salt and pepper. Split 12 brioche slider buns, brush the cut sides with 40g melted butter and toast in a hot pan until golden. Fill with the lobster, dust with paprika and serve cold with lemon wedges.
the lighthouse Teddy is warned away from
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in grated parmesan, paprika and cayenne, folded, cut into strips, twisted and baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
1950s hospital pantry food out on the island

Navy beans slow cooked with molasses, mustard, onion and bacon at 150C for three hours, piled onto hot buttered toast. Soak 300g navy beans overnight, then simmer 30 minutes. Bake at 150C for 4 hours with 150g diced speck, an onion, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tsp mustard powder and enough water to cover. Spoon onto buttered sourdough toast.
M: the hurricane that traps the marshals

Clams steamed open in white wine, liquor strained, ladled into enamel mugs for the marshals riding out the storm. Steam 1kg clams open in 125ml white wine and strain the liquid. Render 150g bacon, add an onion, 2 celery sticks and 500g diced potato. Add the clam liquid and 500ml milk and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream, the clams and thyme.
a proper staff dinner, cut off by the storm

Sirloin roasted pink and carved thin, with puffed Yorkshire puddings, crisp roast potatoes, horseradish cream and a rich red wine gravy. Season a 1.5kg beef sirloin and roast at 200C for 40 minutes until 52C inside, then rest 20 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes, rough up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 3 eggs and 250ml milk and rest. Heat 1 tsp oil in each of 12 muffin holes at 230C, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy with pan juices, 125ml red wine and 300ml beef stock. Mix 150g sour cream with horseradish.
W: Two layers of vanilla sponge baked at 175C, filled with thick vanilla pastry cream, topped with a dark chocolate ganache poured over and set. Whisk 4 eggs and 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 20 minutes. Cook 400ml milk, 3 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick and cool. Fill the sponge and pour over 150g chocolate melted with 100ml cream.
K: the drink in the doctor's study

Brandy shaken hard with dark crème de cacao and cream until frothy, strained into chilled coupes and finished with freshly grated nutmeg. Chill 4 coupe glasses. For each drink shake 40ml brandy, 30ml crème de cacao and 30ml cream with plenty of ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupes and grate nutmeg over the top. Totals are 160ml brandy, 120ml crème de cacao and 120ml cream. Serve a strong coffee alongside for anyone who'd rather not.
T: Eat like a marshal. Sleep like a patient.
D: A US marshal hunts for a missing patient at an island hospital and starts to doubt his own mind.
P: Serve the mains when the hurricane hits the island.

title: Beetlejuice
S: the dinner party prawns grab the guests' faces
Prawns poached in salted water for 2 minutes, iced, piled into glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and a dash of hot sauce.
Adam's model of Winter River in the attic
Cubes of cheddar, gouda and pepper jack stacked like tiny houses on a board, with cherry tomato and gherkin for the trees.
take a number in the afterlife

Seeded crispbreads spread with whipped lemon ricotta, topped with roast cherry tomatoes, basil and black pepper, each numbered with a dot of balsamic glaze. Roast 250g cherry tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and salt at 200C for 15 minutes until they split. Beat 250g ricotta with the zest of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt until smooth. Spread onto 16 seeded crispbreads, top with the tomatoes, torn basil and cracked pepper. Pipe a small number on each with 2 tbsp balsamic glaze and hand them out in order.
M: Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic, lemon and parsley butter, grilled flesh side up under a hot grill for 6 minutes. Shoestring fries and a green salad.
Beetlejuice snacks on bugs, you don't have to

Pork shoulder braised with chipotle, orange and cumin until it shreds, crisped in a hot pan and piled into corn tortillas with pineapple salsa and lime crema. Cut 1.2kg pork shoulder into large chunks and brown. Add 2 chipotles in adobo, the juice of 2 oranges, 1 tsp cumin, 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 250ml stock. Cover and cook at 160C for 3 hours, then shred and fry in a hot pan until crisp at the edges. Dice 250g pineapple with red onion, coriander and lime. Mix 150g sour cream with lime juice. Fill 12 warm corn tortillas with pork, salsa and crema.
W: black and white stripes, like the suit
Vanilla and chocolate sponge batters piped in alternating stripes into a loaf tin, baked at 170C for 50 minutes, covered in white chocolate ganache with dark chocolate stripes.
K: Blend 45ml white rum, 20ml lime juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half a ripe banana with a cup of ice until smooth.
T: Say it three times. Then eat.
D: A recently dead couple hire an obnoxious ghost to scare the new owners out of their house.
P: Serve the prawns when the dinner party breaks into the Banana Boat song.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
S: a sleepover that doesn't go to plan
Kettle chips with a dip of sour cream, cream cheese, garlic, lemon and lots of fresh herbs blitzed until green and smooth.
Pretzel rods with the tips dipped in melted dark chocolate, set on baking paper in groups of five, a pinch of flaky salt on each.
M: a big pot for a long night
Beef chuck diced and browned, onion, garlic, chipotle, cumin and cocoa, tomato and beans, braised 3 hours at 160C until thick. Sour cream and cheddar.
Nancy dozes off in English class

Saucy beef mince cooked down with onion, capsicum, tomato and brown sugar, piled into toasted brioche buns with melted cheddar and crunchy pickles. Brown 700g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 10 minutes. Stir in 250ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp American mustard and 125ml water. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until thick. Toast 4 brioche buns, lay a slice of cheddar on each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced dill pickles. Serve with plenty of napkins.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with buttercream striped red and green in the piping bag so it swirls.
K: Nancy keeps the pot going all night
Coffee made in a plunger, 60g ground coffee to a litre, steeped 4 minutes, served black in big mugs.
T: Whatever you do, don't fall asleep before dessert.
D: A burned killer hunts teenagers in their dreams.
P: Serve the coffee when Nancy tries to stay awake.

title: Poltergeist
S: Carol Anne talking to the snowy TV
Popcorn tossed in melted butter with fine salt, cracked black pepper and black sesame so it looks like static.
Diane turns around and the chairs are stacked
Thick slices of cheddar, gouda and Swiss stacked in a crooked tower with crackers between each layer, skewered through the middle.
the clown doll on the chair, don't leave him there

Round crackers loaded with cream cheese, salami, a cherry tomato nose and olive eyes, flashed under the grill so the cheese just melts. Mix 150g cream cheese with 50g grated mozzarella and a pinch of oregano. Spread onto 20 round crackers on a tray. Give each a thin round of salami from 100g as a face, half a cherry tomato for a nose, two slices of black olive for eyes and a strip of red capsicum for a grin. Grill for 2 minutes until the cheese is just melting and serve straight away.
M: the one that crawls across the kitchen bench
Rump steaks seasoned, seared hard in a smoking pan, butter, garlic and thyme basted in, pulled at 54C, rested 5 minutes. Jacket potatoes and creamed spinach.
a suburban weeknight dinner in the new estate

Pasta shells, tuna and peas folded through a sharp cheddar white sauce, topped with buttery breadcrumbs and baked until bubbling and golden. Boil 400g pasta shells for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain. Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, then whisk in 700ml milk and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in 200g grated cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard and pepper. Fold through the pasta with 2 x 185g tins drained tuna and 200g frozen peas. Tip into a baking dish, top with 60g breadcrumbs mixed with 20g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: Carol Anne's voice from the TV, they're here
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar to stiff peaks, piped into tall ghostly drops, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven.
K: a hot afternoon in the new estate
Orange soda poured over vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up creamy and orange. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each of 4 glasses and pour over 300ml cold orange soda slowly so it foams.
T: They're here. So is dinner.
D: A suburban family's house is invaded by spirits who take their youngest daughter.
P: Serve the steak when one crawls across the kitchen bench.

title: Fright Night
S: Peter Vincent hosts Fright Night on the telly

Fresh popcorn tossed in roasted garlic butter, finely grated parmesan, parsley and a pinch of smoked paprika, garlic strong enough to keep the neighbour out. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves over low heat for 3 minutes until fragrant, then strain. Pop 120g kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot, shaking until the popping slows. Tip into a big bowl and toss with the garlic butter, 40g finely grated parmesan, 1 tbsp chopped parsley, half a tsp smoked paprika and fine salt while still hot.
Baguette split, spread with butter mashed with lots of raw garlic, parsley and salt, wrapped in foil, baked at 200C for 12 minutes, then opened for 3 to crisp.
the neighbour is always eating an apple
Crisp red apples sliced and tossed in lemon, with a dip of peanut butter whipped with honey and a pinch of salt, or salted caramel.
M: enough garlic to keep Jerry out
Chicken thighs browned skin side down, forty unpeeled garlic cloves, thyme and white wine added, covered and baked at 180C for an hour. Squeeze the garlic onto crusty bread.
the club where Jerry dances with Amy

Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle with cheddar, sticky caramelised onion and garlic aioli in soft buns, a stack of thin fries alongside. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 25 minutes until jammy. Bake 600g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls, smash thin on a smoking griddle, season and cook 90 seconds a side, adding a square of cheddar after flipping. Build in 12 slider buns with onion and aioli.
W: blood red, but Jerry won't touch it
Silky set cream sharpened with blood orange juice, served cold in little glasses with a sliver of candied peel.
K: Holy water lemon, lime and bitters
fill the little bottles before the neighbour visits

Fresh lime, lemon and a good dash of aromatic bitters topped with cold lemonade over crushed ice, poured from small glass bottles. Squeeze 2 limes and 1 lemon. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice. Into each add 15ml lime juice, 10ml lemon juice and 4 dashes aromatic bitters. Top each with 200ml cold lemonade and stir once. Drop in a lime wedge. For the bottle look, mix it all in a jug and pour into 4 small glass bottles before serving over ice.
T: Welcome to Fright Night. Bring garlic.
D: A teenager is convinced the new neighbour is a vampire, and nobody believes him.
P: Serve the snacks when Peter Vincent's late night TV show starts.

title: An American Werewolf in London
S: the pub where everyone goes quiet
Pork rind scored, salted and dried in the fridge overnight, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered and crisp, broken into pieces.
a Yorkshire pub classic on the bar
Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. Hot English mustard.
David wakes up naked in the wolf enclosure at the zoo

Almonds, cashews and peanuts roasted in egg white, brown sugar, rosemary and cayenne until crunchy, with a scatter of flaky salt. Whisk 1 egg white until frothy. Toss with 150g almonds, 150g cashews and 150g peanuts. Mix 60g brown sugar, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, half a tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt and toss through. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 150C for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Cool completely so they crisp, then sprinkle with flaky salt.
M: a pub table on the Yorkshire moors

Thick-cut vintage cheddar and honey leg ham with crusty bread and salted butter, pickled onions, piccalilli, apple and a pork pie cut into wedges. Slice 300g vintage cheddar into thick slabs and 300g honey leg ham. Cut 1 large pork pie into 4 wedges. Quarter 2 crisp apples. Slice a crusty loaf thickly. Arrange everything on a big board with 80g salted butter, a small bowl of pickled onions, 150g piccalilli, a handful of cos lettuce and cherry tomatoes. Serve with a pint for those who want one.
Lamb mince browned with onion, carrot, tomato paste, Worcestershire and stock, simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C until golden.
W: Suet pastry rolled with raspberry jam and baked, served hot with custard. Mix 250g self-raising flour, 125g shredded suet or cold grated butter, 30g sugar and 150ml water into a dough.
K: Keep off the moors mulled ale
stay on the road, the regulars warn

English ale warmed gently with brown sugar, cinnamon, cloves, orange and a splash of brandy, served steaming in heavy glass mugs. Pour 4 x 500ml bottles English ale into a saucepan. Add 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 cinnamon stick, 4 cloves, 2 strips orange peel and a grating of nutmeg. Heat gently for 10 minutes, keeping it well under a simmer so the alcohol stays. Stir in 80ml brandy. Strain into 4 heatproof mugs and serve steaming.
T: Stay on the road. Keep clear of the moors. Order the pie.
D: Two American backpackers are attacked by a werewolf on the Yorkshire moors.
P: Serve the snacks when they walk into the Slaughtered Lamb.

title: The Fly
S: the first steak through the pods tastes synthetic
Sirloin in cubes seared hard in a smoking pan, butter, garlic and thyme basted in, rested, served on toothpicks with horseradish cream.
Yeasted dough rested an hour, cut into rounds, proved, fried at 175C for 90 seconds a side, tossed in caster sugar while warm.
Bartok party blinis and goat's cheese figs
the Bartok press party where Seth meets Veronica

Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, alongside fresh figs stuffed with goat's cheese and drizzled with honey and thyme. Warm 16 store-bought blinis at 180C for 5 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche from 150g, a fold of smoked salmon from 150g, a dill sprig and lemon zest. Cut a cross in the tops of 6 figs and press in 120g soft goat's cheese. Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey, scatter thyme leaves and grill 2 minutes until warm. Serve both on a tray.
M: Veronica says the teleported steak tastes synthetic

Dry-aged style rib eye seared in cast iron and pulled medium rare, with a proper béarnaise, crispy potatoes and dressed watercress, the real thing. Salt 2 large rib eye steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast 1kg diced potatoes in oil at 220C for 40 minutes. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter, add chopped tarragon and salt. Sear the steaks in smoking cast iron, flipping every minute, to 52C, rest 8 minutes and slice. Serve with watercress dressed in oil and lemon.
everything Seth eats now needs sugar
Pork belly roasted at 150C for 2 hours, then glazed with soy, honey, brown sugar and ginger under a hot grill until sticky. Steamed rice and greens.
W: Pears baked in butter, brown sugar and vanilla until soft and sticky, with cream. Halve 4 pears and core.
K: Seth spoons in sugar until the coffee is syrup

Espresso shaken with a dark brown sugar syrup and ice, poured over cold milk with a cap of sweet cream, for when the sugar cravings kick in. Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 100ml water for 2 minutes to make a syrup and cool. Brew 4 double espressos (or 250ml very strong coffee). Shake each shot with 25ml syrup and a handful of ice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, pour over the coffee and top with 2 tbsp lightly whipped cream.
T: Be afraid. Be very hungry.
D: A scientist's teleportation experiment goes wrong and fuses him with a fly.
P: Serve the steak when Seth teleports one and it tastes wrong.

title: Hocus Pocus
S: Pretzel rods dipped in melted white chocolate tinted green, a flaked almond pressed on the tip as a nail, set on baking paper.
Thackery Binx, cursed to live as a black cat

Crisp black sesame and parmesan crackers cut into cat shapes, with a whipped feta and honey dip for little paws. Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 50g grated parmesan, 40g black sesame seeds and half a tsp salt. Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to form a dough. Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick and cut out cat shapes. Bake at 180C for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp. Blitz 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and 1 tbsp honey until smooth.
Cake doughnuts made with reduced apple cider and spice, fried at 175C and tossed in cinnamon sugar while warm.
M: bubbled up in the Sanderson cottage
Lamb shoulder browned, onion, garlic, cumin and cinnamon, stock and tomato, pumpkin added for the last hour, braised 2.5 hours at 160C. Served in a black pot with couscous.
a cold New England Halloween night

Creamy New England chowder of clams, smoky bacon and potato, served in crusty bread bowls with chives and a scatter of oyster crackers. Steam 1kg clams in 125ml white wine, covered, until open, then pick the meat and strain the liquor. Render 150g diced bacon, add 1 onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 6 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam liquor, 500ml milk and 400g diced potato and simmer 15 minutes. Add 200ml cream and the clams and heat through. Hollow 4 round crusty rolls and ladle in. Finish with chives and crackers.
W: Sugar, water, golden syrup and red colouring boiled to 150C, apples on sticks dipped and twirled, set on oiled baking paper.
K: Lime sorbet scooped into a punch bowl, topped with lemonade and pineapple juice so it froths, a few gummy worms over the side.
T: Run amok and eat.
D: Three witch sisters are brought back to life in Salem on Halloween night.
P: Serve the mains when the witches take over the town Halloween party.

title: Scream
S: Casey shaking the pan while the phone rings
Kernels popped in a heavy covered pot in coconut oil, shaken constantly, tipped out and tossed with melted butter and fine salt.
Corn chips with a fresh salsa of diced tomato, red onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime, salted and left 10 minutes to get juicy.
Randy's shift at the video store

Dark and milk chocolate rocky road loaded with marshmallows, raspberry lollies, roasted peanuts and crushed pretzels for a salty crunch. Melt 250g milk chocolate and 150g dark chocolate together over simmering water. Stir in 100g marshmallows, 100g raspberry lollies, 100g roasted peanuts and 60g crushed pretzels. Press into a lined 20cm square tin, sprinkle with flaky salt and chill 2 hours until set. Cut into 16 chunky squares with a hot knife.
M: the horror movie rules at the party

Crisp thin-crust pizza loaded with pepperoni and mushrooms, hot honey drizzled over the top, sliced and left in the box for the crowd. Heat a pizza steel or stone at the highest oven setting for 45 minutes. Stretch 2 x 250g balls pizza dough into thin rounds. Spread each with 100g crushed tomato seasoned with garlic and oregano. Top with 125g mozzarella, 60g pepperoni and 80g sliced mushrooms. Bake each for 7 minutes until blistered. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over. Slice and serve in the boxes.
the party at Stu's house on the night it all goes wrong
Big tray of pasta layered with slow beef ragu and ricotta, topped with mozzarella and baked until bubbling.
W: Vanilla sugar cookies cut into long ovals, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white with royal icing, the face piped on in black.
K: the house party at Stu's place

A big red punch of vodka, cranberry, pineapple and lime topped with lemonade, loaded with ice and orange slices, served in plastic party cups. In a big punch bowl, stir together 200ml vodka, 500ml cranberry juice, 500ml pineapple juice and the juice of 3 limes. Chill for 1 hour. Just before serving, add 750ml cold lemonade, a bag of ice and 1 sliced orange. Ladle into 4 plastic party cups. Swap the vodka for extra lemonade for anyone driving.
T: What's your favourite scary snack.
D: A masked killer stalks high schoolers who know all the rules of horror films.
P: Serve the popcorn when Casey makes stovetop popcorn in the opening.

title: Shaun of the Dead
S: Ed's hangover cure the morning after

Waffle cones dipped in chocolate and crushed nuts, filled with vanilla ice cream rippled with fresh strawberry sauce, a chocolate plug at the bottom. Simmer 250g strawberries with 60g caster sugar and a squeeze of lemon for 8 minutes, then cool. Melt 100g dark chocolate. Drop a spoon of chocolate into each of 4 waffle cones, then dip the rims in chocolate and in 40g crushed roasted hazelnuts. Set in the freezer 10 minutes. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream, ripple through the sauce and pack into the cones. Freeze 30 minutes before serving.
the pub, where everyone waits it out
Peanuts tossed in egg white, smoked paprika, salt and a little sugar, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes until crisp. Served in small bowls on the bar.
Shaun's walk to the corner shop, not noticing a thing
Thinly sliced potatoes fried at 170C until golden, tossed with salt and malt vinegar powder, or just salt and vinegar.
M: the Winchester's menu, if the kitchen's open
Steak and ale filling braised 2.5 hours, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, chips and mushy peas.

Bacon, pork sausages, fried eggs, baked beans, grilled tomato, buttery mushrooms, black pudding and toast, all on one big plate. Bake 8 pork sausages at 200C for 25 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon and 4 slices black pudding until crisp and keep warm. Halve 4 tomatoes and grill cut side up for 8 minutes. Fry 300g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter until golden. Warm 2 x 420g tins baked beans. Fry 4 eggs in the bacon fat until the whites set. Toast and butter 4 thick slices of bread and plate everything together.
W: a table Shaun forgot to book
Dates soaked with bicarb, beaten into a butter sponge, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, drowned in warm toffee sauce with cream.
K: wait for it all to blow over
English bitter or lager in a pint glass, cold, a toast to Ed.
T: Have a cup of tea. Go to the pub. Wait for it to blow over.
D: A slacker in London tries to get his mum and girlfriend to safety during a zombie outbreak.
P: Serve the drinks when they make it to the Winchester.

title: The Addams Family
S: Shortcrust dough rolled into finger shapes, a flaked almond nail pressed in each, knuckles scored, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
she cuts off the blooms and keeps the stems
Beetroot crisps sliced paper thin on a mandoline, tossed in oil, baked at 150C for 25 minutes until curled like petals, salted.
the Mamushka dance at Fester's homecoming

Dark rye toasts topped with pickled herring, sour cream and dill, and roast beetroot with horseradish cream, a Russian-style plate for the family dance. Wrap 3 beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for 50 minutes, then peel and dice. Toast 8 slices dark rye and cut in half. Mix 100g sour cream with chopped dill. Mix 100g crème fraîche with 1 tbsp horseradish. Top half the toasts with dill cream and 200g pickled herring pieces and red onion. Top the rest with horseradish cream and beetroot. Finish with dill and pepper.
M: dinner at the long dining table
Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested 20 minutes, carved at the table with roast potatoes and horseradish.
Grandmama stirring something in the kitchen

Beef shin braised black-dark in red wine with onion, carrot, garlic and mushrooms until it falls apart, ladled over buttery mash from a big black pot. Toss 1.2kg diced beef shin with 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches. Cook 2 onions, 2 carrots and 3 garlic cloves for 8 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 375ml red wine, 500ml beef stock, thyme and bay. Return the beef, cover and cook at 160C for 3 hours, adding 250g mushrooms for the last 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 80g butter and 150ml milk. Serve from the pot.
W: Chocolate sponge layers soaked in kirsch syrup, filled with whipped cream and morello cherries, covered in shaved dark chocolate.
K: the lemonade stand, made from real lemons

Fresh lemon juice blended with blackberries and sugar syrup into a deep inky purple lemonade, served over ice with a sprig of mint. Blend 250g blackberries (frozen is fine) with 150ml sugar syrup and the juice of 5 lemons, then strain through a sieve, pressing hard. Pour into a jug with 1L cold water and stir. Chill for 30 minutes. Serve over ice in 4 tall glasses with a few whole blackberries, a lemon slice and a mint sprig.
T: They're creepy, they're kooky, they're eating.
D: The Addams family's long-lost Uncle Fester turns up, or does he.
P: Serve the lemonade when Wednesday sets up her lemonade stand.

title: Addams Family Values
S: camp dinner before the Thanksgiving play

Saucy beef sloppy joe mince with capsicum and a tangy tomato glaze, piled into soft slider buns with crunchy dill pickles and melted cheddar. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 10 minutes. Add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp American mustard and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Split 12 slider buns, lay half a slice of cheddar on each base, spoon on the mince and top with sliced dill pickles.
Vanilla shortbread rounds baked at 160C for 15 minutes, a thin line of dark chocolate piped across as a smile.
the camp cookout at Camp Chippewa

Thin pork sausages charred over hot coals until blistered, tucked into soft rolls with sticky onions, mild mustard and tomato relish. Slice 2 onions and cook slowly in 30g butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden, adding 1 tsp brown sugar at the end. Cook 12 thin pork sausages on a barbecue or grill pan over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning often, until blistered and cooked through. Split 12 small soft rolls and fill each with a sausage, a spoon of onions, mild mustard and tomato relish.
M: the Thanksgiving play that goes very wrong

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy and sliced, with sage and onion stuffing, cranberry sauce, buttery mash and proper pan gravy. Dissolve 60g salt and 30g sugar in 2L water and brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight. Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C for about 75 minutes until 70C inside, then rest 20 minutes.
