Bake 150g breadcrumbs mixed with 1 sautéed onion, sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Lobster tails split and grilled with lemon and garlic butter, a crisp green salad and buttery new potatoes.
W: Roast pumpkin purée whisked with eggs, brown sugar, cream and spices, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: the camp canteen at Camp Chippewa

Fresh lemon juice and raspberries blitzed with sugar syrup and ice into a tangy pink slush, served in tall cups with a lemon wheel. Blend 200g frozen raspberries with 150ml fresh lemon juice (about 5 lemons) and 150ml sugar syrup until smooth, then strain out the seeds. Return to the blender with 500ml cold water and 4 cups of ice and blend until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 tall cups with a lemon wheel and a spoon straw.
T: Summer camp. Thanksgiving play.
D: The Addams kids are sent to summer camp while a gold-digger targets Uncle Fester.
P: Serve the mains at the camp Thanksgiving play.

title: The Witches
S: afternoon tea at the seaside hotel
Crustless sandwiches of cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and smoked salmon with dill, cut into fingers and laid on a tiered stand.
where the RSPCC holds its meeting

Soft white finger sandwiches of fresh crab in lemony mayonnaise with crisp cucumber and chives, crusts off, the way a seaside hotel does them. Mix 250g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest of 1 lemon, a squeeze of juice, chopped chives and pepper. Butter 8 slices soft white bread with 30g butter. Spread the crab over 4 slices, lay thin slices of 1 Lebanese cucumber on top and close with the remaining bread. Press gently, trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

Salmon cured for two days in salt, sugar, dill and white pepper, sliced paper thin onto rye with a sweet mustard and dill sauce. Mix 60g salt, 60g sugar and 1 tsp crushed white pepper. Lay a 600g skin-on salmon fillet in a dish, cover with the cure and a big bunch of chopped dill, wrap tightly and weigh down. Refrigerate 48 hours, turning every 12 hours. Scrape off the cure and slice very thin. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 60ml oil and chopped dill. Serve on 8 slices rye bread.
M: the hotel soup, minus the Mouse-Maker

Leeks and potato sweated in butter, chicken stock added and simmered 20 minutes, watercress stirred in for 1 minute, blitzed bright green, finished with cream. Sweat 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced potatoes in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Add 1L chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 2 bunches watercress for 1 minute, then blitz until bright green. Finish with 100ml cream.
the hotel's on the Cornish coast

Flathead in a crisp soda water batter with double-fried chips, minty mushy peas, tartare sauce and lemon, wrapped in paper like the seaside shops. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then at 190C for 3 minutes. Simmer 400g frozen peas with 30g butter and mint for 5 minutes and mash roughly. Whisk 200g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml cold soda water. Dust 4 flathead fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g mayonnaise with gherkins, capers and lemon. Serve with lemon wedges.
W: the whole cake, in front of everyone
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 40 minutes, covered in a thick dark ganache. Serve in thin slices.
K: afternoon tea in the hotel lounge

English breakfast tea brewed strong, sweetened with honey and blended with ripe peach, chilled and poured over ice with lemon and mint. Steep 4 English breakfast tea bags in 800ml boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and stir in 3 tbsp honey. Cool. Blend 2 ripe peaches (or 400g tinned peaches, drained) with 200ml cold water and strain into the tea. Chill 2 hours. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses with lemon slices and a sprig of mint.
T: Real witches hate children. They love soup.
D: A boy and his grandmother stumble onto a witches' convention at a seaside hotel in England.
P: Serve dessert when Bruno is told to eat the whole cake.

title: Little Shop of Horrors
S: Radish roses, carrot ribbons, cucumber and baby capsicum arranged in a vase like a bunch of flowers, with a green goddess dip.
Small hard taco shells filled with spiced beef mince, lettuce and cheese, a few strips of red capsicum hanging out like a tongue.
Baby plant sesame chilli sugar snaps
little green pods, like the baby plant

Crisp sugar snap peas flashed in boiling water, tossed with sesame oil, chilli, lime and flaky salt, with a creamy miso mayo for dipping. Bring a pot of salted water to the boil and blanch 400g sugar snap peas for 30 seconds, then plunge into iced water and drain well. Toss with 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds, half a sliced red chilli, a squeeze of lime and flaky salt. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp white miso and 1 tsp lime juice for dipping.
M: Audrey dreams of a tidy suburban life and dinner on a tray

Golden crumbed chicken schnitzel with buttery mashed potato, peas and corn and a little pot of gravy, all served on a sectioned tray like a fifties TV dinner. Flatten 2 large chicken breasts and cut each into 2. Dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs, then 150g panko mixed with parmesan. Shallow fry in 1cm oil for 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Cook 300g frozen peas and corn with butter. Make 300ml gravy from a packet mix. Arrange on 4 trays in sections.
the plant wants more, so do you
Beef and pork meatballs with soaked bread, parmesan and parsley, browned, then simmered 40 minutes in a tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
W: Buttermilk cupcakes tinted deep green, baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cream cheese frosting with red sugar on top like the plant's lips.
K: for the hungry plant on Skid Row

Lime sorbet floated in a frothy bowl of lemonade, pineapple juice and fresh lime, bright green and fizzing, with mint leaves on top. Pour 500ml cold pineapple juice and the juice of 3 limes into a punch bowl. Add 1.25L cold lemonade slowly so it keeps its fizz. Drop in 8 scoops of lime sorbet so they float and froth up the top. Scatter with torn mint and thin lime slices and ladle into 4 glasses straight away.
T: Feed me. Then feed everyone else.
D: A nerdy florist raises a talking plant that grows by eating people.
P: Serve the mains when Audrey II says feed me.

title: The Shining
S: Hallorann's tour of the giant pantry

A big board of marinated olives, pickled vegetables, salami, provolone and grissini, laid out in neat rows like the stacked tins in the hotel stores. Warm 250g mixed olives in 60ml olive oil with strips of orange peel, 1 sliced garlic clove and chilli flakes for 5 minutes, then cool. Slice 150g salami and 150g provolone. Arrange on a big board in tidy rows with the olives, 200g giardiniera pickled vegetables, 100g marinated artichokes, 1 packet grissini and a handful of cornichons. Serve at room temperature.
Hedge maze herb crackers and whipped feta
the hedge maze outside, under the snow

Parmesan and herb crackers scored with a maze pattern and studded with rosemary and parsley, with a snowy whipped feta dip. Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 40g grated parmesan, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and half a tsp salt, then add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to bring it together. Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick between baking paper and cut into squares. Score a maze into each with a knife. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest.

Warm mixed nuts roasted with butter, brown sugar, rosemary and a pinch of cayenne until glossy, served in silver bowls along the Gold Room bar. Toss 400g mixed unsalted nuts with 30g melted butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tsp salt flakes and a pinch of cayenne. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and fragrant. Cool for 5 minutes so the coating sets, then serve warm in small bowls.
M: the walk-in freezer tour, Dick knows every shelf

Leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink with crisp potatoes cooked in the pan juices and a rich gravy, carved at the table. Stud a 2kg leg of lamb with 4 sliced garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs, rub with oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 200C for 1 hour 20 minutes with 1kg quartered potatoes around it. Rest 15 minutes and make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
the tray Wendy takes up to Jack

Soft buttery scrambled eggs on sourdough with crisp bacon, grilled tomato and mushrooms, fresh orange juice and a pot of coffee, all on one tray. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Halve 4 tomatoes and grill 6 minutes. Sauté 250g mushrooms in 20g butter. Whisk 8 eggs with 60ml cream and salt and cook over low heat in 30g butter, stirring slowly, for 4 to 5 minutes until just set. Toast 4 slices sourdough. Plate on trays with a glass of fresh orange juice squeezed from 6 oranges and a pot of coffee.
W: he asks Danny if he likes chocolate ice cream
Cream and milk warmed with dark chocolate and cocoa, whisked into yolks and sugar, cooked to 82C, chilled and churned.
K: Jack's order from Lloyd at the Gold Room

Bourbon stirred down with a little demerara syrup and aromatic bitters over one big ice block, finished with a twist of orange peel. For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 10ml demerara sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with ice in a mixing glass for 20 seconds. Strain into a rocks glass over one large ice block. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in. Totals are 240ml bourbon, 40ml syrup and 1 orange.
T: All work and no play. So, dinner.
D: A writer takes a winter job as caretaker of an empty mountain hotel with his wife and son.
P: Serve the drinks when Jack sits down at the Gold Room bar.

title: Young Frankenstein
S: Aged cheddar, gouda and Swiss on a dark wooden board with rye crackers, pickled onions and mustard.
Beetroot hummus: roasted beetroot blended with chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic, swirled in a bowl, served with crackers.
M: the hermit pours hot soup into the monster's lap

A big pot of chicken and vegetable soup with shredded thigh meat, egg noodles, dill and lemon, ladled out hot with crusty bread. Simmer 800g chicken thighs in 2L chicken stock with 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks, diced, and 2 bay leaves for 45 minutes. Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot. Add 150g egg noodles and cook 6 minutes. Season with salt, pepper and the juice of half a lemon, and stir in chopped dill. Serve hot with crusty bread.
a hearty dinner in the castle
Beef chuck browned, onions cooked down slowly, sweet paprika, caraway and tomato, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Buttered egg noodles and sour cream.
W: Chocolate cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, a tall swirl of chocolate buttercream and a white chocolate disc as a hat brim.
K: Frau Blücher offers brandy, then warm milk, before bed

Hot milk whisked with honey, vanilla and cinnamon until frothy, spiked with brandy and dusted with nutmeg, the two offers in one mug. Warm 800ml full cream milk with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick and half a tsp vanilla extract until steaming, without boiling. Rest 5 minutes and remove the cinnamon. Whisk hard until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, add 30ml brandy to each and grate over a little nutmeg. Leave out the brandy for the warm milk crowd.
T: It's pronounced Fronkensteen. The food is pronounced delicious.
D: The grandson of Dr Frankenstein returns to the family castle and can't resist the experiment.
P: Serve the goulash when Frederick and Igor first reach the castle.

title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
S: Thick white bread soaked in vanilla custard, fried golden in butter, cut into soldiers and rolled in cinnamon sugar, with maple syrup to dip. Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml milk, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Cut 6 thick slices white bread into 3 fingers each. Soak each finger for 10 seconds and fry in batches in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden. Roll straight away in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with 125ml warm maple syrup for dipping.
Cocktail frankfurts simmered in a sticky glaze of tomato sauce, brown sugar and mustard, served on toothpicks.
the Transylvanian party in the castle

Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, chilli, fennel seeds and garlic, with crusty bread to mop up the oil. Toast 1 tsp fennel seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute. Add 100ml olive oil, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 4 strips orange peel and half a tsp chilli flakes and warm gently for 4 minutes. Add 400g mixed green and black olives and heat through for 5 minutes, stirring. Rest 10 minutes so the flavours soak in. Serve warm with a sliced crusty baguette.
M: best not ask what's in it
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs soaked in milk, onion, egg and Worcestershire, shaped in a loaf tin, glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour.

Dry-brined roast chicken with crisp skin, garlicky roast potatoes, honey carrots and pan gravy, carved at the head of a long candlelit table. Salt a 1.8kg chicken and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the thigh hits 75C, and rest. Parboil 1kg potatoes 8 minutes, toss with oil and 4 garlic cloves and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with 1 tbsp honey. Make gravy with the juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Frank brings his creation to life on its birthday
Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C for 25 minutes, cooled, split and layered with strawberry jam and whipped cream, covered in vanilla buttercream brushed with edible gold, candles in.
K: the red lips singing in the dark

Vodka shaken hard with orange liqueur, cranberry and fresh lime, strained into chilled coupes with a flamed orange twist. Chill 4 coupes. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and 15ml lime juice with plenty of ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupes. Hold a strip of orange peel over each glass, warm it with a match and squeeze so the oil flashes, then drop it in. Totals are 160ml vodka and 60ml orange liqueur.
T: Let's do the time warp. Then eat.
D: A stranded couple find shelter in a castle run by a mad scientist from Transsexual, Transylvania.
P: Serve the toast when Frank proposes one at dinner.

title: Practical Magic
S: Soft goat's cheese rolled in finely chopped rosemary, thyme, lavender and lemon zest, drizzled with honey and served with crackers.
the herbs hanging in the kitchen
Butter, sugar and flour with dried lavender rubbed in, pressed into a tray, baked at 160C for 25 minutes, dusted with sugar.
something to soak up the midnight margaritas

Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked bubbling and topped with lime guacamole, sour cream and fresh tomato salsa. Layer 300g corn chips in a baking dish with a drained 400g tin black beans, 200g grated cheddar and 40g pickled jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 to 10 minutes until melted. Mash 2 avocados with lime juice and salt. Dice 2 tomatoes with half a red onion, coriander and lime. Top the nachos with the guacamole, salsa and 150g sour cream.
M: Chicken stuffed with lemon, garlic and herbs, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, rested, with roast vegetables and a lemon gravy.
Owens house roast pumpkin and sage soup
a pot always going in the aunts' kitchen

Roast pumpkin and garlic blended silky with stock and cream, topped with crisp sage brown butter, toasted pepitas and warm sourdough. Toss 1.5kg peeled pumpkin chunks and 1 garlic bulb, halved, with oil and salt and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Squeeze out the garlic and blend with the pumpkin, 1 litre chicken stock and 100ml cream until smooth, then heat through. Fry 12 sage leaves in 40g butter until crisp and the butter browns. Toast 40g pepitas. Serve topped with sage butter and pepitas, with sourdough.
W: the aunts let the girls have it
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs, sugar and buttermilk, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 35 minutes, chocolate fudge frosting.
K: 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur, 25ml lime juice, shaken hard with ice, salt rim.
T: Midnight margaritas. Chocolate cake for breakfast.
D: Two witch sisters raised by their aunts deal with a family curse on love.
P: Serve the margaritas at midnight when the aunts start dancing.

title: The Castle
S: Sal's party pies and sausage rolls

Homemade sausage rolls with carrot and thyme and little beef party pies in flaky pastry, piping hot with a big bowl of tomato sauce. Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion, 1 grated carrot, thyme and 40g breadcrumbs. Roll in 2 halved puff pastry sheets, egg wash and cut into 16. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 onion, add 1 tbsp flour, 200ml stock and Worcestershire and simmer 15 minutes, then cool. Line 12 patty tins with shortcrust rounds, fill, top with puff and egg wash. Bake everything at 200C for 25 minutes.
the holiday shack at Bonnie Doon
Kabana sliced on the diagonal, cubes of tasty cheese, round butter crackers and pickled onions, toothpicks in, on a plastic platter.
it's going straight to the pool room
Cooked king prawns peeled, piled on ice with a Marie Rose sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire and lemon, wedges on the side.
M: Darryl tells her it's beautiful every night
Beef mince with grated onion, carrot, an egg, breadcrumbs and a splash of Worcestershire, shaped and fried in a hot pan until browned, finished in onion gravy. Mash and peas.
the family barbie under the power lines

Thick beef snags and rosemary garlic lamb chops off the hotplate, fried onions, buttered white bread and a creamy potato salad, Darryl's way. Marinate 8 lamb loin chops in olive oil, rosemary and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes, cool and toss with 150g mayonnaise, chopped spring onion and parsley. Cook 8 thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate with oil until soft. Grill the chops 3 minutes a side. Serve with buttered white bread and tomato sauce.
W: Sal goes all out for a special occasion
Eggs and sugar whisked 10 minutes until pale and thick, cornflour and flour sifted and folded in, baked at 180C for 20 minutes, filled with jam and cream, icing sugar on top.
K: Bonnie Doon lager and lime shandy

Ice-cold Aussie lager topped with lemonade and fresh lime over ice, poured into chilled pot glasses with a lime wedge. Chill 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each. Pour 200ml cold Australian lager into each glass, tilting it, then top with 150ml cold lemonade. Stir once gently and add a lime wedge. Make lemon, lime and lemonade ones for the kids and the driver.
T: How's the serenity.
D: A Melbourne family fights to keep their home next to the airport from being compulsorily acquired.
P: Serve the mains when Darryl asks Sal what's for tea.

title: Mad Max
S: the Main Force Patrol's highway stop

Thick-cut chips double fried at 140C then 190C, tossed in chicken salt, served in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C, then 190C. Toss in chicken salt. Whisk 3 tbsp gravy powder into 375ml boiling water. Serve the chips in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping.
Pickling onions brined overnight, packed in hot spiced vinegar with sugar, chilli and peppercorns, pickled a week. Served with tasty cheese and crackers.
M: the family trip up the coast

Flathead fillets in crisp beer batter with thick chips, chicken salt, lemon and a punchy tartare, wrapped in paper and eaten by the water. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, fry at 140C for 7 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes and toss with chicken salt. Whisk 200g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml cold beer. Dust 4 flathead fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, dill and lemon. Wrap in paper with lemon wedges.
Last of the V8s highway meat pie
a servo pie for the black Interceptor run

Beef chuck braised in stock and Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, thickened, cooled, in shortcrust with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 500ml stock and 2 tbsp Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and cool. Line 4 pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Sauce on top.
W: Jessie stops for ice cream on the coastal holiday
Vanilla ice cream scooped into waffle cones, drizzled with a hard chocolate shell of dark chocolate melted with coconut oil, which sets in seconds.
K: Strong coffee cooled, poured over ice with cold milk, a scoop of vanilla ice cream and whipped cream.
T: Last of the V8 Interceptors. First of the snacks.
D: A highway patrol cop takes on a vicious bikie gang in a near-future Australia.
P: Serve the mains when Max and his family head off on their coastal holiday.

title: Mad Max 2
S: Max eats from a tin, and it's not people food
Tins of corned beef hash: corned beef, diced potato and onion fried hard until crisp, served in clean tins with a fried egg.
the kid with the metal boomerang
Shortbread cut into boomerang shapes, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, edges dipped in dark chocolate.
the snake that guards his gyrocopter

A long chain of frankfurts wrapped in puff pastry and coiled like a snake, sesame crusted and baked golden, with smoky barbecue and mustard dips. Lay 8 frankfurts end to end on 3 puff pastry sheets cut into strips, roll the pastry around them and press the joins together. Coil the long roll on a lined tray like a snake and shape a head at one end with 2 peppercorns for eyes. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with barbecue sauce and mustard.
M: food for the people in the compound
Lamb shoulder rubbed with salt, garlic, rosemary and paprika, roasted low at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Flatbreads, yoghurt and tomato salad.
Tanker convoy beef stew and damper
a big pot for the run with the tanker

Beef chuck braised for three hours in a dark tomato and stock gravy with carrot and potato, with warm cheesy damper torn at the table. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 2 onions and 2 carrots 5 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 400g tinned tomatoes and 750ml beef stock and return the beef. Cover and cook at 160C for 2 hours, add 600g diced potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Mix 450g self-raising flour, 60g rubbed-in butter, 100g grated cheddar and 300ml milk, shape a round and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.
W: Scone dough dumplings dropped into simmering golden syrup and butter, covered and cooked 20 minutes, served with cream.
K: dark, precious fuel in the wasteland

Dark rum floated over spicy ginger beer and fresh lime in tall glasses of ice, black and amber like a jerry can of guzzoline. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml cold ginger beer. Pour 45ml dark rum slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats dark on top. Add a lime wedge and serve unstirred. Totals are 180ml dark rum, 600ml ginger beer and 2 limes. Skip the rum for a plain ginger beer and lime.
T: Guzzoline not included.
D: In the wasteland, a loner helps a fuel-rich compound break through a siege.
P: Serve the snacks when Max eats his tinned dinner.

title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
S: Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and a toasted almond, dried figs halved, aged cheddar in shards and crackers, all laid out on a rough board like a market stall.

Strips of pork rind salted and dried overnight, roasted until blistered and shatteringly crisp, with a sharp apple and mustard dipping sauce. Score 800g pork rind, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Pat dry, cut into strips and roast on a rack at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered, then rest. Simmer 2 peeled, chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and 50ml water for 10 minutes and mash, then stir in 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and a splash of cider vinegar. Break the crackling into shards and serve with the sauce.

Self-raising flour with a pinch of salt, butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife until just combined, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Butter and golden syrup.
M: everything in Bartertown runs on pigs

Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, roasted low until it pulls apart, piled into soft rolls with tangy slaw and barbecue sauce. Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp salt and 1 tsp garlic powder. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, then shred with the pan juices. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 100g mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 8 soft rolls with pork, slaw and 150ml barbecue sauce.
the boss of Bartertown eats well

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, rubbed with oil and salt, roasted at 180C until 58C in the thickest part, rested 20 minutes, sliced, with a fresh mint sauce of chopped mint, sugar, vinegar and boiling water.
W: Butter sponge cubes dipped in thin chocolate icing, rolled in desiccated coconut, jam and cream in the middle.
K: A quick homemade ginger beer of fresh ginger, lemon and brown sugar syrup topped with soda, fiery and cloudy, served over ice with lime. Grate 100g fresh ginger and simmer with 150g brown sugar and 300ml water for 10 minutes. Cool, then strain, pressing hard on the ginger. Stir in the juice of 2 lemons. Divide the syrup between 4 tall glasses of ice and top each with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and add a lime wedge and a thin slice of ginger.
T: Two men enter. One snack leaves.
D: Max ends up in Bartertown and its fight to the death arena.
P: Serve the mains when the Thunderdome match begins.

title: Young Einstein
S: the family apple orchard in Tasmania

Paper-thin apple slices dusted with cinnamon sugar and dried slowly until crisp, with a whipped honey and vanilla yoghurt dip. Core 4 crisp apples and slice 2mm thin on a mandoline. Toss with the juice of 1 lemon, then 2 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Lay in a single layer on lined trays and bake at 110C for about 2 hours, turning once, until dry. Cool on the trays so they crisp. Stir 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey and half a tsp vanilla to dip.
Albert's Tasmanian home, beer with bubbles

Thick-cut potato chips dipped in a light beer batter and fried crunchy and golden, tossed in chicken salt with aioli on the side. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and parboil 5 minutes, then drain and steam dry 10 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Dip the chips in the batter and fry in batches at 180C for 5 minutes until golden. Drain and toss with chicken salt. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice for dipping.
he invents rock and roll, Tassie invents the scallop pie
Scallops in a curry cream sauce with onion, in shortcrust pastry with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
M: Pork chops browned, then simmered with apple cider, apples, onion and sage for 20 minutes. Mash.
fish in a batter made with the beer he put bubbles in

Flathead in an extra-crisp beer and rice flour batter with chunky chips, lemon and a tartare sauce full of capers and gherkins. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes. Whisk 120g plain flour, 60g rice flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml ice-cold beer until just combined. Dust 4 flathead fillets in flour, dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, parsley and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges.
W: Granny Smiths with sugar and cinnamon in a double crust, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Cream.
K: Albert splits the beer atom to put the bubbles in

Half crisp Australian lager and half cloudy Tasmanian apple cider poured into chilled pint glasses, with a dash of blackcurrant cordial at the bottom. Chill 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Add 10ml blackcurrant cordial to each glass. Pour in 250ml cold apple cider down the side, then top slowly with 250ml cold lager so it layers and foams. Serve straight away. Totals are 1L cider and 1L lager.
T: He split the beer atom. Pass the bubbles.
D: A Tasmanian apple farmer's son splits the beer atom and invents rock and roll.
P: Serve the drinks when Einstein puts the bubbles into beer.

title: Babe
S: the duck who'd rather be a rooster

Egg and lettuce sandwiches on soft white bread, eggs boiled 10 minutes, mashed with mayo, chives and white pepper. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chives and white pepper. Spread on 8 slices soft white bread with shredded iceberg, close and cut into triangles.
Ewe's milk cheese (pecorino), sheep's feta and fresh ricotta on a board with honey, figs and crackers.
Ferdinand the duck, sneaking round the vegie patch

Crisp baby carrots, radish, cucumber, snow peas and cherry tomatoes with a bright green goddess dip of herbs, sour cream and lemon. Blitz 150g sour cream, 80g mayonnaise, a handful each of parsley, basil and chives, 1 spring onion, the juice of half a lemon and salt until smooth and green. Chill 30 minutes. Trim 1 bunch baby carrots and 1 bunch radishes, cut 1 Lebanese cucumber into sticks and top 150g snow peas. Arrange around the dip with 250g cherry tomatoes.
M: Farmhouse leek, mushroom and cheddar pie
no pigs or ducks were harmed in this pie

Leek, mushroom and potato in a creamy cheddar and thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttered peas on the side. Boil 500g diced potato for 8 minutes and drain. Cook 2 sliced leeks and 300g sliced mushrooms in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 400ml milk and simmer 3 minutes. Add 150g grated cheddar, thyme, the potato, salt and pepper. Pour into a pie dish, cover with 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with 400g buttered peas.
the sheep Babe herds, but with beef in the pie
Beef mince browned hard, onion and carrot softened, tomato paste, Worcestershire and stock, simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash, forked and baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
W: the sheep password Babe promises to keep

Apples stewed with sugar and cinnamon, crumble of flour, butter, oats and brown sugar, baked at 180C for 35 minutes. Stew 6 sliced apples with 60g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 10 minutes and tip into a dish. Rub 100g butter into 100g flour, then stir in 60g oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over and bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Serve with custard.
K: Cold full cream milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, malt powder and a drizzle of honey, topped with whipped cream in tall glasses. Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp honey in a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks and spoon on top, then dust with a pinch of malt powder.
T: That'll do, pig. No pork on this menu.
D: A piglet raised by sheepdogs learns to herd sheep.
P: Serve dessert when Farmer Hoggett says that'll do, pig.

title: Muriel's Wedding
S: a seaside town on the Queensland coast
Cooked king prawns peeled, piled into glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, lemon and a dash of hot sauce, a lemon wedge on the rim.
Puff pastry cases baked at 200C, filled with chicken and mushroom in a creamy white sauce with tarragon and a squeeze of lemon, warmed through before serving.

Pineapple, mango, papaya and lychees on crushed ice with lime cheeks, a chilli lime salt and a passionfruit and coconut yoghurt dip. Peel and cut 1 pineapple and 2 mangoes into wedges, slice half a papaya and peel 250g lychees. Arrange over a tray of crushed ice with 2 limes cut into cheeks. Mix 1 tbsp sea salt with half a tsp chilli powder and the zest of 1 lime. Stir the pulp of 3 passionfruit into 200g coconut yoghurt with 1 tbsp honey. Serve the salt and dip on the side.
M: the alternate drop at every Aussie wedding reception

Every second guest gets chicken breast in creamy mushroom sauce, the rest get eye fillet with red wine jus, both with dauphinoise and green beans. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Sear 2 chicken breasts and 2 eye fillet steaks. Roast the chicken at 200C for 15 minutes and the beef 8 minutes, then rest. In one pan cook 200g mushrooms, add 150ml cream. In another reduce 125ml red wine with 200ml beef stock. Steam 300g green beans. Plate alternately.
Sweet and sour pork: pork shoulder in a light batter, fried at 180C, tossed in a sauce of pineapple, capsicum, vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce. Steamed rice.
W: three tiers of white, the dream
Vanilla butter cake baked at 165C, layered with raspberry jam and buttercream, covered in white fondant, a few fresh flowers on top. Serve in fingers.
K: White rum blended with pineapple, coconut cream and lime into a thick frozen colada, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge and umbrella. Put 180ml white rum, 250ml pineapple juice, 150ml coconut cream, 60ml lime juice and 1 tbsp sugar syrup into a blender with 4 cups of ice. Blend until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses and garnish each with a pineapple wedge, a cocktail cherry and a paper umbrella. Swap the rum for extra pineapple juice to make it alcohol-free.
T: You're terrible, Muriel. The food isn't.
D: A lonely young woman from Porpoise Spit dreams of a big white wedding and a life in Sydney.
P: Serve the cocktails when Muriel and Rhonda hit the island resort.

title: Strictly Ballroom
S: Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and cucumber cups filled with whipped goat's cheese and chives, laid on silver trays.
behind the shop with Fran's family
Potatoes and onion sliced thin and cooked slowly in plenty of olive oil for 25 minutes, drained, folded into beaten eggs, cooked in a pan, flipped and cut into squares.
Rico shows Scott the real paso doble out the back

Crisp roast potato cubes under a smoky, spicy tomato bravas sauce and garlic aioli, finished with paprika and parsley. Cut 1kg potatoes into 3cm cubes and boil 5 minutes. Drain, toss in 60ml olive oil and salt and roast at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Cook 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil for 5 minutes, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp cayenne and 400g crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes, then blend. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove. Top the potatoes with both sauces and parsley.
M: Chicken thighs and chorizo browned in a wide pan, onion, garlic, capsicum and paprika, Calasparra rice and saffron stock, cooked without stirring for 20 minutes, prawns pushed in for the last 5. Brown 600g chicken thigh pieces and 150g sliced chorizo in a wide pan. Add an onion, 2 garlic cloves, a red capsicum and 1 tsp paprika. Stir in 300g paella rice and 1L hot stock with saffron and cook without stirring for 20 minutes. Push in 300g prawns for the last 5.
the Federation's dinner dance, Barry Fife presiding

Butter-basted chicken breasts with a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce, crunchy roast potatoes and steamed broccolini, a proper dinner dance plate. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, toss in oil and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in oil 4 minutes a side, add 30g butter and thyme and baste, then finish at 200C for 10 minutes. Rest. In the same pan cook 250g sliced mushrooms and 1 shallot, add 125ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Steam 2 bunches broccolini.
W: Choux dough of water, butter and flour piped into hot oil at 180C, fried golden, tossed in cinnamon sugar, with thick hot chocolate for dipping.
K: Rico shows Scott the real steps out the back

Red wine, brandy, orange juice and sliced orange, lemon and apple in a jug, chilled 2 hours, topped with soda. Mix a 750ml bottle of red wine, 60ml brandy and 250ml orange juice in a jug with a sliced orange, lemon and apple. Chill 2 hours, then top with 300ml soda water and pour over ice.
T: A life lived in fear is a life half lived. Have seconds.
D: A champion ballroom dancer risks everything by dancing his own steps with a beginner.
P: Serve the mains when Fran's dad shows Scott the real paso doble.

title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
S: Sausage mince with grated onion, carrot and herbs rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame seeds on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.

Shimmering cubes of blue, green and purple jelly set inside clear lemon jelly and cut into chunks, with a little edible glitter like raw opal. Make three 85g packets of blue, green and purple jelly with 250ml boiling water each, set in shallow trays for 2 hours and cut into small cubes. Soak 6 gelatine leaves, dissolve in 500ml hot lemonade with 2 tbsp lemon juice and cool. Scatter the cubes into a lined 20cm tin, pour over the clear jelly and set 3 hours. Cut into chunks and dust with edible glitter.

Warm golden bush damper with a crusty top, torn open at the table with cold butter and a good pour of golden syrup. Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt, add 300ml milk and mix to a soft dough. Shape a round, cut a cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.
M: Bob the mechanic who helps them out on the road

Thick beef snags grilled slowly, rosemary and garlic lamb chops, fried onions and a tomato, cucumber and red onion salad, served on the tailgate. Marinate 8 lamb chops in olive oil, rosemary, 2 crushed garlic cloves and lemon zest for 30 minutes. Cook 8 thick beef sausages over medium coals for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate with oil until soft and golden. Grill the chops 3 minutes a side. Toss 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 cucumber and half a red onion with oil, vinegar and salt. Serve with bread and sauce.
they finally make it to Alice
Kangaroo fillet marinated in pepperberry, garlic and oil, seared hard to rare, rested, sliced, with a quandong or plum sauce and roast sweet potato.
W: a climb to the top in heels and sequins

Egg whites whisked with caster sugar, cornflour and vinegar, shaped into a round, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, passionfruit and strawberries. Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 3 passionfruit and 250g strawberries.
K: the show at Alice Springs, finally on stage

Fresh raspberry and peach purée topped with chilled sparkling rosé in flutes, a single raspberry dropped in each glass. Blend 150g raspberries with 1 ripe peach (or 200g tinned peaches, drained) and 1 tbsp sugar syrup until smooth, then strain. Spoon 30ml purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Top slowly with 150ml cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.
T: A cock in a frock on a rock. And a picnic.
D: Three drag performers drive a bus from Sydney to Alice Springs for a show.
P: Serve the snacks when the bus pulls into Broken Hill.

title: The Man from Snowy River
S: cooked in the coals on the high plains
Self-raising flour, salt and butter rubbed together, milk mixed in with a knife, shaped into a round, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until hollow when tapped. Butter and golden syrup.
Corned silverside simmered 3 hours with onion, carrot and peppercorns, cooled, sliced thin onto buttered bread with hot English mustard and pickles.

Slow-braised lamb shoulder with onion, rosemary and gravy in shortcrust pastry with flaky lids, hot pies with tomato sauce for the saddlebag. Brown 800g diced lamb shoulder, add 1 onion, rosemary, 1 tbsp flour, 400ml beef stock and Worcestershire. Cover and simmer gently 2 hours, then shred and cool. Line 6 pie tins with 2 sheets shortcrust pastry, fill, top with lids cut from 2 sheets puff pastry and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
M: cooked over the fire on the high plains
Lamb shoulder chops browned in a camp oven, onion, carrot, potato and stock, covered and simmered over coals or at 160C for 2.5 hours, rosemary and parsley.
dinner at the big station house

Beef sirloin roasted pink and carved at the table, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and pumpkin, horseradish cream and red wine gravy. Season a 1.5kg beef sirloin and roast at 200C for 40 minutes until 52C inside, then rest 20 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Whisk 140g flour, 3 eggs and 250ml milk, pour into 12 hot oiled muffin holes and bake at 230C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with the juices, 125ml red wine and 300ml stock. Mix 150g sour cream with horseradish.
W: Colt from Old Regret spotted dog
the prize colt that got away to the brumbies

Self-raising flour, suet or butter, sugar and currants mixed with milk, wrapped in a floured cloth, steamed 2 hours. Rub 100g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 75g sugar and 150g currants, then add 150ml milk to a soft dough. Wrap in a floured cloth or basin and steam for 2 hours. Serve with golden syrup and custard.
K: Clancy of the Overflow, boiled over the fire

Water boiled in a billy, tea leaves thrown in, a gum leaf if you have one, swung around to settle, poured into tin mugs with milk and sugar. Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Throw in 3 tbsp loose leaf tea and a gum leaf if you have one, take it off the heat and swing it round to settle the leaves. Pour into tin mugs with milk and sugar.
T: The ride was hard. The tucker was better.
D: A young man proves himself as a horseman in the Australian high country.
P: Serve the mains when Jim rides down the mountain after the brumbies.

title: Gallipoli
S: the biscuits sent to the troops
Rolled oats, flour, coconut and sugar mixed with melted butter, golden syrup and bicarb dissolved in boiling water, rolled, flattened, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
Frank and Archy race to the pyramids on leave

Hummus, baba ganoush and warm flatbread with dukkah, olives and cucumber, a dusting of paprika and plenty of olive oil. Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.
Archy's WA cheese and chive damper
the station in WA where Archy trains with Uncle Jack

A crusty round of damper studded with tasty cheese and chives, baked golden and torn open warm with salted butter. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 120g grated tasty cheese and a handful of chopped chives. Add 300ml milk and mix with a knife into a soft dough. Shape a round on a floured tray, cut a cross on top and scatter with 30g more cheese. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve warm with butter.
M: Frank and Archy's Cairo kofta wraps
Frank and Archy on leave in Cairo

Spiced lamb kofta grilled over high heat, wrapped in warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and cucumber salad, pickled chilli and sumac onions. Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion and toss with 1 tsp sumac. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon. Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber. Grill the kofta 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Wrap in 4 warm flatbreads with everything else.
"As fast as a leopard" lamb roast
Uncle Jack's drill before every race

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested, with roast potatoes, pumpkin, peas and gravy. Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary and roast at 180C until 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin alongside. Cook 300g peas and make gravy from the pan juices.
W: Scone dough dumplings dropped into simmering golden syrup, butter and water, covered and cooked 20 minutes until puffed. Cream or ice cream.
K: the long walk across the salt lake

Strong black tea boiled in a billy for a minute, settled, poured into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar. Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Add 3 tbsp loose leaf tea, boil for a minute and swing to settle. Pour into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar.
T: Run like the wind. Bake like your mum.
D: Two young sprinters from Western Australia sign up and head for Gallipoli.
P: Serve the biscuits when Archy and Frank meet at the athletics carnival.

title: The Dish
S: the town ladies' welcome for the Americans

Self-raising flour with cold butter rubbed in, milk and a little cream mixed in lightly with a knife, patted out, cut into rounds, packed close on the tray, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Jam and whipped cream.
the whole town watching the moon landing

Light butter sponge cubes dipped in glossy chocolate icing and rolled in coconut, some split and filled with raspberry jam and whipped cream. Bake a 20 x 30cm butter sponge (125g butter, 150g caster sugar, 2 eggs, 225g self-raising flour, 125ml milk) at 180C for 25 minutes, cool and chill. Cut into 16 squares. Mix 400g icing sugar, 40g cocoa, 20g butter and 125ml boiling water. Dip each square, roll in 200g desiccated coconut and set. Split half and fill with jam and whipped cream.
the boys play cricket on the dish
Cheese and yeast spread scrolls: yeast spread and tasty cheese rolled in scone dough, sliced, baked at 200C for 15 minutes.
M: the town's big night for the US ambassador
Lamb rack roasted at 200C to 56C, rested, carved into cutlets, with roast potatoes, pumpkin, peas and mint sauce.

Minute steak, caramelised onions, beetroot, cheese, lettuce, tomato and a fried egg on toasted Turkish bread, with chips and aioli. Cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 20 minutes until jammy. Bake 750g frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Season 4 minute steaks and sear 1 minute a side in a smoking pan, adding a slice of tasty cheese to each. Fry 4 eggs. Toast 4 halved Turkish rolls. Build with mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, 8 slices beetroot, steak, onions and egg. Serve with chips and garlic aioli.
W: a big white moon, the one everyone's watching
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar until glossy, cornflour and vinegar folded in, shaped into a perfect round, baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven. Cream and passionfruit on top.
K: a hot day out in the sheep paddock under the dish

Ice-cold lager topped with homemade fizzy lemon and lime soda, poured into chilled pot glasses with a lemon wedge. Mix the juice of 2 lemons and 2 limes with 80ml sugar syrup. Chill 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Pour 25ml of the citrus syrup into each glass, add 125ml cold soda water, then top slowly with 175ml cold Australian lager. Stir once and add a lemon wedge. Make extra with just soda for the drivers.
T: The moon landing, live from a sheep paddock.
D: A radio telescope in a sheep paddock in Parkes helps broadcast the 1969 moon landing.
P: Serve the snacks when the first pictures come through from the moon.

title: Home Alone
S: a whole cheese pizza, all to himself
Pizza dough rolled thin, topped with a quick tomato sauce and plenty of mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 6 minutes, cut into small squares.
the giant sundae he builds watching a gangster film

Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with homemade hot fudge, salted caramel, whipped cream, crushed nuts, marshmallows, sprinkles and cherries to build your own. Heat 150ml cream with 150g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp golden syrup, stirring until glossy. Melt 100g brown sugar with 50g butter, add 100ml cream and a pinch of salt and simmer 2 minutes. Whip 300ml thickened cream. Set out 1L vanilla and 1L chocolate ice cream with the sauces, cream and bowls of 80g crushed peanuts, 100g mini marshmallows, sprinkles and cocktail cherries.
the paint cans swinging down the stairs
Popcorn tossed in melted butter and salt, half of it coated in red-tinted white chocolate, mixed together in clean paint tins.
M: the TV dinner he heats up all by himself
Macaroni boiled 2 minutes short, folded through a sauce of butter, flour, milk, sharp cheddar and a little mustard, topped with breadcrumbs and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
the family Christmas Kevin has the house to himself for

Leg ham scored in diamonds, studded with cloves and glazed with brown sugar, orange and mustard, with crispy roast potatoes and honey carrots. Remove the skin from a 3kg half leg ham, score the fat into diamonds and stud with cloves. Simmer 150g brown sugar, the juice of 2 oranges and 2 tbsp Dijon for 5 minutes. Bake the ham at 180C for 45 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil at 220C for 45 minutes and 500g carrots with honey for 30 minutes.
W: the cookies left out for the house
Butter sugar cookies cut into stars and trees, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white and green with silver cachous.
K: keep the change with this one

Cold milk blended thick with chocolate ice cream, malt powder and chocolate syrup, topped with whipped cream and a cherry. Blend 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp chocolate syrup for 30 seconds until thick. Drizzle a little more chocolate syrup inside 4 tall glasses, pour in the shake and top with 150ml whipped cream and a cocktail cherry.
T: Keep the change. Pass the pizza.
D: An eight-year-old left behind at Christmas defends his house from two burglars.
P: Serve the pizza when the delivery guy turns up at the door.

title: Scrooged
S: the network's Christmas Eve live broadcast
Blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, and mini bruschetta with tomato, basil and garlic, laid out on silver trays.
the wild cab ride back to Frank Cross's past

Pretzels, nuts and rice cereal squares roasted in butter, Worcestershire, garlic and smoked paprika until crunchy, served by the paper bag. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Toss with 200g pretzels, 200g mixed nuts and 100g rice cereal squares. Spread on 2 lined trays and bake at 130C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool completely so it crisps, then fill small paper bags.
the Ghost of Christmas Present and her toaster
Thick white bread toasted golden, buttered, cut into soldiers, served with soft-boiled eggs cooked 6 minutes.
M: Christmas at Frank's brother's family table

Brined roast turkey breast, sage and onion stuffing, crispy roast potatoes, glazed carrots, cranberry sauce and a rich gravy for a warm family table. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 60g salt and 30g sugar. Rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C for 75 minutes to 70C, then rest. Bake 150g breadcrumbs with 1 sautéed onion, sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil at 220C for 45 minutes and 500g carrots with honey. Make gravy with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
Claire's work at the homeless shelter
Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, carrot and potato softened, stock and thyme added, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until the meat falls apart. Crusty bread to mop it up.
W: Fruit soaked overnight in brandy, mixed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, breadcrumbs and spice, steamed 4 hours, flamed with brandy. Custard.
K: the staff Christmas Eve toast Frank finally joins
Yolks whisked with sugar, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat to 75C, chilled, finished with brandy and fresh nutmeg.
T: It's Christmas. Even the TV boss gets dinner.
D: A ruthless TV executive is visited by three ghosts on Christmas Eve.
P: Serve the mains when Frank turns up at his brother's Christmas dinner.

title: Gremlins
S: the chicken they trick Billy into feeding them after midnight
Drumsticks brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged twice in flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and white pepper, fried at 165C until 75C at the bone. Serve before 12.
Christmas in a snowy small town

Butter, brown sugar and golden syrup melted, flour, ginger, cinnamon and bicarb mixed in, chilled an hour, rolled, cut into little houses, baked at 180C for 10 minutes and piped with white royal icing.
Mrs Peltzer fights back with the kitchen blender

Frozen berries, banana and Greek yoghurt blitzed thick with honey, poured into little shot glasses with a swirl of berry sauce down the side. Simmer 100g frozen berries with 1 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes and cool for the sauce. Blend 300g frozen mixed berries, 1 banana, 250g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp honey and 200ml milk until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little sauce down the inside of 12 shot glasses, pour in the smoothie and serve straight away with tiny spoons.
M: the bar the gremlins take over
Lamb mince simmered with carrot and gravy under a thick buttery mash, baked until golden on top.
Christmas at the Peltzer house in Kingston Falls

Pork loin with shattering crackling, roasted apples and onions, buttery mash and a cider gravy, a snowy small-town Christmas dinner. Score the rind of a 1.5kg rolled pork loin, salt well and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 180C for 60 minutes with 4 halved apples and 2 quartered onions around it until 65C inside. Rest 15 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Make gravy from the pan with 1 tbsp flour, 200ml apple cider and 200ml stock.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with a dome of fluffy marshmallow frosting made from egg whites and hot sugar syrup, rolled in desiccated coconut.
K: rule two, keep water away from the mogwai

Sparkling water over crushed ice with fresh lemon, lime and orange, a splash of elderflower cordial and mint, served well away from anything furry. Slice 1 lemon, 1 lime and 1 orange into thin wheels. Lightly crush a handful of mint with 60ml elderflower cordial and the juice of 1 lime in a jug. Add the citrus wheels and 1L chilled sparkling water. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice and pour over. Keep it well away from anything furry.
T: Never feed them after midnight. You're fine before.
D: A boy gets a strange little creature for Christmas and breaks every one of the rules.
P: Serve the snacks well before midnight.

title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
S: Clark and Eddie's eggnog in the moose-head mugs
Yolks whisked with sugar, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat to 75C, chilled overnight, finished with dark rum and fresh nutmeg grated over.
Jelly of the Month Club lime mould
the lime jelly Aunt Bethany gift-wraps

A retro lime jelly mould set with crushed pineapple and a creamy whipped layer, turned out wobbling onto a plate with fresh mint. Dissolve two 85g packets lime jelly in 500ml boiling water and stir in 300ml cold water and 1 tbsp lime juice. Pour half into a 1.2L mould and chill 1 hour until set. Chill the other half until thick but not set, then fold through 200ml whipped cream and a drained 440g tin crushed pineapple. Pour over and chill 4 hours. Dip the mould in hot water and turn out.
Eddie's RV parked out the front
Smoked kielbasa sliced thick on the diagonal, griddled until charred, tossed with onions cooked slowly in butter and a spoon of grainy mustard, on toothpicks.
M: the opposite of the one Clark carves
Turkey dry-brined 48 hours uncovered in the fridge, butter under the skin, roasted at 170C until the breast hits 65C, rested an hour under foil, carved at the table. Stuffing and gravy.
the big Griswold family Christmas spread

Leg ham scored in diamonds, studded with cloves and glazed with brown sugar, pineapple and mustard until sticky, with potato bake and peas. Remove the skin from a 3kg half leg ham, score and stud with cloves. Simmer 150g brown sugar, 200ml pineapple juice and 2 tbsp Dijon for 5 minutes. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, glazing every 15 minutes. Layer 1kg sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, 1 sliced onion and 100g cheddar and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Serve with 400g buttered peas.
W: Pecans toasted, then mixed with brown sugar, golden syrup, melted butter, eggs and vanilla, poured into a blind-baked case, baked at 170C for 50 minutes until just set.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot full cream milk, whisked frothy, topped with marshmallows.
T: 25,000 lights. One very dry turkey.
D: Clark Griswold tries to give his whole family the perfect old-fashioned Christmas.
P: Serve the turkey when Clark carves his and it collapses.

title: The Santa Clause
S: the plate left out on Christmas Eve
Butter browned and cooled, beaten with brown sugar and egg, flour and choc chips folded in, rested overnight, baked at 180C for 11 minutes. Cold milk on the side.
the elves' workshop at the North Pole
Bocconcini stacked three high on a skewer with a cherry tomato hat, black pepper eyes and a basil leaf scarf, drizzled with olive oil.
Scott sets the turkey on fire, so you don't have to

Juicy turkey mince patties with sage and onion, charred on purpose on the grill, in soft slider buns with cranberry sauce and brie. Mix 600g turkey mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 egg and salt. Shape into 12 small patties. Cook on a hot oiled grill pan for 3 minutes a side until charred and cooked through, adding a slice of brie from 150g for the last minute. Toast 12 slider buns and fill with the patties, a spoon of cranberry sauce and rocket.
M: Scott burns his, so this one's for him
Turkey breast brined overnight, rolled with herb butter, roasted at 170C until 70C, rested 20 minutes, sliced, with stuffing, roast potatoes and gravy.
the diner full of dads who burnt the turkey

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked with crisp bacon, fried eggs and golden hash browns, warm maple syrup and butter on top. Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 375ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 40g melted butter and rest 15 minutes. Bake 8 frozen hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Cook ladles of batter in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side. Fry 4 eggs. Stack 3 pancakes per plate with bacon, an egg and hash browns, then butter and maple syrup.
W: the elves' workshop at the North Pole
Gingerbread dough of butter, brown sugar, golden syrup, flour and spice, chilled, cut into elves and trees, baked at 180C for 10 minutes and iced in red and green.
K: not too hot, not too cold
Cocoa, sugar and a pinch of salt whisked into milk with a little cream, warmed to drinking temperature with cinnamon and vanilla, never boiled.
T: Not too hot, not too cold.
D: A divorced dad accidentally becomes Santa Claus and has a year to work it out.
P: Serve the cocoa when Judy the elf makes Scott a cup.

title: A Christmas Story
S: Beef mince, breadcrumbs soaked in milk, grated onion and egg mixed lightly, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar and back in for 5.
show us how the piggies eat, Randy

Fluffy mash piped into rounds, baked crisp on top, loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives, perfect finger food without the face-down approach. Boil 1kg potatoes, pass through a ricer and beat with 60g butter, 80ml hot milk, 1 egg yolk and salt. Pipe 20 rounds onto a lined tray and sprinkle with 80g grated cheddar. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes until golden. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Top each with a little sour cream from 150g, bacon and chopped chives.
the leg lamp in the front window
Grissini wrapped in prosciutto in a criss-cross pattern like fishnet, stood up in a glass, with a small bowl of whipped ricotta.
M: the duck at the Chinese restaurant
Duck legs salted overnight, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes until crisp, shredded, wrapped in steamed pancakes with cucumber, spring onion and hoisin.
Christmas dinner before the Bumpus hounds get it

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy and sliced, with stuffing, cranberry sauce, mash, buttered greens and gravy, guarded closely from the neighbours' dogs. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 60g salt and 30g sugar. Rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C for 75 minutes to 70C, then rest 20 minutes. Bake 150g breadcrumbs with 1 sautéed onion, sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Make gravy with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Butter and sugar creamed, egg and vanilla, flour mixed in, chilled, rolled and cut into stars and trees, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with coloured royal icing.
K: Ralphie and his secret decoder ring
Malted milk powder and cocoa whisked into cold milk, blended with a scoop of vanilla ice cream until frothy.
T: You'll shoot your eye out. Have more turkey.
D: A boy in 1940s Indiana wants just one thing for Christmas: a BB gun.
P: Serve the duck when the family heads to the Chinese restaurant after the dogs get the turkey.

title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
S: Thick white bread with sharp cheddar and sweet brown pickle, cut into little party triangles.
the spirit surrounded by a mountain of food

A towering board of roast chestnuts, clementines, grapes, Stilton, walnuts, honey-glazed ham and gingerbread, piled high like the spirit's feast. Cut a cross in 300g chestnuts and roast at 200C for 25 minutes, then peel while warm. Toss 100g walnuts with 1 tbsp honey and bake 8 minutes. Pile everything onto a big board: the chestnuts and walnuts, 6 clementines, 1 bunch grapes, a 200g wedge of Stilton, 200g sliced honey ham, 8 gingerbread biscuits and a packet of oat crackers.
the rat who can't stop thinking about food
Mature cheddar and Red Leicester cut into wedges, with pickled onions, apple chutney and oatcakes, laid out on a little wooden board.
M: The prize turkey from the shop window
the big turkey Scrooge buys for the Cratchits

Butter-basted roast turkey with thyme and lemon, chestnut stuffing, roast potatoes, Brussels sprouts with bacon and plenty of gravy for the whole table. Rub a 4kg turkey with 80g butter mashed with thyme and lemon zest under the skin. Roast at 170C for 2 hours 15 minutes until the breast reaches 65C, then rest under foil 45 minutes. Bake 150g breadcrumbs with 100g chopped cooked chestnuts, 1 onion, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes. Fry 400g halved sprouts with 100g bacon. Make gravy with 300ml stock.
the small family dinner that feels like a feast
Goose legs salted overnight, roasted at 170C for 2 hours until crisp, potatoes roasted in the goose fat, with braised red cabbage and apple sauce.
W: Mrs Cratchit's pudding, carried in steaming

Rich dried fruit pudding soaked in orange juice and cold tea, steamed for hours, served hot with a jug of warm vanilla custard. Soak 500g mixed dried fruit in 150ml orange juice and 50ml cold black tea overnight. Mix with 125g soft butter, 125g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 100g breadcrumbs, 75g plain flour, 2 tsp mixed spice and the zest of 1 orange. Spoon into a greased 1.2L basin, cover tightly with baking paper and foil, and steam for 4 hours, topping up the water. Turn out and serve hot with 600ml warm custard.
K: Scrooge raises Bob's wages at the end

Red grape and cranberry juice warmed gently with clove-studded roasted oranges, cinnamon and a little sugar, ladled steaming into cups. Stud 2 oranges with cloves and roast at 180C for 30 minutes. Put 750ml red grape juice and 500ml cranberry juice in a saucepan with the oranges, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 star anise and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Warm gently for 20 minutes without boiling. Ladle into 4 cups with a slice of the roasted orange in each.
T: Bah humbug. Pass the gravy.
D: A miserly money lender is visited by three spirits on Christmas Eve, with a few Muppets along for the ride.
P: Serve the mains when Scrooge sends for the prize turkey.

title: The Goonies
S: Dark chocolate melted into hot cream with a knob of butter, chilled 3 hours, scooped and rolled into balls, then coated in cocoa, crushed nuts or sprinkles.
Chunk wins Sloth over with a chocolate bar

Chewy peanut nougat and salted caramel loaded with roasted peanuts, dipped in milk chocolate and cut into fat bars, the way Sloth would want them. Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter and 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter, then stir through 150g roasted peanuts and press into a lined 20cm tin. Melt 200g soft caramels with 2 tbsp cream and a pinch of salt and pour over. Chill 1 hour. Cut into 12 bars, dip in 300g melted milk chocolate and set on baking paper in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Sharp cheddar, butter, flour and smoked paprika rolled into a log, chilled, sliced into coins, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp.
M: the Fratellis' hideout in the old restaurant
Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, garlic and oregano, Italian sausage, mushrooms and mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
the Walsh house on the Goon Docks in Astoria

Flathead in a crunchy soda water batter, piled into warm tortillas with chipotle slaw, pickled onion, avocado and lime, a pirate map's worth of crunch. Pickle 1 sliced red onion in the juice of 2 limes with salt for 20 minutes. Toss a quarter red cabbage, shredded, with 100g mayonnaise and 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold soda water and salt. Cut 600g flathead into strips, dip and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 12 flour tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, sliced avocado and lime.
W: One-Eyed Willy's ship, full of gold
Chocolate loaf cake baked at 170C for 50 minutes, hollowed out and filled with gold-wrapped chocolate coins, lid on, covered in chocolate ganache.
K: the kids' summer on the docks
Root beer poured slowly over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses until it foams to the top.
T: Goonies never say die. Goonies never say no to seconds.
D: A gang of kids follow an old treasure map to find a pirate's lost ship.
P: Serve the snacks when Chunk does the truffle shuffle.

title: Hook
S: Watermelon, rockmelon, kiwi, pineapple and berries cut into chunks and arranged in rainbow rows, with a lime and honey drizzle.
the Lost Boys' feast and the food fight with Rufio

Three bright dips, beetroot hummus, pea and mint, and carrot with cumin, swirled in bowls with warm pita chips for flicking at the table. Blitz 1 drained 400g tin chickpeas with 2 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and 3 tbsp oil, then split in two. Blend one half with 1 cooked beetroot. Blend 200g frozen peas, cooked, with mint, 50g feta and lemon. Boil 3 carrots until soft and blend with 1 tsp cumin, honey and oil. Cut 3 pitas into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 180C for 8 minutes.
White bread spread right to the edges with soft butter, pressed into hundreds and thousands, a dusting of edible glitter, cut into triangles.
M: Whole chickens spatchcocked, rubbed with garlic, lemon and paprika, roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, with corn on the cob and roast potatoes, eaten with your hands.
aboard the Jolly Roger with Smee

Beef chuck braised three hours with smoky paprika, tomato, carrot and molasses until sticky and dark, served with cheesy ship's biscuit damper. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 2 onions and 2 carrots 5 minutes, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp molasses, 400g tinned tomatoes and 600ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Rub 50g butter into 300g self-raising flour, add 80g cheddar and 200ml milk, shape into 8 rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: Pandan sponge tinted green, baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in green buttercream with a chocolate clock face on top.
K: Lemonade with a squeeze of lime, a pinch of edible glitter swirled in so it shimmers.
T: Bangarang. Dinner's imaginary. Not this one.
D: A grown-up Peter Pan returns to Neverland to rescue his children from Captain Hook.
P: Serve the mains when Peter finally imagines the Lost Boys' feast.

title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit
S: the nightclub where toons wait tables
Devilled eggs, smoked salmon on rye and cocktail franks in a sticky glaze, served on silver trays like a 1940s supper club.
Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey, cumin and thyme until caramelised, with a whipped feta dip.
no Dip anywhere near this one, Judge Doom

Slow-caramelised onion folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives and Worcestershire, with crinkle-cut chips and pretzels for scooping. Slice 3 brown onions thinly and cook in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep brown and jammy, then cool and chop. Beat 250g sour cream with 100g cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and salt, then fold in the onion and chopped chives. Chill 30 minutes. Serve with a 175g bag crinkle-cut chips and 150g pretzels.
M: lunch at the desk, one Valiant short

A hot pastrami sandwich: pastrami steamed, piled on rye with mustard and Swiss, grilled until the cheese melts. Steam 400g pastrami for 10 minutes until glossy. Pile onto 8 slices rye with mustard and 4 slices Swiss cheese. Grill until the cheese melts. Serve each with a dill pickle on the side.
1947 Los Angeles, the Red Car still running

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick over creamy mash with buttered green beans and gravy. Mix 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with 100ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 180C for 60 minutes and rest. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Steam 300g green beans. Serve with gravy.
W: "Just drawn that way" red velvet cake
the red dress on stage at the Ink and Paint

Red velvet cake baked at 175C, layered with cream cheese frosting, a glossy red glaze on top. Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer with cream cheese frosting and pour a glossy red icing over the top.
K: Eddie's ginger beer on the rocks
the bottle in Eddie's desk drawer, kept well away from Roger

Fiery ginger beer over a big ice block with fresh lime and a dash of vanilla, poured into heavy tumblers like a detective's nightcap. Put one large ice block in each of 4 heavy tumblers. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 2 drops vanilla extract. Top each with 200ml cold ginger beer, poured slowly so it keeps its fizz. Stir once and add a lime wheel. Serve at the desk, with a fedora if you have one.
T: P-p-p-please pass the snacks.
D: A down-on-his-luck detective helps a cartoon rabbit framed for murder in 1947 Los Angeles.
P: Serve the drinks when Jessica takes the stage at the Ink and Paint Club.

title: The Little Mermaid
S: Scuttle swears a fork is for combing hair
Baguette split, spread with garlic and herb butter, baked at 200C for 12 minutes, served with forks stuck in for combing, or eating.
Ariel's grotto, Sebastian safely off the menu

Poached prawns piled over crisp iceberg and avocado with a pink Marie Rose sauce, lemon and a sprinkle of paprika, served in glass cups. Poach 500g green prawns in simmering salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water, then peel. Mix 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of hot sauce. Shred half an iceberg and dice 1 avocado into 4 glasses. Pile on the prawns, spoon over the sauce and dust with paprika. Serve with lemon wedges.
Small pasta shells cooked al dente, tossed with peas, cherry tomatoes, basil and lemon dressing.
M: the dinner where she uses a fork to comb her hair

Pan-roasted chicken breasts with a lemon, tarragon and cream sauce, buttered new potatoes and green beans, crab left firmly off the menu. Season 4 chicken breasts and sear in oil for 4 minutes a side, then finish in a 200C oven for 10 minutes and rest. In the same pan cook 1 chopped shallot in 20g butter, add 150ml chicken stock and the juice of half a lemon and reduce by half. Add 200ml cream and chopped tarragon and simmer 2 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss in butter. Steam 300g green beans.
Chef Louis's kitchen, fish only, no crab

Snapper fillets dusted in flour and pan-fried until the skin crackles, finished in nutty brown butter with lemon, capers and parsley, with crushed potatoes. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, crush lightly with olive oil and salt. Pat 4 snapper fillets dry, season and dust the flesh in flour. Fry skin side down in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes until crisp, flip for 1 minute and lift out. Add 60g butter to the pan and cook until nut brown, then add 1 tbsp capers, the juice of 1 lemon and chopped parsley. Spoon over the fish.
W: Sebastian's big number on the sea floor
Blue jelly set in clear glasses with gummy fish suspended halfway, topped with whipped cream and crushed shortbread for sand, a white chocolate shell on the side.
K: the boat ride across the lagoon
Pineapple juice, coconut water and lemonade with a splash of blue curaçao syrup, over ice.
T: Kiss the cook. Spare the crab.
D: A young mermaid trades her voice for legs to win a prince.
P: Serve the mains when Chef Louis starts chasing Sebastian around the kitchen.

title: Beauty and the Beast
S: The grey stuff cookies and cream mousse
Lumière's dinner show for Belle, ask the dishes

Silky cookies and cream mousse of crushed chocolate biscuits, whipped cream and mascarpone, piped into little cups and topped with a crunchy biscuit crumb. Crush 12 chocolate cream sandwich biscuits, keeping 2 tbsp crumbs. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 250g mascarpone, 2 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla to soft peaks. Fold through the crushed biscuits so it turns grey. Pipe into 8 small cups or glasses and chill 1 hour. Top with the saved crumbs and a white chocolate curl just before serving.
he eats five dozen eggs every morning
Devilled eggs: boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a little butter, piped back, finished with paprika and chives. A dozen will do.
the baker in Belle's village song
Fresh baguette sliced, toasted with olive oil, topped with brie, sliced pear and a drizzle of honey.
M: the enchanted castle kitchen cooks dinner for Belle

Beef chuck braised slowly with bacon, baby onions, mushrooms, thyme and a rich grape and beef stock gravy, over buttery mash with crusty bread. Brown 150g diced bacon, then 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp flour, then 250ml red grape juice, 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, thyme and bay. Return the meat, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Brown 12 peeled baby onions and 250g mushrooms in butter and stir in. Serve with mashed potato.
Chicken roasted at 220C then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes and a rich pan gravy, eaten with your hands.
W: the rose under the glass bell, losing its petals
Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm cream with sugar and a few drops of rosewater, set in glasses for 4 hours, topped with raspberries crushed with a little sugar and a single sugared rose petal.
K: the tavern where everyone sings about Gaston
Cloudy apple juice with a little lemon frozen in a tray, scraped into slush, topped with a toasted marshmallow foam of whipped cream folded with marshmallow creme. Mrs Potts's tea for the grown-ups.
T: Be our guest. Try the grey stuff.
D: A young woman held in an enchanted castle sees past the Beast to the man inside.
P: Serve the snacks during Be Our Guest.

title: Aladdin
S: the loaf Aladdin swipes and gives away
Yeasted dough rested an hour, rolled into rounds, cooked on a smoking hot pan until puffed and blistered, brushed with butter and za'atar.
Agrabah market hummus and smoky baba
the Agrabah market stalls Aladdin runs through

Silky hummus and charred eggplant baba ganoush, swirled with olive oil, sumac and pomegranate, with warm puffy flatbread to tear. Char 2 eggplants over a gas flame or under the grill for 15 minutes until collapsed, scoop out the flesh and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, garlic, lemon and salt. Blitz 2 drained 400g tins chickpeas with 80g tahini, the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and 100ml iced water until silky. Top both with olive oil, sumac and pomegranate seeds. Serve with 4 warm flatbreads.
Medjool dates split, stuffed with a blend of cream cheese, orange zest and chopped pistachio, dusted with cinnamon.
M: a feast for the Sultan's table
Chicken thighs marinated overnight in yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric and lemon, skewered, grilled over high heat until charred. Saffron rice, garlic sauce and pickles.
street food in the Agrabah market square

Spiced lamb kofta charred on skewers, with garlic yoghurt, chilli, herby tomato salad and pickled turnip, wrapped in warm flatbread. Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, 2 tsp ground coriander, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon. Dice 2 tomatoes, 1 cucumber and parsley. Grill the kofta on high for 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Wrap in 4 warm flatbreads with everything and pickled turnip.
W: the magic carpet ride over Agrabah

Crisp buttery filo layered with walnuts, pistachios and cinnamon, cut into diamonds and soaked in hot honey and orange blossom syrup. Mix 200g walnuts and 100g pistachios, chopped, with 1 tsp cinnamon and 50g sugar. Layer 12 sheets filo brushed with 150g butter with the nuts between. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Pour over 200g hot honey with 1 tbsp orange blossom water.
K: a blue genie, a green drink
Lemon juice blended with a big handful of mint, sugar syrup and ice until frothy, strained into glasses.
T: One jump ahead of the bread line.
D: A street kid finds a magic lamp and a genie who grants him three wishes.
P: Serve the snacks when Aladdin steals the bread in the market.

title: The Lion King
S: Gummy worms buried in cups of dark chocolate mousse with crushed chocolate biscuit dirt, a mint leaf on top.
a nod to Southern African street food

Lamb cubes marinated overnight in apricot jam, curry and vinegar, skewered with dried apricots and onion, grilled sticky and charred. Mix 3 tbsp apricot jam, 1 tbsp mild curry powder, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 grated onion and salt. Toss with 800g diced lamb leg and marinate overnight. Thread onto 8 skewers with 100g dried apricots and wedges of 1 onion. Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the leftover marinade, until charred and just pink inside.
the fruit he breaks open on Simba's head
Wedges of mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit on ice, with lime, a pinch of chilli salt and fresh mint.
M: Nala and the lionesses bring home dinner

Butterflied chicken marinated in charred chilli, garlic, lemon and paprika, roasted until crackling, with yellow rice and a cooling mango salsa. Blitz 2 red chillies (seeded for kids), 4 garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 60ml oil and salt. Rub over a butterflied 1.8kg chicken and marinate overnight. Roast at 220C for 45 minutes until 75C in the thigh. Cook 300g rice with half a tsp turmeric. Dice 1 mango with red onion, coriander and lime for salsa.
Beef mince cooked with onion, curry powder, turmeric, chutney and soaked bread, topped with egg and milk custard and bay leaves, baked at 180C for 35 minutes.
