W: a sweet East African street snack, Swahili like Simba's name

Coconut and cardamom dough rested an hour, cut into triangles, fried at 170C until puffed and golden, dusted with icing sugar. Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml warm coconut milk to a soft dough and rest an hour. Roll out, cut into triangles and fry at 170C until puffed and golden. Dust with icing sugar.
K: Mango, passionfruit and pineapple juice with lemonade and lime, poured over crushed ice.
T: Hakuna matata. Second helpings.
D: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death and must return to claim it.
P: Serve the snacks when Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba about grubs.

title: Toy Story
S: Mr Potato Head loaded potato bites
Andy's birthday, the new toy panic
Crispy baby potatoes smashed and loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheese and chives. Boil 1kg baby potatoes until tender, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 25 minutes.
Andy's trip to Pizza Planet, the claw is in charge

Pizza dough tied into knots, baked golden and tossed in garlic parsley butter and parmesan, with warm marinara for dunking. Cut 500g pizza dough into 12 pieces, roll each into a rope and tie into a knot. Place on a lined tray and bake at 220C for 12 to 14 minutes until golden. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley and toss the hot knots in it with 30g grated parmesan. Simmer 300g passata with garlic, oregano and salt for 10 minutes for dipping.
Fresh peas and edamame blanched, tossed with mint, lemon, olive oil and flaky salt, served in little toy buckets.
M: the claw machine at the pizza place
Pizza dough stretched round, crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni rounds arranged like planets, olive slice craters, baked on a hot steel.
Moving day grilled cheese and tomato soup
Andy's house before the big move

Golden sourdough toasties oozing cheddar and mozzarella, dunked into roast tomato soup topped with basil, cream and crunchy croutons. Roast 1kg tomatoes, 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves with oil at 200C for 35 minutes. Blend with 500ml chicken stock and 1 tsp sugar, then heat with 60ml cream. Butter the outsides of 8 slices sourdough and fill with 200g grated cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 4 minutes a side. Cut into soldiers and serve with the soup and basil.
W: with a cowboy hat on top
Chocolate cake baked at 175C, chocolate buttercream, a fondant cowboy hat on top, candles in.
K: the little green aliens in the claw machine
Pineapple juice and lemonade tinted green, with grapes on sticks for little aliens.
T: You've got a friend in the kitchen.
D: A cowboy doll is threatened when a flashy space ranger toy arrives on his kid's birthday.
P: Serve the pizza when Woody and Buzz end up at the pizza place.

title: Toy Story 2
S: the orange dust on his fingers
Homemade cheese puffs: choux pastry with grated cheddar and gruyère, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
Woody's old TV show, Woody's Roundup

Beans slow-cooked with smoky bacon, onion, molasses, mustard and tomato until thick and sticky, served in tin mugs with cheesy cornbread crumbs. Fry 200g diced bacon until crisp, add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 x 400g tins drained cannellini beans, 400g tinned tomatoes, 2 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 250ml water. Cover and bake at 160C for 90 minutes, stirring once. Crumble 2 cornbread muffins with 40g cheddar and toast under the grill to scatter on top.
Jessie's horse with the big goofy grin
Caramels melted with a splash of cream until smooth, crisp apple wedges patted dry and dipped halfway, rolled in crushed roasted peanuts and set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.
M: Al's Toy Barn honey butter fried chicken
Al in his chicken suit on the Toy Barn TV ad

Buttermilk-brined drumsticks double-dredged and fried crunchy, drizzled with honey butter, with creamy coleslaw and pickles on the side. Soak 12 drumsticks overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and salt. Dredge, dip back in buttermilk and dredge again. Fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 75C inside. Melt 50g butter with 3 tbsp honey and drizzle over. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 carrot with 120g mayonnaise and vinegar.
Stinky Pete, still in his box
Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic, chipotle and cumin, tomatoes and beans, braised 3 hours. Sour cream and cornbread.
W: Jessie's cowgirl yodel on the old TV show
Butter sugar cookie dough chilled, rolled, cut into cowboy hats and boots, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with red and white royal icing in Jessie's cowgirl colours.
K: a cowboy's drink at Woody's Roundup

Ice-cold sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream until it foams, a drizzle of caramel down the glass and a cowboy-hat cookie on the rim. Drizzle 1 tbsp caramel sauce down the inside of each of 4 chilled tall glasses. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Pour 300ml cold sarsaparilla slowly down the side of each glass, letting the foam settle before topping up. Perch a cowboy-hat biscuit on each rim and serve with long spoons and straws.
T: When somebody loved me, they fed me.
D: Woody is stolen by a toy collector and the gang sets out to rescue him.
P: Serve the cheese puffs when Al starts eating them in his apartment.

title: Monsters, Inc.
S: Mike and Celia's date night booking

Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar and sugar, rolled in nori with salmon and avocado, cucumber and crab stick, sliced with a wet knife. Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, lay 200g sliced salmon, avocado and cucumber along each and roll tight. Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.
the abominable snowman offers them in the Himalayas
Shaved ice packed into cups and drenched in a lemon syrup of fresh lemon, sugar and water reduced together.
M: for the scarers after a shift
Chicken thighs marinated in soy, mirin, sake and sugar, grilled until charred, the marinade reduced to a glaze. Steamed rice and greens.
dinner after a shift on the scare floor

Ramen noodles in a rich miso and chicken broth with sticky soy pork belly, a jammy soy egg, corn, greens and chilli oil. Roast 600g pork belly at 160C for 2 hours, then slice and glaze with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp honey in a hot pan. Boil 4 eggs 6.5 minutes, peel and soak in 60ml soy with 60ml water. Heat 1.5L chicken stock with 3 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy. Cook 400g ramen noodles. Build bowls with noodles, broth, pork, halved eggs, 200g corn, blanched bok choy, spring onion and chilli oil.
W: all those doors on the scare floor

Buttery thumbprint biscuits each holding a glossy pool of raspberry jam, like a row of closet doors, dusted with icing sugar. Beat 125g soft butter with 80g caster sugar until pale, then add 1 egg yolk and half a tsp vanilla. Mix in 180g plain flour to a soft dough. Roll into 20 balls, place on a lined tray and press a deep hole in each with your thumb. Fill with half a teaspoon of raspberry jam. Bake at 180C for 14 minutes, cool on the tray and dust with icing sugar.
K: the yellow scream canisters on the scare floor

Bright yellow pineapple, mango and lemon slushie blended thick with ice, served in clear canisters with a scream of sherbet on top. Blend 600ml cold pineapple juice, 1 chopped mango, the juice of 2 lemons and 4 cups of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 clear glasses or jars. Sprinkle 1 tsp lemon sherbet over each so it fizzes, and serve straight away with spoon straws.
T: We scare because we care. We cook because we're hungry.
D: Two monsters accidentally let a little girl into their world.
P: Serve the sushi when Mike takes Celia to the sushi place.

title: Shrek
S: Brown onions cut thick, separated, soaked in buttermilk for 30 minutes, dredged in flour, dipped in beaten egg and pressed into panko, fried at 180C for 2 minutes until deep golden. Smoky barbecue mayo.

Soft spiced gingerbread men piped with white icing smiles and finished with bright gumdrop buttons, one with a leg snapped off for the fans. Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir into 350g plain flour, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp bicarb soda with 1 egg. Chill 1 hour, roll 5mm thick and cut gingerbread men. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Pipe faces with icing from 100g icing sugar and lemon juice, and stick on gumdrops as buttons.

Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with chopped artichoke hearts, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and garlic, topped with mozzarella and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Corn chips.
M: Shrek's pot bubbling in the swamp

Beef chuck braised three hours in a rich tomato and stock gravy, with peas and spinach stirred through at the end so it turns swamp green. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves and 2 celery sticks for 8 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 750ml beef stock, return the beef, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Stir in 200g frozen peas and 100g spinach for the last 5 minutes so it turns green. Serve with crusty bread.
Farquaad's perfect, tidy kingdom of Duloc

Chicken marylands rubbed with garlic, rosemary and lemon, roasted golden in perfectly neat rows with crispy potatoes and a sharp herb salsa verde. Rub 4 chicken marylands with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, lemon zest, oil and salt. Toss 1kg diced potatoes with oil. Lay the chicken and potatoes in neat rows on a tray and roast at 200C for 50 minutes until the chicken reaches 75C. Chop parsley, mint, capers and 1 garlic clove and mix with 80ml olive oil and lemon juice. Spoon over to serve.
W: in the morning, he's making waffles
Buttermilk batter with melted butter and separated eggs, the whites whipped and folded in, cooked in a hot waffle iron until crisp, served with whipped cream, strawberries and maple syrup.
K: green and murky, like the swamp
Green apple, cucumber, lime juice and a handful of mint blitzed with ice and a little honey until slushy.
T: Ogres are like onions. So is this menu.
D: An ogre sets out to rescue a princess so he can get his swamp back.
P: Serve the waffles when Donkey promises to make them in the morning.

title: Finding Nemo
S: Cucumber, carrot, capsicum and sugar snap peas cut into sharp triangles like teeth, with a green goddess dip of sour cream, herbs, lemon and garlic blitzed smooth.
P. Sherman's 42 Wallaby Way sausage rolls
the Sydney address Dory can't forget

Pork and zucchini sausage rolls with herbs in flaky puff pastry, sesame crusted and baked golden, with a smoky tomato relish. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated zucchini squeezed dry, 1 grated onion, chopped parsley, 40g breadcrumbs and salt. Cut 3 sheets puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each and roll up. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into 42 bite-size pieces, or as many as you can count. Bake at 200C for 22 minutes. Serve with 200g tomato relish.
the colours of the Great Barrier Reef
White bread buttered right to the edges, pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into little fish shapes with a cutter.
M: P. Sherman's Sydney address, no fish allowed

Thin chicken fillets crumbed in panko and fried golden, with lemon, chips and salad, pub style. Halve 2 large chicken breasts into 4 thin fillets. Dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 2 cups panko crumbs. Shallow fry in oil for 4 minutes a side until golden. Serve with lemon wedges, oven-baked chips and a green salad.
riding the East Australian Current, dude

Pork shoulder braised with orange and mild chipotle until it shreds, crisped up and stuffed into soft tacos with pineapple salsa and lime crema. Brown 1.2kg pork shoulder in chunks. Add the juice of 2 oranges, 1 tsp mild chipotle powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 250ml stock. Cover and cook at 160C for 3 hours, then shred and fry until crisp at the edges. Dice 250g pineapple with coriander and lime. Mix 150g sour cream with lime juice. Fill 12 soft tortillas.
W: orange and white stripes, like Nemo
Fresh orange juice sweetened with a little honey frozen in layers with vanilla yoghurt, 40 minutes per layer, so each ice block has orange and white stripes. Sticks in after the second layer.
K: Pineapple juice, coconut water and a splash of blue raspberry cordial over crushed ice, a pineapple wedge on the side.
T: Fish are friends, not food. So there's no fish.
D: A clownfish dad crosses the ocean to find his son, who ends up in a Sydney dentist's fish tank.
P: Serve the snacks when Bruce leads the sharks' meeting.

title: Ratatouille
S: roasted on the chimney by a bolt of lightning
Swiss brown mushrooms stuffed with gruyère, thyme and garlic, drizzled with oil, roasted at 220C for 12 minutes until bubbling. Lightning optional.
the soup Linguini ruins and Remy fixes
Leek and potato soup: leeks sweated in butter, potatoes and stock simmered 20 minutes, blended silky with cream, finished with chives and a little white pepper.
anyone can cook, even a perfect baguette lunch

Crusty baguette slathered with cultured butter, layered with leg ham, brie and cornichons, cut into chunks with a little pot of Dijon on the side. Split 2 baguettes lengthways and spread generously with 100g softened butter. Layer with 250g shaved leg ham, 200g sliced brie and sliced cornichons. Close, press firmly and cut each baguette into 6 chunks. Serve on a board with a small pot of Dijon mustard and a few radishes with salt.
M: the dish that takes Ego back to his mum's kitchen
Piperade of capsicum, onion, garlic and tomato spread in a dish, zucchini, eggplant, squash and tomato sliced thin and layered in a spiral, thyme oil, covered and baked at 140C for 2 hours.
the Gusteau's kitchen crew at family meal

Chicken roasted with tarragon garlic butter under the skin, with golden pommes purée, buttered green beans and a glossy chicken jus. Mash 60g butter with chopped tarragon, 2 garlic cloves and salt and push under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until 75C, and rest. Boil 1kg potatoes, rice and beat with 120g butter and 150ml hot milk. Deglaze the tray with 300ml chicken stock and reduce by half. Steam 300g green beans.
W: Cream warmed with vanilla bean, whisked into yolks and sugar, baked in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes, chilled, sugar torched to a crack.
K: Ego asks for a little perspective with his meal

Red grape juice muddled with blackberries and thyme, topped with sparkling water and served in wine glasses, a grown-up looking drink for all ages. Lightly crush 100g blackberries with 4 sprigs thyme and 1 tbsp honey in a jug. Add 600ml red grape juice and the juice of half a lemon and stir. Chill 30 minutes, then strain. Pour into 4 wine glasses over ice, top each with 80ml sparkling water and garnish with a thyme sprig and a blackberry.
T: Anyone can cook.
D: A rat with a gift for cooking teams up with a kitchen hand at a famous Paris restaurant.
P: Serve the main when Anton Ego takes his first bite.

title: Mrs. Doubtfire
S: the dinner where he runs between two tables all night

Green prawns tossed fast in foaming garlic and chilli butter with lemon and parsley, crusty bread to mop it up. Go easy on the cayenne. Melt 80g butter in a large pan until foaming. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes and cook 30 seconds. Add 600g peeled green prawns and toss over high heat for 2 minutes until just pink. Add 60ml chicken stock and the juice of 1 lemon and bubble for 30 seconds. Finish with chopped parsley. Serve straight away with crusty bread.
Crustless sandwiches of cucumber with cream cheese and dill, and egg mashed with mayo and cress, cut into neat fingers and arranged on a tiered stand.
the Hillard family home in San Francisco

Garlic-rubbed sourdough toasts topped with torn burrata, balsamic cherry tomatoes and basil, a crack of pepper and a drizzle of good olive oil. Slice 1 sourdough baguette into 16 pieces, brush with oil and grill or toast until golden, then rub with a cut garlic clove. Halve 250g cherry tomatoes and toss with 1 tbsp balsamic, olive oil and salt. Tear 2 burrata over the toasts, spoon on the tomatoes and finish with basil, pepper and a drizzle of oil.
M: The takeaway she passes off as home cooking
the first dinner she has to cook for the kids
Shepherd's pie that tastes homemade because it is: lamb mince browned, onion, carrot, tomato paste and Worcestershire simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C until golden.
Stu's birthday dinner, the night of the cayenne pepper

Sirloin seared hard and basted with butter and thyme, sliced over crispy potatoes with a peppercorn sauce, spice kept well off the plate. Salt 4 sirloin steaks the night before. Roast 1kg diced potatoes in oil at 220C for 40 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, add 40g butter and thyme and baste for 1 minute, then rest 5 minutes. In the pan cook 1 shallot with 1 tbsp crushed peppercorns, add 150ml beef stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick.
W: when her face falls in the cake frosting
Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C, filled and covered in a thick cloud of mascarpone whipped cream, piled with strawberries. Faces stay out of it.
K: English breakfast tea brewed 4 minutes in a warmed pot, milk in first or after, sugar on the side.
T: Helloooo. Dinner is served.
D: A divorced dad disguises himself as an elderly British nanny to spend time with his kids.
P: Serve dessert when Daniel's face ends up in the frosting.

title: Matilda
S: the Wormwoods eat in front of the TV every night

Crunchy panko chicken tenders with buttery mash, peas and a little pot of gravy, served on TV trays the way the Wormwoods like it. Cut 600g chicken tenderloins and dip in flour, 2 beaten eggs, then 150g panko. Lay on an oiled tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 18 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 80ml milk. Cook 300g frozen peas. Make gravy from a packet mix. Serve in sections on 4 trays.
Matilda reads every book in the library
Lavash cut into neat rectangles, brushed with oil and rosemary, baked at 180C until crisp, then stacked with slices of cheddar and apple like a pile of books.
tea at Miss Honey's tiny cottage
Self-raising flour with cold butter rubbed in, milk mixed in lightly with a knife, cut into rounds, packed close on the tray, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Jam and cream.
M: Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in butter until bubbles set and the edges go lacy, stacked high with butter, maple syrup and blueberries warmed in a pan.
Harry Wormwood's car yard chilli dogs
Harry Wormwood's dodgy used car yard

Griddled franks in toasted buns, smothered in beef chilli and cheddar with jammy onions and mustard, a deal even Harry couldn't fiddle. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter for 25 minutes until jammy. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp mild chilli powder and 200g passata and simmer 15 minutes. Simmer 8 franks 5 minutes, then sear on a griddle. Toast 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, chilli, onions, grated cheddar from 100g and a stripe of mustard.
W: the whole thing, in front of the school
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs, sugar and buttermilk, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 45 minutes, covered in a thick fudge frosting. Slices, not the whole cake.
K: the newt in Miss Trunchbull's water jug

Fresh watermelon blitzed with lime and mint, strained over ice and topped with sparkling water in a big glass jug, no newts. Blend 1kg seedless watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and a handful of mint until smooth. Strain into a large glass jug, pressing on the pulp. Add 1 tbsp honey if the melon is not very sweet and stir. Top with 500ml chilled sparkling water and plenty of ice. Pour into 4 glasses with mint sprigs.
T: Eat the whole cake, Bruce.
D: A gifted girl with neglectful parents discovers she has powers and takes on her terrifying headmistress.
P: Serve dessert when Bruce Bogtrotter faces the cake.

title: Casper
S: the friendly ghost in sugar form
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar to stiff, glossy peaks, piped into tall teardrop ghosts, two mini choc chip eyes pressed in, baked at 100C for 90 minutes and left to cool in the oven.
the little seaside town Whipstaff sits in
Cooked lobster or prawn meat chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon, celery and chives, piled into butter-toasted split rolls.
Kat's Halloween party at Whipstaff Manor

Fresh popcorn drizzled with white chocolate and sea salt, tossed with pretzels and candy corn, with little marshmallow ghosts hiding in the bowl. Pop 100g kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip onto a lined tray. Toss with 100g pretzels and 80g candy corn. Melt 150g white chocolate and drizzle over, then sprinkle with flaky salt. Draw tiny eyes on 12 large marshmallows with a food-safe black marker and scatter through. Set 20 minutes, then break into chunks.
M: Casper cooks Kat a breakfast she can't possibly finish

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes, crisp bacon, soft scrambled eggs, golden hash browns and berries, all piled onto one huge plate with maple syrup. Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 375ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 40g melted butter and rest 15 minutes. Bake 8 hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon. Cook pancakes in butter 2 minutes a side. Whisk 6 eggs with a splash of cream and cook slowly in butter until just set. Pile onto 4 plates with 250g berries and maple syrup.
the uncle who eats everything in sight
New England clam chowder: bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk, clams and cream at the end, served in bread bowls.
W: a Maine summer, even in a haunted house
Blueberries tossed with sugar, lemon zest and cornflour, in a double crust with a lattice top, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled 3 hours to set. Vanilla ice cream.
K: a friendly ghost of a drink
Cold cream soda poured over vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up white and ghostly.
T: Can I keep you. Can I feed you.
D: A friendly ghost befriends the daughter of a ghost therapist who moves into his haunted manor.
P: Serve the breakfast feast when Casper cooks for Kat.

title: The Princess Bride
S: a mutton, lettuce and tomato sandwich, the lean mutton kind
Lamb backstrap seared to pink, rested and sliced thin, on toasted bread with crisp cos, ripe tomato, mint mayo and salt.
Miracle Max says the chocolate coating makes it go down easier
Dark chocolate truffles: chocolate melted into hot cream with a pinch of salt, chilled, rolled into small balls and coated in cocoa.
Fire Swamp chorizo and hot honey
flame spurts, quicksand and no rodents of unusual size

Chorizo fried until crisp and charred, glazed with hot honey and lemon, served sizzling in a pan with crusty bread to mop it up. Slice 2 chorizo sausages (about 300g) into thick rounds on the diagonal. Fry in a dry pan over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and the oil runs. Add 2 tbsp honey, half a tsp chilli flakes and a squeeze of lemon and toss for 30 seconds until sticky. Scatter with parsley and serve in the pan with a sliced baguette.
M: the royal mawwiage that never quite happens

Beef rib roast crusted with garlic and herbs, roasted pink and carved at the table, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and horseradish cream. Rub a 2kg beef rib roast with salt, pepper, garlic and rosemary and leave uncovered overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C until 52C inside, about 60 minutes, and rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 140g flour, 3 eggs and 250ml milk, pour into 12 hot oiled muffin holes and bake at 230C for 20 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with horseradish.
for the giant with the big appetite

Steak and onion pie: beef chuck braised with onion and thyme in a dark stock gravy for hours, under a giant puff pastry lid. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck with 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches. Add 2 sliced onions and thyme and cook 5 minutes, then 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 600ml beef stock. Cover and simmer gently for 2.5 hours until tender and thick. Pour into a large pie dish and cool slightly. Cover with 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: Chocolate layer cake stacked tall, filled with salted caramel and chocolate ganache, the sides left rough like a cliff face.
K: Red grape juice warmed with cinnamon, orange and star anise, poured into two sets of goblets and swapped around the table. Put 1L red grape juice in a saucepan with 1 cinnamon stick, 2 star anise, 2 strips orange peel and 1 tbsp honey. Warm gently for 10 minutes without boiling, then strain. Serve warm in 4 goblets, or chill and pour over ice. Set out two goblets each and let someone swap them around while nobody's looking.
T: As you wish.
D: A farmhand turned pirate fights his way back to the princess he loves.
P: Serve the drinks when Vizzini and the man in black do the battle of wits.

title: Cool Runnings
S: no, mon, just hungry for a taste of home

Beef mince cooked with onion, thyme, scotch bonnet, allspice and curry powder, wrapped in turmeric shortcrust, crimped, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Fry 400g beef mince with an onion, thyme, half a chopped scotch bonnet, 1 tsp allspice and 1 tsp curry powder, then cool. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, brush with turmeric water, fill, fold and crimp. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Sanka kisses his lucky egg before every run

Halved boiled eggs with yolks whipped with mayo, jerk seasoning and lime, piped back in and topped with spring onion and a pinch of smoked paprika. Lower 8 eggs into simmering water and cook 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel. Halve and tip the yolks into a bowl. Mash with 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tsp jerk seasoning, the juice of half a lime and a pinch of salt until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Finish with sliced spring onion and a dusting of smoked paprika. Give one a kiss before eating.
Plantain chips with lime chilli mayo
a taste of home in the snow

Green plantain sliced paper thin and fried crisp, dusted with lime salt and served with a scotch bonnet and lime mayo for dipping. Peel 3 green plantains by scoring the skin lengthways and prising it off. Slice very thin with a mandoline. Heat 1L vegetable oil to 175C and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp, then drain on paper towel. Toss with salt mixed with the zest of 1 lime. Stir 150g mayo with the juice of 1 lime and a quarter of a scotch bonnet, finely chopped, for dipping.
M: home in Jamaica, eaten in the Calgary snow

Chicken marylands marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, spring onion, garlic and lime, grilled slowly over coals until charred. Blitz 2 scotch bonnets, 2 tsp allspice, thyme, 4 spring onions, 3 garlic cloves and lime juice into a paste. Marinate 4 chicken marylands overnight. Grill slowly over coals until charred and cooked through. Cook 300g rice with a tin of kidney beans and coconut milk.
warm food for a Jamaican team in a Canadian winter

Goat shoulder marinated in curry powder, garlic and thyme, browned then braised slowly with potato and scotch bonnet, served with warm roti and lime pickle. Toss 1.2kg diced goat or lamb shoulder with 3 tbsp curry powder, 4 crushed garlic cloves, thyme and salt and marinate overnight. Brown in batches in a heavy pot with 2 tbsp oil. Add a diced onion, a whole scotch bonnet and 750ml chicken stock, cover and simmer gently for 2.5 hours. Add 500g diced potato and cook 30 minutes more until the sauce thickens. Warm 8 roti in a dry pan and serve with lime pickle.
W: Moist coconut and brown sugar cake spiced with nutmeg and ginger, baked in a tray, soaked with lime syrup and served warm with coconut cream. Heat the oven to 180C and line a 20 by 30cm tray. Beat 125g soft butter with 200g brown sugar, then add 2 eggs. Stir in 250g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp nutmeg, 1 tsp ground ginger, 100g desiccated coconut and 250ml coconut milk. Bake 35 minutes. Simmer the juice of 2 limes with 80g sugar for 3 minutes and pour over the warm cake. Serve with whipped coconut cream.
K: named for the sled, peace be the journey

Dried hibiscus steeped with fresh ginger, cloves and orange peel, sweetened, chilled and topped with pineapple juice and lime over ice. Bring 1.2L water to the boil with 30g dried hibiscus flowers, a 5cm piece of sliced ginger, 4 cloves and the peel of an orange. Turn off the heat and steep for 1 hour, then strain. Stir in 120g caster sugar until dissolved and chill. Mix with 300ml pineapple juice and the juice of 2 limes. Pour over ice and garnish with orange slices.
T: Feel the rhythm. Feel the rhyme. Get on up, it's dinner time.
D: A team of Jamaican sprinters take up bobsledding for the 1988 Winter Olympics.
P: Serve the mains when the team first sees snow in Calgary.

title: The Sandlot
S: Ham can't believe Smalls has never had one
Big marshmallows toasted over a flame until blistered and molten, sandwiched with a square of milk chocolate between two digestive biscuits, pressed so the chocolate melts.
a sandlot game in the summer heat

Peanuts in the shell roasted, then tossed in a sticky honey and butter glaze with sea salt and a little smoked paprika, served in paper bags. Spread 400g raw peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 15 minutes. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tsp sea salt and half a tsp smoked paprika. Toss the hot peanuts through the glaze, spread back on the tray and roast 6 minutes more until sticky. Cool so the glaze sets, then divide into four paper bags with a bowl for the shells.
the day at the pool with the lifeguard

Fresh watermelon blended with lime and a little sugar, frozen in moulds with whole raspberries, then dipped in a little sour lime sugar. Blend 800g seedless watermelon with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp caster sugar, then strain. Drop 3 raspberries into each of 8 ice block moulds and pour in the juice. Freeze for 1 hour, push in sticks and freeze 5 hours more. Mix 2 tbsp caster sugar with the zest of 1 lime. Unmould and dip the tips in the lime sugar to serve.
M: the night game under the fireworks
Franks scored and grilled over coals until blistered, in toasted buns with mustard, sweet relish and onions cooked slowly in butter.
a summer of baseball and backyard grills

Two thin chuck patties smashed on a hot grill, cheddar melted over, stacked with pickles, onion and burger sauce in a soft bun, with buttered corn. Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 2 tbsp chopped pickles for sauce. Heat a hotplate to very hot, smash the balls flat, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and lay a slice of cheddar on each. Stack two per toasted bun with lettuce, onion, pickles and sauce. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and roll in butter and salt.
W: Carnival fairy floss and toffee apples
the carnival where the rides go badly
Sugar, water and golden syrup boiled to 150C, red colouring, apples on sticks dipped and twirled, set on oiled paper. Bought fairy floss alongside.
K: a hot summer on the sandlot

Fresh lemon juice stirred with strawberry syrup and cold soda water, poured over ice with lemon wheels and sliced strawberries. Simmer 250g hulled strawberries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 5 minutes, mash and strain, then cool the syrup. Squeeze 5 lemons. In a big jug mix the syrup, lemon juice and 1L cold soda water. Add lemon wheels, a few sliced strawberries and plenty of ice. Stir well and pour.
T: You're killing me, Smalls. Have a s'more.
D: A new kid in town joins a neighbourhood baseball team for one unforgettable summer.
P: Serve the s'mores when Ham explains them to Smalls in the treehouse.

title: Labyrinth
S: the little worm invites Sarah in to meet the missus
Fingers of buttered fruit loaf toasted, served with a pot of English breakfast tea, the way you'd host a guest in a tiny burrow.
Bog of Eternal Stench garlic dip
the bog, but this one smells good
Whole heads of garlic roasted at 180C for 45 minutes, squeezed and whipped into cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, with crusty bread.
M: Masked ball lemon and thyme roast chicken
the masked ball in the bubble

Whole chicken rubbed with thyme butter and roasted over lemon, with crisp duck fat potatoes and a rich pan gravy. Mash 80g soft butter with thyme leaves, garlic and salt and push under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Put a halved lemon in the cavity. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the juices run clear, and rest 15 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in 3 tbsp duck fat at 220C for 50 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 350ml chicken stock and simmer 5 minutes for gravy.
Hoggle the dwarf and his little garden

Beef chuck braised slowly with onion, carrot, mushroom, thyme and tomato in a rich stock, served over buttery mash with chopped parsley. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 diced onion, 2 carrots and 250g mushrooms in the same pot. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, thyme and 750ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until tender. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Serve the stew over the mash with chopped parsley.
W: the peach that sends Sarah to the masked ball

Peaches poached in vanilla, honey and apple syrup, skins slipped off and chilled, served with sweet mascarpone and a crumble of almond biscuits. Simmer 400ml apple juice, 200ml water, 100g caster sugar, 2 tbsp honey and a split vanilla bean for 5 minutes. Add 4 halved peaches and poach gently for 10 minutes, then slip off the skins and chill in the syrup for at least 2 hours. Beat 250g mascarpone with 1 tbsp icing sugar. Serve two halves each with a spoon of mascarpone, a little syrup and crumbled almond biscuits.
K: Goblin King's spiced apple and pear punch

Cloudy apple and pear juice warmed with cinnamon, star anise and orange peel, served hot in mugs or poured over ice with sparkling water. Pour 1L cloudy apple juice and 500ml pear juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 3 star anise and 2 strips of orange peel. Simmer gently for 10 minutes so the spices come through, then strain. Serve warm in mugs with a cinnamon stick, or cool it and pour over ice, topping each glass with 50ml sparkling water.
T: Thirteen hours to solve it. Plenty of time for dessert.
D: A teenager has thirteen hours to solve a goblin king's labyrinth and rescue her baby brother.
P: Serve dessert when Sarah bites the peach.

title: Chicken Run
S: Egg quota curried egg and cress sandwiches
the eggs the chickens have to lay to stay alive

Soft boiled eggs mashed with mayo, a little curry powder and chives, on buttered white bread with crunchy cress, cut into triangles. Boil 6 eggs for 9 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Mash with 4 tbsp mayo, half a tsp mild curry powder, chopped chives, salt and white pepper. Butter 8 slices soft white bread and spread the egg over 4. Scatter with a punnet of cress, close, cut off the crusts and cut each into 4 triangles.
the rats who trade smuggled goods for eggs

Sharp cheddar, sliced ham and Scotch eggs on a board with water crackers, pickled onions, apple chutney and crisp apple wedges. Simmer 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Wrap each in 100g sausage meat, roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 170C for 6 minutes, then halve. Lay out 250g sharp cheddar in wedges, 150g sliced ham, a packet of water crackers, a small jar of pickled onions, a jar of apple chutney and 2 apples cut into wedges.
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in parmesan and paprika, cut into strips and twisted like yarn, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
M: Pie machine beef and onion pies
Mrs Tweedy's pie machine, beef only

Beef chuck braised with onion, thyme and rich gravy until falling apart, baked in shortcrust with a flaky puff lid, served with mushy peas. No chicken, ever. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 2 sliced onions, thyme, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 500ml beef stock, cover and braise for 2.5 hours. Thicken with 2 tbsp cornflour in water and cool. Line 4 pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Simmer 300g frozen peas with butter and mash roughly.
Leek, mushroom and cheddar farm pie
the Tweedys' Yorkshire farm, no chickens harmed

Leek, mushroom and potato in a creamy sharp cheddar and mustard sauce, baked under golden puff pastry with buttered peas alongside. Boil 500g diced potato for 8 minutes and drain. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 300g sliced mushrooms in 40g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml milk and cook until thick. Add 150g grated cheddar, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and the potato. Tip into a pie dish, top with a sheet of puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with 300g buttered peas.
W: a proper British pudding for the flight
Suet or butter pastry spread with raspberry jam, rolled up, wrapped loosely in paper and foil, baked at 180C for 40 minutes. Custard.
K: Coop meeting honey malt hot chocolate
the hens' late-night meetings in the hut

Hot milk whisked with dark cocoa, malt powder and honey until frothy, topped with whipped cream and a dusting of grated chocolate. Warm 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Whisk in 3 tbsp cocoa, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp honey until smooth and frothy. Pour into four mugs, top each with a spoonful of whipped cream and grate a little dark chocolate over the top.
T: No chickens were harmed in the making of this menu.
D: A coop of chickens plan a great escape from a farm before they end up in pies.
P: Serve the pies when Mrs Tweedy fires up the pie machine.

title: Weekend at Bernie's
S: Poached prawns chilled on shredded iceberg in tall glasses with a Marie Rose sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, lemon and horseradish, avocado and lemon wedges. Bring a pot of salted water to the boil, add 600g peeled green prawns and poach 2 minutes until just pink, then plunge into iced water. Mix 150g mayo, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of Worcestershire. Shred half an iceberg into four glasses, add diced avocado, pile on the prawns and spoon over the sauce. Dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges.
Chopped clams folded through cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and chives, with potato chips.
Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, brushed with soy, brown sugar and ginger, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.
M: the host who never says a word all weekend

Lobster tails, clams, corn and small potatoes steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic and butter, tipped onto the table. Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 250ml white wine, 3 garlic cloves and 80g butter, then 1kg clams and 4 lobster tails. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

Sirloin marinated in soy, garlic, ginger and pineapple juice, grilled medium-rare, with charred pineapple, coconut rice and a sticky teriyaki glaze. Mix 80ml soy, 80ml pineapple juice, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves and grated ginger. Marinate 4 sirloin steaks for 2 hours. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water. Grill the steaks on very high heat 3 minutes a side and rest 5 minutes. Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred. Boil the leftover marinade for 3 minutes until sticky and spoon over the sliced steak.
W: Brown sugar and butter in the tin, pineapple rings and cherries on top, butter cake batter poured over, baked at 175C for 45 minutes, flipped.
K: the beach party that never notices Bernie's gone

30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime, shaken with ice, mint on top. For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig. Makes four.
T: Bernie's throwing a party. He just doesn't know it.
D: Two junior employees pretend their dead boss is alive at his beach house for the weekend.
P: Serve the cocktails when the guests turn up at Bernie's beach house.

title: Jaws
S: the beach town on the Fourth of July
Clam meat or calamari strips soaked in buttermilk, dredged in fine cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, tartare and lemon.
A smoked trout dip: hot-smoked trout flaked into cream cheese, sour cream, lemon, dill and horseradish, served in a little bucket with crackers.
Shark fin tortilla chips with salsa

Flour tortillas cut into fin shapes, baked crisp with lime salt, served with a charred tomato, jalapeno and coriander salsa and guacamole. Cut 6 flour tortillas into tall triangles with a curved back like a fin. Brush with oil, sprinkle with salt and lime zest and bake at 180C for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Char 4 tomatoes and a jalapeno in a dry pan, chop with half a red onion, a handful of coriander and lime juice. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Stand the fins up in the guacamole.
M: Cooked lobster chopped, folded with a little mayo, lemon, celery and chives, piled into butter-toasted rolls. Chips.

Clams steamed open, then simmered in a creamy bacon, potato and celery chowder with the clam juices, finished with parsley and oyster crackers. Steam 1kg clams in 125ml white wine in a covered pot for 4 minutes until open, then pick the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp, add a diced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam liquid, 500ml milk and 500g diced potato. Simmer 15 minutes until tender. Add 150ml cream and the clams, warm through and finish with parsley and oyster crackers.
W: you're gonna need a bigger bowl
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a shark fin cut from a dark chocolate disc.
K: Ice cold lager poured over lime, hot sauce, Worcestershire and tomato juice in a chilli salt rimmed glass, with a lime wedge on top. Mix 2 tsp chilli flakes with 2 tbsp salt on a plate. Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice. Add to each glass the juice of half a lime, 3 dashes hot sauce, a dash of Worcestershire and 60ml tomato juice. Top each with a 375ml can of cold lager, stir once and crush the can.
T: You're gonna need a bigger platter.
D: A police chief, a marine scientist and a fisherman hunt a great white shark off a summer resort island.
P: Serve the drinks when Quint and Hooper compare scars.

title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
S: Ham and béchamel thickened with plenty of flour, chilled overnight, shaped into logs, rolled in egg and breadcrumbs, fried at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Lime alongside.
the dozens of animals hiding in his flat

Honey and cinnamon shortbread cut into animal shapes and baked golden, half dipped in white chocolate and showered with rainbow sprinkles. Beat 150g soft butter with 80g caster sugar and 2 tbsp honey. Mix in 250g plain flour and 1 tsp cinnamon to a dough and chill 30 minutes. Roll to 4mm and cut with animal cutters. Bake at 170C for 10 minutes and cool. Melt 150g white chocolate, dip half of each biscuit and scatter with sprinkles. Set on baking paper.
Pineapple, mango and papaya chunks threaded on skewers, grilled hot for a minute a side, brushed with lime juice, honey and a pinch of chilli salt.
M: a Miami lunch on the run
Pork shoulder marinated in orange, lime, garlic and oregano, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, sliced, layered in Cuban bread with ham, Swiss, pickles and mustard, pressed flat and toasted in butter.
Game day buffalo wings with blue cheese

Wings dried overnight and baked crisp, tossed in hot sauce and melted butter, with a chunky blue cheese dip and cold celery sticks. Pat 1.5kg chicken wings dry, toss with 1 tbsp baking powder and salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 125ml hot sauce and toss the wings through. Mix 100g crumbled blue cheese with 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Serve with celery sticks.
W: Biscuit crumb and butter pressed into a tin, condensed milk whisked with egg yolks, lime zest and juice, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, chilled overnight, whipped cream on top. Press 200g crushed biscuits mixed with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Whisk a 395g tin condensed milk with 4 yolks, the zest of 2 limes and 125ml lime juice. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, chill overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream.
K: Mint and lime muddled gently with sugar, 45ml white rum, crushed ice, topped with soda water and stirred. For each drink, gently muddle 8 mint leaves with half a lime cut in wedges and 2 tsp sugar. Add 45ml white rum and fill with crushed ice. Top with soda water and stir from the bottom. Makes four.
T: Alrighty then. Dinner is served.
D: A pet detective hunts for the Miami football team's kidnapped dolphin mascot before the big game.
P: Serve the mains when Ace finds the dolphin in the rich guy's private tank.

title: Caddyshack
S: Three slices of toast layered with roast turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned with toothpicks and cut into quarters.
Carl's endless war on the gopher
A hollowed cob loaf filled with a hot spinach and cheese dip, baked at 180C for 25 minutes, the scooped bread toasted for dipping.
Caddy shack mini chilli cheese dogs

Cocktail franks in soft mini rolls, smothered in a quick beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, served in paper boats. Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, then add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 150ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Split 16 mini rolls, add a frank, spoon over chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 2 minutes until the cheese melts and finish with diced onion.
M: the members' dinner at the club
Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested 20 minutes, carved thick, with horseradish cream and a baked potato.
Al Czervik's garlic prawn surf and turf
the loud new money at the club

Eye fillet seared and roasted pink, topped with garlic prawns cooked in butter, chilli and lemon, with shoestring fries and a rocket salad. Season 4 eye fillet steaks of 180g. Sear in a smoking pan 2 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 6 minutes to 54C inside and rest 5 minutes. In the same pan melt 60g butter with 4 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli, add 400g peeled green prawns and cook 2 minutes. Squeeze in lemon and add parsley. Spoon the prawns over the steaks. Serve with 800g oven-baked shoestring fries and rocket.
W: the snack bar by the pool
Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry in a tall glass. Floating in a pool, never.
K: Nineteenth hole peach iced tea lemonade

Strong black tea steeped with fresh peach, cooled and poured half and half with fresh lemonade over ice, finished with mint and a lemon wheel. Brew 4 black tea bags in 500ml boiling water with 2 sliced peaches for 5 minutes, then remove the bags and cool with the peaches in. Make lemonade by stirring the juice of 3 lemons with 80g caster sugar and 400ml cold water. Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour in half tea and half lemonade, and add a peach slice, mint sprig and lemon wheel.
T: Be the ball. Be the buffet.
D: Caddies, golfers and a groundskeeper at war with a gopher all clash at a snobby country club.
P: Serve the mains when Al Czervik starts making noise in the club dining room.

title: Animal House
S: Bluto's mash and gravy cafeteria cups
Bluto loading his tray in the cafeteria

Little cups of buttery mashed potato under rich brown onion gravy, topped with crispy fried shallots and chives, served on a cafeteria tray. Boil 1kg peeled floury potatoes for 20 minutes, drain and mash with 80g butter, 100ml warm milk and salt. Soften a sliced onion in 20g butter for 10 minutes, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 400ml beef stock and simmer 5 minutes until glossy. Spoon the mash into 8 small cups, pour over the gravy and top with fried shallots and chopped chives.
Grapes frozen for 2 hours, piled on a big platter with olives, feta and pita, so everyone can eat like Romans.
the road trip to the roadhouse
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in a barbecue and honey glaze.
M: cheap food for a broke fraternity
Beef mince browned with onion and capsicum, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, brown sugar and mustard, simmered 20 minutes until thick, piled onto toasted soft buns.

Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, piled with buttery slow-cooked onions, warm caraway sauerkraut and yellow mustard. Cook 2 sliced onions in 40g butter over low heat for 20 minutes until soft and golden. Warm 400g sauerkraut with 1 tsp caraway seeds for 5 minutes. Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns in a covered colander over boiling water for 1 minute. Fill with franks, onions and sauerkraut and finish with yellow mustard.
W: the cafeteria, before it goes up
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with buttercream in bright colours, safe to throw. Please don't.
K: Fruit punch of pineapple and orange juice, lemonade and vodka for the adults, in a big bowl with sliced fruit.
T: Toga. Toga. Toga.
D: The misfit Delta fraternity takes on the dean of Faber College.
P: Serve the mains when Bluto yells food fight.

title: Happy Gilmore
S: Thick little chuck patties seared hard, cheddar melted on, in soft slider buns with pickles, onion and a smoky burger sauce. Shape 600g chuck mince into 8 thick rounds like pucks and season well. Sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, lay a half slice of cheddar on each and cover for 1 minute to melt. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and a pinch of smoked paprika. Toast 8 slider buns and fill with the patties, sauce, sliced pickles and thin onion.
he lost his hand to the alligator

Cream cheese, cheddar, Worcestershire and spring onion rolled into golf ball sizes, coated in toasted crushed pecans, on toothpicks. Beat 250g cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 2 chopped spring onions. Roll into golf ball sizes and chill 30 minutes. Toast 100g pecans, crush and roll the balls in them. Spear each with a toothpick.
the grandma he's saving the house for
Buttermilk biscuits: flour, cold butter and buttermilk folded and cut, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with butter and honey.
M: lunch at the pro tour clubhouse

Rump seared hard and sliced thin on toasted ciabatta with buttery slow-cooked onions, melted Swiss and horseradish mayo, with a handful of rocket. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Season 800g rump and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice thin. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp horseradish. Split and toast 4 ciabatta rolls, pile on steak and onions, top with 4 slices Swiss and grill until melted. Add rocket and the horseradish mayo.
Sunday tea at Grandma's before the house is taken
Beef and pork mince mixed lightly with breadcrumbs soaked in milk, grated onion and egg, shaped in a loaf tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and peas.
W: Buttery shortbread base under a sharp lemon custard, baked until just set and showered with icing sugar.
K: two pitchers of beer in Happy's happy place

Two big chilled jugs of cold lager topped with fresh lemon soda made from lemon juice, sugar syrup and soda water, with lemon wheels. Chill two big jugs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Stir the juice of 3 lemons with 60ml sugar syrup and 500ml cold soda water. Pour 1L cold lager into each jug down the side, then top each with half the lemon soda. Add lemon wheels and pour into chilled glasses.
T: The price is wrong. The food is right.
D: A failed hockey player discovers he can hit a golf ball a mile and joins the pro tour to save his grandma's house.
P: Serve the beer when Happy goes to his happy place.

title: Office Space
S: Small potatoes baked, halved and scooped, brushed with butter and crisped at 220C, filled with cheddar and bacon, baked again, sour cream and chives. Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes. Halve, scoop and brush with 40g butter. Crisp at 220C for 10 minutes, fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake 5 more minutes. Top with sour cream and chives.
Lavash cut into neat rectangles like sheets of paper, brushed with oil and salt, baked at 180C until crisp, stacked with a whipped feta dip in the middle.

Red capsicums blistered and peeled, dressed with garlic, olive oil, sherry vinegar and basil, piled onto toasted sourdough over whipped ricotta. Roast 4 red capsicums whole at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until blackened. Cover in a bowl for 10 minutes, then peel, seed and cut into strips. Dress with 3 tbsp olive oil, a crushed garlic clove, 1 tbsp sherry vinegar, salt and torn basil. Beat 250g ricotta with lemon zest and salt. Toast 8 slices sourdough, spread with ricotta and pile on the capsicum.
M: Peter gutting a fish on his desk
Snapper fillets dusted in seasoned flour, pan-fried skin down in butter until crisp, with lemon, capers and parsley. Chips and a green salad.
the place where flair is mandatory

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, baked low and slow in foil, then glazed sticky under the grill, with creamy coleslaw. Mix 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill on high for 5 minutes until sticky and charred. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 2 grated carrots with 125g mayo and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for coleslaw.
W: Milton never gets a slice, you all do
Vanilla sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fluffy buttercream, cut into enough squares for everyone, Milton first.
K: Lumbergh never puts down his coffee mug

Strong coffee cooled over ice with milk and vanilla syrup, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 500ml strong coffee and chill. Simmer 60g caster sugar with 60ml water and a split vanilla bean for 3 minutes and cool. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 30ml vanilla syrup to each, then pour in 125ml coffee and 100ml cold milk. Top each with a small scoop of vanilla ice cream and dust with cocoa.
T: Looks like someone has a case of the Mondays. Have a snack.
D: A fed-up software engineer stops caring about his job and plots against the company with his mates.
P: Serve the cake when the office birthday cake goes round and skips Milton.

title: Forrest Gump
S: you never know what you're gonna get
Dark chocolate tempered and poured into moulds, filled with salted caramel, raspberry ganache and peanut butter, set and mixed in a box.
the first on Bubba's long list
Green prawns skewered, brushed with butter, garlic, paprika and cayenne, grilled 2 minutes a side, lemon squeezed over.
Bus stop ham and honey mustard biscuits

Flaky buttermilk biscuits split warm and filled with shaved leg ham, a sweet honey mustard butter and a little sharp cheddar. Rub 100g cold butter into 300g plain flour with 3 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk, fold the dough over itself three times and pat to 2cm. Cut 8 rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Beat 40g soft butter with 1 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp Dijon. Split the warm biscuits, spread with the butter and fill with 200g shaved ham and sliced cheddar.
M: shrimp gumbo, one of the many
Dark roux of oil and flour stirred 30 minutes, onion, celery and capsicum, garlic, stock and smoked sausage, simmered an hour, prawns in for 3 minutes. Rice.

Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged in spiced flour, fried crunchy, with garlicky greens and buttery mash. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt. Mix 300g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp pepper and salt. Dredge the chicken and fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74C inside. Mash 1kg potatoes with 80g butter. Saute 2 bunches silverbeet or kale with garlic and a splash of vinegar.
W: Sliced peaches with sugar and cinnamon, buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Forrest drinks soft drink after soft drink at the White House

Homemade cherry and vanilla syrup topped with cold soda water and a squeeze of lime, over ice with a cherry on top. Simmer 300g pitted cherries, fresh or frozen, with 150g caster sugar, 150ml water and a split vanilla bean for 10 minutes. Mash, strain and cool the syrup. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 50ml syrup and a squeeze of lime to each, top with 200ml cold soda water and stir. Finish with a cherry.
T: Life is like a box of chocolates. So is this menu.
D: A kind man from Alabama ends up at the centre of decades of American history.
P: Serve the prawns when Bubba starts listing all the ways to cook shrimp.

title: Pretty Woman
S: they bring out the flavour of the champagne
The ripest strawberries you can find, washed, dried properly and chilled, piled in a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. A very cold bottle of bubbles alongside.
the snail that flies across the restaurant

Escargot or button mushrooms tucked into a dish, each covered with butter mashed with garlic, parsley, shallot and a splash of brandy, baked at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Bread for the butter.

Warm little blini topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and salmon roe, alongside cucumber cups of whipped goat's cheese and chives. Warm 16 blini at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon from 150g, a little salmon roe and dill. Beat 150g goat's cheese with 2 tbsp cream, lemon zest and chopped chives. Cut a telegraph cucumber into 3cm rounds, scoop a hollow in each and pipe in the goat's cheese.
M: Business dinner eye fillet and red wine jus
the dinner where she learns which fork to use

Eye fillet seared and roasted pink, with a glossy red wine and shallot jus, creamy potato gratin and buttered green beans. Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream, a crushed garlic clove and salt, and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Sear an 800g eye fillet on all sides, roast at 200C to 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Soften 2 chopped shallots, add 250ml red wine and reduce by half, then add 300ml beef stock and reduce until glossy. Whisk in 20g butter. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.
ordering everything off the room service menu

Three-tier toasted club of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, with a silver bowl of shoestring fries. Grill 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread. Spread with mayo and layer across three slices each: 400g sliced roast chicken, bacon, lettuce and sliced tomato. Pin each sandwich with 4 toothpicks and cut into 4 triangles. Bake 800g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes and salt well.
W: dessert after the night at the opera
Strawberries dried completely, dipped in tempered dark chocolate, set on baking paper, then drizzled with thin lines of melted white chocolate.
K: champagne sent up to the penthouse

A sugar cube soaked in bitters at the bottom of a flute, a splash of brandy, topped with cold champagne and a twist of orange. Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket for 30 minutes. Drop a sugar cube into each of four flutes and soak with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Add 15ml brandy to each, then slowly top with champagne. Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
T: Big mistake. Huge. Order the strawberries.
D: A businessman hires a woman for a week in Beverly Hills and they fall for each other.
P: Serve the strawberries and bubbles when Edward orders them up to the penthouse.

title: The Karate Kid
S: Steamed edamame tossed with flaky salt, chilli and sesame oil, with cucumber batons quick-pickled in rice vinegar and sesame. Chopsticks only. Steam 400g frozen edamame in their pods for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt, a pinch of chilli flakes and 2 tsp sesame oil. Cut a Lebanese cucumber into batons and pickle for 20 minutes in 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt, then drain and scatter with toasted sesame seeds. Serve both in small bowls with chopsticks only.
Mr Miyagi grew up in Okinawa

Purple sweet potato sliced paper thin and fried crisp, dusted with sea salt and togarashi, with a creamy wasabi mayo for dipping. Peel 2 purple sweet potatoes and slice paper thin on a mandoline. Soak in cold water for 20 minutes, then dry very well on tea towels. Heat 1L vegetable oil to 170C and fry in small batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Drain and toss with sea salt and a pinch of shichimi togarashi. Mix 150g mayo with 2 tsp wasabi paste and a squeeze of lime for dipping.
Broccolini blanched 1 minute, charred in a smoking pan with garlic, tossed in oyster sauce and sesame oil, stood up in a little dish like a row of trees.
M: the plate Daniel tips over Johnny's head

Big plate of spaghetti in a rich tomato and beef sauce with parmesan. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 700g passata and 1 tsp oregano and simmer 30 minutes. Cook 400g spaghetti, toss with the sauce and serve with 50g grated parmesan and basil.
a bowl from Miyagi's home island

Pork belly braised soft in soy, mirin and ginger, on thick wheat noodles in a bonito and chicken broth, topped with pickled ginger and spring onion. Cut 800g pork belly into 4cm pieces, blanch 5 minutes and drain. Simmer with 125ml soy, 125ml mirin, 3 tbsp sugar, sliced ginger and 750ml water for 2 hours until tender. Heat 1.5L chicken stock with 2 tsp dashi powder and 2 tbsp of the braising liquid. Cook 800g fresh udon for 2 minutes and divide into bowls. Pour over broth, add the pork and top with pickled ginger and spring onion.
W: Glutinous rice flour, sugar and water stirred into a dough, steamed 20 minutes, kneaded smooth, wrapped around balls of red bean paste and dusted with cornflour.
K: Sencha steeped just off the boil with fresh ginger and lemon, sweetened with honey and served hot in small cups or poured over ice. Simmer 1L water with a 4cm piece of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then let it cool to about 80C. Add 4 tsp sencha and steep for 1 minute only, then strain. Stir in 2 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon. Pour into small cups, or cool completely and serve over ice with a thin slice of lemon.
T: Wax on. Wax off. Eat up.
D: A new kid in town learns karate from an apartment handyman to stand up to bullies.
P: Serve the mains when Mr Miyagi catches the fly with chopsticks.

title: Kung Fu Hustle
S: the poor tenement where everyone lives
Yeasted dough proved an hour, wrapped around char siu pork chopped with oyster sauce, hoisin and sugar, proved again 20 minutes, steamed 12 minutes.
one of the masters hiding as a baker
Youtiao: dough of flour, baking powder and a little salt rested overnight, two strips pressed together, stretched and fried at 190C until puffed and golden. Warm soy milk to dip.

Clear hard candy lollipops boiled from sugar and glucose, flavoured with lemon and swirled with red and yellow colour, set on baking paper. Line two trays with baking paper and lay out 12 lollipop sticks. Boil 400g sugar, 150ml liquid glucose and 125ml water without stirring until it reaches 150C on a sugar thermometer. Take off the heat and stir in 1 tsp lemon extract. Spoon rounds over the end of each stick, then drag a toothpick dipped in red and yellow colour through each for a swirl. Cool 20 minutes until hard.
1 packet red and yellow food colouring@Pantry
M: the Landlady in curlers, yelling at everyone

Pork and prawn wontons in a clear ginger and chicken broth, on thin egg noodles with choy sum, spring onion and a dash of chilli oil. Mix 250g pork mince with 200g chopped green prawns, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, grated ginger and chopped spring onion. Fill 32 wonton wrappers and fold. Simmer 1.5L chicken stock with sliced ginger and 2 tbsp soy. Boil the wontons for 3 minutes, then cook 400g thin egg noodles for 2 minutes and blanch 2 bunches choy sum. Divide everything into bowls, ladle over the broth and add spring onion and chilli oil.
Axe Gang salt and pepper pork
the gang that dances into every scene
Pork belly in strips coated in potato starch, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in a wok with garlic, chilli, spring onion and Sichuan salt and pepper. Steamed rice.
W: Sago boiled 15 minutes until clear, rinsed, chilled in coconut milk, topped with blitzed ripe mango and fresh mango cubes.
K: Dried chrysanthemum flowers steeped 5 minutes in hot water with a little rock sugar, served warm or iced.
T: The Axe Gang is coming. Dinner's not.
D: A small-time crook in 1940s Shanghai tangles with a gang and the hidden kung fu masters of a run-down tenement.
P: Serve the mains when the Landlady comes out in her curlers.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
S: the Okinawa sushi bar with a legendary swordsmith behind it
Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into nigiri with sliced salmon and tuna, a dab of wasabi, served on a board with pickled ginger.
House of Blue Leaves crispy pork gyoza
the Tokyo restaurant before the fight

Pork, cabbage, garlic and ginger dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath and steamed tender, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip. Mix 400g pork mince with 150g finely shredded cabbage squeezed dry, 2 crushed garlic cloves, grated ginger, 2 chopped spring onions, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 32 gyoza wrappers and pleat. Fry in batches in an oiled pan for 2 minutes until brown underneath, add 80ml water, cover and steam 3 minutes until dry. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar and 1 tsp chilli oil to dip.
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with miso butter, sprinkled with shichimi and spring onion.
M: the Tokyo restaurant where O-Ren holds court

Chicken thigh skewers and chicken and spring onion skewers grilled over high heat, brushed with a tare of soy, mirin, sake and sugar reduced. Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 60ml sake and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy for tare. Thread 1kg diced chicken thighs onto skewers, some with spring onion pieces. Grill over high heat, brushing with tare. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

Rich miso and sesame broth with spicy pork mince, springy ramen noodles, a jammy soy egg, corn, bean sprouts, nori and chilli oil. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, chill and peel, then soak in 3 tbsp soy and 3 tbsp mirin for 2 hours. Fry 300g pork mince with garlic, ginger and 1 tbsp chilli bean paste until crisp. Heat 1.6L chicken stock and whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 2 tbsp tahini. Cook 4 portions fresh ramen noodles for 2 minutes and divide into bowls. Ladle over broth and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, sprouts, nori and chilli oil.
W: Matcha sifted and whisked into warm milk and cream, poured onto yolks beaten with sugar, cooked to 82C, strained, chilled overnight and churned.
K: Hanzo and the Bride share a drink

Junmai sake shaken hard with yuzu juice, honey syrup and egg white until frothy, strained into a chilled glass with a twist of lemon. Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp warm water for honey syrup. For each drink, shake 60ml junmai sake, 20ml yuzu juice, 15ml honey syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain into a chilled coupe and finish with a twist of lemon peel.
T: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Sushi too.
D: A former assassin wakes from a coma and goes after the people who tried to kill her.
P: Serve the sushi when the Bride walks into Hattori Hanzo's sushi bar.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
S: the bowl of rice Pai Mei knocks away
Short grain rice washed until the water runs clear, cooked with a splash of sake, served in small bowls with furikake, a pickled plum and a soft egg boiled 6 and a half minutes. Chopsticks only.
El Paso chapel beef cheek tacos
the wedding rehearsal at the little chapel in Texas

Beef cheeks braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until they shred, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander, lime and a fierce salsa roja. Toast 4 dried guajillo chillies, soak in hot water for 20 minutes and blitz with 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 400g crushed tomatoes. Brown 1kg beef cheeks, pour over the sauce with 500ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours. Shred in the sauce. For salsa roja, blitz 2 charred tomatoes, 2 chipotles in adobo and lime. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with diced white onion, coriander and lime.
Budd's run-down trailer in the desert
Corn chips with a hot cheese sauce of cheddar melted into evaporated milk with pickled jalapeño juice, beef jerky on the side, all in plastic bowls.
M: Pork shoulder in big chunks simmered slowly in lard with orange, garlic, bay and salt for 3 hours, then crisped hard in a hot pan, in tortillas with salsa verde of charred tomatillo, chilli and coriander.
a kid's dinner at the villa

Tuna mixed with mayo, celery, spring onion and lemon, piled on buttered sourdough under bubbling cheddar, cut into fingers with a crunchy apple slaw. Drain 2 x 185g tins tuna and mix with 4 tbsp mayo, a finely diced celery stick, 2 sliced spring onions, lemon juice and pepper. Butter 4 thick slices sourdough and toast under the grill. Pile on the tuna and cover with 150g grated cheddar. Grill 3 minutes until bubbling and cut into fingers. Toss a julienned apple and quarter of a shredded cabbage with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon for slaw.
W: Crumbly, buttery Chinese almond cookies made with almond meal, each with a whole almond pressed into the top and an egg glaze, baked golden. Beat 150g butter with 120g sugar and 1 egg, add 1 tsp almond extract, then 220g flour, 50g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder. Roll into 20 balls, press an almond into each, brush with egg and bake at 175C for 14 minutes.
K: Blanco tequila with fresh pink grapefruit and lime juice, a little agave, topped with soda over ice in a chilli salt rimmed glass. Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of four tall glasses with lime and dip in the salt, then fill with ice. Into each glass pour 45ml blanco tequila, 60ml fresh pink grapefruit juice, 15ml lime juice and 10ml agave syrup. Top with 60ml soda water, stir and add a grapefruit wedge.
T: The Bride is back. She's hungry.
D: The Bride works through the rest of her list and finally faces Bill.
P: Serve the mains when the Bride finally reaches Bill's place in Mexico.

title: Lost in Translation
S: the bar high above Tokyo where they meet
Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed with flaky salt and sesame oil, and rice crackers with wasabi peas in little lacquer bowls.
the karaoke night in the private room
Chicken thigh pieces marinated in soy, sake, ginger and garlic for an hour, coated in potato starch, fried at 160C, rested, fried again at 190C. Japanese mayo and lemon.

Warm seasoned short grain rice pressed into triangles around tuna mayo or flaked salted salmon, wrapped in crisp nori just before eating. Wash 400g short grain rice until clear and cook with 480ml water. Season with salt and cool until just warm. Mix a 185g tin of tuna with 3 tbsp Japanese mayo and a little soy. Salt a 200g salmon fillet, grill 8 minutes and flake. With wet, salted hands shape 8 triangles, pushing a spoon of filling into the middle of each. Wrap with nori strips just before eating.
M: the restaurant where Bob complains you have to cook it yourself
Kombu simmered in water for a broth at the table, paper-thin beef, tofu, wombok, enoki and spring onion swished through, dipped in ponzu and sesame sauce. Rice to finish.
Kyoto kitsune udon with soft egg
Charlotte's day trip to the temples

Thick udon in a dashi of kombu and bonito with soy and mirin, topped with sweet simmered tofu, a soft egg, spring onion and tempura flakes. Soak a 10cm piece of kombu in 1.6L water for 30 minutes, bring to a simmer, remove and add 20g bonito flakes. Steep 5 minutes and strain, then season with 4 tbsp soy and 3 tbsp mirin. Simmer 4 fried tofu pouches in 200ml of the broth with 1 tbsp sugar for 10 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes. Cook 800g fresh udon for 2 minutes, divide into bowls and top with broth, tofu, halved eggs, spring onion and tempura flakes.
W: Matcha whisked into sweetened condensed milk and cream, whipped to soft peaks, frozen 6 hours, scooped soft into cones.
K: the drink Bob is in Tokyo to sell
45ml Japanese whisky in a tall glass packed with ice, topped with very cold soda water, stirred once, a twist of lemon.
T: Jet lagged, wide awake, and hungry.
D: A fading actor and a young woman, both stuck awake in a Tokyo hotel, form an unlikely bond.
P: Serve the mains when Bob and Charlotte sit down to cook their own shabu-shabu.

title: Tombstone
S: the saloon where Wyatt runs the faro table
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, peeled, packed into a jar with hot vinegar, beetroot juice, sugar, mustard seed and peppercorns, pickled 3 days until pink.
Smoky pepper beef jerky with cheddar
the long rides out of town

Thin-sliced topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, cracked pepper and smoked paprika, dried low and slow, with crackers, sharp cheddar and pickles. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Marinate overnight in 80ml soy, 3 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp cracked pepper and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Pat dry, lay on racks over trays and dry at 70C with the door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery. Serve with crackers, 200g sharp cheddar and pickles.
a long night at the tables
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot buttered cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter.
M: Saloon rump steak and molasses beans

Thick rump seared over hot coals and rested, with smoky beans simmered with bacon, onion, molasses and mustard, and crusty bread to mop up. Fry 150g diced bacon and a diced onion until golden. Add 2 drained tins cannellini beans, 400g crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 200ml water and simmer 40 minutes until thick. Season 1kg rump steak and cook over hot coals or a smoking pan 4 minutes a side, rest 8 minutes and slice. Serve with the beans and crusty bread.
the Earps' first night in Tombstone
Beef chuck diced, browned, braised 3 hours with dried chillies, cumin, garlic and tomato, no beans, Texas style. Cornbread alongside.
W: the actress who catches Wyatt's eye
Peaches sliced with sugar, lemon and cornflour, in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Cream.
K: Doc Holliday never without a glass

Rye whiskey stirred down over ice with demerara syrup and orange bitters, poured over a big cube with a flamed orange twist. Dissolve 2 tbsp demerara sugar in 2 tbsp hot water and cool. For each drink, stir 60ml rye whiskey, 7ml demerara syrup and 2 dashes orange bitters with ice for 30 seconds. Strain over one large ice cube in a tumbler. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the glass near a lit match so the oil flares, then drop it in.
T: I'm your huckleberry. Pass the beans.
D: Wyatt Earp and his brothers settle in Tombstone and clash with a gang of outlaws.
P: Serve the drinks when Doc Holliday sits down at the faro table.

title: Blazing Saddles
S: the townsfolk's welcome for the new sheriff
Mini apple pies: Granny Smiths cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, spooned into shortcrust cases, lidded, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.

Dark chocolate and salted caramel ganache rolled into truffles, coated in cocoa and crushed honeycomb, packed in a little gift box with a bow. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir until smooth, then mix in 3 tbsp thick caramel and a good pinch of sea salt. Chill 3 hours until firm. Roll into 24 balls with cool hands, then coat half in cocoa and half in 60g crushed honeycomb. Pack into a small box lined with baking paper and tie with a bow.
Peanuts and pecans tossed in butter, brown sugar, smoked paprika and a splash of bourbon, roasted at 160C for 20 minutes.
M: Pinto beans simmered thick with smoky bacon, onion, molasses, mustard and tomato, served in tin bowls with hot buttered skillet cornbread. Fry 200g diced bacon and a diced onion in a heavy pot until golden. Add 2 drained tins pinto beans, 400g crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 250ml water and simmer 40 minutes until thick. For cornbread, mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter, pour into a hot buttered pan and bake at 220C for 20 minutes.
the railroad crew's supper on the trail

Rib eyes crusted with salt and cracked pepper, seared in cast iron over hot coals, with potatoes and onions fried in the butter and steak juices. Season 4 rib eyes of 300g heavily with salt and cracked pepper and leave 30 minutes. Boil 800g halved small potatoes for 10 minutes and drain. Sear the steaks in a smoking cast iron pan 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare and rest 8 minutes. Add 50g butter and 2 sliced onions to the pan, then the potatoes, and fry 12 minutes until golden. Pour the resting juices over and serve.
W: dessert on the trail out of Rock Ridge
Peaches and blackberries tossed with sugar and a little cornflour, covered with spoonfuls of buttery biscuit dough, sprinkled with raw sugar, baked at 190C for 40 minutes until bubbling. Cream.
K: Cold sarsaparilla poured over a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it foams up, with a dash of bitters and a long spoon. Bourbon optional for cowboys. Chill four 375ml cans of sarsaparilla. Put a big scoop of vanilla ice cream into each of four tall glasses. Pour the sarsaparilla slowly down the side so it foams up over the ice cream. Add a dash of bitters to each. For the cowboys, add 30ml bourbon before pouring. Serve with long spoons and straws.
T: Beans. Lots of beans.
D: A Black sheriff is sent to a racist frontier town as part of a scheme to drive everyone out.
P: Serve the beans when the cowboys sit around the campfire.

title: Smokey and the Bandit
S: the truckers' stops on the CB radio

Pork rind dried overnight then roasted until puffed and crackling, broken into shards and dusted with smoked paprika, cayenne and salt, with a ranch dip. Score 600g pork rind in strips, rub well with salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Pat dry, lay skin up on a rack and roast at 240C for 30 to 40 minutes until fully puffed and crackling. Break into shards and dust with 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp cayenne and salt. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, garlic powder, dill and chives for dip.
Raw peanuts in the shell boiled 2 hours in heavily salted water with a little Cajun spice, left to soak an hour, served warm in paper cups.
a Texas sheriff a long way from home
Okra packed into jars with garlic, dill and chilli, covered in hot vinegar brine, pickled a week, served cold with sharp cheddar.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and cayenne, baked low and slow, glazed with a tangy vinegar barbecue sauce and charred, with crunchy coleslaw. Mix 2 tbsp paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp salt and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours.
