Simmer 125ml cider vinegar, 125ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp chilli flakes for 5 minutes. Brush on the ribs and grill hot for 5 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage and a grated carrot with 125g mayo and vinegar.
a quick stop while the Snowman keeps rolling
Minute steaks pounded thin, dredged in seasoned flour, buttermilk and flour again, fried until crisp, smothered in cracked pepper cream gravy. Mash.
W: Sliced peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon and lemon, covered in buttery biscuit dough, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the long haul from Texarkana to Atlanta

Black tea brewed strong with fresh peach and sugar, chilled, poured over ice with a shot of bourbon, lemon and mint. Leave out the bourbon for the drivers. Brew 5 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 2 sliced peaches and 100g sugar for 6 minutes. Remove the bags and chill with the peaches in. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 30ml bourbon to each, then top with the tea. Finish each with a squeeze of lemon, a peach slice and a sprig of mint.
T: Eastbound and down. Pass the ribs.
D: A bootlegger runs a truckload of beer across state lines with a sheriff chasing him the whole way.
P: Serve the mains when the Bandit picks up Frog by the side of the road.

title: Three Amigos!
S: the cantina where they start a brawl

Corn chips layered with spiced black beans and melted cheddar, topped with pico de gallo, pickled jalapeno, guacamole and sour cream. Warm a drained tin of black beans with 1 tsp cumin and a splash of water and mash roughly. Layer 300g corn chips, the beans and 200g grated cheddar on a tray and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Dice 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and coriander with lime and salt for pico. Mash 2 avocados with lime. Top the nachos with pico, sliced pickled jalapeno, guacamole and 150g sour cream.
the little village they ride in to save
Corn cobs grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander.
the singing bush in the desert
Green salsa: tomatillos and green chillies charred, blitzed with onion, garlic, coriander and lime, served with warm tortilla chips.
M: Pork shoulder marinated in achiote, orange and garlic, roasted wrapped at 160C for 4 hours, shredded, in corn tortillas with pickled red onion and habanero salsa.

Poached chicken and cheese rolled in corn tortillas, smothered in a smoky red chilli sauce and more cheese, baked bubbling, with sour cream and coriander. Poach 800g chicken thighs in salted water for 20 minutes and shred. Soften a diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 chipotle in adobo, 700g passata and 200ml stock and simmer 15 minutes. Mix the chicken with a little sauce and 100g cheese. Roll in 12 corn tortillas, lay in a dish, cover with sauce and 150g cheese and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Top with sour cream and coriander.
W: El Guapo's birthday cake, sort of
Choux dough piped into hot oil at 180C, fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with dulce de leche for dipping and a candle in the pile.
K: El Guapo would like to know, what is a plethora?

45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime shaken with ice, salt rim. For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain into a glass with a salted rim. Makes four plethoras of margaritas.
T: A plethora of tacos.
D: Three silent film stars mistake a real call for help from a Mexican village for a paid show.
P: Serve the mains at El Guapo's birthday party.

title: Rocky
S: Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared on a hot plate with onions, provolone melted over, piled into mini rolls.
the run through the Italian Market
Salami, prosciutto, provolone, marinated artichoke, olives and roasted capsicum on a board with crusty bread.
Philly soft pretzels with beer cheese

Chewy figure-eight pretzels dipped in hot bicarb water, baked deep brown with rock salt, served with yellow mustard and a sharp cheddar beer cheese dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll 8 ropes and twist into figure eights. Dip each for 30 seconds in 2L simmering water with 80g bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, 150ml lager and 200g grated cheddar until smooth.
M: the turkey Paulie throws out the back door

Brined turkey breast roasted golden and sliced thick, with sage and onion stuffing, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy. Keep it on the table. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar. Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C to 70C inside, about 80 minutes, then rest 15 minutes. Mix 200g torn bread with a sauteed onion, 40g butter, sage and an egg and bake 30 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 400ml chicken stock and simmer for gravy. Serve with cranberry sauce.
the sides of beef Rocky punches in Paulie's meat locker
Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seasoned with cracked pepper, seared in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, pulled at 54C and rested. Roast potatoes.
W: Cuff and Link, the turtles from Adrian's pet shop
Little clusters of toasted pecans topped with a spoon of soft caramel and a cap of melted dark chocolate, set on baking paper so each one looks like a turtle.
K: the five raw eggs at 4am, but drinkable
A ripe banana, cold milk, a big spoon of peanut butter, oats and a little honey blended thick. Rocky's raw egg version not recommended.
T: Yo, Adrian. Dinner.
D: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a shot at the world heavyweight title.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky runs up the museum steps.

title: Rocky IV
S: the long winter in the Soviet Union
Buckwheat and plain flour batter with yeast and milk, rested an hour, cooked small in butter, topped with sour cream, smoked salmon and dill.
Cucumbers packed into jars with garlic, dill, peppercorns and a hot salted brine, left on the bench 4 days to ferment sour, served with rye bread and butter.
Paulie's birthday present, the talking robot

Chocolate cake crumbled into cream cheese frosting, rolled into balls and dipped in silver-tinted white chocolate on sticks, with silver cachous for eyes. Bake a chocolate cake from 200g self-raising flour, 40g cocoa, 200g sugar, 2 eggs, 125ml oil and 250ml milk at 175C for 35 minutes, then cool. Crumble and mix with 125g cream cheese beaten with 60g icing sugar. Roll into 20 balls, push in sticks and chill 1 hour. Melt 300g white chocolate, dip each pop, dust with edible silver lustre and press on 2 silver cachous for eyes.
M: a hot bowl after chopping wood in the snow

Beef shin simmered with beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato into a deep red soup, sharpened with vinegar, with sour cream, dill and buttered rye. Simmer 800g beef shin in 2L water with a bay leaf for 2 hours, then shred the meat back into the broth. Soften a diced onion and carrot, add 3 grated beetroot and 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook 10 minutes. Add to the pot with 2 diced potatoes and a quarter of a cabbage, shredded, and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and season. Serve with sour cream, dill and buttered rye bread.
Soviet dumplings for Drago's training camp

Beef and pork mince with grated onion and pepper wrapped in thin dough, boiled 5 minutes until they float, tossed in butter with dill and a spoon of sour cream. Mix 300g flour, 1 egg and 125ml water into a firm dough and rest. Mix 250g beef mince, 250g pork mince and 1 grated onion. Roll the dough thin, cut rounds, fill and seal. Boil 5 minutes, toss in 50g butter and dill, serve with sour cream.
W: Buttery walnut shortbread balls baked pale and rolled twice in icing sugar until they look like snowballs, served with strong black tea. Beat 225g butter with 60g icing sugar and vanilla, then mix in 280g plain flour and 100g finely chopped walnuts. Roll into 30 balls and bake at 180C for 14 minutes. Roll in icing sugar while warm, then again when cool.
K: Freezer-cold vodka with cranberry juice, fresh lime and spicy ginger beer over crushed ice, with frozen cranberries and a sprig of rosemary. Keep the vodka in the freezer overnight. Fill four copper mugs or tumblers with crushed ice. Add to each 45ml vodka, 45ml cranberry juice and the juice of half a lime. Top with 120ml cold ginger beer and stir once. Drop in a few frozen cranberries and a rosemary sprig.
T: If he dies, he dies. If you're hungry, eat.
D: Rocky travels to the Soviet Union to fight the giant boxer who killed his friend.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky starts training in the Siberian snow.

title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
S: the dog ate a whole wheel, Ron isn't even mad
A whole wheel of brie scored on top, baked at 180C for 15 minutes with honey, thyme and walnuts, served with crackers.
the pride of San Diego, Ron's town
Thin steak marinated in lime, garlic and cumin, grilled and chopped over crisp fries with melted cheese, guacamole and sour cream.
Brick's French onion dip and chips

Onions cooked low and slow until jammy, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives and a dash of Worcestershire, with thick-cut salted chips. Cook 3 thinly sliced brown onions in 40g butter over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden and jammy. Cool completely. Beat 250g sour cream with 125g cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire, garlic powder and salt, then fold in the onions and chopped chives. Chill 1 hour so the flavour comes through. Serve with 2 large bags of thick-cut salted chips.
M: Stay classy, San Diego. Mild chicken tacos for the news team.
Crispy oven-baked chicken in warm corn tortillas with cabbage, fresh tomato salsa and lime crema. Mild enough for the whole news team.
Ron takes Veronica out on the town

Sirloin seared and butter basted with garlic and thyme, with a loaded baked potato, creamy garlic spinach and a peppercorn sauce. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 sirloins and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, add 40g butter, garlic and thyme and baste until 54C inside, then rest. Add 1 tbsp cracked pepper and 150ml cream to the pan and simmer 2 minutes. Wilt 400g spinach with garlic, add 100ml cream and 30g parmesan and reduce. Split the potatoes and top with sour cream and chives.
W: Warm self-saucing butterscotch pudding with golden syrup, dark brown sugar and vanilla ice cream.
K: Ron's newsroom exclamation, with a blackberry twist.
Homemade blackberry and lemon syrup topped with sparkling water over ice. A deep burgundy drink for the whole family.
T: Stay classy. Stay hungry.
D: A San Diego news anchor's world is turned upside down when a talented woman joins the newsroom.
P: Serve the cheese when Ron finds out Baxter ate a whole wheel of cheese.

title: Step Brothers
S: the yacht club party they somehow end up running
Prawns on cucumber rounds with lemon mayo, crostini with whipped ricotta and honey, and figs wrapped in prosciutto, on silver trays.
Bunk bed parmesan garlic butter popcorn
the bunk beds they build with way too much room

Fresh stovetop popcorn tossed with garlic butter, finely grated parmesan, cracked pepper and chopped parsley, split into two big bowls for top and bottom bunk. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot with a lid, add 150g popping corn, cover and shake over medium heat until the popping slows. Melt 60g butter with a crushed garlic clove. Toss the popcorn with the garlic butter, 40g finely grated parmesan, cracked pepper, fine salt and chopped parsley. Split between two big bowls.
the big pitch for their entertainment company

Little chuck patties smashed thin and crisp on a hot griddle, cheddar melted on, with buttery onions, pickles and burger sauce in soft slider rolls. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Roll 600g chuck mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Heat a griddle until smoking, smash the balls thin, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and add a piece of cheddar. Fill 12 toasted slider rolls with patty, onions, pickles and sauce.
M: Snapper fillets roasted with lemon, garlic, capers and olive oil, with herbed buttery new potatoes and a green salad in mustard dressing. Boil 800g new potatoes for 15 minutes and toss with 30g butter and chopped parsley and dill. Lay 4 snapper fillets in a dish with lemon slices, 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp capers and 3 tbsp olive oil. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Whisk 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar and 3 tbsp olive oil and toss with a bag of mixed leaves.
the awkward first dinner as a blended family

Beef and pork meatloaf with grated onion and milk-soaked crumbs, glazed sticky with tomato and brown sugar, with buttery mash and green beans. Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.
W: two grown men who never grew up
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream in a big tub on ice, with hot fudge made from dark chocolate melted into cream, sprinkles, whipped cream and cherries so everyone builds their own.
K: Catalina Wine Mixer strawberry rosé spritz

Chilled dry rosé with muddled strawberries, elderflower cordial and lemon, topped with soda water over ice in big wine glasses. Slice 8 strawberries and divide between four large wine glasses. Add 15ml elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each and press lightly with a spoon. Fill with ice, pour in 120ml cold dry rosé and top with 60ml soda water. Stir gently and add a lemon wheel.
T: Did we just become best friends. Yep.
D: Two middle-aged men who still live at home become stepbrothers when their parents marry.
P: Serve the wine when the Catalina Wine Mixer starts.

title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
S: Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Yellow mustard.
the French driver who reads at the wheel
Thin crêpe batter rested an hour, cooked in a buttered pan, folded around ham and gruyère, or sugar and lemon.

Raw peanuts in the shell boiled soft in a salty Cajun brine with garlic and chilli, left to soak up the spice, served warm in paper cups. Rinse 500g raw peanuts in the shell. Put in a large pot with 3L water, 80g salt, 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning, a halved garlic bulb and 2 dried chillies. Weigh down with a plate so they stay under and simmer for 2 hours until soft. Turn off the heat and leave to soak for 1 hour. Drain and serve warm in paper cups with a bowl for shells.
M: the grace that turns into a speech
A big family takeaway spread made at home: buttermilk fried chicken, a pizza and hard-shell tacos, all on the table at once. Grace optional.

Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow roasted until it falls apart, tossed in tangy vinegar sauce, on soft rolls with coleslaw and pickles. Mix 2 tbsp paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp salt and rub over a 1.5kg pork shoulder. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Simmer 125ml cider vinegar, 80ml tomato sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar for 3 minutes and toss through the shredded pork. Toss half a shredded cabbage with mayo. Pile into 8 soft rolls with slaw and pickles.
W: Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into squares, half dusted with icing sugar in a chequered pattern.
K: the French driver orders a macchiato

Cold milk and homemade salted caramel over ice, with a double espresso poured on top so it layers, finished with a caramel drizzle. Heat 100g caster sugar in a pan until amber, then carefully whisk in 80ml cream, 20g butter and a pinch of salt and cool. Brew 4 double espressos. Spoon 1 tbsp caramel into each of four glasses, fill with ice and add 200ml cold milk. Pour the espresso slowly over the back of a spoon so it layers, then drizzle with more caramel.
T: If you ain't first, you're last. So eat fast.
D: A NASCAR star loses everything to a French rival and has to fight his way back.
P: Serve the mains when Ricky says grace over the family dinner.

title: Zoolander
S: Cucumber, celery, carrot and radish cut long and lean, stood up in a glass on ice, with a dip of blue cheese mashed into sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and black pepper.
the day spa where Derek gets the mudpack
Thick cucumber rounds topped with goat's cheese whipped with lemon zest, a curl of smoked salmon and a dill frond, kept very cold.
Coal miner's corned beef rye sandwiches
Derek's family back home in the mines

Corned silverside simmered tender and sliced thin on buttered rye with hot English mustard, Swiss cheese and dill pickles, wrapped in paper like a miner's lunch. Rinse a 1.5kg corned silverside and simmer in a pot of water with a brown onion, 6 cloves, 2 bay leaves and 2 tbsp brown sugar for 3 hours. Cool in the liquid, then slice thin. Butter 8 slices rye bread, spread 4 with English mustard and layer with the beef, 4 slices Swiss cheese and sliced dill pickles. Close, cut in half and wrap each in baking paper.
M: Rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, finished in a sauce of garlic and chilli sautéed in butter, tomato paste fried until brick red, a splash of vodka and cream, parmesan and basil.

Lamb cutlets marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled hot and pink, with a Greek salad of feta, tomato, cucumber and olives, and warm pita. Mix the juice and zest of a lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and 3 tbsp olive oil. Marinate 12 lamb cutlets for 1 hour. Grill on very high heat for 2 minutes a side and rest 3 minutes. Toss 3 chopped tomatoes, a cucumber, half a red onion and 100g kalamata olives with olive oil and red wine vinegar, and top with 150g feta. Warm 4 pita breads on the grill.
W: the scale model that is too small
Vanilla sponges baked at 175C, one in a normal tin and one in a teacup, both covered in white buttercream, so there's a cake for ants and a real one for you.
K: the drink before the petrol station fight
Double espresso shaken hard with chocolate syrup, orange zest, cold milk and ice, strained into a tall glass over more ice.
T: Really, really, ridiculously good food.
D: A dim male model is brainwashed into becoming an assassin by a fashion mogul.
P: Serve the drinks when the boys order orange mocha iced coffees.

title: Meet the Parents
S: the pool volleyball game Greg takes too far

Corn chips piled with smoky chipotle chicken, black beans and melted cheddar, topped with pico de gallo, pickled jalapeno, guacamole and sour cream. Poach 400g chicken thighs for 20 minutes, shred and toss with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a splash of the sauce. Layer 300g corn chips with the chicken, a drained tin of black beans and 200g grated cheddar, and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Dice 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and coriander with lime. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top with pico, jalapeno, guacamole and sour cream.
the cat who uses the toilet
Tuna mixed with mayo, celery, spring onion and lemon, spooned onto crisp cucumber rounds, finished with dill and black pepper.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a splash of pickle juice, piped back in, smoked paprika and chives on top.
M: Byrnes family roast sirloin and gravy
the dinner where Greg says grace

Sirloin roasted pink and carved thick, with crisp roast potatoes, honey buttered carrots and a rich red wine gravy. Season a 1.5kg sirloin roast the day before. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil at 220C for 50 minutes. Sear the beef, then roast at 200C to 52C inside, about 40 minutes, and rest 20 minutes. Boil 500g carrots and toss with butter and honey. Add 150ml red wine to the roasting tray and reduce, then add 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp flour paste and simmer for gravy.
the rehearsal dinner for Pam's sister
Salmon fillets roasted at 200C for 10 minutes with a crust of dill, parsley, lemon zest and breadcrumbs, with herbed new potatoes and asparagus.
W: dessert, well away from the gazebo
Sweet pastry blind baked at 180C, filled with lemon juice, zest, eggs, sugar and cream whisked together, baked at 140C for 30 minutes until just set, chilled, icing sugar on top.
K: Greg reckons he can milk just about anything

Ice-cold full cream milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream and malt powder, poured into tall frosted glasses with whipped cream and a sprinkle of malt. Put four tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 800ml ice-cold full cream milk, 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla extract until thick and frothy. Pour into the frosted glasses, top with whipped cream and dust with a little extra malt powder.
T: The circle of trust has snacks.
D: A male nurse meets his girlfriend's intimidating ex-CIA father for a weekend that goes wrong at every turn.
P: Serve the mains when Greg is asked to say grace at dinner.

title: Wedding Crashers
S: Warm little blini topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, salmon roe and chives, passed round on silver trays like a proper reception. Warm 20 blini at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of half a lemon and a pinch of salt. Spoon a little onto each blini, top with a ribbon of smoked salmon from 200g, a few beads of salmon roe and chopped chives. Finish with cracked pepper and serve straight away on a tray.
Crab meat folded with a little mayo, egg, mustard, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon.
the sailing trip that ends badly
Cooked prawns chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf with grated onion, egg and Worcestershire, glazed sticky with tomato and brown sugar, with buttery mash and gravy. Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt and press into a loaf tin. Spread with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Simmer the pan juices with 250ml beef stock and 1 tbsp flour for gravy.

Pan-roasted chicken breasts with a white wine, mustard and tarragon cream sauce, potato gratin and green beans. Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Pan-roast 4 chicken breasts. Add 150ml white wine, 1 tbsp Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then 150ml cream. Serve with 300g green beans.
W: no excuses, play like a champion

Vanilla butter cake baked at 165C, split and layered with raspberry jam and Swiss meringue buttercream (egg whites and sugar heated to 70C, whipped, butter beaten in), served in fingers. Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 165C for 30 minutes. Heat 3 whites and 150g sugar to 70C, whip, then beat in 250g butter. Layer with raspberry jam and cut into fingers.
K: the toast at every reception they crash

Gin shaken with fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup, strained into a flute and topped with cold sparkling wine and a long lemon twist. Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine for three hours. For each drink, shake 30ml gin, 15ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain into a flute and top slowly with about 90ml sparkling wine. Add a long twist of lemon peel and raise them high while someone gives a speech.
T: Ma, the meatloaf.
D: Two divorce mediators crash weddings for fun, until they fall for the daughters of a powerful politician.
P: Serve the mains when the Cleary family sits down to dinner.

title: Old School
S: Frat party smash sliders in paper
the first big party at Mitch's house

Thin crispy smashed beef patties with melted American cheese, pickles, diced onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, wrapped in paper. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for sauce. Heat a griddle until smoking, smash the balls thin, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and top with half a slice of American cheese. Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patty, sauce, pickles and finely diced onion. Wrap each in a square of baking paper.
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce with melted butter and honey, blue cheese dip and celery.
Jalapeños halved and seeded, filled with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon crisps.
M: Brisket rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, smoked or roasted wrapped at 140C for 8 hours until it wobbles, rested an hour, sliced thick. Pickles, white bread and barbecue sauce.
Frank's wedding chicken with mushroom sauce

Chicken breasts pan-roasted in butter and thyme with a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, buttery mash and green beans. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in 30g butter for 4 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 10 minutes and rest. In the same pan fry 300g sliced mushrooms and a chopped shallot, add 125ml white wine and reduce, then 200ml cream and thyme and simmer 3 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Slice the chicken and spoon over the sauce.
W: Chocolate sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fudge frosting and sprinkles, cut into big squares straight from the tray.
K: the keg party at Mitch's house

Bourbon, fresh lemon juice, peach nectar and cold lager stirred in a big bowl with ice, lemon wheels and mint, ladled into red plastic cups. In a big bowl stir 200ml bourbon, the juice of 4 lemons, 60ml sugar syrup and 500ml peach nectar. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml cold lager. Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.
T: We're going streaking. After dinner.
D: Three men in their thirties start a fraternity at the house next to a college campus.
P: Serve the mains when Mitch's house party kicks off.

title: The Hangover
S: Alan welcomes you into his wolfpack

Prawns poached 2 minutes, iced, piled high on crushed ice with cocktail sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish and lemon. Poach 600g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel, leaving the tails on. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish and lemon juice. Pile the prawns on a bag of crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.
waking up with a tiger in the bathroom
Grated potato squeezed dry, seasoned, pressed into thin cakes, fried in butter and oil until deep golden, a fried egg on top.
the chicken wandering around the suite

Buttermilk-brined chicken breast chunks rolled in crushed cornflakes and seasoned flour, fried crunchy and golden, with a honey mustard dip. Cut 600g chicken breast into chunks and soak in 250ml buttermilk with salt for 1 hour. Crush 100g cornflakes and mix with 50g plain flour, 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Coat the chicken and fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden and cooked through. Mix 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp Dijon and 2 tbsp mayo for dipping.
M: a big night on the Strip

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and rested, with a buttery tarragon béarnaise, creamed spinach and a loaded baked potato. Salt 4 rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Reduce 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with a chopped shallot and tarragon to 1 tbsp, whisk with 3 yolks over simmering water, then slowly whisk in 180g melted butter. Sear the steaks to 54C inside and rest. Wilt 400g spinach with garlic and 100ml cream. Load the potatoes with sour cream, bacon and chives.
the morning after, with a baby in the closet

Flour tortillas filled with soft scrambled eggs, chorizo, potato, cheddar and salsa, rolled, toasted in a dry pan. Dice and fry 300g potatoes until crisp, then add 200g diced chorizo. Softly scramble 8 eggs. Fill 4 large flour tortillas with the eggs, potato, chorizo, 100g cheddar and a fresh salsa of 2 tomatoes and onion. Roll and toast in a dry pan.
W: the wedding they barely make it back for
Lemon butter cake baked at 170C, split and filled with lemon curd and vanilla buttercream, covered smooth and chilled before slicing.
K: the toast on the roof before it all goes wrong

Ice-cold herbal liqueur with fresh lime and spicy ginger beer, poured over ice in tall glasses with an orange slice. Put the herbal liqueur in the freezer for an hour. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 30ml liqueur and the juice of half a lime to each, then top with 150ml cold ginger beer. Stir once, add an orange slice and toast on the roof.
T: What happens in Vegas gets eaten in Vegas.
D: Three friends wake up in a trashed Las Vegas suite with no memory of the night and no sign of the groom.
P: Serve the drinks when the Wolf Pack toasts on the roof.

title: Bridesmaids
S: Crisp, chewy almond meringue shells tinted pale pink, sandwiched with a tangy raspberry and white chocolate ganache, rested a day so they go soft in the middle. Sift 150g almond meal with 150g icing sugar and mix with 55g egg white to a paste. Boil 150g caster sugar and 40ml water to 118C and pour into 55g egg whites whisking to a stiff meringue, add pink colour. Fold into the paste until it flows like lava. Pipe 4cm rounds, rest 30 minutes and bake at 145C for 14 minutes. Melt 120g white chocolate with 60ml cream and 3 tbsp raspberry jam, cool and sandwich.

Cubes of squeaky haloumi dipped in a light lager batter and fried until crunchy and golden, with a cold herby ranch dip. Cut 400g haloumi into 2cm cubes and pat dry. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 egg and 200ml cold lager into a batter. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill, chives, garlic powder and a squeeze of lemon for ranch. Heat 1L oil to 185C, dip the cheese in batter and fry in batches for 1 minute until golden. Drain and salt lightly.
Annie's bakery that didn't make it

Cinnamon scrolls: yeasted dough with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon rolled, cut, proved, baked at 190C for 20 minutes, iced. Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and 1 tbsp cinnamon. Roll, cut 12 and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes and ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with icing sugar.
M: Wedding lemon thyme chicken and gratin
the big wedding Helen plans to the last detail

Golden pan-roasted chicken breast in a white wine, lemon and thyme cream sauce, with a slow-baked potato gratin and buttered greens. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, a crushed garlic clove and salt and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Brine 4 skin-on chicken breasts in salted water for 1 hour, pat dry and fry skin down in 30g butter for 5 minutes, then flip and roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Add 125ml white wine to the pan and reduce, then 150ml cream, lemon juice and thyme. Steam 300g green beans and broccolini with butter.
the trip to Vegas that never makes it past the plane
Rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, finished in a sauce of tomato simmered 20 minutes with garlic and chilli, tossed with torn burrata and basil just before serving.
W: the one cupcake she makes alone late at night
Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with a tall swirl of pale pink Swiss meringue buttercream, finished with a little sugar flower made from fondant.
K: Chilled rosé with pink grapefruit juice and soda over lots of ice, sliced strawberries and a sprig of mint in big wine glasses. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice and sliced strawberries. Add 120ml chilled rosé and 40ml pink grapefruit juice to each and top with 60ml soda water. Stir gently and finish with a sprig of mint. Keep the bottle on ice so every top-up stays cold.
T: Help me, I'm poor. Have a cupcake.
D: A maid of honour's life unravels as she competes with a rich new friend over the bride.
P: Serve dessert when Annie bakes her one perfect cupcake.

title: Hot Fuzz
S: where Angel turfs out the underage drinkers

Thick slices of mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, a chunky brown pickle, apple and crusty bread with salted butter on a wooden board. Take 250g mature cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead and cut into thick slices. Cut a pork pie into wedges. Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, a sliced apple, crusty bread and a dish of salted butter.
Village of the Year fete scotch eggs
Sandford's pride, the fete with the coconut shy

Eggs boiled 6 minutes, peeled, wrapped in seasoned sausage mince, rolled in flour, egg and panko, fried at 170C for 7 minutes. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Wrap each in 100g seasoned sausage mince. Roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 7 minutes, halve and serve with English mustard.
Neighbourhood Watch pork and apple rolls

Pork sausage mince with grated apple, sage and onion rolled in flaky puff pastry, glazed with egg and fennel seeds and baked deep golden, with brown sauce. Mix 600g pork sausage mince with a grated green apple, a finely diced onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage and pepper. Cut 3 sheets puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each and roll up, sealing with beaten egg. Brush with egg, sprinkle with fennel seeds and cut into 4cm pieces. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until deep golden. Serve with brown sauce.
M: Greater good steak and ale pie
the Neighbourhood Watch motto, said in unison

Beef chuck braised in dark ale with onion, thyme and a little Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, add 2 onions, thyme, 375ml ale and a dash of Worcestershire and braise 2.5 hours. Thicken and pour into a pie dish. Cover with puff, bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with chips and 300g peas.
Supermarket roast chicken and bread sauce
the village supermarket with its smiling manager

Whole chicken roasted golden, with roast potatoes cooked in the chicken fat, honey roast carrots and a creamy clove-studded bread sauce. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter and salt and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, and rest. Parboil 1kg potatoes, roast in the chicken fat for 50 minutes. Toss 500g carrots in honey and oil and roast 30 minutes. Simmer 400ml milk with an onion studded with 4 cloves for 10 minutes, remove the onion and stir in 80g fresh breadcrumbs and 20g butter.
W: Waffle cones filled with strawberry ice cream rippled with fresh strawberry sauce, dipped in dark chocolate and chopped nuts, frozen until serving.
K: Angel's cranberry lime cooler, no ice
Angel's order at the pub, no ice

Cranberry juice chilled hard and shaken with fresh lime and a little ginger syrup, poured into a cold pint glass with no ice, topped with soda. Chill 800ml cranberry juice and four pint glasses in the fridge for 3 hours. Simmer 60g sugar, 60ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each glass, shake 200ml cranberry juice with the juice of half a lime and 15ml ginger syrup, pour into a cold pint glass and top with soda water. No ice.
T: For the greater good. And the cheese board.
D: A top London cop is reassigned to a quiet country village where the accidents keep piling up.
P: Serve the drinks when Angel orders a cranberry juice at the pub.

title: Tropic Thunder
S: he wants jelly beans very, very badly

Soft fruit pastilles of mango and raspberry purée set with pectin, cut into cubes and rolled in sugar, piled in a bowl with jelly beans. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Bring 250g mango purée and 250g raspberry purée to the boil with 25g pectin mixed into 50g sugar. Add 450g sugar and 2 tbsp glucose and boil, stirring, to 107C. Stir in 1 tsp citric acid and pour into the tin. Set at room temperature for 4 hours, cut into 2cm cubes and roll in caster sugar. Serve with 200g jelly beans.
the candy bar he's in the film to sell
Roasted peanuts bound with a chewy caramel of brown sugar, golden syrup and butter, pressed into a tray, coated in milk chocolate, cut into bars.
Four Leaf's jungle banh mi bites
the vet who wrote the book the film is based on

Small baguettes with pork pâté, char siu, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Quick-pickle a carrot and some daikon in vinegar and sugar. Split 2 small baguettes, spread with 100g pork pâté and fill with 200g char siu, pickles, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Cut into bites.
M: Spiced beef broth with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon over rice noodles and paper-thin raw beef, with bean sprouts, Thai basil, lime and chilli. Char a halved onion and a 6cm piece of ginger under the grill. Simmer 1.5kg beef bones in 3L water for 3 hours with the onion, ginger, 4 star anise, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves, skimming. Strain and season with 3 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar. Soak 400g rice noodles and divide into bowls with 300g paper-thin raw eye fillet. Pour over the boiling broth. Serve with sprouts, Thai basil, lime and chilli.
the jungle gang's camp, hot as it sounds

Green curry paste fried in coconut cream until it splits, chicken thigh, coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, Thai eggplant and basil. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in the thick top of 800ml coconut milk until it splits. Add 800g sliced chicken thighs, the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and Thai eggplant. Simmer 15 minutes and add Thai basil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.
W: Glutinous rice soaked overnight, steamed 25 minutes, soaked in warm coconut milk with sugar and salt, with ripe mango and a salty coconut sauce.
K: the energy drink Alpa Chino keeps plugging

Fresh passionfruit and lime shaken with homemade ginger syrup, topped with soda over ice and a mint sprig. All the buzz, none of the sweat. Simmer 100g sugar, 100ml water and a sliced 5cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Mix with the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Fill four tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top each with 150ml soda water. Stir and add a mint sprig.
T: Never go full jungle. Go full snacks.
D: A group of pampered actors shooting a war film end up in a real jungle fight.
P: Serve the snacks when Portnoy starts begging for jelly beans.

title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
S: dodge, duck, dip, dive and dodge
Crunchy carrot, celery, cucumber and capsicum sticks with hummus, tzatziki and sweet chilli sour cream to dip into.
round, red and ready to throw
Beef and pork meatballs rolled with parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered in tomato sauce for 30 minutes, served on toothpicks.
Globo Gym choc peanut protein balls
White Goodman's very serious fitness empire

Medjool dates, oats, peanut butter, cocoa and honey blitzed into chewy balls, rolled in toasted coconut with a pinch of sea salt. Pit 12 medjool dates and blitz with 100g rolled oats, 120g peanut butter, 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of sea salt until it clumps. Roll into 16 balls. Toast 50g desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden, cool and roll the balls in it. Chill 30 minutes before serving.
M: Seared scotch fillet with a sunny side up egg, hash browns and grilled tomato, casino breakfast at any hour.

Beef chuck browned hard and braised slowly with onion, carrot, celery, tomato and thyme, potatoes in for the last hour, with crusty bread. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Soften a diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks in the same pot. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, thyme and 750ml beef stock, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 600g chunked potatoes and braise 1 hour more until tender. Serve with crusty bread.
W: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 40 minutes, covered in fudge frosting, a red fondant ball sitting on top.
K: water breaks between rounds at Average Joe's

Fresh orange and lemon juice stirred with honey and a pinch of salt, topped with soda over ice with orange wheels and mint. Stir 500ml fresh orange juice with the juice of 2 lemons, 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of fine salt until the honey dissolves. Fill four tall glasses with ice and orange wheels, pour in the juice and top each with 100ml soda water. Finish with mint.
T: If you can dodge a wrench, you can dodge a second helping.
D: A rundown gym's misfit members enter a dodgeball tournament to save it from a slick fitness chain.
P: Serve the mains when the team heads to the tournament in Las Vegas.

title: School of Rock
S: Dewey keeps eating Ned's labelled food
Mini sandwiches of ham, cheese and pickle and egg and lettuce, each wrapped in baking paper with a name written on it in marker.
Battle of the Bands honey corn dogs
the big show at the end

Franks on sticks dipped in a sweet honey cornmeal and buttermilk batter, fried deep golden, with yellow mustard and tomato sauce for squirting. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk into a thick batter and pour into a tall glass. Pat 8 franks dry, push a skewer into each and dust with flour. Heat 1.5L oil to 180C. Dip each frank in the batter and fry for 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
Cheddar, butter and flour pastry rolled thin, cut into stars, brushed with egg, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.
M: Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, mozzarella, pepperoni and chilli honey, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
Roadhouse bacon and onion ring burgers
Dewey takes the principal out for a beer

Thick chuck patties grilled medium with cheddar and crisp bacon, topped with beer-battered onion rings and smoky barbecue mayo on toasted buns. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties. Whisk 100g flour with 150ml cold soda water, dip thick rings from a large onion and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp. Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Grill the patties 4 minutes a side, adding cheddar for the last minute. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Stack on toasted buns with bacon, onion rings and sauce.
W: Butter sugar cookies cut into guitars, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with red, black and white royal icing.
K: Raspberries, orange and pineapple juice stirred with fresh lime and topped with lemonade, ice, sliced oranges and mint in a big jug. Lightly crush 125g raspberries in a big jug with the juice of 2 limes. Add 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice and stir. Just before serving fill with ice, top with 750ml cold lemonade and add sliced oranges and a few mint sprigs. Pour so everyone gets some berries.
T: Stick it to the man. Then eat.
D: A broke rock musician poses as a substitute teacher and turns his class into a band.
P: Serve the snacks when the class gets their band parts.

title: Mean Girls
S: Flour tortillas spread with beetroot hummus, filled with roast chicken, rocket and feta, rolled and sliced into pink spirals.

Dark chocolate layered with white chocolate and crushed candy canes, set and snapped into shards, bundled with ribbon-tied candy canes. Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 200g dark chocolate, spread it thin and chill 15 minutes until set. Melt 200g white chocolate with a few drops of peppermint essence and spread over the top. Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes and press in lightly. Chill 30 minutes, then snap into shards. Tie 8 more candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon.

Little shortcrust pies in a muffin tin filled with cinnamon apple, latticed on top, sprinkled with raw sugar and baked golden. Vanilla cream to dollop. Cook 3 diced Granny Smith apples with 30g butter, 3 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes until soft, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 3 sheets shortcrust and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with apple, cut the leftover pastry into strips and weave a lattice on each. Brush with egg, sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 190C for 25 minutes. Whip 200ml cream with vanilla.
M: Parmesan and panko crumbed chicken tenders baked crisp, with buttery mash and a crunchy cos salad, ranch dip on the side, served on trays. Cut 700g chicken breast into strips. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 150g panko mixed with 40g parmesan and paprika. Bake on an oiled tray at 220C for 18 minutes, turning once. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Toss a chopped cos lettuce with cucumber and lemon dressing. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, dill and chives for ranch.
the Halloween party where everyone dresses up
Beef mince browned hard with onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and a little tomato paste, loosened with stock, spooned into warm hard shells with cheddar, shredded lettuce, tomato and sour cream.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled, piped with buttercream tinted pale pink with a spoon of raspberry purée, finished with pink sprinkles.
K: Fresh lemon juice blended with raspberries and sugar syrup, strained, topped with cold soda water over ice with lemon wheels and whole berries. Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with the juice of 5 lemons and 125g raspberries, then strain. Pour into a jug with plenty of ice, top with 1L cold soda water and add lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries. Stir and pour into four glasses.
T: On Wednesdays we eat pink.
D: A teenager raised in Africa starts at a US high school and gets caught up with the popular girls.
P: Serve the snacks when Cady first sees the cafeteria map.

title: Superbad
S: the bowls on the kitchen bench at Jules's party
Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Thick ridged potato chips.
the shop where McLovin shows his fake ID

Pretzels, cheese crackers and peanuts baked in Worcestershire garlic butter until toasty and crunchy, cooled with chocolate buttons tossed through. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp garlic powder and half a tsp smoked paprika. Toss with 150g pretzels, 150g cheese crackers and 150g roasted peanuts. Spread on a tray and bake at 150C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool completely, then mix through 100g chocolate buttons.
the two cops who take McLovin along for the ride
Cake doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes, dipped in a glaze of icing sugar, milk and vanilla, half of them dusted in cinnamon sugar instead.
M: Jules's party pepperoni hot honey pizza
a slice standing up at Jules's party

Thin crisp base with garlicky crushed tomato, mozzarella and cupped pepperoni, baked very hot and finished with chilli honey and fresh basil. Heat the oven to its highest setting with a tray or steel inside for 30 minutes. Mix 400g crushed tomatoes with a crushed garlic clove, oregano and salt. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases, spread with sauce and top with 250g mozzarella and 120g pepperoni. Bake each for 7 minutes. Warm 3 tbsp honey with half a tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over with torn basil.
Officers Slater and Michaels taking McLovin for a ride
Big tortillas filled with scrambled egg, crisp bacon, potato and cheddar, rolled and toasted in the pan.
W: the end of school, the last night together
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar until glossy, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy.
K: the most famous fake ID going

Cold cola poured over vanilla ice cream and homemade cherry syrup until it foams over, finished with a maraschino cherry and a straw. Simmer 200g frozen pitted cherries with 80g sugar and 60ml water for 8 minutes, mash and strain. Put 2 tbsp cherry syrup and a scoop of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Slowly pour 250ml cold cola down the side so it foams up. Top with a maraschino cherry and serve with a spoon and straw.
T: McLovin is buying. Everyone is eating.
D: Two high school best friends spend one long night trying to get supplies for a party.
P: Serve the mains when they finally make it to Jules's party.

title: 21 Jump Street
S: back in a high school cafeteria at 25
Pizza dough pressed into an oiled tray, crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni right to the edges, baked at 240C for 15 minutes, cut into school-lunch squares.
Schmidt lands the lead in the school play

Crisp folded tortillas filled with melted cheddar, spring onion and jalapeño, cut into wedges with salsa. Lay 4 large tortillas flat and cover half of each with 200g grated cheddar, sliced spring onion and a few pickled jalapeños. Fold over and cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.
Jenko's surprise talent in chemistry, alcohol-free

Three layers of raspberry, lime and orange juice jelly set in little cups like a test tube rack, topped with whipped cream. Soften 3 tsp gelatine powder in 3 tbsp cold water for each layer. Warm 200ml raspberry juice with 1 tbsp sugar, stir in one lot of gelatine and pour into 12 small cups. Chill 1 hour. Repeat with 200ml lime cordial mixed with water, then with 200ml orange juice, chilling 1 hour between. Top with a dot of whipped cream.
M: the party at Schmidt's parents' place

Smashed beef sliders with melted cheddar, slow-cooked butter onions, pickles and a mustard mayo on soft slider buns. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp American mustard. Smash the balls thin on a smoking griddle, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and top with cheddar. Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patties, onions, pickles and mustard mayo.
the prom with a stretch limo
Chicken breasts pan-roasted with butter and thyme, a creamy mushroom sauce, potato gratin and green beans, like a fancy prom dinner.
W: Chocolate cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with vanilla buttercream, topped with a little mortarboard of a chocolate square and a lolly button.
K: Jenko finds his people in chemistry class

Cold milk blended thick with chocolate ice cream, malt powder and a drizzle of melted dark chocolate, topped with whipped cream and malt balls. Melt 60g dark chocolate and drizzle it inside four tall glasses, then chill. Blend 800ml cold milk, 8 scoops chocolate ice cream and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a few crushed malt balls.
T: Back to high school. Back to the cafeteria.
D: Two bumbling young cops go undercover as high school students.
P: Serve the mains when Schmidt throws the house party.

title: Night at the Museum
S: Roman legion warm olives and focaccia
Octavius and his tiny Roman army

Mixed olives warmed in olive oil with lemon peel, garlic, oregano and chilli, with torn rosemary focaccia for dipping in the oil and balsamic. Warm 300g mixed olives in a small pan with 80ml olive oil, 3 strips lemon peel, 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of chilli flakes over low heat for 8 minutes. Warm a 400g rosemary focaccia at 180C for 6 minutes and tear into pieces. Serve the olives in their oil, with a small dish of balsamic for dipping.
the T. rex who plays fetch with a bone
Pizza dough rolled into ropes, knotted at both ends into bone shapes, brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Marinara dip.
Gum gum watermelon, feta and mint skewers
the Easter Island head who wants gum gum

Icy watermelon cubes skewered with salty feta and mint, finished with lime juice, a drizzle of honey and a pinch of flaky salt and chilli. Cut a quarter of a watermelon and 200g feta into 2cm cubes. Thread onto short skewers with a mint leaf between each. Lay on a platter and chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, squeeze over the juice of a lime, drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and add a pinch of flaky salt and chilli flakes.
M: the street cart outside the museum
Franks simmered in water with onions, in steamed buns with spicy brown mustard, sauerkraut and onions in a tomato sauce.
Jedediah, the tiny cowboy in the diorama

Mini beef patties glazed with smoky barbecue sauce, melted cheddar, pickles and crispy fried onions on soft slider buns, with a crunchy apple slaw. Shape 700g beef mince into 12 small patties and season. Grill on a hot plate 2 minutes a side, brushing with 80ml barbecue sauce, and top with cheddar to melt. Toss half a shredded cabbage and a julienned green apple with 3 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patties, pickles and a handful of fried shallots. Serve the slaw alongside.
W: the monkey who keeps stealing Larry's keys
Ripe bananas mashed with melted butter, brown sugar and eggs, flour and bicarb folded in, baked at 170C for an hour, sliced and toasted with butter.
K: Rich hot chocolate made with melted dark chocolate, cocoa and a little cinnamon, poured into a thermos and topped with marshmallows at the cup. Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth. Pour into a warmed thermos to keep hot through the movie. Serve in mugs topped with marshmallows.
T: Everything comes to life after dark. Including dinner.
D: A new night guard at a natural history museum finds the exhibits come alive after closing.
P: Serve the mains when the T. rex skeleton wants to play fetch.

title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
S: Detention sweet and salty snack mix
the four kids stuck in detention clearing out the basement

Ridged chips, pretzels and chocolate-coated peanuts tossed with honey-roasted popcorn, with a bowl of sour lollies like a stash smuggled into detention. Pop 80g popping corn in 1 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Warm 2 tbsp honey with 20g butter and a pinch of salt, toss through the popcorn and bake at 160C for 8 minutes, then cool. Toss with a 170g bag of ridged potato chips, 150g pretzels and 150g chocolate-coated peanuts in a big bowl. Put 200g sour lollies in a small bowl alongside.

Chicken thigh marinated in yoghurt, garlic, paprika and lemon, grilled on skewers until charred, with garlic yoghurt dip and warm flatbread. Cut 800g chicken thighs into chunks and marinate for 2 hours in 150g Greek yoghurt, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, lemon juice and salt. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill on high for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a grated garlic clove, lemon and mint. Warm 4 flatbreads on the grill.
Dr Smolder Bravestone in the jungle

Sweet ripe mango, red onion, chilli and coriander sharpened with lime, scooped up with salted corn chips. Dice 2 mangoes and mix with half a diced red onion, 1 chopped chilli, a handful of coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Season with salt and rest 10 minutes so the juices come out. Serve with 230g corn chips.
M: Rump marinated in garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over high heat and sliced, with a sharp parsley chimichurri and buttered charred corn. Marinate 1kg rump steak in 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the juice of a lime and 2 tbsp oil for 1 hour. Chop a bunch of parsley with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, chilli flakes, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Grill the steak 4 minutes a side and rest 8 minutes. Grill 4 corn cobs until charred and roll in butter. Slice the steak and spoon over chimichurri.
a dinner in the jungle level
Red curry paste fried in thick coconut cream until fragrant, chicken thighs, coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar, simmered 20 minutes. Jasmine rice.
W: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered and covered in glossy ganache. Eat with care.
K: Pineapple juice, mango nectar and fresh passionfruit pulp with a squeeze of lime, topped with soda water over crushed ice.
T: Choose your character. Choose your snack.
D: Four teens in detention get sucked into a video game and become its avatars.
P: Serve dessert, carefully, when Mouse Finch learns his weakness is cake.

title: Jumanji
S: the monkeys tearing through the kitchen
Ripe bananas in thick slices dipped in a batter of flour, sparkling water and a pinch of sugar, fried at 180C until puffed and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar.
everything comes charging through the house

Corn chips piled with cumin refried beans and melted cheese, baked bubbling, then loaded with tomato salsa, sour cream and pickled jalapenos. Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, spoon over 400g refried beans warmed with 1 tsp cumin and cover with 200g grated cheese. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes and top with 200g salsa, 150g sour cream and jalapenos. Serve straight from the tray while the cheese is still stretchy.
Giant pod pork and chive dumplings
the plants that take over the house

Pork and garlic chive dumplings steamed in a bamboo basket lined with cabbage leaves, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dipping sauce. Mix 400g pork mince with a bunch of finely chopped garlic chives, grated ginger, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil and white pepper. Fill 30 round dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Line a bamboo steamer with cabbage leaves and steam the dumplings over simmering water for 8 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar and 1 tsp chilli oil for dipping.
M: Parrish house New England pot roast
the old Parrish house in a small New England town

Beef chuck seared and braised slowly with onion, carrot, celery, garlic and thyme in a rich tomato beef gravy, with potatoes cooked in the pot. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and sear all over in a heavy pot. Remove, then soften an onion, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 4 garlic cloves. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 1 tbsp Worcestershire, add 750ml beef stock and thyme and return the beef. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Slice and spoon over the gravy.
Van Pelt's juniper venison and redcurrant
the hunter who comes out of the game

Venison backstrap crusted with juniper, pepper and thyme, seared rare and sliced, with a glossy redcurrant and stock sauce and buttery parsnip mash. Crush 1 tsp juniper berries with 1 tsp pepper and thyme and rub over 800g venison backstrap. Sear in a hot pan 3 minutes a side for rare and rest 8 minutes. Add 250ml beef stock and 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly to the pan and reduce until glossy, then whisk in 20g butter. Boil 600g parsnips and 400g potatoes until soft and mash with 60g butter.
W: Brantford, New Hampshire in the fall

Soft, creamy fudge boiled from real maple syrup, brown sugar and cream, beaten until thick with toasted walnuts and cut into little squares. Boil 250ml maple syrup, 200g brown sugar, 150ml cream and 40g butter to 115C, stirring gently. Cool 10 minutes, then beat until thick and losing its gloss and stir in 60g toasted chopped walnuts. Spread in a lined 15cm tin, cool and cut into squares.
K: Brantford mulled apple and maple punch
a New Hampshire autumn in Brantford

Cloudy apple juice mulled with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and a little maple syrup, served warm in mugs with a cinnamon stick. Alcohol-free. Warm 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 strips orange peel and 2 tbsp maple syrup over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into four mugs and add a fresh cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.
T: Roll the dice. Bring snacks.
D: Two kids find a board game that unleashes the jungle on their town, and the man trapped inside it for decades.
P: Serve the snacks when the monkeys wreck the kitchen.

title: Paddington
S: the one he keeps under his hat
Thick white bread buttered right to the edges, spread with a coarse-cut orange marmalade, crusts left on, cut into squares and wrapped in baking paper.
cake and cocoa at the antique shop

Small slices of rich Dundee fruit cake with currants, sultanas and orange zest, topped with whole almonds in circles and baked slowly until golden. Beat 150g butter and 150g brown sugar until light, add 3 eggs one at a time, then fold in 200g plain flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and the zest of an orange. Spread in a lined 20cm round tin, arrange 50g whole almonds in circles on top and bake at 150C for 2 hours until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin and cut into small slices.

Golden baked pastries filled with beef mince, onion, cumin, paprika, raisins and green olives, with a zingy coriander and lime dipping sauce. Fry 400g beef mince with a diced onion until browned. Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 40g raisins and 50g chopped green olives and cook 5 minutes, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 3 sheets shortcrust, fill, fold and crimp with a fork. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Blitz a bunch of coriander with 3 tbsp mayo, lime juice and a little jalapeno for dipping.
M: Lamb mince simmered with onion, carrot, tomato and Worcestershire under a golden crust of buttery mash, served with buttered peas. Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 diced carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes until thick. Tip into a baking dish. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and a splash of milk and spread over, roughing up the top with a fork. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 300g peas tossed in 20g butter.
Darkest Peru roast chicken and green sauce
the jungle in Peru where he grew up

Chicken marinated in garlic, cumin, paprika, lime and soy, roasted until the skin crackles, with a creamy coriander and jalapeno sauce and crispy potatoes. Blitz 4 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp oil. Rub over 1.5kg chicken pieces and marinate overnight. Roast at 200C for 45 minutes. Toss 1kg chunked potatoes in oil and salt and roast alongside for 45 minutes. Blitz a bunch of coriander, a jalapeno, 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp grated parmesan and lime juice for the green sauce.
W: Buttered bread spread with marmalade, layered in a dish, covered in a custard of eggs, milk and cream, rested 20 minutes, baked at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: Mr Gruber's orange cocoa with cream

Rich cocoa whisked into hot milk with orange zest and a pinch of salt, poured into china cups and topped with softly whipped cream. Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp sugar with a splash of milk into a smooth paste. Add 1L milk, the zest of an orange and a pinch of salt and heat, whisking, until steaming but not boiling. Strain into four china cups. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks and spoon a little on each with a sprinkle of extra zest.
T: Please look after this bear. And feed him marmalade.
D: A polite young bear from Darkest Peru arrives in London looking for a home.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Paddington takes one out from under his hat.

title: Paddington 2
S: Bread buttered thick, spread with homemade marmalade (Seville oranges simmered whole an hour, shredded, boiled with sugar to 105C), cut into triangles.
the pop-up book of London he wants for Aunt Lucy

Vanilla butter biscuits cut into Big Ben, buses and Tower Bridge shapes, baked golden and piped with red, white and blue royal icing. Beat 125g soft butter with 100g caster sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g plain flour and 1 tsp vanilla. Chill 30 minutes, roll to 4mm and cut into London landmark shapes. Bake at 170C for 10 minutes and cool. Beat 1 egg white with 250g icing sugar and a squeeze of lemon until stiff, divide and colour red and blue, and pipe details.
Paddington's disastrous day at the barber shop
Self-raising flour with cold butter rubbed in, milk mixed in lightly, patted out, cut into fingers, glazed with milk, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Jam and clotted cream.
M: Prison canteen chicken and leek pie
the grim canteen he turns into something lovely

Chicken thigh, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme and mustard sauce under a flaky puff pastry lid, baked golden, with buttered peas. Cook 800g diced chicken thighs in 40g butter until browned, then add 2 sliced leeks and 250g sliced mushrooms and soften. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 250ml chicken stock, 200ml cream, 1 tsp Dijon and thyme and simmer until thick. Cool, tip into a pie dish, top with puff pastry and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with 300g buttered peas.

Thick pork sausages grilled slowly until sticky and browned, piled into soft white rolls with sweet buttery onions and English mustard or tomato sauce. Cook 3 sliced onions in 40g butter with a pinch of brown sugar over low heat for 25 minutes until soft and golden. Grill 8 thick pork sausages over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often, until browned all over. Split 8 soft white rolls, add a sausage and a heap of onions, and serve with English mustard and tomato sauce.
W: the prison uniforms that come out of the wash pink
Butter, sugar, eggs and flour weighed equal, beaten light, baked in two tins at 180C for 22 minutes, filled with raspberry jam and whipped cream, topped with pale pink icing.
K: tea for the whole cell block

Strong English breakfast tea stirred with orange marmalade and lemon while hot, chilled, then poured over ice with orange slices and a splash of soda. Brew 5 tea bags in 1.2L boiling water for 4 minutes and remove. Stir in 4 tbsp orange marmalade and the juice of a lemon until dissolved, then chill. Fill four tall glasses with ice and orange slices, pour in the tea and top each with a splash of soda water.
T: If we're kind and polite, the world will be right. And there will be sandwiches.
D: Paddington is wrongly sent to prison and wins over the inmates with his marmalade.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Paddington teaches Knuckles to make marmalade.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
S: Bucket family cabbage and bacon soup
the thin soup the Buckets eat every night

A proper version: savoy cabbage, onion, carrot and potato simmered in chicken stock with smoky bacon and thyme, finished with butter, pepper and crusty bread. Fry 150g diced bacon in a large pot until golden. Add a diced onion and 2 diced carrots and soften 5 minutes. Add 2 diced potatoes, 1.5L chicken stock and thyme and simmer 15 minutes. Add half a savoy cabbage, shredded, and simmer 10 minutes more. Stir in 30g butter, season with plenty of pepper and serve with crusty bread.
the bar with the golden ticket inside
Dark chocolate tempered and poured into bar moulds, one bar in the batch with a gold foil ticket hidden under the wrapper.
the squirrels sorting nuts for Veruca's tantrum
Walnuts, pecans and almonds tossed in egg white, brown sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, roasted at 160C for 20 minutes, stirred twice.
M: the gum that tastes of tomato soup and roast beef

Little cups of roast tomato and basil soup to start, then sirloin roasted pink and sliced, with baked potatoes loaded with butter and sour cream. Roast 1kg halved tomatoes, an onion and 3 garlic cloves at 200C for 35 minutes, then blitz with 300ml stock and basil for soup. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Season a 1.2kg sirloin, sear all over and roast at 200C to 52C inside, about 30 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and slice. Split the potatoes and load with butter, sour cream and chives.
the German boy who falls in the chocolate river

Bratwurst grilled slowly until browned and juicy, with warm apple and caraway sauerkraut, soft pretzels and plenty of wholegrain mustard. Simmer a 500g jar of sauerkraut with a grated apple, 125ml apple juice and 1 tsp caraway seeds for 20 minutes. Grill 8 bratwurst over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning, until browned all over. Warm 4 soft pretzels at 180C for 5 minutes. Serve together with plenty of wholegrain mustard.
W: the third course of the gum, the one that turns Violet blue
Blueberries tossed with sugar, lemon and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled 3 hours, with vanilla ice cream.
K: the chocolate river, mixed by waterfall
Dark and milk chocolate melted into hot milk and cream, whisked hard until frothy, the way the waterfall churns it.
T: Five golden tickets. One very sweet tour.
D: A poor boy wins a tour of a reclusive chocolatier's factory along with four very badly behaved children.
P: Serve the three-course dinner when Violet grabs the experimental gum.

title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
S: the candy cup Wonka bites into
White chocolate set inside small paper cups, peeled, filled with a vanilla mousse, a chocolate handle stuck on the side. Eat the whole thing.
Veruca wants a goose that lays golden eggs, now

Dark chocolate egg shells filled with salted caramel ganache, joined and brushed with edible gold lustre until they shine like golden eggs. Melt 300g dark chocolate gently and brush into 16 half-egg moulds in two coats, chilling between, then set. Heat 80ml cream and pour over 100g chopped milk chocolate, then stir in 3 tbsp thick caramel and a pinch of sea salt and cool until thick. Fill the shells, warm the rims on a hot tray and press halves together. Chill, unmould and brush with edible gold lustre.
Seeded crackers spread with whipped ricotta and topped with a mix of raspberries, blackberries and blueberries crushed with a little sugar.
M: the little house with four grandparents in one bed
Beef shin browned, onion, carrot and potato softened, pearl barley and stock added, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Bread to stretch it further.
the room where everything, even the grass, is edible

A big board planted like a garden: toasted marshmallow mushrooms on pretzel stalks, chocolate strawberries, toffee apple wedges, honeycomb rocks and a fairy floss cloud. Melt 200g dark chocolate. Dip 250g strawberries halfway and set on baking paper. Push pretzel sticks into 12 large marshmallows, toast the tops with a blowtorch or under the grill and dip the bases in chocolate. Cut 2 apples into wedges, toss in lemon juice and drizzle with 3 tbsp warm caramel. Break 150g honeycomb into rocks. Arrange on a board with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and fairy floss in the middle.
W: the sweet that never gets smaller
Layered truffles: a cherry centre wrapped in white chocolate ganache, chilled, then dark ganache, chilled, then rolled in cocoa and coloured sugar so every bite shows a new layer.
K: the drink that floats Charlie up to the fan
Raspberry purée and lemon syrup in a tall glass, topped with very cold soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up to the rim.
T: Pure imagination. Pure sugar.
D: A poor boy finds a golden ticket and tours a mysterious chocolate factory.
P: Serve the drinks when Charlie and Grandpa Joe sneak a taste of the fizzy lifting drinks.

title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
S: the island town that ran on sardines

Tinned sardines mashed with butter, lemon and parsley, spread on sourdough toast, finished with sliced radish and black pepper. Mash 2 drained tins of sardines with 30g soft butter, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Spread on 8 slices toasted sourdough and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.
Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, stacked high on a platter.

Wobbly cubes of orange, raspberry and lime jelly made with real juice, stacked into a castle on a platter with whipped cream turrets. For each colour, soften 4 tsp gelatine in 3 tbsp cold water, then dissolve in 300ml warm juice with 2 tbsp sugar: orange juice, raspberry juice and lime cordial diluted with water. Pour each into its own lined loaf tin and chill 4 hours until firm. Cut into 3cm cubes and stack into a castle on a platter. Pipe whipped cream from 200ml cream on top.
M: the spaghetti tornado and the giant meatballs
Big beef and pork meatballs with soaked bread, parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered 45 minutes in tomato sauce with basil, over a twisting pile of spaghetti.
Steak storm garlic butter rump and fries

Rump steaks seared in a smoking pan, rested and sliced, topped with melting garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries salted straight from the oven. Mash 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt, roll into a log and chill. Bake 800g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Season 4 rump steaks of 200g and sear in a smoking pan, flipping every minute, for 6 to 8 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, slice and top with discs of garlic butter. Salt the fries and serve.
W: the snow day made of ice cream
Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream scooped into a big snowy mountain, with sprinkles, wafer biscuits and hot fudge.
K: Layers of raspberry, orange and lime syrups in a glass, topped with lemonade so the colours run together.
T: Today's forecast: cheeseburgers.
D: A young inventor's machine makes food rain from the sky over his small island town.
P: Serve the mains when the first cheeseburgers start falling.

title: Chef
S: the scene where Carl makes his son a toastie
Thick white bread buttered on the outside, filled with sharp cheddar, gruyère and a little parmesan, cooked slowly in a pan over low heat, lid on, until the cheese pours, cut on the diagonal.
Yuca peeled, boiled 20 minutes until tender, cut into batons, fried at 185C until crisp, salted, with a garlic and lime mojo.
New Orleans beignets with chicory café
the road trip stop in New Orleans

Pillowy yeasted squares fried until puffed and golden, buried under icing sugar, with a jug of hot café au lait for dunking. Mix 7g yeast, 50g sugar and 180ml warm water, then add 80ml evaporated milk, 1 egg, 30g melted butter and 400g plain flour. Knead briefly, cover and chill overnight. Roll to 5mm, cut into 6cm squares and rest 20 minutes. Fry at 180C for 1 minute a side until puffed. Bury in 100g icing sugar. Serve with 500ml strong coffee mixed with 500ml hot milk.
M: Pork shoulder marinated in mojo of orange, lime, garlic and oregano, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, sliced, layered in a soft roll with ham, Swiss, pickles and mustard, pressed and griddled in butter.
the late-night pasta Carl cooks for Molly

Spaghetti tossed with golden sliced garlic, chilli flakes, parsley, lemon and good olive oil, emulsified with starchy pasta water until glossy. Boil 500g spaghetti in well salted water until just al dente, keeping a cup of pasta water. Meanwhile, warm 125ml olive oil with 8 thinly sliced garlic cloves over low heat for 5 minutes until just golden, then add 1 tsp chilli flakes. Toss the spaghetti in the pan with 125ml pasta water until glossy. Finish with a big handful of chopped parsley, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon.
W: the dessert the critic tears apart, done right
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked into eggs and sugar, a little flour folded in, baked in buttered ramekins at 220C for 9 minutes so the centre runs.
K: a Miami summer on the truck
Mint and lime muddled with sugar, 45ml white rum, crushed ice, topped with soda.
T: Cook what you love. Load up the truck.
D: A top chef quits his restaurant after a viral meltdown and starts again with a food truck.
P: Serve the toasties when Carl makes his son a grilled cheese.

title: Julie & Julia
S: the bruschetta Julie makes to unwind
Ciabatta toasted, rubbed with garlic, topped with ripe tomatoes diced and salted, basil and olive oil.
the first meal in France that changes everything

Sole fillets dusted in flour and cooked in foaming butter until golden, finished with nutty brown butter, lemon and parsley, with crusty bread. Season 600g sole fillets and dust in flour, shaking off the excess. Heat 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil in a large pan until foaming and cook the fillets 2 minutes a side until golden, then plate. Wipe the pan, add 80g butter and cook until nut brown, then add the juice of a lemon and chopped parsley. Spoon over the fish and serve with crusty bread.
a French classic to warm up the kitchen
Choux pastry of water, butter and flour beaten with eggs one at a time, grated gruyère and a pinch of nutmeg folded in, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.
M: 524 recipes, one blog, one tiny Queens kitchen

Beef chuck browned in batches, bacon lardons, onion, carrot, garlic, red Burgundy and stock, bouquet garni, braised at 160C for 3 hours, finished with butter-glazed pearl onions and mushrooms. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck and 150g bacon lardons. Add 2 carrots, an onion and garlic, then 750ml red wine, 250ml stock and herbs. Braise at 160C for 3 hours. Glaze 12 pearl onions and 250g mushrooms in butter and stir through.
the live lobsters in Julie's kitchen

Lobster tails poached and chopped into a sauce of shallot, white wine, Dijon, cream and gruyère, piled back in the shells and grilled golden. Green salad. Poach 4 lobster tails in boiling salted water for 4 minutes, cool, split and remove the meat, keeping the shells. Soften a chopped shallot in 30g butter, add 125ml white wine and reduce by half, then 200ml cream and 1 tsp Dijon and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in 60g gruyère and the chopped lobster. Spoon into the shells, top with 40g more gruyère and grill 3 minutes until golden. Serve with dressed leaves.
W: a classic French chocolate almond cake from the book

Dark chocolate melted with butter, yolks and sugar beaten in, almond meal and a little flour folded through, whites whipped and folded in, baked at 180C for 25 minutes so the middle stays soft, glazed with chocolate.
K: Burgundy kir with crème de cassis

Chilled dry white Burgundy poured over blackcurrant liqueur in a wine glass, the classic aperitif from the region, with a fresh blackberry. Chill a 750ml bottle of dry white Burgundy or chardonnay for 2 hours. Pour 15ml crème de cassis into each of four wine glasses. Top slowly with 120ml cold wine so it blends from the bottom. Drop a blackberry into each glass and serve before the bourguignon. Pour red with the main.
T: 524 recipes. 365 days. One very good stew.
D: A frustrated writer cooks her way through a classic French cookbook, interwoven with the story of the cook who wrote it.
P: Serve the mains when Julie finally nails the boeuf bourguignon.

title: The Menu
S: the bread course with no bread
A bowl of cultured butter, olive oil, whipped ricotta and a few flakes of salt. Then, because you're not on that island, a warm sourdough loaf to go with them.
the first course, served on a rock
Scallops sliced thin and dressed with lime, finger lime, a few drops of good olive oil and sea salt, set on a cold stone or a chilled plate.
the tortillas with the guests' secrets printed on them

Warm corn tortillas charred on a dry pan, with a smoky charred tomato and chipotle salsa, smashed avocado with lime and crumbled feta. Char 4 tomatoes, half a white onion and 2 garlic cloves in a dry pan until blackened in spots. Blitz with 1 chipotle in adobo, a handful of coriander, lime juice and salt. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Warm 16 small corn tortillas in a hot dry pan for 30 seconds a side until lightly charred and keep wrapped in a tea towel. Serve with the salsa, avocado and 80g crumbled feta.
M: the one thing on the menu worth eating
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, two patties, American cheese, white onion and pickles on a soft toasted bun, crinkle-cut fries. Pack one to go.
Hawthorn lamb rack with celeriac purée
a tasting menu main, without the theatre

Lamb rack roasted pink and carved into cutlets, on silky celeriac purée with charred baby leeks and a glossy red wine jus. Simmer a peeled, diced celeriac in 400ml milk for 20 minutes, then blitz with 40g butter until silky.
