Season 2 lamb racks, sear fat side down, then roast at 200C to 56C inside, about 15 minutes, and rest 10 minutes. Blanch 8 baby leeks for 2 minutes and char in a hot pan. Reduce 200ml red wine with a shallot by half, add 300ml beef stock and reduce until glossy, then whisk in 20g butter.
W: the final course, with a bonfire
Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache set inside, topped with a toasted marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.
K: the sommelier who pairs every course

Gin, bitter red aperitivo and sweet vermouth stirred over ice, poured over a big cube and finished with a smouldering rosemary sprig and orange. For each drink, stir 30ml gin, 30ml bitter red aperitivo and 30ml sweet vermouth with ice for 20 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler. Light the tip of a rosemary sprig until it smokes, blow it out and lay it across the glass with a twist of orange peel.
T: Taste. Don't eat. Then order the cheeseburger.
D: A couple join a handful of rich guests at an exclusive island restaurant where the tasting menu turns sinister.
P: Serve the cheeseburgers when Margot asks the chef for one.

title: Mystic Pizza
S: Caldo verde: potato and onion simmered in stock until soft, mashed smooth, finely shredded kale and slices of smoked sausage added for 5 minutes, olive oil on top.
the lobster boats in the harbour

Prawns sizzled in butter, garlic and chilli, splashed with white wine and lemon, finished with parsley and served with crusty bread to mop up. Heat 60g butter and 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pan. Add 5 sliced garlic cloves and a chopped red chilli and cook 1 minute. Add 600g peeled green prawns and cook 2 minutes, turning. Pour in 80ml white wine and the juice of a lemon and bubble 1 minute. Toss with chopped parsley and serve in the pan with a sliced baguette.
the dough nobody can leave alone
Pizza dough rolled into ropes and tied in knots, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, tossed in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.
M: the TV food critic finally calls it superb

Pizza dough stretched thin, a sauce of crushed tomatoes simmered with garlic, oregano, a little honey and a pinch of chilli, mozzarella, linguiça and peppers, baked on a hot steel. Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes with 2 garlic cloves, oregano, 1 tsp honey and a pinch of chilli for 20 minutes. Stretch 500g dough thin, spread with sauce, top with 250g mozzarella, 150g sliced linguiça and capsicum. Bake on a hot steel.
Jojo's wedding clam and chorizo bake

Clams, prawns, new potatoes and corn steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic, butter and chorizo, tipped onto the table with lemon and bread. Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot and drain. Fry 200g sliced chorizo in the pot, add 4 sliced garlic cloves, then 250ml white wine and 60g butter. Add the potatoes, 4 halved corn cobs, 1kg clams and 500g green prawns in the shell. Cover and steam 6 minutes until the clams open. Tip onto a table lined with paper and serve with lemon wedges and bread.
W: Puff pastry rolled into a log, sliced, pressed into a muffin tin, filled with a custard of yolks, cream, sugar and lemon, baked at 250C until blistered.
K: the bride who faints at the altar

Portuguese red wine stirred with orange, lemon, apple, cinnamon and a little brandy, chilled for an hour and topped with lemonade over ice. Slice an orange, a lemon and an apple into a big jug. Add 750ml Portuguese red wine, 60ml brandy, 2 tbsp caster sugar and a cinnamon stick and stir until the sugar dissolves. Chill for 1 hour. Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the sangria with some fruit and top each with a splash of lemonade.
T: A slice of heaven.
D: Three young waitresses at a pizza parlour in a Connecticut fishing town fall in and out of love one summer.
P: Serve the pizza when the food critic takes his first bite.

title: Waitress
S: Jenna's pie for the morning she finds out

Shortcrust blind baked in a mini muffin tin, filled with brie, smoked ham and a custard of eggs and cream, baked at 170C for 15 minutes until just set. Line a 24-hole mini muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and blind-bake. Fill with 100g diced brie and 80g chopped ham. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream and chives, pour in and bake at 170C for 15 minutes.
the early shift at the pie diner
Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and covered in a peppery sausage gravy of browned sausage mince, flour and milk.
Old Joe's cinnamon pie crust twists
the cranky old owner who loves her pies

Buttery shortcrust brushed with melted butter, showered in cinnamon sugar, cut into strips and twisted, baked crisp and caramelised, with warm caramel for dipping. Brush 2 sheets shortcrust pastry with 40g melted butter. Mix 60g sugar with 2 tsp cinnamon and sprinkle over both. Cut into 2cm strips, twist each a few times and lay on lined trays. Bake at 190C for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp and caramelised. Warm 4 tbsp thick caramel with 1 tbsp cream for dipping.
M: a pie for dinner, not just dessert
Chicken thighs, carrot, celery, onion and peas in a thick creamy sauce with thyme, under a puff pastry lid, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.
Pie diner meatloaf with brown gravy
the lunch rush at the diner

Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, sliced thick over buttery mash with onion brown gravy and green beans. Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk and mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, 1 egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin, spread with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter. Soften a sliced onion, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 400ml beef stock and simmer for gravy. Steam 300g green beans.
W: Biscuit crust, a layer of salted caramel, then a bittersweet chocolate ganache set over it, drowned in more caramel and a little flaky salt. Press 200g crushed biscuits with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Melt 250g caramels with 3 tbsp cream and pour in. Pour over 200g dark chocolate melted with 150ml cream and set. Drizzle more caramel and flaky salt on top.
K: the coffee at the pie diner counter

Cold brewed coffee blended thick with vanilla ice cream and salted caramel, poured into tall glasses with whipped cream and a crumble of pie crust. Brew 400ml strong coffee and chill. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 200ml cold milk and 4 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of salt until smooth. Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream, a drizzle of caramel and a few crumbled shortbread biscuits.
T: Every pie has a feeling.
D: A diner waitress stuck in a bad marriage pours everything into the pies she invents.
P: Serve the pies when Jenna starts dreaming up a new one.

title: Fried Green Tomatoes
S: Green tomatoes sliced thick, salted 10 minutes, dipped in buttermilk and seasoned cornmeal, fried in bacon fat until golden, with a remoulade.
Idgie takes honey straight from the bee tree for Ruth
Buttermilk biscuits: flour and cold butter cut together, buttermilk folded in, patted, folded three times, cut and baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Warm, with butter and a chunk of honeycomb.

Sharp cheddar mixed with mayo, cream cheese, roasted red capsicum and hot sauce, spread thick on crackers and topped with pickled jalapeno. Grate 250g sharp cheddar. Beat 100g cream cheese with 80g mayo until smooth, then fold in the cheddar, 100g finely chopped roasted red capsicum, a dash of hot sauce, half a tsp smoked paprika and pepper. Chill 30 minutes. Spread thickly on 24 crackers and top each with a slice of pickled jalapeno.
M: the café's barbecue and its famous sauce
Pork shoulder rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, roasted at 150C for 5 hours, pulled, dressed in a tomato and vinegar sauce. Coleslaw and white bread.

Chicken brined overnight in buttermilk, dredged in peppery seasoned flour and fried crunchy, with garlicky braised greens and warm cornbread. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt. Mix 300g flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp pepper. Dredge and fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74C inside. Wilt 2 bunches kale with garlic and a splash of cider vinegar. Bake cornbread from 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g butter at 220C for 20 minutes.
W: Toasted pecans, brown sugar, golden syrup, butter and eggs in a blind-baked case, baked at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: Black tea brewed strong with ripe peaches and sugar, chilled and poured over ice with lemon, mint and fresh peach slices. Brew 6 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water with 2 sliced peaches for 5 minutes. Remove the bags and stir in 100g sugar while hot. Cool completely with the peaches in, then strain. Pour over ice in four tall glasses with lemon slices, fresh peach slices and mint.
T: The secret's in the sauce.
D: An unhappy housewife befriends an elderly woman who tells her the story of two friends who ran a café in 1930s Alabama.
P: Serve the tomatoes when the story arrives at the Whistle Stop Café.

title: Soul Food
S: Ahmad's plan to get everyone back for Sunday

Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard, a spoon of sweet pickle relish and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, paprika on top. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp sweet relish and a dash of hot sauce. Pipe back and dust with paprika.
Big Mama's skillet cornbread, honey butter
the cornbread in the cast iron pan

Golden buttermilk cornbread baked in a smoking hot cast iron pan so the edges crisp, cut in wedges with whipped honey butter. Put 20g butter in a 25cm cast iron pan and heat in a 220C oven for 10 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar and half a tsp salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter until just combined. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt.
Big Mama's ham hock braised greens

Kale braised slowly with smoked ham hock, onion, garlic and chilli until silky, the meat picked back in, sharpened with cider vinegar and served with the pot liquor. Simmer a smoked ham hock in 1.5L water with a sliced onion, 3 garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes for 1 hour. Add 2 bunches kale or collards, stems removed and chopped, and braise gently for 90 minutes. Pick the meat off the hock and stir it back in. Finish with 2 tbsp cider vinegar and serve in bowls with plenty of the pot liquor.
M: the heart of every Sunday dinner
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged twice in seasoned flour, fried in a cast iron pan at 165C until 74C at the bone.
Big Mama's baked mac and cheese

Macaroni baked in a custard of eggs, evaporated milk and three cheeses until set, with a golden crust of sharp cheddar on top. Boil 500g macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain. Whisk 2 eggs with a 375ml tin of evaporated milk, 250ml milk, 60g melted butter, 1 tsp mustard powder, salt and pepper. Toss the pasta with 300g grated sharp cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella, then the custard. Tip into a buttered dish, top with 100g more cheddar and bake at 180C for 40 minutes until set and golden.
W: the dessert at the end of every Sunday
Peaches sliced and cooked with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg, a buttery biscuit topping sprinkled with sugar, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the big jug on the table

Strong black tea sweetened while hot and mixed half and half with fresh lemonade, poured over ice with lemon wheels and mint. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with a pinch of bicarb for 5 minutes. Stir in 80g sugar while hot and cool. Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80g sugar and 500ml cold water. Mix the tea and lemonade in a big jug with ice, lemon wheels and mint, and pour.
T: Sunday dinner. Every Sunday. No excuses.
D: A Chicago family is held together by their grandmother's weekly Sunday dinners.
P: Serve the mains when the whole family sits down for Sunday dinner at Big Mama's.

title: Chocolat
S: Vianne's spiced hot chocolate, the old South American way
Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with a split chilli, cinnamon stick and a pinch of salt, steeped 5 minutes, strained, served in tiny cups.
the window of the chocolate shop
Dark chocolate ganache with cream and a little butter, chilled, scooped and rolled, coated in cocoa, chopped hazelnuts or chilli sugar.
the French village square on market day

Sliced saucisson, a wedge of comté, soft goat's cheese, cornichons, fig jam and walnuts on a wooden board with warm crusty baguette. Take 200g comté and 150g soft goat's cheese out of the fridge an hour ahead. Slice a 200g saucisson thinly on an angle. Warm a baguette at 180C for 5 minutes and slice. Arrange the cheeses, saucisson, a small bowl of cornichons, 3 tbsp fig jam and a handful of walnuts on a wooden board with the bread.
M: the birthday party Vianne cooks for Armande
Duck legs salted overnight, cooked slowly in their fat at 140C for 2.5 hours, crisped skin side down, with potatoes roasted in duck fat and a green salad.
River party trout with almond brown butter
the river people's party on the boats

Whole trout grilled with lemon, thyme and garlic, finished with nutty brown butter and toasted flaked almonds, with buttery new potatoes. Boil 800g new potatoes for 15 minutes and toss with butter and parsley. Stuff 4 cleaned whole trout with lemon slices, thyme and sliced garlic, brush with oil and season. Grill or barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side until the flesh flakes. Melt 80g butter until foaming and nut brown, add 50g flaked almonds and toast 1 minute, then add lemon juice. Spoon over the fish.
W: the shop's chocolate, all of it
Dark chocolate melted with butter, yolks whisked in, whites whipped with sugar folded through, chilled 4 hours in small cups, a little chilli salt on top.
K: a French village after Lent ends

Southern French red warmed gently with orange, cinnamon, star anise, cloves and honey, served steaming in small glasses with an orange slice. Pour a 750ml bottle of light southern French red into a saucepan with an orange cut into slices, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 star anise, 4 cloves and 3 tbsp honey. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without letting it boil. Strain into small heatproof glasses and add a fresh orange slice to each.
T: Lent is over. The chocolate shop is open.
D: A woman opens a chocolate shop in a strict French village during Lent and shakes everyone up.
P: Serve the hot chocolate when Vianne pours one for Armande.

title: Big Fish
S: the perfect little town with shoes hanging over the road

Soft white bread filled with creamy egg, mayo, chives and white pepper, cut into triangles and laid on a picnic blanket with lemony apple slices. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chopped chives, salt and white pepper. Spread over 4 slices of soft white bread, top with 4 more and cut off the crusts, then into triangles. Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon juice. Lay it all out on a picnic blanket.
the circus where Edward works for clues about Sandra

Fresh popcorn coated in buttery brown sugar caramel, baked low until glassy and crunchy, tossed with roasted peanuts and sea salt. Pop 100g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl with 100g roasted peanuts. Boil 100g butter, 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt so it foams. Pour over and toss. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Cool and break up.
Raw peanuts boiled 2 hours in salted water with Cajun spice, soaked an hour, served warm in paper cones.
M: Whole snapper or barramundi scored, rubbed with Cajun spice and butter, roasted at 200C for 25 minutes, with lemon, hush puppies and coleslaw.
Karl the giant's garlic roast leg of lamb
the giant who eats a whole flock

A whole leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink and carved at the table, with crisp roast potatoes and fresh mint sauce. Make small cuts all over a 2kg leg of lamb and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and sprigs of rosemary. Rub with oil and salt. Roast at 180C to 58C inside, about 1 hour 20 minutes, and rest 20 minutes. Parboil 1.2kg potatoes, rough up and roast in oil for the last hour. Chop a bunch of mint with 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp boiling water and 4 tbsp malt vinegar for mint sauce.
W: the field of daffodils for Sandra
Lemon drizzle cake baked at 170C for 45 minutes, soaked with a hot lemon syrup, iced with yellow lemon icing.
K: Edward works three years for the circus

Homemade cherry and vanilla syrup topped with cold soda water over ice, finished with a float of cream and a cherry on top. Simmer 300g frozen pitted cherries with 150g sugar, 150ml water and a split vanilla bean for 10 minutes, mash and strain, then cool. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 50ml syrup and a squeeze of lime to each and top with 200ml soda water. Pour 2 tbsp cream gently over the top of each and add a cherry.
T: Some fish stories are true. This dinner is.
D: A son tries to separate fact from fiction in his dying father's tall tales.
P: Serve the mains when Edward tells the story of the giant catfish.

title: John Wick
S: the coins that pay for everything in his world

Lacy, golden parmesan crisps baked in small coin-sized rounds with cracked black pepper and a little thyme, served with a smoky tomato jam. Grate 150g parmesan finely and mix with picked thyme leaves. Spoon into small rounds on a tray lined with baking paper, leaving space between. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until lacy and golden. Crack black pepper over each and cool on the tray to crisp. Serve with a small bowl of tomato chutney for dabbing.
drinks at the bar where no business gets done
Green olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, rosemary and garlic, served with salted almonds.
the Russian boss getting very bad news about his son

Warm blini with sour cream and salmon roe, buttered rye topped with pickled herring and red onion, and cold dill pickles alongside. Warm 16 blini at 180C for 4 minutes and top each with a little sour cream, salmon roe and dill. Butter 4 slices dark rye, cut into fingers and top with 200g drained pickled herring and thinly sliced red onion. Halve 4 dill pickles lengthways. Lay everything out on a board and serve with ice-cold vodka for anyone who wants it.
M: Dinner for twelve braised short ribs

Beef short ribs braised slowly in red wine, garlic and thyme until falling off the bone, glazed with the reduced sauce over creamy parmesan polenta. Season and brown 2kg beef short ribs in batches. Add 375ml red wine, 500ml stock, 4 garlic cloves and thyme. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours until tender. Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until glossy, then return the ribs to coat. Cook 200g polenta in 1L water, stirring, for 10 minutes, then beat in 40g butter and 40g parmesan. Spoon the ribs over.
the quiet house before the trouble

Dry-brined rib eye seared in cast iron and basted with butter, garlic and rosemary, rested and sliced, with a sharp rocket, parmesan and lemon salad. Salt 4 rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 2 minutes a side, then add 50g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and rosemary and baste, turning, until 54C inside. Rest 8 minutes and slice. Toss 2 bags rocket with shaved parmesan, lemon juice and olive oil.
W: Peanut butter shortbread cut into little bone shapes, baked at 170C for 12 minutes, half dipped in dark chocolate. Human food only.
K: Addy behind the bar, the usual

Bourbon shaken hard with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky, served over a big cube with a few drops of bitters on the foam. For each drink, shake 60ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Dot 3 drops of aromatic bitters on the foam.
T: They killed his dog. Feed yours first.
D: A retired hitman comes back to settle the score with the Russian mob.
P: Serve the drinks when John sits at the bar in the Continental.

title: John Wick: Chapter 2
S: the Rome sommelier who presents his tasting like fine wine

A tasting flight of bites: chilli honey pecorino, prosciutto and melon with mint, and anchovy crostini with salsa verde, laid out like a tasting case. Cut 150g pecorino into shards. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over. Wrap 100g prosciutto around wedges of a quarter rockmelon and add mint leaves. Chop a handful of parsley with capers, lemon zest and 4 tbsp olive oil for salsa verde. Toast 8 baguette slices, spread with salsa verde and top each with an anchovy. Lay it all out in neat rows on a long board.
Roman street food before the job
Leftover risotto with tomato rolled around a cube of mozzarella, crumbed, fried at 180C until golden, so the cheese pulls like a phone cord.
Bowery King's chicken and mushroom pies
the rooftop kingdom of carrier pigeons, no pigeons harmed

Little puff pastry pies of chicken thigh and mushroom in a peppery thyme cream, baked golden and served in a wooden crate with hot English mustard. Fry 400g diced chicken thighs in 30g butter until browned, add 200g chopped mushrooms and thyme and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 150ml cream and plenty of cracked pepper and simmer until thick, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets puff pastry and press into a muffin tin, fill, top with smaller rounds cut from a third sheet and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with English mustard.
M: a simple bowl of pasta in Rome

Black pepper toasted in a dry pan, spaghetti cooked in a small amount of salted water, tossed off the heat with finely grated pecorino, the pepper and ladles of starchy pasta water until it turns creamy, never stringy.

Butterflied lamb leg marinated in rosemary, garlic, anchovy and lemon, charred on a screaming hot grill, sliced pink over crisp potatoes with salsa verde. Mash 4 anchovies, 4 garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, lemon zest and 4 tbsp olive oil and rub over a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg. Marinate 2 hours. Parboil 1kg chunked potatoes for 8 minutes and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Grill the lamb on high heat, turning, to 56C inside, about 20 minutes, and rest 10 minutes. Chop parsley, capers, lemon juice and olive oil for salsa verde and spoon over the sliced lamb.
W: a Roman dessert before the job goes wrong
Savoiardi dipped quickly in espresso and coffee liqueur, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa sifted on top.
K: 30ml each of gin, red bitter aperitivo and sweet vermouth, stirred over ice for 20 seconds, strained over a big cube, orange peel twisted over.
T: A marker is a promise. Dinner is a promise too.
D: John is forced to honour a blood oath and travels to Rome for a job he doesn't want.
P: Serve the wine when John visits the sommelier at the Rome Continental.

title: John Wick: Chapter 3 Parabellum
S: the assassin who runs a sushi bar in Chinatown
Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into nigiri topped with sliced salmon and tuna, a touch of wasabi under each, pickled ginger and soy on the side.
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with preserved lemon, cumin, harissa and garlic for 10 minutes, cooled slightly, served with bread.
Library stack za'atar lavash and labneh
the fight in the New York Public Library

Lavash cut into book-sized sheets and baked crisp with za'atar and olive oil, stacked with whipped labneh, chilli oil, cucumber and mint between the layers. Cut 3 lavash breads into rectangles the size of a paperback. Brush with olive oil, sprinkle with 2 tbsp za'atar and sea salt and bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp. Beat 300g labneh with lemon zest and a pinch of salt. Thinly slice a Lebanese cucumber. Stack 3 crackers high with labneh, cucumber, mint and a drizzle of chilli oil between each layer.
M: the desert crossing to find the Elder
Lamb shoulder browned, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, cinnamon and saffron, stock, dates and preserved lemon, cooked covered at 160C for 3 hours. Couscous with almonds.
the streets around Zero's sushi counter

Squid scored and dusted in rice flour, Sichuan pepper and salt, flash fried until crisp, then wok-tossed with chilli, garlic and spring onion. Steamed rice. Cook 300g jasmine rice. Cut 800g cleaned squid tubes open, score in a diamond pattern and cut into strips. Toast 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns, grind with 2 tsp salt and mix with 100g rice flour. Toss the squid in the flour and fry at 190C for 60 seconds in batches. Stir-fry 3 sliced garlic cloves, 2 sliced chillies and 3 spring onions in a hot wok, toss in the squid and serve with rice and lime.
W: Semolina, almond meal, yoghurt and sugar baked at 180C for 35 minutes, soaked hot with orange blossom syrup, almonds on top.
K: Gunpowder green tea and a big handful of mint steeped 5 minutes with sugar, poured from a height into little glasses.
T: Excommunicado. Still hungry.
D: With a price on his head, John fights his way from New York to Casablanca and back.
P: Serve the sushi when John walks into Zero's sushi counter.

title: John Wick: Chapter 4
S: Crisp golden octopus balls with spring onion and pickled ginger, drizzled with tangy okonomiyaki sauce and Japanese mayo, topped with dancing bonito flakes. Whisk 200g plain flour, 2 eggs, 600ml water and 1 tsp dashi powder into a thin batter. Heat an oiled takoyaki pan until smoking, fill the holes, then drop in 200g diced cooked octopus, sliced spring onion and pickled ginger. Cook 2 minutes, then turn each ball with a skewer every minute until round and crisp, about 6 minutes. Drizzle with okonomiyaki sauce and Japanese mayo and top with bonito flakes and nori.
the card game at the Berlin nightclub
Bratwurst grilled and sliced, covered in a sauce of tomato, curry powder, onion and a little sugar and vinegar, dusted with more curry powder. Fries.
Choux pastry with gruyère piped in rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow, served warm.
M: sunrise at the top of the steps
Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seared hard in cast iron, pulled at 54C and rested, with a peppercorn sauce of crushed pepper, cognac and cream reduced in the same pan, and thin fries cooked twice.
a late night in the Osaka hotel kitchen

Thick savoury cabbage pancakes crisped under thin pork belly slices, flipped and lacquered with okonomiyaki sauce, mayo, bonito flakes and pickled ginger. Whisk 200g plain flour, 250ml water, 1 tsp dashi powder and 4 eggs. Fold in half a wombok, finely shredded, and 4 sliced spring onions. Heat an oiled pan, add a quarter of the batter, press into a thick round and lay 3 thin slices of pork belly on top. Cook 5 minutes, flip and cook 5 more until the pork crisps. Repeat. Brush with okonomiyaki sauce, zigzag with mayo and top with bonito, nori and pickled ginger.
W: Stale croissants torn into a dish, soaked in an egg and cream custard with dark chocolate, baked at 170C for 35 minutes.
K: the long climb to Sacré-Cœur before sunrise

Cognac shaken hard with orange liqueur and fresh lemon, strained into a chilled coupe with a fine sugared rim and a twist of orange. Rub the rims of four chilled coupes with lemon and dip in caster sugar. For each drink, shake 50ml cognac, 20ml orange liqueur and 20ml fresh lemon juice hard with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupe and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
T: Osaka. Berlin. Paris. Dinner.
D: John takes on the High Table across the world for one last shot at freedom.
P: Serve the mains when the fight reaches the steps of Paris at sunrise.

title: Taken
S: Particular set of skills croque monsieur
built over a very long career

Ham and gruyère between slices of white bread spread with béchamel and Dijon, more béchamel and cheese on top, baked at 200C until bubbling, cut into fingers. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 300ml milk and cook until thick. Spread 8 slices white bread with Dijon and béchamel, fill with 150g ham and half of 150g gruyère, close and top with the rest of the sauce and cheese. Bake at 200C until bubbling.
Kim's birthday, the karaoke machine and the pony

Vanilla cupcakes with a hidden strawberry jam centre, swirled with pale pink strawberry buttercream and topped with a fresh strawberry and a single candle. Beat 125g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs and vanilla, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 in cases at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Core the middle of each and fill with strawberry jam. Beat 150g soft butter with 300g icing sugar and 4 mashed strawberries until fluffy. Pipe on top and finish each with a strawberry and a candle.
the Albanian gang he hunts down
Filo layered with butter and a filling of feta, ricotta, spinach and egg, rolled into a coil, baked at 190C for 35 minutes until crisp, cut into wedges.
M: the tense family dinner with his old colleague

Chicken roasted with tarragon butter under the skin, with a white wine and Dijon pan sauce, creamy gratin dauphinois and green beans. Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream, a crushed garlic clove and salt and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Mash 60g butter with chopped tarragon and push under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, and rest. Add 150ml white wine and 1 tsp Dijon to the tray, scrape and reduce by half. Steam 300g green beans.
Particular set of skills steak frites
a particular set of skills, put to work in Paris

Entrecôte seared hard and rested, topped with shallot and red wine butter, with thin twice-cooked fries and a sharp Dijon mayo. Reduce 2 chopped shallots in 100ml red wine until almost dry, cool and mash into 80g soft butter with parsley and salt, then chill. Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries, soak 30 minutes and dry. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then 185C until crisp. Sear 4 scotch fillet steaks in a smoking pan to 54C inside and rest 5 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp Dijon. Top the steaks with the butter.
W: Caramel poured into ramekins, filled with a custard of eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla, baked in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes, chilled overnight and turned out.
K: I will find you citron pressé
a glass in Paris before the hunt

Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold soda water stirred over ice the way Paris cafés serve it, with a splash of cognac for the grown-ups. Squeeze 6 lemons. Fill four tall glasses with ice and add 40ml lemon juice and 20ml sugar syrup to each. Add 30ml cognac to the glasses that want it. Top each with 150ml cold soda water, stir and add a lemon wheel.
T: A very particular set of skills. One of them is cooking.
D: A retired agent tracks down the men who kidnapped his daughter in Paris.
P: Serve the mains when Bryan sits down to dinner with Jean-Claude's family.

title: Heat
S: the two of them face to face over coffee
Apple pie of Granny Smiths, sugar and cinnamon in a double crust, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, served in wedges with strong drip coffee.

Pork shoulder marinated in guajillo, achiote, orange and pineapple, charred and sliced thin into corn tortillas with grilled pineapple, onion, coriander and salsa verde. Blitz 3 soaked guajillo chillies with 2 tbsp achiote paste, the juice of an orange, 100ml pineapple juice, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and salt. Marinate 1kg thinly sliced pork shoulder overnight. Cook in a very hot pan in batches until charred at the edges. Grill 4 pineapple rings and chop. Fill 16 warm corn tortillas with pork, pineapple, diced white onion, coriander and salsa verde.
Neil's empty house by the ocean
Freshly shucked oysters on ice with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette and lemon.
M: Hanna's three-hour beef and pork ragù
the dinner Vincent never gets home for

Beef and pork ragù simmered slowly with red wine, tomato and a parmesan rind until rich and glossy, tossed through rigatoni with plenty of grated parmesan. Soften a diced onion, carrot and celery stick in olive oil. Add 400g beef mince and 300g pork mince and brown hard. Pour in 200ml red wine and reduce, then add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a parmesan rind and 250ml water. Simmer gently for 3 hours, topping up with water. Cook 500g rigatoni, toss through the ragù with a splash of pasta water and grate 60g parmesan over.
Neil's rule about walking out in thirty seconds flat

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and butter basted, rested and sliced, with a loaded baked potato and garlicky creamed spinach. Salt 4 rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, then baste with 40g butter, garlic and thyme until 54C inside, and rest 8 minutes. Wilt 400g spinach with a crushed garlic clove, add 150ml cream and 30g parmesan and reduce. Split the potatoes and top with sour cream, chives and crisp bacon.
W: Neil's rule, nothing you can't walk out on

New York cheesecake: cream cheese, sugar, eggs and sour cream on a biscuit base, baked in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cooled in the oven. Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for an hour and cool in the oven. Chill overnight.
K: Face-to-face cold brew with cinnamon cream
the diner meeting between cop and robber

Strong coffee steeped cold overnight, poured over ice and topped with a float of cinnamon and brown sugar cream that slowly drifts down. Stir 100g coarse ground coffee into 1L cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain through a fine sieve lined with paper towel. Whisk 150ml cream with 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon until just thickened. Fill four glasses with ice, pour in 200ml cold brew each and spoon the cream over the top.
T: Coffee with the enemy.
D: A detective and a master thief circle each other across Los Angeles.
P: Serve the coffee and pie when Hanna and McCauley sit down at the diner.

title: Collateral
S: Max's long night shifts behind the wheel
Pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews tossed in melted butter, smoked paprika and a little brown sugar, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, cooled and tipped into paper bags with strips of beef jerky.
the packed Korean nightclub near the end
Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C until shattering, tossed in a glaze of gochujang, soy, honey and garlic, sesame on top.
Daniel's jazz club smoky devilled eggs
Daniel tells his old story about the night a trumpet legend walked in

Devilled eggs whipped with mayo, mustard and chipotle, topped with crispy bacon and smoked paprika, with warm olives in orange and fennel alongside. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and whip the yolks with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard and 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, then pipe back in. Top with crumbled crispy bacon from 2 rashers and smoked paprika. Warm 250g mixed olives in 3 tbsp olive oil with strips of orange peel and 1 tsp fennel seeds for 5 minutes and serve alongside.
M: a stop for food between jobs
Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin for 2 hours, seared over very high heat, rested, sliced against the grain, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and salsa roja.
Max's mum Ida in hospital, in the middle of it all

Chicken thighs simmered into a golden broth with onion, carrot and celery, shredded back in with egg noodles, dill, black pepper and a squeeze of lemon. Put 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in a pot with 2L water, an onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and a bay leaf. Simmer gently for 1 hour, skimming. Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and dice the vegetables. Return both to the strained broth, add 200g egg noodles and simmer 5 minutes. Season well and finish with chopped dill and lemon juice.
W: the island postcard Max keeps on his sun visor
Blind-baked sweet pastry filled with desiccated coconut, eggs, sugar, butter and coconut milk whisked together, baked at 170C for 30 minutes until golden and set.
K: Strong dark coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and poured over ice in tall glasses, with a pinch of salt to sharpen it. Brew 500ml very strong coffee with 80g dark roast ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of four tall glasses with a small pinch of salt. Pour 125ml hot coffee into each and stir until combined. Fill with ice, stir again and serve with a straw.
T: One night. Five stops. Plenty of snacks.
D: A cab driver is forced to drive a hitman around Los Angeles for one very long night.
P: Serve the mains when they pull up at the jazz club.

title: Reservoir Dogs
S: the breakfast table talk before the heist
Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in small rounds in butter until bubbles set, stacked in threes with butter and maple syrup.
Mr Pink's bacon and egg sliders
Mr Pink at the diner, who doesn't tip

Soft scrambled eggs, crisp streaky bacon and melted American cheese in toasted brioche slider buns with hot sauce mayo. Grill 8 rashers streaky bacon until crisp and halve. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and scramble softly in 30g butter over low heat. Toast 8 brioche slider buns. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp hot sauce. Fill each bun with egg, bacon, a half slice of American cheese and a spoon of the hot sauce mayo.
Grated potato squeezed dry, seasoned, pressed into flat cakes, fried in butter and oil until crisp and deep golden on both sides.
M: Joe's big breakfast before he hands out the colour names

Two eggs your way, thick-cut bacon, griddled pork sausages, crispy hash browns, buttered toast and a blistered tomato on a big oval plate. Grill 8 pork sausages for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 8 rashers thick-cut bacon. Halve 4 tomatoes and grill cut side down until blistered. Bake 8 hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 eggs in butter to order. Toast 8 slices of bread and butter well. Load everything onto four big plates with tomato sauce on the table.
Rump steak seared and sliced, piled into a toasted roll with onions cooked slowly in butter, provolone and a horseradish mayo.
W: Uncle Bob's after the tip argument
Short pastry case with tangy lemon filling under a tall, toasted meringue, cut in big diner wedges.
K: Tip jar maple cream cold brew
the tipping argument around the diner table

Overnight cold brew poured over ice and topped with a maple cream float, served in thick diner mugs. Tip your waitress. Stir 100g coarse ground coffee into 1L cold water and steep in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain. Whisk 150ml cream with 2 tbsp maple syrup until just thick. Fill four thick mugs or glasses with ice, pour in the cold brew and spoon the maple cream on top.
T: Breakfast first. Then the job.
D: A jewellery heist goes wrong and the surviving crooks suspect one of them is a cop.
P: Serve the breakfast when the crew argues about tipping at the diner.

title: True Romance
S: the kung fu triple bill where Alabama spills her popcorn on Clarence
Popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed in melted butter and fine salt, a second batch tossed in butter, soy and a little sugar for the kung fu films. Served in big paper buckets.
Clarence's Detroit, before the road trip

Griddled cocktail franks in steamed mini rolls under a fine, spicy beef chilli sauce, yellow mustard and plenty of diced raw onion. Brown 250g fine beef mince with half a finely diced onion, breaking it up very small. Add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 20 minutes into a loose sauce. Griddle 16 cocktail franks until blistered. Steam 16 mini rolls for 1 minute. Fill with franks, spoon over the sauce and top with mustard and diced raw onion.
the comic book shop where Clarence works
Choux pastry with sharp cheddar and cayenne, piped into small rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow, served warm.
M: the purple convertible from Detroit to LA

Two crispy smashed chuck patties with American cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce in soft buns, wrapped in paper, with crinkle-cut fries and purple slaw. Bake 800g crinkle-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Toss a quarter of a red cabbage, shredded, with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon. Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls. Smash thin on a smoking griddle, season, cook 2 minutes, flip and add American cheese. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and chopped pickles for sauce. Stack two patties per toasted bun with onion, pickles and sauce, and wrap in paper.
the fancy LA hotel suite with the producer
Club sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo on three slices of toast, cut into triangles, with a silver bowl of shoestring fries.
W: pie after the movie, the night they meet
Sour cherries tossed with sugar, lemon, a splash of almond extract and cornflour, in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled before slicing. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the beach at the very end
45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime shaken hard with ice, strained into a salt-rimmed glass.
T: You're so cool. So is this pie.
D: A comic shop clerk marries a call girl and the two go on the run to Hollywood with a suitcase they shouldn't have.
P: Serve the pie when Clarence and Alabama head to the diner after the kung fu triple feature.

title: Jackie Brown
S: Del Amo food court teriyaki skewers
the half-million-dollar switch at the Del Amo mall

Chicken thigh glazed in sticky soy, ginger and mirin teriyaki, charred on skewers, with sesame, spring onion and pickled cucumber in paper food court boats. Simmer 80ml soy, 80ml mirin, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger for 4 minutes until syrupy. Thread 800g diced chicken thighs onto 12 skewers. Grill on high for 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze in the last 4 minutes until sticky and charred. Slice a cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar. Serve in paper boats with sesame seeds and spring onion.
White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, chipotle crema and lime.
Peanuts tossed in lime zest, chilli powder and salt, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, served in little foil packets like on the plane.
M: the bail bondsman who falls for Jackie
Sirloin seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream and chives and a wedge salad with blue cheese.
Ordell's South Bay hot honey fried chicken

Buttermilk-brined chicken fried shatter-crisp, drizzled with chilli hot honey, with smoky braised greens and a creamy baked mac and cheese. Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge in 300g flour with 2 tsp paprika and fry at 165C until 74C inside. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over. Wilt 2 bunches kale with bacon and cider vinegar. Toss 300g cooked macaroni with 200g grated cheddar, 250ml milk and 1 egg and bake at 180C for 30 minutes.
W: Moist brown sugar banana bread studded with walnuts, toasted in thick slices and spread with salted maple butter. Mash 3 ripe bananas with 120g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs and vanilla. Fold in 250g self-raising flour and 80g walnuts and bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 55 minutes. Beat 40g soft butter with 1 tbsp maple syrup and a pinch of salt. Toast thick slices and spread with the maple butter.
K: Vodka over ice with fresh blood orange and orange juice, a dash of ginger syrup for bite, and a blood orange wheel on the rim. Simmer 50g sugar, 50ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Squeeze 4 blood oranges and 2 oranges. For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice, add 45ml vodka and 10ml ginger syrup and top with about 150ml of the mixed juice. Stir and add a blood orange wheel.
T: Cash, a mall, and a very good plan.
D: A flight attendant caught smuggling money plays the cops and a gun runner against each other.
P: Serve the snacks when the money swap happens at the shopping mall.

title: Snatch
S: East End pie, mash and parsley liquor

Little minced beef and onion pies with a flaky lid, a scoop of buttery mash and bright green parsley liquor, with chilli vinegar to splash on. Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion, add 1 tbsp flour and 200ml beef stock and simmer 15 minutes, then cool. Line 8 muffin holes with shortcrust, fill and top with puff. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Mash 800g potatoes with 50g butter. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml stock and simmer, then add a bunch of finely chopped parsley. Serve with malt vinegar and chilli.
Aged cheddar, red Leicester and a crumbly Wensleydale cut into sharp little diamond shapes, with crackers and pickled onions.
the caravans where the bare-knuckle fighters live
Thin pork sausages grilled until sticky, glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard, served on toothpicks.
M: the promoter's office and its kettle
Bacon, sausages, fried eggs, baked beans, black pudding, mushrooms and grilled tomato with buttered toast.
Avi's New York strip and creamed spinach
Avi, who can't wait to get out of London

Thick sirloin seared hard and rested, with a buttery baked potato, garlicky creamed spinach and a sharp horseradish cream, the way Avi orders back home. Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 thick sirloins and sear in a smoking pan 3 to 4 minutes a side to 54C inside, then rest. Wilt 400g spinach with a crushed garlic clove, add 150ml cream and 30g parmesan and reduce until thick. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish. Split the potatoes, add butter and serve with the steak.
W: Biscuit base, thick caramel and sliced bananas under a mountain of cream and grated chocolate.
K: Mickey's caravan site and its bare-knuckle fights

Irish whiskey over ice topped with fiery ginger beer and fresh lime, with a long ginger and lime garnish. A proper fighter's drink. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Irish whiskey and the juice of half a lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.
T: London. Diamonds. Dogs. Dinner.
D: A stolen diamond, a crooked boxing promoter and a dog all collide in London's underworld.
P: Serve the mains when the dog swallows the squeaky toy.

title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
S: an East End seafood stall, without the jellied eels
Smoked mackerel flaked and blitzed with cream cheese, horseradish, lemon and black pepper, spread on toasted rye with sliced cucumber.
the rigged three-card brag game with Hatchet Harry

Peanuts coated in egg white, smoked paprika, brown sugar and chilli, roasted until glassy and crunchy, served in a bowl in the middle of the card table. Whisk 1 egg white until frothy. Toss with 400g raw peanuts, then with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, half a tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 160C for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring twice, until dry and crunchy. Cool on the tray and break up.

Pork rind dried overnight and roasted until puffed and crackling, then hit with malt vinegar and sea salt flakes, served warm in paper bags. Score 500g pork rind into strips, rub well with salt and dry uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast on a rack at 220C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling. Spray or brush lightly with 2 tbsp malt vinegar while hot, then toss in more sea salt flakes. Tip into paper bags.
M: Bacon, bangers, fried eggs, beans, mushrooms, blistered tomato and fried bread crisped in the bacon fat, brown sauce on the table. Grill 8 pork sausages for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 8 rashers bacon and keep warm, then fry 4 slices of bread in the bacon fat until crisp. Fry 250g mushrooms in butter and halve 4 tomatoes and grill until blistered. Warm a tin of baked beans. Fry 4 eggs. Load onto four warm plates and put brown sauce on the table.
the debt collector who brings his son along
Beef chuck braised in dark ale with onion and thyme for 2.5 hours, thickened, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Thick chips and mushy peas with mint.
W: Self-raising flour, butter, sugar and currants mixed with milk, wrapped in a pudding basin under baking paper and foil, steamed 90 minutes, turned out with hot custard.
K: Two smoking barrels peated whisky sour
the two antique shotguns everyone is chasing

Smoky peated Scotch shaken with fresh lemon, honey syrup and egg white until silky, served over ice with a dash of bitters on the foam. Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp warm water for honey syrup. For each drink, shake 50ml peated Scotch whisky, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml honey syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice, then with ice. Strain into a tumbler over ice and dot the foam with aromatic bitters.
T: It's been emotional. Pass the brown sauce.
D: Four friends lose a rigged card game and scramble to raise half a million pounds in a week.
P: Serve the mains when the lads plan the robbery over breakfast.

title: Ocean's Eleven
S: Rusty eats in nearly every scene
Prawns poached in salted water for 2 minutes, iced, served in martini glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and Worcestershire.
the chips on the high-stakes table
Potatoes sliced paper thin on a mandoline, rinsed, dried, fried at 170C until golden, tossed straight away with truffle salt and finely grated parmesan.
M: Benedict's casino rib eye with béarnaise

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and rested, with a buttery tarragon béarnaise, creamed spinach and a crisp shoestring fry stack. Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with tarragon and a chopped shallot to 1 tbsp, whisk with 3 yolks over simmering water and drizzle in 200g warm melted butter. Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze and simmer in 200ml cream. Bake 600g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Sear the steaks, pull at 54C and rest 8 minutes.
Saul, the old con man coaxed out of retirement

Golden chicken broth simmered with onion, carrot and celery, with fluffy matzo balls, shredded chicken, fresh dill and cracked pepper. Simmer 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in 2L water with an onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks for 1 hour. Strain, shred the chicken and slice the carrots back in. Mix 120g matzo meal, 3 eggs, 3 tbsp melted chicken fat or oil, 3 tbsp broth and salt and chill 30 minutes. Roll into 12 balls and simmer in the broth, covered, for 30 minutes. Finish with dill.
W: the crew watching the fountains at the end
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, hot fudge made from dark chocolate and cream, whipped cream piped high and a few gold sprinkles to catch the light.
K: 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth stirred with ice for 30 seconds, strained into a chilled glass, a green olive on a pick.
T: Eleven guys. Three casinos. One very long buffet.
D: Danny Ocean gathers a crew to rob three Las Vegas casinos in one night.
P: Serve the prawn cocktail whenever Rusty is eating, which is most scenes.

title: Ocean's Twelve
S: the crew's first stop in Amsterdam
Beef braised with onion and thyme until it falls apart, shredded into a thick roux-based ragout, chilled overnight, rolled into balls, crumbed and fried at 180C. Grainy mustard.
the crew's canal-side stop in Amsterdam

Caramel stroopwafels warmed over hot espresso until soft and chewy, served with vanilla ice cream drowned in espresso and a drizzle of salted caramel. Brew 4 hot espressos. Rest a stroopwafel on top of each cup for 2 minutes so the caramel softens. Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream in four small glasses. Warm 3 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of sea salt. Pour an espresso over each scoop, drizzle with caramel and serve with two warm stroopwafels each.
the Night Fox's villa on Lake Como
Bresaola, burrata, figs, grissini and olives on a board, finished with a drizzle of good olive oil and lemon.
M: Carnaroli toasted in butter with onion, white wine, hot stock added ladle by ladle for 18 minutes, saffron steeped in, finished with butter and parmesan.
Rome pork saltimbocca with sage butter
the Rome leg of the job

Pork escalopes pounded thin, pressed with prosciutto and sage, seared crisp in butter and finished with white wine and lemon, over garlicky crushed potatoes. Boil 800g small potatoes for 15 minutes, crush with olive oil, garlic and parsley. Pound 8 pork escalopes thin, lay a slice of prosciutto and a sage leaf on each and secure with a toothpick. Dust the underside with flour. Fry prosciutto side down in 40g butter for 2 minutes, flip for 1 minute. Add 100ml white wine and a squeeze of lemon, bubble, swirl in 20g butter and spoon over.
W: Sponge fingers soaked in strong espresso, layered with light mascarpone and whipped cream, set overnight and finished with a heavy dusting of cocoa. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip 24 sponge fingers in 300ml cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Chill 4 hours or overnight and dust with cocoa.
K: 60ml orange bitter aperitivo, 90ml prosecco and a splash of soda over ice with an orange slice.
T: Amsterdam. Rome. Lake Como. Lunch.
D: Danny's crew head to Europe to pay back the casino owner they robbed, and run into a rival thief.
P: Serve the snacks when the crew lands in Amsterdam.

title: The Italian Job
S: Anchovies, lots of garlic and butter melted slowly into olive oil, kept warm over a flame, with raw fennel, capsicum, radish and bread for dipping.
Blow the bloody doors off cheese toasts
the gold bullion they're after, easy on the dynamite

Bread cut into neat bars, topped with grated aged cheddar and parmesan mixed with mustard and egg, grilled until golden. Mix 150g grated vintage cheddar, 30g parmesan, 1 tsp English mustard and 1 egg. Cut 6 slices of bread into neat bars and toast one side. Spread the cheese mix on the other side and grill until golden and bubbling.
Mr Bridger's cucumber and egg tea fingers
the crime boss running everything from his prison cell

Crustless fingers of buttered white bread with cucumber and mint cream cheese, and curried egg and cress, stacked on a plate like a proper English tea. Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, peel and mash with 3 tbsp mayo, a pinch of curry powder and salt. Beat 150g cream cheese with chopped mint. Butter 12 slices white bread. Spread 3 with cream cheese and top with thin cucumber slices, spread 3 with egg and cress, then close all six. Cut off the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers.
M: Veal or pork loin poached gently, chilled, sliced thin, covered in a sauce of tuna, anchovy, capers, mayo and lemon.
Turin beef agnolotti with brown butter
handmade pasta from Piedmont, the region of the job

Little pinched pasta pockets of braised beef and parmesan, tossed in nutty brown butter with crispy sage and more parmesan. Mix 300g shredded braised beef or cooked beef mince with 40g parmesan, 1 egg and nutmeg. Roll 400g fresh lasagne sheets thinner and cut into 6cm wide strips. Dot teaspoons of filling along each strip, fold over and pinch between each mound, then cut into pockets. Boil for 3 minutes. Melt 100g butter until nut brown with 12 sage leaves, toss the pasta through and finish with parmesan.
W: a Piedmont pudding from around Turin

Sugar cooked to a dark caramel and poured into a loaf tin, a custard of eggs, milk, cocoa, crushed amaretti and a splash of rum poured over, baked in a water bath at 160C for 45 minutes, chilled and turned out.
K: Hang on a minute, lads bicerin
a Turin café, and a great idea

The Turin café classic: thick hot chocolate, a shot of espresso and lightly whipped cream layered in a small glass. Heat 300ml milk and whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tbsp sugar until thick and smooth. Brew 4 espressos. Lightly whip 150ml cream. Pour the hot chocolate into four small heatproof glasses, gently pour an espresso over the back of a spoon on top, then float the cream. Serve straight away without stirring.
T: You were only supposed to blow the doors off. Not the oven.
D: A crew of British crooks plan to steal a fortune in gold from the streets of Turin.
P: Serve the mains when the three little cars start the getaway through Turin.

title: Goldfinger
S: Kentucky gold, cut into bullion bars
Golden buttermilk cornbread baked in a tray and cut into gold bar shapes, with honey butter.
Royal St Mark's golf club prawn toasts
the round of golf Goldfinger tries to cheat

Crisp sesame prawn toasts with sweet chilli and lime, alongside smoked salmon on buttered rye with dill and capers, like a 1960s clubhouse spread. Blitz 300g peeled green prawns with a spring onion, grated ginger, 1 egg white, 1 tsp soy and salt. Spread on 4 slices white bread, press into 50g sesame seeds and cut into triangles. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes a side. Butter 4 slices rye, top with 150g smoked salmon, dill and capers and cut into fingers. Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.
the Miami Beach hotel pool where it all starts

Chilled sweet crab in a lemony celery and chive mayonnaise, spooned into crisp baby cos leaves and dusted with paprika. Mix 300g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a finely diced celery stick, chopped chives, lemon zest and juice and a pinch of paprika. Spoon into 12 baby cos leaves and serve cold.
M: Sirloin seared hard and rested, the pan deglazed with bourbon, cracked pepper and stock, cream added and reduced, served with crisp potatoes roasted in beef dripping.
Goldfinger's Operation Grand Slam on Fort Knox

Buttermilk-brined chicken in a paprika and white pepper crust fried golden as bullion, with smoky honey butter corn on the cob. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt. Mix 300g flour with 2 tsp paprika and 1 tsp white pepper. Dredge and fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74C inside. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, then char on a grill. Melt 50g butter with 1 tbsp honey and half a tsp smoked paprika and brush over the corn.
W: Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, chilled 3 hours, rolled into balls, dusted in cocoa, then rolled in edible gold lustre until they shine.
K: Goldfinger offers Bond one at the farm
Mint gently pressed with sugar syrup in a metal cup, 60ml bourbon, packed with crushed ice, stirred until frosted, a big mint sprig on top.
T: Shaken, not stirred. Gold, not silver.
D: James Bond takes on a gold-obsessed villain with a plan for Fort Knox.
P: Serve the drinks when Goldfinger offers Bond a mint julep at his Kentucky stud farm.

title: GoldenEye
S: the Russian gangster with the caviar business
Buckwheat blini cooked small in butter, topped with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, served on ice beside a bottle of frozen vodka.
the baccarat table in Monte Carlo

Crisp-edged chickpea pancakes from the Riviera cut into wedges, topped with black olive and anchovy tapenade, roasted cherry tomatoes and basil. Whisk 150g chickpea flour with 300ml water, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt and rest 30 minutes. Heat an oiled ovenproof pan in a 240C oven, pour in half the batter and bake 10 minutes until set and crisp at the edges. Repeat. Blitz 150g pitted black olives with 4 anchovies, 1 tbsp capers, a garlic clove and olive oil. Roast 250g cherry tomatoes for 10 minutes. Cut the socca into wedges and top.
the tank chase through St Petersburg
Soft yeasted buns filled with beef mince, onion and dill, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, brushed with butter.
M: a Russian supper after the snow
Beef fillet strips seared fast, mushrooms and onion cooked in butter, paprika, a splash of brandy, stock and sour cream, over buttered egg noodles.
Cuban mojo pork, black beans and plantain
the satellite dish hidden in a Cuban lake

Pork shoulder marinated in sour orange mojo, slow roasted and pulled, with black beans and rice, fried sweet plantain and quick pickled red onion. Blitz the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes with 6 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin and oregano and marinate 1.5kg pork shoulder overnight. Roast covered at 160C for 4 hours and pull. Cook 300g rice, then fold through a drained, warmed tin of black beans. Slice 2 ripe plantains and fry until caramelised. Toss a sliced red onion in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
W: St Petersburg syrniki with berry jam

Little golden cottage cheese pancakes fried in butter until crisp outside and soft inside, with cold sour cream and warm berry jam. Mix 500g cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 80g flour. Shape 12 small patties, dust in flour and fry in butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. Warm 4 tbsp berry jam. Serve with 150g sour cream and the jam.
K: 60ml vodka and 10ml dry vermouth shaken hard with ice, strained into a chilled glass, lemon peel.
T: For England, James. And for dinner.
D: Bond races to stop a former friend from using a stolen Soviet satellite weapon.
P: Serve the drinks when Bond orders his vodka martini at the casino in Monte Carlo.

title: Casino Royale
S: the high-stakes game at the casino
Ripe figs halved and wrapped in prosciutto, warm olives marinated with orange peel and fennel seed, and shards of aged cheddar, all on toothpicks so nobody touches the cards with greasy fingers.
the dinner on the train where they size each other up
Butter lettuce leaves, fennel shaved paper thin, orange segments cut free of pith and hazelnuts toasted at 170C for 8 minutes, dressed at the last second with Dijon, white wine vinegar and olive oil.

Crisp golden fritters of chopped prawn and crab with capsicum, celery, spring onion and scotch bonnet, with a zingy lime and chilli aioli. Chop 250g peeled green prawns and mix with 150g crab meat, half a finely diced red capsicum, a celery stick, 2 spring onions and a little chopped scotch bonnet. Whisk in 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 125ml milk to a thick batter. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayo with lime zest and juice, a crushed garlic clove and chilli sauce.
M: Lamb shoulder chops marinated overnight in garlic, rosemary, lemon and olive oil, grilled hot until charred and pink inside, with roasted capsicum and a garlic yoghurt sauce.

Carnaroli cooked slowly in fish stock with white wine, loaded with prawns, mussels and squid, finished with butter and a sharp lemon, garlic and parsley gremolata. Soften 2 chopped shallots and 2 garlic cloves in 2 tbsp olive oil, add 350g carnaroli and toast 1 minute. Add 125ml white wine, then 1.2L hot fish stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes. Add 300g peeled green prawns, 500g mussels and 200g sliced squid, cover and cook 3 minutes until the mussels open. Stir in 30g butter. Chop parsley, lemon zest and a garlic clove for gremolata and scatter over.
W: a rich dessert for a rich game
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked into eggs and sugar beaten pale, a little flour folded in, baked in buttered and cocoa-dusted moulds at 220C for 9 minutes, turned out so the centre runs.
K: Bond invents it at the poker table
60ml gin, 20ml vodka and 10ml aromatised white wine shaken very cold, strained into a deep coupe, a long strip of lemon peel.
T: The stakes are high. So is the buffet.
D: In his first mission as 007, Bond takes on a banker to terrorists at a high-stakes poker game.
P: Serve the drinks when Bond invents the Vesper at the poker table.

title: Skyfall
S: Pork and prawn siu mai: mince, chopped prawn, ginger, shiitake and soy wrapped in open wonton skins, steamed 8 minutes, a dot of roe on top.
the glass tower fight in Shanghai

Fluffy steamed bao stuffed with sticky soy-braised pork belly, quick pickled cucumber, crushed salted peanuts, coriander and a swipe of hoisin. Simmer 800g pork belly, cut into 2cm slices, with 80ml soy, 60ml Shaoxing wine, 3 tbsp brown sugar, sliced ginger and 500ml water for 2 hours until sticky, reducing at the end. Slice a cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar for 20 minutes. Steam 12 frozen bao buns for 8 minutes. Fill with hoisin, pork, cucumber, crushed peanuts and coriander.
Oatcakes of oats, butter and salt baked at 180C for 20 minutes, topped with crème fraîche, Scottish smoked salmon and dill.
M: the old lodge in the Scottish highlands
Venison backstrap rubbed with juniper, thyme and pepper, seared to rare, rested, with a whisky and redcurrant sauce, mashed neeps and roast potatoes.
a cold night in the lodge before Silva arrives

Smoked haddock poached in milk and flaked into a thick, creamy potato and leek soup, finished with chives, black pepper and buttered crusty bread. Poach 500g smoked haddock or cod in 750ml milk with a bay leaf for 5 minutes, then lift out and flake, keeping the milk. Soften 2 sliced leeks in 40g butter, add 600g diced potatoes and 400ml water and simmer 15 minutes. Add the milk, mash about half the potatoes to thicken, then add the fish and 100ml cream. Warm through and finish with chives and pepper. Serve with buttered bread.
W: a Scottish dessert for the highlands
Oats toasted in a dry pan until nutty, folded through cream whipped with honey and a splash of whisky, layered in glasses with raspberries crushed lightly, more oats on top.
K: the very old whisky Silva pours on his island

Blended Scotch shaken with fresh lemon and honey ginger syrup, poured over a big cube and floated with a little smoky single malt. Simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and a sliced 4cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. For each drink, shake 50ml blended Scotch, 20ml lemon juice and 20ml honey ginger syrup with ice. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler and gently float 10ml peated single malt on top. Garnish with a piece of candied ginger.
T: Some men are coming to kill us. Dinner first.
D: Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt MI6.
P: Serve the mains when Bond and M reach the old family lodge in the Scottish highlands.

title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
S: the pub where Harry teaches some manners
Pork crackling roasted at 240C until blistered, Scotch eggs boiled 6 minutes and wrapped in sausage meat, crumbed and fried at 170C, and sharp pickled onions on a wooden board.
the tailor's shop that hides the agency
Crustless sandwiches of cucumber with cream cheese and mint, and smoked salmon with dill butter, cut into perfectly straight fingers as sharp as a suit.

Vintage cheddar and cayenne shortbread cut into little terrier shapes, baked golden and crisp, served with a sharp pickled onion relish. Human food only. Rub 100g cold butter into 150g plain flour, then add 120g grated vintage cheddar, a pinch of cayenne and salt. Bring together with 1 tbsp cold water, wrap and chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm and cut into small dog shapes. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Chop 6 pickled onions with a spoon of apple chutney for a relish alongside.
M: Valentine serves Harry fast food on silver
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and a mustard-ketchup sauce on soft buns, plated on the best china with silver cutlery and linen napkins.
Round table rib roast and Yorkshires
dinner with Arthur and the knights of the agency

Beef rib roast with a black pepper crust, carved pink, with tall Yorkshire puddings, beef dripping roast potatoes, horseradish cream and a rich red wine gravy. Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C to 52C inside, and rest 20 minutes. Parboil 1.2kg potatoes, roast in 3 tbsp dripping at 220C for 50 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk, pour into a smoking hot oiled 12-hole tin and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 150ml red wine in the roasting tray, add 300ml stock and simmer for gravy.
W: a very English pudding for a very English spy
Crushed meringue, softly whipped cream and quartered strawberries folded together in glasses, with a drizzle of strawberry purée sweetened with a little sugar.
K: stirred while glancing at the vermouth bottle
70ml gin stirred over ice for 10 seconds, strained into a frozen glass, the dry vermouth bottle looked at but never opened. Lemon peel.
T: Manners maketh dinner.
D: A street kid is recruited into a secret spy organisation run out of a London tailor's shop.
P: Serve the burgers when Valentine serves Harry fast food on fine china.

title: Mission: Impossible
S: Ethan's Prague, before it all goes wrong

Little Czech open sandwiches on buttered baguette, piled with potato salad, ham, boiled egg, gherkin and parsley, the way Prague delis line them up. Boil 3 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and slice. Slice a baguette into 16 pieces and spread with butter. Top each with a spoon of potato salad, a fold of ham, a slice of boiled egg, a gherkin slice and parsley. Line them up neatly on a long board.
Prawn crackers fried at 190C for a few seconds until they puff up dramatically, served with a sweet chilli and lime dip.
the white vault at Langley he drops into on a wire

An all-white board of brie, goat's cheese and whipped ricotta stacked on white water crackers with crisp pear, white pepper and a little honey. Beat 150g ricotta with a pinch of salt until smooth. Slice 150g brie and 120g goat's cheese into neat pieces. Core and thinly slice 2 pears and toss in lemon juice. Stack crackers with a layer of cheese, a slice of pear and a crack of white pepper, and drizzle a little honey over. Lay out on a white plate and serve in silence.
M: Beef chuck browned, plenty of onion cooked down slowly, sweet paprika, caraway and tomato, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Bread dumplings or crusty bread.
the restaurant with the giant fish tanks, before they burst

Snapper fillets pan-fried skin down until crackling, finished with nutty brown butter, capers and lemon, with crushed dill potatoes. Boil 800g small potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with 30g butter, chopped dill and salt. Score the skin of 4 snapper fillets, season and fry skin side down in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute. Remove the fish, add 60g butter to the pan and cook until nut brown, then add 1 tbsp capers and the juice of a lemon. Spoon over the fish.
W: Sweet yeasted dough wrapped around foil-covered rolling pins, rolled in cinnamon sugar and walnuts, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until golden, slid off and filled with whipped cream.
K: the briefings that self-destruct after one viewing

Cold Czech pilsner topped with fresh lemon, ginger syrup and soda in a smoked salt rimmed glass, with a crackle of lemon zest. Simmer 50g sugar, 50ml water and a sliced 3cm piece of ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Rub the rims of four glasses with lemon and dip in smoked salt. Add 20ml ginger syrup and the juice of half a lemon to each glass, pour in 330ml cold Czech pilsner and top with a splash of soda water. Finish with grated lemon zest.
T: This menu will self-destruct in five seconds.
D: An agent framed for his team's deaths goes rogue to find the real mole.
P: Serve the mains when Ethan meets Kittridge at the restaurant with the giant fish tanks.

title: Top Gun
S: the bar where they sing to Charlie
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter and a little honey, blue cheese dip and celery sticks.
Flathead strips in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime crema and pico de gallo.
Goose hammering out a rock and roll classic on the bar piano

Smashed beef sliders with melted cheddar, sticky butter onions, pickles and a hot mustard mayo on soft milk rolls, served on a tray for the whole bar. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp American mustard and a dash of hot sauce. Smash the balls thin on a smoking griddle, season, cook 90 seconds, flip and top with cheddar. Fill 12 toasted milk rolls with patties, onions, pickles and the mustard mayo.
M: Maverick turns up at Charlie's for dinner
Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with a Greek salad and warm pita.
the base at Miramar, San Diego

Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, seared over very high heat and sliced, with charred spring onions, Mexican rice, black beans and salsa roja. Marinate 800g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes and an orange, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and salt for 2 hours. Cook 300g rice with 2 tbsp tomato paste and 600ml stock. Warm a drained tin of black beans with cumin. Sear the steak on very high heat 3 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thin against the grain. Char 2 bunches spring onions. Serve with salsa roja.
W: Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into rectangles, drizzled with a glossy dark chocolate glaze so they shine.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup frozen into a sharp slush, topped with ice-cold lager in frosted glasses for a frozen lemon beer float. Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80ml sugar syrup and 200ml water and freeze in a shallow tray for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every hour into a slush. Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Spoon the lemon slush into the frosted glasses and top each with 250ml ice-cold lager.
T: I feel the need. The need for feed.
D: A hotshot naval aviator competes at the elite fighter weapons school in San Diego.
P: Serve the snacks when Goose sits down at the piano in the bar.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
S: the bar where your phone on the bar means you buy a round
Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, finished with pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream.
the dogfight football game on the beach

Franks charred over coals in toasted buns, smothered in quick beef chilli, melted cheddar, buttery onions and yellow mustard. Brown 300g beef mince with a diced onion, add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 15 minutes. Cook a sliced onion in 20g butter until soft. Grill 8 franks over coals until blistered. Toast 8 buns, add the franks, spoon over chilli, top with 120g grated cheddar and the onions, and finish with mustard.
Hard Deck bacon cheese loaded fries
Penny's bar, push-ups if you're wrong

Crisp fries smothered in melted cheddar and crispy bacon, finished with sour cream, pickled jalapeno and chives. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C until crisp. Fry 4 diced rashers bacon until crisp. Top the fries with 150g grated cheddar and bacon, grill 2 minutes to melt and finish with 150g sour cream, sliced pickled jalapeno and chives.
M: Green prawns butterflied and grilled with garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley butter, a crisp salad of cos and cucumber, and crusty bread to mop up the butter, eaten out on deck.
Maverick's old friend Hondo and the crew before the mission

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, baked low and slow, lacquered with smoky bourbon barbecue glaze and charred, with crunchy pickle slaw. Mix 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp bourbon and 1 tbsp honey for 3 minutes. Brush on and grill hot for 5 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage with chopped pickles, 3 tbsp mayo and a splash of pickle juice.
W: Marshmallows toasted over the fire until molten, squashed with milk chocolate and a smear of salted caramel between crisp sweet biscuits. Toast 16 marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden. Spread 16 plain sweet biscuits with a little thick caramel and a pinch of sea salt. Sandwich each marshmallow with a square of milk chocolate between 2 biscuits and squash together.
K: phone on the bar means you buy a round

Bourbon muddled with lemon wedges, mint and sugar syrup, shaken and poured over crushed ice with a big mint crown. For each drink, muddle half a lemon cut into wedges with 15ml sugar syrup and 6 mint leaves in a shaker. Add 60ml bourbon and ice and shake hard. Pour everything into a tumbler, top with crushed ice and add a big sprig of mint.
T: Don't think. Just eat.
D: Maverick returns to train a group of young pilots for a near-impossible mission.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone heads to the Hard Deck bar.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
S: the bag of seeds the Vuvalini carry
Sunflower, pumpkin, sesame, linseed and chia seeds mixed with oats, water and salt, spread thin, baked at 160C for an hour until crisp, broken into shards.
the War Boys spray chrome before they ride

Popcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked salt and a little chilli, dusted with edible silver lustre so it shines like a War Boy's grin. Pop 150g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Melt 60g butter and cook until nut brown. Toss the popcorn with the brown butter, 1 tsp smoked salt and a pinch of chilli flakes. Spread on a tray, cool for 5 minutes and dust lightly with 1 tsp edible silver lustre, tossing to coat.
Max catches a lizard to eat in the opening, these are chicken
Chicken thigh strips threaded on skewers, rubbed with smoked paprika, cumin and chilli, grilled hot and blackened at the edges, with a garlic yoghurt dip.
M: the Citadel up on the rocks
Lamb shoulder rubbed with harissa, garlic and cumin, roasted at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, with blistered flatbreads, hummus and charred capsicum.
Gas Town smoky beef and black bean stew
the long drive in the war rig

Beef chuck braised dark and thick with smoked paprika, chipotle, tomato and black beans, with charred damper and lime sour cream. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, 400g crushed tomatoes and 500ml beef stock. Return the beef, cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours, then add 2 drained tins black beans and cook 30 minutes more. Mix 400g self-raising flour with 250ml milk and salt, shape and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Mix sour cream with lime.
W: the long ride through the desert
Medjool dates, oats, almonds and honey blitzed, pressed into a tray, topped with melted dark chocolate and sea salt, set and cut into bars.
K: Immortan Joe's warning about getting addicted to water

Cold sparkling water poured over cucumber, lime and mint muddled with a little sugar, in big jugs that flow freely, unlike the Citadel's. In two big jugs muddle a sliced Lebanese cucumber, 3 sliced limes, a handful of mint and 3 tbsp caster sugar until fragrant. Fill with ice and top with 2L cold sparkling water. Stir and pour freely for everyone.
T: Witness me. Then pass the water.
D: Max and Furiosa flee across the desert with a tyrant's escaped wives in a war rig.
P: Serve the drinks when Immortan Joe opens the water for the crowd below.

title: Gladiator
S: Strength and honour bread and olives
a soldier's ration on the German frontier

Rustic loaf torn up, with olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, fennel seeds and garlic, and a bowl of good olive oil with salt. Warm 300g mixed olives gently in 3 tbsp olive oil with strips of orange peel, 1 tsp fennel seeds and 2 sliced garlic cloves for 5 minutes. Tear a rustic loaf into chunks. Serve with the olives and a bowl of olive oil with salt for dipping.
Ripe figs halved, topped with a little goat's cheese, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, drizzled with honey and toasted walnuts.
Maximus running his hand through the wheat

Thin wholemeal crackers baked crisp with olive oil, sea salt and rosemary, with whipped lemon ricotta and a pool of honey and chilli oil. Mix 200g wholemeal flour, 60ml olive oil, 1 tsp salt and 90ml water into a firm dough. Roll very thin, cut into long strips, brush with oil and scatter with rosemary and sea salt.
