Bake at 180C for 12 to 15 minutes until crisp. Beat 250g ricotta with lemon zest and salt. Swirl 1 tbsp honey with 1 tbsp chilli oil over the ricotta.
M: Lamb leg studded with garlic, rosemary and anchovy, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested, carved, with chickpeas braised with tomato and greens.
Proximo's sausage, barley and lentil stew

Thick and smoky stew of pork sausage, pearl barley and lentils with onion, carrot, tomato and rosemary, finished with olive oil and parmesan. Brown 500g thick pork sausages cut into chunks. Soften an onion, 2 carrots and 2 garlic cloves in the same pot. Add 100g pearl barley, 150g brown lentils, 400g crushed tomatoes, 1.2L chicken stock and rosemary. Simmer 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil, grated parmesan and crusty bread.
W: a sweet for the emperor's table
Ricotta, flour and egg cakes baked on bay leaves at 200C for 30 minutes, soaked in warm honey, poppy seeds on top.
K: Are you not entertained honey conditum

Roman-style spiced wine warmed with honey, black pepper, bay, saffron and orange peel, strained into cups and served warm. Pour a 750ml bottle of red wine into a pot with 3 tbsp honey, half a tsp black peppercorns, 2 bay leaves, a pinch of saffron and strips of orange peel. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into cups and serve warm.
T: Are you not entertained. Are you not fed.
D: A betrayed Roman general fights his way through the arena to take revenge on the emperor.
P: Serve the mains when Maximus walks into the Colosseum.

title: Braveheart
S: Highland haggis bon bons, whisky cream

Spiced lamb and oat haggis rolled into balls, crumbed and fried crunchy, with a whisky, wholegrain mustard and cream dipping sauce. Fry 400g lamb mince with a diced onion, then add 80g toasted oats, 1 tsp allspice, 1 tsp pepper, half a tsp nutmeg and 150ml beef stock and cook until thick. Cool and roll into 20 balls. Roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 175C for 3 minutes until crisp. Simmer 150ml cream with 2 tbsp whisky and 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard for 3 minutes for the dip.
food for a march across the Highlands
Oatcakes of oats, butter, salt and hot water rolled thin, baked at 180C for 20 minutes, with sharp Scottish cheddar and apple chutney.
Scottish smoked salmon on brown bread with lemon butter, dill and capers, cut into neat squares.
M: a pot over the fire in the Highlands
Lamb neck simmered 2 hours with pearl barley, split peas, leek, carrot and swede, the meat pulled back in, parsley on top. Crusty bread.
Stirling venison with neeps and tatties

Venison backstrap seared rare and sliced, with buttery mashed swede, creamy mashed potato and a peppery whisky cream sauce. Boil 600g diced swede and 600g potatoes in separate pots until soft. Mash the swede with 30g butter and pepper, and the potatoes with 40g butter and 80ml milk. Season 800g venison backstrap with cracked pepper and sear in a hot pan 3 minutes a side for rare, then rest 8 minutes. Add 40ml whisky to the pan, then 150ml cream and 1 tsp cracked pepper and simmer 2 minutes. Slice and spoon over.
W: a tin of shortbread for the long march
Butter and sugar creamed, plain flour and a little rice flour worked in, pressed into a tin, pricked, baked at 150C for 40 minutes, cut while warm, caster sugar on top.
K: the battle cry, one word long

Scotch whisky stirred with heather honey, fresh lemon and hot water, with a clove-studded lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick. Raise it high. Stud 4 lemon wheels with 3 cloves each. Into each of four heatproof glasses put 40ml Scotch whisky, 1 tbsp honey and 15ml lemon juice. Top with 150ml just-boiled water and stir until the honey dissolves. Add a studded lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick to each.
T: They may take our lives. They'll never take our shortbread.
D: A Scottish commoner leads a rebellion against the English king.
P: Serve the mains when Wallace rallies the army before Stirling.

title: Titanic
S: the first course in the first class dining saloon
Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette and lemon.
King of the world ham sandwiches
Jack at the bow, arms out

Thick slices of leg ham with hot English mustard on buttered crusty bread, with small potatoes boiled in their skins and tossed in butter and salt. Butter thick slices of a crusty loaf and fill with 300g ham and hot English mustard. Boil 600g small potatoes in their skins and toss with butter and salt. Serve together below deck.
a dish from the real first class menu that night

Salmon gently poached in a lemon and herb court bouillon, chilled and flaked onto toasts with a light mousseline of hollandaise folded with whipped cream. Simmer 1L water with a sliced lemon, a bay leaf, peppercorns, dill stalks and a splash of vinegar for 10 minutes. Add a 400g salmon fillet, turn off the heat and leave 12 minutes, then chill and flake. Whisk 2 yolks with 1 tbsp lemon juice over simmering water until thick, then drizzle in 100g warm melted butter. Fold in 80ml softly whipped cream. Toast 16 baguette slices and top with salmon, mousseline and dill.
M: Molly Brown's first class filet mignon
Molly kits Jack out in her son's dinner suit

Eye fillet steaks tied, seared hard in butter, roasted at 200C to 54C and rested, with a red wine and shallot sauce reduced with stock, pommes Anna and buttered green beans. Layer 800g thinly sliced potatoes with 60g melted butter in a pan and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna. Tie 4 eye fillet steaks, sear in butter and roast to 54C. Reduce 2 shallots, 200ml red wine and 250ml stock for sauce. Serve with 300g green beans.
First class lamb rack with mint sauce
a dish straight off the real first class menu that night

Lamb racks seared and roasted pink, carved into cutlets, with fresh sharp mint sauce, buttery minted peas and crisp roast potatoes. Parboil 1kg potatoes and roast in oil at 220C for 50 minutes. Season 2 lamb racks, sear fat side down, roast at 200C to 56C inside, about 15 minutes, and rest 10 minutes. Chop a bunch of mint with 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp boiling water and 4 tbsp malt vinegar. Cook 400g peas with 30g butter and chopped mint. Carve the racks into cutlets.
W: the dessert on the last first class menu
Apples peeled, diced and cooked in butter with sultanas, spooned into a dish, covered in a vanilla custard of eggs, milk and sugar with nutmeg, baked in a water bath at 160C for 40 minutes.
K: Jack wins his ticket in a card game at Southampton

Rich Irish stout poured half and half with cold sparkling wine in tall flutes, steerage on the bottom and first class on top. Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine and four 440ml cans of Irish stout. Half fill four tall flutes or glasses with stout, poured slowly so it settles. Top each slowly with sparkling wine poured over the back of a spoon so it sits on top. Serve straight away.
T: First class dinner. Third class party.
D: A poor artist and an upper-class woman fall in love aboard the doomed ocean liner.
P: Serve the mains when Jack joins Rose's family for dinner in first class.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
S: the bad dates in Cairo, but safe
Medjool dates split and stuffed with goat's cheese and a toasted almond, wrapped in prosciutto, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, drizzled with honey.
Dried chickpeas soaked overnight, blitzed raw with onion, garlic, parsley, coriander and cumin, shaped and fried at 175C until deep brown, with tahini sauce and pickles.
the golden idol swapped for a bag of sand

Golden choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cayenne, baked until hollow and crisp, served warm in a hessian sack with a smoky tomato dip. Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g plain flour and stir over the heat for 1 minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated gruyère and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe 20 small rounds, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with tomato chutney mixed with smoked paprika.
M: Rice and brown lentils cooked separately, layered with macaroni, topped with a spiced tomato sauce, chickpeas and crisp fried onions.
Marion's bar in Nepal, the Raven

Juicy pork and coriander dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed until tender, with a fiery charred tomato and chilli achar. Mix 500g pork mince with 2 tsp grated ginger, 2 garlic cloves, 3 spring onions, a handful of chopped coriander, 1 tbsp soy and salt. Fill 30 round dumpling wrappers, gather and pleat closed. Steam on oiled baking paper for 10 minutes. Char 3 tomatoes and 2 red chillies in a dry pan, then blitz with a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, lemon juice and salt for the achar.
W: Semolina, coconut and yoghurt cake baked at 180C for 30 minutes, soaked in lemon and rose syrup, an almond on each square.
K: Marion's drinking contest at the Raven, the warm version

Black tea simmered with ginger, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves in milk, sweetened with brown sugar and poured steaming into mugs. Simmer 500ml water with a sliced 4cm piece of ginger, 6 crushed cardamom pods, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves for 5 minutes. Add 4 black tea bags and 500ml milk and simmer 3 minutes more. Stir in 3 tbsp brown sugar, strain into four mugs and serve hot.
T: Bad dates. Good food.
D: An archaeologist races the Nazis across the world to find the lost Ark of the Covenant.
P: Serve the dates when Indy nearly eats the poisoned one in Cairo.

title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
S: Club Obi Wan prawn har gow
the Shanghai nightclub where it all kicks off

Translucent pleated prawn dumplings with bamboo shoot and ginger, steamed until glassy, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip. Chop 400g peeled green prawns roughly with 50g bamboo shoots, grated ginger, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornflour and salt. Fill 24 round gow gee wrappers, fold and pleat closed. Steam on baking paper over boiling water for 6 minutes until the wrappers turn glassy. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp black vinegar and 1 tsp chilli oil for dipping.
the banquet's snake dish, made with sausages
Long thin sausages coiled on a platter and glazed with mango chutney and chilli, a jug of spiced yoghurt alongside. Surprise.
the kid who keeps Indy alive
Potato and pea filling with cumin, chilli and garam masala, folded into pastry cones, fried at 175C until blistered. Tamarind chutney.
M: the village whose sacred stone was taken

Chickpeas in tomato onion masala, yellow dal tempered with mustard seed and cumin, turmeric roasted cauliflower, basmati, warm flatbread and mango pickle. Simmer 200g yellow split peas with turmeric in 1L water for 40 minutes, then pour over 1 tsp mustard seeds and 1 tsp cumin sizzled in 2 tbsp ghee. Soften an onion with garlic, ginger and 2 tsp garam masala, add 400g tomatoes and 2 tins chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes. Roast a cauliflower in florets with turmeric and oil at 220C for 25 minutes. Cook 300g basmati. Warm 4 flatbreads and serve with mango pickle.

Lamb shoulder marinated overnight in yoghurt, ginger, garlic and garam masala, onions cooked down slowly until deep brown, tomato added, the lamb braised covered at 160C for 2.5 hours until tender. Basmati rice.
W: the chilled monkey brains, made with mango
Mango purée sweetened, gelatine bloomed and stirred through, whipped cream folded in, set in small dome moulds for 4 hours and turned out onto plates with a little passionfruit.
K: Ripe mango blended with yoghurt, cold milk, honey, cardamom and a pinch of saffron until frothy, topped with crushed pistachios. Soak a pinch of saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk for 10 minutes. Blend 2 ripe mangoes with 400g natural yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 2 tbsp honey, a pinch of ground cardamom and the saffron milk until smooth and frothy. Pour over ice into four glasses and top with crushed pistachios.
T: Snake surprise not included.
D: Indy, a singer and a kid end up in India trying to recover sacred stones stolen from a village.
P: Serve the banquet when the Pankot Palace dinner is brought out.

title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
S: the library in Venice with the X on the floor
Toasts topped with whipped salt cod and parsley, prosciutto and fig, and marinated sardines with onion and raisins, Venetian bar style.
Circus train peanut caramel popcorn balls
young Indy running through the circus train

Popcorn and salted roasted peanuts bound in a golden syrup caramel, pressed into fist-sized balls and wrapped in paper like a circus stall treat. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl with 150g roasted salted peanuts. Boil 200g caster sugar, 80g golden syrup, 60g butter and 3 tbsp water to 125C, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss with an oiled spoon. Shape into 12 balls with buttered hands, cool for 20 minutes and wrap each in baking paper.
the castle where Indy finds his dad
Pretzel dough proved, shaped, dipped in hot bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with obatzda of camembert, butter and paprika.
M: Hatay lamb kebabs with garlic yoghurt
the desert road to the canyon

Lamb mince with onion, garlic, sumac, chilli and parsley pressed onto skewers and grilled hot, with warm flatbread, charred tomatoes and garlic yoghurt. Grate 1 onion and squeeze out the juice. Knead 800g lamb mince with the onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp sumac, 1 tsp chilli flakes, a handful of chopped parsley and 1.5 tsp salt for 2 minutes. Press around 8 flat skewers and chill for 30 minutes. Grill on a very hot barbecue for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, with 4 halved tomatoes. Stir 1 grated garlic clove and a pinch of salt into 250g Greek yoghurt. Serve on warm flatbread with the tomatoes and yoghurt.
Veal or pork schnitzel pounded thin, crumbed, fried in butter until golden and puffy, with lemon, warm potato salad and cucumber salad.
W: the canyon city carved into rock
Almond and pistachio cake baked at 170C for 40 minutes, soaked with rosewater and lemon syrup, crushed pistachios and rose petals on top.
K: he chose wisely: the plain cup of a carpenter

Red wine, pomegranate juice, orange and cinnamon steeped together and served cold in plain clay cups with pomegranate seeds, plus one gold goblet nobody touches. Warm 200ml pomegranate juice with 60g caster sugar, 1 cinnamon stick and 3 cloves until the sugar dissolves, then cool. Pour into a jug with a 750ml bottle of tempranillo or shiraz, another 200ml pomegranate juice, 1 sliced orange and 60ml brandy. Chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice into plain clay or wooden cups and scatter pomegranate seeds on top. Use red grape juice in place of the wine and brandy for anyone not drinking.
T: Choose wisely. Choose dessert.
D: Indy and his father race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.
P: Serve the drinks when Indy has to choose the right cup.

title: The Exorcist
S: Crab meat bound with a little mayo, egg, mustard and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon.
Father Merrin at the dig in northern Iraq
Eggplant charred whole over a flame until collapsed, scooped and mashed with tahini, garlic and lemon, served with hummus, pickled turnips and warm flatbread, sumac dusted over the top.
Chris MacNeil's dinner party at the Georgetown house

Cooked king prawns on shredded iceberg in little glasses with a Marie Rose sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce, dusted with paprika. Peel and devein 500g cooked king prawns, leaving the tails on 8 for the rims. Mix 150g whole egg mayonnaise, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, the juice of half a lemon, a few drops of hot sauce and a pinch of paprika. Finely shred half an iceberg lettuce and divide between 8 small glasses. Toss the peeled prawns with half the sauce, pile onto the lettuce and spoon over the rest. Dust with paprika and hang a tail prawn and a lemon wedge on each rim.
M: the famous green, served in a bowl only
Split peas simmered 2 hours with a smoked ham hock, onion, carrot and celery, the ham picked back in, served with crusty bread. Eat it, don't throw it.
Georgetown lemon and garlic roast chicken
Chris and Regan at home in Georgetown before it all starts

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme butter under the skin, with crisp roast potatoes, buttered green beans and a proper pan gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Mash 60g soft butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves, thyme leaves and the zest of a lemon and push it under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Put the lemon halves inside. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and salt around the bird. Roast 20 minutes, drop to 190C and roast 50 minutes more until the thigh juices run clear. Rest 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the tray juices, add 250ml chicken stock and simmer for gravy. Boil 300g green beans for 3 minutes and butter them.
W: Cocoa whisked into hot coffee, beaten into butter, sugar and eggs with buttermilk and flour, baked at 175C for 30 minutes in two tins, sandwiched and covered in a dark chocolate fudge frosting.
K: Holy water gin and elderflower fizz
Karras tests her with a flask of plain tap water

Gin, elderflower cordial and lemon shaken cold, poured clear over ice and topped with soda, a mint sprig and a thin lemon wheel in each glass. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add 240ml gin, 80ml elderflower cordial and 60ml lemon juice. Shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tall glasses over fresh ice and top each with 100ml chilled soda water. Add a mint sprig and a thin lemon wheel. For the non-drinkers, swap the gin for chilled cucumber juice.
T: The power of soup compels you.
D: A mother seeks help from two priests when her daughter is possessed.
P: Serve the soup when the priests climb the stairs to Regan's room.

title: The Sixth Sense
S: Slow-roasted pork shoulder sliced thin with garlicky broccoli rabe and sharp provolone on small soft rolls.
the little red tent in Cole's room
Strawberries dipped in tempered dark chocolate, then half rolled in crushed freeze-dried raspberries so they're bright red.
the birthday party that goes wrong for Cole

Cocktail frankfurts rolled in buttery puff pastry with a sesame top, baked golden and served hot with honey mustard and tomato relish for dipping. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 24 strips. Wrap each strip around a cocktail frankfurt and sit seam side down on a lined tray. Brush with beaten egg and scatter with sesame seeds. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon mustard with 2 tbsp honey and serve alongside a bowl of tomato relish.
M: Malcolm late to his own anniversary dinner

Salmon roasted skin side down until just pink, with a shallot and white wine beurre blanc, crushed baby potatoes and bright green asparagus. Heat the oven to 220C. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt. Season 4 salmon fillets and roast skin side down on an oiled tray for 8 minutes. Meanwhile simmer 1 finely diced shallot in 100ml white wine and 2 tbsp white wine vinegar until about 2 tbsp is left, then whisk in 150g cold diced butter a piece at a time over low heat. Blanch 2 bunches of asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the fish.
Lynn turns her back for a second and every cupboard is open

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with crisp streaky bacon, a pat of salted butter, fresh blueberries and plenty of warm maple syrup. Whisk 300g plain flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Whisk in 500ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 50g melted butter until just combined and rest for 10 minutes. Fry 12 rashers of streaky bacon until crisp and keep warm. Brush a clean pan with butter and cook 80ml ladles of batter over medium heat for 2 minutes until bubbles show, then flip for 1 minute. Stack with the bacon, butter, blueberries and warm maple syrup.
W: the room goes cold when they're close
White chocolate melted into warm cream, cooled to room temperature, folded through whipped cream and a whisked egg white, set in glasses for 4 hours, a few raspberries on top.
K: Philly winter hot spiced apple cider

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange, served steaming in mugs with a cinnamon stick and an optional nip of dark rum. Pour 1.5 litres cloudy apple juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 star anise, 1 sliced orange and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Bring to a simmer, then keep it just below simmering for 20 minutes. Strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each. Stir 30ml dark rum into the adults' mugs if you like.
T: I see dinner.
D: A child psychologist tries to help a frightened boy who says he can see ghosts.
P: Serve the mains when Malcolm sits down at the anniversary dinner.

title: Signs
S: the cornfield with the circles cut into it
Corn cobs grilled over high heat until charred in rings, cut into thick wheels, brushed with butter melted with lime zest and chilli, finished with flaky salt and coriander.
Morgan and Bo in their tin foil hats
Popcorn popped in a covered pot, tossed in browned butter, parmesan and a little garlic salt, served in bowls lined with crumpled foil.
Merrill's old minor league bat hanging on the wall

Grilled frankfurts in toasted soft rolls loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, diced white onion and a line of yellow mustard, ballpark style. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml beef stock and simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes until blistered. Toast 8 hot dog rolls. Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, then top with grated cheddar, finely diced white onion and a line of American mustard.
M: everyone picks their favourite for what might be the last meal

Crumbed chicken breast fried golden, topped with napoli, leg ham and bubbling mozzarella, finished under the grill, with chips and a sharp green salad. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan. Shallow fry in 1cm of oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Heat the oven grill. Top each with 3 tbsp napoli sauce, a slice of leg ham and 50g grated mozzarella, then grill for 4 minutes until bubbling. Bake 800g frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes and toss a green salad in lemon and oil.
Sunday dinner on the Hess farm
Beef chuck seared hard, onion, carrot and celery, stock and thyme, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes added for the last hour, gravy from the pan.
W: Split buttermilk biscuits piled with sugared strawberries and soft whipped cream. Rub 100g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, add 200ml buttermilk and pat 2cm thick.
K: Bo leaves half-drunk glasses of water all over the house

Cucumber, mint, lime and elderflower blended and strained, topped with cold sparkling water over ice and cucumber ribbons, poured into mismatched glasses. Blend 1 continental cucumber with a cup of mint leaves, the juice of 3 limes and 80ml elderflower cordial, then strain through a sieve into a jug. Chill for an hour. Fill mismatched glasses with ice and a few thin cucumber ribbons, pour in the base to a third full and top with 1 litre chilled sparkling water. Finish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.
T: Swing away. Then eat.
D: A farmer and his family find crop circles in their cornfield and brace for what's coming.
P: Serve the mains when the family sits down to their last supper of favourites.

title: The Ring
S: cabin 12 at the mountain lodge where the tape was found
Smoked trout, crackers, sharp cheddar, apple slices and pickled onions on a wooden board, the way a lodge would set it out.

Thick New England clam chowder of fresh clams, smoky bacon, potato and cream, served in small cups with crackers and snipped chives. Steam 1kg vongole in 200ml water in a covered pot for 4 minutes until open, then pick out the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 150g diced bacon, add 1 diced onion and 2 diced celery sticks and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then the clam liquid, 300ml milk and 400g diced potato. Simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender, add 200ml cream and the clams and warm through. Season with pepper and serve with crackers and chives.
Cucumbers sliced thin, packed with dill, garlic and peppercorns in a hot vinegar brine, left in the fridge for seven days before eating.
M: the ferry to the island with the horse farm
Salmon fillets brushed with miso, honey and soy, roasted at 220C for 8 minutes, with wild rice and charred broccolini.
Moesko Island beef and dark ale stew
the Morgans' horse farm on Moesko Island

Chuck steak braised low with dark ale, pearl barley, carrot and onion until spoon-soft, with crusty bread and a sharp horseradish cream. Toss 1.2kg diced chuck steak in 2 tbsp seasoned flour and brown in batches in oil. Add 2 sliced onions and 3 chunky carrots and cook for 5 minutes. Pour in 375ml dark ale and 500ml beef stock, add 80g pearl barley, 2 bay leaves and thyme, cover and cook at 160C for 2.5 hours until tender. Stir 2 tbsp grated horseradish into 150ml sour cream with a pinch of salt. Serve the stew with crusty bread and the horseradish cream.
W: the well at the bottom of everything
Dark chocolate custard of cream, milk, yolks and sugar, poured into deep cups, baked in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes, chilled, a ring of whipped cream on top.
K: cabin 12 at the Shelter Mountain Inn
Whisky, honey, lemon and hot water with a cinnamon stick, for a wet Seattle night.
T: Seven days. Seven snacks.
D: A journalist investigates a cursed videotape that kills whoever watches it seven days later.
P: Serve the snacks when Rachel puts the tape in the player at the mountain cabin.

title: The Others
S: the housekeeper who knows more than she lets on

Dough of flour, butter, sugar and eggs rested an hour, rolled, cut into strips, slit and twisted, fried at 175C until golden, dusted with sugar. Rub 50g butter into 250g flour, add 50g sugar and 2 eggs and knead. Rest an hour, roll out, cut strips, slit and twist through. Fry at 175C until golden and dust with sugar and nutmeg.
Mrs Mills's egg and cress tea sandwiches

Crustless white sandwiches of creamy curried egg and cress, plus cucumber with salted butter and white pepper, cut into fingers and stacked on the tray. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and mash with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, half a teaspoon of curry powder, salt and pepper. Butter 12 slices of soft white bread. Spread the egg on 4 slices, scatter a punnet of cress and top with 4 more. Slice 1 continental cucumber paper thin, salt lightly and pat dry, then layer on the last 4 slices with white pepper and close. Cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.
Crab meat folded with mayo, lemon, chives and a pinch of cayenne, piled on buttered toast.
M: Mr Tuttle's garden potatoes and fish
the gardener raking leaves over something

Small new potatoes boiled with mint and tossed in salted butter, with pan-fried white fish, capers and brown butter. Boil 800g new potatoes with mint and toss in salted butter. Pan-fry 4 white fish fillets until golden. Brown 60g butter, add 1 tbsp capers and lemon juice, and spoon over the fish.

Lamb mince slow-cooked with onion, carrot, peas, rosemary and a good splash of Worcestershire, under a crisp buttery mash crust baked golden. Brown 800g lamb mince in a hot pan, then add 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp plain flour, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, chopped rosemary and 400ml beef stock and simmer for 30 minutes until thick, adding 150g frozen peas at the end. Boil 1.2kg peeled potatoes, mash with 80g butter and 100ml hot milk. Spread the lamb in a baking dish, top with mash, rough it up with a fork and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: lock one door before you open the next

Short grain rice baked slowly at 150C for 2 hours in full cream milk, cream, sugar and a vanilla bean, nutmeg grated on top, served by candlelight. Put 100g short grain rice, 800ml milk, 200ml cream, 70g sugar and a split vanilla bean in a dish. Bake at 150C for 2 hours, stirring twice. Grate nutmeg on top. Serve warm, curtains drawn.
K: Island apple cider toddy from the teapot
always a pot on the tray, though this one isn't tea

Jersey-style dry apple cider warmed with honey, lemon, cinnamon and cloves, a splash of brandy stirred in, poured into teacups from a warmed pot. Pour 1.2 litres dry apple cider into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, the peeled zest of a lemon, 1 cinnamon stick and 4 cloves. Warm gently for 10 minutes without boiling. Take off the heat, stir in 120ml brandy and the juice of half a lemon. Warm a teapot with hot water, tip it out, strain the cider into the pot and pour into teacups at the table.
T: Keep the curtains drawn. Keep the kettle on.
D: A mother and her two light-sensitive children live in a dark house on Jersey after the war.
P: Serve the tea when Mrs Mills brings in the tray.

title: Saw
S: Choose your fate chip and dip
every choice comes with a catch
Three dips, mild to very hot: sour cream and chive, roasted capsicum with smoked paprika, and a habanero salsa. Corn chips to dip and decide.

Crisp homemade cheddar and jalapeño crackers cut into jigsaw pieces, baked golden and served with a smoky red capsicum and walnut dip. Pulse 150g plain flour, 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 1 chopped pickled jalapeño and a pinch of salt until crumbly, then add 2 tbsp cold water to bring it together. Roll 3mm thick between baking paper, cut into jigsaw shapes and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden. Blend 200g roasted capsicum, 60g toasted walnuts, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp pomegranate molasses and 2 tbsp olive oil for the dip.
Detective Tapp watching from the apartment across the street

Soft yeasted ring doughnuts fried golden and dipped in a strong espresso glaze, half rolled in cinnamon sugar instead, for a long night on watch. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g caster sugar and a pinch of salt, then add 250ml warm milk, 2 eggs and 50g soft butter and knead 8 minutes. Prove 1 hour. Roll 1.5cm thick, cut 12 rings and prove 30 minutes. Fry at 175C for 1 minute a side and drain. Whisk 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp hot espresso for the glaze. Dip half the doughnuts and toss the rest in cinnamon sugar while warm.
M: Detective Tapp's beef chilli con carne
the detectives who won't let it go

Chuck steak and kidney beans slow-cooked with chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, topped with sour cream, cheddar and pickled jalapeños, with corn chips. Brown 1kg diced chuck steak in batches. Add 2 diced onions and 3 garlic cloves and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, then 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock. Cover and simmer for 2.5 hours until the beef falls apart. Add 1 drained tin kidney beans for the last 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar, pickled jalapeños and corn chips.
the family dinner he's desperate to get back to
Roast chicken with lemon and thyme at 220C then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes, green beans and pan gravy.
W: the red spiral on the puppet's cheeks
Red velvet cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cream cheese frosting piped in a spiral, a dot of red on top.
K: live or die, make your choice: sweet or sour
Two jugs: sweet lemonade with mint, and a sharp lime soda with no sugar at all.
T: Let's play a game. Pick a snack.
D: Two men wake up chained in a filthy bathroom, part of a killer's twisted game.
P: Serve the snacks when the first tape starts playing.

title: The Conjuring
S: the farmhouse is in Rhode Island
Chopped clams folded into a batter of flour, baking powder, egg and clam juice, spooned into 180C oil, fried until puffed and golden. Lemon and tartare.

Fine cornmeal scalded with boiling water and salt, loosened with milk, cooked in butter on a griddle until crisp at the edges, with butter and maple. Pour 300ml boiling water over 200g fine cornmeal and a pinch of salt and stir. Loosen with 100ml milk. Cook spoonfuls in butter on a griddle until crisp at the edges. Serve with butter and maple syrup.
Music box raspberry jam drop shortbread
the little music box that plays by itself

Buttery vanilla shortbread rounds with a thumbprint of raspberry jam baked in the middle, dusted with icing sugar and kept in a tin. Beat 200g soft butter with 100g caster sugar and 1 tsp vanilla until pale. Mix in 250g plain flour and 50g cornflour to a soft dough. Roll into 20 balls, flatten slightly on lined trays and press a hollow in each with your thumb. Fill each with half a teaspoon of raspberry jam. Bake at 170C for 15 to 18 minutes until pale golden at the edges, cool on the tray and dust with icing sugar.
M: dinner for a family of seven in 1971

Beef chuck seared dark and braised for hours with onion, carrot, celery and red wine, carved thick with potatoes, the braising gravy spooned over. Heat the oven to 160C. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and sear hard on all sides in a heavy pot. Add 2 onions in wedges, 4 carrots and 2 celery sticks in chunks and 2 garlic cloves. Pour in 250ml red wine and 500ml beef stock, add thyme and 2 bay leaves, cover and braise for 3 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes for the last hour. Lift out the meat and veg, reduce the liquid by a third and season for gravy.
the Warrens on the road investigating
Cod baked at 200C for 15 minutes under buttery cracker crumbs with lemon and parsley, buttered peas and boiled potatoes.
W: the Perrons' new place in Harrisville, 1971

Apples sliced and tossed with cinnamon, sugar and lemon, covered with a crumble of oats, flour, brown sugar and cold butter rubbed together, baked at 180C for 40 minutes until bubbling. Toss 6 sliced apples with 1 tsp cinnamon, 60g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 80g flour, 80g oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with pouring cream.
K: Homemade coffee syrup blended thick with cold milk and vanilla ice cream, the way Rhode Islanders do a shake, with whipped cream and grated chocolate. Simmer 250ml strong brewed coffee with 150g caster sugar for 10 minutes until syrupy, then cool completely. Blend 120ml of the syrup with 500ml cold full cream milk and 8 big scoops of vanilla ice cream until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses, top with whipped cream and grate a little dark chocolate over each.
T: Hide and clap. Then come to dinner.
D: Paranormal investigators help a family terrorised by a dark presence in their Rhode Island farmhouse.
P: Serve the mains when the Warrens arrive at the Perron farmhouse.

title: Insidious
S: Specs and Tucker's homemade ghost-hunting kit
Corn chips, pretzels and cheese crackers tossed in butter, smoked paprika and garlic powder, baked at 150C for 20 minutes, tipped into paper bags labelled like evidence.
Elise in her gas mask at the séance in Dalton's room

Creamy devilled eggs whipped with mayo, Dijon and a little pickle juice, piped high and topped with smoked paprika, crisp bacon crumbs and chives. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp pickle juice, salt and pepper until smooth. Fry 3 rashers of bacon until very crisp and crumble. Pipe the yolk mix into the whites, dust with smoked paprika and top with the bacon and snipped chives.
the dark place Josh has to walk into
A smoky baba ganoush: eggplant charred whole over a flame until collapsed, blended with tahini, garlic, lemon and smoked paprika, with flatbread.
M: a family dinner in the new house
Beef and pork ragù simmered 2 hours with tomato and red wine, layered with fresh pasta, béchamel and mozzarella, baked at 180C for 45 minutes, rested 20.
Elise's chicken noodle soup with dill
the psychic who comes to help

Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and onion into a golden broth, with egg noodles, fresh dill, lemon and cracked pepper, crusty bread alongside. Put 800g chicken thighs on the bone in a pot with 2 litres water, 1 halved onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 2 bay leaves and 2 tsp salt. Simmer gently for 1 hour, skimming. Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and strain the broth. Dice another carrot and celery stick, simmer in the broth for 8 minutes, then add 200g egg noodles for 5 minutes. Return the chicken, add a handful of chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with crusty bread.
W: the red-faced figure in the corner
Sour cherries with sugar and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled and served with vanilla ice cream.
K: something dark in the other room
Muddled blackberries and lemon topped with soda, dark purple and fizzing over ice. Muddle 250g blackberries with 4 tbsp sugar and the juice of 2 lemons, then strain into a jug.
T: It's not the house. It's the snacks.
D: A family discover their comatose son's mind has wandered somewhere it shouldn't.
P: Serve the snacks when the ghost hunters set up their gadgets.

title: Us
S: the boardwalk where it began in 1986
Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes. Mustard.
the California coast near Santa Cruz

Artichoke hearts dipped in a light sparkling water batter and fried crisp, salted and served hot with a lemon and garlic aioli for dunking. Drain 2 jars (about 560g) marinated artichoke hearts, halve and pat very dry. Whisk 100g plain flour, 30g cornflour, a pinch of salt and 180ml ice-cold sparkling water into a light batter. Heat oil to 180C. Dip the artichokes and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp, then drain and salt. Stir 1 grated garlic clove, the zest of a lemon and 1 tbsp juice into 150g whole egg mayonnaise for the aioli.
Two identical stacks per person on each side of the plate: cracker, sharp cheddar, thin apple slice and a dot of fig jam, mirrored exactly.
M: the friends' fancy holiday house down the road
Chicken thighs and corn cobs grilled over coals, the chicken brushed with a smoky barbecue glaze in the last minutes, with a creamy coleslaw and soft rolls.
Santa Cruz wharf chowder bread bowls
the Santa Cruz beach boardwalk where it began

Creamy clam and potato chowder with smoky bacon and thyme, ladled into hollowed sourdough cobs with the lids toasted on the side for dipping. Steam 1.5kg vongole in 250ml water for 4 minutes, pick the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 200g diced bacon, add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then the clam liquid, 400ml milk, 500g diced potato and thyme. Simmer 15 minutes, add 250ml cream and the clams and warm through. Cut the tops off 4 small sourdough cobs, hollow them out, toast the lids and bowls at 200C for 8 minutes, and fill with chowder.
W: the white rabbits in the tunnels, left well alone
Grated carrot, toasted walnuts, oil, brown sugar, eggs, cinnamon and nutmeg mixed with self-raising flour, baked at 170C for 50 minutes, covered in cream cheese frosting with lemon zest.
K: the long line of hands across the country in 1986
Pineapple and orange juice with a splash of grenadine, topped with lemonade and ice in a big bowl, orange slices floating on top.
T: There's a family in the driveway. Feed yours first.
D: A family's beach holiday is shattered when their doppelgängers turn up.
P: Serve the snacks when the family hits the Santa Cruz boardwalk.

title: Nope
S: Jupe's big show at Jupiter's Claim

Popcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked paprika and a pinch of chipotle, served in striped paper bags like a park stand. Pop 120g kernels. Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty, then stir in 1 tsp smoked paprika, a pinch of chipotle powder and fine salt. Toss through the popcorn and fill striped paper bags.
the Haywood horse ranch in the valley

Thin strips of topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, black pepper and smoked paprika, dried low in the oven until chewy and smoky. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice across the grain into 4mm strips. Mix 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Toss the beef through and marinate overnight. Pat dry and lay on racks over trays. Dry at 75C with the oven door propped open a crack for 3 to 4 hours until leathery but still bendy.
Jupiter's Claim, the western theme park out in the desert
Pinto beans simmered with bacon, onion, chilli and molasses in a cast-iron pot until thick and smoky.
M: Haywood Hollywood Horses, out in Agua Dulce

Tri-tip or rump cap rubbed with salt, pepper and garlic, grilled over coals, rested and sliced, with pinto beans and fresh salsa. Rub a 1.2kg rump cap with salt, pepper and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Grill over coals, fat side first, until 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Warm 2 tins pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion, coriander and lime for salsa. Slice and serve.
waiting all night with the cameras pointed up

Lime and garlic marinated skirt steak grilled hot and wrapped in big flour tortillas with rice, pinto beans, cheese, pico de gallo and chipotle sour cream. Marinate 800g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. Cook 200g rice. Warm 1 drained tin pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and coriander with lime for pico de gallo. Grill the steak on a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thin. Fill 4 large warm tortillas with rice, beans, steak, grated cheese, pico and sour cream mixed with 1 chopped chipotle, then roll tight.
W: OJ names it after a horse he never got

Two soft chocolate cookies sandwiching a dome of marshmallow filling, rolled at the edges in silver sprinkles. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100g butter, beat in 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then 180g flour. Bake 16 small rounds at 175C for 9 minutes. Sandwich pairs with a marshmallow each, warm 1 minute to melt, then roll the edges in silver sprinkles.
K: Blended watermelon and lime, strained and served over ice, sweet and very cold. Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar.
T: Don't look up. Look at the snacks.
D: Two siblings on a horse ranch try to film the thing hiding in the clouds above their valley.
P: Serve the snacks when the crowd sits down at the western theme park show.

title: Midsommar
S: Pelle's pickled herring and new potatoes
Pelle's invite home to the commune

Small new potatoes boiled with dill, served warm with pickled herring, sour cream, chives and red onion. Boil 600g new potatoes with dill until tender. Serve warm with 250g pickled herring, a bowl of sour cream with chives and thinly sliced red onion.

Radishes, cucumber, baby carrots and edible flowers arranged in a ring like a crown, with a herby dill and sour cream dip. Arrange radishes, cucumber batons and baby carrots in a ring on a platter, tucking edible flowers between them like a crown. Mix 200g sour cream with dill and salt for the dip in the middle.
Midsummer aged cheese tart with dill cream
the long tables in the sun

A crisp shortcrust tart of aged cheddar and parmesan custard baked until just set, served in wedges with dill sour cream and salmon roe. Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23cm tart tin with a sheet of shortcrust pastry, prick, line with paper and weights and blind bake for 15 minutes, then 5 minutes without. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml cream and plenty of pepper, then stir in 150g grated aged cheddar and 50g parmesan. Pour into the shell and bake at 170C for 25 minutes until just set. Mix 150ml sour cream with chopped dill. Serve wedges warm with the dill cream and a spoon of salmon roe.
M: a festival held once every 90 years

Salmon cured 48 hours in salt, sugar, dill and white pepper, sliced thin, with a sweet mustard and dill sauce and rye bread. Cover a 600g salmon fillet with 50g salt, 50g sugar, chopped dill and white pepper. Weight and cure in the fridge for 48 hours. Slice thin. Mix 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp sugar, vinegar and oil with dill for sauce. Serve with rye bread.
Hårga open-fire lamb with dill potatoes

Butterflied lamb leg marinated in garlic, rosemary and lemon, grilled over coals and sliced pink, with buttery dill new potatoes and a mustard herb sauce. Marinate a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg in 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, the zest and juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt for 2 hours. Grill over medium-hot coals for 10 to 12 minutes a side until 58C inside, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg new potatoes until tender and toss with 50g butter and chopped dill. Whisk 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 80ml oil and chopped parsley for the sauce. Slice the lamb and serve.
W: Eggs and sugar whisked pale and thick, flour folded in, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, split into three, each layer brushed with milk, filled with vanilla custard, whipped cream and sliced strawberries, whole berries on top.
K: a pale drink at the long table, nothing yellow in this one

Gin, elderflower cordial, lemon and crushed strawberries topped with sparkling water, served pale pink over ice with edible flowers floating on top. Crush 250g hulled strawberries with 2 tbsp caster sugar in a jug and leave 15 minutes. Add 200ml gin, 100ml elderflower cordial and the juice of 2 lemons and stir. Fill the jug with ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling water. Pour into glasses with a few edible flowers on top. Leave out the gin for a booze-free jug.
T: Eat at the long table. Wear the flowers.
D: A grieving young woman travels to a remote Swedish commune for a midsummer festival that turns sinister.
P: Serve the feast when everyone sits at the long table under the sun.

title: IT
S: Georgie's paper boat in the rain

Corn chips piled into paper boats with spiced beef mince, melted cheddar, black beans, pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream, eaten with your fingers. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste, add 100ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Layer 300g corn chips on a tray with the beef, 1 drained tin black beans and 200g grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Dice 2 tomatoes with red onion and coriander. Scoop into paper boats and top with guacamole, pico and sour cream.
the summer swim at the quarry

Long soft rolls stacked with salami, ham, provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato and pickled peppers, dressed with oregano vinaigrette and wrapped tight for the bike ride. Whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper. Split 4 long soft rolls and drizzle the insides with half the dressing. Layer each with 3 slices provolone, 4 slices salami and 3 slices leg ham. Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, red onion and pickled peppers, drizzle with the rest of the dressing and close. Wrap each tightly in baking paper and halve.
Cherry tomatoes on the vine roasted at 200C for 10 minutes with olive oil and thyme, served on whipped ricotta with toasted bread.
M: Two thin smashed beef patties with melted cheese, pickles, onion and a tangy burger sauce in a toasted soft bun, with crinkle-cut chips. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce. Bake 800g frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, smash the balls thin, salt and cook 2 minutes, flip, top with cheese slices and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns, spread with sauce, and stack two patties with pickles and finely diced onion.
a summer in a small Maine town
Cooked lobster or prawn meat chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.
W: Vanilla cake crumbled into cream cheese frosting, rolled into balls, chilled, dipped in red candy melts on sticks, tied with a bit of string.
K: Fresh lemon juice and strawberry syrup topped with icy soda water, served in a big jug with sliced strawberries, lemon wheels and mint. Simmer 250g hulled strawberries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 5 minutes, crush and strain to a syrup, then cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug, add the syrup and stir. Add plenty of ice, sliced strawberries and lemon wheels, then top with 1 litre chilled soda water and a few mint leaves.
T: You'll float too. After dessert.
D: A group of misfit kids in a small Maine town face a shape-shifting clown that preys on children.
P: Serve the snacks when the Losers jump into the quarry.

title: Carrie
S: the senior prom at the high school
Devilled eggs with paprika, leg ham and pineapple chunks on toothpicks, and cucumber rounds piped with cream cheese and chives, on silver trays like a 1970s prom.
Gym class pretzel bites with cheese dip
the girls' gym class at the start

Chewy pretzel bites dipped in hot bicarb water, salted and baked deep brown, with a warm cheddar and mustard cheese dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water and knead 8 minutes, then prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Simmer 2 litres water with 60g bicarb, drop the bites in for 20 seconds, drain, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick, then melt in 150g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard.
the corsage Tommy brings to the door

Radishes cut into roses, cucumber and carrot batons bunched like a corsage, with a ranch dip of buttermilk, sour cream, garlic, dill and chives. Cut radishes into roses and bunch cucumber and carrot batons like a corsage. Mix 100ml buttermilk, 150g sour cream, a crushed garlic clove, dill and chives for ranch.
M: Chicken breasts browned in butter, finished in a 200C oven, served with a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, mashed potato and buttered green beans.
Carrie's strict mother and her bare kitchen table

Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and thyme in a creamy broth, topped with fluffy parsley dumplings steamed right on top in the pot. Brown 1kg chicken thighs in a large pot, then add 1 diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 1 litre chicken stock and thyme. Simmer covered for 30 minutes and stir in 100ml cream. Mix 200g self-raising flour, 50g grated cold butter, chopped parsley and a pinch of salt with about 120ml milk to a soft dough. Drop 8 spoonfuls on top, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until puffed.
W: Bates High prom queen strawberry cake
Carrie and Tommy crowned on stage

Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C, layered with sliced strawberries and whipped cream, covered in pale pink strawberry buttercream, a little sugar crown on top. Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill with 250g sliced strawberries and 200ml whipped cream. Cover in pink buttercream of 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and mashed strawberry.
K: served from a bowl, nothing hanging above the stage

Pineapple juice and lemonade with sliced strawberries and orange in a big glass bowl, a ring of frozen juice floating instead of ice so it doesn't water down. Freeze 500ml pineapple juice in a ring tin overnight. Put it in a big glass bowl and pour over 1.25L lemonade and 250ml more pineapple juice. Add sliced strawberries and orange.
T: Prom night. Pass the punch.
D: A shy, bullied teenager with telekinetic powers is asked to the senior prom.
P: Serve the punch when Carrie and Tommy are crowned at the prom.

title: The Birds
S: the seaside town north of San Francisco
Crab meat folded with a little mayo, lemon, chives and a pinch of cayenne, piled on toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic.
the children's birthday party on the hill

Poached chicken folded with mayo, celery, toasted walnuts, grapes and tarragon, in soft white bread cut into party triangles. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred finely. Mix with 5 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 finely diced celery sticks, 40g chopped toasted walnuts, a handful of halved green grapes, 1 tbsp chopped tarragon, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper. Butter 12 slices of soft white bread and fill 6 sandwiches. Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 triangles.
the pair of lovebirds Melanie brings in a cage
Little pastry nests of filo baked at 180C until crisp, filled with whipped goat's cheese, a few peas and a mint leaf, two to a plate.
M: the city Melanie drives out from
Onion, fennel and garlic cooked in olive oil, tomato, white wine and fish stock simmered 20 minutes, mussels, clams, prawns and white fish added in turns. Sourdough.
Lydia's roast chicken with sage stuffing

Golden roast chicken filled with a sage, onion and bread stuffing, with roast potatoes, glazed carrots and a pan gravy made from the drippings. Heat the oven to 200C. Soften 1 diced onion in 40g butter, then mix with 150g fresh breadcrumbs, chopped sage, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Stuff a 1.8kg chicken, rub with butter and salt and roast with 1kg halved potatoes tossed in oil for 1 hour 20 minutes. Glaze 500g sliced carrots in a pan with butter, 1 tbsp honey and a splash of water. Rest the chicken 15 minutes, stir 1 tbsp flour and 250ml stock into the tray for gravy.
W: Meringue piped into little nests, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, filled with lemon curd and topped with speckled chocolate eggs.
K: Hot coffee with brown sugar and 30ml Irish whiskey, lightly whipped cream floated on top.
T: Keep the windows shut. Keep the crab coming.
D: A San Francisco socialite follows a man to a seaside town where the birds start attacking.
P: Serve the crab when Melanie sits down at the restaurant in Bodega Bay.

title: Jaws 2
S: Roast chicken torn up and mixed with lemon mayo, piled into soft rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos, wrapped tight in paper for the boat.
just when you thought it was safe

Clam meat or calamari soaked in buttermilk, dredged in cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, tartare and lemon. Cut 500g calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk. Dredge in 100g cornmeal and 50g flour and fry at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.
Shark fin chips with prawn ceviche
the fin behind the water skier

Tortillas cut into fin shapes and baked crisp, with a lime-cured prawn ceviche of tomato, red onion, chilli, avocado and coriander to scoop. Cut 8 corn tortillas into triangles, brush with oil, salt and bake at 190C for 10 minutes until crisp. Dice 400g raw peeled prawns and cover with the juice of 5 limes for 20 minutes until opaque. Drain off half the juice and fold in 2 diced tomatoes, half a finely diced red onion, 1 chopped red chilli, 1 diced avocado and a handful of coriander. Season with salt and serve cold with the chips standing up like fins.
M: the little island where the kids end up stranded

Clams, prawns, new potatoes and corn steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic, butter and smoked sausage, tipped onto the table. Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 200g sliced smoked sausage, 60g butter and a splash of water, then 1kg clams and 500g prawns. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.
the chief who just wants a quiet summer

Thick chargrilled beef patties with melted cheddar, grilled onions, beefsteak tomato, lettuce, pickles and smoky barbecue mayo in toasted sesame buns. Season 800g beef mince with salt and pepper and shape 4 thick patties with a dimple in the middle. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Grill the patties over high heat for 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Toast 4 sesame buns and stack with lettuce, tomato, patty, onions, pickles and the mayo.
W: Blueberries with sugar and lemon under a buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the sailing day out on the water

Golden rum, pineapple, orange and lime with a splash of grenadine and a grate of nutmeg, mixed by the jug and poured over plenty of ice. Stir 240ml golden rum, 400ml pineapple juice, 200ml orange juice, 80ml lime juice and 40ml grenadine in a large jug. Chill for an hour. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the punch and finish each with a little grated nutmeg, a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Make a second jug without the rum and with soda water for the younger crew.
T: Safe to go back to the buffet.
D: Amity Island's police chief is sure another shark is out there, and nobody wants to hear it.
P: Serve the snacks when the teenagers set sail.

title: Pet Sematary
S: beers on the porch across the road with Jud
Salted peanuts roasted in the shell, pickled onions and a wedge of sharp cheddar with crackers, laid out on an old tray for the porch.
the family cat, back but not quite right

Muffin batter of flour, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and egg mixed briefly, fresh blueberries folded in, cinnamon crumble on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Mix 300g flour, 150g sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 80g melted butter and 1 egg briefly. Fold in 200g blueberries. Spoon into a 12-hole tin, top with cinnamon crumble and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
the family picnic in the field by the road

Devilled eggs whipped with mayo, mustard and a little relish, topped with crisp shallots, paprika and chives, packed into a picnic box. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish, salt and pepper until smooth. Pipe back into the whites. Thinly slice 2 shallots and fry in oil until golden and crisp, then drain. Top each egg with paprika, crisp shallots and snipped chives, and chill until the picnic.
M: Louis stays home alone at Thanksgiving while the family visits Chicago

Turkey breast roasted with herb butter until juicy, with cornbread stuffing, buttery mash, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy. Heat the oven to 180C. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast roll with 50g butter mashed with sage, thyme and garlic and roast for 75 minutes to 70C inside, then rest 15 minutes. Mix 300g crumbled cornbread with 1 diced onion softened in butter, chopped sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock and bake for 30 minutes alongside. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk. Make gravy from the tray juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Molasses baked beans with ham hock, served with steamed brown bread and coleslaw. Soak 500g navy beans overnight.
W: the road out front where the trucks fly past

Apples sliced and tossed with cinnamon, sugar and lemon, covered with a crumble of oats, flour, brown sugar and cold butter, baked at 180C for 40 minutes. Toss 6 sliced apples with 1 tsp cinnamon, 60g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 80g flour, 80g oats and 80g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with pouring cream.
K: Jud's porch lager and apple cider shandy
Jud's cold beers on the porch

Ice-cold lager topped with sparkling apple cider and a squeeze of lemon, served in frosted glasses with a thin apple slice, easy drinking on a Maine porch. Put 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Pour 200ml cold lager into each, then top slowly with 150ml chilled sparkling apple cider. Add a squeeze of lemon and a thin slice of green apple to each glass and serve straight away.
T: Sometimes dead is better. Fresh is best.
D: A doctor moves his family to rural Maine and learns about the burial ground beyond the pet cemetery.
P: Serve the beers when Louis and Jud sit out on the porch.

title: Paranormal Activity
S: up again watching the camera footage
Golden toasted cheese sandwiches with a little Dijon, cut into soldiers. Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread.
the footprints in the powder on the hallway floor

Soft yoghurt flatbreads charred in a hot pan, brushed with garlic butter and dusted thick with finely grated parmesan, with a smoky tomato dip. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 300g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 2 minutes. Divide into 8, roll thin and cook in a dry hot pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and parsley, brush over and dust with 50g finely grated parmesan. Blend 200g roasted tomatoes with 1 tsp smoked paprika, olive oil and salt for the dip.
Lavash cut into a big rectangle, brushed with oil, letters and numbers stencilled on with smoked paprika, baked crisp at 180C. Whipped feta to dip.
M: eating in front of the footage
Pepperoni and mushroom pizza on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, left in the box on the bed while you rewatch the tape.
the couple's house in San Diego

Crisp battered white fish in warm corn tortillas with lime slaw, pickled onion and a chipotle crema, plenty of coriander and lime wedges. Quick-pickle 1 sliced red onion in 100ml vinegar with 1 tsp sugar and salt. Shred a quarter red cabbage and toss with lime juice and salt. Mix 150ml sour cream with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 200ml cold sparkling water into a batter. Cut 600g flathead or ling into strips, dip and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, crema and coriander.
W: Dark chocolate custard of cream, milk, yolks and sugar baked in small cups in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes, chilled until set.
K: staying up to check the tape

Fresh espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and a little sugar syrup until it foams, served in coupes with three coffee beans on top. Make 4 shots of espresso (about 120ml) and cool for 5 minutes. Shake half the batch at a time: 60ml espresso, 80ml vodka, 40ml coffee liqueur and 10ml sugar syrup over plenty of ice for 20 seconds until frothy. Strain into 2 chilled coupes and repeat. Float 3 coffee beans on each.
T: Leave the camera running. Leave the lights off.
D: A young couple set up a video camera to record what's happening in their house at night.
P: Serve the snacks when the camera is set up on the tripod for the first night.

title: Smile
S: the grin she can't stop seeing
Mashed potato mixed with cheddar and a little flour, rolled out, cut into rounds with two eyes and a wide smile pressed in, baked at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp.
her sister's family party in the backyard

Smoky slow-roasted pork shoulder pulled and tossed in barbecue sauce, piled on soft slider buns with crunchy apple slaw and pickles. Rub a 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt. Put in a covered dish with 200ml apple juice and roast at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Shred and toss with 200ml barbecue sauce. Shred a quarter cabbage and 1 green apple into matchsticks and toss with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 12 split slider buns with pork, slaw and pickles.
Crunchy bite-size buttermilk fried chicken pieces with a honey mustard dip. Soak 600g diced chicken thigh in 250ml buttermilk for 1 hour.
M: dinner with her fiancé, before it falls apart

Salmon fillet roasted skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes, with lemon and dill butter, crushed potatoes and green beans. Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and dill and spoon over. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 300g green beans.
Late-shift miso ramen with soft eggs
the long nights she can't sleep

Rich miso and chicken broth over springy ramen noodles with seared pork belly, jammy soy eggs, corn, spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and soak in 100ml soy, 100ml water and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 hours. Slice 500g pork belly and pan fry until crisp. Heat 1.6 litres chicken stock with 2 grated garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger, then whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy off the boil. Cook 4 serves ramen noodles. Divide noodles and broth into bowls and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, spring onion and chilli oil.
W: Vanilla sugar cookies cut into rounds, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced pale yellow with a wide red smile piped on. A little unsettling.
K: Rose's cat, curled up on the couch

Chamomile steeped strong, stirred with honey, lemon and a nip of whisky, served hot in mugs with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with cloves. Steep 4 chamomile tea bags in 800ml just-boiled water for 5 minutes, then remove. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and the juice of a lemon. Add 30ml whisky to each of 4 mugs, pour over the tea and finish with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with 3 cloves. Leave out the whisky for a plain version.
T: Keep smiling. Keep eating.
D: A psychiatrist starts seeing a terrifying smiling presence after a disturbing session with a patient.
P: Serve dessert when Rose finally heads back to her childhood home.

title: Barbarian
S: Keith's tea and brown butter shortbread
the stranger in the rental makes her tea

Brown butter shortbread fingers with a sprinkle of sea salt and demerara, served with a pot of strong black tea, milk and sugar on the side. Melt 200g butter and cook until it smells nutty and goes golden brown, then chill until firm but soft. Beat with 90g caster sugar until pale, then mix in 250g plain flour, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 20cm square tin, sprinkle with demerara and flaky salt, prick all over and bake at 160C for 35 minutes. Cut into fingers while warm. Brew a pot of black tea for 4 minutes and serve alongside.
Rental kitchen salami and cheddar toasties
whatever's in a short-stay rental kitchen

Crisp toasted sandwiches of salami, sharp cheddar and pickles on buttered sourdough, cut into fingers with a pot of hot English mustard. Butter one side of 8 slices of sourdough. On the unbuttered side of 4 slices, layer 50g grated sharp cheddar, 4 slices salami and a few sliced pickles, then more cheese, and top with the remaining bread, buttered side out. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted. Cut into fingers and serve with hot English mustard.
Welcome basket baked brie, honey walnuts
the double-booked rental on Barbary Street

A whole brie baked until molten, topped with honey, toasted walnuts, thyme and chilli flakes, with crisp baguette toasts and apple slices for dipping. Heat the oven to 180C. Score the top of a 200g brie and sit it on a lined tray. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until soft in the middle. Toast 40g walnuts in a dry pan and toss with 2 tbsp honey, thyme leaves and a pinch of chilli flakes. Slice a baguette thin, brush with oil and bake for 8 minutes until crisp. Spoon the walnuts over the brie and serve with the toasts and sliced apple.
M: Dough pressed into an oiled rectangular tin, cubed brick cheese or mozzarella and cheddar right to the edges, pepperoni, baked at 250C for 15 minutes, tomato sauce striped on top after.
LA galbi short ribs with kimchi rice
the actor back in LA before everything catches up with him

Thin-cut beef short ribs marinated in soy, pear, garlic and sesame, seared on a smoking grill, with kimchi fried rice, lettuce cups and ssamjang. Blend half a nashi pear, 1 small onion, 5 garlic cloves, 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp sesame oil. Marinate 1.2kg thin-cut LA-style beef short ribs for at least 4 hours. Grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side until charred. Fry 200g chopped kimchi in oil, add 600g cooked cold rice and 1 tbsp gochujang and stir-fry until crisp. Serve with cos leaves, sliced spring onion, sesame seeds and ssamjang.
W: Dates soaked with bicarb, beaten into a butter sponge, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, drowned in hot toffee sauce.
K: a glass to settle the nerves on that first awkward night

Red wine steeped with orange, apple, cinnamon and a dash of brandy, topped with lemonade and poured over ice into mismatched rental glasses. In a large jug, combine a 750ml bottle of medium-bodied red, 60ml brandy, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 sliced orange, 1 diced apple and 1 cinnamon stick. Stir to dissolve the sugar and chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 300ml lemonade. Pour into glasses with some of the fruit in each.
T: Double booked. Don't go in the basement.
D: A woman arrives at her Detroit rental to find a stranger already staying there, and then she finds the basement.
P: Serve the tea when Keith makes Tess a cup on that first night.

title: Annabelle
S: Stovetop maple bacon brown butter popcorn
the pan of popcorn left on the stove too long

Popcorn popped in a heavy pot and tossed in nutty brown butter, maple syrup, crumbled crisp bacon and flaky salt. Never walk away from the stove. Fry 4 rashers of streaky bacon until very crisp, then crumble. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake constantly until the popping slows, then pull it off straight away. Cook 60g butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty, then stir in 2 tbsp maple syrup. Pour over the popcorn, toss with the bacon and a good pinch of flaky salt.
Devilled eggs with paprika, cocktail franks in a sticky barbecue and grape jelly glaze, and celery boats filled with cream cheese and olives.

Puff pastry twisted with parmesan, sharp cheddar, paprika and a little mustard, baked crisp and golden and stood up in a jar like knitting needles. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry with beaten egg and spread one lightly with Dijon mustard. Scatter 60g grated parmesan, 60g grated cheddar and 1 tsp paprika over the mustard sheet, lay the second sheet on top and press firmly. Cut into 1.5cm strips, twist each one and lay on lined trays. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and golden, then cool on a rack.
M: Strips of scotch fillet seared fast, finished in a sour cream, mushroom and paprika sauce with a dash of brandy, over buttered egg noodles with parsley. Slice 700g scotch fillet into thin strips and sear in batches in a very hot pan for 1 minute, then set aside. Soften 1 sliced onion in 30g butter, add 300g sliced mushrooms and cook until golden. Add 2 tsp sweet paprika and 2 tbsp brandy, then 250ml beef stock and 1 tbsp Dijon and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 200ml sour cream and the beef and warm through without boiling. Toss 400g egg noodles with butter and parsley and serve.
John's long hours at the hospital
Chicken, mushroom and rice baked together in a creamy sauce with thyme at 180C for 50 minutes, a 1960s weeknight dinner done properly.
W: the doll John finally finds for Mia's collection

Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with white Swiss meringue buttercream, a tiny pink sugar rose on each. Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites with 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter and pipe white. Add a tiny pink sugar rose.
K: Mint chocolate ice cream blended with milk into pale green shakes, a crème de menthe nip for adults.
T: Mind the popcorn. Mind the doll.
D: A young couple's new house fills with dread after a vintage doll is given to them as a gift.
P: Serve the popcorn when Mia puts a pan of it on the stove.

title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
S: the genetics lab upstairs, best not to ask

Pork and cabbage potstickers folded, fried until the bottoms brown, steamed under a lid, with a soy and black vinegar dip. Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, salted and squeezed, and 1 tbsp grated ginger. Fill 30 gyoza wrappers and pleat. Fry until browned, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes. Dip in soy and Chinkiang vinegar.
the cooking show taped inside the Clamp building

Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes (the oven, not the microwave), salsa and sour cream. Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake in the oven at 200C for 8 minutes, not the microwave. Top with diced tomato and 150g sour cream.
the lobby deli in the smart building

Corned beef, sauerkraut and melted Swiss cheese on rye with Russian dressing, griddled in butter until crisp and cut into halves. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp chopped pickles and a dash of hot sauce for the dressing. Butter one side of 8 slices of rye. On the unbuttered side of 4, layer dressing, 2 slices Swiss cheese, 100g sliced corned beef and 3 tbsp drained sauerkraut, then top with the rest. Cook in a pan over medium heat with a weight on top for 4 minutes a side until crisp and melted.
M: Pastrami steamed 10 minutes until soft and piled high on rye spread with spicy mustard, a whole dill pickle and a creamy potato salad with celery and dill on the side.
the boss's very fancy top floor

Pounded beef fillet seared and finished in a pan sauce of mushrooms, brandy, mustard, Worcestershire and cream, with crisp potato rösti and green beans. Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze dry, mix with salt and fry as 4 rösti in butter for 6 minutes a side. Pound 4 x 180g beef fillet steaks to 1.5cm and sear in a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, then rest. Add 20g butter, 1 diced shallot and 150g sliced mushrooms and cook 3 minutes. Add 50ml brandy, then 1 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 150ml cream and bubble 2 minutes. Serve the steaks with sauce, rösti and buttered beans.
W: New York Italian bakery layers of almond sponge in three colours with jam and a chocolate top.
K: no water near the mogwai, again

Lychees muddled with lime and mint, topped with ginger beer and soda over crushed ice, a lychee on each skewer. Keep the glasses well away from the mogwai. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping 100ml syrup. Muddle 12 lychees with the juice of 3 limes and a handful of mint in a jug. Add the reserved syrup, fill with crushed ice and top with 500ml ginger beer and 300ml soda water. Stir gently, pour into glasses and garnish each with a lychee on a skewer and a mint sprig.
T: New rules. Same rules. Not after midnight.
D: The gremlins break loose inside a high-tech Manhattan skyscraper.
P: Serve the snacks before midnight, still.

title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
S: the tiny marshmallow men who run riot in the store
Big marshmallows stacked in twos on skewers, eyes and smile piped in melted dark chocolate, half of them toasted with a blowtorch.
Okra cut into rounds, tossed in cornmeal and fried crisp, with hot sauce. Slice 500g okra into 1cm rounds, toss in 150ml buttermilk, then in 150g cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, salt and pepper.
the dusty old farmhouse full of secrets

Golden cornbread baked in a hot cast iron pan with corn kernels and jalapeño, served warm in wedges with whipped honey butter and flaky salt. Heat the oven to 210C with a 25cm cast iron pan inside. Mix 200g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Whisk 300ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter, stir into the dry mix with 150g corn kernels and 1 chopped jalapeño. Add 20g butter to the hot pan, pour in the batter and bake 20 to 25 minutes. Beat 100g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm wedges.
M: the carhop diner with the skating waiters
Chuck patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft buns, crinkle-cut fries, delivered on a tray.
Oklahoma chicken fried steak with gravy
dinner in the small Oklahoma town

Tenderised beef steak dredged twice in seasoned flour, fried crunchy and smothered in peppery white country gravy, with mashed potato and green beans. Pound 4 x 150g thin beef minute steaks. Season 200g plain flour with salt, pepper and 1 tsp garlic powder. Dip the steaks in flour, then in 2 eggs beaten with 200ml buttermilk, then back in the flour. Shallow fry in 1cm oil at 180C for 3 minutes a side and drain. Pour off all but 3 tbsp fat, stir in 3 tbsp of the flour, whisk in 500ml milk and simmer until thick with lots of black pepper. Serve with mash and buttered beans.
W: a giant marshmallow man, in pie form
Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache filling, topped with a tall marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.
K: the drinks at the roller diner

Thick chocolate shakes of vanilla ice cream, cold milk, cocoa and malted milk powder, topped with whipped cream, chocolate sauce and a cherry. Blend 8 large scoops of vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp cocoa and 3 tbsp chocolate sauce until thick and smooth. Drizzle more chocolate sauce inside 4 tall chilled glasses, pour in the shakes and top with whipped cream and a cherry.
T: Who you gonna call. The diner.
D: A single mum and her kids move into her late father's Oklahoma farmhouse and find what he left behind.
P: Serve the snacks when the tiny marshmallow men get loose in the supermarket.

title: Toy Story 3
S: when the potato toy has to borrow a tortilla for a body
Flour tortillas filled with cheddar and Monterey Jack, folded, cooked in a dry pan until golden and melted, cut into wedges. Salsa.
snack time in the Caterpillar Room at Sunnyside

Puff pastry rolled with leg ham, cheddar and a little tomato relish, sliced into spirals and baked crisp and golden, easy for small hands. Heat the oven to 200C. Lay 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry flat and spread each with 1 tbsp tomato relish. Cover with 4 slices of leg ham and 60g grated cheddar. Roll up tightly from one edge, chill for 15 minutes, then cut each log into 10 slices. Lay flat on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Bonnie's tea party jam and cream scones
playtime with the toys in Bonnie's room

Little buttermilk scones baked tall and golden, split warm and piled with strawberry jam and softly whipped cream for a pretend tea party. Heat the oven to 220C. Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk with a knife until it just comes together. Pat to 3cm thick, cut 12 small rounds with a floured cutter and pack close together on a lined tray. Brush with milk and bake for 12 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with strawberry jam and 200ml cream whipped soft.
M: Spaghetti and meatballs: beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
College road trip chicken Caesar wraps

Grilled garlic chicken, crisp cos, bacon bits and parmesan tossed in a creamy Caesar dressing, rolled in soft tortillas and wrapped tight for the drive. Toss 600g chicken thigh fillets with oil, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt, and grill for 5 minutes a side, then rest and slice. Fry 4 rashers of bacon until crisp and chop. Whisk 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 small grated garlic clove and 30g grated parmesan. Toss 1 shredded cos lettuce with the dressing, bacon and chicken. Fill 4 large tortillas, roll up tight and wrap in baking paper, then halve.
W: the bear who smells of strawberries
Buttery shortcake rounds baked at 200C for 15 minutes, split and filled with whipped cream and strawberries macerated in sugar.
K: Fresh strawberries blended thick with vanilla ice cream, cold milk and malted milk powder, topped with whipped cream and a halved strawberry. Hull 300g ripe strawberries, keeping 2 for garnish.
