Blend the rest with 6 scoops of vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp honey until thick and pink. Pour into 4 glasses, top with whipped cream and half a strawberry each.
T: So long, partner. Pass the snacks.
D: Andy's toys end up at a daycare centre run by a bear who smells of strawberries.
P: Serve dessert when the toys meet the strawberry-scented bear.

title: Up
S: the grape soda cap badge Ellie gives Carl
Grape juice set with gelatine in little round moulds, turned out and topped with a dot of whipped cream so they look like bottle caps.
Wilderness Explorer honey trail mix bars

Chewy oat bars packed with peanuts, sultanas, banana chips and chocolate chips, bound with honey and peanut butter and cut into badge-sized squares. Heat the oven to 170C and line a 20 x 30cm tin. Toast 250g rolled oats for 10 minutes. Warm 150g honey, 120g peanut butter and 60g butter until smooth. Stir in the oats, 80g roasted peanuts, 80g sultanas and 50g crushed banana chips, cool for 10 minutes, then fold in 80g chocolate chips. Press firmly into the tin and bake for 15 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into squares.
the house floating on thousands of balloons

Light, puffy choux balls with sharp cheddar and a little mustard baked in, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm by the bunch. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until it leaves the pan. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated cheddar and 1 tsp Dijon. Pipe 30 small balls on lined trays, top with a little more cheese and bake for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: the explorer's dinner, served by his dogs
Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with a red wine sauce, roast potatoes and buttered greens, a very proper dinner in the clouds.
the South American cliffs Ellie always wanted to see

Crisp golden corn arepas split open and stuffed with shredded chicken and avocado salad, with grated cheese and a fresh green coriander sauce. Poach 600g chicken breast for 15 minutes and shred. Mix with 1 mashed avocado, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, lime juice, coriander and salt. Mix 300g pre-cooked white corn flour with 450ml warm water and 1 tsp salt, rest 5 minutes and shape 8 discs 1.5cm thick. Cook in an oiled pan over medium heat for 6 minutes a side until crisp. Blend coriander, 1 green chilli, garlic, lime and 80ml oil for the sauce. Split the arepas and fill.
W: the giant bird who loves chocolate
Dark chocolate bark scattered with toasted hazelnuts, dried cherries and flaky salt, set and broken into shards. Save some for the bird.
K: Ellie's club drink, the grape soda cap badge

Purple grape juice and soda poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up, with a straw, a long spoon and a few frozen grapes. Freeze 100g red grapes for 2 hours. Mix 600ml purple grape juice with 400ml chilled soda water and a squeeze of lime. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses, then pour the grape soda over slowly so it foams up. Drop in a few frozen grapes and serve with a straw and a long spoon.
T: Adventure is out there. So is dessert.
D: A grumpy widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, with a young stowaway.
P: Serve dessert when Carl and Russell sit on the kerb with their ice creams.

title: Inside Out
S: Disgust's worst nightmare in San Francisco
Pizza dough stretched in a tray, olive oil, garlic, mozzarella and broccolini roasted until crisp at the edges, chilli flakes and parmesan. Actually good.
Bing Bong pink fairy floss meringues
the imaginary friend made of fairy floss

Crisp pink strawberry meringue kisses with soft chewy middles, topped with a puff of fairy floss just before serving. Heat the oven to 110C. Whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Fold in 1 tbsp freeze-dried strawberry powder and a drop of pink food colouring. Pipe 24 kisses onto lined trays and bake for 1 hour, then turn the oven off and leave them inside to cool for 1 hour. Top each with a little pink fairy floss right before serving.
Cream cheese and cheddar rolled into balls, each coated a different colour: paprika, herbs, sesame, crushed pistachio and black sesame.
M: home in Minnesota before the move

Beef mince, green beans and corn baked in a creamy mushroom sauce under rows of crisp golden potato gems, with a little cheddar melted over. Heat the oven to 200C. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Make a sauce: soften 200g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml milk and 200ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Stir the beef, 200g chopped green beans and 1 cup corn kernels into the sauce and pour into a baking dish. Cover with 700g frozen potato gems in rows and bake for 35 minutes, adding 100g grated cheddar for the last 5.
Family dinner lemon and rosemary chicken
the dinner where Anger takes the controls

Chicken thighs rubbed with lemon zest, garlic and rosemary, roasted on a tray of potatoes until the skin crackles, with buttered green beans. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1kg halved small potatoes in oil and salt on a large tray. Rub 8 chicken thighs on the bone with the zest of 2 lemons, 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, oil and salt, and sit them skin side up on the potatoes. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear, then squeeze over the lemon juice. Boil 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.
W: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust at the controls
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, buttercream split into five bowls tinted yellow, blue, red, purple and green, one colour per cupcake.
K: Riley's imaginary friend is made of it
Thick vanilla milkshake blended with strawberry and topped with a puff of pink fairy floss.
T: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, Disgust. And dinner.
D: An 11-year-old's emotions struggle to steer her through a move from Minnesota to San Francisco.
P: Serve the pizza when Riley tries the broccoli pizza in San Francisco.

title: Coco
S: she keeps piling them on his plate
Masa beaten with lard, stock and baking powder until fluffy, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with chicken in a red chilli sauce, folded and steamed 75 minutes.
the bridge of orange petals to the Land of the Dead
Corn cobs grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander, a few marigold-coloured nasturtium petals on top.
Santa Cecilia plaza guacamole and totopos
the mariachi plaza in Santa Cecilia

Chunky guacamole with lime, chilli, onion and coriander, topped with pomegranate and toasted pepitas, with crisp fried corn tortilla chips. Cut 8 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp, then salt. Mash 3 ripe avocados roughly with the juice of 2 limes and salt. Fold in half a finely diced white onion, 1 seeded chopped jalapeño, 1 diced tomato and a handful of coriander. Top with 2 tbsp pomegranate seeds and 2 tbsp toasted pepitas and serve with the warm chips.
M: the family's Day of the Dead table

Pork shoulder and hominy simmered in a deep red chilli broth, topped at the table with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano and crisp tostadas. Simmer 1.2kg diced pork shoulder in 2.5 litres water with 1 halved onion, 4 garlic cloves and 2 tsp salt for 1.5 hours. Soak 4 dried guajillo and 2 ancho chillies in hot water for 20 minutes, then blend with 2 garlic cloves and a little soaking water and strain into the pot. Add 2 drained tins hominy and simmer 30 minutes more. Serve with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, lime wedges, dried oregano and tostadas.
Corn tortillas dipped in red chilli sauce, rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, covered in more sauce and cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes. Crema and onion.
W: Enriched yeasted dough with orange zest and orange blossom, shaped into rounds with dough "bones" on top, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, brushed with butter and rolled in sugar.
K: the thick chocolate drink of the season
Masa harina whisked into hot milk with Mexican-style chocolate, cinnamon and brown sugar, simmered until thick and silky.
T: Remember dinner.
D: A boy who dreams of music ends up in the Land of the Dead on the Day of the Dead.
P: Serve the tamales when Abuelita insists Miguel eat more.

title: Moana
S: Coconut prawns: prawns dipped in flour, egg and a mix of panko and shredded coconut, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, with a sweet chilli and lime dip.
Raw tuna diced, tossed with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli, spooned onto rice in little cups with cucumber and seaweed.
Motunui taro chips with coconut lime dip
the gardens and groves on Motunui

Thin taro slices fried crisp and dusted with chilli salt, with a cool dip of coconut yoghurt, lime zest, coriander and a touch of garlic. Peel 600g taro and slice paper thin on a mandoline, then rinse and pat completely dry. Fry in batches in oil at 175C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and pale golden, then drain and toss with salt and a pinch of chilli powder. Mix 250g coconut yoghurt with the zest and juice of a lime, chopped coriander, 1 small grated garlic clove and salt for the dip.
M: the island coming back to life
Snapper fillets cooked gently in coconut milk with lime leaf, ginger and chilli, finished with lime and coriander, served with rice.
a feast fit for a demigod

Chicken thighs marinated in pineapple, soy, ginger and brown sugar, grilled and basted until sticky and charred, with coconut rice and grilled pineapple. Mix 200ml pineapple juice, 80ml soy sauce, 60g brown sugar, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp grated ginger and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets in half for 4 hours and simmer the rest until syrupy for basting. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water. Grill the chicken for 5 minutes a side, basting often, with 8 pineapple slices. Serve with the rice and sliced spring onion.
W: a Pacific coconut pudding for the voyage
Coconut milk, sugar and cornflour whisked together and cooked over medium heat until very thick, poured into a tray, chilled 3 hours, cut into squares, topped with toasted coconut and fresh mango.
K: everything a coconut is good for

Coconut water, fresh pineapple, lime and mint blended over ice into a frosty crush, served in halved coconuts or tall glasses with a pineapple wedge. Blend 500ml chilled coconut water, 400g fresh pineapple chunks, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint leaves, 1 tbsp honey and 2 cups ice until slushy. Pour into halved coconuts or tall glasses and garnish with a pineapple wedge and a mint sprig.
T: How far she'll go for a good feed.
D: A chief's daughter sails across the ocean to find a demigod and restore the heart of an island.
P: Serve the snacks when the coconut pirates attack the boat.

title: Frozen
S: Anna's very excited about the chocolate
Dark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa, and white chocolate ones rolled in icing sugar like snow, piled on a silver plate.
the carrot he shares with Sven, and Olaf's nose
Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey, thyme and butter until caramelised, with a whipped feta dip.
the coronation night Anna meets Hans

Nordic open sandwiches on dark rye: smoked salmon with dill cream and egg, and leg ham with mustard butter and crunchy pickled cucumber. Boil 3 eggs for 9 minutes, cool and slice. Mix 100g cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest. Mash 40g soft butter with 2 tsp wholegrain mustard. Slice 1 Lebanese cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and salt for 10 minutes. Spread 4 slices of dark rye with dill cream and top with 150g smoked salmon and egg. Spread 4 more with mustard butter and top with 150g leg ham and the drained cucumber. Halve and serve.
M: a Nordic dinner in the castle
Beef and pork meatballs with breadcrumbs, grated onion and allspice, browned in butter, simmered in a cream gravy, with mash and lingonberry jam.
Ice harvesters' creamy Nordic fish soup
the men cutting ice on the frozen lake

Chunks of salmon and white fish poached in a creamy fish broth with leek, carrot and potato, finished with dill and served with buttered rye. Soften 1 sliced leek, 2 diced carrots and 1 diced celery stick in 30g butter for 5 minutes. Add 500g diced potato and 1.2 litres fish stock and simmer 12 minutes. Stir in 250ml cream and bring back to a gentle simmer. Add 400g diced white fish such as ling and 300g diced salmon and poach for 4 minutes without stirring hard. Season, add a handful of chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with buttered rye.
W: something warm while Arendelle freezes over

Soft cardamom buns, the centres filled with vanilla custard, tops spread with icing and dipped in desiccated coconut. Mix 450g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 60g sugar, 250ml warm milk, 1 egg and 60g butter and prove an hour. Shape 12 buns, press a hollow and fill with thick custard. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Spread icing on top and dip in coconut.
K: the trading post and sauna on the mountain

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with cardamom, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, topped with whipped cream, marshmallows and grated chocolate. Warm 1 litre full cream milk with 4 lightly crushed cardamom pods and 1 cinnamon stick until steaming, then turn off and steep 10 minutes. Strain, return to the heat and whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of salt until smooth and frothy. Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream, a few marshmallows and grated chocolate.
T: The cold never bothered us. Dessert might.
D: A princess sets out across a frozen kingdom to find her sister, whose powers have locked it in winter.
P: Serve the chocolate when Anna arrives at the coronation party.

title: Encanto
S: the arepas that heal any hurt
Pre-cooked corn flour mixed with warm water, salt and butter, shaped into discs, filled with grated mozzarella, cooked on a griddle until golden and crisp.
Tapioca starch, corn flour, feta and egg mixed into a dough, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
the flowers that bloom wherever she goes

Zucchini flowers filled with ricotta, feta and lemon zest, dipped in a light batter and fried crisp, with a drizzle of honey and fresh lime. Mix 200g ricotta, 80g crumbled feta, the zest of a lime, chopped mint and pepper. Gently open 12 zucchini flowers, remove the stamens and pipe in the filling, twisting the petals to close. Whisk 100g plain flour, 30g cornflour and 180ml cold sparkling water into a batter. Heat oil to 180C, dip the flowers and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Drain, salt lightly, drizzle with honey and serve with lime wedges.
M: Colombian home cooking for the Madrigal kitchen

Chicken simmered with three kinds of potato and corn on the cob until the soup thickens, served with cream, capers, avocado and a little rice. Put 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in a pot with 2.5 litres water, 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch of coriander stems and 2 tsp salt. Simmer 40 minutes, then lift out the chicken and shred it. Add 500g diced white potatoes, 500g diced chat potatoes and 300g diced sweet potato with 4 corn cobs in thirds and simmer 40 minutes until the soup thickens. Return the chicken and add 1 tbsp dried oregano. Serve with cream, capers, sliced avocado and rice.
the whole family around the table at Casita
Beef chuck braised in tomato, onion and cumin until shredded, with rice, black beans, fried plantain and a fried egg.
W: a Colombian Christmas treat for the whole house
Crumbled feta and fresh cheese mixed with cornflour, tapioca starch, egg and a little sugar into a soft dough, rolled into balls, fried at 160C for 6 minutes until golden and round.
K: hot chocolate the Colombian way, with cheese
Dark chocolate whisked into hot milk with a little cinnamon until frothy, a cube of mozzarella dropped into each mug to go soft and stringy.
T: We don't talk about dessert. We eat it.
D: A Colombian family with magical gifts lives in an enchanted house, all except one granddaughter.
P: Serve the arepas when Julieta hands them out to heal everyone.

title: Lilo & Stitch
S: Pudge's peanut butter and banana toasties
the fish who controls the weather, fed every Thursday

Crunchy peanut butter, sliced banana and a drizzle of honey in buttered white bread, toasted golden in a pan and cut into fish shapes. Spread 8 slices of white bread on one side with 40g soft butter. Turn over and spread 4 slices with crunchy peanut butter, top with sliced banana from 2 bananas and a drizzle of honey, then close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Cut into fish shapes with a cutter, or into triangles.
Sashimi tuna diced, tossed with soy, sesame oil, spring onion, chilli and a little seaweed, served on rice crackers.
the surfing day with Nani and David

Shell-on prawns fried hard in butter with a whole bulb of garlic, lemon and parsley, served over sticky rice with lemon wedges, island shrimp truck style. Cut down the backs of 800g shell-on green prawns and devein, leaving the shells on. Toss with 2 tbsp plain flour, 1 tsp paprika and salt. Cook 300g sushi rice. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp oil and fry 12 chopped garlic cloves gently for 3 minutes until golden. Add the prawns and cook over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, tossing, until pink. Finish with lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the rice.
M: Beef patties seasoned and seared in a hot pan, set on steamed rice, smothered in a brown onion gravy made in the same pan with stock and butter, topped with a runny fried egg.
the whole family around the table

Smoky pork shoulder slow-roasted in banana leaves until it falls apart, with coconut rice, pineapple salsa and a crunchy cabbage slaw. Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 1 tbsp sea salt and 1 tsp smoked paprika, wrap in banana leaves or foil and roast in a covered dish at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Shred in the juices. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water. Dice half a pineapple with red onion, chilli, coriander and lime for salsa. Toss shredded cabbage with lime and sesame oil. Serve all together.
W: Stitch's number before he gets a name

Frozen pineapple blitzed with a little coconut cream and lime until thick, piped into cups and served straight away. Blitz 500g frozen pineapple with 100ml coconut cream, a squeeze of lime and a spoon of sugar until thick and smooth. Pipe into cups and serve straight away before it melts.
K: Pineapple juice, coconut cream and blue raspberry cordial blended with plenty of ice until slushy, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge.
T: Ohana means nobody gets left out of dinner.
D: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts a strange blue dog who turns out to be an alien experiment.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Lilo takes Pudge the fish his peanut butter sandwich.

title: Mulan
S: the matchmaker's visit that goes badly
Pork and chive dumplings folded and steamed 8 minutes, with a soy and black vinegar dip. Tea poured carefully.

Crisp golden spring rolls packed with pork mince, cabbage, carrot, glass noodles and ginger, served hot with a sweet chilli and lime dipping sauce. Soak 50g glass noodles and cut short. Stir-fry 300g pork mince with 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves, then add 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot, the noodles, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil and cool. Roll 2 tbsp filling tightly in each of 20 spring roll wrappers, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Mix 100ml sweet chilli sauce with lime juice to dip.
the army training camp before sunrise
Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed in a hot wok with garlic, chilli flakes, a splash of soy and plenty of flaky salt.
M: the porridge with a smiling face Mushu makes for Mulan
Jasmine rice simmered 90 minutes in chicken stock with ginger until silky, topped with a fried egg and bacon in a smiling face, spring onion and soy.
the celebration in the Imperial City

Pork belly braised glossy and dark in light and dark soy, rock sugar, star anise and ginger, with steamed rice and garlicky stir-fried bok choy. Cut 1kg pork belly into 3cm cubes, blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain. Melt 60g rock sugar or brown sugar in a wok with 1 tbsp oil until amber, add the pork and toss to coat. Add 4 slices ginger, 3 spring onions, 2 star anise, 60ml light soy, 2 tbsp dark soy and 500ml water. Cover and simmer 1 hour, then uncover and reduce until glossy. Serve with steamed rice and bok choy stir-fried with garlic.
W: a sweet for the autumn festival

Golden syrup, oil and alkaline water mixed into flour and rested 2 hours, wrapped thinly around balls of lotus seed paste, pressed into moulds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, egg washed and baked 10 more.
K: Family temple iced jasmine lychee tea
the family temple where the ancestors gather

Jasmine green tea brewed strong and chilled, shaken with lychee syrup and lime over ice, with whole lychees and a few mint leaves in each glass. Steep 4 jasmine green tea bags in 1 litre water at 80C for 3 minutes, remove and chill. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Stir 120ml of the syrup and the juice of a lime into the cold tea. Pour over ice in 4 glasses with 3 lychees each and a few mint leaves.
T: Bring honour to us all. Bring dumplings.
D: A young woman disguises herself as a man to take her father's place in the army.
P: Serve breakfast when Mushu cooks Mulan her first morning meal at camp.

title: Tarzan
S: the proper English tea Jane brings to the jungle

Poached chicken in a mild curried mayo with mango chutney, sultanas and toasted almonds, on soft white bread cut into neat crustless fingers. Poach 2 chicken breasts for 15 minutes, cool and dice finely. Mix 5 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp mango chutney, 1 tsp mild curry powder, a squeeze of lemon, 30g sultanas and 30g toasted flaked almonds. Fold through the chicken with chopped coriander. Butter 12 slices of white bread, fill 6 sandwiches with a handful of baby spinach each, cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.
Kala and the family foraging in the trees
Bananas, mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit cut into big chunks, piled on banana leaves with lime and a pinch of chilli salt.
Spiced roasted chickpeas and cashews with curry powder and honey, roasted at 180C for 25 minutes until crunchy, tipped out messily on a board.
M: Chicken thighs cooked with onion, ginger, garlic and curry spices, tomato and coconut milk, simmered 40 minutes, with rice and mango chutney.

Chicken thighs simmered in a rich tomato and peanut sauce with ginger, chilli and sweet potato, over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander. Brown 1kg diced chicken thighs in oil. Add 1 diced onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 chopped red chilli and cook 4 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tin crushed tomatoes, 150g smooth peanut butter and 500ml chicken stock. Add 500g diced sweet potato and simmer 30 minutes until thick. Squeeze in lime and serve over rice with chopped roasted peanuts and coriander.
W: Ripe bananas in thick slices dipped in a light batter of flour and sparkling water, fried at 180C until puffed, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with honey.
K: Black tea brewed strong and cooled, stirred with a fresh peach and honey syrup and lemon, poured over ice with peach slices and mint. Steep 4 black tea bags in 1 litre boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool. Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 80g honey and 100ml water for 5 minutes, crush and strain. Stir the syrup and the juice of a lemon into the tea and chill. Serve over ice with fresh peach slices and a sprig of mint.
T: Raised in the jungle. Fed like a king.
D: A man raised by gorillas meets an English explorer's daughter and has to choose between two worlds.
P: Serve the tea when Jane sets out her tea service in the jungle.

title: Hercules
S: Spinach and feta with dill, spring onion and egg, wrapped in buttered filo triangles, baked at 190C for 25 minutes until golden. Wilt 400g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g feta, chopped dill, 3 spring onions and 1 egg. Cut 6 sheets filo into strips, brush with 60g melted butter, add a spoon of filling and fold into triangles. Bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

Little lamb meatballs with mint, oregano and feta, pan-fried until crusty and served on skewers with cool garlic tzatziki and lemon. Mix 500g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 40g fresh breadcrumbs, 60g crumbled feta, chopped mint, 1 tsp dried oregano and salt. Roll into 24 balls and fry in olive oil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Grate 1 Lebanese cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 grated garlic clove, lemon and dill. Serve the keftedes on skewers with the tzatziki.
the monster that grows more heads
Haloumi sliced and griddled until golden, drizzled with honey and chilli, more slices added as fast as they're eaten.
M: Lamb leg cubes marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, skewered and grilled hot, with pita, tzatziki, tomato and red onion. Marinate 1kg diced lamb leg in lemon juice, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano and oil for 2 hours. Thread onto skewers and grill hot. Mix 300g Greek yoghurt with grated cucumber and garlic. Serve in 4 warm pita with tomato and red onion.
the god of the underworld with the flaming hair

King prawns baked in a bubbling chilli, garlic and tomato sauce with crumbled feta, served with crusty bread and a lemony orzo. Heat the oven to 200C. Soften 1 diced onion and 4 sliced garlic cloves in olive oil, add 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1 chopped red chilli, then 1 tin crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 800g peeled green king prawns, tip into a baking dish, crumble 150g feta over and bake 10 minutes. Cook 300g orzo and toss with lemon zest, butter and parsley. Serve with crusty bread.
W: Yeasted batter spooned into hot oil at 175C, fried until puffed and golden, soaked in warm honey and cinnamon, sprinkled with walnuts.
K: Olympus golden peach and honey fizz

Peach nectar shaken with honey, lemon and a little orange blossom water, topped with sparkling water and served golden over ice with mint. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp warm water until dissolved. In a jug mix 600ml peach nectar, the honey water, the juice of a lemon and half a teaspoon of orange blossom water. Fill 4 glasses with ice and fresh peach slices, pour in the nectar to two thirds and top with chilled sparkling water. Add a mint sprig.
T: From zero to hero to second helpings.
D: The son of Zeus, raised on Earth, trains to become a true hero and win back his place on Olympus.
P: Serve the feast when Hercules returns to Mount Olympus.

title: The Emperor's New Groove
S: Kronk is very proud of his spinach puffs
Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with feta, ricotta, garlic and nutmeg, spooned onto puff pastry squares, folded, egg washed, baked at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed.
a nod to the mountain villages

Baby potatoes boiled and halved, covered in a creamy yellow chilli and feta huancaína sauce, topped with boiled egg, black olives and parsley. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then halve. Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes, peel and quarter. Blend 150g feta, 150ml evaporated milk, 2 tbsp aji amarillo paste, 4 crackers, 1 garlic clove and 2 tbsp oil until smooth and thick like custard. Arrange the potatoes on a platter, pour over the sauce and top with the eggs, sliced black olives and chopped parsley.
Quinoa rinsed and cooked, tossed with corn, black beans, tomato, red onion, coriander and a lime and cumin dressing.
M: the roadside diner where Kuzco orders the special
Beef chuck patties grilled hot, cheddar and onion on toasted buns, with chips, the kind of special a jungle diner would sling.
Peruvian pollo a la brasa with green sauce
the emperor's dinner, without the poison

Whole chicken marinated in cumin, paprika, garlic, lime and soy, roasted until the skin is dark and crisp, with chips and a spicy green coriander sauce. Blend 5 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp soy, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp oil. Rub over and under the skin of a 1.8kg butterflied chicken and marinate 4 hours. Roast at 220C for 45 to 50 minutes. Bake 800g frozen chips alongside. Blend a bunch of coriander, 2 green chillies, 60g feta, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, lime juice and a garlic clove for the sauce.
W: the kids' birthday surprise in the village
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 175C for 35 minutes, covered in chocolate fudge frosting and candles.
K: a purple corn drink from Peru
Purple corn simmered with pineapple peel, cinnamon and cloves, strained, sweetened, chilled with lime and diced apple.
T: Pull the lever. Serve the spinach puffs.
D: A selfish young emperor is turned into a llama and has to rely on a kind villager to get home.
P: Serve the spinach puffs when Kronk brings them out at dinner.

title: Madagascar
S: Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar and sugar, spread on nori, filled with salmon and avocado, rolled tight with a mat, sliced with a wet knife, soy and pickled ginger alongside.
Brownie batter and cheesecake batter swirled into black and white stripes, baked at 170C for 30 minutes.
M: the steak Alex dreams about in the zoo
Rib eye dry-brined overnight, seared hard in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, pulled at 54C and rested 8 minutes, topped with garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries.
the fish Alex finally learns to eat on the island

Firm white fish simmered in a coconut, tomato and ginger curry with lime and chilli, served over rice with fresh coriander and toasted coconut. Soften 1 diced onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger in oil. Add 2 tsp mild curry powder and 1 tsp turmeric and stir 1 minute. Add 2 diced tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes. Slip in 800g firm white fish such as barramundi in chunks and poach gently for 6 minutes. Finish with lime juice and salt. Serve over rice with coriander and toasted coconut flakes.
W: Thick pineapple wedges grilled until charred and glazed in a brown sugar, butter and lime caramel, with coconut ice cream and toasted coconut. Cut 1 pineapple into 8 long wedges and grill on a hot pan or barbecue for 3 minutes a side until charred. Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar, bubble for 2 minutes, then stir in the juice of a lime and a pinch of salt. Toss the pineapple in the caramel. Serve warm with scoops of coconut ice cream and toasted coconut flakes.
K: the welcome party on the island

Mango nectar, passionfruit pulp, pineapple and lime topped with fizzing lemonade, served by the jug over crushed ice with fruit floating on top. In a large jug stir 600ml mango nectar, 300ml pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Add diced mango and pineapple and plenty of crushed ice. Top with 600ml chilled lemonade just before serving and pour into tall glasses with a lime wedge.
T: Move it, move it. To the buffet.
D: Four pampered zoo animals from New York end up shipwrecked on Madagascar.
P: Serve the steak when Alex starts seeing his friends as steaks.

title: Ice Age
S: the dodos defending their last melon
Watermelon cut into thick wedges, topped with crumbled feta, torn mint, lime and a pinch of flaky salt, served very cold.
the squirrel and his one acorn
Hazelnut and chocolate truffles rolled in chopped toasted hazelnuts, a pretzel stick pushed in as the stalk so they look like acorns.
M: big food for a woolly mammoth
Beef short ribs rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, wrapped and baked at 150C for 4 hours, glazed under the grill with barbecue sauce. Coleslaw.
Sid's root vegetable and lentil stew
Sid, the sloth who eats plants

Carrot, parsnip, pumpkin and brown lentils simmered with tomato, smoked paprika and thyme until thick, with crusty bread and a dollop of herby yoghurt. Soften 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves and 2 diced celery sticks in olive oil. Add 2 carrots, 1 parsnip and 500g pumpkin, all in chunks, with 1 tsp smoked paprika and thyme. Add 200g rinsed brown lentils, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 1 litre vegetable stock and simmer 35 minutes until thick. Stir in a handful of baby spinach. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread.
W: Vanilla cupcakes covered in marshmallow frosting and rolled in desiccated coconut so they look like snowballs.
K: the one acorn Scrat never lets go of
Vanilla ice cream blended with milk, caramel and peanut butter into a thick nutty shake.
T: One acorn. One very long chase.
D: A mammoth, a sloth and a sabre-tooth tiger team up to return a human baby to his father.
P: Serve the snacks when the dodos fight over the last melon.

title: Shrek 2
S: do you know the Muffin Man
Blueberry muffins: flour, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and egg mixed briefly, blueberries folded in, crumble on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
the tavern full of fairytale villains
Apple wedges dipped in red toffee (sugar, water and red colouring boiled to 150C), set on oiled paper, a little shiny and suspicious.
the cat in boots from Spain

Crisp fried potato cubes with smoky tomato bravas sauce and garlic aioli, alongside sizzling slices of chorizo finished with honey and parsley. Boil 800g potato cubes for 6 minutes, drain, then roast with oil and salt at 220C for 30 minutes until crisp. Simmer 1 tin crushed tomatoes with 1 crushed garlic clove, 2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of chilli for 15 minutes. Mix 120g mayonnaise with 1 grated garlic clove and lemon. Fry 2 sliced chorizo in a dry pan until crisp, then add 1 tbsp honey. Serve the potatoes with both sauces and the chorizo.
M: the Fairy Godmother's stop at the Friar's Fat Boy drive-thru

Double beef burgers with cheese, bacon, onion rings and a smoky sauce in soft buns, with shoestring fries, the way a fairytale drive-thru would do it. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries and 300g frozen onion rings at 220C for 20 minutes. Smash the balls thin on a smoking hot pan, salt and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns and stack 2 patties, bacon, onion rings and sauce in each.
Far Far Away royal roast pork
the awkward dinner with Fiona's parents
Roast pork shoulder with crackling, apple sauce and roast potatoes. Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and roast at 230C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 2 hours.
W: the giant gingerbread man stomping through the kingdom

Butter, brown sugar and golden syrup melted, flour, ginger and cinnamon mixed in, chilled, rolled and cut into one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones, baked at 180C, iced with gumdrop buttons.
K: the happily ever after potion from her factory
Lemonade with a splash of blue raspberry cordial and a spoon of edible glitter swirled in, poured into little glass bottles.
T: Are we there yet. Yes. Dinner's ready.
D: Shrek meets Fiona's royal parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away, and it does not go well.
P: Serve the mains when Shrek and King Harold sit down at that awkward family dinner.

title: Kung Fu Panda
S: Shifu trains Po by making him fight for the last dumpling
Pork and cabbage dumplings folded with ginger and spring onion, steamed 8 minutes, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip. Chopsticks only.
the peach tree where Oogway sits
Ripe peaches halved, grilled cut side down until caramelised, drizzled with honey and served with whipped ricotta and crushed almonds.
Mr Ping's red bean steamed buns

Soft, fluffy white steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste, stacked high in a bamboo steamer and served hot. Mix 300g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g caster sugar, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt with 160ml warm milk and 1 tbsp oil. Knead 8 minutes until smooth and prove 1 hour. Divide into 12, flatten each, fill with a tablespoon of red bean paste and pinch closed. Sit each on a square of baking paper in a bamboo steamer, prove 20 minutes, then steam over boiling water for 12 minutes.
M: Chicken bones simmered 3 hours with ginger, garlic and spring onion, strained, seasoned with soy and white pepper, poured over hand-pulled or fresh wheat noodles with bok choy and shredded chicken. The secret is there isn't one.
Valley of Peace kung pao chicken
the busy village below the Jade Palace

Diced chicken thigh stir-fried hot with dried chilli, Sichuan pepper, spring onion and roasted peanuts in a glossy sweet and sour sauce, with steamed rice. Toss 800g diced chicken thigh with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp cornflour. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour and 60ml water for the sauce. Stir-fry 8 dried chillies and 1 tsp Sichuan pepper in hot oil for 20 seconds, add the chicken and cook 5 minutes. Add 3 garlic cloves, ginger and spring onion, then the sauce, and toss until glossy. Stir in 80g roasted peanuts and serve with rice.
W: Butter, sugar and almond meal cookies with an almond pressed on top, egg washed and baked at 170C for 14 minutes until golden.
K: the peach tree on the hill where Oogway sits

Jasmine green tea brewed and chilled, mixed with fresh peach purée and honey, poured over ice with peach slices. Steep 4 jasmine green tea bags in 1 litre water at 80C for 3 minutes, then remove and chill. Blend 2 ripe peeled peaches with 2 tbsp honey and the juice of half a lemon until smooth. Stir the purée into the cold tea. Pour over ice in tall glasses with thin peach slices.
T: There is no secret ingredient. Except dumplings.
D: A noodle shop panda is chosen as the Dragon Warrior and has to defend the Valley of Peace.
P: Serve the dumplings when Shifu trains Po with a bowl of them.

title: Despicable Me
S: the little yellow helpers who love bananas
Banana coins dipped in yoghurt and frozen, half rolled in crushed peanuts and half in yellow sprinkles.
the girls selling boxes of cookies door to door

Chewy coconut cookies with golden edges, half dipped in dark chocolate and packed into little boxes just like the girls sell. Heat the oven to 170C. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar until creamy, then beat in 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 150g plain flour, half a teaspoon of bicarb and 120g desiccated coconut. Roll into 20 balls, flatten slightly on lined trays and bake for 12 minutes until golden at the edges. Cool, then dip half of each in 150g melted dark chocolate and set on paper.
the funfair where Agnes wins the fluffy unicorn
Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes. Mustard and tomato sauce.
M: the first dinner in Gru's gloomy house
Beef and pork mince mixed with soaked breadcrumbs, parmesan and parsley, rolled, browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce with garlic and basil, over spaghetti.

Chicken tenderloins in a crunchy parmesan and panko crumb, baked golden, with honey mustard, tomato sauce and a crisp potato wedge pile. Heat the oven to 220C. Cut 1kg potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, paprika and salt, and roast for 35 minutes. Dip 800g chicken tenderloins in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 150g panko mixed with 40g grated parmesan. Lay on an oiled tray, spray with oil and bake for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon with 3 tbsp honey and serve with tomato sauce.
W: Agnes and her fluffy unicorn from the funfair
Vanilla sponges baked at 175C, stacked and covered in fluffy white buttercream, a mane of pastel buttercream piped down one side and a gold fondant horn on top.
K: the moon he shrinks and steals
Full cream milk warmed gently with honey, a cinnamon stick and vanilla, never boiled, poured into mugs at bedtime.
T: Steal the moon. Eat the bananas.
D: A supervillain adopts three orphan girls as part of a plan, and gets more than he bargained for.
P: Serve dessert when the girls take Gru to the theme park.

title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
S: Wallace and his love of cheese
Wensleydale with cranberries, a crumbly Lancashire or aged cheddar and a soft blue, with water crackers, apple slices and a pot of chutney.
Prize veg bubble and squeak cakes

Mashed potato, cabbage, carrot and leek pan-fried into crisp golden cakes with melted cheddar, served with brown sauce and a dollop of chutney. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with 30g butter. Shred a quarter savoy cabbage and 1 leek, grate 1 carrot and fry in butter for 6 minutes until soft. Mix into the mash with 80g grated cheddar, salt and pepper. Shape into 12 small cakes and chill 20 minutes. Fry in butter and oil over medium heat for 4 minutes a side until deep golden. Serve with brown sauce and chutney.
the van with the bunnies in the back
Shortcrust filled with grated cheddar, potato and onion, crimped, egg washed, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
M: Gromit's prize marrow, finally on a plate
Zucchini or marrow halved, filled with lamb mince cooked with onion, tomato and herbs, covered in cheese and baked at 190C for 35 minutes.
Tottington Hall roast beef and Yorkshires

Rare roast sirloin with tall Yorkshire puddings, crisp roast potatoes, honey carrots and rich beef gravy, horseradish on the side. Heat the oven to 220C. Rub a 1.2kg beef sirloin with oil, salt and pepper and roast 15 minutes, then at 180C for 25 to 30 minutes to 52C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in hot oil for 45 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150ml milk and 120g plain flour, pour into a very hot oiled 12-hole tin and bake 20 minutes at 220C. Roast 500g carrots with honey. Make gravy with the pan juices, flour and 400ml beef stock.
W: Grated carrot, walnuts, oil, brown sugar, eggs and spice mixed with self-raising flour, baked at 170C for 50 minutes, cream cheese frosting on top.
K: the kettle at 62 West Wallaby Street

Earl Grey tea brewed strong and chilled, mixed with fresh lemon syrup and topped with sparkling water over ice, lemon wheels and mint in the jug. Steep 4 Earl Grey tea bags in 800ml boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool. Simmer 100g caster sugar with 100ml water and the peeled zest of 2 lemons for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. Stir the syrup and the juice of 3 lemons into the tea. Pour over ice and top with 400ml sparkling water, with lemon wheels and mint.
T: Cracking cheese, Gromit.
D: An inventor and his dog run a humane pest control business just before the town's giant vegetable competition.
P: Serve the cheese when Wallace gets the crackers out.

title: Wall-E
S: the cooler he uses to carry home his treasures

A hollowed cob stuffed with layers of ham, roast capsicum, pesto, mozzarella and spinach, pressed overnight into a tight block and sliced into wedges. Cut the top off a 20cm round cob loaf and pull out most of the soft inside. Spread the inside with 4 tbsp basil pesto. Layer in 150g leg ham, 150g roasted capsicum, 150g sliced mozzarella, a handful of baby spinach, 100g salami and 100g semi-dried tomatoes, pressing each layer down. Replace the lid, wrap tightly in plastic wrap and press under a heavy pot in the fridge overnight. Cut into wedges.
the little green plant he keeps in an old boot

Bright green peas smashed with mint, feta, lemon and olive oil, piled into a bowl with a sprout of pea shoots on top, with crunchy pita chips. Cook 400g frozen peas for 3 minutes, drain and cool under cold water. Pulse with a handful of mint, 100g feta, the zest and juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt until roughly smashed. Cut 4 pita breads into triangles, brush with oil and bake at 190C for 10 minutes until crisp. Pile the smash into a bowl, stand a few pea shoots in the middle and serve with the chips.
the cubes of compacted rubbish he stacks into towers
Butter and marshmallows melted slowly together, puffed rice stirred through, pressed into a lined tray, set an hour, cut into neat cubes and stacked into towers.
M: the cruise ship where everyone drinks their meals
A thick roast pumpkin and red lentil soup with ginger and coconut, served in big mugs with a straw. Grilled cheese on the side for the humans who remember chewing.
Earth garden roast veg and haloumi tray
the plant that means Earth can grow again

Pumpkin, capsicum, red onion, zucchini and chickpeas roasted with honey and cumin, topped with golden haloumi, mint and a lemon yoghurt drizzle. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 600g pumpkin chunks, 2 capsicums, 2 red onions in wedges, 2 zucchini and 1 drained tin chickpeas with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp honey and salt. Roast for 35 minutes, turning once. Slice 250g haloumi and fry until golden. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon juice and salt. Top the tray with haloumi, drizzle with yoghurt and scatter with mint.
W: the little sponge cake he finds in the rubbish
Eggs and sugar whisked pale and thick, flour folded in, baked as fingers at 180C for 12 minutes, cooled, split and filled with vanilla whipped cream piped through the middle.
K: the floating chairs and endless drinks on the cruise ship

Fresh lemon juice, raspberries and a splash of blue cordial blended with ice into a frosty slushie, served in tall cups with a straw. Blend 150g frozen raspberries, the juice of 4 lemons, 80ml blue raspberry cordial, 3 tbsp caster sugar, 300ml cold water and 4 cups ice until smooth and slushy. Pour into tall cups and serve straight away with a straw and a lemon wheel.
T: Earth needs a picnic.
D: A lonely trash-compacting robot follows a sleek probe robot into space and changes the fate of humanity.
P: Serve the snacks when Wall-E opens his lunchbox at the end of the day.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
S: the sweets trolley on the train to school

Milk chocolate frogs moulded around crunchy homemade honeycomb, each wrapped in a little paper card like the ones from the trolley. Line a tray with baking paper. Boil 150g caster sugar and 3 tbsp golden syrup to 150C, then whisk in 2 tsp bicarb, pour onto the tray and leave to set for 30 minutes. Break into small crumbs. Melt 250g milk chocolate gently. Spoon a little into frog moulds, add a pinch of honeycomb, top with more chocolate and tap out the air. Chill 30 minutes, turn out and wrap each in paper.
the rock-hard cakes at Hagrid's hut, softer here
Flour, butter, sugar, mixed fruit and spice rubbed together, bound with egg and milk, dropped in rough piles, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until golden but tender.
Roast pumpkin mashed with feta, sage and nutmeg, wrapped in shortcrust half moons, egg washed, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
M: Roast chicken drumsticks glazed with honey and mustard, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings, buttered peas and carrots and gravy, all piled on the table at once.
the first proper Christmas Harry ever has

Herb-buttered turkey breast roasted golden with chipolatas in bacon, roast potatoes, honey parsnips, cranberry sauce and a rich gravy. Heat the oven to 180C. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast roll with 50g butter mashed with sage and thyme and roast 75 minutes to 70C inside, then rest. Wrap 12 chipolatas in half rashers of streaky bacon and roast for the last 30 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes and 500g parsnips tossed in honey and oil at 200C for 45 minutes. Make gravy with the tray juices, 1 tbsp flour and 400ml chicken stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
W: Sweet shortcrust blind baked, filled with golden syrup warmed with fresh breadcrumbs, lemon zest and juice, baked at 180C for 30 minutes until set. Clotted cream.
K: the jug on every table in the Great Hall
Roast pumpkin blended with apple juice, a little honey and cinnamon, strained and served cold.
T: You're a wizard, Harry. You're also hungry.
D: An orphaned boy learns he's a wizard and starts his first year at a school of magic.
P: Serve the feast when the plates fill up at the welcome feast in the Great Hall.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
S: Mrs Weasley's kitchen at the Burrow
Sausages, bacon, fried eggs and buttered toast cooked all at once on a big pan, the plates loaded and passed down the table.
the pudding Dobby floats over the dinner guests

Little choux puffs baked crisp, filled with vanilla whipped cream and topped with pale violet icing and a sugared violet. Keep them on the plate. Heat the oven to 200C. Boil 125ml water, 50g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 75g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs one at a time until glossy. Pipe 20 small mounds on lined trays and bake 20 minutes, then pierce each and bake 5 minutes more. Whip 300ml cream with 2 tbsp icing sugar and vanilla and pipe into the cooled puffs. Mix 120g icing sugar with a little water and a drop of violet colouring and spoon over.
the toffee Hagrid offers that nearly glues your teeth
Brown sugar, butter, black treacle and golden syrup boiled to 140C, poured into a tray, scored and broken once set.
M: Lamb mince browned, onion, carrot, tomato paste and Worcestershire simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash, baked at 200C until golden.
Flying car beef and mushroom pies
the flying car that ends up in a tree

Beef chuck braised with mushrooms, onion and stock until tender, baked in individual shortcrust pies with flaky puff lids, with mushy peas and gravy. Brown 1kg diced chuck steak in batches. Soften 1 diced onion and 250g sliced mushrooms, return the beef, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 600ml beef stock, cover and simmer 2.5 hours until tender, then cool. Line 4 pie tins with shortcrust, fill and top with puff pastry lids. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Cook 300g frozen peas and mash roughly with butter and mint.
W: the potion brewed in the girls' bathroom
Green apple jelly set in small glasses with popping candy sprinkled on top just before serving so it fizzes.
K: a warm drink at the castle on a cold night
Brown sugar and butter cooked to a butterscotch with a splash of cream and pinch of salt, stirred into cold cream soda, topped with lightly whipped cream.
T: The chamber is open. So is the kitchen.
D: Harry's second year at school brings a warning from a house-elf and a monster in the walls.
P: Serve breakfast when Harry arrives at the Weasleys' house.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
S: the chocolate Lupin gives Harry after the Dementors
Good dark and milk chocolate broken into rough pieces, with a slab of homemade honeycomb (sugar, golden syrup and bicarb) dipped half in chocolate.
the sweet shop in the wizarding village

Old-fashioned coconut ice in two layers, snowy white and raspberry pink, set firm, cut into chunky squares and piled into a glass sweet jar. Line a 20cm square tin. Mix 395g sweetened condensed milk with 250g icing sugar, then work in 250g desiccated coconut until stiff. Press half into the tin. Tint the rest pink with a few drops of colouring and 1 tsp raspberry essence, then press on top. Chill for 4 hours until firm, then cut into 3cm squares and pile into a sweet jar.
the divination class reading tea leaves
Earl Grey shortbread: tea leaves ground into butter, sugar and flour, rolled into a log, chilled, sliced, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
M: the old pub in London where Harry stays
Beef chuck browned in batches, dark ale, onion, carrot and thyme, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Crusty bread and butter.
Knight Bus ham and cheese toasties
the purple triple-decker bus at night

Thick-cut ham and gruyère toasties with mustard, griddled in butter until crisp, with a mug of creamy roast tomato soup for dunking. Roast 1kg halved tomatoes, 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves with oil at 200C for 30 minutes, then blend with 500ml vegetable stock and 100ml cream and season. Butter one side of 8 slices of thick white bread. Spread 4 unbuttered sides with Dijon and layer 200g sliced ham and 200g grated gruyère, then close. Cook in a pan over medium heat for 4 minutes a side until golden and melted. Serve with the soup in mugs.
W: Creamy vanilla fudge cut into thick squares, wrapped in paper like the shop sells it.
K: Pumpkin, apple juice and a little honey blended smooth with cinnamon and ginger, strained and served cold.
T: Eat the chocolate. You'll feel better.
D: An escaped prisoner is said to be after Harry, and the guards sent to protect the school are worse.
P: Serve the chocolate when Professor Lupin hands Harry a piece after the Dementors.

title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
S: the camp outside the Quidditch World Cup
Pork sausages fried slowly in a heavy pan until sticky, in soft rolls with fried onions and brown sauce.
the Yule Ball in the Great Hall

Warm buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill, lemon zest and a little salmon roe, laid out on silver trays. Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt with 200ml milk and 1 egg into a thick batter. Cook teaspoons in a buttered pan for 1 minute a side to make about 30 blinis. Cool slightly. Top each with a little crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill, lemon zest and a few beads of salmon roe.
the first task with the dragons
Chorizo cooked in a hot pan with honey and chilli flakes until sticky, on toothpicks with cubes of sharp cheddar.
M: the Christmas feast before the dancing
Beef rib roast roasted at 220C then 160C to 52C, rested, with roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings, honey carrots and red wine gravy.

Snapper, mussels and prawns simmered in a saffron, fennel and tomato broth, with toasted baguette and a garlicky red rouille to stir through. Soften 1 onion, 1 fennel bulb and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil. Add a pinch of saffron, 1 strip orange zest, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 1.2 litres fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 600g snapper chunks for 3 minutes, then 500g mussels and 8 green prawns for 4 minutes until opened. Blend 1 roasted capsicum, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp breadcrumbs, a pinch of chilli and 80ml olive oil for rouille. Serve with toasted baguette.
W: the frozen Great Hall decorated for the ball
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, white chocolate shavings and berries dusted with icing sugar like frost.
K: a cold winter night at the castle
Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise for 15 minutes, served warm.
T: Three tasks. One ball. Plenty of food.
D: Harry is entered into a dangerous tournament between three schools of magic.
P: Serve the feast at the Yule Ball.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
S: Pippin's idea that hobbits need a second breakfast
Thick bacon, fried mushrooms, grilled tomato and buttered toast with marmalade, served mid-morning on a big platter, after the first breakfast.
the hobbits raid Farmer Maggot's crop
Field mushrooms stuffed with garlic, thyme, breadcrumbs and gruyère, roasted at 200C for 15 minutes until bubbling.
the elvish bread from Lothlórien, one bite fills a man

Thick honey and almond shortbread squares scored with a cross, baked pale and wrapped in fresh leaves tied with string. Beat 250g soft butter with 80g caster sugar and 3 tbsp honey until pale. Mix in 300g plain flour, 60g almond meal and a pinch of salt to a soft dough. Press into a lined 20cm square tin, score into 9 squares with a cross on each and prick. Bake at 160C for 35 to 40 minutes until just golden. Cut while warm, cool, then wrap each in a clean banana or vine leaf and tie with kitchen string.
M: the party under the tree with fireworks

Pork shoulder salted overnight and roasted until the crackling shatters, with apple and sage sauce, roast potatoes and buttered cabbage. Score the skin of a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 2.5 hours. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in the fat for the last hour. Simmer 3 chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar, 30g butter and chopped sage until soft for sauce. Shred half a savoy cabbage and cook in butter for 5 minutes. Rest the pork 20 minutes and carve.
Beef and ale pie: chuck braised in dark ale with onion and thyme for 2.5 hours, under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Mash and peas.
W: an old-fashioned Shire cake for elevenses
Butter, sugar and eggs creamed, flour and caraway seeds folded in, baked in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes, sliced with butter.
K: it comes in pints at the inn in Bree

Brown ale warmed gently with honey, cinnamon, nutmeg and clove, a knob of butter and an egg yolk whisked through until creamy, served in tankards. Pour 4 bottles of brown ale into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick, 4 cloves and a good grating of nutmeg. Warm over low heat until steaming, never boiling. Whisk 2 egg yolks in a bowl, whisk in a ladle of the hot ale, then whisk it back into the pan with 30g butter and stir for 2 minutes until slightly thickened. Pour into tankards. Use apple juice for a booze-free version.
T: What about second breakfast.
D: A hobbit sets out from the Shire with a fellowship to destroy a ring of terrible power.
P: Serve the feast at Bilbo's birthday party.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
S: Baby potatoes boiled, smashed flat and roasted until shatteringly crisp, tossed in garlic and herb butter, with a sour cream and chive dip. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, drain and steam dry. Put on an oiled tray and press each flat with a mug. Drizzle with olive oil and salt and roast at 230C for 30 to 35 minutes until deep golden. Melt 40g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, thyme and rosemary and pour over. Mix 200ml sour cream with snipped chives and salt for the dip.
Merry and Pippin find the stores at Isengard

Pork belly cured overnight in salt and sugar, roasted then crisped into cubes and glazed with apple cider vinegar and honey, on toothpicks with pickles. Rub 1kg skin-off pork belly with 2 tbsp salt and 1 tbsp brown sugar and cure in the fridge overnight. Rinse, pat dry and roast at 160C for 2 hours. Cool, then cut into 3cm cubes. Fry in a hot pan until crisp on all sides, then add 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp cider vinegar and toss until sticky. Serve on toothpicks with cornichons and wholegrain mustard.
Oatcakes of oats, butter, honey and salt baked at 180C for 20 minutes, with sharp cheese and apples.
M: the stew Sam makes in Ithilien, with taters
Rabbit or chicken thighs browned, onion, carrot and thyme, stock and a splash of ale, potatoes added, simmered 90 minutes until tender.
Edoras garlic and rosemary roast lamb
the golden mead hall at Edoras

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink and carved at the table, with crisp potatoes, honey-roast root veg and a rich red wine gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Make 12 small cuts in a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with oil and salt. Roast on a bed of 1kg potatoes, 3 carrots and 2 parsnips in chunks for 20 minutes, then at 180C for 60 minutes to about 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock and simmer to a gravy.
W: Rich shortbread squares wrapped in a leaf, the closest thing to Elvish waybread. Beat 250g butter with 100g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then mix in 350g plain flour and a pinch of salt. Press 1cm thick into a tray, score into squares and bake at 160C for 30 minutes. Cut while warm and wrap each in a clean leaf or baking paper.
K: the drink in the great hall

Mead warmed with apple juice, honey, cinnamon, clove and orange, served steaming in horn cups or mugs, with a booze-free pot alongside. Pour a 750ml bottle of mead and 500ml cloudy apple juice into a pot with 1 sliced orange, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and 2 tbsp honey. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into mugs with an orange slice. For a booze-free pot, use 1.2 litres apple juice with the same spices.
T: Po-tay-toes. Boil them, mash them, stick them in a stew.
D: The fellowship is broken and the war for Middle-earth begins in earnest.
P: Serve the stew when Sam cooks the rabbits in Ithilien.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
S: Denethor eating at his table while Pippin sings
Roast chicken drumsticks, cherry tomatoes that burst when you bite them, red grapes and crusty bread, eaten slowly on a long table.
the taste of strawberries Sam reminds Frodo of

Ripe strawberries macerated with sugar and lemon, piled with honey-sweetened whipped cream and crumbled butter shortbread for crunch. Halve 500g strawberries and toss with 2 tbsp caster sugar and a squeeze of lemon, then leave 20 minutes until juicy. Whip 300ml cream with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla to soft peaks. Roughly crumble 8 butter shortbread biscuits. Layer the strawberries and their juice, cream and shortbread in 4 glasses or bowls and finish with a few whole berries.
Minas Tirith garlic and herb flatbreads
the white city on the mountain

Soft yeasted flatbreads blistered in a smoking pan, brushed with garlic, parsley and thyme butter, with a bowl of whipped feta and honey. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil and knead 8 minutes, then prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll thin and cook in a smoking dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and thyme and brush over. Blend 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, then drizzle with honey.
M: the coronation of the King in Minas Tirith
Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with roast potatoes, honey-glazed carrots and parsnips, and a red wine gravy.
Green Dragon chicken and leek pie
home in the Shire at the end

Chicken thigh, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttery mash and minted peas. Brown 1kg diced chicken thighs in butter, then add 2 sliced leeks and 250g sliced mushrooms and cook 6 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream, add thyme and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with mash and peas tossed with butter and mint.
W: Sam and Rosie's wedding back in the Shire
Light fruit cake with almonds, layered with apricot jam, covered in white icing, small flowers on top.
K: Green Dragon honey and ginger ale cup
back at the pub, four hobbits, quiet pints

English bitter stirred with a fresh honey ginger syrup and lemon, poured into pint glasses over a little ice, a lemon wheel on top. Simmer 100g honey, 100ml water and a thumb of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Put 2 tbsp syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 pint glasses, add a few ice cubes and pour in a 375ml bottle of English bitter or pale ale, tilting the glass. Stir once and add a lemon wheel. Use ginger beer for the non-drinkers.
T: Do you remember the taste of strawberries. Here they are.
D: The final battle for Middle-earth as Frodo and Sam make the last climb up Mount Doom.
P: Serve the drinks when the hobbits are back at the pub in the Shire.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
S: the apple Barbossa has waited years to taste
Crisp green apple slices tossed in lime juice, served with a salted caramel dip of melted caramels and cream, and shards of sharp cheddar on the side.

Chopped prawns in a spiced batter with capsicum, onion and chilli, fried into crisp golden fritters, with a lime and hot sauce mayo. Roughly chop 400g raw peeled prawns. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 150ml milk, half a teaspoon of allspice and salt. Fold in the prawns, half a diced red capsicum, 3 sliced spring onions, 1 chopped red chilli and thyme leaves. Drop spoonfuls into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Mix 120g mayonnaise with lime zest and juice and 1 tsp hot sauce to dip.
Plantain slices fried twice until golden and crisp, salted, brushed with a little edible gold lustre on the top ones.
M: Chicken marylands marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, spring onion, garlic and lime, grilled slowly over coals until charred. Rice and peas.
the British fort at Port Royal

Snapper simmered gently in coconut milk with tomato, capsicum, thyme, allspice and a whole chilli, with rice and peas and fried plantain. Cook 300g rice with 1 drained tin kidney beans, 270ml coconut milk, 300ml water and thyme for 18 minutes. Soften 1 onion, 1 capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in oil, add half a teaspoon of allspice, 2 diced tomatoes, 400ml coconut milk and 1 whole scotch bonnet and simmer 10 minutes. Add 800g snapper chunks and poach 6 minutes. Fry 2 sliced ripe plantains in oil until golden. Finish the stew with lime and serve.
W: the governor's town before the attack
Buttery little shortcrust tarts filled with cooked pineapple jam. Cook 1 grated pineapple with 150g sugar and a cinnamon stick for 40 minutes until thick.
K: the stash buried on the island
Dark rum, lime, sugar syrup, pineapple and orange juice over ice with nutmeg.
T: The rum's gone. Bring more.
D: A blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to rescue a governor's daughter from a cursed crew.
P: Serve the drinks when Jack and Elizabeth are marooned on the island.

title: The Dark Knight
S: Seared beef fillet on crostini with horseradish cream, smoked salmon blinis with crème fraîche and chives, served on black trays.
Batman's trip to Hong Kong to grab Lau
Char siu pork belly cubes roasted with honey, hoisin and five-spice, on toothpicks with pickled cucumber.
Joker card cheddar crackers with red dip
the playing card the Joker leaves behind

Crisp cheddar and parmesan crackers cut into playing card rectangles, a paprika smile stencilled on, with a smoky roasted capsicum dip. Pulse 150g plain flour, 120g grated cheddar, 30g parmesan, 60g cold butter and a pinch of cayenne until crumbly, then add 2 tbsp cold water. Roll 3mm thick, cut into 5 x 8cm rectangles, dust a smile of paprika through a paper stencil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Blend 200g roasted capsicum, 50g almonds, 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp smoked paprika, lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil for the dip.
M: Bruce makes the restaurant push two tables together

Pan-roasted salmon on crushed potatoes with a nutty lemon and caper brown butter and a peppery rocket and parmesan salad. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt. Season 4 salmon fillets and cook skin side down in a hot oiled pan for 5 minutes, then flip for 2 minutes. Wipe the pan, melt 80g butter until it foams brown, then add 2 tbsp capers, the juice of a lemon and chopped parsley. Toss 100g rocket with shaved parmesan, oil and lemon. Plate the salmon on the potatoes and spoon over the butter.
late nights at the police station

Beef and pork meatloaf baked under a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick with buttery mash, gravy and green beans. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, chopped parsley and salt. Shape into a loaf in a lined tray. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp cider vinegar and brush half over. Bake at 180C for 50 minutes, brushing on the rest halfway. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with mash, beans and gravy made from 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.
W: Crisp pastry with a smooth, sharp lemon cream, finished with icing sugar. Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes.
K: Alfred's smoky Scotch and ginger sour

Blended Scotch shaken with fresh lemon and a honey ginger syrup, served over a big ice cube with a float of smoky Islay malt and candied ginger. Simmer 80g honey, 80ml water and a thumb of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. For each drink shake 50ml blended Scotch, 20ml lemon juice and 20ml of the syrup hard over ice. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler, float 5ml smoky Islay whisky on top and garnish with a piece of candied ginger.
T: Why so serious. It's only dinner.
D: Batman, Gordon and the new district attorney take on a criminal mastermind who wants Gotham in chaos.
P: Serve the mains when Bruce drags his date over to join Rachel and Harvey's dinner table.

title: Batman Begins
S: the rare blue flower Bruce carries up the mountain

Lamb or beef mince with onion, garlic, ginger and coriander wrapped in thin dough, steamed 10 minutes, with a tomato and chilli achar. Mix 400g beef mince with a grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger and chopped coriander. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and steam for 10 minutes. Blitz 3 roasted tomatoes with a chilli and garlic for achar.

Cucumber and cream cheese, and smoked salmon with dill, crusts off, cut into neat fingers on a silver tray. Spread 8 slices white bread with 150g cream cheese. Fill half with thin cucumber and half with 150g smoked salmon and dill. Cut off the crusts and cut into neat fingers. Lay them on a silver tray.

Pork, cabbage and ginger dumplings pleated by hand, fried until the bottoms crunch then steamed, with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil. Salt 2 cups finely shredded wombok for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry. Mix with 400g pork mince, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 sliced spring onions, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Put a teaspoon in each of 30 round gow gee wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Fry flat side down in oil for 2 minutes, add 100ml water, cover and steam 5 minutes, then uncover until crisp. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar and chilli oil to dip.
M: Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C then 160C to 52C, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy.
Bruce training in the snow with the League

Beef shin braised with ginger, garlic, cumin, chilli and tomato until it falls apart, finished with spinach, with steamed rice and warm flatbread. Brown 1.2kg diced beef shin in batches. Soften 2 onions, 4 garlic cloves and 2 tbsp grated ginger. Add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli and 1 tsp garam masala and stir 1 minute. Return the beef with 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 600ml beef stock, cover and simmer 2.5 hours until tender. Stir in 100g spinach and coriander. Serve with steamed basmati and warm flatbread.
W: the birthday party at Wayne Manor that he clears out
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered and covered in glossy dark ganache, a single candle on top.
K: Lucius Fox's basement full of toys

Gin, elderflower cordial and fresh lemon topped with soda over ice and cucumber ribbons, a sprig of mint on top. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 2 thin cucumber ribbons each. Shake 180ml gin, 80ml elderflower cordial and 80ml lemon juice with ice and strain evenly into the glasses. Top each with 100ml soda water, stir once and add a mint sprig. For non-drinkers, replace the gin with chilled cucumber water.
T: Why do we fall. To get up and eat.
D: Bruce Wayne trains in the mountains and returns to Gotham to fight the corruption that killed his parents.
P: Serve the mains when Bruce comes home to Wayne Manor and Alfred.

title: Black Panther
S: Beef suya skewers with onion and tomato
the busy street market in Birnin Zana

Thin beef rump strips coated in a peanut, ginger and chilli spice, grilled smoky on skewers and served with sliced tomato, red onion and lime. Blitz 80g roasted peanuts to a fine powder and mix with 2 tsp ground ginger, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder and 1 tsp salt. Slice 800g beef rump into thin strips, toss in oil and then in most of the spice. Thread onto soaked skewers and grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side. Scatter with the rest of the spice and serve with sliced tomato, red onion and lime.
Korean fried chicken: wings in potato starch fried twice, tossed in gochujang, honey, soy and garlic glaze, sesame on top.
Beetroot and yoghurt dip with garlic, lemon and dill, a deep purple, with warm flatbread.
M: the ritual challenge at the waterfall
Long grain rice cooked in a sauce of blitzed tomato, capsicum, onion and scotch bonnet fried until deep red, with thyme and stock, baked covered at 170C for 40 minutes. Grilled chicken thighs on top.
M'Baku's sweet potato and peanut stew
the mountain chief who jokes that his people are vegetarian

Sweet potato, chickpeas and spinach simmered in a rich peanut, tomato and ginger sauce with chilli, over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander. Soften 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger in oil. Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander and 1 chopped red chilli. Stir in 1 tin crushed tomatoes, 120g smooth peanut butter and 600ml vegetable stock. Add 800g diced sweet potato and 1 drained tin chickpeas and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 120g spinach and lime juice. Serve over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander.
W: a sweet finish for the king
Ripe plantains sliced on the diagonal, fried in butter until caramelised, drizzled with honey and a pinch of chilli, coconut ice cream.
K: a deep purple drink for Wakanda

Dried hibiscus steeped with ginger, pineapple and lime, chilled deep purple and topped with sparkling water, a nip of white rum for the grown-ups. Bring 1 litre water to the boil with 30g dried hibiscus flowers, a thumb of sliced ginger and 100g caster sugar, then turn off and steep 20 minutes. Strain and chill. Stir in 200ml pineapple juice and the juice of 2 limes. Pour over ice, top with sparkling water and add a lime wheel. Add 30ml white rum per glass for the adults if you like.
T: Wakanda forever. Dinner now.
D: A new king returns to his hidden, high-tech African nation and faces a challenger with a claim to the throne.
P: Serve the mains when the tribes gather at the waterfall for the challenge.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
S: Awesome Mix Vol. 1, the tape his mum made him in 1988

Crisp golden pastry rolls stuffed with pepperoni, mozzarella and pizza sauce, baked until bubbling, with a hot honey and chilli marinara for dunking. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 8 rectangles each. Put 1 tsp pizza sauce, 2 slices pepperoni and a pinch of grated mozzarella and oregano on each, roll up and pinch the ends closed. Lay seam down on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and scatter with parmesan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Warm 300ml napoli sauce with 1 tbsp honey and a big pinch of chilli flakes to dip.
the bar inside a giant skull
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky purple glaze of blackberry, soy, chilli and honey.
Groot charred broccolini with whipped feta
I am Groot, regrowing in his little pot

Broccolini and green beans blanched, then charred in a smoking pan with garlic and chilli, piled over whipped feta with lemon and toasted almonds. Blend 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and a little olive oil until smooth and spread on a platter. Blanch 2 bunches broccolini and 200g green beans for 1 minute, drain and pat dry. Char in a smoking hot pan with olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes, adding 2 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes at the end. Pile over the feta, squeeze over lemon and scatter with toasted flaked almonds.
M: Pork ribs rubbed and slow-baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed under the grill with a smoky barbecue sauce, with corn and slaw.

Tender beef and pork meatloaf lacquered in a sticky gochujang, brown sugar and tomato glaze, sliced thick on creamy mash with buttered corn and onion gravy. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tsp mustard and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined tray. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 1 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, brush half over and bake at 180C for 50 minutes, adding the rest halfway. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with mash, buttered corn kernels and gravy from 1 sliced onion, 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.
W: the dance-off that saves the galaxy
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, rainbow sprinkles, whipped cream and a sparkler for the final move.
K: A spoon of grenadine in the bottom of each glass, then lemonade over ice, then blue raspberry cordial poured slowly down a spoon so it layers like a nebula.
T: Hooked on a feeling. Hungry for snacks.
D: A scrappy band of misfits teams up to keep a powerful orb out of a fanatic's hands.
P: Serve the snacks when Quill puts his mixtape on.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
S: the Grandmaster's colourful palace on Sakaar
Bright fruit skewers of watermelon, kiwi, pineapple and dragonfruit, with a lime, honey and chilli drizzle.
the gentle rock man with the New Zealand accent
Sausage mince with grated onion, carrot and herbs rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
Scrapper 142, aka Valkyrie, and her love of a drink

Squid strips dusted in rice flour, salt, Sichuan pepper and chilli, fried crisp and tossed with fried garlic and spring onion, with lime mayo. Cut 600g cleaned squid tubes into strips and pat dry. Mix 100g rice flour with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground Sichuan pepper and half a teaspoon of chilli powder. Toss the squid through. Fry in batches at 190C for 60 to 90 seconds until crisp and pale golden. Fry 4 sliced garlic cloves and 1 sliced red chilli for 30 seconds and toss through with spring onion. Mix 100g mayonnaise with lime juice to dip.
M: Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and lemon, roasted at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, with roast potatoes and mint yoghurt.
Asgardian roast beef rib with Yorkshires

A bone-in beef rib roasted to pink and carved at the table, with tall Yorkshire puddings, crisp potatoes, roast carrots and red wine gravy. Season a 2kg beef rib roast and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C for about 60 minutes to 52C inside. Rest 25 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes and 500g carrots in hot oil at 220C while the beef rests. Whisk 3 eggs, 150ml milk and 120g plain flour, pour into a smoking oiled 12-hole tin and bake 20 minutes. Simmer the tray juices with 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock for gravy.
W: Crunchy chocolate cornflake biscuits topped with chocolate icing and a walnut. Beat 200g butter with 100g sugar, add 180g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and 50g cornflakes.
K: Never-empty mug of honey lager punch
the beer Doctor Strange gives Thor that keeps refilling

Cold lager mixed by the jug with honey ginger syrup, fresh lemon and a splash of apple juice, poured into big mugs and topped up all night. Simmer 80g honey, 80ml water and a sliced thumb of ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. In a large chilled jug mix the syrup with the juice of 2 lemons and 200ml cloudy apple juice. Slowly pour in 6 bottles of cold lager and stir gently once. Pour into big mugs with a lemon wheel and keep a second jug ready to top them up.
T: He's a friend from work. Bring snacks.
D: Thor is stranded on a garbage planet and forced to fight in a gladiator arena while his home faces destruction.
P: Serve the drinks when Doctor Strange hands Thor the mug that never runs out.

title: Deadpool
S: the mercenary bar run by his mate Weasel
Corn chips with a hot cheese sauce of cheddar melted into evaporated milk with jalapeño juice, pickled jalapeños on top.
Wade and Vanessa's date at the arcade

Popcorn coated in a crunchy brown sugar caramel with lime zest, chilli and salt, baked until it snaps, served in striped paper bags. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil and spread on 2 lined trays.
