Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 60g golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb, 1 tsp chilli powder, the zest of 2 limes and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, then cool and break up.
the taxi driver who becomes his sidekick

Crisp pastry triangles filled with spiced potato, peas, cumin seed, ginger and green chilli, fried until blistered, with tamarind and mint chutneys. Boil 600g potatoes, peel and dice. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds in oil, add 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 chopped green chilli, then the potatoes, 100g frozen peas, 1 tsp garam masala, coriander and salt, and cool. Cut 6 sheets of spring roll pastry into strips, fold into cones, fill and seal with flour paste. Fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with tamarind chutney and mint yoghurt.
M: Flour tortillas filled with shredded beef braised with chipotle, cumin and onion, plus beans and cheese, folded tight, fried at 180C until crisp. Sour cream, guacamole and salsa.
Blind Al's crispy beef and kimchi tacos
dinner with his flatmate Blind Al

Smoky spiced beef mince in shells fried crisp to order, loaded with kimchi slaw, cheddar, pickled onion, sour cream and hot salsa, Seoul-meets-LA street style. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 150ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Fold 12 corn tortillas in half and shallow fry in hot oil for 1 minute a side until crisp. Quick-pickle a sliced red onion in lime juice and salt. Toss shredded iceberg with 100g chopped kimchi. Fill the shells with beef, kimchi slaw, cheddar, onion, sour cream and salsa.
W: the stuffed unicorn he takes everywhere
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with buttercream striped in rainbow colours inside the bag, finished with a little gold fondant horn on each.
K: the bar where the mercenaries drink
45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime shaken hard with ice, strained into a glass with a salted rim.
T: Maximum effort. Maximum chimichangas.
D: A mercenary turned disfigured antihero hunts the man who ruined his face.
P: Serve the chimichangas whenever Deadpool mentions them.

title: Logan
S: Laura's coordinates for Eden in North Dakota

Beef chuck braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until it shreds, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime. Braise 800g beef chuck with 3 soaked dried chillies, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 3 hours until it shreds. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime.
Gas station corn dogs with mustard
the long limo run north towards Eden

Frankfurts dipped in a sweet cornmeal batter and fried golden and crunchy on sticks, with yellow mustard and tomato sauce for dunking. Pat 8 frankfurts dry, skewer each on a stick and dust in flour. Whisk 150g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt with 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk into a thick batter, then pour into a tall glass. Dip each frankfurt to coat and fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
the corn growing on the Munson farm
Fresh corn cut off the cob folded into a batter of flour, egg, milk, spring onion and chilli, fried in spoonfuls until golden. Sour cream.
M: the one good dinner the Munsons share
Pan-fried pork chops with apple and onion gravy, mashed potato and green beans. Season 4 pork chops and pan-fry 4 minutes a side.
Casino hotel rib eye with peppercorn sauce
the casino hotel where they stop for a night

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and butter-basted, with a creamy green peppercorn and brandy sauce, crisp fries and a wedge salad. Salt 4 rib eye steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 800g frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, then add 40g butter, garlic and thyme and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. In the same pan add 1 diced shallot and 1 tbsp crushed green peppercorns, then 40ml brandy, 150ml beef stock and 150ml cream and reduce 3 minutes. Serve with fries and iceberg wedges with ranch.
W: Peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Logan's limo bourbon and maple sour
driving a hire limo to get by

Bourbon shaken with fresh lemon, maple syrup and egg white until foamy, served over a big cube with a pinch of smoked salt and an orange twist. For each drink, dry shake 60ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml maple syrup and half an egg white for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Add a tiny pinch of smoked salt on the foam and twist orange peel over the top.
T: One last ride. One good dinner.
D: An ageing Logan cares for a frail Charles Xavier and protects a young girl being hunted.
P: Serve the mains when the Munson family invite them in for dinner.

title: Wonder Woman
S: the hidden island of the Amazons
Olives, fresh figs, feta drizzled with honey and thyme, warm pita and haloumi griddled until golden with a squeeze of lemon, all on one big platter.
Beef mince, diced potato and onion seasoned with plenty of pepper, folded into shortcrust half moons, crimped, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. English mustard.
the village of Veld they free

Thick-cut potatoes double fried until crisp and golden, salted and served Belgian style in paper cones with a thick garlic mayonnaise. Cut 1.2kg floury potatoes into 1cm batons, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes until soft but pale, drain and rest 20 minutes. Fry again at 180C for 3 minutes until deep golden and crisp. Salt well. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 grated garlic clove, a squeeze of lemon and 1 tsp Dijon. Serve the frites in paper cones with the mayo on top.
M: the night the village celebrates and dances
Beef chuck browned, onions cooked slowly, dark beer, thyme, bay and a little mustard, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Frites.
Charlie, the sniper who sings at the piano

Scotland's smoked fish soup: smoked cod poached in milk with leek and potato, finished with cream and chives, with buttered oatcakes. Poach 500g smoked cod in 600ml milk with a bay leaf for 5 minutes, lift out and flake, keeping the milk. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 1 onion in 40g butter for 8 minutes. Add 600g diced potatoes and 400ml water and simmer 15 minutes. Mash about a third of the potato into the soup, then add the poaching milk, 100ml cream and the fish. Warm through, season with pepper and scatter chives. Serve with oatcakes and butter.
W: Diana's raspberry ripple ice cream cones
she tells the vendor he should be very proud

Rich vanilla custard ice cream churned and rippled with a sharp raspberry sauce, scooped into crisp waffle cones. Heat 300ml milk and 300ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 120g caster sugar, whisk in the hot milk and cook to 82C, stirring. Strain and chill overnight, then churn. Simmer 200g frozen raspberries with 50g sugar for 5 minutes, sieve and cool. Layer the ice cream and sauce in a container, swirl once with a knife and freeze 4 hours. Scoop into cones.
K: Veld Belgian ale with orange and honey
a toast in the freed village of Veld

Belgian white beer poured over a spoon of orange and honey syrup with a dash of lemon, served in stemmed glasses with a thick head and orange peel. Simmer the peeled zest of 1 orange with 60g honey, 60ml water and a pinch of crushed coriander seed for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Put 1 tbsp syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 chilled stemmed glasses. Pour a 330ml Belgian white ale slowly into each so it builds a head, and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
T: It's wonderful. You should be very proud.
D: An Amazon princess leaves her hidden island to stop a war she believes a god has started.
P: Serve dessert when Diana tastes ice cream for the first time in London.

title: Avengers: Endgame
S: Tony's quiet cabin by the lake with Morgan

Soft bread rolls filled with poached chicken, mayo, celery, chives and lemon, with crisp lettuce, packed in a basket with apple slices and strawberries. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred. Mix with 5 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 finely diced celery sticks, chopped chives, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper. Split 8 soft dinner rolls, butter them and fill with lettuce and chicken salad. Pack into a basket with sliced apple tossed in lemon and a punnet of strawberries.
Thor in New Asgard with his beer and video games

Baked potato skins scooped and crisped, filled with cheddar and crispy bacon, finished with sour cream, spring onion and a hit of hot sauce. Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins inside and out with oil and salt. Bake cut side down for 10 minutes, then turn over. Fry 6 rashers bacon until crisp and chop. Fill the skins with 200g grated cheddar and bacon and bake 8 minutes until bubbling. Top with sour cream, sliced spring onion and a few drops of hot sauce.
Scott back at the compound, eating a taco
Hard shell tacos with spiced beef mince, lettuce, cheddar and salsa, a few laid out on a plate for whoever wanders in.
M: Happy promises her as many as she wants
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion, tomato sauce and mustard on soft toasted buns, double stacked. Crinkle fries.
the time heist to the army base in 1970

A 1970 mess hall meatloaf of beef and pork with a sticky tomato glaze, sliced thick with mashed potato, buttered peas and onion gravy. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape on a lined tray. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, brush half over and bake at 180C for 50 minutes, adding the rest halfway. Serve with mash, buttered peas and gravy from 1 sliced onion, 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.
W: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered with fudge frosting and piped on top with 3000 in red and gold.
K: Tony and Morgan and the juice pops at the lake house

Frozen orange, mango and passionfruit juice blended into icy slushies, served in tall cups with a splash of vodka for the grown-ups if you want it. Freeze 500ml orange juice in ice cube trays overnight. Blend the juice cubes with 1 chopped mango, the pulp of 3 passionfruit, 200ml cold apple juice and 1 tbsp honey until slushy. Pour into tall cups with a straw. Stir 30ml vodka into any adult cups if you like.
T: Whatever it takes. Including cheeseburgers.
D: Five years after half of all life vanished, the surviving Avengers try one last plan to bring everyone back.
P: Serve the cheeseburgers when Happy promises Morgan all the cheeseburgers she wants.

title: Ant-Man
S: Luis telling a story that goes on and on
Corn tortillas rolled tight around chicken and cheese, baked until crisp and served with sour cream.
the ants that do all the work
Lavash brushed with oil, sprinkled with black and white sesame seeds in a trail pattern, baked crisp at 180C, with a whipped feta dip.
M: dinner at Hank Pym's old house in San Francisco

Salmon baked under a crust of breadcrumbs, parsley, lemon zest, parmesan and Dijon, with roast baby potatoes and a crunchy fennel and orange salad. Heat the oven to 200C. Toss 800g halved baby potatoes in oil and salt and roast 30 minutes. Mix 60g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, chopped parsley, the zest of a lemon and 2 tbsp melted butter. Spread 4 salmon fillets with 1 tsp Dijon each, press on the crumb and bake for 12 minutes. Shave 1 fennel bulb thin and toss with segments of 2 oranges, olive oil, lemon juice and salt.
Flour tortillas filled with grilled chicken, rice, black beans, cheese, salsa and sour cream, rolled tight and toasted in a dry pan.
W: Ice cream shop hot fudge brownie sundaes
the ice cream shop job he gets fired from

Warm fudgy brownie squares topped with vanilla ice cream, hot fudge sauce, whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 120g butter. Whisk in 200g caster sugar and 2 eggs, then fold in 80g plain flour and 2 tbsp cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 175C for 25 minutes and cool slightly. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and stir in 120g chopped dark chocolate until smooth. Put a warm brownie square in each bowl, top with 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, peanuts and a cherry.
K: everything shrunk down to ant size

Fresh lemonade blended with raspberries and mint, strained and served icy cold in shot glasses on a tray, a tiny raspberry on each rim. Blend 150g raspberries with the juice of 5 lemons, 100g caster sugar and a handful of mint, then strain into a jug. Add 500ml chilled soda water and stir. Line up shot glasses on a tray, fill each and hang a single raspberry on the rim. Keep the jug in the fridge for refills.
T: Small food. Big flavour.
D: A cat burglar fresh out of prison is recruited to wear a suit that shrinks him to the size of an ant.
P: Serve the snacks when Luis starts one of his very long stories.

title: The Sapphires
S: Talent quest party pies and sauce
the talent quest at the country pub where it starts

Homemade bite-size beef and gravy party pies with flaky puff tops, baked golden and served hot with tomato sauce, just like the country pub. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and 250ml beef stock and simmer 15 minutes until thick, then cool. Cut 24 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and press into mini muffin tins. Fill, top with rounds cut from 2 sheets puff pastry, pinch the edges and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

Short crusty rolls spread with pâté and mayo, stuffed with roast pork, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Julienne 1 carrot and a small daikon and pickle in 100ml rice vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt for 30 minutes. Rub 600g pork scotch fillet with fish sauce, garlic and honey and roast at 200C for 30 minutes, then rest and slice thin. Split 8 short crusty rolls and spread with 100g chicken liver pâté and mayonnaise. Fill with pork, drained pickles, cucumber, coriander and sliced chilli, and drizzle with soy.
home on the mission before the tour
Self-raising flour with butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife until just combined, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, served warm with butter and golden syrup.
M: Clear beef broth spiced with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon, over rice noodles and thin rare beef, with herbs, lime, chilli and bean sprouts. Char 1 halved onion and a thumb of ginger in a dry pan. Simmer 1.5kg beef bones with the onion, ginger, 4 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick and 4 cloves in 3 litres water for 4 hours, skimming. Strain and season with 3 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar. Soak 400g flat rice noodles. Slice 300g beef eye fillet paper thin. Put noodles and raw beef in bowls, pour over boiling broth and serve with Thai basil, mint, bean sprouts, lime and chilli.
Sunday at the troops' mess hall
Beef topside seasoned and roasted at 200C to 52C, rested and carved thin, with roast potatoes and pumpkin, peas and a gravy made in the roasting tin with flour and stock.
W: the mission back home on the Murray

Butter sponge cut into cubes, dipped in thin chocolate icing, rolled in desiccated coconut, set on a rack. Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour and cut into cubes. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack.
K: Strong dark coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and poured over ice. Brew 500ml very strong coffee from 60g dark ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of 4 glasses, pour over the hot coffee and stir. Fill with ice and serve straight away.
T: Four voices. One stage. A lot of soul.
D: In 1968, four young Aboriginal women from a country mission form a soul group and tour Vietnam to sing for the troops.
P: Serve the mains when the Sapphires hit the stage for the troops in Vietnam.

title: Animal Kingdom
S: Lamb shoulder strips marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled hot, wrapped in small pieces of warm pita with tomato, onion and garlic yoghurt.
Footy night pork and fennel sausage rolls
the boys on the couch with the footy on

Pork mince with fennel seed, grated apple and herbs rolled in flaky puff, sesame on top, baked golden and served hot with tomato relish. Mix 600g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 grated apple, 2 tsp toasted crushed fennel seeds, 40g breadcrumbs, chopped parsley, salt and pepper. Halve 3 sheets puff pastry, pipe a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal. Cut each into 4, brush with egg and sprinkle sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with tomato relish.
a bowl on the coffee table at the Cody house
French onion dip of onions cooked slowly 40 minutes, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives, and thick ridged chips.
M: Smurf's roast lamb with mint sauce

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary and roasted pink, with crisp potatoes and pumpkin, peas, a proper gravy and sharp homemade mint sauce. Heat the oven to 220C. Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic slivers and rosemary, rub with oil and salt and roast 20 minutes, then at 180C for 60 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes and 600g pumpkin in oil alongside. Rest the lamb 20 minutes. Make gravy from the tray juices, 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock. Pour 60ml boiling water over 2 tbsp sugar, stir in a cup of chopped mint and 80ml malt vinegar for the sauce. Cook 300g peas.

Chicken breast crumbed and fried, topped with ham, Napoli sauce and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling, with chips and salad. Halve 2 chicken breasts and crumb them in flour, egg and panko. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Top with sliced ham, a spoon of crushed tomato simmered with garlic, and grated mozzarella. Grill until bubbling and serve with hot chips and a green salad.
W: Puff pastry sheets baked flat, filled with a thick vanilla custard set with cornflour, topped with passionfruit icing, chilled and cut.
K: the detective who keeps checking on J

The Aussie pub classic: lime cordial, fresh lemon and a good dash of aromatic bitters topped with lemonade over ice, pink and sharp. Fill 4 pot glasses with ice. Add 20ml lime cordial, the juice of a quarter lemon and 4 good dashes of aromatic bitters to each. Top with cold lemonade, stir once and add a lemon wedge. A pot of cold lager on the side for anyone after one.
T: Crooks always come undone. Dinner doesn't.
D: A Melbourne teenager moves in with his grandmother and her family of armed robbers.
P: Serve the mains when Smurf puts dinner on the table for her boys.

title: Wolf Creek
S: the last roadhouse before the crater
Beef chuck braised in stock and Worcestershire for 2.5 hours, thickened, in shortcrust with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. Tomato sauce on top.
Self-raising flour with butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife, wrapped around green sticks over coals or baked in a round at 200C for 30 minutes, with butter and golden syrup.
Road trip honey soy roasted nuts

Cashews, almonds and peanuts roasted in honey, soy, chilli and sesame until glossy and crunchy, tossed with dried mango and bagged up for the car. Heat the oven to 160C. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil and half a teaspoon of chilli flakes. Toss through 200g cashews, 150g almonds and 150g peanuts with 1 tbsp sesame seeds. Spread on a lined tray and roast 20 to 25 minutes, stirring twice, until golden. Cool fully on the tray, break up and mix with 100g chopped dried mango.
M: the friendly bushie with the tow truck

Thick beef sausages cooked slowly over low coals, turned often until browned and cooked through, onions fried on a hotplate with butter, folded into white bread with tomato sauce. Cook 8 thick beef sausages slowly over low coals or a barbecue, turning often until browned and cooked through. Fry 2 sliced onions in butter on the hotplate until soft and golden. Fold each sausage into a slice of white bread with onions and tomato sauce.
the coast at Broome where the trip begins

Barramundi fillets in a crisp lager batter, fried golden, with thick chips, lemon wedges and a homemade tartare sauce of capers, gherkin and dill. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C for 6 minutes, drain, then again at 180C for 3 minutes. Whisk 200g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml cold lager. Dust 800g barramundi pieces in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped capers, gherkins, dill and lemon for tartare.
W: a freezing night in the desert
Scone dough of self-raising flour, butter and milk dropped in spoonfuls into simmering golden syrup, butter, brown sugar and water, covered and cooked 20 minutes until puffed. Cream.
K: Stopped-watches billy tea with lemon myrtle
every watch dies at the crater

Strong black tea boiled in the billy with dried lemon myrtle and a gum leaf, swung to settle and sweetened with condensed milk in tin mugs. Bring 1.2 litres water to the boil in a billy or saucepan. Throw in 3 tbsp loose black tea, 1 tsp dried lemon myrtle and a clean gum leaf if you have one, then take off the heat for 2 minutes. Swing the billy or tap the side to settle the leaves. Pour into tin mugs and stir in a spoon of sweetened condensed milk to taste.
T: Stay off the dirt roads. Stay for dinner.
D: Three backpackers on an outback road trip run into a friendly bushman who turns out to be anything but.
P: Serve the snacks when the backpackers stop at the roadhouse.

title: Lion
S: lost on the streets of Kolkata
Potato and pea filling with cumin, chilli and garam masala folded into pastry cones, fried at 175C until blistered. Tamarind chutney.
growing up with his new family in Hobart
Tasmanian smoked salmon folded onto buttered rye, topped with crème fraîche whipped with lemon zest, a few capers, fresh dill and a crack of black pepper.
the train that carries him far from home

Crumbly Indian shortbread biscuits with cardamom, ghee and pistachio, baked pale and cracked on top, served with small cups of hot sweet chai. Beat 100g ghee with 100g icing sugar until fluffy. Mix in 150g plain flour, 30g fine semolina, half a teaspoon of ground cardamom and a pinch of baking powder. Roll into 16 balls, press a pistachio on each and bake at 170C for 15 minutes until pale and cracked. Simmer 500ml water with 2 tbsp loose black tea, ginger and 4 crushed cardamom pods for 3 minutes, add 500ml milk and sugar, simmer 2 minutes and strain.
M: the family he left behind in a small village
Yellow split peas simmered with turmeric until soft, tempered with ghee, cumin seeds, garlic and dried chilli, served with basmati and flatbreads.
Hobart roast lamb with honey roast veg

Tasmanian lamb leg roasted with garlic and rosemary, with honey-roasted carrots, parsnips and potatoes, peas and a rich pan gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary, rub with oil and salt and roast 20 minutes, then at 180C for 60 minutes. Toss 1kg potatoes, 3 carrots and 2 parsnips in oil and 1 tbsp honey and roast alongside for the last hour. Rest the lamb 20 minutes. Make gravy with the tray juices, 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock. Cook 300g peas and carve.
W: the sweet that brings his memory back
Batter of flour, yoghurt and a pinch of saffron rested overnight, piped in spirals into 170C oil, fried crisp, soaked in warm cardamom and saffron sugar syrup.
K: Black tea simmered with milk, sugar, cardamom, ginger, cinnamon and clove for 5 minutes, strained into cups.
T: A long way home. A good meal waiting.
D: A boy lost thousands of kilometres from home in India is adopted in Tasmania and searches for his family as an adult.
P: Serve dessert when Saroo sees the jalebi at the party in Melbourne.

title: Australia
S: the cattle drive across the Top End
Self-raising flour with butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, with butter and golden syrup.
the ball in Darwin where the Drover turns up in a white dinner jacket

Crisp puff pastry cases filled with prawns in a lemony dill and mayo dressing, topped with a whole prawn, chives and a pinch of paprika. Bake 16 ready-made vol-au-vent cases at 180C for 8 minutes and cool. Peel 500g cooked prawns, keep 16 whole for the tops and chop the rest. Mix the chopped prawns with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest and juice of half a lemon, chopped dill and a pinch of salt. Fill the cases, top each with a whole prawn, snipped chives and a dusting of paprika.
Corned silverside simmered 3 hours with onion and peppercorns, sliced thin onto buttered bread with hot mustard and mustard pickles.
M: supper by the fire on the drive
Beef chuck browned in a camp oven, onion, carrot, potato and stock, covered and cooked over coals or at 160C for 3 hours, thyme and pepper.
Darwin crisp-skin barra with lemon myrtle
Darwin in 1942, on the edge of the war

Barramundi pan-fried skin side down until crackling crisp, with lemon myrtle butter, a mango and chilli salsa and coconut rice. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water. Dice 1 mango with half a red onion, 1 red chilli, coriander and lime juice. Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets, salt well and cook skin side down in a hot oiled pan, pressing flat, for 5 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp dried lemon myrtle and a squeeze of lemon and spoon over.
W: Meringue with a little ground wattleseed folded in, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, mango and passionfruit.
K: Drover's rum and ginger beer billy punch
the Drover pushing 1500 head to Darwin

Dark rum, spicy ginger beer, fresh lime and a splash of billy tea mixed in a big pot over ice, served in enamel mugs with mint. Brew 400ml strong black tea and chill. In a large pot or jug mix the tea with 240ml dark rum, the juice of 4 limes and 3 tbsp brown sugar, stirring to dissolve. Add plenty of ice and top with 750ml cold ginger beer. Ladle into enamel mugs with a lime wedge and mint. Leave out the rum for a booze-free pot.
T: Drive the cattle north. Eat like a drover.
D: An English aristocrat and a rough drover take a herd of cattle across northern Australia on the eve of war.
P: Serve the mains when the drive makes camp for the night.

title: Moulin Rouge!
S: Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette and lemon.
Choux pastry with gruyère and a pinch of nutmeg, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
the can-can dancers kicking across the stage

A whole camembert baked molten with garlic, thyme and honey, topped with a shower of roasted grapes and walnuts, with crisp baguette for dunking. Heat the oven to 180C. Score a 250g camembert, push in slivers of 1 garlic clove and thyme sprigs and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey. Roast 200g red grapes on the vine with oil and salt alongside. Bake the cheese in its box or a small dish for 15 minutes until molten. Toast 40g walnuts. Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast for 8 minutes. Top the cheese with grapes, walnuts and a little more honey.
M: the private supper with the Duke in the elephant
Duck breast scored and rendered skin side down, roasted to pink, rested, with a cherry and red wine sauce and pommes purée.
the bohemians who come crashing through Christian's ceiling

Dry-brined sirloin seared hard in cast iron, sliced over skinny double-fried frites, with café de Paris butter melting on top and a sharp watercress salad. Salt 4 sirloin steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Mash 100g soft butter with 1 tsp Dijon, 1 chopped anchovy, 1 small garlic clove, chopped parsley, tarragon and capers, roll into a log and chill. Fry 1kg skinny cut potatoes at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 185C for 3 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side to 54C, rest 5 minutes and slice. Top with butter coins and serve with frites and dressed watercress.
W: the red windmill on the roof
Sweet pastry blind baked at 180C, filled with chilled vanilla crème pâtissière, covered edge to edge in raspberries and brushed with warm raspberry jam to make them shine.
K: the absinthe that brings out the green fairy
A small measure of absinthe dripped over a sugar cube into cold water until cloudy, or a sparkling green apple and mint soda.
T: Come what may. Order the champagne.
D: A young writer falls for the star of a Paris nightclub promised to a jealous duke.
P: Serve the drinks when Toulouse brings out the green absinthe.

title: The Wog Boy
S: Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with feta, ricotta, dill, spring onion and egg, wrapped in buttered filo triangles, baked at 190C for 25 minutes.
the cheese that's set on fire at the table

Kefalograviera dusted in flour and fried in olive oil until crusty, flamed at the table with a splash of brandy, then hit with lemon, honey and oregano. Cut 400g kefalograviera or haloumi into 2cm thick slabs, wet with water and dust in plain flour. Fry in 3 tbsp hot olive oil for 2 minutes a side until a deep golden crust forms. Move the pan to the table on a board, pour over 30ml warmed brandy and carefully light it, standing back. When the flame dies, squeeze over a lemon, drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and sprinkle with dried oregano. Serve with warm pita.
always on the Greek family table
Tzatziki of grated cucumber, yoghurt, garlic and dill, and taramasalata, with warm pita and olives.
M: Karamitsos family lamb on the spit
Steve's family, out the back in Sydney

Lamb shoulder rubbed with lemon, garlic, oregano and olive oil, roasted at 150C for 5 hours until it falls apart, with lemon potatoes roasted in the juices. Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it falls apart. Add 1kg potato wedges to the pan for the last 90 minutes so they soak up the juices, then uncover to brown.
Pork souvlaki wraps with chips inside
a quick bite on the way to the TV studio

Lemon and oregano pork skewers charred hot, wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion and a handful of salty chips inside, Sydney late-night style. Marinate 800g diced pork shoulder in 4 tbsp olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and salt for 2 hours. Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning. Bake 400g frozen chips at 220C for 20 minutes and salt well. Warm 4 large pita breads, spread with tzatziki and fill with pork, sliced tomato, red onion, parsley and chips, then roll tight in paper.
W: Yeasted batter spooned into hot oil at 175C, fried until puffed and golden, soaked in warm honey syrup with cinnamon and walnuts.
K: Finely ground coffee boiled in a small pot with water and sugar until it foams, poured into small cups, grounds left to settle.
T: Sydney, sunshine and a very big Greek feed.
D: A carefree Greek-Australian bloke from Sydney accidentally becomes a TV star.
P: Serve the mains when the whole family sits down to the Greek feast.

title: Kenny
S: the big day at the races in Melbourne
Smoked salmon on warm blinis with crème fraîche, cooked prawns in shot glasses with a little Marie Rose sauce, and asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto.
Splashdown pork and apple sausage rolls
the footy crowds Kenny's Splashdown crew works

Pork mince with grated apple, sage and a kick of chilli rolled in flaky puff, fennel seed on top, baked golden with smoky tomato relish. Mix 600g pork mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, chopped sage, half a teaspoon of chilli flakes, 40g breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Halve 3 sheets of puff pastry, pipe a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal. Cut each into 4, brush with egg and scatter with fennel seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with smoky tomato relish.
Kenny's portaloo company, on the job

Thick chips double fried at 140C then 190C, tossed in chicken salt, with gravy for dipping. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes until soft, then drain and rest. Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Toss in chicken salt and serve with a cup of hot gravy for dipping.
M: his trip to the convention in Nashville

Buttermilk-brined chicken thighs fried crunchy and painted with a cayenne and brown sugar chilli oil, on white bread with dill pickles and slaw. Soak 1kg chicken thigh fillets in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce and salt for 4 hours. Dredge in 250g plain flour seasoned with salt, pepper and paprika, dip back in the buttermilk, then dredge again. Fry at 165C for 7 to 8 minutes until cooked. Whisk 2 tbsp cayenne, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp paprika into 120ml of the hot frying oil and brush over. Serve on white bread with pickles and coleslaw.
tea at his grumpy dad's place
Lamb loin chops rubbed with rosemary, garlic and salt, grilled hot for 3 minutes a side and rested, with buttery mashed potato, peas and a proper gravy from the pan juices.
W: Two sheets of puff pastry baked flat between trays, a thick custard of milk, eggs, sugar and cornflour poured between them, set overnight, topped with passionfruit icing and cut with a hot knife.
K: knock-off drinks after a long day on the job

Cold Aussie lager poured over lime, tomato juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce in a chilli salt rimmed glass, plenty of ice and a lime wedge. Mix 1 tbsp sea salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of 4 pot glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Into each glass put ice, 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, a dash of Worcestershire and 3 drops of hot sauce. Top slowly with cold lager, stir once and add a lime wedge.
T: Every big event needs a bloke like Kenny.
D: A mockumentary following a cheerful Melbourne bloke who runs portable toilets for big events.
P: Serve the mains when Kenny works the Melbourne Cup.

title: Red Dog
S: Dampier pub loaded chicken salt chips
the pub in Dampier where the stories get told

Thick double-fried chips hit with chicken salt, smothered in gravy and melted cheddar, with pickled jalapeño and spring onion on top. Cut 1.2kg potatoes into thick chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Toss with 2 tsp chicken salt. Make gravy: melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml beef stock and a dash of Worcestershire and simmer until thick. Pile the chips on a tray, scatter with 150g grated cheddar, pour over the hot gravy and top with sliced pickled jalapeño and spring onion.
the crib room at the mine
Sausage mince with grated onion and carrot rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
Pilbara coast, barbie down by the water
Tender squid scored and charred on a hot barbecue with chilli, garlic and lime. Score 600g cleaned squid tubes and cut into pieces.
M: the bus driver who becomes Red Dog's one master

Thick beef sausages and rump steaks grilled over coals, onions fried on the hotplate, with potato salad dressed in mayo and chives and a stack of white bread. Boil 1kg potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and 4 rump steaks over hot coals. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate until golden. Serve it all with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.
Pilbara barra tacos with lime slaw
the coast up north near the mine

Spice-dusted barramundi seared on a hot plate, flaked into charred tortillas with lime and chilli slaw, pickled red onion and a smoky chipotle mayo. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin and salt and rub over 800g barramundi fillets. Pickle 1 sliced red onion in lime juice and salt. Toss a quarter cabbage, shredded, with lime juice, chilli and coriander. Mix 120g mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle. Sear the fish in a hot oiled pan for 3 minutes a side and flake. Char 12 small flour tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion and mayo.
W: Butter sponge cut into cubes, dipped in raspberry jelly that's just starting to set, rolled in desiccated coconut, chilled until firm. Red and fluffy.
K: the mining town pub on a hot night

Ice-cold lager cut half and half with fresh ruby grapefruit soda, red-tinged and sharp, served in frosty stubby holders with a grapefruit wedge. Juice 2 ruby grapefruits and stir with 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then mix with 400ml cold soda water. Chill well. Half fill 4 tall glasses or stubby holder cups with cold lager, top with the grapefruit soda and add a grapefruit wedge. Serve the grapefruit soda on its own for the drivers.
T: Every town needs a dog like this.
D: The true-ish story of a wandering red kelpie who united a mining town in the Pilbara.
P: Serve the mains when the miners at the pub start telling Red Dog stories.

title: Two Hands
S: the beach where the money goes missing
Flathead dusted in flour, dipped in a batter of flour and ice-cold lager, fried at 180C for 4 minutes, with thick chips, lemon and tartare, wrapped in paper and eaten on the sand.
Small beef pies braised 2.5 hours in stock and Worcestershire, baked in shortcrust with a puff lid, served sitting in mushy peas with tomato sauce on top.
the gangster's crew killing time at his place

Thick potato slices dipped in a crisp batter and fried golden, the fish-shop classic, hit with chicken salt and served with tomato sauce and lemon. Peel 3 large potatoes and slice 1cm thick, then simmer for 4 minutes until just tender and pat dry. Whisk 150g self-raising flour, a pinch of salt and 230ml ice-cold soda water into a batter. Dust the slices in flour, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain, sprinkle with chicken salt and serve with tomato sauce and lemon.
M: a night out in the city
Squid scored and cut, dusted in rice flour and Sichuan salt and pepper, fried at 190C for 60 seconds, tossed with chilli and spring onion, with egg fried rice.
Suburban Sunday roast pork and crackling
the family house out in the suburbs

Pork belly roasted until the crackling shatters, with crisp potatoes, honey pumpkin, apple sauce and gravy, the full Sydney Sunday spread. Score the skin of a 1.5kg pork belly, pat dry, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 90 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes and 600g pumpkin drizzled with honey alongside for the last hour. Simmer 3 chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and water until soft for sauce. Make gravy with the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: an Aussie dessert for a Sydney summer
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar until glossy, cornflour and vinegar folded in, baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with cream and passionfruit.
K: the $10,000 that goes missing at Bondi

Cold lager topped with fresh passionfruit and lime soda in chilled schooner glasses, a passionfruit half floating on top. Stir the pulp of 4 passionfruit, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then add 400ml cold soda water. Pour 200ml cold lager into each of 4 chilled schooner glasses, top with the passionfruit soda and float half a passionfruit on top.
T: Ten grand. One bad afternoon at the beach.
D: A young Kings Cross doorman loses a gangster's money at Bondi and has a day to get it back.
P: Serve the snacks when Jimmy heads down to Bondi.

title: Django Unchained
S: the German dentist who pours his own beer
Pretzel dough proved, shaped, dipped in hot bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with grainy mustard and butter.
riding through Texas on the bounty trail
Beef topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and smoked paprika overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
the winter they spend bounty hunting in the snow

Smoky beans baked low with thick-cut bacon, molasses, mustard and chilli until sticky, topped with crunchy fried shallots and served with cornbread. Fry 250g diced thick bacon until crisp, add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 drained tins cannellini beans, 1 tin crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Dijon, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 200ml water. Cover and bake at 160C for 90 minutes, uncovering for the last 20. Top with fried shallots and serve with warm cornbread.
M: Dr Schultz and the German legend he tells Django
Bratwurst grilled slowly until browned, sauerkraut braised with white wine, apple and caraway, buttered potatoes.
Bounty hunter rib eye and skillet spuds
a campfire supper on the trail

Heavily peppered rib eye seared in cast iron and butter-basted, with crisp skillet potatoes and onions and a smoky bourbon steak sauce. Season 4 rib eye steaks heavily with salt and cracked pepper. Fry 1kg diced parboiled potatoes and 1 sliced onion in a cast iron pan with oil and butter for 15 minutes until crisp. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side, basting with butter, garlic and thyme, then rest. Simmer 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp bourbon, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp smoked paprika for 3 minutes.
W: Stephen serves it at the big dinner

Light white butter cake with fluffy vanilla frosting, served in tall slices. Beat 170g butter with 300g sugar, add 4 egg whites and vanilla, then fold in 300g plain flour, 3 tsp baking powder and 250ml milk.
K: the dentist pours two beers at the empty saloon

Cloudy German wheat beer poured slow into tall mugs over a spoon of lemon and honey syrup, a thick head and a lemon wheel on the rim. Simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and the peeled zest of a lemon for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. Add 1 tbsp syrup and a squeeze of lemon to each of 4 chilled tall mugs. Pour in a 500ml German wheat beer slowly, tilting the mug, then straighten to build a thick head. Hang a lemon wheel on each rim.
T: The D is silent. The beer isn't.
D: A freed man teams up with a German bounty hunter to rescue his wife.
P: Serve the beer when Dr Schultz pours two at the empty saloon.

title: True Grit
S: the ones Rooster and LaBoeuf shoot out of the sky
Fine cornmeal, salt and bacon fat mixed with boiling water, shaped into small oval cakes, fried in a cast iron pan until crisp, eaten warm with butter.
Mattie's room at the boarding house
Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and served with butter and sorghum or golden syrup.
LaBoeuf's ham and cheddar hand pies

Flaky saddlebag pies of smoked ham, sharp cheddar and grainy mustard, baked golden, with pickled onions and a tangy apple relish. Cut 2 sheets of shortcrust pastry into 8 rounds. Mix 200g diced smoked ham, 150g grated sharp cheddar, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and chopped parsley. Spoon onto half of each round, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 22 minutes until golden. Serve warm with pickled onions and apple relish.
M: supper on the trail through Indian Territory
Beef chuck browned in a camp oven, onion, carrot and potato added with stock and thyme, the lid on, cooked over low coals or at 160C for 3 hours until thick.
the boarding house table in Fort Smith

Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, fried crisp in cast iron, with honey drizzle, warm biscuits and a vinegar slaw. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces in 400ml buttermilk, 1 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt overnight. Dredge in 250g plain flour mixed with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper. Shallow fry in 3cm oil at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked to 75C. Toss shredded cabbage with cider vinegar, sugar and salt. Serve with honey drizzled over and warm biscuits.
W: Mattie haggles Stonehill down to the cent
Soft, chewy molasses spice cookies rolled in sugar, the kind you'd carry in a saddlebag.
K: Rooster is rarely without a bottle

Bourbon stirred with honey, lemon and hot water, a cinnamon stick and clove-studded lemon in a tin cup. Hot apple and honey for Mattie. Put 1 tbsp honey and the juice of a quarter lemon in each of 4 tin cups or mugs. Add 45ml bourbon to each, top with 150ml just-boiled water and stir. Drop in a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with 3 cloves. Make Mattie's version with hot apple juice in place of the bourbon and water.
T: Real grit. Real cornbread.
D: A determined 14-year-old hires a hard-drinking marshal to track down her father's killer.
P: Serve the cornbread when Rooster and LaBoeuf start shooting corn dodgers out of the air.

title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
S: Tuco marching Blondie across the desert
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in salt and chilli, with a smoky charred tomato salsa.
Father Ramirez's focaccia and warm olives
the mission where Tuco's brother is a priest

Dimpled rosemary focaccia baked golden in good oil, with olives warmed through with orange peel, fennel seed and chilli. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 2 tsp salt and 400ml warm water and prove for 2 hours. Tip into an oiled 30 x 20cm tin with 4 tbsp olive oil, stretch to the edges, dimple with your fingers and prove 30 minutes. Scatter rosemary and flaky salt and bake at 220C for 22 minutes. Warm 300g mixed olives in olive oil with orange peel, 1 tsp fennel seeds and chilli flakes for 5 minutes.
the gold buried in the grave
Small potatoes sliced into coins, roasted at 220C in olive oil until golden and crisp, salted, with a garlic aioli.
M: the meal Angel Eyes eats at the farmer's table
Borlotti beans simmered 2 hours with smoked ham hock, onion, garlic, tomato and rosemary until thick, with crusty bread.
Tuco's spaghetti with beef and pork ragù
Tuco and his brother at the mission

Spaghetti tossed through a slow-cooked beef and pork ragù with red wine and tomato, finished with pecorino, chilli oil and torn basil. Brown 500g beef mince and 300g pork mince. Add 1 diced onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick and 3 garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes. Pour in 150ml red wine, then 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 2 tbsp tomato paste, and simmer gently for 2 hours, adding water if needed. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss through the ragù with a splash of pasta water, then top with grated pecorino, chilli oil and basil.
W: the graveyard where the gold is buried
Chocolate mousse in cups, topped with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and a little gold-wrapped chocolate coin buried in each.
K: Rye whisky stirred down with demerara syrup, orange bitters and a strip of orange peel, served over one big ice cube in a heavy glass. Stir 60g demerara sugar with 60ml hot water until dissolved, then cool. For each drink, stir 60ml rye whisky, 10ml of the syrup and 2 dashes of orange bitters with ice for 30 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.
T: There are two kinds of people. Those who eat, and those who cook.
D: Three gunslingers race each other to a fortune in gold buried in a Civil War cemetery.
P: Serve the mains when Angel Eyes sits down to eat at the farmer's table.

title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
S: Butch and Etta on the bicycle in the morning

Crusty baguettes spread with salted butter and grainy mustard, filled with leg ham, sharp cheddar, crisp apple and cornichons, wrapped in paper. Split 2 baguettes lengthways and cut each in half. Spread with salted butter and wholegrain mustard. Layer with 250g leg ham, 150g sliced sharp cheddar, 1 thinly sliced green apple and halved cornichons. Press closed, wrap tightly in baking paper and tie with string.
the gang's new life in Bolivia

Sweet golden pastry turnovers crimped along the top, filled with a juicy spiced beef, potato, pea and olive stew, with a spoon of hot salsa. Cook 400g beef mince with 1 onion, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and a chopped chilli, then add 1 diced boiled potato, 80g peas, 6 chopped olives and 150ml stock thickened with 1 tsp gelatine, and chill until set. Make dough from 400g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 100g melted butter, 1 egg and 150ml warm water. Roll 10 rounds, fill, fold and crimp along the top. Brush with egg and bake at 220C for 18 minutes.
the safe they blow with far too much dynamite
Pretzel rods dipped two-thirds in melted red candy melts, a short piece of liquorice strap pushed into the top as a fuse, set on baking paper for 20 minutes.
M: Beef chuck diced and browned, braised with dried chillies, cumin, garlic and tomato for 3 hours. Cornbread.
the long trip south to Bolivia

Chicken thighs simmered with onion, red chilli, tomato, cumin and quinoa until thick, finished with fresh herbs, lime and a hot llajwa salsa. Brown 1kg chicken thighs in oil, then add 1 diced onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and 1 tsp cumin. Add 2 diced tomatoes, 150g rinsed quinoa and 1 litre chicken stock, cover and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Blend 3 tomatoes, 2 red chillies, coriander and salt for llajwa. Finish the stew with parsley and lime and serve with the salsa.
W: the bicycle ride with the song playing
Butter and sugar creamed, eggs and lemon zest beaten in, flour folded through, baked in a loaf tin at 170C for 45 minutes, soaked hot with lemon syrup and topped with thin lemon icing.
K: who are those guys? one more before Bolivia

Bourbon shaken with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky, served over ice with a dash of bitters on the foam and a cherry. For each drink, dry shake 50ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain into a glass over ice. Shake 2 drops of aromatic bitters onto the foam and add a cherry.
T: Too much dynamite. Just enough dinner.
D: Two outlaws flee a relentless posse all the way to Bolivia.
P: Serve the snacks when Butch takes Etta for a ride on the bicycle.

title: Encino Man
S: Link's ice block cheddar cheese ball
the caveman frozen in a block of ice

Sharp cheddar and cream cheese beaten with pickled jalapeño and smoked paprika, rolled in crushed pretzels and bacon, served on ice with crackers. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g grated sharp cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapeño, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp Worcestershire. Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 2 hours. Fry 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble with 60g crushed pretzels and chopped chives. Roll the ball in the crumb and serve on a plate of crushed ice with crackers.
Chicken drumsticks rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and brown sugar, roasted at 220C for 40 minutes until sticky, eaten with your hands like a caveman.
the backyard where they dig the pool

Corn chips baked under black beans, chorizo and two cheeses, piled with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeño and a squeeze of lime. Fry 1 diced chorizo until crisp. Layer 300g corn chips on a tray with the chorizo, 1 drained tin black beans, 150g grated cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella, and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top the nachos with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeños, coriander and lime wedges.
M: the backyard pool where they dig him up
Chicken thigh skewers marinated in teriyaki, ginger and garlic, grilled and served with rice and sesame.
a big hunk of meat for a big appetite

Pork ribs rubbed in brown sugar and smoked paprika, baked low until tender, then charred under the grill with sticky barbecue glaze. Eat with your hands. Mix 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Mix 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Unwrap the ribs, brush with the glaze and grill for 5 minutes a side until sticky and charred. Serve with coleslaw.
W: Greek yoghurt mixed with honey and vanilla, spread thin on a tray, scattered with berries and crushed nuts, frozen 4 hours, broken into shards.
K: Stoney and Link wheezin' the juice in 1990s Encino

Mango, banana, pineapple and orange juice blended thick and frosty, with a swirl of strawberry purée up the glass like a California sunset. Blend 200g frozen strawberries with 1 tbsp honey and spoon into the bottom of 4 tall glasses. Blend 2 chopped mangoes, 2 frozen bananas, 200g pineapple, 400ml orange juice and a handful of ice until thick. Pour slowly over the strawberry so it swirls up the sides and serve with a straw.
T: Thawed out and ready to eat, buddy.
D: Two high school losers dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard and pass him off as an exchange student.
P: Serve the snacks when Link is thawed out in the garage.

title: Jingle All the Way
S: Gingerbread dough rolled thin, cut into little men, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, piped with white icing buttons. Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 120g golden syrup. Stir into 375g flour, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda and 3 tsp ground ginger with 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut 20 men. Bake at 180C for 9 minutes, cool and pipe buttons with 100g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.
the too-perfect neighbour always popping over

Crisp vanilla butter cookies cut into stars and trees, iced with flawless white royal icing and finished with silver cachous and sprinkles. Beat 200g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 350g plain flour and a pinch of salt, chill 30 minutes, roll 5mm thick and cut stars and trees. Bake at 180C for 9 minutes and cool. Beat 1 egg white with 250g icing sugar and lemon juice to thick icing, pipe outlines, flood the centres and decorate with cachous and sprinkles.
the Christmas parade at the end
Popcorn tossed in white chocolate with red and green sprinkles and a pinch of salt, spread on a tray to set.
M: the family Christmas in the Minnesota cold

Leg ham scored and glazed with maple, mustard and orange, roasted sticky and dark, with buttery mash, honey carrots and a cranberry relish. Heat the oven to 180C. Peel the rind off a 3kg cooked half leg ham, score the fat in diamonds and stud with cloves. Simmer 125ml maple syrup, 2 tbsp Dijon, the juice of an orange and 2 tbsp brown sugar for 3 minutes. Roast the ham for 50 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Serve with mash, carrots roasted in honey and cranberry sauce stirred with orange zest.
the neighbour who always gets there first

Beef mince and onion in a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with tater tots and cheddar, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until crisp. Brown 600g beef mince with an onion and 200g mushrooms. Stir in 250ml cream and simmer until thick. Tip into a dish, cover with 500g frozen tater tots and 100g cheddar and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until crisp.
W: Dark chocolate spread thin, set, covered with white chocolate and crushed candy canes, set again and broken into shards.
K: Christmas Eve at home, finally, Turbo-Man in hand

Rich vanilla eggnog of yolks, milk and cream cooked gently with cinnamon, nutmeg and a little maple, chilled and topped with whipped cream. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 80g caster sugar until pale. Heat 500ml milk and 250ml cream with a cinnamon stick and a grating of nutmeg until steaming. Whisk into the yolks, return to the pan and stir over low heat to 75C until it coats the spoon. Strain, stir in 1 tbsp maple syrup and 1 tsp vanilla, and chill 4 hours. Serve topped with whipped cream and more nutmeg.
T: One toy left. One very long Christmas Eve.
D: A workaholic dad races around the city on Christmas Eve to find the year's must-have action figure.
P: Serve the snacks when Howard hits the toy store on Christmas Eve.

title: Miracle on 34th Street
S: Parade chestnuts in sage brown butter
warming up along the 1947 Thanksgiving parade route

Chestnuts scored and roasted until they split, peeled warm and tossed in nutty brown butter with crisp sage, maple and flaky salt. Cut a cross in the flat side of 600g chestnuts and soak in water for 10 minutes. Roast at 220C for 25 minutes until the shells open, then wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes and peel while warm. Melt 60g butter until it foams and turns nutty brown, add 12 sage leaves and fry until crisp. Toss in the chestnuts with 1 tbsp maple syrup and flaky salt.
the long line to sit on Santa's knee

Brown butter shortbread rounds dipped in white chocolate and crushed candy cane, the kind Kris might hand out to the children in line. Brown 200g butter until nutty, chill until soft-set, then beat with 90g caster sugar. Mix in 250g plain flour, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Roll into a log, chill 30 minutes, slice into 20 rounds and bake at 160C for 18 minutes. Cool, dip half of each in 150g melted white chocolate and sprinkle with crushed candy cane.
the sacks of letters dumped on the judge's bench

Celery sticks filled with cream cheese whipped with blue cheese and chives, and crackers with sharp cheddar. Beat 250g cream cheese with 50g blue cheese and snipped chives until smooth. Cut celery into short sticks and pipe or spoon the filling along each. Serve on a platter beside crackers topped with slices of vintage cheddar, the way a 1940s party did it.
M: the Thanksgiving Kris spends with Doris and Susan

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy with herb butter, cornbread and sage stuffing, buttery mash, cranberry sauce and a deep pan gravy. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast roll in 2 litres water with 100g salt and 50g sugar overnight. Pat dry, rub with 50g herb butter and roast at 170C to 70C inside, about 80 minutes. Rest 15 minutes. Bake 300g crumbled cornbread with 1 diced onion softened in butter, sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk. Make gravy from the tray juices, flour and 300ml stock.
Fred Gailey's New York pot roast
the lawyer across the hall who takes Kris's case

Beef chuck seared, onion, carrot and celery, red wine and stock, braised at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes for the last hour. Sear a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots and 2 celery sticks, then 250ml red wine and enough water to come halfway. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Slice and serve with the juices.
W: Christmas in the house Susan wished for
Dried fruit soaked overnight in brandy, mixed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, breadcrumbs, flour and spice, steamed 4 hours, flamed at the table. Custard.
K: Cloudy apple juice mulled with maple, cinnamon, star anise and orange, ladled steaming into mugs with a cinnamon stick and a clove-studded orange slice. Pour 1.5 litres cloudy apple juice into a pot with 3 tbsp maple syrup, 2 cinnamon sticks, 3 star anise, 6 cloves and 1 sliced orange. Bring to a simmer, then keep just below simmering for 20 minutes. Strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice studded with cloves to each.
T: Faith is believing. Dinner is eating.
D: A kindly old man hired as a department store Santa insists he's the real thing, and ends up in court.
P: Serve the mains when Kris shares Thanksgiving dinner with Doris and Susan.

title: The Polar Express
S: Polar Express turkey and cranberry rolls
the long ride north through the night

Soft rolls filled with roast turkey, brie, cranberry sauce and baby spinach, warmed until the cheese melts, wrapped in paper with a punched ticket. Heat the oven to 180C. Split 8 soft dinner rolls and spread the bases with cranberry sauce. Layer with 300g sliced roast turkey, 150g sliced brie and a few baby spinach leaves. Close, wrap each in foil and warm in the oven for 10 minutes until the cheese softens. Unwrap and rewrap in baking paper with a hole-punched paper ticket tucked in.
Butter shortbread cut into ticket shapes, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, dusted with gold sugar, holes punched with a straw before baking.
North Pole white choc peppermint popcorn

Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate with crushed candy cane, mini marshmallows and a pinch of salt, set on a tray and broken into snowy clusters. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate gently and drizzle all over, tossing to coat. Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes, a handful of mini marshmallows and a pinch of salt. Leave to set for 30 minutes, then break into clusters.
M: a warm supper on a cold night
Chicken thighs, carrot, celery, onion and peas in a creamy thyme sauce, under puff pastry, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.
Christmas Eve meatballs in cranberry glaze
Christmas Eve at home before the train arrives

Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and nutmeg, baked and tossed in a sticky cranberry, chilli and soy glaze, over buttery mash with chives. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 egg, 30g parmesan, a pinch of nutmeg and salt. Roll into 28 balls and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Simmer 250g cranberry sauce, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp soy and a pinch of chilli for 5 minutes, then toss the meatballs through. Serve over mash with snipped chives.
W: the first gift of Christmas, the silver bell
Butter sugar cookies cut into bells, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white with silver cachous and a red ribbon piped on.
K: the waiters who dance it down the carriage
Dark and milk chocolate melted into hot milk and cream, whisked until thick and frothy, poured from a height, whipped cream on top.
T: All aboard. Hot chocolate is served.
D: On Christmas Eve, a boy who's starting to doubt boards a magical train to the North Pole.
P: Serve the hot chocolate when the waiters dance down the carriage.

title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
S: Cornflakes stirred through melted marshmallow and butter tinted green, shaped into little wreaths, red lollies pressed on as berries.
the mountain where the Grinch lives

A crusty cob sliced in a criss-cross and stuffed with mozzarella, cheddar and garlic herb butter, baked into a molten peak to pull apart. Heat the oven to 180C. Cut a round cob loaf in a criss-cross pattern, not quite through the base. Melt 80g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and chives. Push 150g grated mozzarella and 100g grated cheddar into the cuts and drizzle over the butter. Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 more until bubbling and golden.
M: the Christmas feast he tries to steal
Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested, carved at the table with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy.
Cindy Lou's Who-hash with fried eggs

Corned beef, potato and onion fried hard in butter until crusty, topped with runny fried eggs, pickled jalapeño and a tangy green herb sauce. Boil 800g diced potatoes for 6 minutes and drain. Fry 1 diced onion in 40g butter, add the potatoes and fry for 10 minutes, pressing down. Add 400g diced corned beef and fry until crusty, turning in sections. Blend parsley, chives, 1 garlic clove, lemon and 80ml oil for sauce. Fry 4 eggs. Serve the hash with eggs, sauce and pickled jalapeño.
W: the Christmas pudding on every Who table
Bread and butter pudding made with fruit loaf, layered in a dish, soaked in a vanilla custard of eggs, milk and cream, baked at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: a heart that grows three sizes
Lime sorbet scooped into a punch bowl, topped with lemonade and pineapple juice so it froths up green.
T: Roast beast. Who pudding. No stealing.
D: A grumpy green hermit plans to steal Christmas from the cheerful town below his mountain.
P: Serve the roast beast when the Whos sit down to their Christmas feast.

title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
S: Roast pumpkin mashed with feta, sage and nutmeg, wrapped in shortcrust half moons, a jack-o'-lantern face cut into each, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
Christmas Town candy cane cheese twists
the bright Christmas Town Jack stumbles into

Puff pastry twisted into candy cane hooks, half coated in smoked paprika and parmesan for the red stripes, baked crisp with a tomato relish dip. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush 2 sheets of puff pastry with beaten egg. Scatter one sheet with 60g grated parmesan and 2 tsp smoked paprika and leave the other plain with a little cheddar. Cut both into 1cm strips. Twist a red strip and a plain strip together, bend the top into a hook and lay on lined trays. Bake 14 minutes until golden. Serve with tomato relish.
Jack's little ghost dog with the glowing nose
Meringue piped into ghostly teardrops, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, a dot of red icing for the glowing nose.
M: the soup Sally makes for the doctor, minus the sleeping potion
Roast pumpkin and carrot soup with garlic and thyme, blended with stock and a little cream, swirled with sour cream in a spiderweb pattern.
Halloween Town beef and pumpkin stew

Beef shin braised dark with pumpkin, carrot, smoked paprika and stock until spoon-soft, served from a black pot with crusty bread. Brown 1.2kg diced beef shin in batches. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 3 garlic cloves. Return the beef, add 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 1 litre beef stock, cover and simmer 2 hours. Add 600g pumpkin chunks and simmer 40 minutes more. Serve with crusty bread and a spoon of sour cream.
W: the bug-filled villain in his lair
Chocolate mousse in cups topped with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and gummy worms crawling out.
K: Cloudy apple juice and blackcurrant simmered with cinnamon, star anise and clove, served deep purple and steaming from a black pot. Pour 1.2 litres cloudy apple juice and 300ml blackcurrant juice into a black pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 3 star anise, 6 cloves and a strip of orange peel. Bring to a simmer and keep just below simmering for 15 minutes. Ladle into mugs with a cinnamon stick.
T: Halloween Town does Christmas. Badly. Deliciously.
D: The Pumpkin King of Halloween Town discovers Christmas and decides to take it over.
P: Serve the soup when Sally brings Dr Finkelstein his supper.

title: Bad Santa
S: Thurman's toasted peanut butter and jam
the lonely kid who makes Willie sandwiches

Thick white bread with crunchy peanut butter and strawberry jam, dipped in cinnamon egg and fried golden in butter, cut into triangles. Spread 4 slices of thick white bread with crunchy peanut butter and 4 with strawberry jam and press together. Whisk 2 eggs with 100ml milk and a pinch of cinnamon. Dip each sandwich briefly on both sides and fry in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Cut into triangles and dust with icing sugar.
the advent calendar the kid keeps
Little dark and milk chocolate squares in a numbered tray, each with a toasted hazelnut or a pinch of sea salt.
the Phoenix mall where Willie and Marcus work the season

Frankfurts wrapped in soft pretzel dough, dipped in bicarb water and baked dark with rock salt, with a hot mustard and beer cheese dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into 8 ropes and coil around 8 frankfurts. Dip in simmering water with 60g bicarb for 20 seconds, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Melt 150g grated cheddar into a sauce of 20g butter, 1 tbsp flour and 200ml beer, plus 1 tsp hot mustard.
M: Christmas in Phoenix, tamales on every table

Masa beaten fluffy with lard and stock, wrapped around red chilli pork in corn husks, steamed tender, with salsa verde and crema. Simmer 800g pork shoulder until tender, about 2 hours, then shred. Blend 4 soaked dried guajillo chillies with garlic, cumin and 250ml stock, fry for 5 minutes and stir through the pork. Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 500g masa harina, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 500ml warm stock. Spread on 16 soaked corn husks, fill, fold and steam upright for 75 minutes. Serve with salsa verde and sour cream.
a sad Christmas at the diner
Roast turkey breast, stuffing, mashed potato, gravy and cranberry sauce, a proper diner Christmas plate done right.
W: Rich fruit cake with brandy-soaked fruit, almonds and spice, baked low and slow at 150C for 2.5 hours, sliced thin.
K: the flask Santa keeps under the suit

Bourbon over plenty of ice topped with spicy ginger beer and fresh lime, a cinnamon stick for Christmas. Ginger beer and lime for anyone driving the sleigh. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml bourbon and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml cold spicy ginger beer. Stir once and add a lime wedge and a cinnamon stick. Skip the bourbon for the non-drinkers.
T: Ho ho no. Pass the sandwiches.
D: A drunken safecracker works as a mall Santa every Christmas so he can rob the place.
P: Serve the sandwiches when the kid makes Willie his lunch.

title: Mamma Mia!
S: Donna's little hotel on the island

Thick garlicky tzatziki, smoky charred eggplant dip and whipped feta with chilli, with olives and grilled pita brushed with oregano oil. Grate 1 Lebanese cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 grated garlic clove, dill and lemon. Char 1 eggplant over a flame until collapsed, scoop and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, garlic, lemon and olive oil. Blend 150g feta with 3 tbsp yoghurt and top with chilli flakes. Brush 4 pita breads with oil and oregano and grill. Serve with olives.
the hen night on the terrace
Haloumi sliced and griddled until golden, drizzled with honey and thyme, a squeeze of lemon.
Rosie has just written a cookbook
Spinach, feta and dill wrapped in crisp buttered filo, the kind of recipe Rosie would sign for a villager.
M: Lamb shoulder with garlic, oregano, lemon and potatoes, wrapped in baking paper and foil, roasted at 160C for 4 hours until it falls apart.
Kalokairi charred octopus and Greek salad

Octopus simmered tender, then charred over high heat with lemon, oregano and olive oil, with a chunky Greek salad and fava dip. Simmer 1.2kg cleaned octopus in water with a bay leaf and a splash of vinegar for 50 minutes until tender, then cool in the liquid. Cut into tentacles, toss with oil and grill over high heat for 3 minutes a side until charred. Dress with lemon, olive oil and oregano. Toss tomato, cucumber, red onion, capsicum, olives and a slab of feta with oil and oregano. Serve with store-bought fava or hummus.
W: Yeasted batter spooned into hot oil, fried until puffed and golden, soaked in warm honey with cinnamon and walnuts.
K: Pepper tending bar at the Villa Donna
Ouzo poured over ice so it turns cloudy, topped with lemonade, the way it goes out over the Villa Donna bar. Minty lemonade for the kids.
T: Sun, sea and three possible dads. Pass the feta.
D: On a Greek island, a bride-to-be invites three men who might be her father to her wedding.
P: Serve the feast at Sophie's wedding party on the island.

title: The Greatest Showman
S: the smallest star of the show

Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and a little smoked paprika, served in paper cones. Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss hot with flaky salt and a little smoked paprika. Roll paper into cones and fill them up.
the crowd pouring into the tent
Popcorn tossed in a brown sugar and butter caramel with a pinch of bicarb and salt, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirred every 15.

Crisp green apples on sticks dipped in a glassy red toffee, half rolled in crushed salted peanuts before it sets. Wash and dry 8 small green apples and push a stick into each. Boil 400g caster sugar, 150ml water, 2 tbsp golden syrup and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C without stirring, then add red food colouring. Tip the pan and dip each apple, twisting, then roll the bottom in 60g crushed salted peanuts and set on baking paper for 15 minutes.
M: the Swedish Nightingale's first American show

Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and a red wine gravy. Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C until 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 200ml red wine with the pan juices for gravy.
Jenny Lind, the Swedish singer on her American tour

Pork and beef meatballs with allspice, browned in butter and simmered in a creamy brown gravy, with buttery mash, lingonberry jam and quick pickled cucumber. Mix 400g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 50g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 egg, half a teaspoon of allspice and salt. Roll 28 balls and brown in butter. Stir 2 tbsp flour into the pan, whisk in 400ml beef stock, 100ml cream and 1 tsp soy, add the meatballs and simmer 10 minutes. Toss sliced cucumber in vinegar, sugar and dill. Serve with mash and lingonberry jam.
W: Red velvet layer cake baked at 175C, layered and covered in cream cheese frosting, gold sprinkles on top.
K: the bar where the partnership is agreed

A sugar cube soaked in bitters in the bottom of a coupe, a splash of cognac, topped with cold champagne and a twist of lemon. Put a sugar cube in each of 4 coupes and soak with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Add 15ml cognac to each, then slowly top with cold champagne. Twist a strip of lemon peel over and drop it in. Use sparkling apple juice and a dash of bitters for the younger crowd.
T: Roll up. Roll up. Dinner is served.
D: A dreamer from nothing builds a dazzling circus show in 1800s New York.
P: Serve the snacks when the ringmaster opens the show.

title: La La Land
S: the coffee shop on the studio lot where Mia works
Mini almond croissants: day-old croissants split, filled with almond cream, topped with flaked almonds, baked at 180C for 15 minutes, icing sugar dusted.
the jazz club by the beach where Seb takes Mia
Olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel and fennel seed, almonds roasted at 170C with rosemary and salt, and parmesan crisps baked in little rounds at 190C for 6 minutes.
the Hollywood party by the pool

Thin beef patties smashed on a smoking griddle with caramelised onion, cheddar, pickles and a spicy burger sauce on toasted brioche slider buns. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 20 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sriracha and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Smash thin on a smoking hot pan, salt, cook 90 seconds, flip, top with cheddar and onions and cook 1 minute. Toast 12 brioche slider buns, spread with sauce and add a patty and pickles.
M: Chicken on a Stick, Korean BBQ skewers
the club name Seb drops for Seb's

Chicken thighs on skewers glazed in gochujang, soy and honey, charred LA street-cart style, with steamed rice, kimchi slaw and sesame. Mix 3 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp sesame oil and 2 grated garlic cloves. Toss 1kg diced chicken thighs in half the mix for 1 hour, then thread onto skewers. Grill over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the rest. Toss shredded cabbage with 100g chopped kimchi and lime. Serve on rice with spring onion and sesame seeds.
the Paris dream near the end
Chicken roasted at 220C with tarragon butter pushed under the skin, rested, carved, with silky pommes purée and a green salad with Dijon vinaigrette.
W: the dance among the stars at the observatory
Sweet pastry blind baked at 180C, filled with a dark chocolate ganache set for 3 hours, finished with flaky salt and a scatter of edible gold stars.
K: 60ml bourbon stirred with a sugar cube, 2 dashes of bitters and ice for 30 seconds, strained over a big cube, orange peel twisted over.
T: City of stars. City of tacos.
D: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles.
P: Serve the drinks when Sebastian takes Mia to the jazz club.

title: Hairspray
S: Crab meat folded with a little mayo, egg, mustard, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon and tartare.
dancing to the Corny Collins Show after school

Saucy beef mince simmered with tomato, mustard and brown sugar, piled on soft slider buns with melted cheese and crunchy dill pickles. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum. Stir in 150ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Toast 12 slider buns, add a slice of cheese, spoon on the beef and top with pickles.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, smoked paprika and chives on top.
M: Beef topside rubbed with salt, pepper, garlic and paprika, grilled hot until charred outside and rare inside, sliced thin, piled on rolls with raw onion and horseradish sauce.
Edna feeding the family in their little rowhouse

Buttermilk fried chicken with a crunchy craggy crust, honey hot sauce, creamy mash and gravy, buttered corn and a soft dinner roll. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces in 400ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt overnight. Dredge in 250g flour with paprika, garlic powder and pepper, drizzling a little buttermilk into the flour for crags. Fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes to 75C inside. Mix 3 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Serve with mash, gravy from 300ml stock, buttered corn cobs and dinner rolls.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with a tall swirl of buttercream piped into a beehive, pastel sprinkles.
K: Har-De-Har Hut black and white malts
Wilbur's joke shop and a 1962 Baltimore soda fountain

Vanilla ice cream blended thick with malted milk powder and a ribbon of chocolate sauce, topped with whipped cream and a cherry. Blend 8 scoops of vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Drizzle chocolate sauce down the inside of 4 tall chilled glasses. Pour in the shake, swirl a little more chocolate sauce through the top and finish with whipped cream and a cherry.
T: Big hair. Bigger appetite.
D: A big-hearted teenager in 1962 Baltimore dances her way onto a TV show and fights to integrate it.
P: Serve the snacks when the Corny Collins Show comes on the TV.

title: Chicago
S: the jazz club where Velma performs
Prunes stuffed with blue cheese, wrapped in streaky bacon and baked crisp, a Jazz Age party classic.
Chicago-style hot dog bites, all the way
the city of Chicago in the jazz age

Mini franks in poppy seed rolls with yellow mustard, bright green relish, onion, tomato, pickle spears, sport peppers and a dash of celery salt. Simmer 12 cocktail frankfurts in water for 5 minutes. Brush 12 small soft rolls with melted butter and sprinkle with poppy seeds, then warm in the oven for 3 minutes. Fill each with a frank, a line of yellow mustard, sweet green relish, finely diced white onion, a tomato wedge, a thin pickle spear and a few pickled chillies, then finish with a pinch of celery salt.
Cook County jail and the matron's deals
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in grated parmesan and paprika, cut into thin strips like cell bars, twisted, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
M: Rare roast beef shaved thin and dunked in garlicky oregano jus, piled into crusty rolls with hot giardiniera and roasted sweet capsicum. Rub a 1.2kg beef topside with oil, salt, pepper and oregano and roast at 220C for 15 minutes, then 180C to 52C inside. Rest, chill and slice paper thin. Simmer 750ml beef stock with 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, chilli flakes and the roasting juices for 10 minutes. Slice and roast 2 red capsicums. Dunk the beef in the jus and pile into 4 crusty rolls with capsicum and hot giardiniera, spooning over extra jus.
