Buttery dough pressed into a deep tin, mozzarella first, then Italian sausage, then chunky tomato sauce, parmesan on top, baked at 220C for 35 minutes.
W: the showbiz sparkle of the courtroom
Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm sugar syrup, cold sparkling wine stirred in gently, poured into coupes with raspberries, set 4 hours so the bubbles stay trapped.
K: 45ml gin, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup shaken hard with ice, strained into a tall glass and topped with soda water.
T: All that jazz. All that food.
D: Two murderesses in 1920s Chicago compete for fame with the help of a slick lawyer.
P: Serve the drinks when Velma takes the stage at the nightclub.

title: Nacho Libre
S: his tag-team partner snacking on the street
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in salt, lime and chilli, with a fresh tomato salsa.
the crowd at the lucha libre arena
Corn grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander.
the plain food Nacho is stuck serving

Crisp fried tostadas spread with garlicky refried black beans, topped with queso fresco, shredded lettuce, pickled onion, salsa roja and a drizzle of crema. Fry 8 corn tortillas in 180C oil for 1 minute a side until crisp, then drain. Fry a diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil, add 2 drained cans of black beans and mash with a splash of water until thick. Slice a red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 15 minutes. Spread the beans on the tostadas and top with shredded iceberg, 150g crumbled feta, pickled onion, salsa and sour cream.
M: the proper feast he buys with his winnings
Chorizo and potato cooked crisp in a hot pan with onion and chilli, in warm corn tortillas with avocado, pickled onion and coriander.
Oaxaca chicken mole with sesame rice
the Oaxaca town where Nacho cooks for the orphans

Chicken thighs simmered in a mole of dried chillies, tomato, garlic, cinnamon, almonds and dark chocolate blitzed smooth, served with rice and toasted sesame. Toast 4 dried ancho chillies in a dry pan, then soak in 500ml hot chicken stock for 20 minutes. Fry a chopped onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tomatoes, 50g almonds, 1 tsp cinnamon and the chillies with their stock, and blitz smooth with 40g dark chocolate. Brown 1kg chicken thighs, pour over the mole and simmer covered for 40 minutes. Serve over steamed rice with toasted sesame seeds.
W: the better food Nacho fights for the orphans to have

Choux dough piped into hot oil and fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served hot with a warm dark chocolate dipping sauce. Bring 250ml water, 60g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, then beat in 150g plain flour until it leaves the sides of the pan. Cool 5 minutes and beat in 2 eggs one at a time. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into 180C oil and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 100g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 100ml cream and serve warm for dipping.
K: a sweet rice drink for the kids
Rice and cinnamon soaked overnight in water, blitzed, strained, sweetened, mixed with milk and served over ice.
T: Get that corn out of my face. Eat this instead.
D: A monastery cook in Mexico secretly moonlights as a luchador to buy better food for the orphans.
P: Serve the mains when Nacho finally cooks the orphans a proper feast.

title: El Mariachi
S: the dusty town near the border
Pork shoulder marinated in chilli, orange and pineapple, roasted, sliced and crisped, in small corn tortillas with pineapple, onion and coriander.
Cantina garlic and chilli fried peanuts
the bar where he asks to play

Raw peanuts fried with whole garlic cloves and dried chillies until golden, tossed hot with lime and salt, served by the bowl on the bar. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add 400g raw peanuts and 8 peeled garlic cloves and stir for 6 minutes until golden. Add 6 dried red chillies broken in half and cook 1 more minute. Tip into a bowl, squeeze over a lime and toss with 1 tsp salt and a pinch of chilli powder. Cool for 10 minutes so they crisp up before serving.
the cantina he walks into looking for work

Ripe avocado smashed rough with charred jalapeño, white onion, lime and coriander, finished with crumbled feta and served with warm salted corn chips. Char 2 jalapenos in a dry pan until blackened, then seed and chop fine. Halve 3 ripe avocados and smash roughly with a fork. Stir in the jalapeno, the juice of 2 limes, half a finely diced white onion and a handful of chopped coriander. Season well with salt and top with 50g crumbled feta. Warm the corn chips at 180C for 4 minutes and serve straight away.
M: the boss who runs the town

Skirt steak marinated 2 hours in lime, garlic, cumin and orange, seared over very high heat, rested and sliced thin against the grain, with rice, black beans and charred spring onions. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in lime juice, garlic, ground cumin and a little orange juice. Sear over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin against the grain. Serve with long grain rice, warmed black beans and charred spring onions.
the hotel where he hides out

Corn tortillas rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, covered in a red chilli and tomato sauce and more cheese, baked bubbling and finished with crema and coriander. Poach 600g chicken thighs in salted water for 20 minutes, then shred. Soak 3 dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with a 400g can of tomatoes, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and salt, and simmer 10 minutes. Dip 8 corn tortillas in the sauce, fill with chicken and 150g grated cheddar, roll and pack into a dish. Pour over the rest of the sauce, top with 100g more cheese and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Finish with sour cream and coriander.
W: something sweet in the border town

Chewy golden Mexican coconut sweets baked from fresh coconut, sugar and condensed milk, piled on a plate beside a battered guitar case. Mix 250g desiccated coconut, 395g condensed milk, 2 egg yolks and 1 tsp vanilla. Spoon 20 small mounds onto a lined tray and bake at 170C for 18 minutes until golden on the edges. Cool on the tray until firm.
K: his case gets swapped for one full of guns

Ice-cold Mexican lager poured over lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire in a glass rimmed with chilli salt, finished with a lime wedge. Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Run a lime wedge around four tall glasses and dip the rims in the chilli salt. Fill with ice. Into each glass add 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 4 dashes hot sauce and 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce. Top each with a cold 355ml bottle of Mexican lager, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
T: One guitar case. Wrong guitar case.
D: A travelling musician is mistaken for a hitman in a Mexican border town.
P: Serve the mains when the mariachi walks into the bar looking for work.

title: Desperado
S: where Buscemi tells his tall story

Pork rind scored, salted and dried overnight, roasted at 240C until puffed and crackling, broken up and dusted with chilli and lime salt. Score 600g pork rind, salt and dry uncovered overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling. Break up and dust with flaky salt mixed with chilli powder and lime zest.

Flour tortillas filled with Monterey Jack, cheddar and pickled jalapeños, cooked in a dry pan until golden and melted, cut into wedges with salsa verde. Mix 200g grated Monterey Jack, 100g grated cheddar and 3 tbsp chopped pickled jalapenos. Spread over half of each of 4 large flour tortillas and fold over. Cook in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese has melted. Rest 1 minute, cut each into 4 wedges and serve with salsa verde and sour cream.
the guitar case and the songs
Avocados smashed with lime, white onion, serrano chilli, coriander and salt, with warm tortilla chips.
M: the boss up at the big house

Pork shoulder marinated overnight in dried chillies, achiote, pineapple and vinegar, roasted at 200C, sliced and crisped in a pan, in small corn tortillas with pineapple, onion and coriander. Blitz 3 soaked dried chillies, 50g achiote, 200g pineapple and 2 tbsp vinegar and marinate 1.2kg sliced pork shoulder overnight. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then slice and crisp in a pan. Serve in 16 small tortillas with pineapple, white onion and coriander.
a home-cooked meal in Carolina's flat

Shredded chicken simmered in a smoky tomato, onion and chipotle sauce, piled on crisp tostadas with refried beans, avocado, crema and pickled onion. Poach 700g chicken thighs in salted water for 20 minutes and shred. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft, add 2 garlic cloves, a 400g can of tomatoes and 2 chopped chipotles in adobo. Simmer 10 minutes, then stir in the chicken. Fry 8 corn tortillas at 180C until crisp. Spread with warm refried beans, top with the tinga, sliced avocado, sour cream and red onion soaked in lime juice.
W: the bookshop that hardly sells a book

Sponge baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pricked and soaked overnight in condensed, evaporated and full cream milk, topped with whipped cream and cinnamon. Whisk 5 eggs with 200g sugar until thick and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Prick all over and pour over 395g condensed milk, 375ml evaporated milk and 125ml milk. Soak overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream and cinnamon.
K: Smoky mezcal shaken hard with blood orange juice, fresh lime and agave syrup, poured over ice into glasses rimmed with chilli salt. Mix 2 tbsp salt and 1 tsp chilli powder on a saucer, wet the rims of four glasses with lime and dip them in. Fill a shaker with ice and add 180ml mezcal, 180ml blood orange juice, 90ml lime juice and 60ml agave syrup. Shake hard for 15 seconds, working in two batches if needed. Strain into the glasses over fresh ice and garnish each with an orange wheel.
T: Bring the guitar case. Leave the trouble.
D: A mariachi with a guitar case full of weapons hunts the drug boss who ruined his life.
P: Serve the snacks when the stranger walks into the bar to tell his story.

title: Once Upon a Time in Mexico
S: Day of the Dead concha buns
the Day of the Dead parade

Soft sweet yeasted buns with a crackly vanilla and cocoa sugar shell scored in a shell pattern, baked golden and served warm with butter. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 80g caster sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml warm milk, 80g soft butter and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 10 minutes. Prove 1 hour, then shape 12 balls. Rub 100g icing sugar, 100g plain flour and 80g butter into a paste, split it and mix cocoa into half. Press a disc onto each bun and score a shell pattern. Prove 40 minutes and bake at 180C for 18 minutes.
Corn tortillas cut into wedges and fried crisp, with a salsa of charred tomato, dried chilli, garlic and onion blitzed rough.

Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with chipotle and lime mayo, rolled in crumbled feta and finished with chilli powder and coriander. Boil 4 corn cobs for 5 minutes, then grill over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred all over. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and the juice of a lime. Brush the hot corn with the mayo, roll in 100g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder and chopped coriander. Serve with lime wedges.
M: the dish Agent Sands orders everywhere he goes

Pork shoulder marinated overnight in achiote, orange juice, lime, garlic, cumin and oregano, wrapped in banana leaves and foil, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, shredded. Pickled red onion and warm tortillas.
Chicken in red mole with rice

Chicken thighs simmered in a rich red mole of dried chillies, tomato, almonds, sesame, cinnamon and dark chocolate, served on rice with toasted sesame. Toast 4 dried guajillo chillies, then soak in 500ml hot chicken stock for 20 minutes. Fry an onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tomatoes, 50g almonds, 2 tbsp sesame seeds and 1 tsp cinnamon. Blitz with the chillies, stock and 40g dark chocolate until smooth. Brown 1kg chicken thighs, pour over the sauce and simmer 40 minutes. Serve on rice with more toasted sesame.
W: Caramel poured into ramekins, custard of eggs, milk, cream, dark chocolate and cinnamon on top, baked in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes, chilled and turned out.
K: Day of the Dead tequila and sangrita
the coup set for the Day of the Dead

30ml blanco tequila beside a chaser of orange, lime and tomato juice with a pinch of chilli. Mix 200ml orange juice, the juice of a lime, 100ml tomato juice and a pinch of chilli powder for sangrita. Pour 30ml blanco tequila into each of four glasses with a sangrita chaser alongside.
T: Puerco pibil. Every single time.
D: A retired mariachi is pulled back in by a rogue CIA agent to stop a coup in Mexico.
P: Serve the pibil when Agent Sands orders it, again.

title: Romancing the Stone
S: Griddled white corn cakes, crisp outside and soft inside, split and stuffed with melting mozzarella and butter, served with a fresh tomato and spring onion hogao. Mix 300g pre-cooked white cornmeal with 500ml warm water and 1 tsp salt into a soft dough and rest 5 minutes. Shape 8 patties 1.5cm thick and cook in a buttered pan over medium heat for 5 minutes a side. For hogao, fry 3 diced tomatoes and 4 sliced spring onions in oil for 10 minutes. Split the arepas, stuff with 200g sliced mozzarella and a knob of butter and serve with the hogao.
Corn flour dough wrapped around spiced beef and potato, crimped, fried at 180C until crisp, with a green chilli and coriander sauce.

Mango, pineapple and papaya cut into cups, squeezed with lime, dusted with chilli salt and topped with fresh passionfruit pulp and torn mint. Peel and cut 2 mangoes, a quarter pineapple and half a papaya into long batons. Pack into four cups or glasses. Mix 1 tsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp caster sugar. Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fruit, dust with the chilli salt, then spoon the pulp of 2 passionfruit over the top. Finish with torn mint and serve cold.
M: the village where Juan's fans live
Chicken thighs simmered with corn, potato, cassava and plantain, onion, garlic and coriander for an hour until thick, served with rice and avocado.
the run to Cartagena for the final showdown

Whole snapper scored and rubbed with lime, garlic and chilli, grilled crisp, served with Caribbean coconut rice, fried green plantain and a tomato and onion salsa. Score 2 whole 600g snapper and rub with 3 crushed garlic cloves, a chopped chilli, lime juice, oil and salt. Cook 300g rice in 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water, covered, for 15 minutes. Slice a green plantain, fry at 180C until golden, smash flat and fry again. Grill the fish over high heat for 8 minutes a side. Serve with the rice, plantain and a salsa of diced tomato, red onion and lime.
W: the heart-sized stone everyone is chasing

Fresh lime juice and sugar syrup set with gelatine in a faceted mould for 4 hours, turned out and served with chilled coconut cream and mint. Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Heat 300ml water with 150g sugar, stir in the gelatine, then add 250ml fresh lime juice and a drop of green colouring if you like. Set in a mould for 4 hours. Turn out and serve with chilled coconut cream and mint.
K: Joan Wilder's iced coffee with panela cream
the romance writer a long way from New York

Strong Colombian coffee sweetened with panela and cinnamon, poured over ice and topped with a float of lightly whipped cream and a dusting of cinnamon. Brew 60g ground Colombian coffee with 1L hot water so it's strong. While hot, stir in 80g panela or dark brown sugar and a cinnamon stick, then cool for 30 minutes and remove the cinnamon. Lightly whip 150ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp of the brown sugar until just thick. Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the coffee, float the cream on top and dust with cinnamon.
T: From a New York flat to the Colombian jungle.
D: A shy romance novelist heads to Colombia to rescue her sister and lands in a real adventure.
P: Serve the snacks when Joan finishes her novel with a glass of wine at home.

title: The Mask of Zorro
S: Chorizo slices fried and finished in red wine until sticky, Manchego cut into triangles with quince paste, and olives warmed with orange peel.
the Mexican families of old California

Masa beaten light with lard and stock, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with chicken in red chilli sauce, folded and steamed until firm. Soak 16 dried corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes. Poach 500g chicken thighs, shred and mix with 250ml red enchilada sauce. Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 450g masa harina, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 450ml warm chicken stock. Spread 3 tbsp masa on each husk, add a spoon of chicken, fold and stand upright in a steamer. Steam covered for 75 minutes and serve with salsa.
the Z he slashes into everything
Flour tortillas filled with Monterey Jack and roasted green chilli, cooked in butter until golden and melted, a Z scored into the top before cutting into wedges.
M: the old Zorro, training his replacement

Skirt steak marinated 2 hours in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, grilled over very high heat, rested, sliced against the grain, with rice, black beans and fresh salsa. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in lime and orange juice with crushed garlic and cumin. Grill over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thinly against the grain. Serve with long grain rice, warm black beans and a fresh tomato salsa.
Governor's chicken with olives and capers

Chicken thighs browned crisp, then braised with garlic, white wine, tomato, green olives and capers until tender, served with crusty bread to mop the sauce. Season 8 bone-in chicken thighs and brown skin side down in olive oil for 8 minutes. Remove, soften 4 sliced garlic cloves and a sliced onion, then add 200ml white wine and a 400g can of tomatoes. Stir in 100g green olives and 2 tbsp capers, return the chicken skin side up and braise uncovered at 170C for 40 minutes. Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.
W: a Spanish dessert for the hacienda
Choux dough piped into 180C oil, fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with thick hot chocolate.
K: the dance at the governor's party

Red wine, a splash of brandy, orange juice and sliced orange and apple in a big jug, chilled 2 hours, topped with soda water just before pouring. Slice 2 oranges and an apple into a big jug. Pour in a bottle of red wine, 60ml brandy and 250ml orange juice. Chill for 2 hours so the fruit soaks it up. Top with cold soda water just before pouring into glasses over ice.
T: The mask passes on. So does the recipe.
D: An ageing Zorro trains a young thief to take his place and avenge his family in old California.
P: Serve the mains when Alejandro and Elena dance at the governor's party.

title: Selena
S: the little family restaurant where young Selena first sings

Corn chips layered with spiced beef, refried beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked bubbling and topped with pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream. Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion, 2 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin. Spread 300g corn chips over a large tray, spoon over a can of refried beans and the beef, then 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapenos. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with 3 diced tomatoes mixed with onion, coriander and lime, a smashed avocado and sour cream.
life on the road in the family tour bus
Flour tortillas filled with scrambled eggs, crispy potato, chorizo and cheddar, with a red salsa.
the Gulf coast at Corpus Christi
Mexican-style prawn cocktail: poached prawns with tomato juice, lime, avocado, onion, coriander and hot sauce in glasses, crackers on the side.
M: the family band on the road

Corn tortillas rolled around cheddar and onion, covered in a chilli gravy of flour, chilli powder, cumin and stock, more cheese on top, baked at 190C for 20 minutes. Make a gravy by cooking 2 tbsp flour in oil, then adding chilli powder, cumin and 500ml beef stock and simmering until thick. Roll corn tortillas around grated cheddar and diced onion, lay in a dish, pour over the gravy and more cheese. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes.

Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and cumin, seared hot with capsicum and onion, brought out sizzling with warm tortillas, guacamole, pico and sour cream. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 1 hour in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder and oil. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 3 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thin. Fry 2 sliced capsicums and a sliced onion hard in the same pan, return the beef and bring the pan to the table. Serve with 12 warm flour tortillas, guacamole, chopped tomato and sour cream.
W: a family celebration after the show
Sponge baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pricked all over and soaked overnight in condensed, evaporated and full cream milk, topped with whipped cream and sliced strawberries.
K: Fresh watermelon blitzed with lime juice and a little sugar, strained and poured long over crushed ice with torn mint and a chilli-salt rim. Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 3 limes, 2 tbsp caster sugar and 500ml cold water until smooth. Strain into a big jug and chill for an hour. Mix 1 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder, wet the rims of four tall glasses with lime and dip them in. Fill with crushed ice, pour in the agua fresca and top with torn mint.
T: Tex-Mex for the queen of Tejano.
D: The rise of a young Tejano singer from Texas family gigs to stadium stardom.
P: Serve the mains when Selena takes the stage at the big stadium concert.

title: La Bamba
S: the family party in the backyard

Masa beaten light with lard and stock, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with pork braised in red chilli, folded and steamed until firm. Simmer 600g pork shoulder in salted water for 2 hours, then shred. Soak 3 dried chillies, blitz with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin, and stir through the pork. Soak 16 corn husks for 30 minutes. Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 450g masa harina, 1 tsp baking powder, salt and 450ml warm stock. Spread masa on each husk, add pork, fold and steam upright for 75 minutes.
the trip across the border with his brother
Grilled skirt steak chopped fine, in small corn tortillas with onion, coriander, lime and a fiery salsa verde.
Thin fries soaked in cold water for an hour, dried, fried at 140C then again at 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper boats with tomato sauce.
M: Pork shoulder simmered with hominy, garlic and a red chilli sauce for 3 hours, served with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.
a 1950s diner in the San Fernando Valley

Two thin chuck patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese melted between, with pickles, diced onion, mustard and tomato sauce on toasted soft buns. Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls of 100g. Heat a heavy pan or flat plate until smoking. Add the balls, smash flat with a spatula, season with salt and cook 2 minutes until deeply browned. Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute. Stack two patties on each toasted bun with dill pickles, finely diced white onion, mustard and tomato sauce.
W: the girl he writes the song for

Short grain rice simmered with a cinnamon stick and lemon peel in water, then milk added and stirred slowly for 30 minutes until creamy, finished with condensed milk and ground cinnamon. Simmer 200g short grain rice with a cinnamon stick, a strip of lemon peel and 500ml water until absorbed. Add 750ml milk and stir slowly for 30 minutes until creamy. Stir in half a can of condensed milk, remove the cinnamon and dust with ground cinnamon.
K: Vanilla ice cream, cold milk and malted milk powder blended until thick, poured into tall glasses with a straw. Blend 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into tall chilled glasses, add a straw to each and serve straight away like a fifties soda fountain.
T: A teenage rock and roll star from the San Fernando Valley.
D: The short, bright career of 1950s rock and roll star Ritchie Valens.
P: Serve the mains when Ritchie plays the party at home.

title: Boyz n the Hood
S: the party when Doughboy gets out

Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky barbecue, honey and hot sauce glaze. Leave 1kg chicken wings uncovered in the fridge overnight, then toss with garlic powder and salt. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm barbecue sauce with honey and a splash of hot sauce, toss the wings through and serve with plenty of napkins.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard, sweet relish and hot sauce, piped back, paprika on top.
Caramelised onion dip with ridged chips
the corner store down the street

Onions cooked slow until deep brown, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives and a dash of Worcestershire, served with ridged salted chips. Slice 3 brown onions thinly and cook in 30g butter and a splash of oil over low heat for 35 minutes, stirring, until deep brown. Cool completely. Beat 250g sour cream with 125g soft cream cheese, a dash of Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Fold in the onions and a handful of chopped chives. Chill for an hour and serve with ridged potato chips.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar, garlic and cayenne, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with barbecue sauce over hot coals. Rub 2kg pork ribs with smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, cayenne and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky. Serve with a crunchy cabbage coleslaw.

Chicken pieces brined in buttermilk, fried crisp in seasoned flour, served with baked mac and cheese and collard-style greens braised with smoked ham hock. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces in 500ml buttermilk with salt and hot sauce overnight. Simmer a ham hock in 1L water for 1 hour, add 2 bunches shredded silverbeet and cook 20 minutes. Boil 300g macaroni, stir through 250g grated cheddar and 300ml milk and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Dredge the chicken in 300g flour with paprika and garlic powder and fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 74C inside.
W: Roasted sweet potato mashed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk and spices, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: Red fruit punch of cranberry juice, pineapple juice and lemonade, poured over ice from a big cooler.
T: Increase the peace. Fire up the grill.
D: Three friends grow up in South Central Los Angeles, guided or lost depending on who's there for them.
P: Serve the mains at the backyard welcome-home barbecue.

title: Friday
S: Smokey: never two things that match, so this time they do

Thick white bread filled with peanut butter and strawberry jam, fried golden in butter, dusted with icing sugar and cut into triangles for the porch. Spread 8 slices of thick white bread with 160g smooth peanut butter on four slices and 160g strawberry jam on the other four. Press together into 4 sandwiches and butter the outsides with 40g soft butter. Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the filling is warm. Dust with icing sugar, cut into triangles and serve warm.
Little beef sliders topped with a slice of grilled ham and melted cheese on soft buns, so the ham finally gets its burger.
something cold and sharp for a hot day on the porch

Fresh pineapple cut into long spears, charred on a hot grill pan, then dusted with chilli, lime zest, sugar and salt and served cold on a stick. Peel and core a large pineapple and cut into 12 long spears. Heat a grill pan until smoking and char the spears for 2 minutes a side until marked. Mix 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp caster sugar and the zest of a lime. Squeeze the lime over the warm pineapple, sprinkle with the chilli mix, push a skewer into each spear and chill for 20 minutes before serving.
M: a long hot day on the block
Sticky barbecue chicken drumsticks off the grill with buttered corn on the cob and potato salad, eaten on the steps.
W: Big Worm's ice cream truck cones
Big Worm's ice cream truck rolling down the street
Vanilla ice cream cones dipped in chocolate that sets hard and rolled in crushed cornflakes and sprinkles, like the truck sells.
K: Red drink, with sugar this time
Craig's kitchen has the drink but no sugar
Homemade red fruit drink of strawberry, cherry and lemon, sweetened properly and poured over plenty of ice in big plastic cups.
T: It's Friday. You ain't got no job. You got snacks.
D: Two friends sit on a front porch in South Central LA through one very long Friday.
P: Serve the snacks when Craig and Smokey settle in on the porch.

title: House Party
S: the snacks on the kitchen bench at Play's house
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter and honey.
the dance battle in the living room

Baked potato halves scooped and crisped, filled with cheddar and bacon, baked bubbling and topped with sour cream and spring onion. Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200C for 50 minutes until soft. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins inside and out with oil. Bake cut side down for 10 minutes until crisp. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Fill the skins with 200g grated cheddar and the bacon and bake 8 minutes more. Top with sour cream and sliced spring onion.
the dance-off in the lounge room

A long Italian loaf filled with salami, ham, provolone, lettuce, tomato, onion and Italian dressing, cut into thick slices. Split a long Italian loaf. Layer with 100g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded iceberg, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with oil and red wine vinegar and season. Press, then cut into thick slices.
M: Bilal on the decks all night

Pizza dough stretched thin, sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and left in the box on the bench. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and dried oregano. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and leave in the box on the bench.
Kid's dad waiting up at home

Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked until sticky, sliced thick with buttery mash, green beans and onion gravy. Mix 800g beef mince, a grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Steam 300g green beans. Make gravy from the pan juices and a sachet of onion gravy mix.
W: the party that runs all night
Chocolate sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fudge frosting and sprinkles, cut into big squares.
K: the punch bowl in the kitchen

Pineapple and orange juice with passionfruit pulp and lime, topped with lemonade over ice, with frozen pineapple chunks, orange slices and mint floating on top. Freeze 300g pineapple chunks on a tray for 2 hours. In a big bowl, mix 750ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Add a tray of ice and the frozen pineapple. Just before serving, top with 1L cold lemonade and float sliced orange and torn mint on top. Ladle into cups.
T: Grounded. Going anyway.
D: A high school kid sneaks out against his dad's orders to go to his best friend's house party.
P: Serve the snacks when the dance-off starts at the party.

title: Barbershop
S: Hot sauce butter kettle chips with ranch
the snacks on the counter between haircuts

Thick kettle chips tossed warm in hot sauce butter, lime zest and salt, served with a cool buttermilk ranch dip for dunking. Melt 40g butter with 3 tbsp hot sauce and the zest of a lime. Spread 2 bags of kettle chips on a tray, drizzle with the butter, toss and warm at 160C for 4 minutes. For the dip, whisk 150g sour cream, 100ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and dill, half a tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper. Serve the chips warm with the ranch.
JD and Billy and the ATM they can't crack

Spicy smoked sausages grilled slowly over coals until blistered and hot through, sliced thick and served on toothpicks with yellow mustard and pickled jalapeños. Grill 8 hot smoked sausages slowly over medium coals, turning often, until the skins blister and they are hot right through. Slice thickly on an angle and spear each piece with a toothpick. Serve with a bowl of yellow mustard and pickled jalapenos on the side.
the tamale man doing the rounds of the South Side
Corn masa wrapped around spiced beef, steamed in husks for an hour, served with hot sauce.
M: the shop his dad left him

Pork rib tips rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, roasted at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with a tangy barbecue sauce, piled on white bread with fries. Rub 1.5kg pork ribs cut into short pieces with smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic and salt. Cover and roast at 150C for 2.5 hours. Uncover, brush with tangy barbecue sauce and roast hot until sticky. Pile over slices of white bread with oven fries.

Beef topside roasted rare, sliced paper thin and dunked in garlic and oregano beef jus, piled into soft rolls with hot pickled giardiniera. Rub 1kg beef topside with oil, salt, pepper and 1 tsp oregano and roast at 200C for 35 minutes to rare. Rest and chill for an hour, then slice paper thin. Simmer 1L beef stock with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the roasting juices for 15 minutes. Drop the beef into the jus for 1 minute, pile into 4 split long rolls, spoon over jus and top with giardiniera.
W: a slice from the bakery down the road
Roasted sweet potato mashed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk and spices, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: Cloudy apple juice shaken with fresh ginger and lime, poured over ice and topped with soda, each bottle labelled with a name so nobody steals it. Grate a 4cm knob of ginger and squeeze the juice into a big jug through a sieve. Add 1L cloudy apple juice and the juice of 2 limes and stir. Pour into four bottles, add ice and top each with 100ml soda water. Write a name on each bottle in marker so nobody else touches it, then serve with lime wedges.
T: Everybody talks. Nobody touches Terri's apple juice.
D: On a busy Saturday, a barbershop owner on Chicago's South Side has second thoughts about selling the shop.
P: Serve the drinks when Terri finds out someone drank her apple juice.

title: Harlem Nights
S: Vera Walker, an old friend of Sugar Ray's

Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, finished with paprika and chives on silver trays. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a dash of hot sauce. Pipe back and finish with smoked paprika and chives. Lay them on silver trays.

Cubes of mozzarella and sharp cheddar crumbed twice, fried until golden and oozing, served hot on toothpicks with a spicy tomato dipping sauce. Cut 250g mozzarella block and 150g sharp cheddar into 2cm dice and freeze for 30 minutes. Toss in 50g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, roll in 100g panko, then dip and roll again. Freeze 15 minutes more. Fry in 180C oil for 1 minute until golden. Simmer 250ml passata with a crushed garlic clove, chilli flakes and salt for 10 minutes and serve as the dip.
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and grated onion mixed, spooned into 175C oil and fried golden. Honey butter.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken fried at 165C until 74C inside, on crisp buttermilk waffles with maple syrup and hot sauce butter. Brine 800g chicken thighs in buttermilk, dredge in flour and fry at 165C until 74C. Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 60g butter and cook waffles. Serve with maple syrup and butter melted with hot sauce.
Smothered pork chops in onion gravy

Thick pork chops floured and browned, then simmered in a dark roux onion gravy until tender, served over white rice with garlicky braised greens. Season 4 thick pork chops, dust in flour and brown in oil for 3 minutes a side, then set aside. Melt 40g butter in the pan, stir in 3 tbsp flour and cook to a dark brown roux. Add 2 sliced onions and cook 5 minutes, then whisk in 600ml chicken stock. Return the chops, cover and simmer 40 minutes. Serve over 300g rice with a bunch of kale wilted with garlic.
W: Club Sugar Ray lemon chess pie
Short pastry with a buttery lemon custard that bakes a crackly top, served in thin slices.
K: A sugar cube soaked in bitters in a flute, topped with chilled sparkling wine and a twist of lemon.
T: The best club in Harlem. The best table in the house.
D: A nightclub owner and his adopted son outfox a crooked cop and a mob boss in 1930s Harlem.
P: Serve the drinks when the craps tables open at Club Sugar Ray.

title: Boomerang
S: a perfume launch only Strangé could throw

Little pork and beef meatballs baked until browned, then rolled in a sticky sweet chilli and grape jelly glaze and served on toothpicks. Mix 500g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, a grated garlic clove and salt. Roll into 30 small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes until browned. Simmer 250ml sweet chilli sauce with 150g grape jelly in a wide pan for 5 minutes until glossy. Add the meatballs and turn until coated. Serve hot on toothpicks.
Soft tortillas spread with dill cream cheese, rolled with smoked salmon and cut into neat pinwheels.

Corn chips piled with beef and bean chilli and a hot cheddar cheese sauce, finished with pickled jalapeños, salsa and sour cream. Brown 300g beef mince with a diced onion and 2 tsp chilli powder, add a drained can of kidney beans and 100ml passata and simmer 15 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk and simmer until thick, then stir in 150g grated cheddar. Spread 300g corn chips on a platter, spoon over the chilli and cheese sauce, and top with jalapenos, salsa and sour cream.
M: the friends' Thanksgiving at Marcus's place

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy, sliced with cornbread and sage stuffing, maple candied sweet potato, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar. Pat dry, rub with butter and roast at 170C to 70C inside, about 75 minutes, then rest. Toss 300g cubed cornbread with a fried onion, celery, sage and 250ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Roast 800g sweet potato chunks with butter and 3 tbsp maple syrup. Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Eye fillet seasoned and seared hard in butter, roasted at 200C to 54C, rested, the pan deglazed with red wine and stock for a glossy sauce, with a potato gratin and charred asparagus.
W: Roasted sweet potato mashed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes, whipped cream on top.
K: Gin, lemon and sugar topped with cold sparkling wine in a flute, with a lemon twist.
T: What goes around comes around. So does dessert.
D: A smooth ad executive meets his match when his new boss treats him the way he treats women.
P: Serve the mains when Marcus and his friends sit down to Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Sister Act
S: the casino lounge where Deloris sings
Button mushroom caps filled with fried bacon, garlic, breadcrumbs and parmesan, then baked until golden on top.
San Francisco, the convent's home city

Creamy clam chowder with bacon, potato and thyme, ladled into hollowed sourdough rolls toasted crisp and topped with crumbled bacon and chives. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp, set half aside. Soften an onion and 2 celery sticks in the fat, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then add 300ml fish stock, 300ml milk and 2 diced potatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Add 2 drained 280g cans of baby clams and 150ml cream and heat through. Hollow 4 small sourdough rolls and toast at 200C for 6 minutes. Fill with chowder and top with bacon and chives.
the choir's tea break after rehearsal
Scones with grated cheddar, chives and a pinch of cayenne, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, butter on the side.
M: Mary Clarence's convent stew, spiced up
the bland dinner she can't believe

Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic, smoked paprika, thyme and a splash of hot sauce, stock and tomato, braised 3 hours with potatoes and carrots. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 onions, crushed garlic, a spoon of smoked paprika and thyme. Pour in stock, a can of tomatoes and a splash of hot sauce. Braise for 3 hours, adding potatoes and carrots for the last hour. Proper flavour this time.
Late night bar cheeseburgers and fries
the nuns sneaking into the bar across the road

Thick chuck patties grilled to medium with melted cheddar, onion, lettuce, pickles and burger sauce on a toasted bun, with crisp double-fried chips. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then at 190C until crisp. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties and season. Grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Build on toasted buns with lettuce, onion and pickles.
W: St Katherine's bread and butter pudding
the sisters never waste a loaf

Buttered bread layered with sultanas in a baked vanilla custard, crisp on top and soft underneath. Butter 8 slices of white bread, cut into triangles and layer in a dish with 80g sultanas. Whisk 3 eggs, 500ml milk, 100ml cream, 70g sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, pour over and soak 20 minutes. Sprinkle with nutmeg and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.
K: Choir practice honey ginger lemon tea

Fresh ginger simmered with lemon and cinnamon, steeped with black tea and sweetened with honey, served hot in plain white cups with a lemon slice. Slice a 5cm knob of ginger and simmer in 1.2L water with a cinnamon stick for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat, add 4 black tea bags and steep for 4 minutes, then remove the bags. Stir in the juice of a lemon and 4 tbsp honey. Pour into plain white cups and float a thin lemon slice in each.
T: The convent choir just got soul. So did the kitchen.
D: A Reno lounge singer hides from the mob in a San Francisco convent and turns the choir around.
P: Serve the mains when Deloris sits down to her first plain convent dinner.

title: Car Wash
S: the food truck that pulls up at lunchtime
Beef mince cooked with onion, garlic, cumin and chilli, in warm corn tortillas with lettuce, cheese and salsa.

Raw peanuts in the shell boiled soft in a salty Cajun spice brine with garlic and chilli, soaked to take on the flavour, served warm in paper cups. Rinse 750g raw peanuts in the shell and put in a big pot with 3L water, 80g salt, 3 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 4 smashed garlic cloves and 2 dried chillies. Weigh them down with a plate, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 hours until the nuts are soft. Turn off the heat and leave them soaking in the brine for an hour. Drain and serve warm in paper cups.
the burger stand down the road
Thick fries double fried, covered in a beef and bean chilli and melted cheddar, chopped onion on top.
M: Dee-Luxe hot dogs with the works
lunch break at the Dee-Luxe Car Wash

Franks griddled until blistered, in steamed buns, topped with a spoon of beef chilli simmered with cumin, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish. Simmer 250g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, chilli powder and 150ml water for 20 minutes until loose. Griddle 8 franks and put in steamed buns. Top with the chilli, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish.
a soul food lunch on the break

Chicken pieces brined in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried crisp, with a creamy mustard potato salad and crunchy cabbage coleslaw. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with salt and hot sauce. Boil 800g potatoes until tender, cool and mix with mayonnaise, mustard, chopped celery and spring onion. Shred a quarter cabbage and a carrot and toss with mayo and vinegar. Dredge the chicken in 300g flour with paprika, garlic powder and pepper and fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 74C inside.
W: the preacher who rolls up in a gold limo

Fresh orange juice sweetened with a little sugar, poured into moulds over frozen berries, sticks pushed in after an hour, frozen solid for 6 hours. Stir 2 tbsp sugar into 500ml fresh orange juice until dissolved. Drop a few frozen berries into each mould and pour the juice over. Push sticks in after an hour and freeze solid for 6 hours.
K: Fresh watermelon blended with cold water and lime, strained and poured over ice.
T: Eight hours of suds. One long lunch break.
D: A single day in the lives of the workers at a busy Los Angeles car wash.
P: Serve the lunch when the crew takes a break between cars.

title: The Five Heartbeats
S: Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a honey and hot sauce glaze. Leave 1kg chicken wings uncovered in the fridge overnight, then toss with garlic powder and salt. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 3 tbsp honey and a good splash of hot sauce and toss the wings through until glossy.
the long bus rides between shows

Brown sugar, butter and cream boiled to soft ball, pecans stirred through, spooned onto paper and left to set into fudgy Southern pralines. Line two trays with baking paper. In a heavy pan, stir 200g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 125ml cream and 50g butter over medium heat until dissolved. Boil without stirring until it reaches 115C on a sugar thermometer. Take off the heat, add 1 tsp vanilla, a pinch of salt and 200g pecans and beat for 2 minutes until it thickens. Spoon quickly onto the trays and leave to set for 30 minutes.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard, sweet relish and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, paprika on top.
M: Sunday fried chicken with ham hock greens

Chicken pieces brined in buttermilk, dredged twice in seasoned flour and fried crisp, with greens braised slowly with smoked ham hock and a splash of vinegar. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with salt and hot sauce. Simmer a smoked ham hock in 1L water for 1 hour, add 2 bunches shredded silverbeet and a splash of vinegar and cook 20 minutes. Season 300g flour with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Dredge the chicken, dip back in buttermilk, dredge again and fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 74C at the bone.
the dish on every family table
Macaroni boiled 2 minutes short, mixed with sharp cheddar and a custard of eggs, evaporated milk and butter, more cheese on top, baked at 180C for 40 minutes.
W: the manager who believes in them first

Dense buttery lemon pound cake baked low and slow, with a sharp lemon glaze soaked into the warm top and a spoon of whipped cream. Beat 250g soft butter and 250g caster sugar until pale. Add 4 eggs one at a time with the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in 250g plain flour and 1 tsp baking powder. Spoon into a lined loaf tin and bake at 160C for 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Mix 120g icing sugar with 3 tbsp lemon juice and pour over the warm cake. Serve slices with whipped cream.
K: Fresh lime juice and cherry syrup topped with lemonade over crushed ice with a cherry.
T: Five voices. One Sunday dinner.
D: The rise and fall of a 1960s vocal group, told through friendship, fame and family.
P: Serve the mains when the group sits down to Sunday dinner with Duck's family.

title: Shaft
S: Puff pastry parcels filled with mashed potato and soft fried onion, a New York street corner favourite.
the cop who keeps tabs on Shaft

Mixed nuts tossed with butter, rosemary and salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes, with a bowl of olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel. Toss 300g mixed nuts with 30g melted butter, chopped rosemary and salt and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Warm 250g olives in olive oil with strips of orange peel. Serve both in bowls.

Thick slices of green tomato dipped in buttermilk and seasoned cornmeal, fried golden, served with a sharp remoulade of mayo, capers, mustard and hot sauce. Slice 4 green tomatoes 1cm thick, salt and rest 10 minutes, then pat dry. Dip in 200ml buttermilk, then in 150g fine cornmeal mixed with 50g flour, paprika, salt and pepper. Shallow fry in 1cm of 180C oil for 2 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade, mix 150g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tsp Dijon, a dash of hot sauce and lemon juice. Serve hot.
M: Chicken thighs seasoned, floured and browned, a dark roux made in the same pan with onions and stock, the chicken simmered 40 minutes in the gravy, over rice with collard greens braised with garlic.
Pastrami on rye with dill pickles
a quick lunch while he works the case

Pastrami steamed until soft and piled high on rye spread with hot English and wholegrain mustard, with a whole dill pickle and salted chips on the side. Put 800g sliced pastrami in a steamer basket over simmering water, cover and steam for 10 minutes until soft and hot. Mix 2 tbsp hot English mustard with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard. Spread on 8 slices of rye bread. Pile a quarter of the pastrami onto each of 4 slices and close the sandwiches. Cut in half and serve with a whole dill pickle and potato chips.
W: Cream cheese, sugar, eggs and sour cream on a biscuit base, baked in a water bath at 150C for an hour, cooled in the oven, chilled overnight.
K: the Harlem boss whose daughter goes missing

45ml bourbon, 25ml lemon and 15ml sugar syrup shaken with ice, strained over fresh ice, a cherry on top. For each drink, shake 45ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain over fresh ice and top with a cherry. Makes four. Right on.
T: Harlem's coolest detective. Harlem's best plate.
D: A private detective in Harlem is hired to find a gangster's kidnapped daughter.
P: Serve the mains when Shaft walks into Harlem.

title: Enter the Dragon
S: the junk boats sailing out of Hong Kong harbour
Prawn and pork siu mai: mince, chopped prawn, ginger, shiitake and soy wrapped in open wonton skins, steamed 8 minutes. Chilli oil.

Cabbage, carrot, mushroom and glass noodles rolled tight in pastry, fried at 180C until golden, with sweet chilli sauce. Stir-fry 2 cups shredded wombok, a grated carrot and 100g sliced shiitake. Add 50g soaked glass noodles and soy, then cool. Roll tight in 16 spring roll wrappers and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with sweet chilli.

Scored squid dusted in rice flour and Sichuan salt and pepper, fried hard and fast, tossed with fried garlic, chilli and spring onion, with lemon. Cut 600g cleaned squid tubes open, score the inside in a crisscross and cut into strips. Toast 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns, grind with 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp white pepper and mix with 100g rice flour. Toss the squid in the flour and fry in 190C oil for 60 seconds until just crisp. Stir-fry 3 sliced garlic cloves, a sliced red chilli and 2 spring onions for 30 seconds, toss with the squid and serve with lemon.
M: the lavish feast on Han's island

Duck legs salted overnight, rubbed with five-spice and roasted until the skin crackles, shredded into steamed pancakes with cucumber, spring onion and hoisin. Rub 4 duck legs with 2 tsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Rub with 2 tsp five spice and roast skin up on a rack at 180C for 90 minutes, then 10 minutes at 220C until crisp. Shred the meat and skin with two forks. Steam 20 Chinese pancakes for 3 minutes. Serve with batons of a cucumber, shredded spring onion and a bowl of hoisin sauce.
Mirror room char siu with fried rice
the last fight among the mirrors

Pork neck marinated overnight in hoisin, soy, honey, five-spice and Shaoxing wine, roasted at 200C and glazed, sliced over egg fried rice. Marinate 800g pork neck overnight in 4 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp five spice and 2 tbsp Shaoxing. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, glazing twice. Fry 300g cooked jasmine rice with 2 eggs and spring onion. Slice the pork over.
W: a Hong Kong dessert shop favourite
Thin crêpes of flour, egg, milk and sugar cooked in a non-stick pan, cooled, wrapped around whipped cream and a thick slice of fresh mango, folded into neat parcels and chilled an hour.
K: Iced chrysanthemum and goji honey tea

Dried chrysanthemum flowers and goji berries steeped with rock sugar and honey, chilled and poured over ice with a squeeze of lemon. Bring 1.2L water to the boil, take off the heat and add 15g dried chrysanthemum flowers, 2 tbsp goji berries and 50g rock sugar. Steep for 6 minutes, stirring until the sugar melts, then strain, keeping the goji berries. Stir in 1 tbsp honey and cool, then chill for an hour. Pour over ice in four glasses, drop in a few goji berries and add a squeeze of lemon.
T: Don't think. Feel. Then eat.
D: A martial artist goes undercover at a deadly tournament on a crime lord's private island.
P: Serve the mains when Han's island banquet begins.

title: Bloodsport
S: Batter of flour, eggs, sugar, evaporated milk and a little custard powder, cooked in an egg waffle pan until crisp outside, soft inside.
Kowloon Walled City curry fish balls

Fish balls simmered in a curry sauce of curry powder, garlic, coconut milk and a little sugar, served on skewers. Fry 2 tbsp curry powder and crushed garlic in oil for a minute. Add 400ml coconut milk, a spoon of sugar and a little water and simmer 5 minutes. Add 500g fish balls and simmer for 10 minutes until hot through. Thread onto skewers and spoon over the sauce.
Frank and Ray playing the arcade game in Hong Kong

Fluffy steamed buns filled with diced char siu pork in a sticky oyster, hoisin and sugar sauce, steamed until puffed and split open on top. Dice 300g char siu pork. Fry a diced shallot, add 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp sugar and 100ml water, thicken with 1 tsp cornflour and stir in the pork. Cool. Mix 300g bao flour, 5g dried yeast, 30g sugar and 160ml warm water into a soft dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 12, fill, pinch closed and prove 20 minutes. Steam 12 minutes.
M: Pork and prawn wontons in a clear chicken, ginger and dried shrimp broth with thin egg noodles, blanched choy sum and a drizzle of sesame oil. Simmer 1.5L chicken stock with 4 slices ginger and 1 tbsp dried shrimp for 20 minutes, then season with soy and white pepper. Mix 200g pork mince, 200g chopped green prawns, sesame oil and soy, and fold into 24 wonton wrappers. Boil the wontons for 3 minutes. Cook 300g thin egg noodles for 1 minute and blanch 2 bunches choy sum. Divide into bowls, top with wontons and pour over the hot broth.
the night before the final fight

Rump steak strips marinated in soy and cornflour, stir-fried hard with onion, capsicum and garlic, finished with lots of cracked black pepper and oyster sauce, over steamed rice. Slice 600g rump steak thinly and marinate in soy and a spoon of cornflour for 20 minutes. Stir-fry hard in a very hot wok, then add sliced onion, green capsicum and garlic. Finish with oyster sauce and a big spoon of cracked black pepper. Serve over jasmine rice.
W: the champion nobody wants to draw

Puff pastry pressed into tart tins, filled with a custard of eggs, milk, evaporated milk and sugar strained until silky, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until just set and wobbly. Cut puff pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin. Whisk 3 eggs with 150ml milk, 100ml evaporated milk and 80g sugar until dissolved, then strain until silky. Fill the cases and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until just set and still wobbly in the centre.
K: the cha chaan teng café round the corner
Strong black tea simmered 5 minutes, strained through a fine cloth, mixed with evaporated milk and sugar, served hot or over ice.
T: Full contact. Full plates.
D: An American soldier goes absent without leave to fight in a secret, brutal martial arts tournament in Hong Kong.
P: Serve the snacks when Ray and Frank arrive in Hong Kong.

title: Rumble in the Bronx
S: the shop Uncle Bill sells to Elaine

Rye bread squares stacked with pastrami, sauerkraut and Swiss, toasted until the cheese melts, with a dab of Russian dressing and a pickle on a pick. Cut 6 slices of rye bread into quarters and toast lightly at 200C for 4 minutes. Top each with folded pastrami from 250g, a little drained sauerkraut from 150g and a square of Swiss cheese from 150g. Bake 5 minutes until melted. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish and chopped pickle. Dab on each bite and spear with a slice of dill pickle.
his uncle's Chinese family in New York
Pork, garlic chives, ginger and sesame oil folded into wrappers, pan-fried until crisp underneath, then steamed. Black vinegar dip.
Uncle Bill's family in New York

Soft steamed buns filled with sticky honey and hoisin barbecue pork, steamed until puffed and served hot with extra hoisin for dipping. Dice 300g char siu pork and stir into 2 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 80ml water thickened with 1 tsp cornflour. Cool. Mix 300g bao flour, 5g dried yeast, 30g sugar and 160ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 12, roll into discs, fill and pleat closed. Prove 20 minutes on squares of baking paper and steam 12 minutes. Serve with hoisin.
M: Ginger and spring onion lobster noodles

Lobster tails cut through the shell and wok-fried with ginger and spring onion in a light oyster sauce, piled over crisp-edged soft egg noodles. Cut 4 lobster tails through the shell into chunks, or use 800g king prawns. Dust in cornflour and fry in a hot wok for 2 minutes, then set aside. Pan-fry 400g boiled egg noodles in oil until crisp underneath. Stir-fry 50g sliced ginger and 6 spring onion lengths, add the lobster, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine and 150ml chicken stock and toss 2 minutes. Pour over the noodles.
the hovercraft loose in the streets

Pork shoulder pieces in a light batter, fried crisp, tossed in a sauce of pineapple, capsicum, vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce. Toss 700g diced pork shoulder in egg and 100g cornflour and fry at 180C until crisp. Simmer chunks of half a pineapple and a red capsicum with 80ml vinegar, 80g sugar and 80ml tomato sauce, then thicken. Toss the pork through and serve with 300g jasmine rice.
W: Milk set with gelatine and almond extract, cut into cubes, served with lychees and mandarin segments in syrup.
K: Uncle Bill's wedding iced jasmine tea
the wedding that brings Keung to New York

Fragrant jasmine tea steeped strong, sweetened with lychee syrup, poured over ice with whole lychees and a twist of lime. Heat 1L water to just off the boil and steep 5 tsp jasmine tea for 4 minutes, then strain and cool. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Stir 150ml of the syrup and the juice of a lime into the tea and chill for an hour. Fill four tall glasses with ice and a few lychees, pour in the tea and finish with a twist of lime peel.
T: New York welcome. Hong Kong kicks.
D: A Hong Kong cop visiting his uncle in New York ends up protecting a supermarket from a street gang.
P: Serve the mains at his uncle's wedding banquet.

title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
S: the inn where Jen takes on every fighter
Pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed 8 minutes in bamboo baskets, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
the fight on top of the bamboo forest

Baby bok choy, snow peas and bamboo shoots stir-fried fast in a smoking wok with garlic, oyster sauce and sesame oil, served in a bamboo steamer basket. Halve 4 baby bok choy and trim 150g snow peas. Drain a 225g tin of bamboo shoots. Heat a wok until smoking, add 2 tbsp oil and 4 sliced garlic cloves and stir 10 seconds. Add the bok choy stems, snow peas and bamboo shoots and toss 1 minute, then the leaves with a splash of water. Add 2 tbsp oyster sauce and a few drops of sesame oil, toss and serve in a bamboo basket.
the desert where Jen meets Lo
Lamb shoulder cubes rubbed with cumin, chilli flakes and salt, threaded on skewers and grilled hot until charred.
M: Duck legs salted overnight and roasted until the skin crackles, shredded into steamed pancakes with cucumber, spring onion and sweet hoisin. Rub 4 duck legs with 2 tsp salt and a little five spice and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast skin up on a rack at 180C for 90 minutes, then at 220C for 10 minutes until crisp. Shred with two forks. Steam 20 Chinese pancakes for 3 minutes. Cut a cucumber and 4 spring onions into thin batons. Serve everything with a bowl of hoisin to build your own.
Yu Shu Lien's steamed whole fish
a quiet meal at her security company

Whole snapper scored, steamed over ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes, finished with smoking hot oil poured over fresh spring onion, soy sauce and coriander. Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and lay on sliced ginger and spring onion. Steam for 12 minutes. Pile fresh shredded spring onion and coriander on top, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil so it sizzles.
W: Li Mu Bai's sword, stolen in the night

Glutinous rice flour mixed with sugar and hot water into a dough, wrapped around balls of red bean paste, rolled in sesame seeds, fried at 160C until puffed and golden. Mix 250g glutinous rice flour and 60g sugar with about 200ml hot water into a dough. Wrap around small balls of red bean paste, roll in sesame seeds and fry at 160C until puffed and golden.
K: Hand-rolled jasmine pearl green tea steeped gently at 80C, poured into small cups and refilled through the meal with dried longan on the side. Heat 1L water to about 80C, or boil it and leave it to stand for 5 minutes. Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tsp jasmine pearl green tea, pour over the water and steep for 2 minutes. Pour into small cups. Refill the pot with fresh water for a second and third steep. Serve a bowl of dried longan on the side.
T: The sword is hidden. The dumplings are not.
D: A legendary warrior's stolen sword draws a young noblewoman into a world of martial arts and secrets.
P: Serve the tea when the fight breaks out in the teahouse.

title: Shanghai Noon
S: the Forbidden City where Chon starts out
Pork and prawn dumplings with ginger and spring onion, pleated and steamed 8 minutes, with soy and black vinegar.

Thin-sliced beef topside marinated in soy, ginger, five-spice, black pepper and smoked paprika, dried low in the oven until chewy. Half Shanghai, half Nevada. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick against the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 1 tsp five spice, 1 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.

Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, with honey butter. Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 220C oven. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter briefly. Pour in and bake 20 minutes. Serve with 60g butter beaten with honey.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with five-spice, brown sugar, garlic and salt, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with hoisin and honey under the grill. Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 2 tsp five spice, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 garlic cloves and salt. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 4 tbsp hoisin mixed with 2 tbsp honey and glaze under the grill.
the outlaw's camp under the stars

Rump steak seared over hot coals and sliced, with beans simmered slowly with bacon, onion, molasses and mustard until thick and sticky, and charred bread. Fry 200g diced bacon and an onion until golden. Add 2 drained 400g cans of cannellini beans, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp Dijon, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 300ml water and simmer 1 hour until thick. Season 2 large rump steaks, about 1kg, and sear over very hot coals or a grill pan for 4 minutes a side. Rest 5 minutes and slice. Serve with the beans and grilled crusty bread.
W: Cool almond milk jelly cut into diamonds and served in a bowl with lychees and their syrup.
K: the bathtub drinking game at the saloon

Rye whisky stirred with cold jasmine tea, honey and lemon, poured long over ice and topped with soda. Half Shanghai, half Nevada. Steep 3 tsp jasmine tea in 400ml water just off the boil for 4 minutes, strain and chill. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp hot water to loosen. Fill four highball glasses with ice. Into each pour 45ml rye whisky, 100ml cold jasmine tea, 2 tsp honey syrup and 10ml lemon juice. Stir, top with soda water and add a strip of lemon peel.
T: East meets Wild West. Both bring food.
D: An imperial guard heads to 1880s Nevada to rescue a kidnapped princess, with a smooth-talking outlaw in tow.
P: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy hit the saloon in Carson City.

title: Young Guns
S: the English rancher who teaches the boys manners
Cucumber and butter, and ham and mustard sandwiches, crusts off, cut into triangles, a proper English touch on a New Mexico ranch.
Roasted green chillies chopped into a hot cheese dip of cheddar melted into evaporated milk with garlic, with tortilla chips.

Thin-sliced beef topside marinated in Worcestershire, soy, cracked pepper and chilli, dried low in the oven until chewy and dark. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick against the grain. Mix 80ml Worcestershire sauce, 40ml soy sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp cracked black pepper and 1 tsp chilli flakes. Marinate the beef overnight in the fridge. Pat dry, press on more pepper and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the door ajar for 4 hours until leathery. Cool and store airtight.
M: Beef chuck browned and braised slowly with onion, carrot, potato and toasted dried red chillies until thick and rich, with warm flour tortillas. Toast 4 dried red chillies in a dry pan, soak in 300ml hot water for 20 minutes and blitz smooth. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 garlic cloves, add 1 tsp cumin, the chilli puree and 500ml beef stock, and return the beef. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 2 carrots and 500g potatoes in chunks and cook 1 hour more. Serve with warm flour tortillas.
Pork shoulder in chunks browned, braised 2.5 hours with roasted green chillies, tomatillos, onion, garlic and cumin until it falls apart, served over rice.
W: Butter and sugar creamed with aniseed, flour worked in, rolled and cut into stars, dipped in cinnamon sugar, baked at 175C for 10 minutes until pale gold.
K: Rye whisky stirred down over ice with demerara syrup and aromatic bitters, poured over one big ice cube with a wide strip of orange peel. Stir 50g demerara sugar into 50ml hot water to make a syrup and cool. For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add 60ml rye whisky, 10ml of the syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain over a large ice cube in a short glass. Squeeze a wide strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.
T: Six guns. One ranch table.
D: A group of young ranch hands become outlaws after their mentor is murdered in New Mexico.
P: Serve the mains when Tunstall's boys sit down at his ranch table.

title: Unforgiven
S: Pig farm crackling with apple sauce
Munny's struggling pig farm in Kansas

Pork rind scored, salted and dried overnight, roasted hot until blistered and crackling, broken into shards and served with warm spiced apple sauce. Score 600g pork rind every 1cm, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Pat dry, lay skin up on a rack and roast at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and blistered. Meanwhile, simmer 3 peeled, chopped green apples with 2 tbsp brown sugar, a pinch of cinnamon and 3 tbsp water for 10 minutes and mash. Break the crackling into shards and serve with the warm sauce.
the long ride north to Wyoming
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and bacon fat mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, peeled, pickled 3 days in hot vinegar with beetroot, sugar, mustard seed and peppercorns.
M: Rainy night beef and bean stew
sheltering from the rain on the trail
Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic and dried chilli, tomato and beans, braised at 160C for 3 hours until thick.
home on the farm with his children

Thick pork chops seared in cast iron, with apples and onions cooked golden in the same fat and a cider pan sauce, buttery mash and wilted greens. Season 4 thick pork chops and sear in a hot cast iron pan for 4 minutes a side, then rest. Add 20g butter, 2 sliced apples and a sliced onion and cook 8 minutes until golden. Pour in 150ml apple cider and 100ml chicken stock and reduce by half. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Wilt a bunch of silverbeet with garlic. Serve the chops with apples and sauce over the top.
W: Big Whiskey bread pudding, whiskey sauce
Greeley's saloon in Big Whiskey, Wyoming

Day-old bread baked in a cinnamon custard with raisins until puffed and golden, served warm under a buttery brown sugar whiskey sauce. Tear 400g day-old bread into a buttered dish with 80g raisins. Whisk 4 eggs, 600ml milk, 120g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon, pour over and soak 20 minutes, then bake at 170C for 45 minutes until set and golden. Melt 80g butter with 100g brown sugar and 100ml cream, simmer 2 minutes and stir in 40ml whiskey. Pour over the warm pudding to serve.
K: the whiskey Munny swore off, until he doesn't

Strong boiled coffee sweetened with brown sugar and spiked with whiskey, poured into tin mugs and topped with a float of lightly whipped cream. Bring 1L water to the boil in a pot, stir in 60g coarse ground coffee and simmer 2 minutes. Take off the heat, splash in a little cold water to settle the grounds and rest 3 minutes. Lightly whip 150ml cream until just thick. Put 2 tsp brown sugar and 30ml whiskey in each of four mugs, pour in the coffee carefully and stir. Spoon the cream over the back of a spoon to float it on top.
T: One last job. One hot meal.
D: A retired gunfighter turned pig farmer takes one last bounty in a Wyoming town run by a brutal sheriff.
P: Serve the mains when the riders finally get in out of the rain.

title: City Slickers
S: Curly's one-thing brisket sliders with slaw
one thing, and you work out what

Beef brisket rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow-cooked until it pulls apart, piled into soft slider buns with barbecue sauce and a tangy slaw. Rub 1kg beef brisket with 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and salt. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Shred with two forks and stir through 150ml barbecue sauce and the juices. Toss a quarter cabbage, shredded, with 2 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 12 slider buns with brisket and slaw.
the first night out on the drive

Buttermilk cornbread baked in a smoking hot cast iron pan until crusty at the edges, cut into wedges and served warm with whipped honey butter. Put a cast iron pan with 20g butter in the oven and heat to 220C. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter, then stir briefly into the dry mix. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes until golden. Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm wedges.
the guys' life back in the city
Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill.
M: Beef chuck diced and browned, braised with dried chillies, cumin, garlic, tomato and beans for 3 hours. Cornbread.
Cast iron rib eye with ranch beans

Rib eye seasoned heavily and seared in cast iron, rested, with beans simmered with bacon and molasses and potatoes fried crisp in the steak pan with onion. Fry 150g diced bacon and an onion, add 2 drained cans of cannellini beans, 3 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard and 300ml water and simmer 45 minutes. Parboil 800g potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes. Season 4 rib eye steaks heavily and sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 4 minutes a side, then rest. Fry the potatoes and a sliced onion in the steak fat until crisp.
W: the calf Mitch helps bring into the world

Big marshmallows toasted on sticks over the fire until blistered, sandwiched with a square of milk chocolate between two digestive biscuits and pressed so it melts. Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire until blistered. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 digestive biscuits, 100g chocolate and 32 biscuits in all, and press so it melts.
K: Coarse coffee boiled with a cinnamon stick in the pot, settled, poured into tin mugs and topped with cold cream whipped with brown sugar and cinnamon. Bring 1.2L water to the boil with a cinnamon stick and stir in 80g coarse ground coffee. Boil 4 minutes, then take off the heat and splash in 100ml cold water to settle the grounds. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp ground cinnamon until soft peaks. Pour the coffee carefully into tin mugs, leaving the grounds behind, and top each with a spoon of the cream.
T: Find your one thing. Then find the chuckwagon.
D: Three city friends in a midlife crisis sign up for a cattle drive holiday.
P: Serve the mains when the friends take over the cooking on the trail.

title: Road House
S: Wings dried overnight and baked until crisp, tossed in hot sauce butter, served with a chunky blue cheese dip and cold celery sticks. Leave 1kg chicken wings uncovered in the fridge overnight, then toss with 1 tbsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 60g butter with 100ml hot sauce. Mash 100g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Toss the hot wings in the sauce and serve with the dip and celery sticks.

Halved jalapeños packed with cream cheese, cheddar and smoked paprika, wrapped in streaky bacon and baked until crisp, with a cool ranch dip. Halve 12 jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds. Beat 200g cream cheese with 60g grated cheddar and half a tsp smoked paprika and pack into the halves. Wrap each in half a rasher of streaky bacon and pin with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp. Mix 150g sour cream with chopped chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for a dip.
the loft on Emmet's farm by the river
Cucumbers packed into jars with garlic, dill and peppercorns in a hot vinegar brine, pickled a week, with sharp cheddar.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar, garlic and cayenne, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with a tomato and molasses barbecue sauce under the grill.

Rump steak seared hard in cast iron and basted with garlic thyme butter, with a baked potato loaded with sour cream, bacon and chives, and a green salad. Rub 4 large potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 rump steaks and sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 3 minutes. Flip, add 50g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for 3 minutes for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes. Split the potatoes and top with sour cream, crisp bacon and chives. Serve with a green salad dressed in oil and vinegar.
W: Jasper, Missouri, the Double Deuce's town
A St Louis classic: cake base under a rich, gooey butter and cream cheese layer, dusted with icing sugar.
K: the bar behind the chicken wire stage

Bourbon poured over ice with fresh lime and a dash of bitters, topped with spicy ginger beer and finished with a lime wedge. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Pour 45ml bourbon into each and squeeze in a lime wedge. Add a dash of aromatic bitters to each glass. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and give it one gentle stir. Garnish with a fresh lime wedge and serve straight away while the band plays.
T: Be nice. Until it's time to eat.
D: A professional bar cooler is hired to clean up the roughest roadhouse in Missouri.
P: Serve the snacks when Dalton takes over the Double Deuce.

title: Rocky II
S: Rocky's shift at the meat packing plant
Thick slices of pork roll fried until the edges curl, stacked on soft rolls with fried egg and cheese.
Wedding day devilled eggs with crisp ham

Eggs boiled and halved, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and a dash of hot sauce, piped back and topped with crisp fried ham, paprika and chives. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon, a dash of hot sauce, salt and pepper until smooth. Dice 100g leg ham finely and fry in a dry pan until crisp. Pipe the yolk mix back into the whites, top with the crisp ham, a dusting of paprika and chopped chives.
Prosciutto folded with cubes of provolone, olives and strips of roasted capsicum on toothpicks, with crusty bread and olive oil.
M: the chicken chasing training, Mickey's idea

Whole chicken spatchcocked and rubbed with garlic, lemon, rosemary and paprika, roasted until the skin is crisp, with potatoes roasted in the drippings. Cut the backbone out of a 1.8kg chicken and press it flat. Rub with 4 crushed garlic cloves, the zest and juice of a lemon, chopped rosemary, 2 tsp paprika, olive oil and salt. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and salt in a roasting tin and sit the chicken on top. Roast at 220C for 45 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes, then carve.
home cooking in the new house
Beef and pork meatballs with breadcrumbs, parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
W: Ricotta drained and beaten with icing sugar, orange zest and chopped dark chocolate, piped into crisp shells, ends dipped in pistachio.
K: the morning run with half of Philadelphia behind him
A ripe banana, cold milk, oats, a spoon of peanut butter and honey blended thick. Skip the raw eggs.
T: Catch the chicken. Then cook it.
D: Rocky marries Adrian and trains for a rematch with the champion.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky finally catches the chicken.

title: Rocky III
S: Rocky made it big, but he's still from Philly

Ciabatta grilled until charred, rubbed with garlic and piled with ripe tomato, basil, olive oil and sea salt, finished with shaved parmesan. Slice a ciabatta into 12 pieces, brush with olive oil and grill or chargrill until charred. Rub each piece with a cut garlic clove. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes, mix with torn basil, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, a splash of balsamic and sea salt, and rest 10 minutes. Pile on the bread just before serving and top with shaved parmesan.
training on the beach in Los Angeles
White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm tortillas with cabbage, lime crema and salsa.
the old Los Angeles gym where Apollo started out

Chicken thighs marinated in chilli, lime and garlic, grilled until charred and chopped, on small corn tortillas with onion, coriander and a smoky salsa roja. Marinate 700g chicken thighs for 1 hour in the juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and oil. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side and chop. Char 3 tomatoes and a soaked dried chilli, then blitz with a garlic clove and salt for salsa. Warm 16 small corn tortillas and fill with chicken, diced white onion, coriander and salsa.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with brown rice, broccoli and a squeeze of lemon. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed brown rice, broccoli florets and an extra squeeze of lemon. Fuel for a training camp.
