Adrian and the family in Philadelphia

Pork shoulder, Italian sausages and meatballs browned and simmered for hours in a garlic and basil tomato sauce, served over rigatoni with parmesan. Brown 600g pork shoulder in chunks and 4 Italian sausages in olive oil. Mix 400g beef mince with an egg, 50g breadcrumbs and parmesan, roll into balls and brown. Soften 4 garlic cloves, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 250ml water and basil. Return all the meat and simmer gently for 3 hours, covered. Serve over 500g rigatoni with grated parmesan.
W: Savoiardi dipped in espresso, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa on top. Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar until pale, then fold in 250g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip savoiardi biscuits briefly in cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Repeat, finish with cream, chill overnight and dust with cocoa.
K: the sprints on the sand with Apollo
Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water stirred in a big jug with bruised mint and plenty of ice.
T: Rich, soft, then hungry again.
D: A comfortable champion loses his edge and has to train with his old rival to win it back.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky and Apollo start training at the LA gym.

title: Creed
S: the Italian restaurant Rocky runs, named after Adrian
Salami and provolone folded on a board with olives warmed in olive oil, marinated artichokes, strips of roasted capsicum and torn crusty bread.
Italian hoagie bites with hot peppers

Long rolls layered with ham, salami, capocollo, provolone, lettuce, tomato and onion, dressed with oil, vinegar and oregano, cut into bites with hot cherry peppers. Split 2 long Italian rolls. Drizzle the insides with olive oil and red wine vinegar and sprinkle with dried oregano. Layer with 100g leg ham, 100g salami, 100g capocollo and 100g provolone. Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, thin red onion and chopped hot cherry peppers. Press closed, wrap tightly for 15 minutes, then cut each into 6 bites with a toothpick through each.
the old boxing gym in Philly
Medjool dates, oats, peanut butter, cocoa and a pinch of salt blitzed in a food processor, rolled into balls and coated in desiccated coconut, chilled an hour.
M: Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared on a hot plate with onions, provolone or cheese sauce melted over, piled into long rolls.

Beef chuck and lamb neck browned and simmered with onion, carrot and potato until the potato breaks down, with pickled red cabbage and crusty bread. Brown 600g diced beef chuck and 400g lamb neck in batches. Add 2 sliced onions and 3 carrots in chunks and cook 5 minutes. Add 1kg potatoes in chunks, 1L beef stock and a bay leaf. Simmer gently, partly covered, for 2 hours, stirring now and then, until the potatoes break down and thicken the stew. Season well. Serve with a jar of pickled red cabbage and buttered crusty bread.
W: a box from the Italian bakery near Adrian's

Almond sponge batter split in three, tinted green, left plain and tinted red, baked in thin layers at 175C for 12 minutes, stacked with apricot jam, pressed overnight, covered in dark chocolate and sliced.
K: Training camp honey lemon ginger fizz
between rounds at the training camp

Fresh lemon juice shaken with ginger and honey syrup and a pinch of salt, poured over ice and topped with sparkling water and a lemon wheel. Grate a 4cm knob of ginger into a small pan with 4 tbsp honey and 100ml water and simmer 3 minutes, then strain and cool. Squeeze 3 lemons into a jug, add the ginger syrup and a small pinch of salt and stir. Fill four tall glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top each with 200ml cold sparkling water. Finish with a lemon wheel.
T: One step. One punch. One cheesesteak.
D: Apollo Creed's son asks Rocky to train him and steps out of his father's shadow.
P: Serve the mains when Adonis and Bianca go out for cheesesteaks.

title: Million Dollar Baby
S: Maggie wrapping up steak left on customers' plates
Rump steak seared hard, rested, cut into bite-sized pieces and tossed in garlic butter, served on toothpicks with a little horseradish.
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, honey butter.
M: the diner where Maggie waits tables
Rump steak seared to medium-rare, rested, with two fried eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.
the training diet in the gym

Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, over steamed rice with garlicky broccolini and a spoon of tzatziki. Marinate 800g chicken thighs for 1 hour in the zest and juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, olive oil and salt. Rinse 300g long grain rice and simmer covered in 450ml water for 12 minutes, then rest 5 minutes. Grill the chicken over high heat for 5 minutes a side until charred and cooked through. Blanch 2 bunches broccolini and toss with garlic oil. Serve with tzatziki and lemon wedges.
W: the real lemon pie at the roadside diner Frankie loves
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a lemon curd of lemon juice, zest, sugar, cornflour, yolks and butter, topped with a tall Italian meringue, browned at 200C for 6 minutes.
K: Diner coffee float with vanilla ice cream
the late drive back from the diner

Strong drip coffee chilled and poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream in tall diner glasses, topped with whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 800ml strong drip coffee from 60g ground coffee and stir in 2 tbsp brown sugar while hot. Cool, then chill for an hour. Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour the cold coffee slowly over the ice cream so it foams up. Top with a swirl of whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.
T: Tough ain't enough. Lemon pie helps.
D: A determined waitress talks a grizzled boxing trainer into taking her on.
P: Serve dessert when Frankie and Maggie stop at the roadside diner for lemon pie.

title: Cinderella Man
S: the salami his son takes and James makes him give back

Toasted baguette spread with whipped lemon ricotta, topped with folded salami, a sliver of pickled onion and cracked pepper. Bought and paid for this time. Slice a baguette into 16 thin rounds, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes until golden. Whip 200g ricotta with the zest of a lemon, a pinch of salt and a drizzle of olive oil until smooth. Spread on the toasts and top each with a folded slice of salami from 150g. Finish with a sliver of pickled onion, cracked black pepper and a few parsley leaves.
making a little go a long way
Thick slices of white bread fried slowly in hot beef dripping until golden and crisp on both sides, drained, sprinkled with flaky salt and cracked pepper, served hot.
the fight crowd at the big arena

Franks simmered then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with yellow mustard and sauerkraut warmed with caraway and onion, wrapped in wax paper. Fry a sliced onion in 20g butter until soft, add 400g drained sauerkraut and 1 tsp caraway seeds and warm through for 10 minutes. Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns over the simmering water for 1 minute. Fill each bun with a frank, a line of yellow mustard and a spoon of the kraut. Wrap each in wax paper to serve.
M: Mae making one pot feed the whole family
Beef shin browned, onion, carrot, potato and barley, stock and thyme, simmered 3 hours until thick. Bread.
Comeback rib eye with mash and gravy
the first proper meal after a win

Rib eye seared hard and basted in butter and thyme, rested, with buttery mashed potato, minted peas and a rich gravy made from the pan juices. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 80g butter and 100ml hot milk. Season 4 rib eye steaks and sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes, then flip, add 40g butter and thyme and baste for 3 minutes. Rest 5 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan, whisk in 300ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Cook 300g frozen peas with butter and chopped mint. Serve together.
W: Day-old bread torn into a buttered dish with sultanas, soaked 20 minutes in a custard of eggs, milk, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.
K: the milk they can barely afford in the Depression

Full cream milk warmed slowly with honey, a cinnamon stick and vanilla, frothed and poured into mugs with fresh nutmeg grated over the top. Pour 1L full cream milk into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, a cinnamon stick and half a tsp vanilla extract. Warm gently over low heat for 8 minutes, stirring, until steaming but not boiling. Remove the cinnamon stick. Whisk hard for 30 seconds until frothy, or use a milk frother. Pour into four mugs and grate fresh nutmeg over each.
T: Feed the family. Then fight.
D: A broke Depression-era boxer makes an unlikely comeback to keep his family together.
P: Serve the mains when the Braddocks sit down to their thin family dinner.

title: The Fighter
S: Beer-battered onion rings with malt aioli
the local bar where Charlene works

Thick onion rings dipped in a cold lager batter and fried golden and crisp, salted hot and served with a malt vinegar and garlic aioli. Cut 2 large brown onions into 1cm rings and separate. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt with 250ml cold lager until just smooth. Dust the rings in flour, dip in the batter and fry in batches at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Salt straight away. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp malt vinegar and a crushed garlic clove for the dip.
Beef topside roasted rare, sliced paper thin, piled into soft rolls with a tangy barbecue sauce, mayo and white American cheese.

Bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam juice and milk added, clams and cream at the end, served in small cups with oyster crackers. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Add a diced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 2 cans baby clams with their juice drained into 300ml, plus 300ml milk and 2 diced potatoes. Simmer 15 minutes until the potato is tender. Add the clams and 150ml cream and heat through without boiling. Season with pepper and serve in cups with oyster crackers and chives.
M: Alice's Sunday pot roast and gravy
the loud house full of sisters

Beef chuck seared dark and braised with onion, carrot, celery, red wine and thyme until fork tender, with potatoes cooked in the juices and a thick gravy. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and sear on all sides in a heavy casserole. Add 2 quartered onions, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Lift out the meat and veg, then simmer the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed in water until thick. Slice and serve with the gravy.
Lowell, the whole family at the table

Ziti tossed in a fennel sausage and tomato sauce with dollops of ricotta, baked under a bubbling mozzarella and parmesan crust. Squeeze 400g Italian sausages from their skins and brown in a pan, breaking them up. Add 2 crushed garlic cloves, 700g passata and a pinch of chilli flakes and simmer 15 minutes. Boil 500g ziti or penne for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Toss with the sauce, spread in a baking dish and dot with 250g ricotta. Top with 200g grated mozzarella and 40g parmesan and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C, sandwiched with chilled vanilla pastry cream, topped with dark chocolate ganache poured over and left to set.
K: A pint of cold pale ale with Irish stout poured slowly over the back of a spoon so it sits in a dark layer on top. Chill four pint glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Pour a 375ml can of pale ale into each glass, tilting it so the head stays small. Hold a spoon upside down just above the beer and slowly pour 200ml Irish stout over the back of it so it floats in a dark layer on top. Serve straight away before the layers mix.
T: Lowell's own. Pull up a stool.
D: A working-class boxer from Lowell, Massachusetts tries to escape the shadow of his troubled brother.
P: Serve the mains when Micky takes Charlene out after her shift at the bar.

title: Weird Science
S: the party while Wyatt's parents are away
A hollowed cob loaf filled with hot cheese, bacon and onion dip, with the torn bread for dunking.
Salt and vinegar chips with onion dip

Potatoes sliced paper thin, soaked in vinegar, fried until crisp and tossed with salt and malt vinegar, with a creamy French onion and chive dip. Slice 4 large potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and soak in 500ml water with 200ml white vinegar for 30 minutes. Dry very well on tea towels. Fry in small batches at 170C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crisp. Toss with flaky salt and a sprinkle of malt vinegar. Mix 250g sour cream with half a packet of French onion soup mix and chopped chives for the dip.
the Chicago blues bar Lisa takes them to
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, blue cheese dip.
M: Shermer, Illinois, where it all goes wrong

Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato with oregano, mozzarella, pepperoni and mushroom, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, sliced and left in the box on the bench. Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, then scatter grated mozzarella, pepperoni and sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the highest oven heat for 7 to 10 minutes. Slice and leave in a box on the bench.
the Chicago suburbs where it all happens

Beef topside roasted rare, sliced paper thin and dunked in garlic and oregano beef jus, piled into soft rolls with hot pickled giardiniera. Rub 1kg beef topside with oil, salt, pepper and 1 tsp oregano and roast at 200C for 35 minutes to rare. Rest, chill for an hour and slice paper thin. Simmer 1L beef stock with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the roasting juices for 15 minutes. Dip the beef in the jus for 1 minute, pile into 4 split long rolls, spoon over more jus and top with giardiniera.
W: Big brother Chet's party sheet cake
Wyatt's brother, before Lisa sorts him out

Chocolate cake baked in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes, cooled, spread thickly with fudge frosting and covered in sprinkles, cut into big squares straight from the tray. Beat 200g butter with 300g sugar, then 3 eggs. Fold in 300g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 250ml milk. Bake in a lined tray at 175C for 30 minutes and cool. Spread with fudge frosting of butter, icing sugar and cocoa, then cover with sprinkles.
K: Lisa takes the boys to the blues bar

Bourbon muddled with lemon wedges, mint and sugar syrup, shaken with ice and poured over crushed ice with a mint sprig on top. Dissolve 60g sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. For each drink, muddle half a lemon cut into wedges with 4 mint leaves and 15ml of the syrup in a shaker. Add 50ml bourbon and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Pour everything into a short glass and top with crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig.
T: They made the perfect woman. You make the snacks.
D: Two teenage nerds use a computer to create their dream woman, and their weekend goes wild.
P: Serve the snacks when the house party kicks off at Wyatt's place.

title: Better Off Dead
S: the paperboy chasing his two dollars
Thin fries soaked in cold water an hour, dried, fried at 140C then 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce.
the French exchange student next door

Ham and gruyère sandwiches spread with Dijon and a nutmeg béchamel, grilled until bubbling and golden, cut into neat squares. Melt 25g butter, stir in 25g flour, whisk in 250ml milk and simmer until thick, then add nutmeg, salt and 30g grated gruyere. Spread 8 slices of white bread with Dijon. Fill 4 with 150g leg ham and 80g grated gruyere and close. Spread the béchamel on top, scatter with 40g more gruyere and grill for 4 to 5 minutes until bubbling and golden. Cut each into 4 squares.
the ski slopes and the K-12
Gruyère and emmental melted into white wine with garlic and a little cornflour, kept warm, with bread cubes and apple to dip.
M: Lane's job at the burger place

Two smashed chuck patties with American cheese, pickles, onion and a tangy burger sauce on a toasted bun, wrapped in paper. Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls of 100g. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add the balls, smash flat, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns. Stack two patties per bun with sauce, pickles and finely diced onion, and wrap in baking paper.
his mum's strange cooking that wriggles off the plate
Chicken, mushroom and rice baked together in a creamy thyme sauce at 180C for 50 minutes, golden on top. Nothing moves.
W: Thin crêpe batter rested an hour, cooked in a buttered pan 1 minute a side, folded with sugar and lemon juice, or with sliced banana and melted dark chocolate.
K: the French exchange student does it properly
Fresh lemon juice with sugar syrup on the side and cold water to mix your own, the French way.
T: Two dollars. And a burger.
D: A heartbroken teenager tries to win back his girlfriend by beating the school's ski champion down the K-12.
P: Serve the mains when Lane starts his shift at the burger joint.

title: Can't Buy Me Love
S: the cafeteria where everyone watches them walk in

Chicken tenderloins crumbed in panko and parmesan, baked crisp, served on a tray with honey mustard dipping sauce and crunchy potato gems. Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in 50g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 100g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan and paprika. Lay on a lined tray with 500g frozen potato gems, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 3 tbsp honey and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for the dip. Serve on a tray.
Mini franks wrapped in bacon and griddled until crisp, tucked into soft rolls with warm pinto beans, diced tomato, onion, mustard and a spoon of jalapeño salsa.
Baked potato halves scooped out, filled with bacon and cheddar, baked crisp and topped with sour cream and chives.
M: Beef chuck braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until it shreds, rolled with cheddar in flour tortillas, fried crisp, with sour cream and guacamole. Soak 3 dried chillies, blitz with 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 400ml beef stock. Braise 1kg beef chuck in the sauce, covered, at 160C for 3 hours, then shred and reduce until thick. Lay the beef and 150g grated cheddar on 8 large flour tortillas, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Fry seam side down at 180C for 2 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with sour cream and guacamole.
Corn tortillas rolled around chicken and cheddar, baked in red chilli sauce under more melted cheese.
W: Ronald pays Cindy $1000 to go out with him

Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, whipped cream piped high, chopped peanuts and a cherry on top. Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and pipe whipped cream high. Top with chopped peanuts and a cherry.
K: the borrowed white suede outfit and the red wine stain
Cranberry juice and lemonade with sliced orange over ice in a big jug, red enough to make anyone nervous.
T: A thousand dollars buys a girlfriend. Not dinner.
D: A nerdy teenager pays the most popular girl at school to pretend to date him for a month.
P: Serve the snacks when Ronald and Cindy walk into the cafeteria together.

title: Say Anything...
S: the party where Lloyd keeps everyone's car keys

Pork and fennel sausage meat rolled in buttery puff pastry with sesame seeds, baked golden and flaky, served hot with a sharp tomato relish. Mix 500g sausage mince with a grated onion, 1 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 30g breadcrumbs and pepper. Halve 2 puff pastry sheets, lay a log of filling along each strip and roll up, sealing with beaten egg. Cut each into 4, brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden and puffed. Serve hot with tomato relish.
Sweet and salty road trip snack mix
the driving lesson by the petrol station

Pretzels, peanuts and cereal squares baked in a Worcestershire, garlic and brown sugar butter until crunchy, tossed with chocolate drops once cool. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and half a tsp smoked paprika. Toss with 150g mini pretzels, 150g roasted peanuts and 150g wheat cereal squares in a large tray. Bake at 140C for 40 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Cool completely, then toss through 100g chocolate drops. Tip into paper bags for the car.
rainy Seattle, where Lloyd and Diane live
Hot-smoked salmon flaked and folded through cream cheese with dill, lemon zest and capers, spread on rye crispbread and finished with a squeeze of lemon.
M: Salmon fillets spread with Dijon and topped with breadcrumbs, parsley and lemon zest, roasted at 220C for 10 minutes, with crushed potatoes and buttered green beans.

Chicken thighs grilled in a sticky soy, mirin, ginger and garlic glaze, sliced over steamed rice with a sesame cabbage salad and pickled ginger. Simmer 100ml soy sauce, 60ml mirin, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 5 minutes until syrupy. Cook 300g jasmine rice. Grill or pan-fry 800g chicken thighs for 5 minutes a side, brushing with the glaze for the last few minutes until sticky. Toss shredded cabbage with rice vinegar and sesame oil. Slice the chicken over the rice with the salad, sesame seeds and pickled ginger.
W: Mixed berries with sugar and lemon under an oat and butter crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes. Toss 500g mixed berries with 50g sugar and a squeeze of lemon and spread in a dish. Rub 100g butter into 100g oats, 100g flour and 80g sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling and serve with vanilla ice cream.
K: Boombox Seattle mocha with whipped cream
Lloyd outside her window, stereo held high

Strong espresso stirred into steamed milk with melted dark chocolate, topped with whipped cream and shaved chocolate, served in big mugs. Brew 4 strong espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee. Warm 800ml milk with 100g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tbsp sugar, whisking until melted and frothy, without boiling. Divide the coffee between four big mugs and pour over the chocolate milk. Top each with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and shave a little chocolate over the top.
T: Hold the boombox high. Hold the plate higher.
D: An easygoing kickboxer falls for the class valedictorian the summer after graduation.
P: Serve the snacks when Lloyd keeps the keys at the graduation party.

title: Heathers
S: Dried corn kernels soaked, fried until puffed and crunchy, then tossed in melted butter, chilli powder, lime zest and salt. Soak 300g dried corn kernels in water overnight, drain and dry very well on tea towels. Fry in batches in 180C oil for about 6 minutes, using a lid as they pop, until puffed and crunchy. Drain on paper. Toss hot with 20g melted butter, 1 tsp chilli powder, the zest of a lime and 1 tsp salt. Cool so they stay crisp.
the croquet game in the opening scene

Soft white bread filled with smoked trout whipped into cream cheese with lemon and dill, thin cucumber, crusts off and cut into neat fingers. Flake 200g smoked trout and beat into 150g soft cream cheese with the zest and juice of half a lemon, chopped dill and pepper. Spread over 6 slices of soft white bread. Top with thin ribbons of a Lebanese cucumber and 6 more buttered slices. Press gently, trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers. Cover with a damp tea towel until serving.
the red scrunchie that marks the leader
Baguette sliced and toasted with olive oil, spread with whipped ricotta, topped with fresh raspberries crushed with a little sugar and a drizzle of honey.
M: Cafeteria schnitzel with mash and gravy
the high school cafeteria where the Heathers rule

Chicken breasts pounded thin, crumbed in panko and fried golden in butter and oil, with buttery mashed potato, minted peas and a pan gravy. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 120g panko. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Fry the schnitzels in 30g butter and oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Cook 300g peas with mint.
Beef and pork ragù simmered 2 hours with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and rested 20.
W: Red velvet cupcakes of buttermilk, cocoa and red colouring baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with cream cheese frosting, a red sugar dot on top.
K: Cherry juice and lemonade blended with plenty of ice until slushy, poured into tall cups with a straw and a spoon.
T: What's your damage. Have a slushie.
D: A teenager falls in with a dangerous new boyfriend who has a deadly answer to the school's popular clique.
P: Serve the drinks when J.D. and Veronica stop at the convenience store for slushies.

title: Inception
S: Cobb and Ariadne at the outdoor café before it explodes
Puff pastry cut into triangles, rolled around a stick of dark chocolate or a strip of ham and gruyère, egg washed and baked at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Cobb's spinning top totem on the table
Small lamb and beef meatballs with garlic, cumin and parsley, baked at 200C for 15 minutes, each speared upright on a toothpick so they look like little tops, with garlic yoghurt to dip.
the chase through the Mombasa markets

Spiced potato, peas and onion with garam masala and green chilli, folded into pastry triangles and fried until blistered, with a lime and coriander chutney. Boil 600g diced potatoes until tender. Fry an onion with 1 tsp cumin seeds, a chopped green chilli and 1 tsp grated ginger, add the potato, 100g peas and 2 tsp garam masala and mash lightly. Cut 12 spring roll wrappers in half, fold into cones, fill and seal with flour paste. Fry at 180C until crisp. Blitz a bunch of coriander, a green chilli, lime juice, salt and 2 tbsp yoghurt for chutney.
M: Saito's offer on the helicopter over Tokyo
Salmon fillets glazed with soy, mirin and sugar and grilled until sticky, packed into boxes with sushi rice, pickled ginger, cucumber salad and a soft-boiled egg.
Snow fortress red wine beef stew
the mountain fortress on the third dream level

Beef chuck browned and braised with onion, carrot, garlic, red wine, thyme and bay until it falls apart, served over buttery mash with gremolata. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions, 2 carrots and 4 garlic cloves, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 300ml red wine and 500ml beef stock with thyme and 2 bay leaves. Return the beef, cover and simmer for 3 hours. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Chop parsley with lemon zest and garlic for gremolata and scatter over the stew.
W: Dream within a dream layer cake
Three thin vanilla sponges baked at 175C for 15 minutes, layered with chocolate mousse and coffee cream, chilled 4 hours and cut to show every level.
K: the overnight flight from Sydney to Los Angeles
Fresh espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and ice, strained into chilled glasses with three beans on top.
T: Dream bigger. Eat bigger.
D: A thief who steals secrets from dreams is hired to plant an idea instead.
P: Serve the snacks when Ariadne folds the Paris street over their heads.

title: Interstellar
S: Last crop corn on the cob
the farms where corn is the only crop left
Corn cobs boiled 6 minutes, brushed with butter mixed with smoked paprika and lime, charred on a hot grill and sprinkled with salt and grated parmesan.
the dust storms that roll over the farm

Fresh popcorn coated in a butter caramel with smoked paprika and sea salt, baked until glassy and crunchy, broken into clusters. Pop 100g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil and tip into a large bowl. Boil 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup for 4 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in half a tsp bicarb soda, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp sea salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss to coat. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break into clusters.
Soft pretzel bites with beer cheese
Cooper and Donald's beers on the porch

Soft pretzel bites dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, with a hot beer and cheddar dipping sauce. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip the bites for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 150ml lager and 100ml milk, then 200g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard.
M: Cooper Station chicken and corn pie
the old farmhouse, rebuilt in orbit

Chicken thighs poached, shredded and folded into a creamy sauce with corn, leek and thyme, topped with shortcrust pastry and baked at 200C for 30 minutes until golden. Poach 800g chicken thighs and shred. Soften a sliced leek in butter, add 2 tbsp flour, 200ml stock and 200ml cream, then the chicken, 200g corn kernels and thyme. Tip into a dish, top with 2 sheets shortcrust and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

Pork shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and salt, roasted slow until tender, the crackling blasted until it shatters, with roast potatoes and apple sauce. Score the skin of a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Make cuts in the flesh and push in 4 garlic slivers and rosemary. Roast at 160C for 4 hours. Turn up to 240C for 25 minutes until the crackling blisters. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil alongside for the last hour. Simmer 3 chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and water and mash for apple sauce.
W: A sweet, custardy buttermilk pie with vanilla and fresh nutmeg in a crisp shortcrust case, served cool with lightly whipped cream and berries. Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 15 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 250g caster sugar, 60g melted butter, 2 tbsp plain flour, 250ml buttermilk, 1 tsp vanilla and a good grating of nutmeg until smooth. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely. Serve with whipped cream and fresh berries.
K: the beer on the porch at dusk

Cold lager topped with homemade lemonade of fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup, poured into frosted glasses with a lemon wheel. Frost four glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Dissolve 80g sugar in 80ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 4 lemons and mix the juice with the syrup and 300ml cold soda water. Half fill each glass with cold lager, about 190ml, then top with the lemonade. Add a lemon wheel and serve on the porch.
T: The last harvest is corn. Make it count.
D: Astronauts travel through a wormhole to find a new home for humanity.
P: Serve the snacks when Cooper and Donald sit on the porch with a beer.

title: The Martian
S: the potato crop Mark grows in the Hab
Potatoes baked at 200C for an hour, scooped out, brushed with butter, filled with cheddar and bacon and baked again until crisp, sour cream and chives on top.
the red dust and rock of Mars
Roasted red capsicum blitzed with chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon and smoked paprika until smooth, swirled with olive oil, served with warm flatbread.
counting out the crew's food packs to make them last

Almonds, cashews, oats and pepitas roasted in honey and cinnamon, set into crunchy clusters with dried apricot and dark chocolate, one bag per sol. Mix 100g almonds, 100g cashews, 100g rolled oats and 50g pepitas. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 30g butter and half a tsp cinnamon, pour over and toss well. Press onto a lined tray and bake at 160C for 20 minutes until golden. Cool completely, then break into clusters. Toss with 100g chopped dried apricots and 80g dark chocolate chunks and bag up.
M: eating potatoes every sol to stay alive
Leeks and onion softened in butter, potatoes and chicken stock simmered 25 minutes, blended silky with cream, topped with crisp bacon and chives, crusty bread alongside.
Hermes lemon chicken with roast pumpkin
the Hermes crew turning around to go back for him

Brined chicken breasts roasted with garlic and lemon, sliced over a warm salad of roast pumpkin, baby spinach, feta and toasted pepitas with honey mustard dressing. Brine 4 chicken breasts in 1L water with 50g salt for 1 hour, then pat dry. Roast 800g pumpkin chunks in oil at 200C for 30 minutes. Rub the chicken with oil, garlic and lemon zest and roast at 200C for 20 minutes to 74C inside, then rest. Toss the pumpkin with 100g spinach, 100g feta and toasted pepitas. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, mustard and honey and dress. Slice the chicken over.
W: the slingshot plan that brings him home

Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge, whipped cream piped into a tall rocket shape, crushed honeycomb at the base for the flames. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses and pour over the fudge. Pipe whipped cream into a tall rocket shape and scatter crushed honeycomb at the base for flames.
K: Lewis's disco condensed milk iced coffee
the commander's disco music, all he's got

Strong drip coffee poured hot over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and chilled, then served over ice with a splash of cold milk. Brew 800ml strong coffee from 60g ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of four heatproof glasses. Pour 200ml hot coffee into each and stir until the condensed milk dissolves. Cool, then chill for 30 minutes. Add plenty of ice and top with a splash of cold milk. Stir once and serve with a straw.
T: Grow your own. Eat potatoes.
D: An astronaut left for dead on Mars has to survive alone until anyone can reach him.
P: Serve the snacks when Mark harvests his first potato crop in the Hab.

title: Gravity
S: Pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger and spring onion, pan-fried until the bottoms crisp then steamed with a splash of water, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
Beef and pork pelmeni filled with onion and dill, boiled until they float, tossed in butter and served with sour cream and fresh dill.
M: Matt Kowalski admiring the sunrise over the Ganges
Chicken thighs simmered in a tomato and cream curry with garlic, ginger, garam masala and kasoori methi until rich, with basmati rice and naan.
Ryan dragging herself out of the lake onto the shore

Barramundi fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, with a nutty lemon and caper brown butter, crushed potatoes and a green salad. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, then crush with olive oil and salt. Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets, pat very dry and season. Fry skin side down in hot oil for 5 minutes, pressing flat, then flip for 1 minute. Remove, add 60g butter and cook until nutty brown, then add 2 tbsp capers and the juice of a lemon. Spoon over the fish and serve with potatoes and salad leaves.
W: Egg whites whipped with caster sugar to stiff peaks, piped into clouds, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, served with whipped cream and passionfruit pulp.
K: Freshly squeezed orange juice with a little ginger syrup and lime, topped with ice-cold sparkling water and served with an orange wheel. Simmer a sliced 4cm knob of ginger with 60g sugar and 80ml water for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Squeeze 8 oranges and a lime into a jug and stir in the ginger syrup. Chill for 30 minutes. Fill four tall glasses with ice, half fill with the juice and top with cold sparkling water. Add an orange wheel to each.
T: Hold on to something. Like dinner.
D: Two astronauts are left adrift after debris tears apart their shuttle.
P: Serve the mains when Ryan finally reaches the Chinese space station.

title: Arrival
S: Logogram parmesan and black sesame crisps
the circular inky logograms the heptapods write

Parmesan and black sesame spooned into rings and baked into lacy crisps, each splattered with a little squid ink mayo like a heptapod logogram. Mix 150g finely grated parmesan with 2 tbsp black sesame seeds. Spoon into 16 thin rings about 8cm wide on baking paper, leaving the middles open. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until golden and lacy, then cool on the tray to crisp. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp squid ink. Flick or pipe the black mayo around each crisp in a rough circle just before serving.
the army camp in a Montana field
Beef topside sliced thin, marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and garlic, dried in the oven at 75C for 4 hours until chewy.
the canary in its cage that goes up with the team
Sunflower, pumpkin, linseed and sesame seeds mixed with chia and water, spread thin, baked at 160C for an hour until crunchy, broken into shards with soft goat's cheese.
M: Ian's names for the two heptapods

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, tomato, cumin and chipotle until thick, ladled into bowls with cheddar, sour cream and cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a can of crushed tomatoes, a spoon of cumin, 2 chopped chipotles and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until it falls apart, adding 2 cans of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Ladle into bowls with grated cheddar.
Lake house dill salmon, new potatoes
the glass house by the lake

Salmon fillets roasted on lemon slices with dill and olive oil, with crushed new potatoes and a cucumber, crème fraîche and dill salad. Boil 800g new potatoes until tender, then crush lightly with butter and salt. Lay 2 sliced lemons in a tray, top with 4 salmon fillets, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with dill and salt. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes until just cooked. Slice 2 Lebanese cucumbers thinly and toss with 150g crème fraîche, chopped dill, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Serve together.
W: the way the heptapods see time as a circle
Meringue piped into a ring, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, filled with whipped cream and blackberries, a drizzle of dark chocolate around the edge.
K: Louise and Ian working out the language late into the night
Earl grey brewed strong, honey stirred through, a slice of lemon, served hot in big mugs or iced on a warm night.
T: Learn the language. Then pass the plate.
D: A linguist is brought in to talk with the visitors inside a giant shell hovering over Montana.
P: Serve the snacks when Louise takes off her suit and steps up to the glass.

title: Avatar
S: the forest glowing under Jake's feet
Dragon fruit, kiwifruit, pineapple and blueberries threaded onto skewers, drizzled with lime and honey, served on a dark board under low light.

Pork belly simmered in soy, ginger and star anise until soft, sliced, tucked into steamed bao buns with pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts. Simmer 600g pork belly in 125ml soy, sliced ginger, 2 star anise and water for 2 hours, then slice. Steam 12 bao buns and fill with pork, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.
Hometree lemongrass fish in banana leaf
the giant Hometree where the clan lives

Firm white fish rubbed with a paste of lemongrass, chilli, garlic and lime, wrapped in banana leaves and grilled, unwrapped at the table with nam jim. Blitz 2 lemongrass stalks, 2 red chillies, 3 garlic cloves, a knob of ginger, a handful of coriander, the zest of a lime and 1 tbsp fish sauce to a paste. Cut 600g ling fillets into 8 pieces and coat in the paste. Wrap each in a square of softened banana leaf and pin with a toothpick. Grill over medium heat for 10 minutes. Mix lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli for nam jim.
M: Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and smoked paprika, roasted low at 150C for 5 hours, pulled apart and served with flatbreads and a herb salad. Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Serve with 6 warm flatbreads and a salad of mint and parsley.
Ikran flight prawn and pumpkin curry

King prawns and pumpkin simmered in coconut milk with green curry paste, lime leaves and fish sauce, Thai basil folded through, with jasmine rice. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in 2 tbsp coconut cream for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add 400ml coconut milk, 200ml water, 4 torn lime leaves and 500g pumpkin in 2cm chunks and simmer 12 minutes until tender. Add 600g peeled green king prawns and simmer 3 minutes. Season with 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp palm sugar, then fold through Thai basil. Serve with 300g steamed jasmine rice.
W: Coconut tapioca pudding simmered 15 minutes, chilled, layered in glasses with mango and passionfruit, topped with toasted coconut.
K: the blue skin of the Na'vi
Coconut water, pineapple juice and a splash of blue curaçao or blue sports drink over ice, garnished with pineapple.
T: See the dinner. Then eat it.
D: A paralysed marine links to a Na'vi body on Pandora and starts to change sides.
P: Serve the snacks when the forest lights up around Jake and Neytiri at night.

title: Dune
S: the spice that drifts across Arrakis
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and baked at 220C until blistered, sprinkled with a dukkah of hazelnuts, sesame, cumin, coriander and cinnamon, labneh to dip.
the palm trees in the Arrakeen courtyard
Medjool dates split and stuffed with goat's cheese and a walnut, drizzled with honey and orange zest, on a board with dried apricots and figs.

Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a mignonette of eschalot, red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, lemon wedges alongside. Finely dice 2 eschalots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar, half a tsp cracked black pepper and a pinch of sugar. Rest for 15 minutes. Spread crushed ice over a large platter. Shuck 24 oysters, or buy them freshly shucked, and sit them on the ice, checking for any shell grit. Spoon a little mignonette over each and serve straight away with lemon wedges.
M: the long walk across the deep desert with the Fremen
Lamb shoulder browned and slow cooked 3 hours with onion, ras el hanout, saffron, apricots and chickpeas until tender, over herbed couscous.
House Atreides taking over the Arrakeen residence

Whole chicken rubbed with harissa, garlic and lemon, roasted golden and carved at the table with saffron rice, honey roast carrots and minted yoghurt. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 3 tbsp harissa, 3 crushed garlic cloves, lemon zest, olive oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes until the juices run clear. Toss 600g carrots with oil and 2 tbsp honey and roast alongside for 40 minutes. Soak a pinch of saffron in 500ml hot stock and cook 300g basmati in it, covered, for 12 minutes. Mix 200g yoghurt with chopped mint and serve.
W: the sandworm rising out of the dunes
Yeasted dough rolled with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, cut into thick spirals, baked at 190C for 22 minutes, glazed with cardamom icing.
K: Every drop counts orange blossom cooler
water so precious Stilgar spits on the table as a sign of respect

Fresh orange and lemon juice with cardamom honey syrup and a drop of orange blossom water, topped with chilled water over ice and mint. Simmer 4 tbsp honey with 80ml water and 4 crushed cardamom pods for 3 minutes, then strain and cool. Squeeze 4 oranges and a lemon into a jug and stir in the syrup and half a tsp orange blossom water. Add 600ml chilled still water. Fill four glasses with ice, pour carefully so nothing is spilled and top each with mint and an orange slice.
T: The spice must flow. So must the snacks.
D: A young duke's son is sent with his family to rule the desert planet that holds the universe's most precious spice.
P: Serve the snacks when the Atreides land on Arrakis.

title: Blade Runner 2049
S: Chicken thighs marinated in miso and garlic, threaded on skewers and grilled until charred, served with a sesame dipping sauce.
the neon street stalls in the LA rain
Pork and cabbage gyoza pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, with soy and black vinegar dipping sauce and chilli oil.
Wooden horse soft pretzels with mustard
the small wooden horse K carves into his memory

Soft pretzel twists dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a honey and wholegrain mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzels. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 2 tbsp honey to dip.
M: Joi laying a hologram dinner over K's plain bowl
Pan-seared rib eye, buttered mash and green beans, plated like a proper dinner for two the way Joi pictures it, a red wine jus poured over.
Off-world miso ramen with pork belly
the off-world ads glowing over the rainy city

Ramen noodles in a rich pork and miso broth with seared soy-braised pork belly, jammy soy eggs, corn, nori and spring onion. Simmer 600g pork belly in 100ml soy, 100ml mirin and 500ml water for 90 minutes, then slice and sear. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, peel and soak in some of the braising liquid. Heat 1.5L chicken stock, whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 2 tbsp of the braising liquid. Cook 4 portions of ramen noodles. Fill bowls with noodles and broth and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, nori and spring onion.
W: K lying on the steps as snow falls
Vanilla bean panna cotta set in glasses overnight, topped with crushed meringue scattered like snow.
K: Deckard sharing whisky with K, and with the dog

Scotch whisky stirred with honey syrup and lemon, poured long over ice and topped with ginger ale, finished with a strip of lemon peel. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp hot water to loosen and cool. Fill four tall glasses with ice. Into each pour 45ml Scotch whisky, 10ml honey syrup and 10ml lemon juice and stir. Top each with 120ml cold ginger ale and stir once more. Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top and drop it in.
T: More human than human. Same for the noodles.
D: A replicant blade runner finds a secret that could change the world, and goes looking for the man who vanished thirty years ago.
P: Serve the drinks when K finds Deckard in the empty Las Vegas casino.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
S: waking at the army base at Heathrow every morning
Thick bacon rashers fried crisp, stuffed into soft white rolls with butter and brown sauce, wrapped in paper for the next drop.
Mussels steamed open in white wine with garlic, eschalot and parsley, finished with butter, served with crusty bread to mop up.
Same day again pork and fennel rolls
living the same day over and over

Pork mince with onion, sage and fennel seed rolled in puff pastry, egg washed and baked golden, cut into pieces and served hot with tomato relish. Mix 500g pork mince with a grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 1 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 30g breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Halve 2 puff pastry sheets, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal with beaten egg. Cut each into 4, brush with egg and score the tops. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden and puffed. Serve hot with tomato relish.
M: Farmhouse chicken, bacon and leek stew
the farmhouse where Cage and Rita hide out

Chicken thighs, smoky bacon, leeks and potatoes simmered in stock with thyme until thick, grain mustard and cream stirred through, with crusty bread. Brown 1kg chicken thighs cut into chunks and 150g diced smoked bacon. Add 2 sliced leeks and cook 5 minutes until soft. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 750ml chicken stock, 600g potatoes in chunks and thyme. Simmer 35 minutes until thick and the potatoes are tender. Stir in 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard and 100ml cream. Season and serve with crusty bread.
Angel of Verdun chicken, cider and cream

Chicken thighs browned and braised in apple cider with eschalots and mushrooms, finished with cream and parsley, with a warm baguette to mop the sauce. Season 1kg chicken thighs and brown in butter for 4 minutes a side, then set aside. Soften 2 sliced eschalots and 200g sliced mushrooms in the pan. Pour in 375ml apple cider and scrape up the browned bits. Return the chicken, cover and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and simmer 3 minutes until glossy. Scatter with parsley and serve with a warm baguette.
W: Farell's lot at the forward base

Date sponge baked at 180C for 35 minutes, soaked with a butterscotch sauce of brown sugar, butter and cream, served warm with custard. Soak 200g chopped dates in boiling water with a pinch of bicarb. Cream 60g butter with 150g brown sugar, add 2 eggs, the dates and 175g self-raising flour. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Pour over hot sauce of butter, brown sugar and cream and serve with custard.
K: Gunfire: army tea with dark rum

Old British army brew of strong black tea stewed in a big pot, sweetened with brown sugar and milk, with a tot of dark rum in each mug. Warm a big teapot with boiling water and tip it out. Add 6 black tea bags and 1.2L freshly boiled water and leave to stew for 5 minutes until properly strong. Put 2 tsp brown sugar and 30ml dark rum into each of four metal mugs. Pour in the tea, add a splash of milk and stir well.
T: Live. Die. Repeat. Reheat.
D: A reluctant officer dropped into an alien war keeps waking on the same day, and has to train until he gets it right.
P: Serve the snacks when Cage wakes up face down at Heathrow, again.

title: Ghostbusters
S: the running joke about the soup with almost no wontons
Pork and prawn wontons folded and simmered in chicken stock with ginger and soy, loaded into bowls with bok choy so there are more wontons than soup.

Pork, cabbage, carrot and vermicelli rolled tight in pastry, fried until crisp and blistered, with sweet chilli sauce and fresh lettuce cups. Soak 50g rice vermicelli and cut short. Stir-fry 300g pork mince with 2 garlic cloves and grated ginger, then add 2 cups shredded wombok and a grated carrot for 2 minutes. Stir in the noodles, 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy, then cool. Roll tightly in 16 spring roll wrappers, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with sweet chilli and lettuce leaves.
getting slimed by the ghost at the mansion
Avocado, edamame, lime, garlic and coriander blitzed bright green, served with prawn crackers and cucumber sticks.
M: the Chinese restaurant under their office
Sweet and sour pork with pineapple and capsicum, crisp battered pieces tossed in a sauce of vinegar, sugar and tomato, and egg fried rice.
Times Square onion sauce hot dogs

All-beef franks griddled until split, in soft buns with spicy brown mustard, sweet onions stewed in tomato and a little chilli, and pickle relish. Slice 2 onions thinly and cook in oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until soft. Add 3 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp sugar, half a tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp vinegar and 150ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick and sticky. Griddle 8 all-beef franks until blistered and split. Warm 8 hot dog buns. Fill with franks, mustard, the onion sauce and a spoon of pickle relish.
W: Thin batter of egg white, sugar, flour and vanilla baked at 180C in small rounds for 6 minutes, folded around a paper fortune while still hot.
K: the green slime all over Erin

Kiwifruit blitzed with lime juice, mint and sugar syrup, poured over crushed ice and topped with fizzy soda water so it foams up bright green. Dissolve 60g sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. Peel 4 kiwifruit and blitz with the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint leaves and the syrup until smooth. Spoon into four tall glasses over crushed ice. Top each slowly with 150ml cold soda water so it foams up, stir once and add a lime wheel.
T: Ghosts upstairs. Wontons downstairs.
D: Four scientists set up shop above a Chinese restaurant and start catching ghosts across Manhattan.
P: Serve the snacks when the wonton soup arrives with hardly any wontons.

title: The Holiday
S: Aged cheddar, brie and blue cheese with oatcakes, quince paste, apple slices and walnuts on a wooden board by the fire.

Thick sourdough toast spread with a sauce of vintage cheddar, ale, English mustard and Worcestershire, grilled until bubbling and brown in spots. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in 80ml ale. Add 200g grated vintage cheddar, 1 tsp English mustard and a dash of Worcestershire and stir over low heat until thick and smooth. Toast 6 slices of sourdough. Spread the cheese mixture thickly to the edges and grill for 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling and browned in spots. Cut in half and serve hot.
LA pool house green goddess crudités
Amanda's huge house in Los Angeles

Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and snow peas on ice around a bright green goddess dip of avocado, herbs, lemon and Greek yoghurt. Blitz an avocado, 150g Greek yoghurt, a handful each of parsley, basil and chives, a garlic clove, 2 anchovies, the juice of a lemon and salt until smooth and green. Trim 2 bunches baby carrots and a bunch of radishes, cut a Lebanese cucumber into batons and trim 150g snow peas. Arrange the vegetables over a tray of crushed ice with the dip in the middle.
M: Iris throwing a dinner for Arthur and his old friends

Whole chicken rubbed with lemon and thyme butter, roasted golden, with crisp roast potatoes, honey glazed carrots and gravy made from the pan. Mix 60g soft butter with lemon zest, chopped thyme and salt and push under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Put the halved lemon inside. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes, rough them up and roast in oil alongside for an hour. Glaze 500g carrots with butter and honey. Rest the chicken, then stir flour into the pan juices and whisk in 300ml stock for gravy.
dinner with Graham and his two daughters
Spaghetti with a slow tomato and butter sauce simmered 45 minutes with a halved onion, finished with basil and lots of parmesan, simple enough for the girls to love.
W: Date sponge baked at 180C for 35 minutes, poked and soaked with a toffee sauce of brown sugar, butter and cream, served warm with vanilla ice cream.
K: Christmas by the fire in the cottage
Red wine warmed slowly with orange, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and honey, never boiled, ladled into mugs.
T: Swap houses. Keep the cheese board.
D: Two heartbroken women swap homes for Christmas, one in Surrey and one in Los Angeles.
P: Serve the snacks when Amanda opens the door of the snowy Surrey cottage.

title: Klaus
S: Alva selling fish out of the old schoolhouse
Smoked trout flaked into cream cheese with dill and lemon, spread on rye crispbread and topped with pickled onion.
the Krums and the Ellingboes at each other's throats
Little Nordic pork and beef meatballs with a hint of allspice, browned in butter and served with cranberry.

Thin rye and barley flatbreads cooked in a hot dry pan, spread with butter and topped with smoked salmon, sour cream, dill and lingonberry jam. Mix 120g rye flour, 80g barley or plain flour, half a tsp baking powder, a pinch of salt, 20g melted butter and about 150ml warm milk into a soft dough. Divide into 8 and roll very thin. Cook in a hot dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until speckled. Butter while warm and top with 200g smoked salmon, sour cream, a little lingonberry jam and dill.
M: Klaus's juniper beef stew with mash
the big cabin in the woods full of carved toys

Beef chuck browned and simmered for hours with onion, carrot, juniper, thyme and a spoon of blackcurrant jam until it falls apart, with buttery mash. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 2 sliced onions and 3 carrots in chunks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, 6 crushed juniper berries, thyme, 1 tbsp blackcurrant jam and 750ml beef stock. Cover and simmer for 3 hours until the beef falls apart. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Serve the stew over the mash.
Jesper's spoiled life before the island

Duck breasts scored and rendered skin side down until crisp, finished in the oven, sliced over a creamy potato gratin with a glossy cherry and balsamic sauce. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a dish with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Score the skin of 4 duck breasts and start skin side down in a cold pan, then cook over medium heat for 8 minutes to render. Flip and roast at 200C for 6 minutes. Rest. Pour off most of the fat, add 200g pitted cherries, 2 tbsp balsamic, 1 tbsp honey and 150ml stock and reduce until glossy.
W: Gingerbread dough of butter, golden syrup, ginger and cinnamon cut into envelope shapes, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, piped with white icing and a red seal.
K: the Sámi girl who wins everyone over

Tart lingonberry cordial simmered with sugar and cinnamon, served warm in mugs with an orange slice, or poured over ice and topped with soda. Simmer 300g frozen lingonberries or cranberries with 150g sugar, a cinnamon stick and 500ml water for 10 minutes. Mash well and strain through a sieve, pressing on the fruit. Add 500ml more water and the juice of an orange. To serve warm, heat gently and pour into mugs with an orange slice. To serve cold, pour over ice and top with soda water.
T: One letter, one toy. One plate, one pudding.
D: A spoiled postman sent to a frozen island town teams up with a reclusive toymaker to bring some joy.
P: Serve the dessert when the first wrapped toy slides down the chimney.

title: Arthur Christmas
S: the elves running the huge Christmas Eve operation
Popcorn tossed with melted white chocolate, red and green sprinkles and a pinch of salt, spread out to set then broken into clusters.
Grandsanta and his beloved old sleigh
Shortcrust pastry cut into rounds, filled with fruit mince and orange zest, topped with pastry stars, baked at 190C for 18 minutes, dusted with icing sugar.
Bryony's spinach and feta filo parcels
Bryony the wrapping elf who can wrap anything

Buttered filo wrapped around spinach, feta, ricotta and dill, tied with a blanched chive ribbon like a present and baked golden and flaky. Wilt 250g baby spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 150g crumbled feta, 100g ricotta, chopped dill, an egg and pepper. Brush a sheet of filo with melted butter, top with another, cut into 4 squares and repeat to make 12. Spoon filling in the middle, gather the corners into a bundle and tie with a chive dipped in hot water. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 20 minutes.
M: the house in Cornwall where Gwen waits for her bike

Short pastry filled with diced beef skirt, potato, swede and onion with plenty of pepper, crimped along the side, baked golden with tomato relish. Rub 150g cold butter into 400g plain flour with a pinch of salt and bind with about 120ml cold water, then chill 30 minutes. Dice 400g beef skirt, 1 potato, a quarter swede and an onion small and toss with salt and lots of pepper. Roll the pastry into 4 rounds, pile the filling on one half, fold and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 180C for 50 minutes.
Christmas dinner with the whole Claus family
Turkey breast rolled with sage, onion and bacon stuffing, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes, sprouts and cranberry sauce.
W: A rich fruit Christmas pudding steamed until hot, served in thick slices with warm orange and vanilla custard and a spoon of whipped cream. Heat the Christmas pudding following the packet directions until hot right through. Warm 500ml custard gently with the finely grated zest of an orange and half a tsp vanilla extract, stirring, without boiling. Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks. Cut the pudding into thick slices, pour over the orange custard and top each with a spoon of cream and a little more zest.
K: the reindeer pulling the old sleigh

Milk, cream, eggs and brown sugar cooked gently with ginger, cinnamon and nutmeg until thick, chilled and topped with whipped cream and crumbled gingernut. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 80g brown sugar in a pot. Stir in 600ml milk, 200ml cream, 1 tsp ground ginger, half a tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg. Heat gently, stirring all the time, until it coats the back of a spoon, about 8 minutes, without boiling. Strain and chill for 2 hours. Pour into glasses, top with whipped cream and crumble a gingernut biscuit over each.
T: One present left. No child forgotten.
D: Santa's clumsy younger son sets out with Grandsanta and an old sleigh to deliver the one gift that got missed.
P: Serve the mains when the old sleigh finally lands in Cornwall.

title: Four Christmases
S: stuck at the San Francisco airport
Roasted almonds, cashews and pretzels tossed with rosemary, brown sugar and salt, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, bagged up for the trip.
Brad's rough dad and brothers who wrestle in the yard

Bratwurst simmered in lager with onions, then grilled until charred, sliced into bites and served on toothpicks with hot mustard and the sticky beer onions. Slice 3 onions and put in a wide pan with 8 bratwurst, 375ml lager and 20g butter. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Lift out the sausages and grill over high heat until charred all over. Keep boiling the onions until the liquid is gone and they turn sticky and golden. Slice the bratwurst into thick bites, spear with toothpicks and serve with the onions and hot mustard.
Kate stuck in the kids' jumping castle
Mini beef pies of mince, onion and gravy in shortcrust bases with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, tomato sauce on top.
M: Brad and Kate roped in as Joseph and Mary

Leg ham scored and glazed with brown sugar, mustard and orange, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and basted often, with potato salad and green beans. Score a 3kg leg ham and glaze with 150g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon and the juice of 2 oranges. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, basting often. Serve with potato salad of 1kg potatoes and 300g green beans.
the nativity play at the church with Brad as Joseph

Beef ragù simmered slowly with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella, baked bubbling and rested before slicing. Brown 800g beef mince with an onion, carrot and 3 garlic cloves. Add 150ml red wine, 2 cans crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 2 hours. Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, whisk in 600ml milk and simmer until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan. Layer ragù, 300g lasagne sheets and béchamel in a dish, finishing with béchamel and 200g mozzarella. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes and rest 20.
W: the family board game that turns into a fight
Sponge soaked in sherry, layered with raspberry jelly, custard and whipped cream, chilled overnight and topped with berries.
K: four Christmas parties in one day

Cranberry and fresh orange juice with rosemary honey syrup, topped with ginger ale over ice, with frozen cranberries and orange wheels floating on top. Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 100ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and remove the rosemary. In a big bowl, mix 750ml cranberry juice, 500ml fresh orange juice and the syrup. Add plenty of ice, 100g frozen cranberries and 2 sliced oranges. Top with 1L cold ginger ale just before serving and float a few rosemary sprigs on top.
T: Four houses. Four dinners. One very full couple.
D: A couple stuck in town on Christmas Day has to visit all four of their divorced parents.
P: Serve the snacks when the fog cancels every flight out of San Francisco.

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
S: the big house party where Kat dances on the table
Hot baked dip of cream cheese, spinach, artichoke and mozzarella with toasted baguette for scooping.

Little beef and pork meatballs baked crisp, served on a white platter splattered with a sticky tomato glaze, mango chutney and basil oil like paint. Mix 500g beef and pork mince with 40g breadcrumbs, an egg, a grated garlic clove and salt, roll into 30 small balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer 150ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar until sticky. Blitz a bunch of basil with 80ml olive oil and salt. Toss the meatballs in some of the glaze, then splatter the platter with glaze, mango chutney and basil oil.
Ham and gruyère toasties brushed with Dijon and béchamel, grilled until bubbling, cut into small squares.
M: Seattle salmon burgers with dill mayo
Padua High in the rainy Pacific Northwest

Salmon chopped with spring onion, lemon zest and panko, seared into patties and served in toasted brioche buns with dill mayo, rocket and pickled cucumber. Slice a Lebanese cucumber thinly and soak in 3 tbsp rice vinegar with a pinch of sugar and salt. Chop 600g skinless salmon finely and mix with 2 sliced spring onions, lemon zest, 50g panko, an egg and salt. Shape into 4 patties and chill 20 minutes. Sear in oil for 3 minutes a side. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with chopped dill and lemon juice. Build in toasted brioche buns with rocket and pickles.
the prom where all the bets come out
Penne with a vodka sauce of tomato, cream, garlic and chilli simmered until rosy, finished with parmesan and basil.
W: Kat reading her list poem in class
Fudgy dark chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into ten squares, each topped with something different: raspberries, nuts, salt flakes, cherries.
K: the Seattle coffee scene and late nights at Club Skunk

Cold espresso shaken with homemade vanilla syrup and ice until frothy, poured over cold milk in tall glasses so it settles in layers. Simmer 80g sugar with 80ml water and a split vanilla bean for 3 minutes and cool. Brew 4 strong espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee, and cool. Shake the coffee with 2 tbsp vanilla syrup and a handful of ice until frothy. Fill four tall glasses with ice and 150ml cold milk each, then pour the frothy coffee slowly over the top so it sits in layers.
T: I hate the way you skip dessert.
D: A new kid pays the school bad boy to date the sharp-tongued older sister so he can take out the younger one.
P: Serve the snacks when Patrick starts singing to Kat across the football bleachers.

title: American Pie
S: Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, served with a blue cheese dip and celery.
Dog Years cheese and gravy fries
the gang's hangout at the Dog Years diner

Thick-cut chips fried twice until crisp, piled with melting cheese curds or torn mozzarella and smothered in hot rich beef gravy. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, soak 30 minutes and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then at 190C until golden and crisp, and salt. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour until brown, whisk in 400ml beef stock and a dash of Worcestershire and simmer until thick. Pile the chips onto a platter, scatter with 200g torn fresh mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy.
Michelle and all her band camp stories
Corn cobs boiled, then charred on a hot grill and brushed with smoky paprika butter and fresh lime.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, slow cooked in foil until tender, then glazed with barbecue sauce over hot coals, with creamy coleslaw. Mix 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and half a tsp cayenne. Rub over 2kg pork ribs, wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 3 hours. Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and cook over hot coals or under the grill for 10 minutes, basting, until sticky. Toss a quarter cabbage and a carrot, shredded, with mayonnaise and cider vinegar.
Chicken parmigiana: crumbed breasts fried until golden, topped with napoli sauce, ham and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling, with chips and salad.
W: the pie Jim's mum left cooling
Granny Smith apples cooked with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, served warm with ice cream.
K: Espresso stirred into cocoa and hot milk, frothed and topped with whipped cream and grated chocolate.
T: Bake it. Do not ask.
D: Four high school friends make a pact to change their lives before graduation.
P: Serve dessert when Jim's dad walks into the kitchen.

title: Easy A
S: the red A Olive stitches onto her clothes
Pita bread cut into A shapes, brushed with olive oil and sumac, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, served with a roasted beetroot dip swirled with yoghurt.
the small town of Ojai, California
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with strips of orange and lemon peel, garlic, chilli and fennel seed.
Todd in the school mascot suit

Soft pretzel bites dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a honey mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip the bites for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayonnaise for the dip.
M: Rice noodles fried with egg, tofu, tamarind and fish sauce, topped with peanuts and lime.

Flathead strips dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried crisp, in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw, lime crema, sliced radish and coriander. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips and toss in 2 tbsp flour, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with the zest and juice of a lime. Toss a quarter red cabbage, shredded, with lime juice and salt. Pan-fry the fish in hot oil for 2 minutes a side. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, crema, sliced radish and coriander.
W: the bright red A on everything
Red velvet cake batter piped into rounds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, sandwiched together with cream cheese frosting.
K: the song Olive can't get out of her head all weekend

Fresh lemon juice and strawberries blitzed with sugar syrup, poured over ice with cold sparkling water, sliced strawberries and mint. Dissolve 120g sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with the syrup and strain into a big jug. Add the juice of 6 lemons and 1L cold sparkling water and stir. Fill four tall glasses with ice, a few sliced strawberries and mint leaves, then pour in the lemonade.
T: Rumour has it dinner is good.
D: A clean-cut high school student lets a lie about her spread, and it takes on a life of its own.
P: Serve the mains when Olive sits down to dinner with her parents.

title: Juno
S: the orange mints Bleeker can't stop eating

Almonds and cashews tossed in a bubbling orange zest and sugar syrup, roasted until glassy and crunchy, finished with flaky salt. Heat 80g caster sugar, 2 tbsp water and the finely grated zest of an orange until the sugar dissolves and bubbles. Take off the heat and stir in 200g almonds, 200g cashews and a pinch of cinnamon until coated. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until glassy. Sprinkle with sea salt flakes, cool completely and break apart.
Mini beef patties with cheddar, pickles and tomato sauce on small sesame buns, held together with a toothpick.
Gold shorts peanut butter oat bites
Bleeker running in his gold track shorts

Rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, dark chocolate chips and coconut mixed and rolled into balls, chilled firm and dusted in golden toasted coconut. Toast 40g desiccated coconut in a dry pan until golden and set aside. Mix 150g rolled oats, 120g smooth peanut butter, 80g honey, 60g dark chocolate chips, 2 tbsp chia seeds, half a tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt until it holds together. Roll into 16 balls, then roll each in the toasted coconut. Chill for an hour until firm.
M: Beef mince browned with onion, mixed with corn, green beans and a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with rows of potato gems and baked at 200C for 35 minutes.
Mac's creamy chicken wild rice soup
Juno's dad Mac at the kitchen table

Chicken, wild rice, carrot, celery and mushroom simmered in stock, finished with cream and thyme, served with crusty bread and butter. Rinse 150g wild rice blend. Soften a diced onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 200g sliced mushrooms in 40g butter. Stir in 3 tbsp flour, then 1.5L chicken stock, the rice and thyme. Add 600g chicken thighs and simmer 40 minutes until the rice is tender. Lift out the chicken, shred and return it. Stir in 200ml cream and heat through. Serve with crusty bread.
W: the corner store where Juno buys the tests

Bright blue jelly set in clear cups with fresh raspberries, layered with vanilla custard, whipped cream and crushed shortbread on top. Make up 2 packets of blue jelly following the packet directions. Drop a few raspberries from 125g into 4 clear cups, pour in the jelly and chill for 3 hours until set. Spoon 300ml thick vanilla custard over the jelly. Whip 200ml cream to soft peaks and spoon on top. Finish with crushed shortbread and the rest of the raspberries just before serving.
K: Juno drinking orange juice straight from the jug
Fresh orange juice in a big jug over ice, with a splash of mango nectar and soda water for fizz.
T: Way too much orange drink.
D: A sixteen-year-old with a quick wit finds herself pregnant and picks the perfect couple to adopt the baby.
P: Serve the drink when Juno is sitting on the front lawn with her big jug of orange juice.

title: Lady Bird
S: the big Thanksgiving at Danny's family home
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, spread with goat's cheese, topped with roasted pumpkin, sage and a drizzle of honey.
Lady Bird and Julie eating the unblessed wafers like chips

Rice paper rounds fried for seconds until they puff into crisp white wafers, dusted with salt and chilli and served with a sweet chilli lime dip. Cut 10 rice paper sheets into quarters or rounds with scissors. Heat 3cm oil in a wok to 180C. Drop pieces in one at a time; they puff in 2 seconds, so lift out straight away and drain on paper. Dust with fine salt and a pinch of chilli powder. Mix 100ml sweet chilli sauce with the juice of a lime for the dip.

Almonds roasted with olive oil, rosemary and smoked salt at 180C for 10 minutes, served warm with marinated olives. Toss 300g almonds with olive oil, chopped rosemary and smoked salt. Spread on a tray and roast at 180C for 10 minutes until fragrant. Serve warm in a bowl beside green olives, a taste of the valley the film keeps leaving and coming home to.
M: the big Thanksgiving at Danny's family home

Brined turkey breast roasted with thyme butter until juicy, with sage and onion stuffing, buttery mash, green beans and pan gravy. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar. Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and thyme and roast at 180C to 70C inside, about 75 minutes, then rest. Mix 200g torn bread with a fried onion, chopped sage, an egg and 150ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with butter and milk. Steam 300g beans. Make gravy from the pan juices.
Marion working double shifts at the hospital
Chicken, broccoli and rice baked in a creamy cheese sauce at 180C for 40 minutes, the kind of dinner that waits in the oven for whoever gets home.
W: Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cooled, cut into squares and wrapped in paper for the stall. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 2 tbsp cocoa. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool completely, cut into squares and wrap each in paper for the stall.
K: Café shift brown sugar cinnamon latte
Lady Bird's job at the coffee shop

Espresso stirred with brown sugar and cinnamon syrup, topped with silky steamed milk and a dusting of cinnamon, served in glasses. Simmer 60g brown sugar, 60ml water and a cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. Brew 4 espresso shots, or 250ml very strong coffee. Put 1 tbsp of the syrup in each of four glasses and add the coffee. Heat 600ml milk until steaming and froth it with a whisk or frother. Pour slowly over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon foam on top and dust with cinnamon.
T: Sacramento has the best almonds. Don't argue.
D: A headstrong senior at a Catholic school in Sacramento butts heads with her mum over her plans for college.
P: Serve the mains when Lady Bird sits down to Thanksgiving at Danny's grandmother's house.

title: Footloose
S: the burger joint where the town's teenagers hang out

Little chuck patties smashed thin with melted cheddar, pickles, mustard and grilled onion on soft slider buns, with a tray of crinkle-cut fries. Cook 500g frozen crinkle-cut fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Roll 500g chuck mince into 12 balls. Cook a thinly sliced onion on a hot flat plate until soft and brown. Smash the balls flat on the plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and add half a slice of cheddar. Toast 12 slider buns, add mustard and pickles, and stack in the patties and onions.
the game of chicken on tractors
Chicken thigh pieces marinated in buttermilk overnight, dredged in flour and paprika, fried at 180C until crisp, with honey to dip.
the old grain mill where the prom is held
Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg, spring onion and paprika, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with a sour cream and chive dip.
M: Sunday dinner at Reverend Moore's table
Beef blade rubbed with garlic and thyme, slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours, with roast potatoes, carrots and gravy.
Bomont fried chicken with mash and slaw

Buttermilk chicken fried crisp and golden, with creamy mashed potato and pepper gravy, buttered corn and a crunchy coleslaw. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with salt. Dredge in 300g flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and pepper and fry at 165C for 12 to 14 minutes until 74C inside. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with butter and milk. Make gravy with 30g butter, 2 tbsp flour, 400ml milk and lots of pepper. Boil 4 corn cobs and butter them. Toss shredded cabbage with mayo and vinegar.
W: Fresh popcorn bound in a sticky brown sugar and butter caramel with a pinch of salt, shaped into balls by hand and wrapped in paper. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in a little oil and tip into a large buttered bowl. Boil 200g brown sugar, 100g golden syrup and 60g butter for 3 minutes, then stir in a pinch of salt and half a tsp vanilla. Pour over the popcorn and toss with two spoons. Cool for 3 minutes, then butter your hands and press into 12 balls. Set on baking paper and wrap when firm.
K: the punch bowl at the prom
Pineapple and orange juice topped with lemonade and a scoop of lemon sorbet in a big bowl with sliced oranges.
T: No dancing. Plenty of dinner.
D: A city teenager moves to a small town where dancing is banned, and decides to change that.
P: Serve the snacks when Ren starts teaching Willard to dance.

title: Clerks
S: the customer checking every carton for a perfect dozen
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks mashed with mayo, mustard and a dash of vinegar, piped back in, a dusting of paprika on top, twelve perfect halves.
Quick Stop chips with nacho cheese

Warm salted corn chips with a hot, smooth cheddar nacho cheese sauce spiked with pickled jalapeño, served in a paper boat like the store counter. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in 300ml milk and simmer until thick. Take off the heat and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth, then add 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapenos, a splash of the pickling liquid and half a tsp smoked paprika. Warm 300g corn chips at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve the chips with the hot cheese for dunking.
the hockey game on the store roof

Soft pretzel knots dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with a sharp two-mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll into ropes and tie into knots.
