Dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with wholegrain mustard and a little hot English mustard mixed together.
M: the lasagne Veronica brings to the store

Beef ragù simmered slowly with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, lemony ricotta and mozzarella, baked bubbling and rested before cutting. Brown 800g beef mince with an onion and 3 garlic cloves. Add 150ml red wine, 2 cans crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 2 hours. Mix 500g ricotta with an egg, 50g parmesan, lemon zest and parsley. In a dish, layer ragù, 300g lasagne sheets and ricotta three times, finishing with ragù and 250g mozzarella. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes and rest 20 minutes before cutting.
Long rolls loaded with salami, ham, provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato, onion, oil, vinegar and oregano, wrapped tight and cut in half.
W: the shelves Dante never stops restocking

Little chocolate sponge cakes split and filled with fluffy vanilla marshmallow cream, then dipped in a glossy chocolate coat with a white icing squiggle. Whisk 3 eggs and 100g caster sugar until thick, fold in 70g self-raising flour and 20g cocoa and bake in a lined slice tin at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool and cut into 12 rectangles. Beat 100g soft butter, 150g icing sugar, 100g marshmallow fluff and vanilla until fluffy. Sandwich pairs of cake with it. Dip in 150g dark chocolate melted with 50ml cream and pipe a white icing squiggle on top.
K: the customer digging through the milk fridge for the freshest carton

Cold milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, cocoa and malted milk powder, poured into tall glasses with crushed malt balls on top. Put 600ml cold milk, 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp malted milk powder in a blender. Blend until thick and frothy. Pour into four tall chilled glasses. Crush a handful of chocolate malt balls in a bag with a rolling pin and scatter over the top. Serve with a straw.
T: Not even supposed to be here today. Stayed for dinner.
D: A convenience store clerk called in on his day off has a very long shift.
P: Serve the mains when Veronica turns up at the counter with lasagne for Dante.

title: Mallrats
S: the food court where everyone hangs out
Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, brushed with butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar, served with a cream cheese dip.
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, finely grated parmesan and garlic powder until coated, poured into paper bags to eat while flipping comics.
the fast food stalls around the food court

Pork, cabbage, carrot and spring onion rolled tight in egg roll wrappers, fried crisp and blistered, sliced on the angle with sweet and sour sauce. Stir-fry 300g pork mince with 2 garlic cloves and grated ginger until browned. Add 3 cups shredded cabbage, a grated carrot and 3 spring onions and cook 3 minutes. Season with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil, then cool. Roll tightly in 12 large spring roll wrappers, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Slice on the angle and serve with sweet and sour sauce.
M: Eden Prairie food court teriyaki chicken

Chicken thighs grilled with a glaze of soy, mirin, sugar and ginger, sliced over steamed rice with stir-fried vegetables. Simmer soy sauce, mirin, a spoon of sugar and grated ginger until syrupy. Grill 800g chicken thighs, brushing with the glaze until sticky and charred. Slice over steamed jasmine rice with quickly stir-fried broccoli and spoon over the extra sauce.
the dating game show in the middle of the mall

Thin pizza bases spread with garlic tomato sauce, loaded with mozzarella, pepperoni, mushrooms and oregano, baked blistering hot and cut into squares. Blitz a 400g can of tomatoes with a garlic clove, 1 tsp oregano, salt and olive oil. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases on oiled trays. Spread with the sauce, then top with 250g grated mozzarella, 120g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake at 250C, or the hottest your oven goes, for 10 minutes until blistered. Scatter with chilli flakes and cut into squares.
W: Willam staring at the poster all day

Big soft chocolate chip cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes so the middle stays gooey, served warm. Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and an egg until creamy. Mix in 225g flour and 200g dark chocolate chips. Roll into big balls and bake at 180C for 10 minutes so the centres stay gooey. Cool for 5 minutes and serve warm.
K: the dating show taped at the mall

Fresh lemonade of lemon juice, sugar syrup and soda water, with strawberries muddled in, in big cups with ice. Muddle a handful of strawberries in the bottom of a big jug. Add the juice of 6 lemons and sugar syrup to taste, then top with cold soda water. Pour into big cups packed with ice and add a straw to each.
T: Dumped. Go to the mall. Eat.
D: Two friends dumped on the same day spend it hanging around the local mall.
P: Serve the snacks when Brodie and T.S. hit the food court.

title: Space Jam
S: Baby carrots and cucumber sticks standing in cups over a herby ranch dip of sour cream, mayo, garlic, dill and chives.
Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into balls, coated in smoked paprika and crushed corn chips so they look like basketballs, served with crackers.
the alien theme park on Moron Mountain

Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips, brushed with egg and sprinkled with sesame, baked golden, with mustard and tomato sauce for dipping. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 24 strips. Wrap a strip around each of 24 cocktail franks, leaving the ends poking out. Lay on a lined tray seam side down, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with small bowls of mild mustard and tomato sauce for dipping.
M: eating courtside at the Tune Squad game
Beef and pork meatballs baked at 200C for 15 minutes, simmered in tomato sauce, piled into long rolls with mozzarella and grilled until bubbly.
the halftime team talk in the locker room

Chicken tenderloins crumbed in panko and parmesan, baked crisp and golden, with honey mustard dip and crunchy paprika potato wedges. Cut 4 potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, salt and paprika and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 100g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan. Lay on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 15 minutes, turning once. Mix 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp mild mustard and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for dipping.
W: the Monstars stealing the players' talent
Dark chocolate pudding in cups, topped with crushed chocolate biscuits and gummy worms crawling out like little monsters.
K: the bottle of plain water the Tune Squad thinks is magic

Fresh orange juice shaken with lime, honey and mint, topped with icy sparkling water and handed out in squeeze bottles labelled Secret Stuff. Squeeze 6 oranges and a lime into a jug. Stir in 2 tbsp honey until dissolved and add a handful of torn mint. Divide between 4 sports bottles, add ice and top each with 150ml cold sparkling water. Shake gently and write Secret Stuff on each bottle with a marker before handing them out at halftime.
T: Bring the secret stuff.
D: A basketball legend is pulled into a cartoon world to help Bugs Bunny and friends win a game against alien invaders.
P: Serve the drinks when Bugs fills the water bottle with Michael's secret stuff.

title: Free Willy
S: Salmon pieces glazed with soy, honey and ginger, baked at 200C for 10 minutes, served on toothpicks with a lime wedge.

Creamy clam chowder with bacon, potato, onion and thyme, ladled into small cups and topped with crumbled bacon, chives and oyster crackers. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp and set half aside. Soften an onion and 2 celery sticks in the fat, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then add 2 cans baby clams with their juice, 400ml milk, 2 diced potatoes and thyme. Simmer 15 minutes until the potato is tender. Stir in 150ml cream and heat through without boiling. Ladle into cups and top with bacon, chives and oyster crackers.
Glen and Annie's grilled cheese soldiers
Buttery toasted cheddar sandwiches fried golden in the pan and cut into fingers for dipping in tomato sauce.
M: Linguine tossed with sweet crab meat, garlic, a little chilli, lemon zest and parsley in good olive oil, finished with toasted breadcrumbs. Cook 400g linguine in well salted water. Toast 40g breadcrumbs in a little oil until golden. Gently fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and half a seeded red chilli in 80ml olive oil for 2 minutes. Add 300g crab meat, the zest and juice of a lemon and a ladle of pasta water and warm through. Toss with the drained pasta and chopped parsley, then scatter with the crumbs.
the night drive to get Willy to the sea

White fish strips crumbed in panko and fried crisp, tucked into warm tortillas with lime slaw, sliced avocado and a lime and sour cream crema. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 100g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Toss a quarter cabbage, shredded, with lime juice and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with lime zest and juice. Warm 8 flour tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, sliced avocado and crema.
W: Vanilla ice cream churned with crushed chocolate cream biscuits, scooped into bowls with a little white chocolate fin on top.
K: Willy clearing the rocks to the open sea

Lemonade with a few drops of blue colouring and a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top, served in tall glasses. Pour cold lemonade into tall glasses and add a drop or two of blue food colouring to each, stirring until ocean blue. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and foams up. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw.
T: Jump for it.
D: A troubled boy befriends a captive orca at an amusement park and sets out to free him.
P: Serve the dessert when Willy jumps over the breakwater.

title: Jumanji: The Next Level
S: the long chase across the desert dunes

Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar and grilled until charred, served with garlicky hummus and a chopped tomato, cucumber and mint salad. Mix 3 tbsp za'atar with 4 tbsp olive oil and brush over 4 flatbreads. Grill or chargrill for 2 minutes a side until blistered, then cut into wedges. Blitz a drained can of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, a garlic clove, lemon juice, salt and a splash of water until smooth. Dice 3 tomatoes and a Lebanese cucumber and toss with mint, lemon and oil.
the mandrills on the swinging rope bridges
Banana slices dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed peanuts, frozen 30 minutes on a tray.
the green jungle at the start of the game
Pineapple, mango, papaya and lychee cubes in cups with lime juice, mint and a little chilli salt.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato and brown sugar and baked sticky, with creamy mash, green beans and gravy. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, a grated onion, an egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Spread with 100ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Steam 300g green beans. Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and stock.
Jurgen the Brutal's snowy mountain fortress
Beef chuck browned with onions and lots of sweet paprika, simmered 3 hours with tomato and capsicum until thick, served with buttered noodles and sour cream.
W: the Falcon jewel they have to steal back
Green jelly set in glasses with diced kiwifruit and grapes, topped with whipped cream and a green grape on top like a gem.
K: crossing the desert with no water
Watermelon blended with lime juice and mint, strained and poured over ice in tall glasses.
T: The game is back. So is lunch.
D: The friends return to Jumanji to rescue Spencer, but the game has changed and two grandpas got sucked in too.
P: Serve the mains when the group is back at the diner at the end.

title: Willow
S: the magic acorns that turn things to stone
Bocconcini rolled in crushed toasted hazelnuts and chives so they look like acorns, with a little honey to drizzle.
Willow's farm in the Nelwyn village
Soft bread rolls brushed with butter, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, served warm with herb butter and a soft cheese.
Franjean and Rool, the troublesome brownies

Tiny crisp pastry cases filled with vanilla whipped cream and piled with mixed berries tossed in sugar and lemon zest, finished with icing sugar. Cut 2 sheets of sweet shortcrust into 24 rounds and press into a mini muffin tray. Prick and bake at 190C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool. Toss 300g mixed berries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the zest of a lemon. Whip 200ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and vanilla. Spoon cream into the cases, pile on the berries and dust with icing sugar.
M: Crossroads tavern beef and root veg stew
the rowdy tavern where Madmartigan hides

Beef chuck braised with onion, carrot, parsnip, thyme and bay in a rich beef stock until tender, served in bowls with crusty bread and butter. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots and 2 parsnips in chunks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp flour and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 1L beef stock, thyme and a bay leaf. Cover and simmer for 3 hours until the beef is tender and the sauce is rich. Serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.

Pork shoulder scored and rubbed with salt and fennel seed, roasted slow until tender, the crackling blasted until it shatters, with roast apples and potatoes. Score the skin of a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and 2 tsp crushed fennel seeds and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 160C for 4 hours. Add 1kg potatoes and 4 halved apples tossed in oil for the last hour. Turn up to 240C for 25 minutes until the crackling blisters. Rest 15 minutes and carve.
W: Sweet pastry filled with almond cream and dark blackberries, baked until bubbling and golden, dusted with icing sugar and served with thick cream. Line a 23cm tart tin with sweet shortcrust and chill 20 minutes. Beat 100g soft butter with 100g caster sugar, then 2 eggs and 100g almond meal. Spread in the case and press in 300g blackberries. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden and set. Cool, dust with icing sugar and serve with thick cream.
K: Cloudy apple juice warmed slowly with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and a little honey, ladled into mugs with an apple slice. Pour 1.5L cloudy apple juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 whole cloves, a few strips of orange peel and 1 tbsp honey. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling so the spices come through. Strain out the cloves. Ladle into mugs and float a thin apple slice in each.
T: Magic acorns. Bigger appetite.
D: A farmer from a village of little people is chosen to carry a special baby to safety.
P: Serve the snacks when Willow first meets Madmartigan in the crow's cage at the crossroads.

title: The NeverEnding Story
S: Bastian eating his lunch in the attic while he reads
Little sandwiches of ham, cheese and pickle on buttered bread, cut into triangles, with apple slices and a twist of salted nuts.
Dark chocolate rocky road with marshmallows, roasted almonds and broken biscuits, set in a tray and smashed into chunky rocks.
Swamp of Sadness spinach cob loaf
the swamp where Atreyu loses Artax

Spinach, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and garlic baked bubbling inside a hollowed cob loaf, with the torn bread toasted for dipping. Cut the top off a cob loaf and hollow it out, tearing the inside into chunks. Mix 250g thawed spinach squeezed dry, 250g cream cheese, 200g sour cream, 50g grated parmesan, a crushed garlic clove and pepper. Fill the loaf, replace the lid and wrap in foil. Bake at 190C for 25 minutes, adding the bread chunks to the tray for the last 10 minutes. Serve warm.
M: the gnome Urgl nursing Atreyu back to health
Chicken thighs simmered with barley, carrots, leek and celery for an hour, herbs and lemon stirred in at the end, served with brown bread.
the Childlike Empress in her Ivory Tower

Whole chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and tarragon and roasted golden, with silky white bean mash, buttered leeks and the pan juices. Mix 60g soft butter with chopped tarragon, lemon zest and salt and rub under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Warm 2 drained cans of cannellini beans with a garlic clove and 100ml stock, then blitz with 30g butter until smooth. Slice 2 leeks and cook gently in 30g butter for 10 minutes. Rest the chicken and spoon over the pan juices.
W: flying through the clouds on Falkor
Egg whites whipped glossy with caster sugar, piped into big fluffy clouds, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, with cream and strawberries.
K: the long journey to the Southern Oracle
Chamomile and honey tea brewed with lemon peel, served warm in small cups, or chilled with apple juice.
T: Read on. Keep eating.
D: A bullied boy hides in a school attic with a strange book and is drawn into the world of Fantasia.
P: Serve the snacks when Bastian unwraps his lunch in the school attic.

title: The Mighty Ducks
S: Cubes of firm mozzarella dipped in light batter and fried golden, with ranch for dipping. Cut 400g firm mozzarella into 2cm cubes. Whisk 1 cup self-raising flour with 250ml cold milk and a pinch of salt. Dip the cubes in the batter and fry in 5cm hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Serve with ranch dressing.
Creamy chicken wild rice soup cups

Wild rice simmered with chicken, carrot, celery and onion in a creamy thyme stock, ladled into small cups with buttered bread fingers. Soften a diced onion, a carrot and 2 celery sticks in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 1.2L chicken stock, 120g wild rice blend and thyme. Add 400g chicken thighs and simmer 40 minutes until the rice is tender. Shred the chicken back in and stir through 150ml cream. Ladle into cups and serve with fingers of buttered toast.
Two thin beef patties sealed around a slice of cheese, griddled so the cheese melts inside, in slider buns with pickles.
M: Beef mince browned with onion, mixed with corn, green beans and a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with potato gems and baked at 200C for 35 minutes.

Beef and pork meatballs browned and simmered in a garlic and basil tomato sauce, served from a big pot over spaghetti with grated parmesan. Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, an egg, 30g grated parmesan, chopped parsley and salt. Roll into 24 balls and brown in olive oil. Add 3 crushed garlic cloves, then 2 cans crushed tomatoes and 200ml water. Simmer 30 minutes and stir in torn basil. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and top with the meatballs and more parmesan.
W: the skate shop owner who taught Gordon

Chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, topped with white chocolate icing smoothed like ice, cut into squares. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs and fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Spread 150g melted white chocolate smooth over the top like ice and cut into squares.
K: the team before they became the Ducks

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk, whisked frothy, topped with marshmallows in big mugs. Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into big mugs and pile marshmallows on top. Ducks fly together.
T: Quack. Then eat.
D: A hotshot lawyer is ordered to coach a team of misfit kids in peewee ice hockey.
P: Serve the snacks when the Ducks pull off the Flying V for the first time.

title: Little Giants
S: Spiced beef and melted cheddar rolled tight in corn tortillas, baked until crisp like the ones on the counter roller, with salsa and sour cream. Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion, 2 tsp taco seasoning and 3 tbsp water. Warm 12 corn tortillas so they bend. Spoon beef and 150g grated cheddar along each, roll tightly and lay seam side down on an oiled tray. Brush with oil and bake at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp. Serve with mild salsa and sour cream.
the trick play that wins it

Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky honey and barbecue glaze, with ranch dip and celery. Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 125ml barbecue sauce and toss the wings through. Mix sour cream with mayonnaise and herbs for a ranch dip, and serve with celery sticks.
Peanut butter balls dipped in dark chocolate with a round left showing on top, Ohio's famous treat.
M: Cincinnati-style beef chilli spiced with cumin, cinnamon and cocoa, ladled over spaghetti and piled high with grated cheddar and diced onion. Brown 600g beef mince with a diced onion. Add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp mild chilli powder, 2 tbsp cocoa, 400g diced tomatoes and 250ml water, and simmer 40 minutes until thick. Cook 400g spaghetti. Pile the spaghetti into bowls, ladle over the chilli and top with 200g grated cheddar and finely diced onion.
Becky the Icebox rallying the team

Macaroni baked in a cheddar and parmesan sauce with a hint of mustard, under a crunchy buttered breadcrumb crust, with a crisp green salad. Boil 400g macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, whisk in 750ml milk and simmer until thick. Stir in 250g grated cheddar, 50g parmesan and 1 tsp mustard. Mix with the pasta and tip into a dish. Toss 60g breadcrumbs with 20g melted butter, scatter over and bake at 190C for 25 minutes. Serve with salad leaves.
W: Becky, the girl they call Icebox

Chocolate cookie dough shaped into footballs, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, white icing laces piped across the top. Cream 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, beat in an egg, then mix in 250g flour and 40g cocoa. Shape into small footballs and flatten slightly. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Pipe white icing laces across the top with icing sugar and a little water.
K: the water boys on the sideline

Fresh orange and lemon juice with a little honey and a pinch of salt, topped with icy water and served in paper cups with orange wedges. Squeeze 6 oranges and 2 lemons into a big jug. Stir in 2 tbsp honey dissolved in a little warm water and a small pinch of salt. Top with 1L cold water and plenty of ice and stir well. Pour into paper cups and serve with orange wedges for the players coming off the field.
T: Small team. Big plates.
D: Two brothers coach rival kids' football teams in their small Ohio town.
P: Serve the snacks when the Little Giants run the big trick play.

title: Dennis the Menace
S: Butter, brown sugar and vanilla creamed, oats and chocolate chips folded in, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.
Slingshot gruyère puffs with hot honey

Crisp little choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cracked pepper, baked hollow and hit with a drizzle of chilli honey and flaky salt. Pocket-sized ammo. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it leaves the sides, then cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time, then 100g grated gruyere and cracked pepper. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes, drizzle over and finish with sea salt.
the flower Mr Wilson waited years to see bloom

Cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, dill and smoked salmon, and mini egg sandwiches cut into fingers. Slice 2 Lebanese cucumbers into thick rounds and top each with cream cheese, a fold of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Hard boil 4 eggs, mash with salt and spread on white bread. Cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.
M: Dennis at the campfire with Switchblade Sam

Thick pork snags charred over the fire, in toasted rolls with sticky caramelised onions, smoky mustard mayo and crunchy pickles. Slice 3 onions and cook slowly in 30g butter with 1 tbsp brown sugar for 25 minutes until sticky and dark. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and half a tsp smoked paprika. Grill 8 thick pork sausages over medium coals or a barbecue for 15 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through. Toast 8 long rolls, spread with the mayo and fill with sausages, onions and sliced dill pickles.
Mr Wilson just wanting some peace
Lamb chops grilled with rosemary and garlic, with buttered mashed potato, peas and mint sauce.
W: Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, with ice cream.
K: Fresh lemons squeezed with sugar syrup and cold water, poured into tall glasses with ice and a strawberry.
T: Mr Wilson will not be impressed.
D: A cheeky five-year-old drives his grumpy retired neighbour up the wall.
P: Serve dessert when Mrs Wilson brings out the cookies.

title: Richie Rich
S: Parmesan and thyme crisps spooned into coin shapes, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until golden, served with fig jam and soft cheese.
Small blinis topped with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, laid out on silver trays.
the inventor's workshop under the mansion

Bite-sized chicken thigh soaked in buttermilk, fried in a crunchy cornflake crust, tossed in a parmesan and garlic dust with a honey sriracha dip. Cut 600g chicken thighs into 2cm pieces and soak in 250ml buttermilk with salt for 1 hour. Crush 100g cornflakes and mix with 50g plain flour and 1 tsp garlic powder. Toss the chicken in the crumbs and fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden. Toss hot with 30g finely grated parmesan and a pinch of salt. Mix 3 tbsp honey with 1 tsp sriracha and 2 tbsp mayonnaise to dip.
M: the burger counter built right into his house
Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles, onion and special sauce on soft sesame buns, with fries and a thick shake.
dinner in the huge dining room

Seared beef fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and golden puff pastry, with a glossy beef and thyme jus and buttery mash. Sear 4 x 150g beef fillet steaks hard for 1 minute a side and cool. Fry 300g finely chopped mushrooms with garlic and thyme until dry. Lay 2 slices prosciutto on each, spread with mushroom, add a steak and wrap. Wrap each in a square of puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 220C for 18 minutes. Reduce 400ml beef stock with thyme to a jus. Serve with mash.
W: the family vault at Mount Richmore
Vanilla ice cream with salted caramel sauce, crushed honeycomb and a chocolate coin on top in a tall glass.
K: playing baseball with real kids at last
Vanilla ice cream blended with milk and malt powder until thick, poured into tall glasses with a straw.
T: The richest kid in the world wants a mate and a burger.
D: The world's richest boy has everything except friends, until villains try to steal the family fortune.
P: Serve the mains when Richie takes his new friends to his own burger bar at the mansion.

title: Mouse Hunt
S: String cheese, aged cheddar, gouda and blue cheese on a board with crackers, grapes and a little bowl of nuts, enough to tempt any mouse. Arrange string cheese, wedges of aged cheddar, gouda and blue cheese on a wooden board. Add water crackers, a bunch of green grapes and a little bowl of nuts. Leave one small wedge of cheese on its own at the edge of the board as bait.
the cheese they keep using as bait
Little toasties of cheddar and gruyère on buttered bread, grilled until golden and cut into wedge shapes with holes poked in the top.

Tangles of spaghetti bound with egg, parmesan and parsley, fried into crisp golden nests and served with a smoky tomato and basil dipping sauce. Cook 200g spaghetti, drain and cool. Toss with 3 beaten eggs, 60g grated parmesan, chopped parsley and pepper. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan and drop in twisted forkfuls, flattening slightly. Fry 2 minutes a side until crisp and golden. Simmer 300ml passata with a garlic clove, half a tsp smoked paprika and basil for 10 minutes to dip.
M: Ernie the chef and his fancy restaurant
Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a creamy mushroom sauce and potato gratin.
LaRue mansion pork loin with crackling
getting the old LaRue mansion ready for auction

Pork loin rolled with sage and garlic, roasted with apples and potatoes until the crackling shatters, with a sharp apple and mustard sauce. Score the skin of a 1.5kg rolled pork loin, rub with salt and dry in the fridge for an hour. Push sage leaves and garlic slivers into the meat. Roast at 240C for 25 minutes, then at 180C for 1 hour with 1kg halved potatoes and 3 quartered apples. Simmer 2 more chopped apples with sugar and water until soft, then stir in 1 tsp Dijon. Rest the pork 10 minutes and carve.
W: the old house by architect Charles LaRue

Baked vanilla cheesecake on a biscuit base, baked at 160C for 50 minutes, cooled in the oven, with lemon curd. Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 500g cream cheese with 150g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs. Pour over and bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then cool in the oven. Spread with lemon curd before serving.
K: Cold milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, honey and a pinch of cinnamon, served in small glasses with a tiny cheese biscuit on the rim. Put 500ml cold milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon in a blender. Blend until thick and frothy. Pour into eight small glasses so everyone gets two little ones. Cut a small slit in 8 round cheese biscuits and perch one on the rim of each glass.
T: One mouse. Two brothers. Plenty of cheese.
D: Two brothers inherit a run-down mansion and a tiny mouse who refuses to leave.
P: Serve the snacks when the brothers set their first mouse trap with cheese.

title: Flubber
S: the green flubber bouncing around the lab
Avocado, peas, lime, mint and feta blitzed bright green, served with pita crisps and sugar snap peas.

Choux pastry with cheddar and paprika piped into small balls, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour until smooth, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time. Stir in 100g grated cheddar and a pinch of paprika. Pipe small balls onto trays and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.
the basketball game with the flubber shoes

Little beef meatballs baked crisp and rolled in a sticky honey barbecue glaze, speared on picks and served with a cool ranch dip for the bench. Mix 500g beef mince with 40g breadcrumbs, an egg, a grated garlic clove and salt. Roll into 30 small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer 150ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey for 3 minutes and toss the meatballs through. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives, dill and garlic powder for the dip.
M: Sara waiting at the altar while he works
Chicken breasts roasted at 200C with lemon and thyme, served with buttered potatoes and green beans, the dinner he should have been at.
Weebo the little flying robot who runs the house

Thin crisp bases spread with basil pesto, loaded with mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms and capsicum, finished with rocket and parmesan. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases on oiled trays. Spread each with 3 tbsp basil pesto. Top with 250g grated mozzarella, 150g halved cherry tomatoes, 100g sliced mushrooms and half a sliced green capsicum. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered. Scatter with rocket and shaved parmesan and cut into squares.
W: Lime jelly set in a ring mould, turned out wobbling onto a plate with whipped cream and kiwifruit.
K: the little flying robot who adores him

Lime cordial and lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top in tall glasses. Pour a splash of lime cordial into tall glasses and top with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and foams up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before it bubbles over like an experiment.
T: It bounces. Dinner doesn't.
D: An absent-minded professor invents a bouncing green goo and forgets his own wedding, again.
P: Serve dessert when the flubber starts dancing around the lab.

title: Inspector Gadget
S: the gadgets hidden all over his body
Cherry tomatoes, bocconcini, salami and basil threaded onto skewers, drizzled with olive oil and balsamic.
Riverton soft pretzels with cheese sauce

Soft pretzel knots dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, with a hot cheddar sauce for dunking. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Shape 8 knots and dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick, then stir in 150g grated cheddar.

Puff pastry spread with tomato and oregano, rolled up with ham and mozzarella, sliced into swirls and baked golden and bubbling. Spread 2 sheets of puff pastry with 4 tbsp tomato paste mixed with 1 tsp dried oregano. Scatter with 150g chopped leg ham and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes so it slices cleanly. Cut into 2cm rounds, lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden.
M: Spaghetti bolognese with beef mince, carrot, celery and tomato simmered an hour, lots of parmesan on top.
Sanford Scolex, the Claw, in his dark lair

Beef chuck simmered slowly with kidney beans, mild chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, with sour cream, cheddar and buttered cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften an onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin and 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, then a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml beef stock. Return the beef, cover and simmer 3 hours. Add a drained can of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Bake a packet of cornbread mix following the directions. Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with grey icing and chocolate wheels.
K: Penny, the real brains of the case
Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and soda water poured over ice with sliced lemon.
T: Go go gadget snacks.
D: A security guard rebuilt with gadgets becomes a cyborg detective chasing an evil tycoon.
P: Serve the snacks when Gadget finally gets the helicopter hat working.

title: George of the Jungle
S: Ripe bananas mashed with brown sugar, butter, egg and cinnamon, baked in a loaf tin at 175C for 55 minutes, sliced thick and buttered. Mash 3 ripe bananas with 150g brown sugar, 100g melted butter, 2 eggs and a teaspoon of cinnamon. Fold in 250g self-raising flour until just combined. Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175C for 55 minutes. Cool a little, then slice thick and butter.
Shep the elephant who thinks he's a dog

Roasted peanuts set in a golden honey toffee with a pinch of chilli and sea salt, cooled hard and smashed into shards for snacking. Line a tray with baking paper. Heat 200g caster sugar, 80g honey and 60ml water until it turns light amber, about 8 minutes. Stir in 250g roasted peanuts, 20g butter, half a tsp chilli flakes and half a tsp bicarb soda, then pour straight onto the tray and spread thin. Sprinkle with sea salt and cool for 30 minutes. Smash into shards.
Mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit in a big bowl with lime juice and torn mint.
M: Ape, the talking gorilla with very good manners

Eye fillet seared and roasted to medium rare, sliced with a buttery tarragon béarnaise, crisp potato rösti and garlicky green beans. Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze dry, season and fry as 4 rösti in butter for 6 minutes a side. Sear 4 eye fillet steaks and roast at 200C to 54C inside, then rest. Reduce 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with a chopped eschalot and tarragon to 1 tbsp. Whisk with 2 egg yolks over simmering water, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with garlic.
San Francisco cioppino with garlic toast

Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, fennel and garlic broth with a pinch of chilli, served with garlicky toasted sourdough for mopping. Soften a sliced fennel bulb, an onion and 3 garlic cloves in olive oil. Add a pinch of chilli flakes, a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 400g chunks of white fish, 300g green prawns and 500g mussels, cover and cook 6 minutes until the mussels open. Stir through parsley. Toast sourdough slices, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.
W: the trees George keeps swinging into

Coconut rice pudding simmered 30 minutes with sugar and vanilla, chilled, topped with toasted coconut and mango. Simmer 150g arborio rice in 800ml coconut milk with 80g sugar and a teaspoon of vanilla paste for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Chill for 2 hours. Spoon into bowls and top with toasted shredded coconut and slices of fresh mango.
K: the elephant who thinks he's a dog

Banana, mango, yoghurt and honey blended with ice until thick, poured into tall glasses. Peel 2 bananas and a mango and drop into a blender. Add 300g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp honey and a big handful of ice. Blend until thick and smooth, adding a splash of water if it is too thick, then pour into tall glasses with straws.
T: Watch out for that tree. And the snacks.
D: A good-hearted jungle man raised by apes falls for an heiress and follows her to San Francisco.
P: Serve the snacks when George swings straight into a tree.

title: Small Soldiers
S: Alan's family shop where the boxes arrive

Popcorn tossed with butter and coloured sprinkles, mixed with little chocolate buttons and pretzel pieces. Pop 100g popping corn and toss with 60g melted butter. Add a big handful of coloured sprinkles while the butter is warm so they stick. Stir in chocolate buttons and broken pretzel pieces and tip into a bowl like a toy box.
Pumpkin and feta filo triangles with sage, baked at 190C for 20 minutes until golden and crisp.
Chip Hazard and his toy soldiers

Crackers lined up in rows like troops, topped with sharp cheddar, crisped salami, a slice of pickle and a dab of hot honey mustard. Lay 16 slices of salami on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp, then cool. Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp mild mustard. Top 16 crackers with a slice of sharp cheddar, a piece of crisp salami and a round of dill pickle. Add a dab of the honey mustard and line them up on a board in neat army rows.
M: the suburban street where the war breaks out
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, cooked at 150C for 3 hours wrapped in foil, glazed with barbecue sauce over hot coals, with corn and coleslaw.
defending the house against the toy soldiers

Beef meatloaf wrapped in streaky bacon and glazed with smoky tomato barbecue sauce, baked sticky, with buttery mash and minted peas. Mix 800g beef mince, a grated onion, an egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined tray and wrap with 8 rashers of streaky bacon. Brush with 100ml barbecue sauce and bake at 180C for 1 hour, brushing again halfway. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Cook 300g peas with mint.
W: Chocolate biscuit base, green peppermint icing and a dark chocolate top, chilled and cut into small squares.
K: Commando Elite lime and mint fizz

Fresh lime juice muddled with mint and sugar syrup, topped with icy soda water and served in tin camping mugs, army canteen style. Dissolve 100g sugar in 100ml hot water and cool. In a jug, muddle a big handful of mint leaves with the syrup. Add the juice of 5 limes and plenty of ice. Top with 1L cold soda water and stir. Pour into four metal camping mugs and add a lime wheel and a mint sprig to each.
T: Toys at war. Snacks at peace.
D: Action figures fitted with military chips come to life and go to war in a quiet Ohio town.
P: Serve the snacks when the Commando Elite wake up in the toy shop.

title: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
S: the fruit stall where Anakin buys a pallie for old Jira
Pears and nectarines sliced and fanned on a board with honey, crumbled feta and toasted pistachios.
Lamb pieces marinated in yoghurt, cumin and garlic, threaded onto skewers and grilled hot and fast, with a tahini sauce.

King prawns in an ice-cold tempura batter fried until puffed and bubbly, with a soy, lime and chilli dipping sauce and sesame mayo. Peel and devein 16 green king prawns, leaving the tails on, and score the bellies so they stay straight. Whisk 100g plain flour, 30g cornflour and 200ml ice-cold soda water until just mixed and still lumpy. Dip the prawns and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until puffed and pale gold. Mix 3 tbsp soy, the juice of a lime and a sliced chilli. Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp sesame oil.
M: Shmi cooking for the Jedi in her small home
Chicken thighs rubbed with harissa and lemon, roasted at 200C on chickpeas and red onion, with flatbread and a cucumber yoghurt.
Theed palace fennel pork with polenta

Pork loin roasted with fennel, garlic and white wine, sliced over soft parmesan polenta with blistered roasted grapes and the pan juices. Rub a 1.2kg pork loin with crushed fennel seeds, 3 garlic cloves, olive oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 50 minutes with 2 sliced fennel bulbs and 150ml white wine in the tray, adding 300g red grapes for the last 15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Whisk 200g instant polenta into 1L simmering stock and cook 5 minutes, then stir in 40g butter and 50g parmesan. Slice the pork over the polenta.
W: Duel of the Fates red and blue tart
the double-bladed red lightsaber against the Jedi
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with vanilla custard, topped half with raspberries and half with blueberries, glazed with jam.
K: Milk blended with coconut milk, a little honey and a few drops of blue colouring, served icy cold.
T: Now this is podracing. And this is dinner.
D: Two Jedi find a gifted slave boy on Tatooine while trying to protect a young queen and her planet.
P: Serve the snacks when the podrace starts at Mos Espa.

title: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
S: Anakin floating a piece of fruit across the table to Padmé
Pear and melon cubes speared on toothpicks, drizzled with honey and lime, arranged on a long platter as if they are hovering.
Tipoca City salt and vinegar fish bites
the ocean planet of Kamino, where it never stops raining

Flathead pieces in a crisp salt and vinegar crumb, fried golden, with a sharp dill pickle and caper tartare and lemon wedges. Cut 600g flathead fillets into bite pieces and soak in 3 tbsp malt vinegar for 10 minutes, then pat dry. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 100g panko mixed with 1 tsp salt. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped dill pickle, capers, dill and lemon juice. Sprinkle the fish with more salt and vinegar.
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery red chilli glaze of sriracha, honey and butter.
M: Dexter Jettster's greasy diner on Coruscant
Thick beef patty melts with caramelised onions and Swiss cheese on rye, grilled in butter, with crinkle fries and a pickle.
Anakin and Padmé on the grass at the Naboo lake retreat

Lamb cutlets grilled pink with rosemary and lemon, with a warm new potato salad, green beans and a bright salsa verde to spoon over. Boil 800g new potatoes until tender and halve. Blanch 300g green beans. Blitz parsley, mint, a garlic clove, 1 tbsp capers, 2 anchovies, lemon juice and 100ml olive oil into a salsa verde. Rub 12 lamb cutlets with oil, rosemary, lemon zest and salt and grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side. Toss the potatoes and beans with half the salsa verde and serve with the cutlets.
W: White chocolate mousse set in glasses, topped with whipped cream and a thin square of dark chocolate.
K: Strong drip coffee in thick mugs with hot milk and sugar on the side.
T: Dinner at Dex's. Ask no questions.
D: Ten years on, Anakin protects Padmé while Obi-Wan uncovers a secret clone army.
P: Serve the mains when Obi-Wan walks into Dex's Diner on Coruscant.

title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
S: the Wookiee home world of Kashyyyk
Mixed mushrooms sautéed in butter with garlic and thyme, piled onto toasted sourdough and finished with shaved parmesan.
Mini vol-au-vent cases filled with creamy chicken and leek, baked at 200C for 10 minutes until golden.
Galaxies Opera House smoked salmon blinis
Palpatine and Anakin at the opera

Warm blinis topped with smoked salmon, lemony crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, served on a dark tray like the box at the opera. Warm 16 blinis at 160C for 5 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of a lemon, salt and pepper. Top each blini with a spoon of the crème fraîche and a fold of smoked salmon from 200g. Finish with a small spoon of salmon roe and snipped chives. Serve straight away on a dark tray.
M: Senate chamber beef fillet, red wine jus
the halls of power on Coruscant

Eye fillet roasted to medium rare and sliced, with a glossy red wine jus, a crunchy-topped potato gratin and honey roasted carrots. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 1 hour, adding 40g grated parmesan for the last 15 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with oil and honey. Sear a 1kg eye fillet on all sides, then roast at 220C to 54C inside, about 20 minutes, and rest. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock and thyme to a glossy jus and whisk in 20g butter.

Whole duck rubbed with salt and five-spice and roasted until the skin crackles, glazed with orange, honey, soy and star anise, sliced over jasmine rice. Prick a 2kg duck all over, rub with salt and 1 tsp five spice and roast on a rack at 180C for 1 hour 45 minutes. Simmer the juice of 2 oranges, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 2 star anise until syrupy. Brush the glaze over the duck for the last 15 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, carve and serve over 300g steamed jasmine rice with the rest of the glaze.
W: Dark chocolate fondants baked at 200C for 10 minutes so the middle stays molten, turned out with raspberry coulis running out like lava.
K: baby Luke handed over under the twin suns
Orange and pineapple juice over ice with grenadine poured in last to sink like a sunset.
T: You were the chosen one. To bring dessert.
D: As the Clone Wars end, Anakin is pulled to the dark side and the Jedi fall.
P: Serve dessert when the duel on Mustafar begins.

title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
S: the busy holy city of Jedha
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar, grilled until blistered, with hummus, pickled turnips and olives.
the palm-lined beaches of Scarif in the final battle
Prawns marinated in garlic, chilli and lime for 20 minutes, threaded onto skewers and grilled until pink and charred, with a mango and coriander salsa.
the Erso family farm on Lah'mu

Crisp little potato and onion rösti fried golden in butter, topped with sour cream, chives and a spoon of hot smoked trout. Grate 800g potatoes and a small onion, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can in a tea towel. Mix with an egg, 2 tbsp flour and salt. Fry spoonfuls in butter and oil, flattening them, for 3 minutes a side until crisp and golden. Drain on paper. Top each with sour cream, flaked hot smoked trout from 150g and snipped chives.
M: Basmati cooked with cumin and cinnamon spiced lamb, carrot and onion, piled on a platter with raisins, toasted almonds and a garlic yoghurt. Brown 600g diced lamb in oil. Add a sliced onion, 2 carrots cut into strips, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp cinnamon and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 300g rinsed basmati and 600ml chicken stock, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes, then rest 10 minutes. Toast 50g flaked almonds. Pile onto a platter with 50g raisins and the almonds, and serve with yoghurt mixed with a crushed garlic clove.
Yavin 4 rebel base chicken rice bowls
the rebel base on Yavin 4 where Rogue One gets its call sign

Smoky paprika and garlic chicken charred on the grill, sliced over rice with black beans, charred corn, avocado, pickled onion and lime crema. Rub 800g chicken thighs with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt. Cook 300g rice. Slice a red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Warm a drained can of black beans with cumin. Grill the chicken 5 minutes a side and slice. Build bowls with avocado, pickled onion and sour cream mixed with lime.
W: Dark chocolate mousse set in round moulds, glazed with a shiny grey-black ganache, one little dent pressed into each.
K: Chirrut and Baze, the guardians of Jedha
Green tea brewed with ginger and honey, served hot in small cups or iced on a warm night.
T: Rebellions are built on hope. And snacks.
D: A band of rebels sets out to steal the plans for the Death Star.
P: Serve the snacks when the team walks through the crowded streets of Jedha.

title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
S: Roasted almonds and cashews with rosemary and smoked salt, and a bowl of marinated olives on the card table.
Han's lucky pair of gold dice

Cubes of haloumi dusted in smoked paprika and fried golden on every side, drizzled with hot honey and lemon, with pips of toasted sesame like dice spots. Cut 2 blocks of haloumi, about 500g, into 2cm cubes and pat dry. Toss in 2 tbsp flour mixed with 1 tsp smoked paprika. Fry in a little oil over medium high heat for 1 minute a side until golden all over. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and the juice of half a lemon. Drizzle over the cubes and dot with toasted black and white sesame seeds.
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, chilli oil and black vinegar to dip.
M: Pork knuckles simmered with caraway and bay, then roasted until the crackling blisters, with warm sauerkraut, buttered potatoes and wholegrain mustard. Simmer 2 pork knuckles with an onion, 2 bay leaves and 1 tsp caraway seeds for 1.5 hours. Pat very dry, score, rub with salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes until the crackling blisters. Boil 800g potatoes and toss with butter and parsley. Warm 500g sauerkraut with a little of the cooking liquid. Serve with wholegrain mustard.
First Light duck with cherry and port
the glittering party on Dryden Vos's yacht, the First Light

Duck breasts scored and rendered until the skin crackles, sliced pink over silky celeriac purée with a cherry and port sauce and crisp kale. Simmer a peeled, chopped celeriac in milk and water for 20 minutes, drain and blitz with 40g butter. Score 4 duck breasts, start skin side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat for 8 minutes, then flip and roast at 200C for 6 minutes. Rest. Pour off most fat, add 100ml port, 200g pitted cherries and 150ml stock and reduce until glossy. Bake kale leaves with oil until crisp.
W: the fuel they're stealing is unstable

Dark chocolate bark spread thin and scattered with popping candy, freeze-dried raspberries and sea salt that crackles and fizzes as you eat it. Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 300g dark chocolate over barely simmering water, stirring until smooth. Spread thin on the tray. While still soft, scatter with 2 sachets popping candy, 15g freeze-dried raspberries and a few sea salt flakes. Set in the fridge for 30 minutes, then snap into jagged shards.
K: Lando and his collection of capes
Bourbon stirred with honey syrup and orange bitters over a big ice cube, with orange peel.
T: Twelve parsecs. One full plate.
D: Young Han Solo joins a crew of thieves and meets Chewbacca and Lando on the way.
P: Serve the snacks when Han sits down at the card table with Lando.

title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
S: Rey's ration of powder that puffs into bread on Jakku
Quick soda bread of flour, buttermilk and bicarb mixed and baked at 200C for 30 minutes until it rises, torn warm with butter and honey.
the desert trading post on Jakku
Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and a walnut half, drizzled with honey, with dried apricots and figs.

Saffron risotto balls with a melting mozzarella centre, crumbed and fried deep orange, with a smoky paprika aioli for the white stripe. Soak a pinch of saffron in 750ml hot stock. Soften an onion in butter, add 250g arborio and stir in the stock a ladle at a time for 18 minutes. Stir in 40g parmesan and spread out to cool. Shape 16 balls around a cube of mozzarella. Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, a crushed garlic clove and smoked paprika to dip.
M: Maz Kanata's busy castle on Takodana
Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and paprika, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, pulled apart with flatbreads, yoghurt and roasted vegetables.
the frozen forest on Starkiller Base

Barramundi baked in paper parcels with lemon, dill, capers and butter, torn open at the table, with crushed potatoes and a sharp fennel slaw. Lay 4 barramundi fillets on squares of baking paper. Top each with lemon slices, dill, 1 tsp capers and 15g butter, season and fold into sealed parcels. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Boil 800g baby potatoes, crush with olive oil and salt. Shave a fennel bulb thin and toss with lemon juice, olive oil and dill. Open the parcels at the table.
W: the island where Rey finds Luke
Scones of self-raising flour, cream and lemonade, baked at 220C for 15 minutes, with jam and whipped cream.
K: Han and Chewie back on the Falcon, home

Strong coffee stirred into cocoa and cinnamon steamed milk, topped with whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa, served in metal mugs. Brew 250ml very strong coffee or 4 espresso shots. Warm 700ml milk with 3 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon, whisking until frothy, without boiling. Divide the coffee between four metal mugs and pour in the hot chocolate milk. Top with whipped cream from 150ml cream and dust with cocoa.
T: Chewie, we're home. Dinner's on.
D: Thirty years after the Empire fell, a scavenger and a runaway stormtrooper get caught up in the hunt for Luke Skywalker.
P: Serve the snacks when Rey makes her instant bread on Jakku.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
S: Luke spearing a fish off the rocks on Ahch-To
Salmon chunks marinated in lemon, dill and olive oil, threaded onto skewers and grilled 2 minutes a side, with a herby yoghurt dip.
the glitzy casino city of Canto Bight

Fresh figs split and filled with gorgonzola, wrapped in prosciutto and blistered under the grill, finished with hot honey and cracked pepper on a gold tray. Cut a cross in the top of 12 fresh figs and press about 10g gorgonzola into each, 120g in all. Wrap each fig in half a slice of prosciutto. Grill on a lined tray for 5 minutes until the prosciutto crisps and the cheese melts. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over. Finish with cracked pepper and thyme leaves.
the white salt over red ground on Crait
Potatoes sliced thin and fried at 170C until crisp, tossed with sea salt and a good dusting of smoked paprika so the red shows through.
M: Chewie roasting his dinner over the fire as the porgs stare

Whole spatchcocked poussins rubbed with garlic, thyme and smoked paprika, charred over the coals, with crisp smashed potatoes and lemony greens. No porgs harmed. Cut the backbones out of 4 poussins and press flat. Rub with 4 crushed garlic cloves, thyme, 2 tsp smoked paprika, olive oil and salt. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Grill or roast the poussins at 220C for 30 minutes until the juices run clear. Wilt a bunch of kale with lemon and garlic.
the Resistance fleet running low on fuel
Chicken thighs grilled with lemon and oregano, over rice with roasted capsicum, cucumber, feta and a tahini drizzle.
W: Luke drinking the green milk on the island
Pistachio and vanilla panna cotta set overnight, pale green, topped with crushed pistachios and honey.
K: Cranberry and pomegranate juice topped with soda water, with pomegranate seeds and plenty of ice.
T: This is not going to go the way you think. Dinner, that is.
D: Rey trains with a reluctant Luke while the Resistance runs from the First Order.
P: Serve the mains when Chewie roasts his dinner while the porgs watch.

title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
S: the colourful Festival of the Ancestors on Pasaana
Flatbreads brushed with oil and dusted with sumac, paprika and turmeric, grilled and served with three dips: hummus, beetroot and green herb yoghurt.
Chicken and ginger dumplings steamed 10 minutes, served in a little hot broth with spring onion and chilli oil.

Bite-sized toasts piled with a buttery mushroom, thyme and garlic pâté, topped with a sliver of cornichon and crispy shallot. Small enough for Babu Frik. Fry 300g chopped mushrooms in 40g butter with 2 garlic cloves and thyme until dark and dry. Blitz with 80g cream cheese, salt and pepper until smooth and chill. Cut a baguette into 20 thin slices, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes. Fry 2 sliced shallots in oil until crisp. Spread the pâté on the toasts and top with sliced cornichons and crispy shallots.
M: the stormy ocean and the old Death Star wreck
Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, fennel and white wine broth with saffron, served with garlic toast.
the whole fleet arriving over Exegol

Rib eye seared in a smoking pan and basted in garlic butter, sliced over buttery mash with a punchy cracked peppercorn cream sauce. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Season 4 rib eye steaks and sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes, flip, add 40g butter and 2 garlic cloves and baste for 3 minutes. Rest. Add 2 tsp crushed black peppercorns to the pan, then 150ml beef stock, 1 tsp Dijon and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Slice the steaks over the mash and pour over the sauce.
W: Rey on Tatooine at the very end
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, mango and passionfruit for two glowing suns.
K: Rey burying the lightsabers at the old homestead
Milk blended with coconut milk, honey and a few drops of blue colouring, served cold.
T: The saga ends. The snacks don't.
D: Rey and her friends race to find the hidden world where the Emperor has returned.
P: Serve the snacks during the festival on Pasaana.

title: Flash Gordon
S: Flash fighting the guards with a football game
Chicken thigh pieces crumbed and fried, shaped like little footballs, with a honey mustard dip.
Prince Barin's forest moon of Arboria

Flat mushrooms packed with garlic butter, crisp bacon, breadcrumbs, parmesan and parsley, baked until golden and bubbling, finished with lemon. Remove the stems from 8 flat mushrooms and chop them. Fry 100g diced bacon until crisp, add the stems and 2 garlic cloves and cook 2 minutes. Mix with 60g breadcrumbs, 40g grated parmesan, chopped parsley and 40g melted butter. Pile into the mushroom caps and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until golden. Squeeze over lemon to serve.
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky honey, soy and chilli glaze, scattered with sesame.
M: Beef eye fillet roasted to medium rare and sliced on a long platter with roasted red onions, beetroot and a rich, glossy red wine and thyme sauce. Roast 4 beetroot wrapped in foil at 200C for 1 hour, then peel and cut into wedges. Halve 4 red onions and roast with oil and balsamic for 40 minutes. Sear a 1kg eye fillet on all sides and roast at 220C for 20 minutes to medium rare, then rest. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock and thyme until glossy and whisk in 20g butter. Slice and arrange on a long platter.
Chicken thighs in a hot red curry with coconut milk, capsicum and Thai basil, served with jasmine rice.
W: Ming's red and gold palace on Mongo
Sponge layered with raspberry jelly, mango, custard and whipped cream, chilled overnight and topped with gold sprinkles.
K: Princess Aura and her red palace
Pomegranate and cranberry juice with soda water and fresh lime over ice in tall glasses.
T: Ming is merciless. Dinner is not.
D: A football star crash lands on the planet Mongo and takes on Ming the Merciless.
P: Serve the snacks when Flash starts the football brawl in Ming's palace.

title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
S: the diner near campus where Mutt tracks Indy down

Thick fries cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt with flaky salt and serve in paper cones with tomato sauce.
Snapper cubes cured in lime juice with red onion, chilli and coriander, served in small cups with sweet potato and corn.

Flaky pastry filled with cumin-spiced beef, onion, olive and egg, crimped and baked golden, with a punchy green chilli and coriander salsa. Fry an onion with 400g beef mince, 2 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika until browned. Stir in 50g chopped green olives and a chopped boiled egg and cool. Cut 4 sheets of shortcrust into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Blitz a bunch of coriander, a green chilli, a garlic clove, lime juice and olive oil for the salsa.
M: Chicken pieces marinated in garlic, cumin, paprika and lime, roasted at 220C until charred, with a green sauce of coriander, jalapeño and mayo, and fries.
the jungle chase in the Amazon

Rump strips seared in a smoking wok with red onion, tomato, soy and vinegar, tossed with crisp chips and served with rice the Peruvian way. Cook 1kg frozen chips at 220C until crisp. Cook 300g rice. Slice 700g rump steak into strips and toss with soy, garlic and cumin. Sear in a smoking wok in batches for 1 minute. Add a red onion in wedges and 2 tomatoes in wedges and toss 1 minute. Add 3 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, return the beef, toss with the chips and coriander. Serve with rice.
W: taking the skull home to Akator

Clear lemon jelly set with gelatine in glasses, layered with sliced grapes and berries so it sparkles, kept cold in a lead-lined fridge. Soak 6 gelatine sheets. Heat 500ml water with 150g sugar and the juice of 3 lemons and stir in the gelatine. Layer halved green grapes and blueberries in glasses, pour over the jelly and set 4 hours.
K: Mutt rolling up on his motorbike in a leather jacket

Vanilla ice cream blended with milk and malt powder until thick, poured into tall glasses. For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and 1 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into tall glasses. Makes four.
T: Nineteen fifty-seven. Same hat.
D: In 1957 Indy races Soviet agents to find a crystal skull in the jungles of Peru.
P: Serve the drinks when Mutt and Indy meet at the diner.

title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
S: the tuk-tuk chase through the streets of Tangier
Lamb kofta of mince, onion, cumin and parsley shaped on skewers and grilled, with a harissa yoghurt dip.
diving for the dial in the Aegean Sea with Renaldo
Baby octopus marinated in olive oil, lemon and oregano, grilled hot and fast, served with lemon and capers.
the 1969 ticker tape parade in New York

New York street-cart soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, served warm with spicy brown mustard. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Shape 8 big pretzels and dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard with 1 tsp hot English mustard and 1 tsp honey to serve.
M: the journey to Syracuse in Sicily

Swordfish steaks seared golden, finished with a sweet and sour caponata of eggplant, tomato, olives, capers and pine nuts, with crusty bread. Cube an eggplant and fry in olive oil until golden. Add a sliced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften. Stir in 400g crushed tomatoes, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 50g green olives and 1 tbsp capers and simmer 15 minutes. Toast 30g pine nuts and stir through with basil. Season 4 swordfish steaks and sear 2 minutes a side. Serve on the caponata with crusty bread.
the Moroccan leg of the hunt
Chicken thighs slow cooked with preserved lemon, green olives, ginger, saffron and onion, served over couscous.
W: Icy Sicilian almond milk granita scraped into glasses, served the local way with a warm split brioche bun for dunking. Blend 200g ground almonds with 800ml water and 150g caster sugar, stand 30 minutes and strain well through a cloth, squeezing hard. Stir in 1 tsp almond extract. Pour into a shallow tray and freeze, scraping with a fork every 40 minutes for 3 hours until fluffy ice crystals form. Warm 4 brioche buns at 160C for 5 minutes. Spoon the granita into glasses and serve with the brioche.
K: Green tea brewed with plenty of fresh mint and sugar, poured from a height into small glasses.
T: One last adventure. One more helping.
D: In 1969 Indy and his goddaughter race a former Nazi to find an ancient device that can change history.
P: Serve the snacks when the tuk-tuk chase tears through Tangier.

title: The Mummy
S: Soaked chickpeas blitzed with onion, garlic, parsley, coriander and cumin, shaped into balls and fried at 180C, with tahini sauce.
the scarab beetles swarming under the sand
Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter, dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed pistachios.
the riverboat up the Nile before it burns

Eggplant charred black over a flame until smoky, whipped with tahini, garlic and lemon, topped with pomegranate and olive oil, with warm pita. Char 2 eggplants directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, until black and collapsed. Cool, peel and drain in a sieve for 10 minutes. Mash with 3 tbsp tahini, a crushed garlic clove, the juice of a lemon and salt. Spread on a plate, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with pomegranate seeds and parsley. Serve with 4 warm pita breads.
M: Lamb shoulder braised slowly with cumin, cinnamon and tomato until it pulls apart, over spiced rice with toasted almonds, crispy onions and yoghurt. Brown a 1.5kg lamb shoulder, add a sliced onion, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml water, then cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Fry 2 sliced onions until dark and crisp. Cook 300g basmati with a cinnamon stick and 2 cardamom pods. Pull the lamb apart into its sauce. Serve over the rice with toasted almonds, crispy onions and yoghurt.
the camp at the dig site
Lentils, rice and macaroni layered with a spicy tomato sauce, crispy fried onions and chickpeas.
W: Book of the Dead honey pastries
the black Book of the Dead
Filo layered with butter, walnuts and cinnamon, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, soaked in honey syrup.
K: Desert ruby hibiscus and lime cooler
the long desert ride to Hamunaptra

Dried hibiscus steeped with sugar, ginger and cinnamon until deep ruby red, chilled and poured over ice with lime and mint. Steep 30g dried hibiscus flowers in 1L just-boiled water with 100g sugar, a few slices of ginger and a cinnamon stick for 15 minutes. Strain into a jug and chill well. Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour in the hibiscus and add a good squeeze of lime to each. Finish with mint sprigs.
T: Death is only the beginning. Of dinner.
D: An adventurer, a librarian and her brother wake a cursed high priest in the lost city of Hamunaptra.
P: Serve the snacks when Evie knocks over every shelf in the Cairo library.

title: The Mummy Returns
S: O'Connell pork and sage sausage rolls
the O'Connell family home in London

Pork mince, onion, sage and breadcrumbs rolled in buttery puff pastry, egg washed and baked golden, served hot with brown sauce. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Halve 2 thawed puff pastry sheets, lay a sausage of filling along each strip and roll up, seam down. Brush with beaten egg, cut into 5cm pieces and score the tops. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot with brown sauce.
the hidden green oasis at the end of the race
Watermelon cut into wedges with halved figs, dates and pomegranate seeds, scattered with mint and crumbled feta, finished with a squeeze of lime.
Izzy's flying airship over the desert
Small falafel tucked into mini pita with tahini, pickled turnip and tomato, wrapped in paper for the flight.
M: the Scorpion King and his army
Lamb leg butterflied, rubbed with harissa, garlic and cumin, grilled until charred, sliced with couscous and a yoghurt sauce.
London beef and stout pie with mash
Rick and Evie back home in England

Beef chuck braised in stout with onions and thyme for three hours, under a flaky puff lid, with buttery mash and minted peas. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 sliced onions, add the beef, 440ml stout, 250ml beef stock and 4 thyme sprigs. Cover and simmer gently for 3 hours, then cool slightly. Spoon into a pie dish, top with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and milk, and peas tossed with mint.
W: the golden pyramid at the oasis
Filo layered with butter, pistachios and cardamom, cut into triangles, baked at 180C for 40 minutes and soaked in honey syrup.
K: Iced karkadé with orange and mint
crossing the desert to the oasis, Egyptian style

Egyptian hibiscus tea brewed deep red with cinnamon, sweetened, chilled hard and poured over ice with orange slices and torn mint. Bring 1.5L water to the boil with 1 cinnamon stick, then take off the heat and add 40g dried hibiscus flowers. Steep for 15 minutes, strain and stir in 120g caster sugar until dissolved. Chill for at least 2 hours. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, a few orange slices and torn mint, pour over the karkadé and finish with a squeeze of orange.
T: He's back. Bring snacks.
D: Rick and Evie's young son puts on a cursed bracelet that sends them racing to the Oasis of Ahm Shere.
P: Serve the snacks when the double-decker bus chase starts in London.

title: Jurassic World
S: the mosasaur grabbing the shark at feeding time
Big prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, piled high on a platter with lime wedges for the crowd.
the gyrosphere ride through the valley
Cheddar, cream cheese and chives rolled into balls, coated in crushed nuts and paprika, with crackers.
the busy theme park main street

Soft pretzels dipped in a bicarb bath, baked chewy and brown, brushed with butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar, with warm caramel dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar and 320ml warm water into a dough, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Shape into 8 pretzels. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with 60g melted butter and toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with warmed caramel sauce.
M: Owen at his bungalow by the lake

Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika and pepper, slow cooked until they pull off the bone, glazed sticky, with buttered corn and slaw. Rub 2kg beef short ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp salt. Wrap tightly in foil and cook at 140C for 5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and roast at 220C for 15 minutes until sticky. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 4 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp vinegar.
the tropical island off Costa Rica
White fish dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, in corn tortillas with cabbage, pineapple salsa and lime crema.
W: the dinosaur eggs in the hatchery
Chocolate mousse set in glasses, topped with a speckled white chocolate egg and crushed chocolate biscuit dirt.
K: the hot day at the park
Lemon juice, sugar and water frozen and blitzed into slush, poured into big cups with straws.
T: The park is open. So is the kitchen.
D: A fully working dinosaur theme park opens on Isla Nublar, and its newest creation escapes.
P: Serve the snacks when the mosasaur leaps up to grab its lunch.

title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
S: Owen building his cabin by hand
Thick beef sausages grilled over coals, sliced and served on toothpicks with mustard and caramelised onion.
Lockwood auction smoked salmon on rye
the auction at the Lockwood mansion

Toasted rye squares topped with lemon crème fraîche, folds of smoked salmon, capers and dill, passed round on trays like at the auction. Cut 6 slices dark rye into quarters, brush with olive oil and toast at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp, then cool. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Spread a little on each square, top with a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, 2 capers and a dill sprig. Finish with cracked pepper and serve within the hour.
the secret cloning lab under Lockwood Manor
Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sausage meat, crumbed and cooked golden, then halved like cracked dinosaur eggs.
M: Lockwood Manor eye fillet with red wine jus

Beef eye fillet seared hard and roasted pink, sliced with a glossy red wine jus, creamy potato gratin and buttered green beans. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, 2 garlic cloves and salt, and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 20 minutes for medium-rare, then rest 10 minutes. In the same pan, boil 250ml red wine and 250ml beef stock until reduced by half, then whisk in 30g butter. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes.
Isla Nublar chilli lime chicken and beans
the rescue team heading back into the island jungle

Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, chargrilled, served over rice and smoky black beans with a fresh tomato salsa. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side until charred. Cook 300g rice. Warm 2 drained cans black beans with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Dice 3 tomatoes with half a red onion and coriander. Serve the chicken over rice and beans with the salsa.
W: Owen living rough while he builds his cabin

Bananas split in the skin and stuffed with dark chocolate and marshmallows, baked in foil until gooey, with crushed biscuits on top. Slit 4 bananas lengthways through the top skin without cutting through the bottom, and open them slightly. Stuff each with 25g chopped dark chocolate and a handful of mini marshmallows from 50g. Wrap each in foil and cook on a barbecue or at 200C in the oven for 10 minutes until melted. Open the foil, scatter with 4 crushed digestive biscuits and eat with spoons.
K: Butterfly pea tea chilled bright blue over ice, topped with lemonade, then a squeeze of lime that turns it purple at the table. Steep 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 500ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain, stir in 3 tbsp honey and chill. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice and pour in the blue tea until half full. Top each with lemonade. Serve with lime wedges on the side and let everyone squeeze in the lime to watch the colour change.
T: The island is erupting. The oven is on.
D: Owen and Claire go back to Isla Nublar to rescue the dinosaurs before a volcano wipes them out.
P: Serve dessert when the volcano blows on Isla Nublar.

title: Jurassic Park III
S: Eric and Ben parasailing over the island

Garlic, chilli and lime prawns threaded on skewers and grilled over high heat, with a sweet mango and red onion salsa. Toss 800g peeled green prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, the zest and juice of 1 lime and 2 tbsp olive oil, and leave for 20 minutes. Thread onto 8 skewers. Dice 2 mangoes with half a red onion, a handful of coriander and the juice of another lime. Grill the skewers over high heat for 2 minutes a side until pink and charred. Serve with the salsa and lime wedges.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks mashed with mayo, mustard and chives, piped back in, a dusting of paprika on top.
Isla Sorna tostones with garlic lime mojo

Green plantain fried, smashed flat and fried again until crisp, salted and served with a sharp garlic, lime and coriander mojo. Peel 3 green plantains and cut into 3cm pieces. Fry in oil at 160C for 4 minutes until soft but pale, then drain and smash each flat with a heavy glass. Fry again at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then salt well. For the mojo, mix 3 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of 2 limes, 4 tbsp olive oil, chopped coriander and salt. Serve hot with the mojo for dipping.
M: Ellie's lemon and thyme roast chicken
Grant visiting Ellie and her family at home

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme until the skin crackles, with crisp roast potatoes, honey carrots and pan gravy. Stuff a 1.8kg chicken with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and thyme, rub with butter and salt, and roast at 200C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil alongside for 50 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with 1 tbsp honey for 35 minutes. Rest the chicken, then stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices with 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick.
the Costa Rican coast near Isla Sorna
Black beans and rice cooked together with onion, capsicum and coriander, served with fried eggs, plantain and salsa.
W: the giant birdcage full of pteranodons
Small meringue nests baked at 120C for 60 minutes, filled with cream and passionfruit, three berries in each like eggs.
K: Pineapple, orange and passionfruit juice topped with soda water and lots of ice in a big jug.
T: Some people never learn. Some people bring snacks.
D: Dr Grant is tricked into joining a rescue mission to the dinosaur island of Isla Sorna.
P: Serve the snacks when the satellite phone rings inside the spinosaurus.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
S: Liar's dice halloumi with chilli honey
the liar's dice game on the Dutchman

Halloumi cut into dice, fried golden and crisp, tipped out of a cup and drizzled with chilli honey, lemon and fresh thyme. Cut 2 x 180g blocks halloumi into 2cm cubes and pat dry. Toss in 2 tbsp plain flour. Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the cubes for 1 minute a side until golden all over. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes. Pile the halloumi into a cup, tip onto a board like a throw of dice, drizzle with the chilli honey, a squeeze of lemon and thyme leaves.
the island tribe who make Jack their chief
Pork and pineapple skewers glazed with honey, chilli and lime, grilled over coals until sticky and charred.
Tia Dalma's chicken and sausage gumbo
Tia Dalma's hut up the swamp river

Chicken and smoky sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum, celery and onion, ladled over rice with spring onion. Stir 80ml oil and 80g plain flour in a heavy pot over medium heat for 20 minutes until the roux is dark brown. Add 1 diced onion, 1 green capsicum and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Add 500g diced chicken thighs, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun spice and 1L chicken stock. Simmer for 45 minutes, adding 200g sliced okra for the last 15. Serve in cups over 300g cooked rice with sliced spring onion.
M: the Flying Dutchman and its sea-creature crew
Prawns, mussels, corn and potatoes boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, tipped onto paper with melted butter.
Tortuga jerk pork belly with rice and peas
recruiting a crew in the Tortuga tavern

Pork belly rubbed with jerk spice and lime, slow roasted until tender with blistered crackling, with coconut rice and peas. Score the skin of a 1.5kg pork belly, dry well and rub salt into the skin. Rub the meat side with 3 tbsp jerk seasoning and the juice of 1 lime. Roast at 160C for 2.5 hours, then at 240C for 25 minutes until the crackling blisters. Rest 10 minutes.
