Cook 300g rice with 400ml coconut milk, 200ml water, a drained can of kidney beans, 2 spring onions and 2 thyme sprigs, covered, for 18 minutes.
W: Dark chocolate ganache tart in a cocoa pastry shell, set overnight, with sea salt flakes on top.
K: the swamp shack up the river
Deep red Caribbean hibiscus drink brewed with ginger, cloves and orange peel, served over ice.
T: Bring a jar of dirt. And something to eat.
D: Jack Sparrow owes Davy Jones a soul and goes hunting for the chest that holds Jones's heart.
P: Serve the snacks when the crew sits down to play liar's dice on the Flying Dutchman.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
S: Pork and prawn dumplings steamed 8 minutes in bamboo baskets, with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.
Jack's honey and smoked salt peanuts
Jack and his single peanut in the Locker

Peanuts roasted with butter, honey and smoked salt at 180C for 10 minutes, cooled into crunchy clusters. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey and toss through 300g peanuts with a pinch of smoked salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180C for 10 minutes, stirring once. Cool until crunchy, then break into clusters. A snack fit for a captain in a strange place.
Locker crab and chive brioche toasts
the crabs carrying the Pearl across the sand

Sweet crab meat folded with lemon mayo and chives, piled on golden toasted brioche rounds with a dusting of paprika. Cut 16 rounds from 4 thick slices of brioche with a small cutter, brush with 30g melted butter and toast at 180C for 8 minutes. Drain 250g cooked crab meat well and mix with 3 tbsp mayo, the zest and a squeeze of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper. Pile onto the cooled toasts, dust with sweet paprika and add a few chive tips.
M: Crab cooked in a sticky sweet chilli tomato sauce with egg ribbons, eaten with bread to mop up.
Maelstrom snapper with lime caper butter
Will and Elizabeth marrying mid-battle in the maelstrom

Snapper fillets pan-fried with crisp skin, spooned with a foaming lime and caper butter, over coconut rice with a mango salad. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water, covered, for 15 minutes. Score the skin of 4 snapper fillets, season and fry skin side down in oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, flip and cook 1 minute more. Add 60g butter to the pan, let it foam, then add 1 tbsp capers and the juice of 1 lime. Toss 1 sliced mango with coriander and red onion. Spoon the butter over the fish.
W: the green flash at sunset as Will goes back to the sea
Coconut milk, sugar and pandan paste whisked with cornflour over low heat until thick, poured into glasses and chilled 3 hours, topped with toasted coconut and mango.
K: Gin shaken with cherry liqueur, pineapple, lime and a dash of grenadine and bitters, tall, pink and frothy over ice with a cherry. For each drink, shake 30ml gin, 15ml cherry liqueur, 90ml pineapple juice, 15ml lime juice, 10ml grenadine and a dash of bitters hard with ice until frothy. Strain into a tall glass filled with ice and top with a splash of soda water. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Make four, using 120ml gin and 60ml cherry liqueur in total.
T: Up is down. Dinner is now.
D: Will, Elizabeth and Barbossa sail to the end of the world to bring Jack back from Davy Jones's Locker.
P: Serve the snacks when the Brethren Court gathers at Shipwreck Cove.

title: National Treasure
S: the lemon juice and heat that reveal the hidden map
Chicken thigh pieces marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, served on toothpicks with lemon aioli.
the Silence Dogood letters that crack the cipher

Pretzels shaped into figure eights, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with yellow mustard. Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into figure eights, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.
the old ship buried in the Arctic ice

Creamy chowder of bacon, potato, onion and clams finished with cream and thyme, served in small cups with oyster crackers on top. Steam 1kg clams in 250ml water in a covered pot for 5 minutes until open, then pick out the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 150g diced bacon, add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften. Add 500g diced potatoes, the clam liquid and 500ml milk, and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream, the clams and thyme, and season. Serve in cups with oyster crackers.
M: the tower shadow that falls at 2:22

Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared with onions, provolone melted over, piled into long rolls. Freeze a 600g rib eye steak for 30 minutes, then shave it paper thin. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft, add the beef and sear fast on high heat. Lay provolone over the top to melt and pile into split long bread rolls.
Founding Fathers chicken and leek pot pie

Chicken, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce, baked under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttered peas on the side. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then remove. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 200g mushrooms in 40g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream. Simmer until thick, add thyme and the chicken, and season. Pour into a pie dish, top with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and cut a slit. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 400g buttered peas.
W: Philadelphia street treat while the clues come together

Sharp, smooth lemon water ice scraped into paper cups, the Philadelphia corner-stand favourite, with a few fresh raspberries on top. Boil 750ml water with 250g caster sugar until dissolved, then cool. Stir in 250ml lemon juice and the zest of 2 lemons. Pour into a shallow metal tray and freeze for 4 hours, scraping and stirring with a fork every 45 minutes so it stays smooth and fine. Blitz briefly in a food processor just before serving, scoop into cups and top with raspberries.
K: Invisible ink lemon, ginger and mint fizz
the lemon juice that reveals the map

Fresh lemon juice shaken with ginger syrup and mint, topped with soda over crushed ice, sharp enough to bring a map to light. Simmer 150g caster sugar, 150ml water and a 5cm piece of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. In a jug, muddle a big handful of mint with 200ml lemon juice and the ginger syrup. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the lemon mix and top with 800ml chilled soda water. Garnish with lemon wheels and mint sprigs.
T: Steal the Declaration. Then have lunch.
D: A treasure hunter finds a map on the back of the Declaration of Independence and has to steal it first.
P: Serve the snacks when Ben brushes lemon juice on the back of the Declaration.

title: The Lost City
S: Loretta's book tour in the sequinned jumpsuit
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, and thin prosciutto wrapped around wedges of rockmelon, laid out on trays for the launch crowd.
the jungle on the remote island

Mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit cut into cups, squeezed with lime and sprinkled with a chilli and sea salt dust. Peel and cut 2 mangoes, half a papaya and half a pineapple into long batons. Stand them up in 4 cups. Grind 1 tsp chilli flakes with 1 tsp sea salt and 1 tsp caster sugar. Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fruit, spoon the pulp of 2 passionfruit on top and sprinkle with the chilli salt just before serving.
Alan, the cover model with the flowing hair
Prawns dipped in egg and shredded coconut, fried at 180C until golden, with sweet chilli sauce.
M: the tropical island in the Atlantic
Snapper fillets rubbed with lime, garlic and chilli, grilled in banana leaves, with coconut rice and black beans.
Fairfax, the spoilt billionaire who kidnaps Loretta

Beef eye fillet roasted pink and sliced thick, with a rich tarragon béarnaise, crispy smashed potatoes and grilled asparagus. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat, drizzle with oil and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Sear a seasoned 1kg eye fillet and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then rest. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with a chopped eschalot to 1 tbsp. Whisk 3 egg yolks with the reduction over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in 180g melted butter and add chopped tarragon. Grill 2 bunches asparagus.
W: the crown of fire everyone is chasing
Ripe mango, lime juice and sugar syrup blended smooth, frozen in a tray and scraped every hour until set, scooped into glasses with passionfruit on top.
K: Coconut water, pineapple juice and lime over ice with mint.
T: Romance novel. Real jungle. Big lunch.
D: A romance writer is kidnapped by a billionaire who thinks she can find a lost treasure, and her cover model goes to rescue her.
P: Serve the snacks when Loretta and Alan finally get out of the jungle.

title: Iron Man 2
S: the strawberries Tony brings Pepper, the one thing she's allergic to
Sugared strawberries with softly whipped cream for dipping, a better peace offering than Tony managed.

Warm little buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, salmon roe and chives, passed round like trackside in Monaco. Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 200ml milk into a thick batter. Drop teaspoons into a buttered frying pan over medium heat and cook 1 minute a side until golden, making about 24. Cool slightly. Top each with a little crème fraîche from 150g, a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, a few salmon roe and snipped chives.
Beef and pork dumplings boiled until they float, tossed in butter and dill, with sour cream.
M: Tony's wild birthday party at the Malibu house

Rare roast beef eye fillet sliced thin onto soft brioche buns with hot horseradish cream, rocket and crispy fried shallots. Season an 800g eye fillet, sear all over and roast at 220C for 18 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and slice thinly. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Split and lightly toast 12 brioche slider buns. Spread with horseradish cream, layer on the beef and a handful of rocket, and finish with crispy fried shallots.
Tony building a new element in his lab
Salmon fillets glazed with miso and honey, roasted at 200C for 12 minutes, over rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger.
W: Tony sitting inside the giant doughnut sign
Yeasted doughnuts fried at 175C until golden, dipped in a glaze of icing sugar and milk, some with sprinkles.
K: the glowing arc reactor in his chest

Vodka and blue curaçao topped with lemonade and lime over crushed ice, glowing electric blue like the reactor in Tony's chest. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Into each pour 30ml vodka, 20ml blue curaçao and 10ml fresh lime juice, then top with about 150ml chilled lemonade and stir gently. Garnish with a lime wheel. For a booze-free version, swap the vodka and curaçao for 20ml blue cordial and extra lime.
T: Sitting in a giant doughnut. Eating one.
D: Tony Stark faces pressure to hand over his suit while a vengeful Russian engineer comes after him.
P: Serve dessert when Tony sits in the giant doughnut sign and Fury turns up.

title: Iron Man 3
S: Tony stranded in the snow in small-town Tennessee
Popcorn tossed with melted white chocolate and a pinch of salt, spread out to set and broken into clusters.
Harley's garage ham and cheese toasties
Harley helping Tony in his garage

Thick ham, sharp cheddar and a scrape of mustard toasted in buttered bread until crisp and oozing, cut into fingers for fixing the suit. Butter one side of 8 slices of white bread. Lay 4 slices butter side down and spread lightly with 2 tbsp mustard. Top with 200g sliced ham and 160g grated cheddar, then the remaining bread, butter side up. Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted. Cut each into 3 fingers and serve with pickles.
the cliff-top house in Malibu before the helicopters hit it
Big prawns butterflied, tossed with garlic, chilli, lemon zest and olive oil, grilled 2 minutes a side over high heat, piled on a platter with lemon aioli.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in buttermilk, fried crisp, brushed with a hot oil of cayenne, brown sugar and paprika, on white bread with pickles.
Christmas turkey roll with sage stuffing

Turkey breast rolled around sage, onion and bacon stuffing, roasted golden, with crisp roast potatoes, gravy and cranberry sauce. Mix 100g breadcrumbs, 1 softened onion, 2 chopped bacon rashers, 1 tbsp chopped sage and 1 egg. Butterfly a 1.2kg turkey breast, spread with the stuffing, roll and tie with string. Rub with butter and salt and roast at 180C for 90 minutes, resting 15 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potato chunks in oil for 50 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
W: the enormous stuffed bunny Tony gives Pepper
Vanilla sponge baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in white icing and shredded coconut, with marshmallow ears.
K: Harley's Tennessee town, snowed in at Christmas

Old-fashioned chocolate malted milkshakes blended thick enough to stand a straw in, topped with whipped cream and crushed malt balls. Blend 1L chocolate ice cream, 500ml cold milk and 6 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth, about 30 seconds. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks and spoon on top. Crush a handful of chocolate malt balls and scatter over, then serve straight away with wide straws and long spoons.
T: Christmas in Tennessee. Bring dinner.
D: Tony is pushed to the edge when a mysterious terrorist destroys his home and he has to fight back without his suits.
P: Serve the mains when Tony is stranded in the snow in Tennessee.

title: The Incredible Hulk
S: the hillside favela in Rio de Janeiro

Crisp blistered pastry pockets stuffed with spiced beef mince, olives and egg, fried hot and served with a squeeze of lime and hot sauce. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp paprika and salt, then stir in 50g chopped green olives and 2 chopped boiled eggs and cool. Cut 4 thawed puff or spring roll pastry sheets into 12cm squares. Put a spoonful of filling on each, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork. Fry in oil at 180C for 3 minutes until blistered. Serve with lime and hot sauce.
Bruce keeping his pulse down in Brazil

Tapioca flour, milk, oil, egg and parmesan mixed into a dough, rolled into balls and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed. Bring 250ml milk and 125ml oil to the boil and pour over 250g tapioca flour, mixing well. Cool slightly, then beat in 2 eggs and 100g grated parmesan to a sticky dough. Roll into balls and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
the green giant smashing everything in his way
Ripe avocados roughly smashed with lime juice, chopped coriander, finely diced red onion, green chilli and salt, left chunky, served with warm corn chips.
M: Bruce working his way through Brazil
Rump steak grilled over high heat, sliced with a toasted cassava flour farofa, black beans and a tomato vinaigrette.
Culver campus pepperoni and mushroom pizza
the pizzas Bruce uses to get past the guard at Culver

Thin crust blistered in a hot oven, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and garlic mushrooms, finished with chilli oil. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch thin. Spread each with 3 tbsp passata mixed with oregano and salt. Fry 200g sliced mushrooms in butter with 1 garlic clove. Top the bases with 400g grated mozzarella, 150g sliced pepperoni and the mushrooms. Bake on a hot tray at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered. Drizzle with chilli oil.
W: Bruce Banner hiding out in Brazil

Brazilian chocolate fudge balls of condensed milk, cocoa and butter, cooked thick, rolled by hand and coated in chocolate sprinkles. Put 395g condensed milk, 2 tbsp cocoa and 20g butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir constantly for about 10 minutes until it thickens and pulls away from the base in one mass. Tip onto a buttered plate and cool for 1 hour. With buttered hands, roll into 20 small balls, then roll in 100g chocolate sprinkles. Sit each in a small paper case.
K: Bruce cutting his finger on the bottling line

Lime muddled with sugar and cachaça over crushed ice, topped with ice-cold guaraná soda straight off the line, every bottle checked twice. For each drink, cut half a lime into wedges and muddle hard in a glass with 2 tsp caster sugar. Fill with crushed ice, add 45ml cachaça and stir well. Top with about 60ml cold guaraná soda and stir once more. Make four, using 180ml cachaça in total. For a booze-free version, skip the cachaça and fill up with more guaraná.
T: Stay calm. Have a snack.
D: Bruce Banner hides out in Brazil looking for a cure while the army hunts him down.
P: Serve the snacks when Bruce is working at the bottling plant in Rio.

title: Thor
S: Thor's first breakfast at the diner
Grated potato squeezed dry, fried in butter in small cakes until crisp, with sour cream and chives.
the small desert town in New Mexico

Melted cheddar and cream cheese stirred with roasted green chillies, tomato and onion, served bubbling hot with warm corn chips. Soften 1 diced onion in 20g butter, then add 2 chopped long green chillies and 1 diced tomato and cook 3 minutes. Lower the heat and stir in 250g cream cheese and 100ml milk until smooth, then add 250g grated cheddar a handful at a time until melted. Season with 1 tsp cumin and salt. Pour into a hot dish, top with coriander and serve with 300g corn chips.
Chicken wings roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a honey, garlic and thyme glaze.
M: Asgardian feast beef ribs with roast roots
the great hall feast in Asgard

Beef ribs rubbed with salt and pepper, cooked at 140C for 5 hours, with roasted root vegetables and crusty bread. Rub 2kg beef short ribs with salt and cracked pepper. Roast covered at 140C for 5 hours until tender. For the last hour, add chunks of carrot, parsnip and potato to the tray to roast in the juices. Serve on a big board with crusty bread.
Diner pancake, bacon and egg stack
the diner where Thor eats everything in sight

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with crisp bacon and fried eggs between the layers, with maple syrup poured over the lot. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 400ml buttermilk into a thick batter. Cook 12 pancakes in a buttered pan over medium heat, about 2 minutes a side. Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp and fry 4 eggs sunny side up. Stack 3 pancakes per plate with bacon between the layers and an egg on top, then pour over 125ml maple syrup.
W: Puente Antiguo churros with hot chocolate
the dusty little New Mexico town where Thor lands

Piped churros fried crisp, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with a thick, dark hot chocolate sauce for dunking. Boil 250ml water with 30g butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt, then beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes and beat in 1 egg. Pipe 10cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring smooth, for dipping.
K: Thor smashing the mug and asking for another

Strong chilled coffee poured over vanilla ice cream with a splash of milk, topped with whipped cream and grated chocolate. Brew 600ml strong coffee, stir in 2 tbsp brown sugar and chill for at least 1 hour. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream into each of 4 tall glasses, then pour over the coffee and 50ml cold milk each. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and grate over dark chocolate. Serve with a straw and a long spoon, and try not to smash the glass.
T: This drink. I like it. Another.
D: The god of thunder is stripped of his powers and dropped in a small New Mexico town.
P: Serve the drinks when Thor smashes his mug in the diner and asks for another.

title: Thor: The Dark World
S: Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in pork sausage meat with sage, crumbed and fried at 170C for 6 minutes, halved with English mustard.
Thor catching the Underground to Greenwich
Thick chips cooked twice, at 140C then 190C, served in paper with malt vinegar and plenty of salt.
Jane's awkward restaurant date before Thor turns up

Grilled ciabatta rubbed with garlic, piled with ripe tomato and basil, torn buffalo mozzarella, sea salt and a drizzle of good olive oil. Dice 500g ripe tomatoes and mix with a handful of torn basil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt, and leave 15 minutes. Slice 1 ciabatta into 12 pieces, brush with olive oil and grill or toast until charred at the edges. Rub each with a cut garlic clove. Pile on the tomato, tear over 2 balls of buffalo mozzarella and finish with sea salt and more oil.
M: Asgard honey and rosemary lamb shoulder
Frigga's home in the golden halls of Asgard

Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and honey, slow roasted until it pulls apart, with roasted root vegetables and the pan juices. Stab a 2kg lamb shoulder all over and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with 3 tbsp honey, olive oil and salt. Put in a roasting dish with 250ml water, cover with foil and roast at 150C for 5 hours. Add 1kg chopped carrots, parsnips and potatoes for the last 90 minutes, uncovering for the final 30. Pull the lamb apart and spoon over the juices.
Thor fighting through the streets of Greenwich
Beef chuck and ale pie filling simmered 3 hours, under a puff pastry lid baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with mash and green peas.
W: Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with vanilla custard and topped with blackberries glazed in blackberry jam.
K: Aether blood orange and cranberry spritz
the red Aether flowing into Jane

Vodka shaken with blood orange and cranberry juice and lime, topped with soda over ice, swirling deep red like the Aether. For each drink, shake 30ml vodka, 60ml blood orange juice, 60ml cranberry juice and 10ml lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a wine glass full of ice and top with 60ml soda water. Garnish with a blood orange wheel and a rosemary sprig. Make four, using 120ml vodka in total. Leave out the vodka for a booze-free version.
T: Hang your hammer on the hook. Dinner's up.
D: Thor teams up with his brother Loki to stop the Dark Elves from plunging the universe into darkness.
P: Serve the snacks when Thor hangs his hammer on the coat hook in Jane's flat.

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
S: the fishing village turned tourist town of New Asgard
Smoked trout and pickled herring on rye crispbread with crème fraîche, dill and thinly sliced red onion.
Omnipotence City feta and honey triangles
Zeus's golden city of the gods

Feta, spinach and mint wrapped in buttered filo triangles, baked golden and crackling, brushed with honey and scattered with sesame. Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g crumbled feta, 1 egg, chopped mint and pepper. Cut 8 filo sheets into 3 long strips each, brushing with 80g melted butter. Put a spoonful of filling at the end of each strip and fold into triangles. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 20 minutes until golden. Brush with 2 tbsp warm honey and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder, the screaming goats
Soft goat's cheese rolled into balls, coated in crushed pistachios and chives, served on crackers with a little fig jam on each.
M: life in New Asgard on the Norwegian coast

Salmon, white fish and prawns poached in a creamy broth with leek, carrot and dill, served with crusty bread and butter. Soften 1 sliced leek and 2 diced carrots in 30g butter for 5 minutes. Add 2 diced potatoes and 1L fish stock and simmer 12 minutes. Stir in 300ml cream, then add 300g salmon and 300g white fish in chunks and simmer gently for 4 minutes. Add 200g peeled prawns and cook 2 minutes more. Season, stir through chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with crusty bread.
Valkyrie ruling as king of New Asgard
Beef short ribs braised 4 hours in dark beer with onion and thyme until falling apart, over mashed potato.
W: Crisp layers of buttered filo and spiced walnuts and pistachios, baked golden and soaked in lemon honey syrup, cut into diamonds. Mix 300g chopped walnuts and pistachios with 1 tsp cinnamon. Layer 375g filo in a 20 x 30cm tin, brushing every sheet with 200g melted butter and scattering nuts every few sheets, ending with filo. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until golden. Boil 200g sugar, 150ml water, 100g honey and a squeeze of lemon for 5 minutes and pour over the hot baklava. Cool 4 hours before serving.
K: Korg telling the story by the fire

Pineapple and passionfruit juice with spiced rum, lime and ginger beer, poured into a big jug of ice with mint and pineapple wedges. In a big jug, mix 1L pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit, 200ml spiced rum and the juice of 2 limes. Chill until ready. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and 750ml ginger beer, and stir gently. Drop in pineapple wedges and mint sprigs. For a kids' jug, leave out the rum and add more ginger beer.
T: Screaming goats. Quiet dinner.
D: Thor teams up with Valkyrie, Korg and a newly powerful Jane to stop the god butcher Gorr.
P: Serve the snacks when the giant screaming goats pull the longship into the sky.

title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
S: a DC classic after the morning run
Smoked half-pork, half-beef sausages split and grilled, in buns with chilli, mustard and chopped onion.

Toasted mini bagels spread with lemon and dill cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, red onion, capers and cracked pepper. Split and toast 12 mini bagels until golden. Mix 200g cream cheese with the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp chopped dill and a pinch of salt. Spread thickly on each bagel half. Top with folds of smoked salmon from 200g, a few rings of thinly sliced red onion and 3 or 4 capers. Finish with cracked black pepper and a little more dill.
Sam's safe house pancakes and bacon
Sam letting Steve and Natasha lie low at his house

Small fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked with melting butter and maple syrup, with crisp streaky bacon on the side. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 30g melted butter into a thick batter. Fry 4 tbsp at a time in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, making about 16. Keep warm in a low oven. Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp. Stack the pancakes with a knob of butter and pour over maple syrup.
M: Thai food written on Steve's list of things he missed
Chicken thighs stir-fried with garlic, chilli, fish sauce and holy basil, served over jasmine rice with a fried egg.
Helicarrier beef and red wine stew
the S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarriers rising out of the Potomac

Beef chuck braised for hours in red wine and stock with carrots, onions and potatoes until spoon tender, served with crusty bread. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches in oil. Soften 2 diced onions and 2 garlic cloves, then add the beef, 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours. Add 3 chopped carrots and 500g potato chunks and cook 1 hour more. Season and serve with crusty bread.
W: Cherry and blueberry pie with a lattice top in red, white and blue, baked at 190C for 45 minutes.
K: Steve visits his own museum exhibit

An old soda fountain drink of homemade cherry syrup, lime and a dash of bitters, topped with fizzing soda over crushed ice. Simmer 300g frozen pitted cherries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 10 minutes, mash well, then strain and cool. For each drink, put 50ml cherry syrup, 15ml lime juice and a dash of bitters in a tall glass of crushed ice. Top with about 200ml soda water and stir once. Garnish with a cherry and a lime wedge.
T: On your left. Pass the noodles.
D: Steve Rogers uncovers a conspiracy inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and comes face to face with an old friend.
P: Serve the mains when Steve adds another item to his catch-up list.

title: Captain America: Civil War
S: the opening chase through the market in Lagos
Beef strips rubbed with ground peanuts, paprika, ginger and chilli, threaded onto skewers and grilled, with sliced onion and tomato.
the big airport fight in Germany
Bratwurst grilled until browned and sliced into rounds, smothered in a warm sauce of tomato, curry powder and smoked paprika, with a pile of hot fries.

Flaky puff pastry squares folded around sweet lemon cream cheese, baked golden, glazed with apricot jam and dusted with icing sugar. Beat 250g cream cheese with 60g caster sugar, 1 egg yolk, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 tsp vanilla. Cut 2 thawed puff pastry sheets into 9 squares each. Spoon filling into the middle and fold two opposite corners over to meet. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Brush with 3 tbsp warmed apricot jam, cool a little and dust with icing sugar.
M: Beef chuck browned with onions and lots of paprika, simmered 3 hours with tomato until thick, with buttered noodles and sour cream.
Tony visiting Peter at Aunt May's

Pork and beef meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered in a slow garlic tomato sauce, over spaghetti with more parmesan. Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g grated parmesan, 1 egg, chopped parsley and salt, and roll into 20 balls. Brown in olive oil and set aside. Soften 3 garlic cloves and 1 diced onion, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and basil, and simmer 20 minutes. Add the meatballs and simmer 20 minutes more. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and top with meatballs and parmesan.
W: the walnut date loaf May serves Tony
Dates soaked in hot water and bicarb, mixed with butter, brown sugar, egg, flour and walnuts, baked in a loaf tin at 175C for 50 minutes, sliced and buttered.
K: Team Cap and Team Iron Man fizz
Team Cap against Team Iron Man

Pick a side: a red cranberry, raspberry and lime fizz or a blue butterfly pea lemonade, served side by side over ice. Team Iron Man: muddle 125g raspberries with 2 tbsp sugar, add 400ml cranberry juice and the juice of 1 lime, strain and top 2 glasses of ice with it and soda water. Team Cap: steep 1 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 250ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain, chill and pour into 2 glasses of ice, then top with lemonade. Line them up and let everyone choose.
T: Pick a side. Pick a plate.
D: A new set of rules for superheroes splits the Avengers into two camps.
P: Serve dessert when Tony sits in Aunt May's kitchen with her walnut date loaf.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
S: the party at the tower where everyone tries to lift the hammer

Crisp garlic crostini topped with paper-thin seared beef, rocket, shaved parmesan, capers and a drizzle of lemon olive oil. Season a 400g eye fillet, sear hard on all sides for 3 minutes, then wrap tightly in cling film and freeze for 1 hour. Slice a baguette into 20 thin rounds, brush with olive oil and bake at 180C for 10 minutes, then rub with garlic. Slice the beef wafer thin. Top each crostini with rocket and beef, then shaved parmesan from 60g, a few capers, lemon juice and olive oil.
Chicken wings fried twice until crackly, tossed in a sticky sauce of gochujang, honey, garlic and soy, with sesame seeds.
Potato and cheese dumplings boiled, then fried in butter with onion until golden, served with sour cream.
M: Clint's secret family farm where the team hides out
Whole chickens roasted with lemon and thyme, with roast potatoes, carrots and a big bowl of gravy on the farmhouse table.
Johannesburg boerewors with pap and relish

Coriander-spiced beef sausage coils grilled over coals, with buttery maize meal pap and a warm tomato and onion relish. Grill 1kg thick beef sausages over medium coals for 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. For the relish, soften 2 sliced onions in oil, add 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp curry powder, 4 chopped tomatoes and 1 tbsp sugar, and simmer 15 minutes. Bring 1L salted water to the boil, whisk in 250g fine polenta and cook, stirring, for 10 minutes, then beat in 40g butter.
W: the city of Sokovia lifted into the sky
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream and berries, served on a raised cake stand.
K: Thor's Asgardian liquor that floors the old soldier at the party

Honey mead stirred with lemon, a cinnamon and clove honey syrup and ginger beer, served over ice with orange slices. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp water, 1 cinnamon stick and 3 cloves until the honey melts, then cool and strain. In a jug, mix 500ml chilled mead, the honey syrup and the juice of 1 lemon. Add plenty of ice and top with 500ml ginger beer. Pour into 4 glasses with orange slices. For a booze-free jug, use apple juice in place of the mead.
T: Lift the hammer. Then lift a fork.
D: Tony builds a peacekeeping AI that decides humanity is the problem.
P: Serve the snacks when everyone takes a turn trying to lift Thor's hammer at the party.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
S: the battle on the plains of Wakanda
Beef strips coated in ground peanuts, paprika, ginger and chilli, grilled on skewers, with sliced onion and tomato.
Bruce crashing through the roof of the Sanctum

Light choux pastry beaten with gruyère and mustard, piped into balls and baked until puffed, crisp outside and hollow and cheesy within. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
School bus ham and cheese pizza scrolls
Peter on the school bus over Queens

Soft scone dough spread with tomato paste, rolled with ham, cheddar and oregano, sliced and baked golden, easy to grab on the bus. Rub 60g butter into 400g self-raising flour, then mix in 250ml milk to a soft dough. Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 3 tbsp tomato paste, scatter with 150g chopped ham, 150g grated cheddar and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Lay in a lined tin, cut side up, and bake at 210C for 20 minutes until golden.
M: Thanos resting on his farm at the very end
A simple vegetable stew of pumpkin, chickpeas, tomato and spinach simmered with cumin, served with flatbread.
Wakandan chicken with jollof and plantain
Wakanda, where the heroes make their stand

Chicken thighs marinated in ginger, garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals, with smoky tomato jollof rice and fried sweet plantain. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 2 tbsp grated ginger, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the juice of 2 limes and oil for 1 hour. Fry 1 onion, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 400g crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp curry powder, then 300g rice and 500ml stock. Cover and cook gently 25 minutes. Grill the chicken 6 minutes a side. Fry 2 sliced ripe plantains in oil until caramelised.
W: Six jelly cups in six stone colours, each set around matching fruit, from raspberry red to blueberry blue, with vanilla cream on top. Make up 3 packets of jelly in red, orange and green as the packets say, then set three more colours, each 250ml liquid with 2 tsp gelatine dissolved in: apple juice for yellow, grape juice for purple and butterfly pea tea for blue. Pour each into a glass over matching fruit: raspberries, mango, green grapes, tinned pineapple, purple grapes and blueberries. Chill 4 hours. Top with 200ml cream whipped with vanilla.
K: Fresh pineapple blended with ginger and lime, strained and sweetened with honey, poured very cold over ice with mint and a pineapple wedge. Peel and chop 1 pineapple and blend with a 5cm knob of peeled ginger, the juice of 2 limes, 3 tbsp honey and 500ml cold water until smooth. Strain through a sieve, pressing on the pulp. Chill for 1 hour. Pour into 4 glasses of ice, top each with a splash of soda water and garnish with mint and a pineapple wedge.
T: Bring everyone. Bring everything.
D: The Avengers and the Guardians try to stop Thanos from collecting all six Infinity Stones.
P: Serve the mains when the Wakandan army lines up for the battle.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
S: Baby Groot dancing while the others fight the monster
Sweet potato cut into thin sticks, tossed in oil and paprika, baked at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.

Saffron risotto cooked and chilled, rolled around cubes of mozzarella, crumbed in egg and panko, fried at 180C until golden. Cook 300g arborio rice with stock and a pinch of saffron into a risotto, stir in parmesan and chill overnight. Roll into balls around small cubes of mozzarella. Coat in beaten egg and panko and fry at 180C until perfectly golden all over.
Contraxia mini beef and gravy pies
the Ravagers' snowy hangout on Contraxia

Little shortcrust pies packed with peppery minced beef in thick onion gravy, under golden puff lids, with tomato sauce for dunking. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 250ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and plenty of pepper. Simmer 20 minutes until thick and cool. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets to line a greased muffin tin, fill with the beef and top with rounds cut from 2 puff sheets. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
M: Ego's garden lemon chicken with farro

Chicken thighs roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs over a big herby farro salad with roast pumpkin, capsicum, feta and pomegranate. Toss 1kg chicken thighs with the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes alongside 500g pumpkin chunks and 1 sliced red capsicum. Simmer 250g farro in salted water for 25 minutes and drain. Toss the farro with the roast veg, parsley, mint, 100g feta, pomegranate seeds and lemon juice and olive oil. Serve the chicken on top.
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with dark beer, onion and smoked paprika until thick, served with crusty bread.
W: the Ravager ships lighting up the sky for Yondu

Vanilla ice cream in bowls, topped with popping candy and sparklers, served with chocolate sauce. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until smooth. Scoop vanilla ice cream into bowls and pour over the warm sauce. Scatter popping candy on top at the table so it crackles like fireworks.
K: Ego's garden pear and passionfruit cooler
Ego's planet looks like a giant garden

Pear nectar shaken with passionfruit pulp, lime and mint, poured over crushed ice and topped with sparkling water, sweet and floral. In a jug, mix 800ml pear nectar with the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 1 lime. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and stir them through, then chill for 30 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the nectar until three quarters full and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint sprigs and a thin pear slice.
T: I am Groot. I am hungry.
D: The Guardians meet Peter Quill's long-lost father, who turns out to be a living planet.
P: Serve the snacks when Baby Groot dances through the opening fight.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
S: Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, chilli oil to dip.

Sharp cheddar and butter crackers cut into little dog bone shapes, baked crisp and golden with a pinch of paprika. Pulse 200g grated vintage cheddar, 80g cold butter, 150g plain flour, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt in a food processor until crumbly, then add 2 tbsp cold water to bring it together. Chill for 30 minutes. Roll out 4mm thick and cut into dog bone shapes. Bake on lined trays at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp, then cool on the tray.
Rocket's smoky roasted chickpeas and nuts
Rocket and his friends Lylla, Teefs and Floor

Roasted chickpeas and peanuts tossed with smoked paprika and garlic, baked at 200C until crunchy. Drain and dry 2 cans of chickpeas. Toss with 150g peanuts, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt. Roast at 200C for 30 minutes, shaking the tray, until crunchy. Cool and pile into a bowl. Do not call them trash snacks.
M: the copy of Earth the High Evolutionary built

Smashed beef patties with melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato, pickles and burger sauce in toasted buns, with crisp oven fries. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Divide 600g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash each flat onto a very hot greased pan, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, top with a cheddar slice and cook 1 minute more. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce. Toast 4 buns, then stack 2 patties each with lettuce, tomato, pickles and sauce.
Orgocorp crackling pork belly with mash

Pork belly slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours, crackling blasted crisp, sliced over mash with apple sauce. Score a 1.5kg pork belly, rub with salt and dry overnight. Roast at 160C for 3 hours, then blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles. Simmer chopped apples with a little water into sauce. Slice the pork over buttery mash from 1kg potatoes.
W: Rocket taking over as captain of the Guardians

Chocolate cake baked at 175C for 35 minutes, covered in fudge icing and sprinkles, a little candle on top. Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, then 3 eggs. Fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 250ml milk. Bake at 175C for 35 minutes. Cover with fudge icing of butter, icing sugar and cocoa, then sprinkles and one little candle on top.
K: Kraglin learning to use Yondu's arrow

Dark rum poured over ginger beer and fresh lime with a dash of bitters, tall over ice with a fat wedge of lime. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze the juice of half a lime into each and add a dash of bitters. Pour in 150ml ginger beer, then gently float 45ml dark rum over the top of each so it clouds down through the glass. Garnish with a lime wedge and a piece of crystallised ginger. For a booze-free version, skip the rum and add more ginger beer.
T: One last ride. One last feast.
D: The Guardians race to save Rocket's life and face the scientist who made him.
P: Serve the mains when the Guardians land on Counter-Earth.

title: Doctor Strange
S: Chicken and spring onion dumplings with ginger and cumin, steamed 10 minutes, with a spicy tomato and sesame achar.
the city folding over itself in the mirror dimension
Puff pastry spread with pesto and parmesan, rolled, sliced into spirals and baked at 200C for 15 minutes.
Wong guarding the library at Kamar-Taj

Soft white bread layered with shredded roast chicken, herbed mayo, smashed avocado and cucumber, crusts off, cut into neat fingers. Shred 400g roast chicken meat. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with chopped chives, parsley, a squeeze of lemon and salt, then fold through the chicken. Smash 2 avocados with lemon juice and salt. Spread 6 slices of white bread with avocado, top with the chicken and thin cucumber slices, and close with 6 more slices. Trim the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers.
M: Red lentils simmered with turmeric, garlic and ginger, finished with a tempering of cumin seeds and ghee, with basmati rice and a spinach curry.
Strange's fancy life in New York before the crash

Thick rib eye seared hard and basted with garlic thyme butter, sliced with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and charred asparagus. Bake 1kg thinly sliced potatoes layered with 300ml cream, garlic and salt at 180C for 1 hour. Season 2 x 500g rib eyes and sear in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side. Add 60g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme, and spoon the foaming butter over for 2 minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Reduce 250ml red wine and 250ml stock in the pan by half. Grill 2 bunches asparagus.
W: the time loop Strange traps Dormammu in
Yeasted dough rolled with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, cut into spirals, baked at 190C for 22 minutes, glazed.
K: Black tea simmered with milk, ginger, cardamom and cinnamon, sweetened and strained into cups.
T: Dormammu, I've come to bargain. For seconds.
D: An arrogant surgeon loses the use of his hands and finds the mystic arts in Kathmandu.
P: Serve the snacks when Strange first arrives at Kamar-Taj.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
S: the academic decathlon trip to Washington

Popcorn coated in a crackly brown sugar and butter caramel with sea salt, tossed with pretzels and peanuts, packed in paper bags for the bus. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Melt 100g butter with 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup and boil 4 minutes, then take off the heat and stir in 1/2 tsp bicarb soda and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn, 100g pretzels and 100g peanuts, and stir to coat. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break up.
Cauliflower florets baked in light batter, tossed in buttery hot sauce and served with blue cheese dip.
M: Peter's order at Delmar's deli, pressed flat
Long rolls filled with salami, ham, provolone, pickles and mustard, pressed hard in a sandwich press until flat and crisp.
Staten Island Ferry chicken parm heroes
Peter trying to hold the split Staten Island Ferry together

Crumbed chicken schnitzels fried crisp, baked under tomato sauce and melted mozzarella, stuffed into long toasted rolls with basil. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound thin. Coat in flour, beaten egg and 150g panko mixed with 30g parmesan. Shallow fry in oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Lay on a tray, spoon over 250ml passata cooked with garlic and oregano, top with 200g grated mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Tuck into 4 toasted long rolls with basil leaves.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled and piped with swirls of red and blue buttercream, with a little web drawn in white icing.
K: study session snacks with Ned and MJ

Sweet brown sugar milk tea poured over chewy tapioca pearls and plenty of ice, shaken frothy and served with fat straws. Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the pack says, drain and soak in a syrup of 4 tbsp brown sugar and 3 tbsp hot water. Brew 4 strong black tea bags in 600ml boiling water for 5 minutes, then chill. Spoon the pearls and syrup into 4 tall glasses and add ice. Shake the tea with 400ml cold milk and 2 tbsp sugar until frothy and pour over. Serve with fat straws.
T: Number five. Smushed.
D: Peter Parker balances high school in Queens with trying to prove himself as Spider-Man.
P: Serve the mains when Peter orders his sandwich at Delmar's.

title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
S: Toasted baguette slices topped three ways: smoked cod whipped with olive oil and garlic, prosciutto with fresh fig, and marinated artichoke with parsley.
Prague trdelník with cinnamon walnut sugar
the night at the festival in Prague

Sweet yeast dough spiralled round foil-wrapped rolling pins, baked golden and rolled in cinnamon sugar and crushed walnuts, warm and chewy. Mix 300g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 150ml warm milk into a soft dough, knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Wrap 2 rolling pins in buttered foil. Roll the dough into long 1cm ropes and coil tightly around the pins. Brush with melted butter, roll in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon and 50g crushed walnuts, and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Slide off and cut into rings.
Peter and Happy in the tulip fields in the Netherlands
Thick fries cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with a big spoon of mayonnaise, the Dutch way.
M: the water monster rising out of the Venice canals

Garlic and chilli softened in olive oil, white wine added with prawns, mussels and clams, covered until the shells open, tossed through spaghetti with parsley. Soften crushed garlic and a pinch of chilli in olive oil. Add 250ml white wine, 300g green prawns, 500g mussels and 500g clams, cover and cook until the shells open. Toss through 500g cooked spaghetti with chopped parsley.
the final fight at Tower Bridge

Flathead fillets in a crisp lager batter fried golden, with thick double-cooked chips, minted mushy peas and tartare sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then drain. Whisk 200g self-raising flour with 300ml cold lager and salt. Dust 600g flathead fillets in flour, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Simmer 400g frozen peas for 4 minutes, mash with butter and mint. Serve with tartare and lemon.
W: Tony's glasses: Even Dead, I'm The Hero

Savoiardi dipped in espresso, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa on top. Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar until pale, then fold in 250g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip savoiardi briefly in cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Repeat, chill overnight and dust with cocoa.
K: Ned and Betty's peach bellini mocktail
Ned and Betty's whirlwind holiday romance

Fresh peach purée topped with sparkling apple juice, the alcohol-free take on Venice's own drink. Blend 4 ripe peaches, peeled and stoned, with 1 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon until smooth. Spoon 3 tbsp purée into each of 4 glasses and slowly top with 150ml chilled sparkling apple juice, stirring gently.
T: School trip to Europe. Bring an appetite.
D: Peter's class trip to Europe is hijacked by Nick Fury and a new hero called Mysterio.
P: Serve the snacks when the water monster rises out of the canals in Venice.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
S: Tomato and red lentil soup simmered with onion, garlic and cumin, blended smooth, served in mugs with grilled cheese fingers.

Thin, crackling Filipino spring rolls packed with pork, carrot and garlic, fried golden and served with sweet chilli and vinegar dipping sauces. Mix 400g pork mince with 1 grated carrot, 1 finely diced onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 egg, 1 tbsp soy sauce and pepper. Lay 20 spring roll wrappers out one at a time, put a thin line of filling along one edge, fold in the sides and roll tightly, sealing with water. Fry at 175C for 5 minutes until deep golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and vinegar mixed with garlic.
three Spider-Men together on the rooftop

Three smashed beef sliders each with melted cheddar, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft toasted buns, one for every Spider-Man. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Smash each flat on a very hot greased pan, season and cook 90 seconds, flip, top with a quarter slice of cheddar and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and chopped pickles. Toast 12 slider buns. Fill each with sauce, a patty, pickles and finely diced onion. Serve three per person.
M: Spaghetti and beef meatballs simmered in a slow tomato sauce, with garlic bread and parmesan.
the final battle at the Statue of Liberty

Grilled beef franks in toasted buns, smothered in beef chilli and melted cheddar, with diced onion, mustard and grilled corn on the side. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 400g crushed tomatoes and a drained can of kidney beans, and simmer 25 minutes. Grill 8 beef frankfurts for 6 minutes. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes and butter them. Toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over chilli, top with 150g grated cheddar, diced onion and mustard.
W: the coffee shop where MJ works at the end

Yeasted dough proved, cut into rounds, fried at 175C until golden, filled with thick vanilla custard and rolled in caster sugar. Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Cut rounds, prove 30 minutes and fry at 175C until golden. Pipe in 300ml thick custard and roll in 100g caster sugar.
K: MJ's coffee shop iced vanilla latte
Peter buying a coffee from MJ

Double shots of espresso poured over ice and cold milk with homemade vanilla syrup, topped with a thick, frothy cold foam. Simmer 100g caster sugar and 100ml water with 1 split vanilla pod for 3 minutes, then cool. Brew 8 shots of espresso, or 320ml very strong coffee, and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 2 tbsp vanilla syrup and 200ml cold milk to each, then pour over the coffee. Froth 150ml cold milk with 50ml cream until thick and spoon on top.
T: Everyone forgets. Nobody forgets dinner.
D: A spell to make the world forget Peter Parker goes wrong and brings villains from other worlds.
P: Serve dessert when Peter walks into the coffee shop where MJ works.

title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
S: the hidden underwater kingdom of Talokan
Diced prawns cured in lime juice for 20 minutes until opaque, tossed with red onion and coriander, piled onto small corn tostadas with smashed avocado.
the herb Shuri finally recreates in her lab

Green plantains sliced thin, fried at 180C until crisp, salted and served with a chilli peanut dip. Peel 3 green plantains and slice very thin. Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and golden, then salt well. Whisk 4 tbsp peanut butter with warm water, a pinch of chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime to a smooth dip and serve alongside.
Haiti accra taro fritters with pikliz

Grated taro mixed with garlic, chilli, spring onion and thyme, fried in spoonfuls until crisp, with a fiery pickled cabbage pikliz. A day ahead, pack a quarter of a shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot, half a sliced onion and 2 sliced chillies into a jar, cover with 300ml white vinegar and the juice of 1 lime. Grate 600g peeled taro and mix with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, 3 spring onions, thyme, 1 egg, 2 tbsp plain flour and salt. Fry spoonfuls at 175C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with the pikliz.
M: Namor's people and their Mayan roots
Pork shoulder marinated in achiote, orange and lime, wrapped in banana leaves and slow cooked at 150C for 4 hours, with tortillas and pickled red onion.
Queen Ramonda's jollof with grilled chicken

Smoky jollof rice cooked in a rich tomato, capsicum and chilli base with thyme, topped with charred spiced chicken thighs and fried onions. Blend 2 red capsicums, 400g canned tomatoes, 1 onion and 1 chilli. Fry 1 sliced onion in oil, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and the blend and cook 15 minutes until thick. Add 400g rinsed long grain rice, 500ml chicken stock, thyme, 1 tsp curry powder and salt, cover tightly and cook gently 30 minutes. Rub 1kg chicken thighs with paprika, garlic and oil and grill 6 minutes a side.
W: Namor, the feathered serpent god to his people

Silky baked coconut custard under a dark, glossy caramel, turned out and sliced, with toasted coconut flakes and lime zest on top. Melt 150g sugar in a pan until deep amber and pour into a 20cm round dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml coconut milk, 395g condensed milk and 1 tsp vanilla, then pour over the caramel. Sit the dish in a roasting tin of hot water and bake at 160C for 50 minutes until just set. Chill overnight, run a knife round the edge and turn out. Top with toasted coconut and lime zest.
K: Talokan coconut and lime agua fresca
the deep blue sea of Talokan

Coconut water and fresh coconut blended with lime and a little sugar, strained and served icy cold with mint and lime wheels. Blend 1L coconut water, 100g shredded fresh or desiccated coconut, the juice of 3 limes and 3 tbsp caster sugar until smooth. Strain through a fine sieve, pressing hard. Chill for 1 hour. Pour into 4 glasses filled with ice and garnish with lime wheels and mint sprigs.
T: Wakanda forever. Talokan too.
D: After the loss of their king, Wakanda faces a powerful hidden undersea nation.
P: Serve the snacks when Shuri first sees the underwater city of Talokan.

title: Captain Marvel
S: Video store brown butter parmesan popcorn
Carol crashing through the roof of a video store in 1995

Fresh popcorn tossed in nutty brown butter, finely grated parmesan and rosemary salt, piled into big tubs like the rental counter. Heat 3 tbsp oil and 120g popcorn kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows. Melt 80g butter in a small pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown. Blitz 1 tsp sea salt with 1 tsp rosemary leaves. Toss the popcorn with the brown butter, 40g finely grated parmesan and the rosemary salt. Serve in big tubs.
Goose the cat, who is really a flerken
Salmon cut into bite-sized pieces, dusted in flour, dipped in egg and panko, baked at 220C for 12 minutes until golden, with tartare sauce to dip.

Sweet crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, pan-fried crisp and golden, with a tangy caper remoulade. Mix 400g drained crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 egg, 60g panko and a pinch of cayenne. Shape into 8 small cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in oil and butter over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade, mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped pickles, 1 tsp mustard, paprika and lemon juice.
M: catching up with Maria and Monica at home
Chicken and smoked sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum, onion and celery, over rice.
W: Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a lemon curd of juice, zest, sugar, cornflour, yolks and butter, topped with meringue and browned at 200C for 6 minutes.
K: A nineties party classic blitzed into a slushie: peach schnapps, orange juice and frozen peaches, with a cherry on top. Blend 300g frozen peach slices, 500ml orange juice, 160ml peach schnapps, the juice of 1 lime and 2 cups of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 chilled glasses and top each with a maraschino cherry and an orange wheel. For a booze-free version, leave out the schnapps and add 150ml peach nectar.
T: Higher. Further. Faster. Snack.
D: A Kree warrior crashes into 1990s Earth and starts piecing together who she really is.
P: Serve the snacks when Carol crashes through the roof of the video store.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
S: the whole lab shrunk down and carried like luggage
Little puff pastry quiches of egg, ham and cheddar, baked in a mini muffin tray until puffed and golden.

One huge chocolate chip cookie baked in a pan at 180C for 20 minutes, cut into wedges at the table. Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, then beat in an egg. Mix in 200g flour and 150g dark chocolate chips. Press into a greased ovenproof pan and bake at 180C for 20 minutes until golden at the edges and soft in the centre. Cut into wedges.
racing round the steep streets of San Francisco

Flaky pastry cases filled with silky sweet egg custard and baked until just set and lightly caramelised on top, served warm. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets of puff pastry and press into a greased muffin tin. Whisk 3 eggs, 2 egg yolks, 80g caster sugar, 150ml milk, 100ml cream and 1 tsp vanilla, then strain. Pour into the cases until three quarters full. Bake at 220C for 15 to 18 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight wobble and spotted brown on top. Cool 10 minutes before serving.
M: Luis telling the whole story on truth serum
Chicken thighs marinated in chipotle and lime, grilled, in warm tortillas with pineapple salsa and crema.
House arrest salami and mushroom pizza
Scott stuck at home with his ankle monitor

Thin crisp bases with garlicky tomato sauce, mozzarella, hot salami, sliced mushrooms and olives, blistered in a hot oven, with chilli flakes. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch into thin rounds. Mix 250ml passata with 1 crushed garlic clove, oregano and salt and spread over the bases. Top with 400g grated mozzarella, 150g sliced hot salami, 150g sliced mushrooms and a handful of olives. Bake on hot trays at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered. Finish with chilli flakes and torn basil.
W: the strange colourful quantum realm Scott gets stuck in

Four jellies made one at a time and poured in thin layers into clear glasses, each set for an hour before the next goes on, topped with whipped cream. Make up raspberry jelly with half the water and pour a thin layer into clear glasses, then chill an hour. Repeat with lime, then blue, then orange jelly, letting each set before the next goes on. Top with whipped cream just before serving.
K: Scott's two years stuck at home

Frosty mugs of fizzing root beer poured over vanilla ice cream so it foams up high, with whipped cream and a cherry. Freeze 4 glass mugs for an hour. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream into each frozen mug. Tilt the mug and slowly pour in about 250ml cold root beer down the side, letting it foam up over the ice cream, then top up as the foam settles. Add a spoon of whipped cream and a cherry, and serve with a straw and a long spoon.
T: Shrink the snacks. Supersize the mains.
D: Scott Lang, stuck on house arrest, teams up with Hope and Hank to rescue Janet from the quantum realm.
P: Serve the snacks when Scott does magic tricks for Cassie under house arrest.

title: Black Widow
S: Fried yeasted dough rounds brushed with garlic butter, spread with sour cream and topped with grated cheese.
Yelena's vest and all its pockets

Almonds and cashews roasted in honey, chilli and sea salt until glassy, tossed with dried apricots and dark chocolate chunks, in little paper bags. Toss 200g almonds and 200g cashews with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp melted butter, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tsp sea salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until glossy and golden. Cool completely so they crisp up, then break apart. Mix with 100g chopped dried apricots and 100g dark chocolate chunks and portion into little paper bags.
Natasha hiding out in a caravan in Norway
Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with folds of smoked salmon, thin slices of cucumber, dill and a squeeze of lemon.
M: Melina's pet pig, named after her ex

Pork chops seared and roasted with apples and onions, with mashed potato and braised cabbage. Sear 4 pork chops until golden, then add sliced apples and onions to the pan and roast at 200C for 15 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter. Braise shredded cabbage in a little butter and water until soft. Serve it all on big plates.

Beef, beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato simmered in a deep red broth with dill, finished with sour cream and dark rye bread. Brown 600g diced beef chuck in oil, cover with 2L water and simmer 1 hour. Add 3 grated beetroots, 2 grated carrots, 1 diced onion and 2 diced potatoes and cook 20 minutes. Add a quarter of a shredded cabbage, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and simmer 15 minutes more. Season well, stir through chopped dill and serve with sour cream and rye bread.
W: the family's pretend life in suburban Ohio in 1995
Vanilla butter cake batter spooned into patty pans, baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled and piped with pastel buttercream and sprinkles.
K: Red Guardian's black tea with cherry jam
Alexei still bragging about fighting Captain America

Strong black tea brewed with lemon and a spoon of jam stirred in, served in glasses. Brew a strong pot of black tea with 4 tea bags and a litre of boiling water for 5 minutes. Pour into heatproof glasses and stir a spoon of strawberry jam into each. Add a slice of lemon and serve hot, family style.
T: Family dinner. Fake family. Real food.
D: Natasha reunites with the fake family she grew up with to bring down the Red Room.
P: Serve the mains when the whole fake family sits down to dinner at Melina's farm.

title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
S: Rice simmered slowly in chicken stock with ginger until creamy, topped with shredded chicken, spring onion, soy, sesame oil and fried shallots. Rinse 200g jasmine rice and put in a big pot with 2L chicken stock and a 5cm piece of sliced ginger. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently, stirring often, for 1 hour until thick and creamy. Poach 2 chicken breasts in the congee for the last 20 minutes, then shred. Ladle into bowls and top with the chicken, sliced spring onion, soy, a few drops of sesame oil and fried shallots.
the fight on the runaway bus in San Francisco

Pork scotch fillet roasted with hoisin and honey until sticky and charred, sliced into soft steamed bao with cucumber, spring onion and peanuts. Marinate 800g pork scotch fillet in 4 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 2 hours. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and charred at the edges. Rest and slice thinly. Steam 12 frozen bao buns for 8 minutes. Fill with pork, thin cucumber sticks, sliced spring onion and crushed peanuts.
the fight club up the side of a Macau tower

Pork and prawn dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed in bamboo baskets and served with chilli oil and black vinegar. Mix 300g pork mince with 200g finely chopped peeled prawns, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil and a pinch of white pepper. Put a heaped teaspoon on each of 30 round dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Steam in a paper-lined bamboo basket over boiling water for 8 minutes. Serve with chilli oil and black vinegar.
M: the hidden village of Ta Lo

Whole snapper steamed with ginger and spring onion, finished with hot oil and soy, with rice and stir-fried greens. Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and steam over sliced ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes. Top with fresh spring onion, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and bok choy.
Valet night beef and broccoli noodles
Shang-Chi and Katy parking cars for a living

Beef strips seared hot in a wok with garlic and broccoli, tossed with egg noodles and oyster sauce until glossy, served in takeaway boxes. Slice 500g rump thinly and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Soak 400g egg noodles as the pack says. Sear the beef in a very hot wok with oil in 2 batches and remove. Stir-fry 1 head broccoli in florets and 3 sliced garlic cloves for 2 minutes with a splash of water. Add the noodles, beef, 4 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy and toss until glossy.
W: the great protector dragon of Ta Lo
Mango purée warmed with sugar and gelatine, stirred into evaporated milk, set in glasses for 4 hours, topped with thin mango slices laid like scales.
K: Katy's brown sugar boba milk tea
Shang-Chi and Katy's laid-back life in San Francisco

Chewy tapioca pearls cooked in dark brown sugar syrup, swirled up the glass in tiger stripes, with cold milk tea and ice. Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the pack says and drain. Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 60ml water for 3 minutes, add the pearls and cook 2 minutes more until sticky. Brew 3 black tea bags in 300ml boiling water, then chill. Spoon the pearls and syrup into 4 glasses and swirl up the sides. Add ice, then 600ml cold milk mixed with the tea. Serve with fat straws.
T: Breakfast with Katy's family. Then the dragon.
D: A San Francisco valet is pulled back into the world of his father's secret organisation.
P: Serve the mains when Shang-Chi and Katy have breakfast with her family.

title: Eternals
S: Kingo's film set samosas with mint chutney
Kingo's career as a Bollywood star

Crisp pastry triangles stuffed with spiced potato, peas and garam masala, fried golden and served with a bright mint and coriander chutney. Boil 600g diced potatoes until tender. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds and 1 diced onion, add 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 chopped green chilli, the potatoes and 100g peas, mash roughly and cool. Cut 6 spring roll wrappers into strips, fill and fold into triangles, sealing with flour paste. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Blend mint, coriander, 1 green chilli, 150g yoghurt and lemon juice for the chutney.
the Eternals living in ancient Babylon
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil, sprinkled with za'atar and grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus scattered with pomegranate seeds.
Sersi working at the Natural History Museum in London
White bread spread with cream cheese and thin cucumber, and with egg mayonnaise and cress, crusts cut off and sliced into neat fingers.
M: Phastos at home with his husband and son in Chicago

Rare roast beef sliced paper thin, dunked in garlic and oregano beef juices, piled into soft rolls with spicy giardiniera pickles. Rub a 1kg beef topside with garlic, oregano, pepper and salt and roast at 220C for 15 minutes, then at 180C for 25 minutes until rare. Rest, chill for 1 hour and slice paper thin. Simmer 750ml beef stock with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano and 1 tsp chilli flakes for 10 minutes. Drop the beef into the hot stock for 1 minute, then pile into 4 soft long rolls with giardiniera and a spoon of juice.
Chicken thighs in a mole of dried chillies, chocolate, spices and nuts, simmered until rich, with rice and tortillas.
W: the Eternals' days in ancient Babylon

Crumbly honey and tahini halva swirled with chopped dates and pistachios, set firm and cut into small squares to share. Line a small loaf tin with baking paper. Put 300g tahini in a bowl with a pinch of salt and 1 tsp vanilla. Heat 200g honey in a small pan to 120C on a thermometer, then quickly pour onto the tahini and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until it thickens and starts to pull away. Fold in 100g chopped dates and 40g pistachios, press into the tin and chill overnight before cutting.
K: the Eternals living through thousands of years, starting in Babylon

Dates and honey blended with lemon and orange blossom water, strained and poured over ice with soda, mint and a pinch of cardamom. Soak 150g pitted dates in 300ml hot water for 15 minutes, then blend with 2 tbsp honey, the juice of 2 lemons, 1 tsp orange blossom water and a pinch of ground cardamom until smooth. Strain through a fine sieve and chill. Divide between 4 glasses of ice, top each with soda water and stir. Garnish with mint and a lemon slice.
T: Seven thousand years. Still time for dinner.
D: Immortal beings who have lived on Earth for thousands of years reunite to stop an ancient threat.
P: Serve the snacks when the Eternals track down Kingo on his film set.

title: Deadpool 2
S: Shredded beef braised with chipotle, rolled with cheddar in small flour tortillas, fried until crisp, with sour cream and salsa.
Spiced potato and pea filling folded in pastry triangles, fried until golden, with tamarind chutney.
the X-Force skydive that goes badly wrong

Popcorn tossed in melted butter with chilli flakes, lime zest and salt, a bit of heat and a lot of zing, poured into paper cones. Heat 3 tbsp oil and 120g popcorn kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows to a few seconds apart. Tip into a large bowl. Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1/2 tsp smoked paprika. Pour over the popcorn, add the zest of 2 limes and 1 tsp fine salt, and toss well. Squeeze over a little lime juice and serve in paper cones.
M: Ice Box beef and potato stew
the mutant prison called the Ice Box

Beef chuck braised slow with onion, carrot and potato in a thick peppery gravy, served in metal bowls with buttered crusty bread. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 diced onions, add the beef, 1L beef stock, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Add 3 chopped carrots and 600g potato chunks and simmer 1 hour more until thick. Season with plenty of pepper and serve with crusty bread and butter.

Steaks seared and butter basted, sliced with chips and a red wine sauce, candles on the table. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and roast until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest. Add 150ml red wine and 250ml beef stock to the pan and reduce until glossy. Slice and serve by candlelight.
W: Cream cheese, sugar and eggs beaten smooth over a biscuit base, baked at 160C for 50 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with a glossy raspberry coulis.
K: Cold brew coffee shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and a touch of sugar syrup until frothy, strained and topped with three coffee beans. Chill 4 martini glasses. For each drink, shake 60ml strong cold brew, 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 10ml sugar syrup very hard with plenty of ice for 15 seconds so it foams. Strain into the glass and float 3 coffee beans on top. Make four, using 160ml vodka and 80ml coffee liqueur in total. For a booze-free version, shake cold brew with milk and vanilla syrup.
T: Family-sized. Like the team.
D: Deadpool forms a team to protect a young mutant from a time-travelling soldier named Cable.
P: Serve the snacks when X-Force jumps out of the plane.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
S: Dogpool, the scruffy little Deadpool from the Void

Cocktail franks in soft mini buns smothered in beef chilli and melted cheddar, with mustard and crispy onions on top. Brown 250g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and 400g crushed tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Heat 16 cocktail frankfurts in simmering water for 5 minutes. Split 16 mini hot dog buns or soft dinner rolls and fill with the franks. Spoon over the chilli, top with 120g grated cheddar and grill for 2 minutes until melted. Finish with mustard and crispy fried onions.
Deadpool's favourite thing in any universe
Mini fried burritos filled with spiced beef, beans and cheese, with sour cream and salsa.
the dusty wasteland of the Void
Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C until crisp, tossed straight away with smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt.
M: Wade's birthday party with his friends

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow cooked until tender, glazed and charred on the grill, with buttered corn and slaw. Rub 2kg pork ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt. Wrap in foil and cook at 150C for 3 hours. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill over high heat for 5 minutes, turning, until sticky and charred. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with mayo and lemon.
the resistance hideout out in the Void
Beef and kidney bean chilli simmered with cumin and tomato, served with cheddar and corn chips.
W: Deadpool's red suit next to Wolverine's yellow one
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, half spooned over with raspberry sauce and half with mango purée, whipped cream piled on top.
K: Whisky over a big block of ice, topped with spicy ginger ale, fresh lime and a dash of bitters, rough edges and all. Put one large ice cube or a few big ones into each of 4 tall glasses. Pour in 45ml whisky, the juice of a quarter of a lime and a dash of bitters. Top slowly with about 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge. For non-drinkers, swap the whisky for cold strong tea with a squeeze of lime.
T: Two heroes. Twice the chimichangas.
D: Deadpool drags a reluctant Wolverine into a mission to save his world.
P: Serve the snacks when Deadpool finds Dogpool in the Void.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
S: Pentagon kitchen tomato soup and toasties
Quicksilver's slow-motion run around the Pentagon kitchen

Roasted tomato and garlic soup blended smooth with a swirl of cream, in mugs with crisp cheddar toastie fingers for dunking. Halve 1kg tomatoes, toss with 1 quartered onion, 4 garlic cloves and olive oil, and roast at 200C for 30 minutes. Blend with 500ml chicken stock, 1 tsp sugar and salt, then reheat and stir in 50ml cream. Make 4 cheddar toasties from 8 slices of buttered bread and 160g grated cheddar, cooking 3 minutes a side in a frying pan. Cut into fingers and serve with the soup.
Choux pastry with gruyère piped into small balls, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
Seventies walnut and cheddar cheese ball

Sharp cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion beaten together, rolled into a ball and coated in toasted walnuts and parsley, with crackers. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g finely grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely sliced spring onions, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and a pinch of cayenne. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 2 hours. Toast 80g walnuts in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Roll the ball in the nut mix to coat and serve with crackers.
M: Beef bourguignon of chuck, bacon, mushrooms and red wine simmered 3 hours, with buttery mash. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck and 150g bacon. Add 250g mushrooms and cook until golden, then pour in a bottle of red wine. Simmer for 3 hours until tender and glossy. Serve over mash from 1kg potatoes and plenty of butter.
White House lawn burgers and potato salad
the showdown on the White House lawn

Chargrilled beef burgers with cheddar, tomato and pickles in toasted buns, with a creamy mustard and spring onion potato salad. Boil 1kg halved baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and cool. Toss with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 3 sliced spring onions and salt. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and season. Grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute. Toast 4 buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickles, the patties and tomato sauce.
W: the 1970s, when fondue parties were everywhere
Dark chocolate melted gently with cream in a fondue pot, kept warm at the table, with strawberries, marshmallows and sponge cubes on forks to dip.
K: Tequila, blue curaçao and fresh lime shaken hard with ice and poured into salt-rimmed glasses, bright blue and sharp. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt. For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml blue curaçao, 25ml fresh lime juice and 10ml sugar syrup hard with ice for 10 seconds. Strain into the glass over fresh ice and garnish with a lime wheel. Make four, using 180ml tequila and 80ml blue curaçao in total.
T: Back to 1973. Back for seconds.
D: Wolverine is sent back to 1973 to stop a choice that dooms mutants in the future.
P: Serve the snacks when Quicksilver races around the Pentagon kitchen in slow motion.

title: X-Men: First Class
S: Charles trying his lines in an Oxford pub
A board of aged cheddar, sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney, apple wedges and thick slices of crusty bread with butter.
Erik's visit to the bar in Argentina

Golden baked pastry half-moons filled with cumin-spiced beef, onion, olives and egg, served with a sharp parsley and garlic chimichurri. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, then add 50g chopped green olives and 1 chopped boiled egg and cool. Cut 12 rounds from 3 shortcrust sheets, fill, fold and crimp the edges. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. For the chimichurri, mix a chopped bunch of parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil.
the standoff off the coast of Cuba
A thick béchamel of butter, flour and milk cooked with chopped ham, chilled overnight, shaped into logs, crumbed and fried until golden.
M: Sebastian Shaw's Hellfire Club in Las Vegas

Rib eye seared hard and butter basted, rested and sliced, with a creamy cracked peppercorn sauce and crispy roast potatoes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, shake to rough up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Season 2 x 500g rib eyes and sear in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side, basting with 40g butter for the last minute. Rest 5 minutes. In the same pan, add 1 tbsp crushed peppercorns and 60ml brandy, then 200ml cream and 100ml beef stock, and simmer until thick. Slice and spoon over.
training the young mutants at the Xavier mansion

Whole chicken roasted with lemon and thyme until golden, carved with a mustardy potato salad and buttered green beans for the team. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, salt and thyme, stuff with a halved lemon and roast at 200C for 75 minutes, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes, halve and toss warm with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, chives and a squeeze of lemon. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.
