Carve the chicken and pour over the pan juices.
W: Dark and white chocolate fudge set in a tray, cut into squares and arranged like a chess board.
K: the spy style of the early sixties

Gin stirred long and cold with a whisper of dry vermouth, strained into frozen glasses with a skewer of green olives. Put 4 martini glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Fill a jug with ice, add 240ml gin and 40ml dry vermouth, and stir steadily for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the frozen glasses. Add a toothpick with 2 green olives to each. Drink straight away while it is ice cold. For a booze-free version, stir chilled tonic with a splash of olive brine.
T: Groovy mutation. Groovy dinner.
D: A young Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr form the first team of mutants during the Cuban Missile Crisis.
P: Serve the snacks when Charles tries his lines on a girl in the Oxford pub.

title: Venom
S: Frozen potato gems baked at 220C for 20 minutes until crunchy, with a chilli and garlic mayo.
the black goo of the symbiote
Chicken pieces fried crisp, tossed in a sticky soy and honey glaze, coated in black sesame seeds.
M: Lobster tank garlic butter lobster tails
Eddie jumping into the restaurant's lobster tank

Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic and herb butter, grilled 6 minutes, with fries and lemon. Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and fry twice until crisp. Split 4 lobster tails, brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic and parsley, and grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Serve with the fries and lemon wedges. Tater tots optional.
Eddie and Venom starving at all hours

Double beef patties with melted cheddar, crisp bacon and pickles in toasted buns, with a pile of crunchy double-cooked fries. Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and cook at 140C for 6 minutes, then drain. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Shape 800g beef mince into 8 thin patties, season and grill 2 minutes a side, adding cheddar slices for the last minute. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes and salt. Toast 4 buns and stack 2 patties each with bacon, pickles, onion, mustard and tomato sauce.
W: Silky Hong Kong mango pudding set in glasses, with a pour of evaporated milk over the top and fresh mango cubes. Dissolve 3 tsp gelatine in 100ml hot water. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with 80g caster sugar until smooth, keeping a few cubes aside. Stir in the gelatine, then 200ml evaporated milk and 100ml cream. Pour into 4 glasses and chill for at least 4 hours until set. Just before serving, pour a little evaporated milk over each and top with mango cubes.
K: Strong black tea sweetened with condensed milk, chilled and poured over ice with a splash of milk.
T: We are Venom. We are hungry.
D: A disgraced reporter bonds with an alien symbiote that has a big appetite.
P: Serve the mains when Eddie climbs into the lobster tank at the restaurant.

title: Spider-Man 3
S: Harry and MJ making an omelette together
Small omelettes of eggs, cheese and chives baked in muffin tins at 180C for 15 minutes.
the Sandman rising out of the sand
Butter browned until nutty, cooled and mixed with flour and brown sugar, rolled into logs, coated in raw sugar, sliced and baked at 170C for 15 minutes.
Jazz club fig and goat's cheese bites
Peter's black suit dance at the jazz club

Fresh figs halved and topped with soft goat's cheese, honey, walnuts and thyme, flashed under the grill and laid out on black trays. Halve 8 ripe figs and lay cut side up on a tray. Top each with a teaspoon of soft goat's cheese from 150g and a walnut half. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and grill on high for 3 minutes until the cheese is warm and just colouring. Scatter with thyme leaves and cracked pepper and serve on a black tray with a few prosciutto ribbons alongside.
M: Peter planning to propose at the French restaurant

Coq au vin of chicken, bacon, mushrooms and red wine simmered 90 minutes, with buttery mash. Brown 1kg chicken thighs and 150g diced bacon. Add 250g mushrooms and cook until golden, then pour in 500ml red wine and enough water to cover. Simmer for 90 minutes until rich and glossy. Serve over mash from 1kg potatoes and plenty of butter.
Aunt May's lemon thyme roast chicken
Aunt May giving Peter advice at her kitchen table

Whole chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and thyme and roasted golden, with crispy roast potatoes and a rich gravy from the pan juices. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, the zest of 1 lemon, thyme and salt, put the lemon inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer, scraping the pan, until thick.
W: the ring at the French restaurant
Vanilla custard baked at 150C for 35 minutes in a water bath, chilled, sugar torched on top.
K: Fresh raspberry purée and a splash of lemon topped with chilled prosecco in tall flutes, with floating raspberries. Blend 150g raspberries with 2 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tbsp lemon juice, then push through a sieve. Spoon 1 tbsp purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Slowly top with chilled prosecco from a 750ml bottle, letting it fizz up and settle. Drop 2 raspberries into each glass. For a booze-free version, top with sparkling apple juice.
T: Black suit. Same appetite.
D: Peter's life falls apart as a black alien suit brings out his dark side and new villains appear.
P: Serve dessert when Peter takes MJ to the fancy French restaurant to propose.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
S: Aunt May asking Peter to pick up eggs on the way home
Eggs whisked with cheddar, spring onion and diced ham, poured into a muffin tin and baked at 180C for 15 minutes until puffed and set.
after-school snacks for a science kid

Golden puff pastry spirals rolled with pizza sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano, baked until crisp, with warm marinara for dipping. Spread 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry with 4 tbsp pizza sauce, leaving a 1cm border. Scatter with 100g sliced pepperoni, 150g grated mozzarella and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes, then cut into 2cm slices. Lay cut side up on lined trays, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden. Serve with 250ml warmed passata.
M: the dinner where Peter meets Gwen's dad

Beef brisket braised for hours in red wine and sweet onions until it slices like butter, with honey roast carrots and the braising gravy. Brown a 1.5kg brisket, then soften 3 sliced onions. Add 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock and 2 tbsp tomato paste and braise covered at 160C for 3.5 hours. Roast 6 carrots for the last 40 minutes and slice the meat across the grain.
dinner at home with Aunt May

Beef and pork meatloaf with onion and herbs, brushed with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, baked and sliced thick over buttery mash. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, parsley and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp mustard and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk. Slice the meatloaf thick over the mash.
W: Big soft cake-like vanilla cookies iced half in white lemon icing and half in glossy chocolate, the New York bakery classic. Beat 120g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 150ml milk and vanilla, then 300g self-raising flour. Spoon 12 rounds onto trays and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Ice half of each with white icing and half with icing mixed with 2 tbsp cocoa.
K: Gwen's dark hot chocolate with marshmallow

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with vanilla and a pinch of salt, whisked frothy and topped with toasted marshmallows. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Take off the heat and whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 1 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 mugs. Top each with 3 large marshmallows and toast them with a kitchen blowtorch or under a hot grill for 30 seconds.
T: Don't forget the eggs.
D: A teenage Peter Parker gets his powers and goes after a scientist who turns himself into a giant lizard.
P: Serve the mains when Peter sits down to dinner with Gwen's family.

title: Fantastic Four
S: Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery glaze of hot sauce, honey and butter, with a cooling sour cream dip.
A cob loaf sliced in a crosshatch, stuffed with mozzarella and garlic butter, baked at 180C for 20 minutes until the cheese stretches.
Invisible Woman clear lemon berry jelly

Crystal clear lemon and elderflower jelly set in shot glasses with fresh blueberries and raspberries hanging inside, almost invisible. Dissolve 4 tsp gelatine powder in 100ml hot water. Stir in 400ml lemonade that has gone flat, 2 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp elderflower cordial. Pour a little into 12 shot glasses and chill 30 minutes until just tacky. Add a few blueberries and raspberries from 250g, then top up with the rest of the jelly and chill 3 hours until set.
M: Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika, garlic and brown sugar, cooked at 140C for 5 hours until a dark crust forms, with corn and slaw.
the team's home in the Baxter Building

Salmon fillets roasted on lemon slices with dill butter, with crushed garlic baby potatoes and charred asparagus. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and lightly crush with 30g butter, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt. Lay 2 sliced lemons in a roasting dish and set 4 salmon fillets on top. Mix 40g soft butter with 2 tbsp chopped dill and dot over the fish. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Grill 2 bunches asparagus with olive oil for 4 minutes. Serve together with the pan juices.
W: the cosmic storm that hits the space station
Blueberries simmered with sugar into a sauce, spooned over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, topped with whipped cream and a sprinkle of popping candy.
K: breakfast at the Baxter Building lab

A thick, deep purple-blue smoothie of frozen blueberries, banana, Greek yoghurt and honey, topped with crunchy granola and fresh berries. Put 300g frozen blueberries, 2 bananas, 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk and 2 tbsp honey in a blender and blend for 1 minute until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 glasses. Top each with a spoon of granola and a few fresh blueberries, and serve straight away with wide straws.
T: It's clobbering time. Then dinner time.
D: Four astronauts gain strange powers after a cosmic storm and have to stop their former backer, Victor Von Doom.
P: Serve the snacks when the four save the day on the Brooklyn Bridge.

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
S: Sixties devilled eggs and cheese hedgehog

Devilled eggs with paprika, and cheese and pineapple on toothpicks stuck into a halved grapefruit, a proper sixties party spread. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, then pipe back and dust with paprika. Cube 200g cheddar and pineapple and thread onto toothpicks. Stick them into a halved grapefruit set cut side down, a proper sixties spread.

Cooked prawns on shredded iceberg in little glasses, under a pink cocktail sauce with a dusting of paprika and a lemon wedge. Peel 600g cooked prawns, keeping 8 whole for the tops, and chop the rest roughly. Mix 120g mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of Tabasco. Shred half an iceberg lettuce finely and divide between 8 small glasses. Spoon in the chopped prawns and the sauce, top each with a whole prawn, a dusting of paprika and a lemon wedge.
the Silver Surfer arriving on her board
Baby potatoes wrapped in foil with butter, garlic and rosemary, roasted at 200C for 40 minutes, opened at the table with sour cream.
M: Retro roast chicken with glazed carrots
the family dinners in the Baxter Building

Chicken roasted at 200C with lemon and thyme, with glazed carrots, mashed potato and peas, served on a big platter like a sixties ad. Rub a whole chicken with butter, lemon and thyme and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Glaze sliced carrots in butter and a little sugar. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and cook peas. Serve everything on one big platter like a sixties advertisement.

Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs under a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick with buttered green beans and mash. Mix 800g beef mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt, then press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp mustard and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with butter and milk. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.
W: A big ring of strawberry jelly set with sliced strawberries and grapes, turned out onto a plate with whipped cream.
K: the Fantasticar flying over the city
Orange juice blended with vanilla ice cream and milk, topped with cream, retro diner style.
T: Retro future. Fresh dinner.
D: In a retro-futuristic 1960s New York, the Fantastic Four face Galactus while Sue and Reed await their first child.
P: Serve the mains when the family sits down together at the Baxter Building.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
S: the Gotham football game where the field collapses
Soft pretzels boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with yellow mustard.
the masked ball where Bruce dances with Selina

Warm buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, lemon zest and dill, passed round on silver trays. Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 200ml milk into a thick batter. Drop teaspoons into a buttered pan over medium heat and cook 1 minute a side, making about 24. Cool slightly. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon. Top each blini with a little crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon from 200g and a sprig of dill.
Selina Kyle stealing the pearls from Wayne Manor
Bocconcini pearls marinated in olive oil, basil and chilli for an hour, threaded onto toothpicks with cherry tomatoes.
M: Parmesan beef meatballs simmered in garlicky tomato sauce, packed into toasted long rolls under melted provolone and fresh basil. Mix 500g beef mince, 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt, and roll into 16 meatballs. Brown in olive oil, then add 500ml passata, 2 more crushed garlic cloves and a few basil leaves, and simmer 20 minutes. Split and toast 4 long rolls. Fill each with 4 meatballs and sauce, lay over 8 slices of provolone and grill for 2 minutes until melted. Finish with fresh basil.
Gotham rib eye with creamed spinach
the rich of Gotham before Bane strikes

Rib eye seared hard and basted with garlic butter, with nutmeg creamed spinach and crispy smashed potatoes, steakhouse style. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat and roast in oil at 220C for 35 minutes. Season 2 x 500g rib eyes, sear 4 minutes a side in a very hot pan, then baste with 40g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 1 minute. Rest 10 minutes. Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze dry and chop, then simmer with 200ml cream, a pinch of nutmeg and 30g parmesan until thick.
W: Alfred at the café in Florence
A scoop of vanilla gelato in each glass with a hot shot of espresso poured over at the table.
K: Alfred's dream of seeing Bruce happy in Florence

Fresh espresso shaken hard with ice and a little sugar syrup until frothy, strained into chilled glasses with a twist of lemon peel. Brew 8 shots of espresso, or 320ml very strong coffee. Make a syrup by dissolving 2 tbsp caster sugar in 2 tbsp hot water. For each drink, add 2 shots of coffee and 2 tsp syrup to a shaker full of ice and shake very hard for 15 seconds until thick and foamy. Strain into a chilled martini or wine glass and twist a strip of lemon peel over the top.
T: The fire rises. So does dinner.
D: Eight years after he vanished, Batman comes back to face Bane, who has taken Gotham hostage.
P: Serve dessert when Alfred is sitting at the café in Florence.

title: Man of Steel
S: young Clark pushing the bus out of the river

Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg, spring onion and paprika, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with a sour cream and chive dip. Mix a drained can of corn with 100g flour, 2 eggs, sliced spring onions and a pinch of paprika. Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until golden on both sides. Stir chopped chives through sour cream for the dip and serve the fritters warm.
Clark working on the fishing boat
Flathead pieces dusted in flour and paprika, fried at 180C until crisp, with lemon and tartare sauce.
the roadside bar where Clark works for a while

Buttermilk chicken tenders fried crisp and tossed in buttery hot sauce, with celery sticks and a cool blue cheese dip. Soak 800g chicken tenderloins in 250ml buttermilk with salt for 1 hour. Toss in 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder, and fry at 180C for 5 minutes until golden. Melt 60g butter with 120ml hot sauce and toss the chicken through. Mix 80g crumbled blue cheese with 100g sour cream and 2 tbsp mayo. Serve with celery sticks.
M: Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, celery and stock, potatoes added for the last hour.
Lois Lane at the Daily Planet

Triple-decker toasted club of roast chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, tomato, lettuce and mayo, cut into triangles with a pickle and chips. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices of white bread. Slice 400g roast chicken breast, 2 tomatoes and 1 avocado. Spread 8 slices of toast with mayo. Build each sandwich: toast, lettuce, chicken and tomato, then toast, bacon and avocado, then a final slice. Hold with 4 toothpicks, cut into 4 triangles and serve with pickles and potato chips.
W: on Krypton the symbol means hope

Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, with ice cream and a pastry S. Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes and serve warm with ice cream.
K: a hot afternoon on the Kansas farm

Fresh lemon juice and strawberries muddled with basil and sugar syrup, topped with cold water in a big jug of ice. Simmer 150g caster sugar and 150ml water until dissolved, then cool. Blend 250g hulled strawberries with the syrup and strain. In a big jug, bruise a handful of basil leaves, then add the strawberry syrup, 200ml fresh lemon juice and 1L cold water. Stir, add lots of ice and sliced strawberries and lemons, and serve in tall glasses with a basil leaf on top.
T: Raised in Kansas. Fed in Kansas.
D: A young man raised on a Kansas farm learns he came from the dying planet Krypton.
P: Serve the mains when Clark comes home to Martha on the farm.

title: Wonder Woman 1984
S: Food court sausage rolls and potato skins

Mini hot dogs in pastry and cheese-topped potato skins, served together on a tray like the food court. Wrap 16 cocktail franks in strips of puff pastry and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Bake 6 small potatoes (about 800g) until soft, halve, scoop out a little and fill with cheddar and crisp bacon. Grill until bubbling and serve both with sour cream.
the island of Themyscira and its games
Green and black olives marinated with feta, lemon peel, oregano and olive oil, served with warm pita.
the car chase across the Egyptian desert

Herby falafel of soaked chickpeas, onion, garlic and cumin, fried crisp and green inside, with lemony tahini sauce and pickles. Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight and drain well. Blitz with 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch of parsley, a bunch of coriander, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp bicarb soda until fine but not a paste. Shape into 20 balls and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until dark golden. Whisk 100g tahini with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and about 80ml water. Serve with pickles and pita.
M: the two of them out for dinner and drinks

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach, ricotta and parmesan, seared and roasted, with a lemon butter sauce and herby rice pilaf. Mix 200g ricotta, 100g chopped wilted spinach, 30g parmesan and lemon zest. Cut a pocket in 4 chicken breasts, fill and close with toothpicks. Sear for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 300g rice with 1 diced onion and 600ml stock, covered, for 15 minutes, then stir in parsley. Add 100ml white wine, the juice of 1 lemon and 40g butter to the chicken pan and bubble until glossy.
Fourth of July sticky pork ribs

Pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, potato salad and corn on the cob for a holiday picnic. Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with salt and bake covered at 150C for 2.5 hours. Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Boil 1kg potatoes, cool and dress with mayonnaise and spring onion. Grill 4 corn cobs and serve it all picnic style.
W: Big soft cinnamon scrolls baked golden and dripping with tangy cream cheese icing, straight from the 1984 mall food court. Roll 500g sweet bread dough into a rectangle, spread with 80g soft butter mixed with 100g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon, roll up and cut 8 scrolls. Prove 30 minutes and bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with 120g icing sugar.
K: the wishing stone that grants everyone's wish

Sparkling wine or sparkling grape juice with a sugar cube and a dash of orange bitters. Drop a sugar cube into each flute and add a dash of orange bitters. Pour sparkling wine for the grown-ups or sparkling grape juice for everyone else, so the bubbles stream up from the cube. Be careful what you wish for.
T: 1984. Big hair. Big dinner.
D: Diana's quiet life in 1984 Washington is upended by a wishing stone and a man who wants everything.
P: Serve the mains when Diana and Barbara go out to dinner together.

title: Aquaman
S: Mera eating a rose in the Sicilian town

Golden saffron risotto balls with molten mozzarella centres, crumbed and fried crisp, on a plate scattered with edible rose petals. Cook 300g arborio rice into a risotto with 1 diced onion, a pinch of saffron and 1L stock, stir in 40g parmesan and chill overnight. Shape into 16 balls around cubes of mozzarella from 125g. Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko crumbs. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Serve with lemon wedges and scatter the plate with edible rose petals.
Arthur and his dad Tom at the lighthouse in Maine
Cod pieces dipped in a lager batter and fried at 180C until crisp, with lemon and tartare sauce.
Arthur drinking with his dad in the biker bar
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, with a blue cheese dip.
M: Prawns, mussels, scallops and white fish roasted with garlic butter and lemon at 220C for 10 minutes, piled onto a big platter with crusty bread.
Arthur growing up on the Maine coast

Sweet chunks of lobster tossed with lemon mayo, celery and chives, piled high into butter-toasted rolls with a pinch of paprika. Chop the meat from 4 cooked lobster tails, about 500g, into chunks. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with the zest and juice of half a lemon, 1 finely diced celery stick, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper, and fold through the lobster. Split 4 soft hot dog rolls on top, brush the sides with 40g melted butter and toast in a frying pan until golden. Fill with the lobster and dust with paprika.
W: Sweet pastry shell filled with salted caramel, topped with dark chocolate ganache and sea salt flakes, set overnight.
K: White rum, blue curaçao, pineapple juice and coconut cream shaken frothy and poured over crushed ice, glowing ocean blue. For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 20ml blue curaçao, 90ml pineapple juice and 30ml coconut cream hard with ice until frothy. Strain into a tall glass full of crushed ice. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Make four, using 120ml rum and 80ml blue curaçao in total. For a booze-free version, swap the spirits for 15ml blue cordial and a squeeze of lime.
T: Permission to come aboard. With snacks.
D: The half-human heir to Atlantis has to claim his throne before his brother starts a war with the surface.
P: Serve the snacks when Mera bites into a rose in the Sicilian village.

title: Shazam!
S: Billy's new foster home in Philadelphia
Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared with onions, provolone melted over the top, piled onto toasted mini rolls.
Freddy's the brains of the operation
Crisp potato gems baked hot and tossed with garlic salt and parmesan, with tomato sauce.
the fight at the Christmas carnival

Little yeasted ring doughnuts fried golden and fluffy, rolled hot in cinnamon sugar and served in paper bags with warm chocolate sauce. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 200ml warm milk into a soft dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll out 1cm thick and cut 20 small rings. Prove 20 minutes, then fry at 175C for 1 minute a side until golden. Toss hot in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Melt 100g chocolate with 100ml cream for dipping.
M: Saffron yellow rice baked in one big pot with browned chicken thighs, capsicum, peas and green olives, finished with lime and coriander. Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften 1 onion and 1 red capsicum. Add 300g rice, a pinch of saffron, 1 tsp paprika and 750ml stock and nestle in the chicken. Cover and bake at 180C for 35 minutes, then stir through 100g peas and olives.
Freddy filming Billy testing out his powers

Thin pizza bases spread with tomato sauce, loaded with mozzarella and pepperoni, baked blistered and crisp, with chilli flakes and parmesan. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch into thin rounds. Mix 250ml passata with 1 tsp dried oregano, a pinch of sugar and salt and spread over the bases. Top with 400g grated mozzarella and 200g sliced pepperoni. Bake on hot trays at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered and bubbling. Finish with grated parmesan and chilli flakes for whoever wants them.
W: the Rock of Eternity where Billy meets the wizard
Dark chocolate rocky road with marshmallows, roasted almonds and broken biscuits, set and cut into chunks.
K: Rich, creamy eggnog cooked into a light custard with cinnamon and vanilla, chilled and topped with whipped cream and fresh nutmeg. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 80g caster sugar until pale. Heat 600ml milk and 200ml cream with 1 cinnamon stick and 1 tsp vanilla until steaming, then whisk slowly into the yolks. Return to the pan and stir over low heat for 5 minutes until it coats a spoon, without boiling. Strain, chill for 3 hours, then pour into 4 glasses, top with whipped cream and grate over nutmeg.
T: Say the word. Pass the plate.
D: A foster kid in Philadelphia can turn into a grown-up superhero just by saying one word.
P: Serve the mains when the Vasquez foster family sits down to dinner together.

title: Joker
S: Arthur and his mum watching the talk show every night

Fresh popcorn coated in a glassy brown sugar and butter caramel with sea salt, baked crisp and poured into one big bowl for the couch. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Melt 100g butter with 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup and boil for 4 minutes. Take off the heat, stir in 1/2 tsp bicarb soda and 1 tsp sea salt, then pour over the popcorn and stir to coat. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break up.
Arthur's job as a party clown

Bite-sized balls of sharp cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion, rolled in smoked paprika and parsley, with crackers and red pepper jelly. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g finely grated vintage cheddar, 2 sliced spring onions and a pinch of cayenne. Chill for 1 hour until firm. Roll into 20 small balls. Roll half in 2 tbsp smoked paprika and half in finely chopped parsley. Chill until serving and set out with crackers and a small bowl of red pepper jelly.
Cucumbers pickled overnight with dill, garlic, vinegar and salt, served in a jar with rye crackers.
M: Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and peas.
Green room roast beef on rye
the talk show where Arthur is finally invited

Rare roast beef piled on rye with horseradish cream, pickles and crisp lettuce, cut in halves and stacked on a backstage platter. Season a 800g beef topside, sear all over and roast at 200C for 30 minutes for rare. Rest, cool and slice thinly. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Spread 8 slices of rye with the horseradish cream, then layer 4 with beef, sliced dill pickles and lettuce. Top with the other slices, cut in half and stack on a platter.
W: Arthur's life as a party clown

Crisp green apples dipped in a glassy, blood red toffee that cracks when you bite it, set on sticks like a party table. Wash and dry 6 green apples well, remove the stalks and push in wooden sticks. Heat 400g caster sugar, 125ml water and 1 tbsp white vinegar over medium heat until dissolved, then boil without stirring until it reaches 150C on a thermometer. Add a few drops of red food colouring and swirl. Tilt the pan and dip each apple, twisting to coat, then stand on baking paper to set for 15 minutes.
K: Bourbon stirred long with sweet vermouth and bitters until ice cold, strained into chilled glasses with a dark cherry and orange twist. Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer. Fill a jug with ice and add 240ml bourbon, 80ml sweet vermouth and 4 dashes of bitters. Stir steadily for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the chilled glasses, drop a cocktail cherry into each and twist a strip of orange peel over the top. For a booze-free version, mix cold black tea, cherry juice and a dash of orange.
T: Put on a happy face. Pass the bowl.
D: A struggling party clown in 1981 Gotham slowly comes apart.
P: Serve the snacks when Arthur and his mum settle in front of the late-night talk show.

title: The Batman
S: Iceberg Lounge salmon rye and spiced olives

Smoked salmon on rye with crème fraîche, and spicy marinated olives with orange peel, served on black slate. Cut 4 slices rye into small squares and spread with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon. Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and a pinch of chilli flakes for 3 minutes, then serve both on a dark board.
Pretzel dough shaped into question marks, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.
Selina Kyle and the cats in her apartment

Tuna, mashed potato, spring onion and lemon shaped into little cakes, crumbed in panko and fried crisp, with sriracha mayo. Boil 500g potatoes until tender, mash and cool. Mix with 2 x 185g cans drained tuna, 3 sliced spring onions, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Shape into 12 small cakes, then dip in flour, beaten egg and 120g panko. Shallow fry in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp sriracha for dipping.
M: Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with stout, onion and thyme, served over buttery mash.
Alfred keeping Bruce going in the old Wayne Tower

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs until golden, with crisp roast potatoes and a pan gravy, the meal Alfred puts in front of Bruce. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, salt, thyme and rosemary, put a halved lemon and 4 garlic cloves inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick.
W: the sea wall breaking and flooding Gotham
Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, whisked with yolks and sugar, set in small glasses for 4 hours, topped with whipped cream and crushed honeycomb.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken hard with ice for a thick, frothy top, with three coffee beans floating on it. Brew 4 shots of espresso, or 160ml very strong coffee, and cool. Chill 4 martini glasses. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur, 40ml coffee and 10ml sugar syrup very hard with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into a glass and float 3 coffee beans on top. For anyone not drinking, shake the coffee with milk, ice and a little vanilla syrup.
T: Vengeance in the rain. Stew by the fire.
D: In his second year as Batman, Bruce follows a serial killer's riddles into Gotham's corruption.
P: Serve the snacks when Batman and Gordon walk into the Iceberg Lounge.

title: Superman
S: Krypto's pork and sage sausage rolls

Pork mince, onion and sage wrapped in buttery puff pastry, baked golden and flaky, cut into bites with tomato relish for dipping. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Halve 2 puff pastry sheets, lay a line of filling along each strip and roll up, seam down. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into 4cm bites. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with tomato relish.
Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese and topped with smoked salmon, capers and red onion.
Fortress crystal prawn rice paper rolls

See-through rice paper rolls packed with prawns, vermicelli, crisp cucumber, mint and coriander, served chilled with a sweet chilli lime dip. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and cool. Halve 300g cooked peeled prawns lengthways. Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds and lay flat. Add prawns, noodles, cucumber sticks, mint and coriander, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Repeat to make 12. Mix 4 tbsp sweet chilli sauce with the juice of 1 lime and 1 tsp fish sauce for dipping.
M: Clark going home to his parents in Smallville

Beef chuck pot roast braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrots and potatoes, gravy from the pot. Brown a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 500ml beef stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Thicken the juices into gravy and serve family style.

Spiced chicken thighs chargrilled and sliced into warm flatbread with tomato, lettuce, pickles and a punchy garlic sauce. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 3 tbsp yoghurt, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and 1/2 tsp cinnamon for 1 hour. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side and slice. Mix 150g Greek yoghurt with 2 crushed garlic cloves, lemon juice and salt. Warm 4 flatbreads, spread with garlic sauce and fill with chicken, lettuce, tomato and pickles. Roll tightly in paper.
W: Buttery shortcake scones baked at 220C for 15 minutes, split and filled with whipped cream and strawberries macerated in sugar for half an hour.
K: Cold farm milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, honey and malt powder, topped with whipped cream and a drizzle of honey. Put 800ml cold milk, 6 scoops of vanilla ice cream, 3 tbsp honey, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla in a blender and blend for 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Top each with a spoon of whipped cream and a thin drizzle of honey, and serve with straws.
T: Look up. Then dig in.
D: Superman tries to do good in a world that doesn't trust him, while Lex Luthor plots to bring him down.
P: Serve the snacks when Krypto comes bounding in.

title: Batman Forever
S: the circus where the Flying Graysons perform

Popcorn tossed with melted butter and a little caramel, poured into red and white striped cones. Pop 100g popping corn in a large lidded pot. Melt 50g butter with 50g brown sugar until bubbling and toss through the popcorn with a pinch of sea salt flakes. Spread out to cool for 5 minutes, then pour into red and white striped paper cones.

Two sliders per plate: a beef and cheddar slider with pickles, and a crumbed chicken slider with slaw, decided by a coin toss. Shape 400g beef mince into 4 small patties and grill 2 minutes a side, adding cheddar for the last minute. Cut 2 chicken breasts into 4 flat pieces, coat in flour, egg and panko, and shallow fry 3 minutes a side. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon. Toast 8 slider buns. Fill 4 with beef, pickles and tomato sauce, and 4 with chicken and slaw.

Soft chewy pretzels twisted into question marks, dipped in a bicarb bath, salted and baked brown, with hot English mustard. Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and shape each into a question mark, with a small ball of dough for the dot. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each piece for 30 seconds. Lay on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. Serve warm with English mustard.
M: Wayne Manor eye fillet with red wine jus

Beef eye fillet seared and roasted pink, with a glossy red wine jus, creamy potato gratin and grilled asparagus. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, 2 garlic cloves and salt, and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over and roast at 200C for 20 minutes for medium-rare, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 250ml red wine and 250ml beef stock in the pan until reduced by half and whisk in 30g butter. Grill 2 bunches asparagus.
Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and a sticky sweet chilli sauce, served in takeaway boxes.
W: the trapeze act at the circus
Batter piped in swirls into hot oil, fried golden, dusted with icing sugar and served with berries.
K: Lime cordial and lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top. Pour a splash of lime cordial into each tall glass and top up with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and fizzes up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before the foam spills over.
T: Riddle me this. What's for dinner.
D: Batman takes on the Riddler and Two-Face while taking in a young circus acrobat named Dick Grayson.
P: Serve the snacks when the Flying Graysons take to the trapeze at the circus.

title: Batman & Robin
S: Mr Freeze turning everything to ice
Poached prawns served on a bed of crushed ice with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, lemon and a dash of hot sauce.
Baby leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and herbs in lettuce cups with a lemon and honey dressing and crumbled feta.
the diamond auction at the Gotham botanical gardens

Crisp little pastry cases filled with crab, lemon mayo and chives, topped with avocado and a sparkle of salmon roe. Cut 24 rounds from 2 sheets of shortcrust pastry, press into mini muffin tins, prick and bake at 190C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool. Mix 250g drained crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, the zest and a squeeze of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped chives and salt. Dice 1 avocado with lemon juice. Fill each case with crab, a little avocado and a few salmon roe.
M: thawing out after Gotham freezes over

Beef chuck slow cooked with kidney beans, chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, with sour cream, cheddar and warm cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 500ml beef stock and the beef. Cover and simmer 2.5 hours, adding 2 drained cans kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 200g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 300ml milk and 80g melted butter and bake at 200C for 22 minutes.
looking after Alfred when he falls ill
Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery, onion and noodles until tender, finished with parsley and lemon.
W: Mr Freeze turning the city to ice
Layers of vanilla and mint ice cream on a chocolate biscuit base, frozen overnight, topped with crushed meringue like snow.
K: Frozen lemonade blitzed into an icy slush with butterfly pea tea for an icy blue glow, with a squeeze of lime to finish. Steep 1 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 250ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain and stir in 3 tbsp sugar, then chill. Pour 750ml lemonade into an ice cube tray and freeze overnight. Blend the lemonade cubes with the blue tea and 2 cups of ice until slushy. Spoon into 4 glasses and serve with spoon straws and lime wedges.
T: Ice to see you. Chilli to eat.
D: Batman, Robin and Batgirl take on Mr Freeze and Poison Ivy, who plan to freeze Gotham.
P: Serve dessert when Mr Freeze freezes the charity auction.

title: Hellboy
S: young Hellboy and his love of pancakes

Small fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with melting butter and maple syrup, with crisp bacon rashers alongside. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 30g melted butter into a thick batter. Fry 3 tbsp at a time in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, making about 16. Keep warm in a low oven. Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp. Stack the pancakes with butter, pour over maple syrup and serve the bacon on the side.
Abe Sapien and his love of eggs
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks mashed with mayo, mustard and dill, piped back in with a pinch of paprika.
the red-skinned agent of the bureau
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery red chilli and honey glaze.
M: the hunt in a Moscow cemetery
Beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato simmered in beef stock with dill, served with sour cream and rye bread.
the agents of the Bureau for Paranormal Research

Grilled beef franks in soft buns under thick beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar, diced onion and a stripe of mustard. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 400g crushed tomatoes and a drained can of kidney beans, and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Grill 8 beef frankfurts for 6 minutes. Toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over the chilli and top with 150g grated cheddar, diced onion and mustard.
W: Rooftop brown butter choc chip cookies
Hellboy and the kid on the rooftop

Big chewy cookies made with nutty brown butter, chunks of dark chocolate and sea salt flakes, served warm off the tray. Melt 150g butter and cook until golden brown and nutty, then cool 10 minutes. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 80g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 250g plain flour and 1/2 tsp bicarb soda, then 200g chopped dark chocolate. Chill 30 minutes. Roll into 16 balls, bake at 180C for 10 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle, and sprinkle with sea salt.
K: the cold milk Hellboy shares with the kid on the rooftop

Ice-cold milk blended with fresh strawberries, malt powder and a scoop of vanilla ice cream, frothy and pink, made for dunking cookies. Hull 250g strawberries and put in a blender with 800ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp honey and 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream. Blend for 30 seconds until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses and top each with a halved strawberry. Serve straight away alongside the warm cookies.
T: Pancakes first. Then the end of the world.
D: A demon raised by humans works for a secret bureau fighting the supernatural.
P: Serve dessert when Hellboy shares milk and cookies with the kid on the rooftop.

title: Blade
S: Whistler's garlic serum that keeps Blade going
Baguette split and spread with butter packed with roasted garlic, parsley and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp.
the blood rave where the sprinklers rain blood
Beetroot roasted in foil at 200C for an hour, peeled and blitzed with yoghurt, garlic, lemon and cumin until deep red, with warm pita crisps.

Rump and capsicum skewers marinated in garlic, oregano and lemon, grilled hot and fast, with a sharp garlic aioli. Cut 800g rump into 3cm cubes and marinate with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, the juice of 1 lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt for 1 hour. Thread onto 8 skewers with chunks of 2 red capsicums and 1 red onion. Grill over high heat for 2 minutes a side. Mix 150g mayo with 2 crushed garlic cloves and a squeeze of lemon to serve.
M: Rib eye seared and basted in butter with a whole head of crushed garlic, with garlic mash and greens.

Beef chuck simmered for hours with kidney beans, chipotle and a whole head of garlic, with sour cream and buttery cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and a whole head of chopped garlic, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 500ml beef stock and the beef. Cover and simmer 2.5 hours, adding 2 cans kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 200g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 300ml milk and 80g melted butter and bake at 200C for 22 minutes.
W: Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a blood orange curd and set, topped with candied blood orange slices.
K: the blood rave where the sprinklers rain red

Red wine steeped with blood orange, pomegranate and cinnamon, topped with soda over ice, deep red and dangerously easy to drink. In a big jug, mix 750ml red wine, 250ml pomegranate juice, 60ml brandy, 2 tbsp caster sugar and 1 cinnamon stick. Add 2 sliced blood oranges and the seeds of half a pomegranate. Chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 300ml soda water. For a booze-free jug, swap the wine and brandy for cranberry juice.
T: Extra garlic. You'll thank us.
D: A half-vampire hunter wages war on the vampires who secretly run the city.
P: Serve the snacks when Whistler hands Blade a fresh batch of garlic serum.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
S: Splinter raising four boys in the sewers

Pizza dough rolled up with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, sliced into scrolls and baked golden. Roll 500g pizza dough into a rectangle, spread with 125ml pizza sauce and scatter with 150g mozzarella and 80g sliced pepperoni. Roll up from the long side, cut into 12 rolls, sit in a lined tin and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Avocado mashed with lime, coriander and chilli, served in a halved round loaf like a shell, with tortilla chips.
the turtles roaming New York's streets at night

Pork and garlic chive dumplings pan-fried until crisp and golden underneath, then steamed tender, with soy and black vinegar for dipping. Mix 400g pork mince with a bunch of finely chopped garlic chives, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil and white pepper. Put a heaped teaspoon on each of 30 round wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Fry in a lidded pan with 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath, add 100ml water, cover and steam 5 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp soy with 2 tbsp black vinegar.
M: Pizza dough stretched thin, tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked on a hot tray at 250C for 10 minutes, folded New York style. Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, scatter with grated mozzarella, pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake on a very hot tray at 250C for 10 minutes. Cut into big slices and fold each in half to eat.
Superfly and his gang of mutants

Thin crust loaded with everything: Italian sausage, mushroom, capsicum, olives, red onion and pineapple under bubbling mozzarella. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch thin. Spread each with 3 tbsp passata mixed with oregano. Squeeze 300g Italian sausages out of their skins and fry in small pieces until browned. Top the bases with 400g grated mozzarella, the sausage, 150g sliced mushrooms, 1 sliced green capsicum, half a sliced red onion, a handful of olives and 200g pineapple pieces. Bake on hot trays at 250C for 12 minutes.
W: the scientist who cooked up the green ooze

Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled and topped with bright green buttercream left to drip down the sides like ooze. Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter, icing sugar and green colouring until soft and spoon on top so it drips down the sides like ooze.
K: the ooze from the TCRI labs

Kiwi fruit, lime, apple juice and mint blended with ice into a bright green slushie that glows like the ooze, no colouring needed. Peel 6 ripe kiwi fruit and put in a blender with the juice of 3 limes, 500ml cold apple juice, a handful of mint leaves and 3 tbsp honey. Blend until smooth, then add 3 cups of ice and blend again until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a kiwi slice and a mint sprig. Serve with wide straws.
T: Teenage turtles. Teenage appetites.
D: Four teenage turtle brothers want to be accepted in New York and try to stop a gang of mutants.
P: Serve the mains when the turtles head up to the rooftops with pizza.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
S: Sushi rice shaped into triangles around salted salmon, wrapped in strips of nori, with pickled ginger. Cook 2 cups sushi rice and season lightly. Salt and grill 200g salmon, then flake. Wet your hands and shape rice into triangles around a little salmon. Wrap the base in a strip of nori, sprinkle with sesame and serve with pickled ginger.
the old sceptre that swaps them through time

Chicken thigh pieces threaded onto skewers, grilled and basted with soy, mirin and sugar simmered down until sticky, scattered with spring onion. Simmer 4 tbsp soy sauce, 4 tbsp mirin and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy. Thread 600g chicken thigh pieces onto skewers and grill, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred. Scatter with sliced spring onion and serve hot.

Pizza dough rolled up with tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano, sliced into spirals and baked golden and bubbling. Roll 500g pizza dough into a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 4 tbsp pizza sauce, then scatter with 150g grated mozzarella, 100g chopped pepperoni and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Lay cut side up in a lined tin, brush with olive oil and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden. Serve warm with extra sauce.
M: Back home mushroom and capsicum pizza
getting back to New York and real pizza

Pizza dough with tomato sauce, mozzarella, mushroom and capsicum, baked at 250C for 10 minutes. Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, then scatter with grated mozzarella, sliced mushrooms and green capsicum. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until bubbling and crisp. Cut into slices and celebrate being back home.
the villagers who shelter the turtles

Ramen noodles in a rich miso and pork broth, topped with sliced pork belly, a jammy egg, sweet corn, spring onion and nori. Simmer 1L chicken stock with 2 tbsp grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves for 10 minutes, then whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Slice 400g cooked pork belly and sear until crisp. Cook 4 portions ramen noodles. Divide into bowls, ladle over the broth and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, spring onion and nori strips.
W: Glutinous rice flour dough wrapped around scoops of mango and vanilla ice cream, frozen until firm.
K: Iced honey barley tea with lemon
the turtles travel back in time

Toasty Japanese barley tea cold-brewed overnight, sweetened with honey and poured over ice with lemon slices, the taste of a Japanese summer. Put 4 barley tea bags in a jug with 1.5L cold water and leave in the fridge for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Remove the bags. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp hot water until runny and stir into the tea with the juice of half a lemon. Pour into 4 glasses filled with ice and add a lemon slice to each.
T: Feudal Japan. No pizza. Big problem.
D: The turtles travel back in time to feudal Japan to rescue April.
P: Serve the mains when the turtles realise there's no pizza in 1603.

title: The Crow
S: Devil's Night, the night before Halloween
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter, black salt and a pinch of chilli flakes, served in dark bowls by candlelight.
Eric playing guitar on the rooftop in the rain
Thick white bread buttered on the outside, filled with cheddar and ham, grilled in a pan until golden and melting, cut into soldiers.

Cocktail franks in soft little buns under a spiced beef chilli, with yellow mustard and finely diced white onion, Detroit style. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 finely diced onion, breaking it up well. Add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water, and simmer 20 minutes until thick and saucy. Simmer 16 cocktail frankfurts in water for 5 minutes. Tuck into 16 small soft rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with mustard and diced onion.
M: Darla's bacon and egg breakfast plate
Darla finally cooking breakfast for her daughter

Crisp bacon, sunny side up eggs, golden potato hash browns and thick buttered toast, a proper diner-style plate cooked with care. Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze very dry in a tea towel and mix with salt and 1 grated onion. Fry 8 flat cakes in oil and butter over medium heat for 5 minutes a side until crisp. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Fry 4 eggs sunny side up in butter. Toast 4 thick slices of bread and butter well. Plate it all up with tomato sauce on the side.
Officer Albrecht, the cop who believes Eric
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and gravy.
W: Dark, jammy blackberries baked under a buttery oat and brown sugar crumble until bubbling, served hot with vanilla ice cream. Toss 750g blackberries with 80g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 80g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over the fruit. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 10 minutes and serve hot with scoops of vanilla ice cream.
K: Hot strong coffee sweetened with brown sugar and spiked with Irish whiskey, under a thick layer of lightly whipped cream. Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out. Add 2 tsp brown sugar and 40ml Irish whiskey to each, then pour in 150ml hot strong coffee and stir until the sugar dissolves. Lightly whip 150ml cream until just thickened but still pourable. Pour it slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. For Sarah, make hot chocolate instead.
T: It can't rain all the time. Breakfast helps.
D: A murdered musician returns from the dead a year later to avenge himself and his fiancée.
P: Serve the mains when Darla cooks Sarah a proper breakfast.

title: Unbreakable
S: David's job as a stadium security guard
Soft pretzels boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with yellow mustard.
a Philadelphia breakfast before the stadium shift

Pork, sage and polenta set into a loaf, sliced and fried until crunchy outside and soft inside, with apple butter and a fried egg. Brown 500g pork mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1L chicken stock, 1 tsp dried sage, 1/2 tsp pepper and salt and bring to the boil. Whisk in 180g polenta and stir over low heat for 15 minutes until very thick. Press into a lined loaf tin and chill overnight. Slice 1.5cm thick, dust with flour and fry in butter for 4 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with apple butter and fried eggs.

Purple sweet potatoes sliced paper thin and fried until crisp, dusted with sea salt and smoked paprika, as purple as Elijah's suits. Slice 2 purple sweet potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and soak in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain and dry very well on tea towels. Fry in small batches in oil at 160C for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until the bubbling slows and they crisp up. Drain on paper towel and season straight away with sea salt and a pinch of smoked paprika. Cool so they crisp fully.
M: Dunn family bacon and scrambled eggs
David, Audrey and Joseph at the kitchen table

Soft buttery scrambled eggs with chives, crisp bacon, grilled tomatoes and thick buttered toast, served family style at the kitchen table. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp and keep warm. Halve 4 tomatoes, season and grill cut side up for 5 minutes. Whisk 8 eggs with 60ml milk and salt. Melt 30g butter in a non-stick pan over low heat, add the eggs and stir slowly for 4 minutes until just set and creamy, then stir in chopped chives. Toast 4 thick slices of bread and butter well. Serve with orange juice.
Weight room rump with garlic butter
David lifting more than he ever knew he could

Thick rump steaks grilled to medium and topped with melting garlic and parsley butter, with crunchy roast potatoes and buttered green beans. Roast 1kg potato chunks tossed in oil and salt at 220C for 45 minutes. Mash 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley. Season 4 x 250g rump steaks and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side for medium, then rest 5 minutes. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with a little butter. Top each steak with a slice of the garlic butter.
W: Mr Glass lemon and berry jelly
Mr Glass and his fragile bones

Lemon juice and sugar warmed with gelatine until dissolved, poured into round glasses over blueberries and raspberries, set for 4 hours until clear. Warm 500ml water with the juice of 3 lemons and 120g sugar. Soak 5 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in until dissolved. Divide 125g blueberries and 125g raspberries among round glasses and pour over the jelly. Chill for 4 hours until clear and set.
K: Hot green tea steeped with fresh ginger, sweetened with honey and sharpened with lemon, with a splash of whisky for anyone who wants it. Simmer a 5cm piece of sliced ginger in 1L water for 5 minutes, then take off the heat and let it cool for 2 minutes. Add 4 green tea bags and steep for 3 minutes, then remove. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and the juice of 1 lemon. Pour into 4 mugs with a lemon slice each. Add 30ml whisky to any mug where it's wanted.
T: Never sick. Never hurt. Always hungry.
D: The sole survivor of a train crash learns from a fragile comic book collector that he may be a real superhero.
P: Serve the mains when David sits down to breakfast with his son Joseph.

title: Hancock
S: Hancock throwing the beached whale back into the ocean
Prawns tossed in garlic, chilli, lime and melted butter, grilled 2 minutes a side until charred, piled high with lime wedges.
Ray's All Heart pitch to the big companies
Toasted baguette rubbed with garlic and piled with chopped ripe tomato, basil and good olive oil.
Prison yard toasted cheese and pickle
Hancock doing his time in prison

Sharp cheddar and tangy pickle toasted in buttered bread until golden and oozing, cut into squares and lined up on a canteen tray. Butter one side of 8 slices of bread. Lay 4 slices butter side down and spread each with 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish. Top with 200g grated vintage cheddar, then the remaining bread, butter side up. Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted. Cut each into 4 squares and line them up on a tray.
M: dinner with Ray, Mary and their son

Parmesan beef meatballs simmered in a slow tomato and basil sauce over spaghetti, with crisp garlic bread and a green salad. Mix 600g beef mince, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g parmesan, 1 egg, parsley and salt and roll 20 meatballs. Brown in olive oil. Soften 3 garlic cloves and 1 onion, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and basil, simmer 20 minutes, then add the meatballs for 20 minutes more. Split a baguette, spread with 60g butter mashed with garlic and parsley and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Cook 500g spaghetti and serve with salad leaves.
Ray giving Hancock a new public image
Sirloin steaks grilled to medium-rare and rested, with a cream and cracked peppercorn sauce, thick chips cooked twice and a green salad.
W: Hancock learning to say good job
Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into squares with a scoop of ice cream.
K: Whisky shaken hard with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky and foamy, poured over ice with bitters on top. For each drink, add 50ml whisky, 25ml fresh lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white to a shaker. Shake hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again for 10 seconds. Strain into a short glass over fresh ice and shake 3 drops of bitters onto the foam. Make four, using 200ml whisky in total. For the sober version, make iced tea with lemon and honey.
T: Good job. Have a sandwich.
D: A drunk, grumpy superhero lets a PR man help fix his image, until a secret comes out.
P: Serve the mains when Hancock comes over for dinner at Ray's house.

title: Big Hero 6
S: Aunt Cass and her famous spicy wings
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky glaze of gochujang, honey, garlic and soy.
Lucky Cat Café pork belly bao

Pork belly braised in soy, ginger and star anise until meltingly soft, sliced into steamed bao with hoisin, cucumber, spring onion and peanuts. Cut 800g pork belly into 3 thick strips and simmer in 100ml soy, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 4 slices ginger, 2 star anise and 750ml water, covered, for 2 hours until soft. Lift out, slice 1cm thick and sear in a hot pan until caramelised. Steam 12 frozen bao buns for 8 minutes. Fill each with hoisin, pork, cucumber sticks, sliced spring onion and crushed peanuts.
Marshmallows dipped in white chocolate, with two dark chocolate dots and a line for his face.
M: the mash-up city of San Fransokyo
Noodles in a rich pork and miso broth with chashu pork, soft eggs, corn, nori and spring onion.
Nerd lab salmon and avocado sushi rolls
the robotics lab at the university

Seasoned sushi rice rolled in nori around fresh salmon, avocado and cucumber, sliced into rounds with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger. Rinse 400g sushi rice until the water runs clear, then cook with 480ml water, covered, for 12 minutes and rest 10 minutes. Stir in 60ml rice vinegar mixed with 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Spread rice over 4 nori sheets on a bamboo mat, leaving a 2cm strip at the top. Lay strips of 250g sashimi salmon, 1 avocado and 1 cucumber along the bottom and roll tightly. Slice each into 8.
W: the pastries at the Lucky Cat Café
Choux pastry baked at 200C until puffed, filled with vanilla custard cream, dusted with icing sugar.
K: Thin lemon slices steeped in honey into a sticky marmalade, stirred into hot water or iced soda, sweet, sour and glowing gold. A day ahead, slice 3 lemons very thinly, remove the seeds, and layer in a clean jar with 250g honey and 2 tbsp caster sugar. Leave at room temperature for 24 hours, shaking now and then, until syrupy. For each drink, stir 3 tbsp of the lemon honey into a mug of hot water, or into a glass of ice topped with soda water for a cold version.
T: Hairy baby. Hot wings.
D: A boy genius and his brother's gentle healthcare robot form a team to find out who caused a tragedy.
P: Serve the snacks when Aunt Cass brings out her hot wings.

title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
S: the dwarfs digging diamonds in the mine
Cubes of cheddar, gouda and brie threaded onto toothpicks with red and green grapes, piled on a dark board so they glitter like gems.
Cottage garden veg with dill yoghurt dip
the little cottage in the woods

Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and snow peas standing in little jars around a cool dip of Greek yoghurt, dill, lemon and garlic. Mix 300g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp chopped dill, the zest and juice of half a lemon, 1 small crushed garlic clove, 1 tbsp olive oil and salt, then chill. Trim 1 bunch baby carrots, leaving a little green on top. Halve 1 bunch radishes, cut 1 cucumber into sticks and string 150g snow peas. Stand the vegetables upright in small jars around the bowl of dip.
the forest animals that help Snow White clean the cottage

Walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds tossed with honey, chopped rosemary and salt, roasted at 170C for 15 minutes, cooled and broken into clusters. Toss 100g each of walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds with 3 tbsp honey, a spoon of chopped rosemary and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely, then break into clusters for little hands.
M: supper for seven hungry dwarfs home from the mine
Chicken, leek and potato soup simmered with thyme, finished with cream, served with crusty bread.
Cottage herb roast chicken and veg
the dwarfs' cottage in the woods

Whole chicken roasted with lemon and herbs on a bed of potatoes and carrots that soak up the juices, carved at a long wooden table. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, salt, thyme and rosemary and put half a lemon inside. Toss 1kg potato chunks and 500g carrots with oil and salt in a roasting tin and sit the chicken on top. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes until the juices run clear and the vegetables are golden. Rest 10 minutes, carve and spoon the pan juices over everything.
W: the gooseberry pie Snow White bakes for Grumpy
Gooseberries cooked with sugar, baked in shortcrust with a pastry lid at 190C for 45 minutes, with cream.
K: Shiny red apple and cinnamon punch

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon and cloves, chilled and topped with sparkling apple, with thin red apple slices floating on top. Simmer 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 2 strips of orange peel for 10 minutes, then cool and chill for 2 hours. Strain into a jug. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml sparkling apple juice. Float thin slices of 1 red apple on top and serve in glasses with a cinnamon stick each.
T: One bite. Make sure it's pie.
D: A princess hides from her jealous stepmother in a cottage with seven dwarfs.
P: Serve dessert when Snow White bakes her pie for Grumpy.

title: Pinocchio
S: Geppetto's workshop full of clocks and toys

Little toasts of salami, provolone and a slice of pickled capsicum, laid out on a wooden board. Slice a baguette thinly, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 6 minutes until crisp. Top each toast with a fold of salami, a small slice of provolone and a strip of pickled capsicum. Lay them out in rows on a wooden board like tools on a bench.

Little fried ring doughnuts tossed hot in cinnamon sugar and served in paper bags with a warm caramel sauce for dipping. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 200ml warm milk into a soft dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll out 1cm thick and cut 20 small rings. Prove 20 minutes, then fry at 175C for 1 minute a side until golden. Toss hot in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve in paper bags with warm caramel sauce.
Cheddar cracker dough cut into fish shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.
M: Geppetto fishing inside Monstro the whale

Whole snapper stuffed with lemon, garlic and parsley, roasted until the skin crisps, with golden roast potatoes and salsa verde. Roast 1kg potato chunks tossed in oil at 220C for 20 minutes. Score a 1.5kg whole snapper 3 times on each side, rub with olive oil and salt and stuff with lemon slices, 3 garlic cloves and parsley. Lay it on top of the potatoes and roast at 200C for 25 minutes until the flesh flakes. Chop a bunch of parsley with 1 tbsp capers, lemon zest and 80ml olive oil for the salsa verde.

Beef meatballs with parmesan and parsley browned, then simmered 40 minutes in a slow tomato and basil sauce, served over spaghetti with extra parmesan. Mix 600g beef mince with grated parmesan, chopped parsley, salt and an egg, roll into balls and brown well. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, crushed garlic and torn basil and simmer for 40 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti with extra parmesan grated on top.
W: the Blue Fairy granting the wish
Sweet pastry filled with vanilla custard and topped with blueberries, glazed and dusted with icing sugar.
K: Lime, mint and honey muddled together and topped with sparkling water over crushed ice, bright green and fresh like a cricket. In a jug, muddle 2 big handfuls of mint leaves with 4 tbsp honey and the juice of 4 limes until the mint is bruised and fragrant. Add 250ml cold apple juice and stir. Fill 4 small glasses with crushed ice, pour in the mix to halfway and top with sparkling water. Garnish each with a lime wheel and a mint sprig.
T: No strings. No lies. Seconds.
D: A wooden puppet brought to life has to prove himself brave, truthful and unselfish to become a real boy.
P: Serve the mains when Pinocchio finds Geppetto inside the whale.

title: Fantasia
S: the little mushrooms dancing in the Nutcracker Suite
Button mushrooms stuffed with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
Bacchus and the grape harvest in the Pastoral Symphony
Bunches of red and green grapes piled on a big platter with a wedge of brie, halved fresh figs and a little pot of honey for drizzling over the cheese.
the dancing hippos in the Dance of the Hours

Light, golden choux puffs beaten with gruyère and a little mustard, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: the Greek gods' afternoon on Olympus

Layers of golden eggplant and cinnamon-spiced lamb sauce under a thick, creamy béchamel, baked until bubbling and browned on top. Slice 2 eggplants 1cm thick, brush with oil and grill or fry until golden. Brown 600g lamb mince with 1 diced onion, 1 tsp cinnamon and 400g diced tomatoes, and simmer 20 minutes. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g plain flour, then whisk in 600ml milk until thick, and beat in 1 egg off the heat. Layer eggplant and lamb in a dish, pour over the béchamel and bake at 180C for 40 minutes.
Rite of Spring garlic rosemary lamb
the dinosaurs in the Rite of Spring

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink, sliced with crispy roast potatoes, pumpkin and a rich pan gravy. Make small cuts all over a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers of 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with olive oil and salt. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes for medium, with 1kg potato chunks and 600g pumpkin pieces tossed in oil around it. Rest the lamb 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, add 300ml beef stock and simmer until thick.
W: Meringue kisses baked at 100C for an hour, dusted with edible glitter and served with berries.
K: Dark grape juice shaken with lemon and rosemary syrup, topped with sparkling water in goblets, with frozen grapes for ice. Freeze 200g red grapes on a tray for 2 hours. Simmer 3 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, mix 600ml purple grape juice, the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lemon. Pour into 4 goblets over the frozen grapes and top each with sparkling water. Garnish with a small rosemary sprig.
T: Classical music. Dancing mushrooms. Dinner.
D: Animated pieces set to classical music, from dancing mushrooms to a sorcerer's apprentice.
P: Serve the snacks when the little mushrooms start dancing.

title: Dumbo
S: Timothy Mouse winning Dumbo over with a peanut
Roasted peanuts stirred into melted dark chocolate with a pinch of salt, spooned into little clusters on baking paper and chilled 30 minutes until set.
the circus tent going up in the rain
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with butter, brown sugar and a little salt cooked to a quick caramel, spread out to cool, served in red striped cones.
the little circus train chugging between towns

Cocktail franks dipped in a sweet cornmeal and buttermilk batter, fried golden and crunchy on sticks, with mustard and tomato sauce. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk into a thick batter, then pour into a tall glass. Pat 20 cocktail frankfurts dry, push a skewer into each and dust in flour. Dip into the batter, letting the excess drip off, and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
M: the ringmaster planning the big show
Pork loin rubbed with fennel, garlic and salt, roasted at 200C for an hour with apples and onions, sliced with roast potatoes and pan gravy.
the clowns and their fire act

Parmesan beef meatballs browned and simmered in a slow tomato sauce, tossed through spaghetti and finished with basil and plenty of parmesan. Mix 600g beef mince, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g parmesan, 1 egg, chopped parsley and salt, and roll into 20 meatballs. Brown in olive oil and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes. Add the meatballs and simmer 20 minutes more. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some of the sauce and top with meatballs, torn basil and grated parmesan.
W: the pink elephants in Dumbo's dream
Biscuit base topped with a fluffy pink marshmallow of gelatine, sugar and vanilla whipped until thick, set overnight and dusted with coconut.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup with crushed raspberries and cold water, poured over ice in tall glasses.
T: Big ears. Bigger appetite.
D: A baby circus elephant with enormous ears is mocked until he finds out he can fly.
P: Serve the snacks when Timothy Mouse offers Dumbo a peanut.

title: Bambi
S: Thumper telling Bambi to eat the clover and leave the greens
Baby leaves, pea shoots and soft herbs tossed with lemon and olive oil, spooned into little lettuce cups with shaved parmesan and toasted seeds.
Flower the skunk in the flower patch
Baby carrots, radishes and snow peas arranged like a garden bed around a dip of whipped feta, yoghurt, honey and dill.

Crisp little shortcrust cases filled with vanilla custard and piled with strawberries, blueberries and raspberries, dusted with icing sugar. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets and press into a muffin tin. Prick and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool. Heat 300ml milk with 1 tsp vanilla. Whisk 3 egg yolks, 60g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, pour in the hot milk, return to the pan and stir until thick. Cool, then spoon into the cases and top with 250g mixed berries. Dust with icing sugar.
M: the deep forest where the Great Prince watches
Mixed mushrooms, leek and thyme cooked down in butter with a splash of cream, spooned into a dish, topped with puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
Bambi seeing snow for the first time

Roasted pumpkin and carrot blended silky with stock, cream and nutmeg, served with a snowy swirl of cream and crunchy garlic toasts. Toss 1.2kg pumpkin chunks, 2 chopped carrots and 1 quartered onion with oil and salt and roast at 200C for 35 minutes. Blend with 1L chicken or vegetable stock until smooth, then reheat with 100ml cream and a pinch of nutmeg and season. Slice a baguette, brush with oil, rub with garlic and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Serve the soup with a swirl of cream and the toasts.
W: Bambi slipping around on the frozen pond
Meringue spread into a flat round, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream like snow and fresh berries.
K: spring in the meadow, when everyone is twitterpated
Apple juice and cold elderflower cordial topped with soda water, with cucumber ribbons and mint over ice.
T: Eat your greens. Thumper's orders.
D: A young deer grows up in the forest with his friends Thumper and Flower.
P: Serve the snacks when Thumper teaches Bambi to eat the clover.

title: Cinderella
S: Gus the mouse gathering corn kernels
Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg, spring onion and a little paprika, fried in spoonfuls until golden, served with a sour cream and chive dip.
Cinderella carrying breakfast trays up the stairs

Little buttered toasts topped with soft, creamy scrambled egg, chives and a sliver of ham, laid out on silver trays. Cut 12 rounds from 6 slices of bread with a cutter, brush with 20g melted butter and toast at 180C for 8 minutes. Whisk 6 eggs with 50ml cream and salt. Melt 20g butter in a non-stick pan over low heat and stir the eggs slowly for 4 minutes until just set and creamy. Top each toast with a small piece of ham from 100g, a spoon of egg and chopped chives.
the royal ball at the palace
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and prosciutto wrapped around melon, served on silver trays.
M: the pumpkin that turns into a coach
Butternut pumpkin roasted at 200C, half mashed through a parmesan risotto stirred slowly with stock for 20 minutes, the rest folded in, finished with sage butter.

Golden roast chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and thyme, carved with crisp roast potatoes, honey carrots and a silky pan gravy. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, the zest of 1 lemon, thyme and salt, put the lemon inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with 1 tbsp honey for 35 minutes. Rest the chicken, then stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices with 300ml chicken stock and simmer until smooth.
W: the glass slipper left on the palace stairs
Meringue piped into little slipper shapes, baked at 100C for an hour, dusted with edible glitter and served with whipped cream and berries.
K: Cinderella's blue ball gown at midnight

Blueberry juice and lemonade with a squeeze of lime, poured over ice with frozen blueberries floating in it. Fill a jug with ice and a handful of frozen blueberries. Pour in 1L blueberry juice and 1L cold lemonade, then squeeze in the juice of a lime. Stir gently and pour into glasses before the clock strikes midnight.
T: Home by midnight. Pumpkin first.
D: A kind young woman, kept as a servant by her stepfamily, gets to the royal ball with help from her Fairy Godmother.
P: Serve the mains when the pumpkin turns into a coach.

title: Alice in Wonderland
S: the little cake marked eat me
Small vanilla cakes baked in a mini muffin tin at 175C for 12 minutes, iced white with eat me piped on top in pink.
the oysters in Tweedledum and Tweedledee's story

Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a sharp mignonette of eschalot, red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, and lemon wedges. Finely dice 1 eschalot and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar, 1 tsp caster sugar and plenty of cracked black pepper, then chill for 30 minutes. Fill a large platter with crushed ice. Shuck 24 oysters, or buy them freshly shucked, and sit them on the ice. Spoon a little mignonette onto each just before eating and serve with lemon wedges.
the Queen of Hearts and her painted red roses
Puff pastry hearts baked at 200C for 12 minutes, split and filled with strawberry jam and whipped cream.
M: Mad Hatter's tea party finger sandwiches
the Mad Hatter's long tea table

Three kinds of crustless finger sandwiches, cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and ham and mustard, stacked high on tiered plates. Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 3 tbsp mayo and salt. Mix 150g cream cheese with chopped dill. Spread 12 slices of soft white bread with butter. Make 2 rounds of thin cucumber and cream cheese, 2 of egg and cress, and 2 of ham and mustard, using 150g ham. Trim the crusts and cut each round into 3 fingers. Stack on tiered plates.
Croquet lawn chicken and leek pie
the Queen's croquet game played with flamingos

Chicken and leek pie with a creamy thyme filling under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 2 sliced leeks. Stir in a spoon of flour, 250ml chicken stock, 200ml cream and thyme and simmer until thick. Pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: Vanilla sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes, sandwiched with jam and cream, iced in pastel colours with candles for nobody's birthday.
K: Drink me iced earl grey lemonade
the little bottle marked drink me
