Earl grey tea brewed and cooled, mixed with lemonade and a little honey, served in teacups over ice. Brew 4 earl grey tea bags in 500ml boiling water and stir in a spoon of honey. Cool, then mix with 500ml lemonade and a squeeze of lemon. Pour over ice in mismatched teacups. Drink me, but not too much at once.
T: Eat me. Drink me. Happy unbirthday.
D: A curious girl follows a white rabbit down a hole into a very strange world.
P: Serve dessert when the Mad Hatter's unbirthday party gets going.

title: Peter Pan
S: the crocodile that swallowed a clock
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, topped with smashed peas, mint and feta, the green ridges made with a fork.
Skull Rock gruyère and pepper puffs

Golden choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cracked black pepper, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm from the oven. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on ice with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and lemon.
M: Captain Hook's beef and allspice stew
Captain Hook's ship in the bay

Beef chuck simmered for hours with onions, carrots, allspice and a touch of molasses until thick and dark, with crusty bread. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 sliced onions and 3 chopped carrots, then add the beef, 1 tsp ground allspice, 1 tbsp molasses or brown sugar, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 750ml beef stock. Cover and simmer gently for 3 hours until thick and tender. Season well and serve in big bowls with crusty bread.
the Lost Boys' hideout under the tree

Sticky drumsticks roasted in honey, paprika and garlic, with buttered corn cobs and crispy roast potatoes, all eaten with your hands. Toss 12 chicken drumsticks with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, turning once, until sticky and cooked through. Roast 1kg potato chunks tossed in oil alongside for 45 minutes. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, cut in half and roll in butter. Pile everything onto one big board.
W: Tinker Bell and her pixie dust
White bread spread with butter and covered in hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles, dusted with a little edible glitter.
K: Nana the dog looking after the nursery

Warm milk whisked frothy with malt powder, honey and vanilla, topped with a cloud of cream and a dusting of nutmeg. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Take off the heat and whisk in 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs. Whip 100ml cream to soft peaks and spoon a little on each, then grate over a little nutmeg. Serve with a plain biscuit on the side.
T: Second star to the right. Snacks straight on.
D: A boy who never grows up takes Wendy and her brothers to Neverland to face Captain Hook.
P: Serve the snacks when the children fly over London.

title: Lady and the Tramp
S: Jim Dear's doughnuts with coffee caramel
Jim Dear dunking a doughnut at breakfast

Hot cinnamon sugar doughnuts made for dunking, with a silky coffee caramel dip, the breakfast Lady sits begging beside. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 200ml warm milk into a dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll 1cm thick, cut 12 rings and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 1 minute a side and toss in 100g sugar with 2 tsp cinnamon. For the dip, melt 150g brown sugar with 50g butter, add 150ml cream and 1 tsp instant coffee and simmer 3 minutes.
Italian bread split and spread with butter mashed with garlic, parsley and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp at the edges.
the candlelit table set for Lady and Tramp
Salami and provolone folded on a board with olives, marinated artichoke and roasted capsicum, with torn bread.
M: the famous spaghetti dinner behind Tony's
Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered 40 minutes in a slow tomato and basil sauce, served over one big plate of spaghetti.
Tramp's back door chicken with salsa verde
Tramp doing his rounds of the back doors for scraps

Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken thighs roasted crisp-skinned, with smashed potatoes and a sharp caper salsa verde, the pick of the back-door rounds. Toss 1kg bone-in chicken thighs with the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 4 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast skin up at 200C for 40 minutes until crisp. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat and roast alongside in oil for 30 minutes. Chop a bunch of parsley, a handful of basil, 1 tbsp capers and 1 garlic clove, and mix with lemon juice and 80ml olive oil. Spoon over the chicken.
W: Cannoli shells piped with ricotta whipped with icing sugar, orange zest and dark chocolate chips, the ends dipped in crushed pistachios.
K: Tony and Joe serenading the dinner out the back of Tony's

Blood orange juice and rosemary syrup topped with fizzing soda over ice, red as the checked tablecloth on Tony's back-step table. Simmer 80g caster sugar, 80ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. In a jug, mix 500ml blood orange juice with the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lemon. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the juice to halfway and top with soda water. Garnish each with a blood orange slice and a small rosemary sprig.
T: One plate. One strand. One meatball.
D: A pampered cocker spaniel falls for a streetwise stray who shows her life outside the yard.
P: Serve the mains when Tony brings out the spaghetti at the back of the restaurant.

title: Sleeping Beauty
S: Briar Rose picking berries in the forest
Strawberries and blackberries dipped in melted white chocolate, set on baking paper and dusted with a little freeze-dried raspberry.
King Hubert's wedding toast cheese board
King Hubert and King Stefan toasting the wedding plans

Aged cheddar, gooey baked brie and blue cheese with honey-roasted walnuts, quince paste, grapes and crackers, built for two kings toasting a wedding. Toss 100g walnuts with 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt and roast at 180C for 8 minutes, then cool. Score the top of a 200g brie wheel, drizzle with honey and thyme and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until wobbly. Set it on a big board with 200g aged cheddar in shards, 150g blue cheese, 150g quince paste, the walnuts, 300g grapes and crackers.
the fairies fighting over pink or blue for the dress
Two dips side by side: beetroot whipped with yoghurt for pink, and blue cheese with sour cream for blue, with pita crisps.
M: King Stefan's crackling pork with apples
the celebration in King Stefan's castle

Fennel and salt rubbed pork shoulder roasted low then blasted for shattering crackling, with roast apples, crispy potatoes and a mustard apple gravy. Score the skin of a 2kg pork shoulder, dry well and rub with 1 tbsp crushed fennel seeds and plenty of salt. Roast at 160C for 3.5 hours, adding 1kg potato chunks and 4 quartered apples for the last hour. Turn the oven to 240C for 20 minutes until the crackling blisters. Rest 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml apple juice, 200ml stock and 1 tsp mustard and simmer until thick.
the cottage in the woods where the fairies hide Aurora
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots, parsnips and thyme until tender, served with crusty bread and butter.
W: the wobbly birthday cake made without magic
Vanilla sponge baked in three tins at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked high with jam and buttercream, iced pink and blue and left proudly a little crooked.
K: King Stefan and King Hubert raising a toast to the wedding

Sparkling apple and pomegranate punch with orange, cinnamon syrup and pomegranate seeds, poured into goblets for a royal toast of skumps. Simmer 3 tbsp sugar and 3 tbsp water with 1 cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, mix 300ml pomegranate juice, the juice of 1 orange and the cinnamon syrup. Add 1 sliced orange and the seeds of half a pomegranate. Just before serving, add ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling apple juice. Pour into goblets and raise them high.
T: Make the cake without magic. Good luck.
D: A princess cursed by Maleficent is hidden in the forest by three good fairies until her sixteenth birthday.
P: Serve dessert when the fairies try to bake the birthday cake without magic.

title: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
S: Pongo and Perdita's spotty cheese straws

Flaky puff pastry twisted with sharp cheddar and parmesan, spotted with black olive and nigella seeds, baked crisp and golden. Lay out 2 thawed puff pastry sheets and brush with beaten egg. Scatter one with 80g grated cheddar, 30g parmesan, 50g finely chopped black olives and 1 tsp nigella seeds. Lay the second sheet on top and press down firmly. Cut into 1.5cm strips, twist each a few times and lay on lined trays. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden and crisp.
Barn honey shortbread with warm milk dip
the kind cows in the barn giving the puppies warm milk

Buttery honey shortbread fingers baked pale gold, with little cups of warm vanilla and honey milk for dipping, just like the barn stop. Beat 200g soft butter with 70g caster sugar and 2 tbsp honey until pale, then mix in 300g plain flour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick all over and bake at 160C for 25 minutes until pale gold. Cut into fingers while warm and cool in the tin. Warm 600ml milk with 1 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla and serve in small cups for dunking.
Sooty puppy black sesame potato chips
the puppies rolling in soot to disguise themselves

Thin crisp potato chips tossed in a sooty seasoning of black sesame, smoked salt and crumbled nori, the puppies' chimney-soot disguise. Slice 4 large potatoes paper thin on a mandoline, soak in cold water 20 minutes, then dry thoroughly. Fry in small batches at 170C for 3 minutes until crisp and golden, and drain. Grind 2 tbsp toasted black sesame seeds, 1 sheet of nori and 1 tsp smoked salt to a coarse dust. Toss the hot chips in the seasoning and serve in a big bowl.
M: the little London flat by Regent's Park
Lamb mince simmered with onion, carrot, peas and stock, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Nanny's roast beef and Yorkshire puds
Nanny looking after the house and the puppies

Mustard-crusted beef topside roasted pink, with puffed Yorkshire puddings, crunchy roast potatoes and lashings of onion gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with 1 tbsp English mustard and salt and roast at 200C for 50 minutes for medium, with 1kg parboiled potato chunks in oil around it. Rest 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 3 eggs and 300ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin at 230C, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Fry 1 sliced onion, add 1 tbsp flour and 400ml beef stock and simmer.
W: Soft vanilla cookies baked at 180C for 12 minutes, iced half in vanilla glaze and half in chocolate glaze.
K: the puppies glued to Thunderbolt on the telly

Half chocolate, half vanilla thickshake poured side by side so it swirls into spots, with whipped cream and chocolate drops on top. Blend 4 scoops vanilla ice cream with 300ml cold milk and 1 tsp vanilla, and pour into a jug. Blend 4 scoops chocolate ice cream with 300ml cold milk and 1 tbsp cocoa. Pour both shakes into 4 tall glasses at the same time from either side so they sit half and half. Top with whipped cream and a few dark chocolate drops for spots.
T: Ninety-nine puppies. One big pot.
D: Pongo and Perdita set out across England to rescue their puppies from Cruella De Vil.
P: Serve the snacks when the puppies settle in front of the TV for their favourite dog show.

title: The Jungle Book
S: Baloo shaking fruit down from the trees
Banana slices dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed peanuts and coconut, frozen on a tray for 30 minutes.
Mango, pineapple, papaya and lychee piled on banana leaves with lime and a sprinkle of chilli salt.
Kaa's spinach and feta pastry coils
Kaa the snake coiling around Mowgli

Spinach, feta and dill wrapped in flaky pastry and coiled up like Kaa, baked golden, with a cooling mint yoghurt and a hit of chilli. Wilt 300g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g crumbled feta, 1 egg, chopped dill and pepper. Cut 2 puff pastry sheets into 4 long strips each, spoon filling along each strip and roll over to enclose. Coil each strip into a snail shape on a lined tray, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Mix 200g yoghurt with chopped mint and a pinch of chilli flakes to serve.
M: Mowgli following the girl to the man village

Chicken thighs simmered in a tomato and coconut curry with garlic, ginger, garam masala and curry leaves, served with basmati rice and naan. Soften grated ginger and garlic in oil, add 2 tsp garam masala and fry a minute. Add 1kg chicken thighs, a can of crushed tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with basmati rice and warm naan.
Man village tadka dal with roti
the man village at the end of the journey

Red lentils simmered silky with turmeric, garlic and ginger, finished with sizzling cumin, chilli and ghee, with rice, warm roti and lime pickle. Rinse 300g red lentils and simmer in 1.2L water with 1 tsp turmeric, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 25 minutes until soft, then season. Cook 300g basmati rice. Heat 40g ghee, add 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 dried chilli and 1 sliced onion and fry until golden, then pour over the dal sizzling. Warm 8 roti and serve with lime pickle and coriander.
W: Coconut milk and sugar set with gelatine in glasses, topped with mango and toasted coconut.
K: Colonel Hathi's dawn patrol mango lassi
the elephants marching through the jungle

Ripe mango blended with yoghurt, milk, a little sugar and cardamom, poured over ice. Blend the flesh of 2 ripe mangoes with 300g Greek yoghurt, 250ml cold milk, a spoon of sugar and a pinch of cardamom until smooth. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Cool enough for the hottest day in the jungle.
T: Bare necessities. Plus snacks.
D: A boy raised by wolves travels through the jungle with a panther and a bear to reach the man village.
P: Serve the snacks when Baloo floats down the river with Mowgli on his belly.

title: Robin Hood
S: the outlaws' picnic in the forest

Pork pies, crusty bread, aged cheddar, pickled onions and apples laid out on a cloth. Spread a cloth on the floor or table. Lay out 4 small pork pies, torn crusty bread, wedges of aged cheddar, a jar of pickled onions and sliced green apples. Let everyone help themselves like outlaws picnicking in the forest.
the archery tournament where Robin wins in disguise
Chicken and capsicum threaded onto long skewers, marinated in honey and mustard, grilled until charred.
Friar Tuck's dripping toast with mushrooms
Friar Tuck feeding his poor parish

Thick sourdough fried golden in beef dripping, piled with garlicky thyme mushrooms and a crack of pepper, a humble feed for the parish. Melt 3 tbsp beef dripping in a large frying pan and fry 4 thick slices of sourdough for 2 minutes a side until golden and crisp, then keep warm. Add 20g butter to the pan and fry 400g sliced mixed mushrooms over high heat for 5 minutes, then add 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme leaves and cook 1 minute more. Season, pile onto the toast and add chopped parsley.
M: the phony king of England counting his taxes

Mustard and thyme crusted beef roasted pink, with puffy Yorkshire puddings, crunchy roast potatoes and a rich onion gravy fit for a greedy prince. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with 1 tbsp English mustard, thyme and salt and roast at 200C for 50 minutes for medium, with 1kg parboiled potato chunks in oil around it. Rest 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 3 eggs and 300ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin at 230C, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Fry 1 sliced onion, add 1 tbsp flour and 400ml beef stock and simmer.
Lamb neck, barley, carrots and leeks simmered 2 hours in stock with rosemary, served with crusty bread.
W: the gold taken back from Prince John
Small honey cakes baked at 175C for 15 minutes, glazed with honey and topped with a chocolate coin.
K: Merry Men hot spiced apple punch

Cloudy apple juice mulled with cinnamon, cloves, orange and a little honey, ladled hot into mugs round the Sherwood campfire. Pour 1.5L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 strips of orange peel, the juice of 1 orange and 2 tbsp honey. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling so the spices infuse. Strain and ladle into 4 mugs, each with an orange slice and a cinnamon stick. For a chilled version, cool and top with sparkling apple juice.
T: Rob from the rich. Feed the hungry.
D: A fox in Sherwood Forest robs the greedy Prince John to give back to the poor.
P: Serve the mains when the outlaws celebrate in Sherwood Forest.

title: Pocahontas
S: Meeko the raccoon raiding the biscuits
Buttermilk biscuits of flour, cold butter and buttermilk, cut into rounds and baked at 220C for 14 minutes, split with butter and honey.
River corn fritters with lime crema
the river that runs around the bend

Sweet corn fritters with spring onion and chilli, fried crisp and lacy, with a zingy lime and sour cream dip and a pinch of smoked salt. Mix 400g corn kernels with 100g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 80ml milk, 3 sliced spring onions, 1 chopped red chilli and salt. Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry heaped tablespoons for 2 minutes a side until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towel. Mix 200g sour cream with the zest and juice of 1 lime. Sprinkle the fritters with smoked salt and serve with the crema.
Grandmother Willow, the wise old tree
Pecans, walnuts and pepitas roasted with maple syrup and a pinch of salt at 170C for 12 minutes, cooled into clusters.
M: the Virginia harvest of corn, beans and squash
Chicken thighs simmered with pumpkin, corn, kidney beans, tomato and smoked paprika until thick, served with cornbread.
the English settlers building their fort

Beef chuck slow cooked with sweet onions, thyme and stock until rich, baked under a golden puff pastry lid with mustard on the side. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 3 sliced onions, then add the beef, 600ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and thyme. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender and thick, then cool slightly. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with hot English mustard.
W: the colours of the wind in autumn
Peaches halved and roasted at 200C with maple syrup and butter for 15 minutes, with vanilla ice cream and crushed pecans.
K: Blueberries muddled with mint and lime, stirred through cranberry juice and topped with sparkling water over crushed ice. In a jug, muddle 125g blueberries with a handful of mint leaves, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp honey until the berries burst. Stir in 500ml cranberry juice and chill for 30 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the berry mix to halfway and top with sparkling water. Garnish with fresh blueberries and a mint sprig.
T: Feed Meeko first. He won't wait.
D: A young woman in 1607 Virginia meets an English settler and tries to keep the peace.
P: Serve the snacks when Meeko goes digging through John Smith's bag for biscuits.

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
S: the Festival of Fools in the square
Thin crêpe batter rested an hour, cooked in a buttered pan, folded with ham and gruyère, or with sugar and lemon.
Hugo, Victor and Laverne's croque bites
the three gargoyles cheering Quasimodo on

Little ham and gruyère toasties smothered in béchamel and grilled until bubbling and blistered, cut into bites with cornichons. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 200ml milk and cook until thick, and season with nutmeg. Spread 4 slices of bread with Dijon mustard, top with 150g ham and 80g grated gruyère, and close with 4 more slices. Toast in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side. Spread the tops with béchamel, scatter with 60g more gruyère and grill until bubbling. Cut into 6 bites each.
the busy Paris market below the cathedral
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, topped with brie and fig jam, or with tomato and basil.
M: Bell tower beef and mushroom braise

Beef chuck braised slow with bacon, mushrooms and baby onions in a rich dark stock until spoon tender, served over buttery mash. Brown 150g diced bacon, then brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 12 peeled baby onions and 300g mushrooms and colour lightly. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 750ml beef stock, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer gently for 3 hours. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and warm milk.

Chicken thighs braised with garlic, green olives, lemon and herbs until tender and saucy, with crusty bread to mop it all up. Season 1kg chicken thighs and brown skin side down in olive oil for 6 minutes, then turn. Add 10 whole peeled garlic cloves, 100g green olives, 1 sliced lemon, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Pour in 300ml chicken stock, cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes, then uncover and bubble for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens. Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.
W: the great cathedral of Notre Dame
Madeleine batter of butter, eggs, sugar and lemon zest rested an hour, baked in shell tins at 200C for 10 minutes.
K: Esmeralda and her goat Djali in the Paris square

French-style sirop à l'eau: homemade pomegranate grenadine and lime poured into iced soda so it sinks red, stirred at the table. Simmer 250ml pomegranate juice with 100g caster sugar for 10 minutes until slightly syrupy, add a squeeze of lemon and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and add the juice of a quarter lime to each. Top with soda water, then slowly pour 3 tbsp of the grenadine down the side of each glass so it settles at the bottom. Serve with a spoon to stir.
T: Ring the bells. Ring the dinner bell.
D: A kind bell-ringer hidden in Notre Dame sneaks out to the Festival of Fools in Paris.
P: Serve the snacks when Quasimodo sneaks down to the Festival of Fools.

title: The Princess and the Frog
S: the beignets Tiana makes for Charlotte
Yeasted dough rolled and cut into squares, fried at 180C until puffed and golden, buried under icing sugar and served hot.
Bayou crab cakes with Creole remoulade
Louis, Ray and the frogs in the bayou

Crab cakes bound with mayo, mustard and spring onion, fried crisp, with a punchy Creole remoulade of pickles, capers and hot sauce. Mix 400g drained crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 egg, 60g panko and 1/2 tsp Cajun spice. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in oil and butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade, mix 120g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped pickles, 1 tbsp capers, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tsp hot sauce and paprika. Serve with lemon.
the Mardi Gras parade in New Orleans
Round loaf filled with salami, ham, provolone and a chopped olive salad, pressed overnight, cut into small wedges.
M: Daddy James's chicken and sausage gumbo
the gumbo Tiana's daddy taught her, shared with the whole street

Chicken and smoky sausage in a dark, nutty roux with okra, capsicum, celery and onion, ladled over rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Stir 80ml oil and 80g plain flour in a heavy pot over medium heat for 20 minutes until dark brown. Add 1 diced onion, 1 green capsicum and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Add 600g diced chicken thighs, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun spice and 1.2L chicken stock. Simmer for 1 hour, adding 200g sliced okra for the last 15 minutes. Serve over 300g cooked rice with spring onion and hot sauce.
Tiana's Palace, her own restaurant at last
Prawns sautéed with garlic, bacon and Cajun spice, spooned over creamy cheesy polenta with spring onion.
W: Bananas caramelised in butter, brown sugar and cinnamon with a splash of orange, spooned hot over vanilla ice cream with toasted pecans. Melt 60g butter in a frying pan with 100g brown sugar and 1/2 tsp cinnamon and stir until bubbling. Add 4 bananas, halved lengthways and across, and cook 2 minutes a side until caramelised. Pour in the juice of 1 orange and 1 tsp vanilla and let it bubble into a glossy sauce. Spoon over scoops of vanilla ice cream and scatter with 50g toasted chopped pecans.
K: Duke's Café iced chicory au lait
Tiana's double shifts at Duke's Café

Strong coffee and chicory brew poured over ice with cold milk and vanilla sugar syrup, a New Orleans morning with beignets on the side. Brew 500ml strong coffee using 4 tbsp ground coffee and 1 tbsp roasted chicory, then cool. Simmer 60g caster sugar with 60ml water and 1 tsp vanilla to a syrup. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 1 tbsp syrup and 150ml cold milk to each, then pour over the coffee. For the kids, make it with decaf or just chilled milk and syrup.
T: Beignets first. Then the bayou.
D: A hardworking waitress in New Orleans kisses a frog prince and ends up a frog herself.
P: Serve the snacks when Tiana hands Charlotte a plate of hot beignets.

title: Tangled
S: the rough Snuggly Duckling pub full of thugs
Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with mustard.
the lantern festival in the kingdom of Corona

Lemon cupcakes piped with lilac blueberry buttercream and topped with a golden sugar sun, the royal emblem of Corona. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, the zest of 1 lemon, 125ml milk and 200g self-raising flour. Spoon into 12 paper cases and bake at 175C for 18 minutes, then cool. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and 2 tbsp blueberry jam until fluffy and lilac. Pipe onto the cakes and top each with a yellow fondant sun cut with a small cutter.
the palace horse who loves apples

Wafer-thin apple slices baked low and slow until crisp, dusted with cinnamon sugar, served with a salted caramel yoghurt dip. Slice 4 apples paper thin on a mandoline and lay in a single layer on 2 lined trays. Dust with 1 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Bake at 100C for 2 hours, turning once halfway, until dry and curling, then cool on the trays so they crisp. Swirl 2 tbsp caramel sauce and a pinch of salt through 200g Greek yoghurt for dipping.
M: Toasted hazelnuts blended with onion, celery and potato simmered in chicken stock, finished with cream and topped with crushed hazelnuts and chives.
Flynn Rider trying out the smoulder

Chicken spatchcocked and rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and lemon, roasted with a smoky char, over crispy potatoes with herby yoghurt. Cut out the backbone of a 1.8kg chicken and press flat. Rub with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 crushed garlic cloves, the zest of 1 lemon, olive oil and salt. Lay over 1kg sliced potatoes tossed in oil in a roasting tin and roast at 220C for 50 minutes until charred and cooked through. Rest 10 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon juice, parsley and mint to serve.
W: the floating lanterns on Rapunzel's birthday
Orange and almond cakes baked in muffin tins at 170C for 25 minutes, glazed with orange syrup and topped with a candied orange slice.
K: Homemade lavender syrup with fresh lemon and soda over ice, pale purple like Rapunzel's dress, with a lemon wheel and a lavender sprig. Simmer 150g sugar, 150ml water and 1 tbsp dried culinary lavender for 5 minutes, cool and strain. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 40ml syrup and the juice of half a lemon to each and top with 200ml soda water.
T: Hazelnut soup and floating lanterns.
D: A girl with magic hair leaves her tower for the first time to see the floating lanterns.
P: Serve the mains when Mother Gothel promises to make hazelnut soup.

title: Frozen II
S: the family charades game in the castle
Popcorn tossed with melted white chocolate and a pinch of salt, set and broken into clusters, served in big bowls.

Mixed mushrooms seared hard in brown butter with garlic and thyme, piled onto charred sourdough with whipped ricotta and shaved parmesan. Mix 200g ricotta with the zest of 1 lemon and salt and whip until smooth. Melt 40g butter in a large pan until golden and nutty, add 400g torn mixed mushrooms and fry over high heat for 5 minutes until browned. Add 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and cook 1 minute. Grill 4 slices of sourdough until charred. Spread with ricotta, pile on the mushrooms and finish with shaved parmesan.
Olaf's honey roast carrots with feta

Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey and thyme until sticky, served with a whipped feta dip. Toss 500g baby carrots with honey, thyme and oil and roast at 200C for 25 minutes until sticky. Whip 150g feta with 150g Greek yoghurt until smooth. Serve the carrots warm around the dip. Keep one aside for a snowman's nose.
M: Salmon, white fish and prawns simmered in a creamy broth with leek, potato and dill, served with rye bread.
the Northuldra camp in the forest

Lamb shoulder rubbed with juniper, garlic and rosemary, slow roasted until it falls apart, with charred root vegetables and lingonberry-style jam. Crush 1 tbsp juniper berries with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary leaves, olive oil and salt and rub over a 2kg lamb shoulder. Put in a roasting tin with 250ml water, cover with foil and roast at 150C for 5 hours. Add 1kg chopped carrots, parsnips and beetroot for the last 90 minutes, uncovering for the final 30 minutes. Pull the lamb apart and serve with cranberry sauce.
W: Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, topped with whipped cream and blueberries, dusted with icing sugar like frost.
K: Kristoff trying to propose to Anna

Apple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and a little maple syrup, ladled into mugs with a cinnamon stick for stirring. Pour 1.5L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 strips of orange peel and 2 tbsp maple syrup. Warm over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add a fresh cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each. Serve with carrots on the side for anyone who brought a reindeer.
T: Into the unknown. With snacks.
D: Elsa follows a mysterious voice into an enchanted forest to learn the truth about Arendelle's past.
P: Serve the snacks when the family plays charades on game night.

title: Moana 2
S: Prawns dipped in egg and shredded coconut, fried at 180C until golden, with sweet chilli and lime sauce.
Taro sliced thin and fried at 170C until crisp, tossed with sea salt and a little chilli.
Motunui chilli lime fruit with coconut

Pineapple, mango and papaya wedges squeezed with lime, dusted with chilli salt and toasted coconut, with halved passionfruit to spoon over. Toast 40g shredded coconut in a dry pan until golden, then cool. Cut half a pineapple, 2 mangoes and half a papaya into wedges and lay on a big platter with 3 halved passionfruit. Grind 1 tsp sea salt with 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tsp sugar. Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fruit, sprinkle with the chilli salt and scatter with the coconut.
M: the crew's long voyage across the ocean
Snapper fillets marinated in coconut milk, lime and chilli, wrapped in banana leaves and grilled, with coconut rice.
the welcome feast back home on Motunui

Pork shoulder rubbed with salt, garlic and brown sugar, slow roasted in banana leaves until it pulls apart, with charred pineapple and coconut slaw. Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 2 tsp salt, 4 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Wrap in banana leaves, then foil, and roast at 150C for 5 hours. Pull apart with forks and toss in the juices. Grill 8 pineapple rings until charred. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 3 tbsp coconut cream, the juice of 1 lime and coriander. Serve together.
W: Coconut milk and sugar thickened with cornflour, set in cups, topped with mango and toasted coconut. Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar and 5 tbsp cornflour over low heat until thick and glossy. Pour into cups and chill for 3 hours until set. Top with diced mango and toasted shredded coconut before serving.
K: Pua the pig, who gets left on the beach at Motunui

Coconut water, fresh pineapple and lime blended with ice into a frosty crush, topped with a pineapple wedge and a paper umbrella. Blend 500ml chilled coconut water, 300g fresh pineapple chunks, the juice of 1 lime, 2 tbsp honey and 2 cups of ice until smooth and slushy. Pour into 4 glasses or hollowed coconut shells. Garnish each with a pineapple wedge and a mint sprig and serve straight away with straws.
T: Back on the water. Bring coconuts.
D: Moana sails out with a new crew to break a storm god's curse and reconnect the islands.
P: Serve the snacks when the Kakamora come paddling up.

title: Raya and the Last Dragon
S: Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, served on skewers with a dipping sauce of fish sauce, lime and sugar.
Rice paper rolls filled with prawns, vermicelli, mint, coriander and lettuce, with a peanut and hoisin dipping sauce.
Noi and her gang of Ongis

Bouncy little steamed cakes of rice flour, coconut milk and pandan, topped with salty coconut cream and toasted coconut, mischievous as Noi's Ongis. Whisk 150g glutinous rice flour, 50g rice flour, 100g caster sugar, 300ml coconut milk and 1 tsp pandan paste until smooth. Pour into 16 small greased cups and steam over boiling water for 15 minutes until set. Cool 20 minutes and turn out. Warm 100ml coconut cream with a pinch of salt and spoon a little over each, then scatter with toasted shredded coconut.
M: the soup Benja makes with something from every land
Jasmine rice simmered in stock with lemongrass and ginger until creamy, topped with prawns, bamboo shoots, chilli and a little palm sugar.
Kumandra five lands beef noodle soup

Star anise and cinnamon beef broth poured over rice noodles and paper-thin raw beef, piled with herbs, bean sprouts, chilli, lime and hoisin. Char 1 halved onion and a 5cm piece of ginger in a dry pan. Simmer with 2L beef stock, 3 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp sugar for 30 minutes, then strain. Freeze 300g sirloin for 30 minutes and slice paper thin. Soak 400g rice noodles and divide between bowls. Top with raw beef and pour over the boiling broth. Serve with bean sprouts, Thai basil, mint, chilli, lime and hoisin.
W: Glutinous rice soaked overnight, steamed and stirred with sweet coconut cream, served with fresh mango and sesame.
K: Tuk Tuk's lemongrass lime iced tea
Tuk Tuk, Raya's giant rolling pill-bug ride

Black tea steeped with bruised lemongrass and palm sugar, chilled and poured over ice with lime and mint, a night market cooler. Bruise 3 lemongrass stalks with the back of a knife and cut into pieces. Pour 1L boiling water over them with 3 black tea bags and 60g palm sugar or brown sugar, stir and steep 5 minutes. Remove the tea bags and leave the lemongrass in as it cools, then strain and chill. Pour over ice in 4 glasses with the juice of half a lime each and a mint sprig.
T: Every land adds to the bowl.
D: A warrior princess searches for the last dragon to bring the divided lands of Kumandra back together.
P: Serve the mains when Raya and her crew sit down to share the soup.

title: Zootopia
S: Judy's family carrot farm in Bunnyburrow
Carrots cut into fries, tossed in oil, smoked paprika and salt, roasted at 220C for 25 minutes until caramelised, with a garlic dip.
Clawhauser and his doughnut at the front desk
Yeasted dough proved, rolled into small balls, fried at 175C until golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar while warm.
the blueberries Judy brings Nick from the family farm

Toasted brioche spread with honey-whipped ricotta, piled with jammy blistered blueberries and toasted almonds, Hopps family farm produce. Whip 250g ricotta with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Cook 250g blueberries with 1 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon in a pan over high heat for 3 minutes until some burst. Toast 4 thick slices of brioche, halve them and spread with the ricotta. Spoon over the warm blueberries and scatter with 30g toasted flaked almonds.
M: the hot desert district of Sahara Square
Chicken thighs browned and slow cooked 90 minutes with onion, preserved lemon, green olives, ginger and saffron, served over fluffy couscous.

Smoked fish and salmon poached in a creamy potato and leek chowder with dill and bacon crumbs, with crusty bread for the snowy district. Fry 100g diced bacon until crisp and set aside. Soften 1 sliced leek in 30g butter, add 500g diced potatoes and 800ml fish stock and simmer 12 minutes. Stir in 300ml cream, then add 250g smoked cod and 250g salmon in chunks and poach gently for 5 minutes. Season, stir in chopped dill and serve topped with the bacon, with crusty bread.
W: the little red paw pops Nick sells

Strawberries and watermelon blended with lime juice and sugar, poured into small ice block moulds with sticks and frozen overnight. Blend 250g strawberries with 500g watermelon, the juice of a lime and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth. Pour into ice block moulds, push in sticks and freeze overnight. Sell them at a good markup, or just hand them out.
K: Kiwifruit, cucumber and mint blended with lime and sugar, topped with soda water over ice.
T: Anyone can be anything. Except hungry.
D: A rookie bunny cop teams up with a con artist fox to solve a missing animals case.
P: Serve dessert when Nick sells his little red paw pops.

title: Wreck-It Ralph
S: the candy racing game Sugar Rush

Dark and white chocolate swirled into a slab and loaded with gummy lollies, honeycomb, marshmallows and sprinkles, smashed into shards. Melt 300g dark chocolate and 150g white chocolate separately. Spread the dark chocolate over a lined 25 x 35cm tray and drizzle with the white, then swirl with a skewer. Scatter over 100g chopped gummy lollies, 50g crushed honeycomb, a handful of mini marshmallows and sprinkles, pressing them in lightly. Chill for 1 hour until set and smash into shards.
the candy go-karts in Sugar Rush
Pretzel rods dipped in melted white chocolate and rolled in sprinkles, set on baking paper.
the alien shooter game Hero's Duty

Corn chips loaded with spiced beef and beans, melted cheddar and pickled jalapeño, blitzed in the oven, with salsa, guacamole and sour cream. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 tsp taco spice, add a drained can of black beans and 100ml water and simmer 5 minutes. Spread 300g corn chips over a large tray, spoon over the beef and scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with tomato salsa, mashed avocado with lime and sour cream.
M: Niceland chicken and leek pot pie

Chicken, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, the kind of pie the Nicelanders bake for Felix. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then remove. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 200g mushrooms in 40g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream. Simmer until thick, add thyme and the chicken and season. Pour into a pie dish, top with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and cut a slit. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Ralph smashing the bricks of the apartment building
Eight huge beef and parmesan meatballs browned and simmered in tomato sauce, then served over a pile of spaghetti.
W: the pies the Nicelanders give Felix
Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, a gold star piped on top.
K: the fizzing mountain in Sugar Rush

Cola poured over a scoop of vanilla ice cream in a tall glass so it froths over the top. Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream into each tall glass. Slowly pour cold cola over the top so it fizzes up and froths over the rim like a volcano. Stand the glasses on plates and serve with long spoons.
T: I'm bad. And that's good. Pass the pie.
D: An arcade game villain tired of being the bad guy goes game-jumping to win a medal.
P: Serve dessert when the Nicelanders hand Felix a pie at the anniversary party.

title: Bolt
S: the cat who taught Bolt to beg

Toasted English muffins piled with creamy tuna, celery and pickle, smothered in melted cheddar and grilled until bubbling, cut into quarters. Mix 2 drained 185g tins of tuna with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 finely diced celery stick, 1 tbsp chopped pickles, a squeeze of lemon and pepper. Split and toast 4 English muffins. Spread the tuna over the 8 halves and top with 150g grated cheddar. Grill for 3 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Cut each half into quarters and serve warm.
Rhino the hamster rolling along in his ball
Cheddar, cream cheese and chives mixed, rolled into small balls and coated in finely chopped walnuts, chilled an hour and served with crackers.
Las Vegas jackpot chilli cheese popcorn
Bolt, Mittens and Rhino passing through Las Vegas

Popcorn tossed in melted butter with finely grated cheddar, parmesan, smoked paprika and a little chilli, hitting the jackpot in every handful. Heat 3 tbsp oil and 120g popcorn kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows. Tip into a large bowl. Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1/2 tsp chilli powder and pour over. Blitz 50g grated cheddar and 30g parmesan to a fine powder and toss through with 1 tsp salt. Serve in paper cones.
M: Lime and garlic chargrilled chicken over coriander rice with black beans, charred corn, avocado, pickled onion and chipotle mayo. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and oil for 30 minutes. Cook 300g rice and stir through chopped coriander. Grill the chicken 5 minutes a side and slice. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Slice 1 red onion and soak in lime juice for 10 minutes. Build bowls with rice, warmed black beans, chicken, corn, avocado, onion and mayo mixed with chipotle.
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash.
W: the lightning bolt on Bolt's side
Shortbread dough of butter, flour and sugar rolled out, cut into lightning bolts, baked at 160C for 15 minutes and iced white once cool.
K: Penny's super bark choc malt thickshake
Penny and Bolt back together at home

Chocolate ice cream, cold milk, malt and cocoa blended thick, with whipped cream and a crushed malt ball lightning bolt on top. Blend 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 600ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp cocoa for 30 seconds until thick. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Top each with whipped cream. Crush a handful of chocolate malt balls and scatter them over in a zigzag like Bolt's lightning bolt. Serve with wide straws.
T: Real dog. Real dinner.
D: A TV dog who thinks his powers are real crosses the country to get home to his person, Penny.
P: Serve the snacks when Mittens teaches Bolt to beg at the RV park.

title: Mary Poppins
S: the tea party on the ceiling with Uncle Albert
Finger sandwiches of cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and ham and mustard, crusts off, on a tiered plate.
the bird woman selling crumbs on the steps of St Paul's

Crunchy seeded crackers of sunflower, pumpkin, linseed and sesame, baked thin, with whipped goat's cheese, honey and cracked pepper. Mix 60g sunflower seeds, 60g pepitas, 40g linseeds, 40g sesame seeds and 30g rolled oats with 1 tbsp chia seeds, 1/2 tsp salt and 200ml boiling water. Rest 15 minutes until thick, then spread thinly between 2 sheets of baking paper. Peel off the top sheet and bake at 160C for 1 hour until crisp, then snap into shards. Whip 150g soft goat's cheese with 2 tbsp milk and serve with honey and pepper.

Golden crimped pastry half-moons packed with peppery beef, potato, swede and onion, baked until the juices bubble, with brown sauce. Mix 400g finely diced chuck steak with 250g diced potato, 150g diced swede, 1 diced onion, 1 tsp salt and plenty of pepper. Cut 4 x 20cm rounds from 4 sheets of shortcrust pastry. Pile the filling onto one half of each, dot with butter, fold over and crimp the edge. Brush with beaten egg, cut a small slit and bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 170C for 40 minutes. Serve with brown sauce.
M: Sunday at the Banks house on Cherry Tree Lane
Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes, peas and gravy.
Old London pie and mash with parsley sauce
the rooftops and streets of old London

Minced beef and onion pies in crisp pastry, with buttery mash and a bright green parsley sauce poured over, the London eel shop way. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 1 tbsp plain flour, 300ml beef stock and pepper, and simmer 20 minutes until thick, then cool. Line 4 pie tins with shortcrust, fill and top with puff pastry. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml stock and simmer, then add a bunch of chopped parsley.
W: Mary and Bert jumping into the chalk pavement drawing

Raspberries blended with sugar syrup and lemon, frozen and scraped every hour until fluffy, served in glass dishes with wafers. Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend 500g raspberries with the syrup and the juice of a lemon, then strain out the seeds. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours. Serve in glass dishes with ice cream wafers.
K: Admiral Boom firing his cannon from the rooftop on Cherry Tree Lane

Fiery ginger and lemon syrup topped with fizzing soda over ice, with a sugar rim and a strip of candied ginger, served on the hour. Simmer 100g caster sugar, 100ml water and a 6cm piece of sliced ginger for 10 minutes, then cool and strain. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lemon and dip in caster sugar. Fill with ice and add 3 tbsp ginger syrup and the juice of a quarter lemon to each. Top with soda water and stir. Garnish with a strip of crystallised ginger.
T: A spoonful of sugar. Then a full plate.
D: A magical nanny arrives at Cherry Tree Lane to look after the Banks children.
P: Serve the snacks when Uncle Albert's tea party floats up to the ceiling.

title: Enchanted
S: Strawberries dipped in white chocolate and dusted with edible glitter, served next to pink meringue kisses baked at 100C for an hour.
Central Park pretzels with cheddar dip
the big song in Central Park

Chewy soft pretzels dipped in a bicarb bath, salted and baked deep brown, with a warm sharp cheddar and mustard dip. Divide 500g pizza dough into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzels. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each for 30 seconds. Brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. For the dip, melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick, then stir in 150g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard until smooth.
Hazelnuts and almonds tossed with honey and cinnamon, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes, cooled on baking paper and broken into clusters.
M: Giselle making breakfast in Robert's apartment
Pancakes, scrambled eggs, crisp bacon and fruit on one big plate, maple syrup on the side.
King and Queen's ball eye fillet
the King and Queen's costume ball where Giselle turns up in blue

Beef eye fillet roasted pink with a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce, potato gratin and grilled asparagus, dinner fit for a fairytale ball. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Sear a seasoned 1kg eye fillet and roast at 200C for 20 minutes, then rest 10 minutes. In the same pan, fry 250g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter, add thyme, 200ml beef stock and 150ml cream, and simmer until thick. Grill 2 bunches asparagus. Slice the beef and spoon over the sauce.
W: Red apples dipped in a hard red toffee of sugar and water cooked to 150C, set on baking paper.
K: True love's kiss pink lemonade float

Homemade raspberry pink lemonade poured over a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up, with fresh raspberries and a mint leaf. Blend 125g raspberries with 100g caster sugar and the juice of 4 lemons, then strain through a sieve. Stir into 800ml chilled soda water in a jug. Put a scoop of lemon sorbet into each of 4 tall glasses and slowly pour over the pink lemonade so it foams up. Drop in a few whole raspberries and a mint leaf, and serve with a spoon and a straw.
T: Fairy tale. Real city. Real dinner.
D: A fairy-tale princess is sent to modern New York and has to find her way.
P: Serve the mains when Giselle cooks breakfast in Robert's apartment.

title: Maleficent
S: Blackberries and raspberries tossed with honey and mint, spooned onto whipped ricotta on toasted brioche.
Pitted black olives blitzed with capers, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil into a rough paste, spread onto toasted baguette slices.
the wall of thorns around the Moors

Puff pastry twisted with parmesan, black pepper and rosemary into spiky thorny sticks, baked crisp and golden, with a smoky tomato dip. Brush 2 thawed puff pastry sheets with beaten egg and scatter with 60g finely grated parmesan, 1 tsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary. Press in, cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each tightly. Bake on lined trays at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp. For the dip, simmer 250ml passata with 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 crushed garlic clove for 10 minutes.
M: Pork shoulder roasted at 160C for 4 hours with crackling, with roasted apples, potatoes and greens. Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and dry overnight. Roast at 160C for 4 hours, adding apple halves and 1kg potato chunks for the last hour. Blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles. Serve with steamed broccolini on a long platter.
Aurora growing up in the woodland cottage

Lamb mince simmered with onion, carrot, thyme and Worcestershire until rich, under fluffy cheesy mash baked golden and crunchy on top. Brown 800g lamb mince, then add 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, thyme and 400ml beef stock, and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Spread the lamb in a dish, top with mash, scatter with 60g cheddar and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: the three pixies making a mess of the cake
Vanilla sponge layers stacked with jam and cream, iced in pastel colours and decorated with edible flowers.
K: Maleficent's green fire matcha lime fizz

Matcha whisked with honey and lime, poured over ice and topped with sparkling water, glowing green like Maleficent's fire, with cucumber and mint. Whisk 2 tsp matcha powder with 100ml warm water until smooth and frothy, then stir in 3 tbsp honey and the juice of 2 limes. Fill 4 glasses with ice, cucumber ribbons and mint leaves. Divide the matcha mix between the glasses and top slowly with sparkling water so it swirls green. Stir gently and serve with a lime wheel.
T: Well, well. Dinner is served.
D: The story of Sleeping Beauty told from the side of the fairy who cursed the princess.
P: Serve dessert when the three pixies try to bake Aurora's birthday cake.

title: Cruella
S: the Baroness's black and white ball
Blinis spread with crème fraîche and topped with black lumpfish roe, beside strawberries half dipped in white chocolate, all on black trays.
Thick chips cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, served in paper with plenty of malt vinegar and salt.
Wink, the little dog who goes everywhere in disguise

Crisp crostini spread with whipped feta and topped with black olive and black sesame spots, finished with chilli honey. Slice a baguette into 20 thin rounds, brush with olive oil and bake at 180C for 10 minutes until crisp. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Spread thickly on the crostini. Dot with finely chopped black olives from 60g and a sprinkle of black sesame seeds to make spots. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey warmed with a pinch of chilli flakes.
M: Beef Wellington of fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles and puff pastry, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. Sear a 1kg beef eye fillet all over and brush with Dijon. Cook 400g chopped mushrooms until dry. Lay prosciutto on plastic wrap, spread with the mushrooms, roll around the beef and chill. Wrap in puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.
Jasper and Horace's full English fry-up
Estella, Jasper and Horace in their hideout

Thick pork sausages, crisp bacon, fried eggs, mushrooms, grilled tomato and baked beans with buttered toast, a hideout fry-up on one plate. Fry 8 thick pork sausages over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning, until browned. Fry 8 bacon rashers alongside until crisp. Halve 4 tomatoes and fry cut side down with 200g sliced mushrooms in butter for 5 minutes. Warm 2 cans baked beans. Fry 4 eggs in the pan fat. Toast and butter 4 thick slices of bread and load everything onto 4 plates with brown sauce.
W: Two chocolate sponges baked at 175C for 30 minutes, split and layered with white chocolate whipped cream, chilled and sliced to show the black and white stripes.
K: the red dress that bursts out of the burning cape at the ball

Deep red hibiscus and raspberry syrup with lime, topped with sparkling water over ice, as loud as the dress reveal. Steep 2 tbsp dried hibiscus flowers in 300ml boiling water for 10 minutes, then strain. Simmer with 125g raspberries and 80g caster sugar for 5 minutes, mash and strain again, then chill. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 60ml syrup and the juice of a quarter lime to each, then top with sparkling water. Garnish with raspberries.
T: Black and white. And red all over.
D: A young fashion designer in 1970s London turns into the infamous Cruella.
P: Serve the snacks when Cruella crashes the Baroness's black and white ball.

title: Beauty and the Beast
S: the busy morning market in Belle's village
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, topped with brie and apple, or goat's cheese and honey, laid out on a wooden board.
Gaston bragging at the tavern about the eggs he eats

Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks mashed with mayo, Dijon and chives, piped back in and dusted with paprika, a big platter of them. Boil 12 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon and snipped chives until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and dust with smoked paprika. Pile onto one big platter, because no one eats eggs like Gaston.
Mrs Potts and Chip serving tea

Crustless finger sandwiches of curried coronation chicken with apricot and almonds, and cucumber with cream cheese, on a tiered stand. Shred 400g roast chicken. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp Greek yoghurt, 2 tsp mild curry powder, 1 tbsp apricot jam, 40g toasted flaked almonds and chopped coriander, then fold through the chicken. Spread 12 slices of soft bread with butter. Make 4 rounds of coronation chicken and 2 of thin cucumber with 100g cream cheese. Trim the crusts and cut each round into 3 fingers.
M: Lumière putting on the dinner show in the castle dining room

Beef chuck braised slow with bacon, mushrooms and baby onions in a rich, glossy stock, served over buttery mash with crusty bread. Brown 150g diced bacon, then brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 12 peeled baby onions and 300g mushrooms and colour lightly. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 750ml beef stock, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer for 3 hours. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and warm milk. Serve with crusty bread.
Belle's father Maurice heading off to market

Chicken thighs braised with leeks, thyme, mustard and a splash of cream until tender, with crusty bread to mop up every bit of sauce. Season 1kg chicken thighs and brown skin side down in a little oil for 6 minutes, then turn and remove. Soften 2 sliced leeks in 20g butter, add 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme, then pour in 300ml chicken stock and 1 tbsp Dijon mustard. Return the chicken, cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in 100ml cream and bubble for 5 minutes. Serve with crusty bread.
W: Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with vanilla custard, topped with thin apple slices fanned into a rose and glazed with apricot jam.
K: Peach nectar, orange and a touch of vanilla topped with sparkling apple juice, glowing gold like Belle's ball gown, with peach slices. In a big jug, mix 750ml chilled peach nectar, the juice of 2 oranges and 1/2 tsp vanilla. Add 1 sliced orange and 1 sliced fresh peach. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling apple juice. Stir gently and pour into wide glasses so a peach slice lands in each.
T: Be our guest. Bring an appetite.
D: A bookish young woman takes her father's place as the Beast's prisoner in his enchanted castle.
P: Serve the mains when Lumière throws Belle a dinner show in the castle dining room.

title: Aladdin
S: Aladdin running through the market with stolen bread
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar, grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus and labneh.
Abu the monkey grabbing whatever he can
Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter, dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed pistachios.

Crunchy golden falafel bright green inside with herbs and cumin, with lemony tahini, pickled turnip and warm pita, treasure from the Cave of Wonders. Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight and drain well. Blitz with 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch of parsley, a bunch of coriander, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp bicarb soda until fine. Shape into 20 balls and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Whisk 100g tahini with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and about 80ml water. Serve with pickled turnip and warm pita.
M: the big parade into the city
Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, cumin, cinnamon and paprika, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, pulled over saffron rice with almonds and sultanas.

Chicken thighs slow cooked with onion, dried apricots, ginger, saffron and honey until sticky, over herby couscous with toasted almonds. Brown 1kg chicken thighs in oil and remove. Soften 2 sliced onions, add 2 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin and a pinch of saffron. Return the chicken with 500ml chicken stock, 150g dried apricots and 2 tbsp honey. Cover and simmer 45 minutes, then uncover and cook 15 minutes until sticky. Pour 300g couscous into 375ml boiling stock, cover 5 minutes, fluff and stir through herbs and 40g toasted almonds.
W: Filo layered with butter, pistachios, walnuts and cardamom, cut into diamonds, baked at 180C for 40 minutes and soaked in honey syrup.
K: Butterfly pea and fresh mint tea sweetened with honey, poured over ice glowing blue, then a squeeze of lemon turns it violet. Pour 1L boiling water over 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers and a big handful of mint leaves, steep 10 minutes, then strain. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and chill for 2 hours. Fill 4 glasses with ice and fresh mint and pour in the blue tea. Serve with lemon wedges so everyone can squeeze one in and watch it change colour.
T: One jump ahead. One plate behind.
D: A street thief in Agrabah finds a magic lamp and a genie, and tries to win the heart of Princess Jasmine.
P: Serve the snacks when Aladdin runs through the Agrabah market with the bread.

title: The Lion King
S: Timon and Pumbaa showing Simba the grubs
Rice noodles fried at 190C until they puff into crunchy grubs, tossed with chilli salt and lime, piled on a leaf.
Rockmelon, papaya, mango and passionfruit cut into wedges, with lime and a sprinkle of chilli salt.
Pride Rock beef samosas with mint yoghurt

Spiced beef mince with onion, peas and garam masala folded into pastry triangles, fried until crisp, with mint yoghurt. Fry 1 diced onion in oil until soft, add 400g beef mince, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin and 2 grated garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes. Stir in 1 cup frozen peas and season, then cool. Cut 6 sheets spring roll pastry into 3 long strips each, fold a spoonful of filling into triangles and seal with flour paste. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp. Stir chopped mint and a squeeze of lemon into 200g Greek yoghurt for dipping.
M: Pride Lands braai rump with pap and relish
the open savannah of the Pride Lands

Beef rump steaks rubbed with paprika, coriander and garlic, grilled over coals, sliced with pap and a tomato and onion relish. Rub 800g rump steak with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground coriander, 2 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt and stand 30 minutes. For the relish, fry 2 sliced onions until soft, add 4 chopped tomatoes and a pinch of chilli and simmer 15 minutes. Whisk 250g white maize meal into 1L salted boiling water and stir over low heat for 20 minutes until thick, then beat in 30g butter. Grill the steak over hot coals 4 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice over the pap with relish.
Simba growing up in the jungle with Timon and Pumbaa
Chicken thighs marinated in peri peri of chilli, lemon, garlic and paprika, grilled until charred, with yellow rice.
W: South African malva pudding of apricot jam sponge baked at 180C for 40 minutes, soaked in a hot cream and butter sauce, with custard.
K: Watering hole peach rooibos iced tea
the watering hole on the savannah

Rooibos steeped with honey and orange peel, chilled and poured over ice with sliced ripe peach, fresh mint and a splash of sparkling water. Steep 4 rooibos tea bags and the peel of 1 orange in 1L just-boiled water for 8 minutes. Remove the bags and peel, stir in 3 tbsp honey and chill for at least 2 hours. Slice 2 ripe peaches. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and peach slices, pour in the tea to three quarters full and top each with a splash of sparkling water and a sprig of mint.
T: No worries. Plenty of snacks.
D: A young lion prince runs from his kingdom after his father's death and has to come back to claim it.
P: Serve the snacks when Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba to eat grubs.

title: Mary Poppins Returns
S: Crumpets toasted until crisp at the edges, loaded with whipped honey butter that melts into every hole, golden syrup on the side for drizzling. Beat 100g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of flaky salt until pale and fluffy. Toast 8 crumpets under a hot grill or in the toaster for about 3 minutes until crisp on the edges and golden on top. Spread the honey butter on straight away so it sinks into the holes. Stack on a warm plate and serve with a jug of golden syrup.
Cousin Topsy's fix-it shop that turns upside down
Upside-down toasts: bread pressed onto a pan of melted cheddar and fried until a lacy cheese crust forms, flipped and served.
the bathtub that turns into an ocean

Poached prawns on shredded lettuce in small glasses with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and lemon. Peel and devein 600g cooked king prawns, leaving a few tails on for the rims. Mix 120g whole egg mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a few drops of Tabasco and the juice of half a lemon. Shred half an iceberg lettuce and divide between 4 glasses. Pile the prawns on top, spoon over the sauce, dust with a pinch of paprika and serve with lemon wedges.
M: Cherry Tree Lane chicken, leek and ham pie
the Banks family home on Cherry Tree Lane

Chicken, leek and ham in a creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with buttered peas. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 30g butter and set aside. Soften 2 sliced leeks in the same pan, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken, 150g diced ham and chopped thyme and season. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with 1 sheet puff pastry, cut a slit and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 2 cups peas tossed in butter.
the music hall show inside the painted bowl
Thick pork sausages browned slowly, served on buttery mash with an onion gravy cooked down for 20 minutes, and peas.
W: the balloon lady in the park
Shortcrust rounds filled with strawberry, apricot and blackcurrant jam, baked at 190C for 15 minutes.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup shaken with muddled strawberries and mint, topped with soda water and served over ice in tall glasses. Simmer 100g caster sugar with 100ml water until dissolved, then cool. Muddle 250g hulled strawberries with a handful of mint leaves in a jug. Add the syrup and the juice of 5 lemons and stir well. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, divide the strawberry lemon mix between them and top with 600ml chilled soda water. Garnish with half a strawberry and a mint sprig.
T: The cover is not the book. Neither is the menu.
D: Mary Poppins comes back to Cherry Tree Lane to help the grown-up Banks children through hard times.
P: Serve the snacks when Jack and the lamplighters light up the London streets.

title: The Parent Trap
S: Camp Walden choc biscuits and PB dip
the twins dunking chocolate biscuits in peanut butter in the isolation cabin

Chocolate cream sandwich biscuits with a whipped peanut butter and honey dip, salted pretzels on the side for the sweet and salty dunk. Beat 200g smooth peanut butter with 100g softened cream cheese, 2 tbsp honey, a pinch of salt and 60ml milk until light and fluffy. Spoon into a bowl and swirl a little extra honey through the top. Pile 2 packets of chocolate cream sandwich biscuits and 150g salted pretzels on a platter around the dip and let everyone dunk.
Aged cheddar, brie and goat's cheese on a board with bunches of red grapes, fig jam, toasted walnuts and crackers.
Scones of self-raising flour, cream and lemonade, baked at 220C for 15 minutes, with jam and clotted cream.
M: the twins recreating their parents' first date dinner
Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and green beans, served by candlelight.
Camping trip snags with fried onions
the camping trip where Meredith gets pranked

Thick beef sausages grilled on the barbecue, tucked into soft rolls with sticky fried onions and mustard, smoky baked beans on the side. Slice 3 onions and cook slowly in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 20 minutes until golden and sticky, adding a pinch of brown sugar at the end. Grill 8 thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 minutes, turning often. Warm 2 tins baked beans with 1 tsp smoked paprika. Split 8 soft rolls, add a sausage, pile on onions and finish with mustard. Serve the beans on the side.
W: the London twin's pudding, strawberries and cream
Crushed meringue, softly whipped cream and quartered strawberries folded together in glasses, with a drizzle of strawberry purée sweetened with a little sugar.
K: Napa Valley grape and rosemary spritz

Chilled red grape juice with fresh lime and a rosemary syrup, topped with sparkling water and frozen grapes, served in wine glasses like the grown-ups. Simmer 60g caster sugar, 60ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. Freeze a bunch of red grapes for 2 hours. Mix 600ml chilled red grape juice with the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lime. Drop frozen grapes into 4 wine glasses, pour in the juice and top each with 80ml sparkling water. Finish with a small rosemary sprig.
T: Twins swap. Dinner stays.
D: Identical twins meet at summer camp and swap places to get their parents back together.
P: Serve the snacks when Hallie and Annie share biscuits dipped in peanut butter.

title: Freaky Friday
S: the Chinese restaurant where the curse starts
Pork, cabbage, carrot and vermicelli rolled in pastry, fried at 180C until crisp, with sweet chilli sauce.
Anna's band rehearsing in the garage
Bite-size chicken thigh in crunchy paprika panko crumbs, shallow fried golden and served with honey mustard for dipping.
Rehearsal dinner salmon blinis and melon

Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and chives, beside wedges of rockmelon wrapped in thin prosciutto, on silver trays. Warm 24 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of half a lemon and a pinch of salt. Top each blini with a spoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon from 150g and a few snipped chives. Cut half a rockmelon into 12 thin wedges, remove the skin and wrap each in a slice of prosciutto from 100g. Arrange both on a silver tray with lemon wedges.
M: Chicken thigh pieces battered and fried crisp, tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesame and steamed rice.
the chaos the night before the wedding

Chicken strips seared, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes added with cream, spinach wilted through, tossed with penne and parmesan. Cook 400g penne in salted water until al dente. Slice 600g chicken breast into strips, season and sear in olive oil until golden, then set aside. In the same pan fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and 80g chopped sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute, pour in 300ml cream and simmer 3 minutes. Add 2 big handfuls baby spinach and stir until wilted. Toss through the chicken, pasta and 50g grated parmesan, loosening with pasta water. Serve with extra parmesan and black pepper.
W: the fortune cookies that swap them
Thin batter of egg white, sugar, flour and vanilla baked at 180C in small rounds for 6 minutes, folded around paper fortunes while hot.
K: Lychee jasmine iced tea with lime
the Chinese restaurant where Pei-Pei's mum hands over the fortune cookies

Jasmine tea brewed, chilled and shaken with lychee syrup and lime, poured over ice with whole lychees and topped with a splash of soda. Steep 4 jasmine tea bags in 800ml hot water at about 85C for 4 minutes, remove the bags and chill. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Mix the cold tea with 120ml lychee syrup and the juice of 1 lime. Fill 4 glasses with ice and 3 lychees each, pour over the tea and top with a splash of soda water and a lime wheel.
T: Mind the fortune cookie.
D: A mother and daughter swap bodies after a fortune cookie curse, the day before the mum's wedding.
P: Serve dessert when the fortune cookies arrive at the Chinese restaurant.

title: The Muppets
S: the big telethon to save the Muppet Theater

A cob loaf cut deep in a crisscross, stuffed with cheddar, mozzarella and garlic chive butter, baked until bubbling for everyone manning the phones. Cut a cob loaf in a crisscross pattern about 3cm apart, going deep but not through the base. Melt 100g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and a handful of chopped chives. Push 150g grated cheddar and 150g grated mozzarella into the cuts and spoon the garlic butter over. Wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes, then open the foil and bake 10 minutes more until the cheese bubbles. Put it in the middle of the table and pull apart.
the Swedish Chef in the kitchen
Pork and beef meatballs with onion and allspice, browned and simmered in a creamy gravy, served with lingonberry jam on toothpicks.
Gary and Walter's home town of Smalltown
Thick fries cooked twice until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce.
M: Mary's anniversary dinner in Los Angeles

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and rice pilaf. Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket into the side of 4 chicken breasts and stuff with the mixture, closing with toothpicks. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 1 cup basmati with a little butter and 2 cups stock, covered, for 15 minutes. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and parsley for the sauce and spoon over the sliced chicken.
Miss Piggy working at the fashion magazine in Paris
Steak frites of sirloin seared and rested, with thin fries and a béarnaise of yolks, butter and tarragon. Not pork.
W: Biscuit base topped with a pale green peppermint icing and a dark chocolate top, chilled and cut into squares.
K: Orange, pineapple and cranberry juice layered over ice and topped with lemonade.
T: Put on a show. Put on the kettle.
D: Walter, Gary and Mary get the Muppets back together to save their old theatre from an oil baron.
P: Serve the snacks when the telethon finally goes live.

title: A Bug's Life
S: the seed and grain offering the ants gather
Sunflower, pumpkin, linseed and sesame seeds mixed with chia and water, spread thin, baked at 160C for an hour, broken into shards.
the berries the ants carry across Ant Island
Blueberries and raspberries threaded onto toothpicks with small cubes of feta and a mint leaf, laid out in neat marching lines on a platter.

Popcorn coated in a crunchy brown sugar and butter caramel, baked until glassy, sprinkled with sea salt and handed out in striped cones. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a lidded pot and tip into a big roasting tin. Boil 100g butter, 200g brown sugar, 60ml golden syrup and a pinch of salt for 4 minutes, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb so it foams. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, then spread out to cool and break apart. Sprinkle with flaky salt.
M: the big city made of rubbish

Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and broccoli in an oyster sauce, served in takeaway boxes. Soak 400g fresh egg noodles in hot water for 2 minutes and drain. Slice 500g chicken thigh and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Stir-fry in a very hot wok with oil for 4 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry 1 sliced red capsicum, 1 head broccoli in small florets and 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes with a splash of water. Add the noodles, chicken, 3 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy and toss for 2 minutes. Serve in takeaway boxes with spring onion.
Corn, potato and bacon simmered in stock and milk with onion and thyme, finished with cream and chives.
W: Heimlich the caterpillar finally getting his wings
Shortbread dough rolled out and cut into butterflies, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced in bright colours once cool.
K: the giant dewdrops on the leaves
Cucumber and mint blended with lime and sugar, strained and topped with soda water over ice.
T: Gather the harvest. Keep some for yourself.
D: An inventive ant hires a troupe of circus bugs he thinks are warriors to stand up to the grasshoppers.
P: Serve the snacks when the ants pile up the harvest offering.

title: Toy Story 4
S: Cocktail franks dipped in a cornmeal batter, fried at 180C until golden, with mustard and tomato sauce.
Forky, made from a spork at kindergarten
Little cups of chopped salad of corn, tomato, cucumber and avocado with lime, each with a spork to eat it.
Ducky and Bunny's cinnamon kettle corn
Ducky and Bunny stuck on the carnival prize wall

Old-school carnival kettle corn popped with sugar and salt in one pot, dusted with cinnamon and served warm in red and white striped bags. Heat 3 tbsp vegetable oil in a large lidded pot over medium-high heat with 3 test kernels. When they pop, add 100g popcorn kernels and 60g caster sugar and cover. Shake the pot constantly as it pops so the sugar doesn't burn. When the popping slows to a few seconds apart, tip straight into a big bowl. Toss with 1 tsp fine salt and 1 tsp cinnamon while hot, then split into paper bags.
M: Thick-cut chips piled with shredded chicken and melty cheese, drowned in hot gravy, Canadian style.
Second Chance Antiques chicken pot pie
the antique store where Gabby Gabby waits

Chicken pot pie with leek and mushroom in a creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 30g butter and set aside. Cook 1 sliced leek and 200g sliced mushrooms in the same pan for 6 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 350ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken and chopped thyme and season. Spoon into a pie dish, lay 1 sheet puff pastry over, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
W: Batter piped in swirls into hot oil, fried golden, dusted with icing sugar and served with strawberries.
K: the hot day at the carnival

Strawberries, lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with ice into a thick slushie, poured into big cups with a straw and a strawberry on the rim. Simmer 100g caster sugar with 100ml water until dissolved and cool. Blend 400g frozen strawberries with the juice of 4 lemons, the syrup, 250ml cold water and 3 cups ice until thick and slushy. Taste and add more syrup if it's too sharp. Pour into 4 big cups and serve straight away with straws and a fresh strawberry on each rim.
T: Road trip. Carnival food.
D: Woody goes after Forky, a spork turned toy, and finds Bo Peep at a travelling carnival.
P: Serve the snacks when the toys sneak into the carnival.

title: Finding Dory
S: Nori sheets brushed with sesame oil, sprinkled with sesame seeds and salt, toasted in a dry pan until crisp, cut into strips.
Colourful fruit laid out in patches so it hides in plain sight, like Hank, with vanilla yoghurt for dipping.
the trail of shells that leads Dory home

Cheddar cracker dough of cheese, butter and flour rolled thin, cut into shell shapes and baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Rub 100g cold diced butter into 150g plain flour with a pinch of salt and half a teaspoon of smoked paprika. Stir in 150g finely grated vintage cheddar and bring together with 2 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes, then roll out 3mm thick between baking paper. Cut into shell shapes with a small cutter and press lines in with a fork. Bake on a lined tray at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Cool before serving with a chive sour cream dip.
M: the Marine Life Institute in California
Chicken thighs grilled with lime and chilli, over rice with avocado, corn, black beans and salsa.
Ocean green pesto pasta with peas

Orecchiette tossed with basil pesto, sweet peas, baby spinach and lemon, finished with parmesan and toasted nori crumbs for a taste of the sea. Cook 400g orecchiette in salted water, adding 2 cups frozen peas for the last 2 minutes. Toast 2 nori sheets over a flame until crisp and crumble them. Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water. Toss the pasta and peas with 190g basil pesto, 2 handfuls baby spinach, the zest and juice of half a lemon and 50g grated parmesan, adding pasta water until glossy. Serve topped with the nori crumbs and more parmesan.
W: Blue jelly set in glasses with whipped cream and a slice of orange on top for Nemo.
K: the open ocean where Dory finds her parents
Lemonade with blue colouring and a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top.
T: Just keep snacking.
D: Dory sets off to find the family she lost as a child, with help from Marlin, Nemo and an octopus called Hank.
P: Serve the snacks when Hank sneaks Dory through the Marine Life Institute.

title: The Incredibles 2
S: Jack-Jack and the cookie that calms him down
Chewy chocolate chip cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes, still soft in the middle, piled on a plate.
Violet's date at the Happy Platter

Beef sliders with cheddar and pickles on soft buns, with a little bowl of fries. Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small balls and season. Smash them thin onto a very hot greased pan or flat plate and cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip and top each with a quarter slice of cheddar for 1 minute more. Toast 12 slider buns. Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for burger sauce. Build each bun with sauce, a patty and pickle slices. Serve with a bowl of 500g oven fries baked at 220C for 20 minutes.
Puff pastry spread with pesto and parmesan, rolled, sliced into spirals and baked at 200C for 15 minutes.
M: Bob trying to help Dash with maths
Spaghetti bolognese of beef, carrot, celery and tomato simmered an hour, with parmesan and garlic bread.
Edna's lemon dill salmon and asparagus
