Salmon fillets roasted with lemon and dill, with crushed potatoes and asparagus, plated very neatly. Halve 600g baby potatoes and boil 15 minutes until tender, then drain and lightly crush with 30g butter, salt and chopped dill. Lay 4 salmon fillets on a lined tray, season, top with lemon slices and dill and drizzle with oil. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Add 2 bunches trimmed asparagus to the tray for the last 6 minutes. Plate neatly with the crushed potatoes and a spoon of crème fraîche mixed with lemon zest.
W: Jack-Jack battling the raccoon in the yard
Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into squares with a glass of milk.
K: Fresh lemonade turned red with a quick raspberry syrup and served over ice.
T: Cookie num num.
D: Helen heads out on a hero mission while Bob stays home with the kids and a baby with too many powers.
P: Serve dessert when Jack-Jack fights the raccoon for a cookie.

title: Brave
S: Jammy soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sage and pepper sausage meat, crumbed and fried until golden, halved and served with wholegrain mustard. Boil 6 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Mix 500g sausage meat with sage and pepper, wrap around each egg, roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 170C for 8 minutes. Halve and serve with mustard.
Elinor as a bear learning to catch fish in the river
Oatcakes spread with cream cheese, topped with folds of smoked salmon, dill and a squeeze of lemon, laid out on a slate.
Merida's little brothers pinching the tarts

Shortcrust rounds pressed into a patty tin, filled with raspberry jam, baked at 190C for 15 minutes and dusted with icing sugar. Roll 2 sheets shortcrust pastry to 3mm and cut 12 rounds with an 8cm cutter. Press into a greased patty tin and prick the bases. Spoon 1 heaped teaspoon of raspberry jam into each, no more or it will bubble over. Bake at 190C for 15 minutes until the pastry is golden. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, as the jam is very hot, then lift out and dust with icing sugar. Serve with whipped cream.
M: DunBroch braised lamb, neeps and tatties
the great hall feast at DunBroch

Lamb shoulder braised 3 hours with onion, carrots, barley and stock, served with mashed neeps and tatties. Season 1.5kg lamb shoulder and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 chopped onions, 3 chunky carrots, 75g pearl barley, 2 rosemary sprigs and 750ml chicken stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until it pulls apart. Boil 800g peeled potatoes and 600g swede separately until soft. Mash the potatoes with 50g butter and milk, and the swede with 30g butter and pepper. Serve the lamb and barley over both mashes with the juices.
Lamb neck simmered with barley, leek, carrot and turnip for 2 hours, finished with parsley.
W: the cake from the witch that changes Elinor
A spiced honey cake with oats and berries, baked at 175C for 40 minutes, glazed with honey and topped with a raspberry.
K: Raspberries blended with milk, honey and toasted oats, poured into tall glasses with cream on top.
T: Change your fate. Not the cake.
D: A Scottish princess's wish to change her fate turns her mother into a bear.
P: Serve dessert when Merida feeds her mum the witch's cake.

title: Monsters University
S: Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky honey barbecue glaze, with ranch dip.
Squishy's mum looking after the Oozma Kappa boys at home

Cocktail franks wrapped in buttery puff pastry with a sprinkle of sesame, baked until golden and served with a honey mustard dip. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 24 strips. Wrap a strip around each of 24 cocktail franks, sealing the end underneath. Lay on a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon mustard with 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayo for the dip and serve the franks hot.

Crisp oven fries smothered in a hot cheddar cheese sauce, finished with spring onion and pickled jalapeños for a bit of a scare. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 300ml milk until thick and stir in 150g grated cheddar. Pour over the chips and top with sliced spring onion and pickled jalapeños.
M: the dining hall at Monsters University

Pizza dough topped with tomato, mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms, baked at 250C for 10 minutes, cut into squares. Stretch 500g pizza dough into a large oiled baking tray and rest 15 minutes. Spread with 150g passata mixed with 1 tsp dried oregano and a crushed garlic clove. Scatter 250g grated mozzarella, 100g sliced pepperoni and 150g sliced button mushrooms. Bake at 250C on the lowest shelf for 10 to 12 minutes until the base is crisp and the cheese blisters. Rest 2 minutes, cut into squares and finish with chilli flakes.
Spaghetti with beef meatballs simmered in tomato sauce, with garlic bread, a big pot for the study group.
W: Sulley's blue fur with purple spots
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with shaggy blue buttercream and purple sprinkles.
K: Mike Wazowski, one big green eye
Cloudy apple juice with soda water, lime and mint, tinted green with an apple round floating on top.
T: Scare Games tonight. Snacks first.
D: Mike and Sulley start out as rivals at university and end up in the Scare Games with a frat of misfits.
P: Serve the snacks when the Oozma Kappas move into the Scare Games.

title: Cars
S: Luigi's Casa Della Tires in Radiator Springs

Thick onion rings dunked in a fizzy soda water batter, fried until crunchy and stacked like tyres, with a smoky chipotle mayo. Slice 3 large brown onions into 1.5cm rings and separate. Whisk 150g plain flour, 50g cornflour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 300ml ice-cold soda water into a smooth batter. Heat oil to 180C. Dust the rings in flour, dip in batter and fry in batches for 3 minutes until golden. Drain and salt. Mix 150g mayo with 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime. Stack the rings on skewers like tyres and serve with the dip.
the motel built from traffic cones

Curly fries baked crisp and tossed with smoked paprika salt, served in paper cones like Sally's motel rooms with lemony garlic aioli. Spread 1kg frozen curly fries on 2 lined trays and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika with 1 tsp sea salt and a pinch of garlic powder and toss through the hot fries. Stir the zest of half a lemon into 150g garlic aioli. Roll baking paper into 4 cones, fill with fries and serve with the aioli for dipping.
Corn cobs boiled 6 minutes, brushed with butter mixed with chilli and lime, and charred on a hot grill until blistered.
M: Beef patties grilled with cheddar melted on, stacked with bacon and fried onion on toasted buns, with crinkle fries cooked twice.
the old Route 66 through the desert

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. For cornbread, mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, whipped cream and a cherry on top.
K: Cola with a scoop of vanilla ice cream in tall glasses.
T: Ka-chow. Pass the fries.
D: A hotshot race car gets stuck in a forgotten Route 66 town on the way to a big race.
P: Serve the mains when Lightning pulls into Flo's café in Radiator Springs.

title: Cars 2
S: the glitzy welcome party in Tokyo
Edamame boiled in salted water for 4 minutes, drained and tossed while hot with sesame oil, chilli flakes and flaky salt, piled into small bowls.
Mater and Lightning's race stop in Paris
Thin crêpe batter rested an hour, cooked in a buttered pan, filled with ham and gruyère, folded into quarters and crisped again, cut into triangles.
London chip shop chips with curry sauce
the final race through the streets of London

Thick-cut chips fried twice until crunchy, salted and served in paper cones with a mild chip shop curry sauce and malt vinegar. Cut 1kg washed potatoes into thick chips and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, drain and cool, then fry at 190C for 3 minutes until crisp and golden. For the sauce, soften 1 diced onion in 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp mild curry powder and 1 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 400ml chicken stock, 1 tbsp sultanas and 1 tsp honey. Simmer 10 minutes and blitz smooth. Salt the chips and serve with sauce and vinegar.
M: the race in the Italian seaside town of Porto Corsa
Garlic and chilli softened in olive oil, prawns and cherry tomatoes added with a splash of white wine until the prawns turn pink, tossed through spaghetti with parsley.
Luigi's Uncle Topolino in his little Italian village

Chicken thighs browned and simmered 45 minutes with tomato, olives, capsicum and rosemary until the sauce is thick, served with crusty bread. Season 8 chicken thigh pieces on the bone and brown in olive oil, skin side first, then set aside. Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced red capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in the pan. Add 2 rosemary sprigs, a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and 125ml chicken stock. Return the chicken, cover and simmer 45 minutes. Stir in 80g pitted kalamata olives for the last 10 minutes. Serve with a torn crusty loaf for the sauce.
W: the wasabi Mater thinks is pistachio ice cream
Pistachio ice cream scooped into chilled bowls, scattered with crushed roasted pistachios and drizzled with honey. Wasabi optional.
K: Blood orange and lemon juice with a touch of honey syrup, topped with sparkling water over ice and garnished with orange and mint. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp warm water to make a quick syrup. Mix 400ml blood orange juice with the juice of 1 lemon and the honey syrup. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and a thin orange slice each. Pour in the juice mix to half full and top with 400ml cold sparkling water. Finish with a mint sprig and serve straight away.
T: That's not pistachio.
D: Lightning heads to the World Grand Prix while Mater gets mistaken for a secret agent.
P: Serve dessert when Mater eats the wasabi in Tokyo thinking it's ice cream.

title: Soul
S: 22 tasting a lollipop for the first time in Joe's body
Sugar, glucose and water boiled to 150C, coloured and poured into rounds on baking paper with sticks pressed in, left to harden 20 minutes.
22 chatting with Dez in the barber's chair
Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers and thin red onion.
Half Note smoky nuts and warm olives
the Half Note jazz club where Joe gets his chance

Almonds and cashews roasted with smoked paprika, honey and salt, served warm beside olives heated through with orange peel, garlic and rosemary. Toss 150g almonds and 150g cashews with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp sea salt. Roast on a lined tray at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once, and cool for 5 minutes so they crisp. Warm 250g mixed olives in a small pan with 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 strips orange peel, 2 smashed garlic cloves and a rosemary sprig for 5 minutes. Serve both in small bowls.
M: 22 tasting her first slice of New York pizza
Pizza dough stretched thin, spread with tomato sauce and mozzarella, baked on a hot tray at 250C until blistered, dusted with oregano and folded to eat.
Libba's lemon roast chicken and mac cheese
Joe's mum Libba and her tailor shop

Chicken roasted with lemon and thyme at 200C for 75 minutes, served with baked macaroni cheese and garlicky sautéed silverbeet. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, salt and thyme, put a halved lemon inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Cook 300g macaroni until just al dente. Melt 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, whisk in 600ml milk until thick and stir in 200g grated cheddar. Mix with the pasta, tip into a dish, top with 50g more cheddar and breadcrumbs and bake 20 minutes alongside the chicken. Sauté a bunch of silverbeet with garlic and oil to serve.
W: the maple seed that spins into Joe's hand
Butter, brown sugar and maple syrup creamed with an egg, flour and chopped pecans folded in, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
K: Joe's New York, the city 22 finally falls for

The old New York soda fountain classic of chocolate syrup and cold milk, hit with soda water and stirred hard until a thick white foam rises. Make a chocolate syrup by whisking 60g cocoa, 120g caster sugar and 125ml water over low heat for 3 minutes, then stir in a dash of vanilla and chill. Spoon 3 tbsp syrup into each of 4 tall glasses and add 120ml very cold full cream milk. Pour in 150ml cold soda water quickly while stirring hard with a long spoon until a thick foam rises to the top. Serve straight away.
T: Pizza tastes better on Earth.
D: A jazz teacher's soul gets separated from his body right before his big break.
P: Serve the mains when 22 tastes New York pizza for the first time.

title: Luca
S: Luca and Alberto trying gelato for the first time
Vanilla ice cream and lemon sorbet scooped into small cups side by side, topped with crushed amaretti biscuits and a little lemon zest.
Giulia's dad Massimo working the harbour
Grated zucchini squeezed dry, mixed with ricotta, egg, parmesan and flour, fried in spoonfuls until golden, served with lemon wedges.
Luca and Alberto dreaming of a Vespa

Focaccia dough proved twice, dimpled with olive oil, rosemary and sea salt, baked at 220C for 20 minutes until golden. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 10g salt and 400ml lukewarm water into a wet dough and rest 30 minutes. Stretch and fold it 4 times over the next hour, then pour 60ml olive oil into a 30 x 20cm tin, tip in the dough and leave to rise 1 hour. Dimple all over with oiled fingers, push in rosemary sprigs, drizzle with more oil and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake at 220C for 20 minutes until deep golden.
M: the pasta-eating leg of the Portorosso Cup
Linguine cooked with sliced potato and green beans in the same pot, drained and tossed with fresh pesto of basil, pine nuts, garlic and parmesan.
Riviera fish, prawn and mussel stew
the little fishing town on the Italian Riviera

Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, garlic and white wine broth for 10 minutes until the shells open, with crusty bread. Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced fennel bulb and 4 sliced garlic cloves in olive oil for 8 minutes. Add a pinch of chilli, a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and 650ml fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Add 500g firm white fish in chunks and 8 green prawns, simmer 3 minutes, then add 500g cleaned mussels, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the shells open. Throw away any that stay shut. Finish with parsley and serve with toasted crusty bread.
W: Ricotta, lemon zest, eggs and sugar beaten smooth, self-raising flour folded in, baked at 170C for 45 minutes and dusted with icing sugar.
K: Fresh lemon juice shaken with a basil sugar syrup, topped with soda water over ice and finished with a strip of lemon peel and basil. Simmer 100g caster sugar and 100ml water until dissolved, take off the heat, add a handful of basil leaves and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with 700ml cold soda water. Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add a small basil sprig.
T: Silenzio, Bruno. Eat the pasta.
D: Two sea monster boys hide in human form in an Italian seaside town for one summer.
P: Serve the mains when the Portorosso Cup gets to the pasta-eating leg.

title: Turning Red
S: Mei's dad cooking in the family kitchen
Pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger and spring onion, pan-fried until crisp underneath, then steamed with a splash of water, with black vinegar to dip.
Mei and her friends saving up for the 4*Town concert

Bite-size chicken thigh marinated in soy and five spice, coated in sweet potato flour, fried crisp and tossed with fried basil and chilli salt. Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-size pieces and marinate 30 minutes with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp five spice, 2 grated garlic cloves and 1 tsp sugar. Toss in 100g sweet potato flour or cornflour. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp, then drain. Fry a handful of basil leaves for 10 seconds. Mix 1 tsp salt, half a teaspoon white pepper and half a teaspoon chilli powder and toss through the chicken and basil. Serve in paper bags.
the family temple Mei helps look after
Frozen bao buns filled with a spoon of sweet red bean paste, pinched closed and steamed 12 minutes until soft and puffy.
M: dinner at the Lee family table
Chicken thighs braised in soy, ginger, star anise and a little sugar for 40 minutes until glossy, with steamed rice and garlic bok choy.

Beef strips seared hot in a wok, broccoli and garlic tossed through, finished with oyster sauce and served over egg noodles. Slice 500g rump steak thinly and toss with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp oil. Blanch 1 large head broccoli in florets for 1 minute and drain. Loosen 400g fresh egg noodles in hot water. Sear the beef in a smoking wok in 2 batches for 1 minute each and set aside. Stir-fry 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp ginger for 30 seconds, add the broccoli, beef, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy and 60ml water and toss. Serve over the noodles.
W: the ritual that seals the red panda away

Mango purée warmed with sugar and gelatine, stirred into evaporated milk, set in glasses for 4 hours, topped with fresh mango. Blend 2 mangoes into a puree and warm with 80g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in until dissolved. Stir in 250ml evaporated milk. Pour into glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with diced fresh mango.
K: Mei, Miriam, Priya and Abby saving up for 4*Town

Strong black tea with milk and brown sugar syrup, poured over cooked tapioca pearls and ice. Cook tapioca pearls as the packet says and soak in syrup of brown sugar and water. Brew 4 strong black tea bags in 500ml water and cool. Spoon pearls into glasses, add ice, pour over the tea and top with milk. Serve with wide straws.
T: Big feelings. Bigger dumplings.
D: A thirteen-year-old in Toronto turns into a giant red panda whenever she gets too excited.
P: Serve the mains when the Lee family sits down to dinner.

title: Elemental
S: the spicy snacks sold at the Fireplace shop
Cashews and peanuts tossed with chilli flakes, smoked paprika and honey, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes until glossy and hot.

Flatbreads brushed with harissa stirred into olive oil, grilled until charred at the edges, torn and served with thick labneh. Mix 300g self-raising flour with 300g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 1 minute. Divide into 4 and roll each into a thin oval. Stir 2 tbsp harissa into 3 tbsp olive oil. Cook the flatbreads on a very hot dry pan or grill for 2 minutes a side until puffed and charred at the edges, brushing with the harissa oil as they come off. Spread 250g labneh on a plate, drizzle with oil and za'atar and serve with the torn flatbreads.
Thick cucumber rounds topped with feta whipped with Greek yoghurt and lemon, finished with dill and cracked pepper.
M: Ember's dad Bernie and the shop he built
Lamb shoulder browned, braised with harissa, tomato, chickpeas and cumin at 160C for 3 hours until it pulls apart, with warm flatbread.
dinner with Wade's family in their high-rise

Salmon gently poached in a light broth of ginger, soy and spring onion for 8 minutes, with steamed rice and bok choy. Bring 1L chicken stock to a gentle simmer with 6 slices ginger, 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp mirin and 3 spring onions cut into lengths. Lower in 4 skinless salmon fillets and poach gently, never boiling, for 8 minutes. Steam 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Add 4 halved baby bok choy to the broth for the last 2 minutes. Serve the salmon over rice with the bok choy, a ladle of broth, a few drops of sesame oil and thin sliced spring onion.
W: the Vivisteria flower Ember always wanted to see
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream, blueberries and edible purple flowers.
K: Apple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and ginger, served steaming in mugs.
T: Fire meets water. Dinner meets you.
D: A fiery young woman and a soft-hearted water guy fall for each other in Element City.
P: Serve the snacks when Ember works the counter at her family's shop.

title: Onward
S: Crumbed mozzarella sticks fried until melting, with warm marinara for dunking. Cut 400g firm mozzarella into 16 sticks.
the fast food stop on the quest

Little beef sliders with cheese, pickles and sauce on soft mini buns. Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties, season and cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheese at the end.

Puff pastry spread with tomato paste, ham and mozzarella, rolled into scrolls, baked golden and wrapped in paper for the road trip. Lay 2 sheets puff pastry on the bench. Spread each with 2 tbsp tomato paste mixed with half a teaspoon of dried oregano. Scatter with 150g chopped ham and 150g grated mozzarella, leaving a 2cm border on one edge. Roll up tightly towards the border, then cut each log into 8 scrolls. Lay cut side up on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool 5 minutes before eating.
M: the brothers on the road together
Chicken drumsticks glazed with honey, garlic and thyme, roasted at 200C for 40 minutes, with roast potatoes and carrots.
New Mushroomton mushroom and leek pie

Mixed mushrooms and leek cooked down in butter with thyme and cream, spooned into a dish, topped with puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Melt 50g butter in a big pan and cook 750g mixed mushrooms, torn or sliced, over high heat until golden. Add 2 sliced leeks, 2 garlic cloves and a few thyme sprigs and cook 8 minutes until soft. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, then 150ml cream and 100ml vegetable stock and simmer until thick. Season well and spoon into a pie dish. Top with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: the one day the boys get with their dad
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot chocolate sauce of melted dark chocolate and cream, whipped cream and sprinkles.
K: the magic staff and the visitation spell
Apple juice and blackcurrant cordial topped with soda water over ice, purple like a potion.
T: One day with Dad. One big feast.
D: Two elf brothers set out on a quest to bring back their late father for one day.
P: Serve the mains when the brothers pull up at the Manticore's tavern.

title: Inside Out 2
S: Hockey camp pretzel bites and cheese dip

Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with a warm cheddar sauce. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 30g melted butter and 250ml warm water and knead 5 minutes. Rest 1 hour. Roll into long ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb, drop the bites in for 20 seconds, then drain onto a lined tray. Brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk and stir in 150g cheddar for dipping.
Pouchy, with everything you need in his pouch

A bit of everything on one big board: cheddar, crackers, grapes, roasted almonds, baby carrots and hummus, so nobody is caught short. Arrange cubes of cheddar, water crackers, bunches of red grapes, roasted almonds, baby carrots and a bowl of hummus on one big board. Fill every gap. Then add a few more crackers just in case, because you can never be too prepared.
Joy trying to keep things bright

Popcorn tossed in a bubbling honey butter glaze, baked until crunchy and glowing golden, finished with a pinch of flaky salt. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a lidded pot and tip into a large roasting tin. Melt 80g butter with 80g honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of turmeric for colour, and bubble for 2 minutes. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 150C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway, then spread on baking paper to cool and crisp. Sprinkle with flaky salt and serve in a big bowl.
M: Camp cafeteria chicken broccoli pasta bake
lunch in the hockey camp cafeteria

Penne mixed with chicken, broccoli and a creamy parmesan and garlic sauce, topped with cheese and baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 400g penne until 2 minutes short of al dente, adding 1 head broccoli in florets for the last 2 minutes, then drain. Melt 40g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then whisk in 700ml milk until thick and stir in 60g parmesan. Fold in the pasta, broccoli and 400g shredded cooked chicken. Tip into a baking dish, top with 150g grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
dinner at home with Riley's mum and dad
Beef mince cooked with cumin, paprika and tomato, served in taco shells with lettuce, tomato, cheddar and sour cream.
W: Riley chasing a spot on the Firehawks

Dense dark chocolate brownies with a crackly top, baked fudgy in the middle and cut into thick squares for the team after practice. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 28 minutes and cool before cutting.
K: Chamomile tea brewed with honey, cooled, mixed with apple juice and poured over ice.
T: New emotions. Same snack drawer.
D: Riley heads to hockey camp as a teenager and a crowd of new emotions moves into headquarters.
P: Serve the snacks when Riley arrives at hockey camp.

title: The Good Dinosaur
S: Arlo's family filling the silo with corn
Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg and spring onion, fried in spoonfuls until golden, served with a sour cream and chive dip.
Spot hunting through the bushes for food
Blueberries, raspberries and blackberries tossed with a little honey and lime, spooned into small bowls with whipped cream.
Arlo and Spot watching the fireflies light up the field

Sweet potato wedges roasted with smoked paprika and maple until caramelised at the edges, with a cool lime and chive sour cream dip. Cut 1kg sweet potatoes into wedges and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Spread on 2 lined trays and roast at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once. Drizzle with 1 tbsp maple syrup and roast 5 minutes more until the edges caramelise. Mix 200g sour cream with the zest and juice of 1 lime and a handful of chopped chives. Serve the wedges hot with the dip.
M: Butch and the T-Rex ranchers driving their longhorns
Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika, pepper and salt, cooked low at 140C for 5 hours, served with charred corn and coleslaw.
Arlo's family farm by the river

Bacon, onion and potato softened, corn and stock added and simmered 20 minutes, finished with cream and chives. Fry 200g diced bacon until crisp, then add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 500g diced potato, the kernels from 4 corn cobs and 1L chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes until the potato is soft. Blitz a third of the soup and stir it back in to thicken. Add 150ml cream, season and heat through. Serve in bowls with chopped chives and buttered crusty bread.
W: the family's corn harvest before winter
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, served with honey butter.
K: Farm stand watermelon and mint cooler
Arlo's family farm by the river

Fresh watermelon blitzed with lime and mint, strained, topped with sparkling water and poured over ice in a big jug to share. Blitz 1.2kg seedless watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and a small handful of mint leaves until smooth. Strain through a sieve into a big jug and stir in 1 tbsp honey if the melon isn't sweet. Chill for 30 minutes. Fill the jug with ice and top with 400ml sparkling water. Pour into 4 glasses with a watermelon wedge and mint sprig each.
T: Earn your mark. Then eat.
D: A timid young dinosaur gets lost far from his family's farm and makes friends with a human boy.
P: Serve the mains when Arlo helps fill the family silo with corn.

title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
S: Hog's Head pork and sage sausage rolls
the Hog's Head pub where Dumbledore's Army forms

Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with English mustard, like a dusty village pub. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 tsp salt and plenty of pepper. Halve 2 sheets puff pastry lengthways. Lay a log of the filling down each strip, roll up and seal the seam with beaten egg. Cut each log into 4, brush with egg and score the tops. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot with English mustard and tomato chutney.
Fred and George's fireworks wrecking Umbridge's exam
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with melted butter and coloured sprinkles, with popping candy scattered over just before serving.
Umbridge's pink office full of kitten plates
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with very pink buttercream and topped with a little sugar flower.
M: Grimmauld Place steak and kidney pie
the Order meets at Number Twelve
Rich steak and kidney in gravy under a golden puff pastry lid. Brown 800g diced chuck and 200g lamb kidney, add an onion, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml beef stock and Worcestershire and simmer 2 hours.
Great Hall thyme roast chicken and gravy
dinner under the floating candles in the Great Hall

Chicken rubbed with butter and thyme, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, with crispy roast potatoes, peas and gravy from the pan. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, salt and thyme leaves and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg halved potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up in the colander and roast in hot oil alongside the chicken for 50 minutes, turning once. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Serve with buttered peas and the gravy.
W: Shortcrust filled with warmed golden syrup, fresh breadcrumbs and lemon zest, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, served warm with cream.
K: the jugs on every Hogwarts table
Roasted pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, strained and chilled.
T: The Ministry lies. The snacks don't.
D: Harry forms a secret group of students to fight back while the Ministry takes over Hogwarts.
P: Serve the snacks when Dumbledore's Army meets in the Room of Requirement.

title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
S: Blinis spread with crème fraîche, topped with smoked salmon and dill, served beside tiny mince pies baked at 190C for 15 minutes.
Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, chilled until firm, rolled into truffles and coated in cocoa with a pink sugar heart on top.
Fred and George's joke shop in Diagon Alley

Golden honeycomb that foams up in the pot like a joke shop trick, set crunchy, broken into shards and half dipped in dark chocolate. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Heat 200g caster sugar and 80g golden syrup in a deep saucepan, stirring until dissolved, then boil without stirring until it turns deep amber, about 6 minutes. Take off the heat, whisk in 1.5 tsp bicarb quickly and pour straight into the tin as it foams. Leave 1 hour to set, then smash into shards. Dip half of each into 150g melted dark chocolate and set on baking paper.
M: Christmas with the Weasleys at the Burrow
Turkey breast rolled with sage and onion stuffing, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes and buttered brussels sprouts.
the trolley on the Hogwarts Express

Shortcrust filled with diced beef skirt, potato, swede and onion with lots of pepper, crimped and baked at 180C for 50 minutes. Mix 400g diced beef skirt or chuck with 1 diced potato, 150g diced swede, 1 diced onion, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Cut 4 sheets shortcrust pastry into 4 large rounds about 20cm across. Pile the filling on one half of each, dot with butter, fold over and crimp the edge tightly. Brush with beaten egg and cut a steam hole. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 170C for 35 minutes until golden. Serve with tomato chutney.
W: Chunks of fresh pineapple candied slowly in syrup, dried until chewy and rolled in sugar, the treat Slughorn can never say no to.
K: the mead Slughorn was saving as a gift
Honey stirred into warm water with lemon and a cinnamon stick, cooled and topped with ginger beer over ice.
T: Liquid luck. Solid dinner.
D: Harry learns about Voldemort's past while Slughorn's secrets and teenage romances fill Hogwarts.
P: Serve the snacks when Slughorn's Christmas party gets going.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
S: Bill and Fleur's wedding in the marquee at the Burrow
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and little gougères of gruyère choux, laid out on silver trays for the guests.
the late-night café where the Death Eaters find them

Thick white bread toasted in butter around leg ham, melted vintage cheddar and a scrape of hot English mustard, cut into triangles. Butter the outsides of 8 slices thick white bread. Spread the insides of 4 slices with English mustard, then layer with 200g leg ham and 200g grated vintage cheddar and close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down with a spatula, until deep golden and the cheese runs. Cut into triangles and serve with a pickle on the side.
Bill and Fleur's Shell Cottage by the sea
Crab meat folded through mayo, lemon and chives, piled onto toasted sourdough with a pinch of paprika.
M: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and butter, cooked in foil over the coals until flaky, with buttery parsley potatoes. Stuff 4 cleaned trout with lemon slices, dill and butter, season and wrap in oiled foil. Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes tossed in butter and parsley.
Godric's Hollow beef and red wine pie
Christmas Eve in snowy Godric's Hollow

Beef chuck and onion simmered 3 hours in stock and red wine, spooned into a dish under puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp seasoned plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 onions and 2 carrots in the pot, add 250ml red wine and bubble 2 minutes. Add 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 2 bay leaves, cover and simmer 2.5 to 3 hours until tender. Cool a little, spoon into a pie dish and cover with 1 sheet puff pastry. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with buttered greens.
W: Lemon sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes, filled with lemon curd and whipped cream, dusted with icing sugar and topped with white flowers. Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of a lemon, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, dust with icing sugar and top with white flowers.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with a pinch of cinnamon, whisked and poured into tin mugs.
T: On the run. Still need dinner.
D: Harry, Ron and Hermione leave Hogwarts behind to hunt down Voldemort's Horcruxes.
P: Serve the snacks when the guests arrive for Bill and Fleur's wedding at the Burrow.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
S: Parmesan crisps spooned into rounds on baking paper, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until golden as coins, served with fig jam.
escaping Gringotts on the back of the dragon
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery glaze of chilli, honey and soy, scattered with sesame.
Hogsmeade sausage rolls with brown sauce
sneaking back into Hogsmeade at night

Pork mince with onion and sage rolled in puff pastry, egg washed and baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with brown sauce. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 40g breadcrumbs and plenty of salt and pepper. Halve 2 sheets puff pastry, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal with beaten egg. Cut each log into 4, brush with egg and scatter with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with brown sauce.
M: Aberforth feeding Harry, Ron and Hermione at the Hog's Head
Lamb shoulder braised with onions, carrots and stout for 3 hours, served with mash and crusty bread.
everyone gathered in the Great Hall after the battle

Roast chicken with lemon and thyme, roast potatoes, peas and gravy, laid out for everyone who stayed to fight. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, salt and thyme and stuff with a halved lemon and garlic. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, shake to rough the edges and roast in hot oil for 50 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes, then stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices and whisk in 300ml chicken stock to make gravy. Serve with buttered peas, laid out on big platters.
W: Platform nine and three-quarters treacle tart
nineteen years later at King's Cross
Shortcrust filled with warmed golden syrup, breadcrumbs and lemon zest, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, served with cream.
K: the end of the Battle of Hogwarts
Roasted pumpkin blended with apple juice, honey and cinnamon, strained and served chilled.
T: It all ends. Dinner doesn't.
D: Harry returns to Hogwarts for the final battle against Voldemort.
P: Serve the mains when Aberforth feeds the trio at the Hog's Head.

title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
S: the pastries Jacob shapes like Newt's creatures
Puff pastry cut into little animal shapes, brushed with egg, sprinkled with cinnamon sugar and baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
the Blind Pig, the wizarding speakeasy
Devilled eggs and marinated olives on the bar, the eggs piped with mayo and mustard and dusted with paprika.
the niffler raiding the bank for anything shiny

Crisp golden choux puffs made with gruyère and a pinch of cayenne, baked until hollow and shiny, piled up like a niffler's stash. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until the dough leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe walnut-size balls onto lined trays, top with a little more cheese and bake at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes until golden and hollow.
M: the Goldstein sisters' apartment in New York

Beef chuck browned and braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot and stock, potatoes added for the last hour. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 3 carrots in chunks, 2 garlic cloves, 2 thyme sprigs, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more until everything is tender. Lift out the beef and veg, simmer the juices to thicken slightly and pour over the sliced meat.
Dumplings filled with potato and cheddar, boiled, then fried in butter with onion until golden, served with sour cream.
W: Apples, sultanas, cinnamon and breadcrumbs rolled in buttered filo, baked at 190C for 35 minutes, dusted with icing sugar, with cream.
K: Fresh lemonade with a splash of gin for the grown-ups, served in teacups to look innocent.
T: Jacob bakes. Queenie cooks. You eat.
D: A magizoologist arrives in 1926 New York and his case of magical creatures gets loose.
P: Serve dessert when Queenie magics up the apple strudel.

title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
S: the dwarves clearing out Bilbo's pantry
Aged cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, apples and crusty bread piled onto a big board for everyone to grab.
the dwarves turning up their noses at elvish greens in Rivendell
Baby leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and herbs dressed with lemon and olive oil, scattered with toasted seeds.
Gollum and the riddles in the dark

Flathead pieces dusted in seasoned flour, fried in hot oil until crisp, served with tartare sauce and lemon wedges. Cut 600g flathead fillets into fingers and pat dry. Season 100g plain flour with salt, pepper and a pinch of paprika. Dust the fish in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g panko crumbs. Shallow fry in 1cm of oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden. Mix 150g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve the fish with the tartare and lemon wedges.
M: Trolls' garlic and rosemary roast lamb
the three trolls roasting mutton over the fire

Lamb leg rubbed with garlic, rosemary and salt, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes and carrots. Cut small slits all over a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and small rosemary sprigs. Rub with olive oil and plenty of salt and pepper. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes for medium, adding 1kg potatoes in chunks and 4 carrots tossed in oil to the tray for the last hour. Rest the lamb 15 minutes under foil. Carve thick and serve with the roast veg, pan juices and mint sauce.
Bilbo's love of a proper meal
Pork sausages, bacon, mushrooms and halved tomatoes fried in one pan, eggs fried in the fat, served with buttered toast.
W: the seed cake the dwarves eat at Bag End
Butter cake with caraway seeds baked in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes, sliced and served with tea.
K: the dwarves' rowdy feast at Bag End

Brown ale and cloudy apple juice warmed with honey, cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, ladled into big mugs. Ginger beer version for the hobbits. Pour 750ml cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 3 strips orange peel. Simmer gently for 10 minutes. Turn the heat to low and add 750ml brown ale, warming through for 3 minutes without boiling. Ladle into 4 big mugs and add a cinnamon stick each. For non-drinkers, swap the ale for ginger beer and serve over ice.
T: Thirteen dwarves. One pantry.
D: Bilbo Baggins is swept off on a quest with thirteen dwarves to reclaim their mountain home.
P: Serve the snacks when the dwarves raid Bilbo's pantry.

title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
S: Beorn's house surrounded by giant bees
Ricotta whipped with honey and spread on toasted sourdough, drizzled with more honey and scattered with walnuts.
the dark and twisted forest of Mirkwood
Mixed mushrooms sautéed in butter with garlic and thyme, spooned onto toasted bread with shaved parmesan.
Elvenking's baked brie with red wine figs
Thranduil's halls and the elves' wine cellar

A whole brie baked until oozing, topped with figs stewed in red wine and honey, with walnuts, grapes and crackers for scooping. Simmer 6 halved dried figs in 125ml red wine with 1 tbsp honey and a thyme sprig for 10 minutes until sticky. Score the top of a 200g brie, sit it in a small dish and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until soft in the middle. Spoon the figs and syrup over the top and scatter with toasted walnuts. Serve straight away with a bunch of red grapes and 200g crackers.
M: Bard smuggling the dwarves in barrels of fish

Whole snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and parsley at 200C for 25 minutes, served with roast potatoes and greens. Score 2 whole snapper of about 800g each on both sides. Stuff with lemon slices, garlic and parsley stalks and rub with olive oil and salt. Parboil 800g halved potatoes for 8 minutes and roast at 200C in oil for 20 minutes first. Lay the fish on top of the potatoes and roast 25 minutes until the flesh flakes at the bone. Toss 2 bunches green beans in butter and lemon. Serve with salsa verde of parsley, capers, lemon and oil.
the dwarves' lost gold in the mountain
Pork belly slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours with honey and fennel, crackling blasted golden, with roasted apples.
W: Smaug lying on his pile of gold
Honey cake baked at 175C for 40 minutes, soaked in hot honey syrup, topped with gold leaf or sprinkles.
K: Beorn feeding the company at his long table

Cold milk shaken hard with bourbon, honey, vanilla and ice until frothy, poured into wooden cups and dusted with fresh nutmeg. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp water until runny, then cool. In a cocktail shaker or big jar with ice, shake 2 drinks at a time: 300ml cold full cream milk, 90ml bourbon, half the honey and a few drops of vanilla. Shake hard for 15 seconds until frothy and strain into 2 cups. Repeat. Grate fresh nutmeg over the top. For a non-drinking version, leave out the bourbon and add a pinch of cinnamon.
T: Barrels of fish. Barrels of fun.
D: Bilbo and the dwarves cross Mirkwood and Lake-town to reach the dragon in the mountain.
P: Serve the mains when the dwarves are smuggled into Lake-town in Bard's fish barrels.

title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
S: Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with smoked trout, dill and thinly sliced pickled onion.
Dale campfire damper with golden syrup
the survivors camping in the ruins of Dale

Damper of self-raising flour, butter and milk, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, torn and served with butter and golden syrup. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Stir in 300ml milk to make a soft dough and knead lightly. Shape into a round, sit on a lined tray, cut a deep cross on top and dust with flour. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow when tapped. Tear into chunks while hot and serve with soft butter and a jug of golden syrup.
Thorin's cousin riding in on a war boar

Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust bases with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Brown 500g beef mince with a diced onion, add 250ml beef stock and simmer until thick, then cool. Line a muffin tin with shortcrust rounds, fill and top with puff pastry lids. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes and serve with tomato sauce.
M: Erebor roast beef and Yorkshire puddings
the dwarves take back their halls

Sirloin roasted and sliced pink, served with tall puffed Yorkshire puddings and a rich pan gravy for the dwarves taking back their halls. Roast a 1.5kg beef sirloin at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 40 minutes and rest. Heat oil in a muffin tin at 230C, pour in a batter of 140g flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices with 300ml stock.
Elvish lemon and herb roast chicken
Thranduil's elves arriving at the mountain

Chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs, with roasted root vegetables and a herb salad. Mix 50g soft butter with lemon zest, 2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley, thyme and tarragon. Push it under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken and put the zested lemon inside. Toss 1kg parsnips, carrots and beetroot in chunks with oil and salt. Roast the chicken on top of the veg at 200C for 75 minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Dress rocket and herbs with lemon juice and oil and serve with the carved chicken and veg.
W: Bilbo coming home to find his things up for auction

Apples and blackberries cooked with sugar under an oat crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes, with custard. Peel and slice 4 green apples and cook with 250g blackberries and 50g brown sugar for 5 minutes. Spoon into a dish. Rub 100g butter into oats, flour and 100g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes and serve with warm custard.
K: Bag End hot spiced apple cider

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange and a little brown sugar, ladled into mugs with a cinnamon stick for stirring. Pour 1L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 2 cinnamon sticks, 5 cloves, 2 star anise, 3 strips orange peel and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Simmer gently for 15 minutes so the spices infuse, without boiling hard. Strain into 4 mugs, add a fresh cinnamon stick and a thin orange slice to each and serve with a slice of seed cake.
T: Five armies. One table.
D: Smaug attacks Lake-town and armies gather at the Lonely Mountain to fight over its treasure.
P: Serve the mains when the people of Lake-town shelter in the ruins of Dale.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
S: tea with Mr Tumnus in his cave
Toast fingers buttered and topped with sardines and lemon, or with honey, served with a pot of tea.
the Professor's big old house in the country
Scones of self-raising flour, cream and lemonade, baked at 220C for 15 minutes, with jam and cream.
M: dinner at the Beavers' cosy dam
Fish fillets pan-fried in butter until golden, served with boiled potatoes and peas tossed in parsley butter and lemon.

Roast lamb with rosemary and garlic, roast potatoes and carrots, served for the whole army. Make small slits in a 2kg lamb leg and push in garlic slivers and rosemary sprigs. Rub with olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes, adding 1kg potatoes and 4 carrots in chunks tossed in oil for the last hour. Rest the lamb 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml stock and bubble into gravy. Carve and serve on a big platter with the veg and mint sauce.
W: Rosewater jelly of sugar, cornflour and lemon cooked for an hour until thick, set overnight, cut into cubes and rolled in icing sugar.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with cinnamon, topped with whipped cream.
T: Through the wardrobe. Mind the Turkish delight.
D: Four children step through a wardrobe into Narnia and join Aslan against the White Witch.
P: Serve dessert when the White Witch offers Edmund the Turkish delight.

title: Wicked
S: Ozdust salmon blinis and beetroot hummus
the dance at the Ozdust Ballroom

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and chives, and pink beetroot hummus on crackers. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and a snip of chives. Blitz 1 drained tin chickpeas with 1 cooked beetroot, 2 tbsp tahini, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil until smooth and bright pink. Spoon onto 16 water crackers and top with crumbled feta. Arrange both on a platter.
Avocado, thawed peas, lime juice and mint blitzed bright green with salt, served with cucumber sticks and crackers.
Egg whites whipped glossy with caster sugar and a drop of pink colouring, piped into kisses, baked at 100C for an hour, with raspberries.
M: the dining hall at Shiz University

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and rice. Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket in 4 chicken breasts and fill with the mixture. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley. Slice the chicken and spoon over the lemon butter sauce, with rice on the side.
Elphaba and Galinda's trip to the Emerald City
Arborio stirred with hot stock for 20 minutes, peas and spinach blitzed in at the end with butter and parmesan until bright green.
W: Vanilla sponge batter split in two, one tinted pink and one green, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked with vanilla buttercream.
K: the dance at the Ozdust Ballroom
Fresh lemonade turned pink with a splash of cranberry and topped with raspberries.
T: Green girl. Pink girl. One table.
D: Before Dorothy arrived, a green-skinned student and a bubbly blonde became unlikely friends at Shiz University.
P: Serve the snacks when Elphaba and Galinda dance at the Ozdust Ballroom.

title: The Wizard of Oz
S: Auntie Em offering the farmhands fresh crullers
Choux dough piped into twisted rings, fried at 180C until golden, dipped in a honey glaze while warm.

Crisp red apple wedges with a warm salted caramel dip, crushed roasted peanuts and a dusting of cinnamon for dunking. Melt 100g brown sugar with 60g butter, stirring for 2 minutes, then pour in 125ml cream and simmer 3 minutes until thick. Take off the heat and stir in half a teaspoon of salt. Cut 4 red apples into wedges and toss in lemon juice so they don't brown. Pour the warm caramel into a bowl, scatter with 60g crushed roasted peanuts and a pinch of cinnamon and serve with the apples.
Homemade lollipops of sugar and glucose boiled to 150C, swirled with colours and set on sticks.
M: Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 170C until crisp, with mash and gravy.
Emerald City pesto penne with broccoli

Penne cooked with broccoli and peas in the same pot, tossed with basil pesto, parmesan and lemon until bright green. Cook 400g penne in salted water, adding 1 head broccoli in small florets and 1 cup frozen peas for the last 3 minutes. Drain, keeping a cup of the water. Toss with 190g basil pesto, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and 50g grated parmesan, adding pasta water until glossy. Toast 40g pine nuts in a dry pan. Serve topped with the pine nuts, extra parmesan and a handful of basil leaves.
W: Raspberry jelly set in glasses with raspberries and a sparkle of edible glitter, topped with cream.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup mixed with pineapple juice and grated ginger, topped with soda water over ice with a pineapple wedge. Simmer 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and 1 tsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons and 400ml pineapple juice. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, divide the mix between them and top with 400ml soda water. Finish each with a fresh pineapple wedge on the rim.
T: No place like home. No crullers like Auntie Em's.
D: A Kansas farm girl is swept by a tornado to the land of Oz and follows the yellow brick road to the wizard.
P: Serve the snacks when Auntie Em hands out the fresh crullers on the farm.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
S: Scott's book signing coffee and cookies
Scott enjoying free coffee and fame in San Francisco
Chocolate chip cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes, served with small cups of coffee.
the strange creatures of the quantum realm
Broccolini, purple carrots and radishes roasted with honey and chilli, served with a green herb dip.

Choux pastry of butter, water, flour and eggs beaten with gruyère, piped into small balls and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow. Bring 250ml water, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe 24 small balls onto lined trays, sprinkle with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed, golden and hollow.
M: Lord Krylar's restaurant in the quantum realm
Strange-looking but tasty: purple rice of black rice cooked with coconut, topped with grilled chicken and pickled vegetables.

Fish, prawns and mussels in a tomato and white wine broth with garlic and fennel, with sourdough. Soften 1 onion, 1 fennel bulb and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil for 8 minutes. Add a pinch of chilli, 150ml white wine and bubble 2 minutes, then a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Add 400g firm white fish in chunks and 8 green king prawns for 3 minutes, then 500g mussels, cover and cook until they open, about 4 minutes. Finish with basil and serve with toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic.
W: everything shrinking and growing in the quantum realm
One batch of vanilla batter baked as mini cupcakes and one giant cupcake at 175C, all iced with red buttercream and served together.
K: Blue butterfly pea tea poured over lemonade so it swirls purple in the glass.
T: Free coffee. Weird dinner.
D: Scott and his family get sucked into the quantum realm and face Kang the Conqueror.
P: Serve the mains when Janet and the gang sit down at the strange quantum realm restaurant.

title: The Marvels
S: Kamala's family home in Jersey City
Spiced potato, peas and onion folded into pastry triangles, fried at 180C until crisp, with a mint and coriander yoghurt.
Goose the flerken and her kittens

Cheddar cracker dough cut into fish shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crunchy. Rub 100g cold diced butter into 150g plain flour with half a teaspoon salt and a pinch of paprika. Mix in 150g finely grated vintage cheddar and 2 tbsp cold water and press into a dough. Chill 20 minutes, roll out 3mm thick and cut with a small fish cutter. Mark a little eye with a skewer. Bake on lined trays at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crunchy. Cool and serve with a sweet chilli cream cheese dip.
Popcorn popped in oil, tossed with butter and a little chilli and lime, served in silver bowls.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt and spices, layered with par-cooked basmati, fried onions and saffron milk, sealed and baked at 170C for 45 minutes.
Aladna lemon and oregano lamb skewers

Lamb skewers marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled and served with flatbread and herb salad. Cut 800g lamb leg into 3cm cubes and marinate 1 hour with the juice and zest of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred outside and pink inside. Warm 4 flatbreads. Toss parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and red onion with lemon and oil. Serve with the skewers and 200g tzatziki.
W: Kamala's fan art of Captain Marvel
Vanilla cupcakes piped with red, blue and gold buttercream and a little star on top.
K: Mango blended with yoghurt, milk, a little sugar and cardamom, poured over ice.
T: Three heroes. One very full kitchen.
D: Carol Danvers, Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan keep swapping places every time they use their powers.
P: Serve the mains when Carol and Monica crash into the Khan family home in Jersey City.

title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
S: the pizza balls Strange and America find in another universe
Pizza dough wrapped around cubes of mozzarella and pepperoni, rolled into balls, baked at 200C for 15 minutes, brushed with garlic butter and served with tomato sauce.
Christine's wedding salmon and fig canapés

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and fig and goat's cheese bites. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 120g crème fraîche with lemon zest and top each blini with a spoon of it, a fold of smoked salmon and a dill sprig. Quarter 4 fresh figs. Sit each quarter on a small crostini with a little soft goat's cheese from 120g, drizzle with honey and add cracked pepper. Arrange both on a platter.
Chicken and spring onion dumplings with ginger, steamed 10 minutes, with a spicy tomato achar.
M: Ramen noodles in a pork and miso broth with braised pork belly, soft-boiled eggs, corn and nori, every bowl topped a little differently.
Wanda's dream of a family life

Beef meatballs browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, served over spaghetti with garlic bread and parmesan, family style. Mix 600g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and salt and roll into 20 meatballs. Brown in olive oil and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion in the same pan, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and basil and simmer 15 minutes. Add the meatballs and simmer 25 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked spaghetti and serve with parmesan and garlic bread.
W: Nepali sweet rice rings from Kamar-Taj

Crisp Nepali sweet rice flour rings scented with cardamom and butter, fried golden in big loops and served warm from the pan. Mix 300g rice flour, 100g sugar, 50g melted butter, 1 tsp ground cardamom and 250ml milk into a thick batter and rest 1 hour. Pour rings into oil at 175C and fry until golden on both sides.
K: Black tea simmered with milk, cardamom, cinnamon, ginger and cloves, sweetened and strained.
T: Pizza balls from another universe.
D: Doctor Strange protects a teenager who can travel between universes from a powerful witch.
P: Serve the snacks when Strange and America find the pizza ball stall.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
S: the World Exposition of Tomorrow in 1943
Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in wax paper.

Pretzel dough shaped into knots, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with mustard. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp salt, 40g melted butter and 300ml warm water and knead 5 minutes. Rise 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzel knots. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb and dip each pretzel for 20 seconds. Lay on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. Serve warm with hot English and American mustard.
the London pub where the Howling Commandos sing
A board of aged cheddar, sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney and thick slices of crusty bread with butter.
M: Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with onion, carrot and potato in stock until thick, ladled into tin bowls with bread.
Peggy's chicken, leek and ham pie
Peggy Carter and the Strategic Scientific Reserve

Chicken, leek and ham pie in a creamy sauce under puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in butter and set aside. Soften 2 sliced leeks in the pan, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken, 150g diced ham and chopped tarragon and season. Tip into a pie dish, cover with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with buttered peas.
W: the round shield in red, white and blue
Cherries and blueberries cooked with sugar and cornflour, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes.
K: Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream and malted milk powder until thick and frothy, served in tall soda fountain glasses. Blend 1L cold milk with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and 5 tbsp malted milk powder until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
T: 1940s Brooklyn. Big appetite.
D: A skinny Brooklyn kid becomes a super soldier and takes on Hydra in the Second World War.
P: Serve the snacks when Steve and Bucky go to the Stark Expo.

title: Thunderbolts*
S: Yelena and her vest full of pockets
Almonds and cashews roasted at 180C for 10 minutes, mixed with dried apricots and dark chocolate chips, portioned into paper bags.
Cucumbers pickled overnight with dill, garlic and vinegar, served with rye bread and salted butter.
the team breaking out of the vault

Beef patties smashed thin on a hot grill, cheddar melted on, tucked into slider buns with pickles and tomato sauce. Roll 500g beef mince into 12 balls. Smash each flat onto a smoking hot greased flat plate, season and cook 2 minutes until a dark crust forms. Flip, top with a quarter slice of cheddar and cook 1 minute more. Toast 12 slider buns cut side down. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp mustard. Build with sauce, a patty, sliced dill pickle and a few thin onion rings.
M: the Red Guardian now driving a limo for a living

Beef strips seared, mushrooms and onion cooked down with paprika, finished with sour cream, over buttered noodles. Sear 600g thinly sliced rump in batches and set aside. Cook a sliced onion and 300g mushrooms until golden, add a spoon of sweet paprika, then stir in 300ml sour cream and return the beef. Warm through without boiling and serve over buttered egg noodles.

Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and shawarma spices, charred and sliced into flatbread with lettuce, tomato, pickles and garlic sauce. Marinate 800g chicken thigh for 1 hour with the juice of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cinnamon and 3 tbsp olive oil. Grill on high heat 5 minutes a side until charred, rest and slice. Mix 150g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and salt for the sauce. Warm 4 large flatbreads and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickled turnip or dill pickles, chicken and sauce. Roll tightly in foil.
W: the dark Void Bob carries inside him

Butter cookies made with ground black sesame, baked at 170C for 12 minutes, half dipped in white chocolate. Grind 50g black sesame seeds fine. Beat 150g butter with 80g sugar, add 200g flour and the sesame and roll into a log. Chill 30 minutes, slice into 20 rounds and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Dip half of each in 100g melted white chocolate.
K: Strong black tea chilled and stirred with cherry jam, lemon and vodka, topped with soda over ice. Leave out the vodka for a softer one. Steep 4 black tea bags in 600ml boiling water for 5 minutes, remove the bags and stir in 4 tbsp cherry jam until dissolved. Chill well, then strain out any fruit. Mix with the juice of 1 lemon and 160ml vodka. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the tea and top each with a splash of soda water. Garnish with a lemon slice and a few fresh or frozen cherries.
T: Misfits. Leftovers. Still a team.
D: A group of damaged antiheroes is tricked into a trap and ends up working together.
P: Serve the mains when the misfit team finally sits down together.

title: Captain America: Brave New World
S: the cherry blossom festival in Washington
Baguette slices toasted, spread with whipped ricotta and topped with cherries cooked with honey and thyme.
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a smoky barbecue and honey glaze.

Crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, shaped and pan-fried until golden, with a lemon remoulade. Mix 400g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 beaten egg, 2 sliced spring onions, a pinch of cayenne and 50g panko crumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Coat in more panko and pan-fry in oil and butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. For remoulade, mix 120g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, 1 tsp paprika, lemon juice and parsley. Serve with lemon wedges.
M: Chicken and smoked sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum and celery, over rice.
White House eye fillet with red wine jus
the state dinner at the White House

Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and asparagus. Season a 1kg beef eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes. Slice 1kg potatoes thinly, layer in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, garlic and salt, and bake at 180C for 60 minutes before the beef goes in. Deglaze the beef pan with 200ml red wine, add 200ml beef stock and reduce by half, then whisk in 20g butter. Serve with steamed asparagus.
W: the blossoms around the White House
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, topped with whipped cream, cherries and pale pink rose petals.
K: Fresh strawberries blitzed with lemon and sugar, strained and topped with soda water over ice, with a halved strawberry on the rim. Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with 3 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth, then push through a sieve. Fill 4 glasses with ice and divide the strawberry purée between them. Top each with 200ml soda water and stir gently. Finish with a halved strawberry on the rim and a strip of lemon peel.
T: New shield. Cherry blossoms.
D: Sam Wilson takes on the shield and is pulled into a conspiracy around the new President.
P: Serve dessert when the cherry blossoms are out in Washington.

title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
S: Lex Luthor's fundraiser in his library
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche, and figs with goat's cheese and honey, on silver trays.

Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg and spring onion, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with sour cream. Mix 100g self-raising flour with 1 egg, 100ml milk, half a teaspoon smoked paprika and salt into a thick batter. Stir in the kernels from 3 corn cobs and 3 sliced spring onions. Heat 5mm of oil in a frying pan and drop in tablespoons of batter, cooking 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Mix 200g sour cream with chopped chives and lime zest and serve with the hot fritters.
Bruce's glass house by the lake
Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with flaked smoked trout, thin pickled onion and dill.
M: Beef fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and puff pastry, baked golden and carved into thick slices for Lex's library gala. Sear a 1kg beef fillet all over and brush with mustard. Cook 400g chopped mushrooms with garlic until dry. Lay prosciutto on puff pastry, spread with mushrooms, wrap the beef, brush with egg and bake at 210C for 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes.
Lois and Clark at the Daily Planet

Club sandwiches of grilled chicken, crisp bacon, avocado and tomato on toasted bread with mayo, stacked three high and cut into triangles. Season 2 chicken breasts, grill 6 minutes a side and slice. Cook 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread. Spread 4 slices with mayo and layer with chicken, sliced tomato and lettuce. Add a second slice of toast, spread with mayo, and layer with bacon and sliced avocado. Top with a third slice, push 4 toothpicks through and cut each into 4 triangles. Serve with potato crisps.
W: Hot dark chocolate soufflés risen tall above the ramekins, served straight from the oven with a jug of cold cream to pour in the middle. Butter and sugar 4 ramekins. Melt 150g dark chocolate, stir in 3 egg yolks. Whisk 4 egg whites with 60g sugar to soft peaks, fold in and fill the ramekins. Bake at 190C for 12 minutes and serve with 200ml cream.
K: LexCorp gala pear and ginger fizz
Lex's library fundraiser, where Bruce first crosses paths with Diana.

Pear nectar, fresh ginger syrup and a squeeze of lemon, topped with chilled sparkling wine and a twist of candied ginger on the rim. Simmer 100g sliced fresh ginger with 100g caster sugar and 100ml water for 10 minutes, then strain and cool. Into four chilled flutes pour 60ml pear nectar, 20ml ginger syrup and 10ml lemon juice each. Top each with about 100ml cold sparkling wine and stir once gently. Thread a piece of candied ginger onto a pick and rest it across each glass.
T: Martha's peach tea. Lex's jar.
D: Batman goes after Superman while Lex Luthor plays them against each other.
P: Serve the drinks when Lex hands over the jar of peach tea at the hearing.

title: Justice League
S: Barry burning through energy at super speed
Small buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter, stacked high with crisp bacon and maple syrup, enough for someone who runs faster than light.
the Icelandic fishing village where Bruce finds Arthur
Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with smoked salmon, dill and thin pickled onion, laid out on a slate.

Pretzel rods dipped in melted white chocolate, set on baking paper, then drizzled with blue icing lines like circuits. Melt 250g white chocolate in short bursts in the microwave, stirring each time. Dip 24 pretzel rods two thirds of the way in, let the excess drip off and lay on baking paper. Chill 15 minutes until set. Melt 50g more white chocolate and tint it bright blue with gel colouring. Spoon into a snap-lock bag, snip a tiny corner and pipe thin straight lines and dots like circuits. Sprinkle with a pinch of silver cachous and chill to set.
M: Lake house garlic butter rib eye
the team gathering at Bruce's lake house

Rib eye seared hard and butter basted with garlic, rested 5 minutes, sliced with crispy roast potatoes and charred broccolini. Take 4 rib eye steaks out 30 minutes early and season well. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, then add 60g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. Char 2 bunches broccolini in the same pan with a squeeze of lemon. Slice the steak and pour over the pan butter.
Diana and her home island of Themyscira
Lamb leg rubbed with lemon, garlic and oregano, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with a tomato, cucumber and feta salad.
W: Vanilla ice cream with a salted caramel sauce of sugar, cream and butter, scattered with popping candy just before serving.
K: Arthur Curry knocking back whisky in the village

Scotch whisky over plenty of ice with fresh lime and a honey ginger syrup, topped with ginger ale and a thick lime wedge. Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp water and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Scotch whisky, 1 tbsp of the ginger syrup and the juice of a quarter lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge. For non-drinkers, skip the whisky and double the ginger syrup.
T: Assemble the team. Then feed them.
D: Batman and Wonder Woman recruit a team of heroes to stop Steppenwolf and the Mother Boxes.
P: Serve the snacks when Barry agrees to join the team in his junk-filled lair.

title: The Suicide Squad
S: the island nation of Corto Maltese
Beef mince cooked with onion, cumin and chopped olives, folded into pastry rounds, crimped and baked at 200C for 20 minutes, with chimichurri.
Polka-Dot Man and his coloured spots
Bocconcini, cherry tomatoes and basil threaded onto toothpicks, drizzled with olive oil and dots of thick balsamic.

A whole camembert baked with garlic, thyme and honey until molten, with crusty bread, grapes and walnuts for a rat-sized feast. Unwrap a 200g camembert, sit it back in the base of its wooden box or a small dish and score the top. Push 1 sliced garlic clove and a few thyme sprigs into the cuts and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and a little olive oil. Bake at 180C for 15 minutes until molten in the middle. Toast 40g walnuts. Serve straight away with a sliced baguette toasted in oil, a bunch of grapes and the walnuts.
M: trekking through the jungle to Jotunheim
Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, grilled until charred, served with rice and black beans and a fresh salsa.
Harley's palace eye fillet and red wine
Harley Quinn's date at the president's palace

Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare, sliced with a red wine sauce and crispy potatoes roasted in butter. Season a 1kg beef eye fillet, sear on all sides and roast at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes. Toss 1kg halved chat potatoes in 40g melted butter, salt and rosemary and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Deglaze the beef pan with 200ml red wine and a crushed garlic clove, add 200ml beef stock and reduce by half, then whisk in 20g cold butter. Slice the beef thick and pour over the sauce.
W: Shortbread dough rolled and cut into starfish shapes, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced pink and blue with white dots.
K: the island the squad lands on
Blended mango, coconut milk and lime over ice, with cachaça or white rum for adults.
T: Mission one: snacks.
D: A team of supervillains is dropped onto the island of Corto Maltese on a mission that goes very wrong.
P: Serve the snacks when the squad cuts loose in a Corto Maltese bar.

title: The Flash
S: Barry running late for work again
Toasted English muffins filled with a fried egg, crisp bacon and melted cheddar, wrapped in paper to eat on the run.
Popcorn tossed with butter and a pinch of chilli and lime, ready in a flash.
Wayne Manor baked brie with quince
the older Batman's run-down Wayne Manor

A wheel of brie baked until runny, topped with warm quince paste, thyme and toasted walnuts, served with crackers and red grapes. Score the top of a 200g brie and sit it in a small baking dish. Warm 80g quince paste with 1 tbsp water in a small pan until spoonable. Bake the brie at 180C for 12 minutes until soft in the middle. Spoon the quince over, scatter with thyme leaves and 40g toasted walnuts and drizzle with a little honey. Serve straight away with 200g crackers and a bunch of red grapes.
M: the can of tomatoes Barry's mum forgot
Crushed tomatoes simmered with garlic, onion and basil for 45 minutes, tossed through spaghetti with parmesan.
Allen family lemon thyme roast chicken
dinner at the Allen family home

Chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and thyme, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, with roast potatoes, peas and a pan gravy. Mix 40g soft butter with lemon zest and thyme and rub over a 1.8kg chicken. Put the zested lemon inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in hot oil alongside for 50 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer into gravy. Serve with buttered peas.
W: Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cooled and piped with a yellow icing lightning bolt on each square.
K: Central City blood orange lightning fizz

Blood orange and lime juice shaken with a ginger honey syrup, topped with sparkling water over crushed ice and a sugar-salt rim. Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp water and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with a pinch of salt on a saucer, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip them in. Fill with crushed ice. Mix 400ml blood orange juice with the juice of 2 limes and the ginger syrup, pour into the glasses and top each with 80ml sparkling water.
T: Don't forget the tomatoes.
D: Barry Allen goes back in time to save his mum and breaks the timeline.
P: Serve the mains when Barry's mum makes her spaghetti sauce.

title: Blue Beetle
S: Jaime's Nana and her family recipes

Masa spread on corn husks, filled with pork in red chilli sauce, steamed 90 minutes. Simmer 800g pork shoulder in water with onion and garlic for 2 hours, then shred. Blend 4 soaked guajillo chillies with 2 garlic cloves, cumin and 250ml of the cooking liquid and stir through the pork. Soak 16 corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes. Beat 150g lard or butter until fluffy, then beat in 400g masa harina, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 500ml warm stock. Spread on the husks, add pork, fold up and steam standing for 90 minutes.
the streets of Palmera City where Jaime grew up
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with mayo and lime, rolled in crumbled feta and dusted with chilli.
Uncle Rudy and his homemade gadgets
Pork belly roasted until the skin puffs into crackling, cut into bites with lime and hot sauce.
M: Red chilli pork and hominy soup simmered until tender, topped with crunchy cabbage, radish, dried oregano and a big squeeze of lime. Simmer 1kg pork shoulder pieces in 2L water with onion and garlic for 2 hours. Blend 4 soaked dried guajillo chillies with garlic and stir in with 800g tinned hominy and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, oregano and lime.

Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and orange, grilled and sliced into tacos with salsa. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours with the juice of 1 orange and 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, a handful of chopped coriander and 2 tbsp oil. Grill over very high heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thinly across the grain. Mix 3 chopped tomatoes, half a diced white onion, 1 chopped jalapeño, coriander and lime for salsa. Serve in 12 warm corn tortillas with salsa and lime wedges.
W: Sweet yeasted buns topped with a sugar shell crust, baked at 180C for 20 minutes.
K: Rice soaked with cinnamon overnight, blended with milk and sugar, strained and served over ice.
T: Family first. Food second.
D: A recent graduate becomes the host of an alien scarab and his whole family gets dragged in.
P: Serve the mains when the Reyes family sits down to dinner.

title: X2
S: Bacon, onion and potato softened in butter, clams and milk added and simmered 10 minutes, finished with cream, served in small cups with oyster crackers.
Bobby freezing a drink with his fingertip
