Red and green grapes washed, dried and frozen on a tray for 3 hours, served straight from the freezer like little ice marbles.
Boston baked beans on buttered toast
Nightcrawler's hideout in an old Boston church

Navy beans slow cooked with molasses, mustard, onion and bacon at 150C for three hours, piled onto hot buttered toast. Soak 400g dried navy beans overnight, then simmer 45 minutes until just tender and drain, keeping 500ml of the water. Fry 200g diced bacon and 1 diced onion in a heavy pot. Stir in 80ml molasses, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp tomato paste, the beans and the reserved water. Cover and bake at 150C for 3 hours, stirring now and then and adding water if dry. Pile onto thick buttered toast.
M: Xavier school roast chicken and veg
dinner at Xavier's school for gifted youngsters

Chicken rubbed with butter and thyme, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, with roast potatoes, carrots and a gravy made from the pan. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, thyme and salt. Toss 800g potatoes and 4 carrots in chunks with oil and salt and spread around the bird. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes, turning the veg once. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Carve and serve with the roast veg and gravy.
Stryker's base under the dam at Alkali Lake
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots and red wine until tender, served over buttery mash.
W: Soft chocolate cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes, cooled and sandwiched around a thick slab of vanilla ice cream, frozen an hour before serving.
K: Iceman frozen apple and mint spritz
Bobby frosting over a drink with his fingertip

Cloudy apple juice frozen into cubes, then topped with more apple, lime, muddled mint and soda water so it stays icy cold to the last sip. Freeze 400ml cloudy apple juice in ice cube trays overnight. Muddle a few mint leaves and a squeeze of lime in the bottom of 4 glasses. Fill with the apple ice cubes and a few thin green apple slices. Pour in 100ml cloudy apple juice each and top with 100ml soda water. Stir gently and finish with a mint sprig.
T: Mutants unite. Snacks too.
D: The X-Men team up with Magneto to stop a military man's attack on mutants.
P: Serve the snacks when Bobby brings the team home to his parents' place in Boston.

title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
S: Logan's quiet life working as a lumberjack in Canada
Thick chips cooked twice until crisp, piled into bowls, scattered with torn mozzarella and covered in hot beef gravy so the cheese melts.
the logging camp in the Rockies
Medjool dates wrapped in half rashers of bacon, held with toothpicks and baked at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp and sticky.
the Canadian forest where Logan lives with Kayla

Pecans tossed in maple syrup, brown sugar, chilli and sea salt, roasted until glassy and crunchy, broken into sweet and salty clusters. Toss 300g pecans with 60ml maple syrup, 1 tbsp brown sugar, half a teaspoon chilli flakes, a pinch of cinnamon and 1 tsp sea salt. Spread on a tray lined with baking paper and roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until the syrup bubbles and darkens. Sprinkle with a little more salt and leave to cool for 15 minutes so the coating sets crunchy, then break into clusters.
M: the elderly farm couple who take Logan in
Buttermilk pancakes, fried eggs and crisp bacon on one big plate, drowned in maple syrup, the full farmhouse breakfast.
Weapon X garlic butter rib eye

Rib eye seared hard and butter basted with garlic, rested and served with crispy roast potatoes and greens. Take 4 rib eye steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes early and season well. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, then add 60g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and rosemary and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. Sauté 2 bunches broccolini in the pan butter. Serve the steak sliced with potatoes, greens and the pan juices.
W: Maple syrup whisked with eggs and cream, poured into a blind-baked shortcrust shell, baked at 170C for 40 minutes until just set.
K: the Canadian Rockies where Logan lives with Kayla

Canadian whisky shaken hard with lemon juice, maple syrup and egg white until silky and foamy, served over ice with a few drops of bitters. Make 2 drinks at a time. Add 120ml Canadian whisky, 60ml lemon juice, 40ml maple syrup and 1 egg white to a shaker without ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Add a big handful of ice and shake again until very cold. Strain into 2 rocks glasses over fresh ice and add 3 drops of bitters to the foam. Repeat for the other 2. For non-drinkers, use cold black tea instead of whisky.
T: Claws out. Breakfast in.
D: Logan's past, from his brother Victor to the Weapon X program.
P: Serve the mains when the kind old farm couple feed Logan breakfast.

title: The Wolverine
S: the fight on top of the bullet train
Sushi rice shaped into triangles around flaked salted salmon, wrapped in strips of nori and packed into a bento box with pickled ginger.
Chicken thigh pieces threaded onto skewers, grilled and basted with soy, mirin and sugar simmered down until sticky, scattered with spring onion.

Pork and cabbage gyoza pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, with soy and rice vinegar to dip. Salt 200g finely chopped wombok for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 300g pork mince, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 1 grated garlic clove, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 gyoza wrappers and pleat them closed. Fry flat side down in oil over medium heat for 2 minutes until golden, add 80ml water, cover and steam 3 minutes until dry. Serve with 3 tbsp soy mixed with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and chilli oil.
M: hiding out in the snowy mountain village
Ramen noodles in a rich pork and miso broth with slices of braised pork belly, soft-boiled eggs and spring onion.

Salmon fillets glazed with soy, mirin and sugar, grilled until sticky, served with steamed rice and a quick pickled cucumber salad. Simmer 4 tbsp soy, 4 tbsp mirin, 2 tbsp sake or water and 1 tbsp sugar for 3 minutes until syrupy. Thinly slice 2 Lebanese cucumbers, salt for 10 minutes, squeeze and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and sesame seeds. Cook 1.5 cups short grain rice. Pan-fry 4 salmon fillets skin side down for 4 minutes, flip, cook 2 minutes, then pour in the glaze and bubble until sticky. Serve with the rice and cucumber.
W: Matcha ice cream with sesame brittle
the quiet gardens of the Yashida estate

Vanilla ice cream rippled with matcha, scooped into small bowls and topped with shards of black sesame brittle and a drizzle of honey. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes. Whisk 2 tbsp matcha powder with 2 tbsp hot water into a paste and fold through the ice cream, then refreeze for 1 hour. For brittle, melt 100g caster sugar in a pan without stirring until golden, stir in 3 tbsp black sesame seeds and pour onto baking paper. Cool 15 minutes and break into shards. Scoop the ice cream and top with brittle and a little honey.
K: Warm sake with yuzu and ginger
the funeral and the long night after

Sake gently warmed with fresh ginger and a splash of yuzu juice, poured into small cups. Hot green tea with yuzu for anyone not drinking. Pour 500ml sake into a heatproof jug with 4 thin slices of ginger. Stand the jug in a saucepan of hot water over low heat for 8 minutes until warm to touch, about 50C, never boiling. Stir in 2 tsp yuzu juice and 1 tsp honey. Pour into small cups. For non-drinkers, brew green tea at 80C and add the same yuzu and honey.
T: Tokyo. Bullet train. Noodles.
D: Logan travels to Japan to say goodbye to a man he once saved and gets caught up in a family fight.
P: Serve the snacks when Logan fights on top of the bullet train.

title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
S: Mrs Chen's sriracha mayo potato gems

Frozen potato gems baked at 220C for 20 minutes until crunchy, served with mayo mixed with sriracha and garlic. Spread 1kg frozen potato gems on 2 lined trays and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy. Mix 150g Japanese mayo with 2 tbsp sriracha, 1 small grated garlic clove and a squeeze of lime. Toss the hot gems with a pinch of salt, pile into bowls, drizzle with the sriracha mayo and scatter with sliced spring onion and toasted sesame seeds.

Dark and milk chocolate set thick around marshmallows, honeycomb, salted peanuts and raspberry lollies, smashed into chunks for a symbiote-sized craving. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Melt 250g dark chocolate and 150g milk chocolate together in short bursts in the microwave. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roughly broken honeycomb, 100g salted peanuts and 80g raspberry lollies. Spread into the tin and chill for 2 hours until firm. Smash or cut into big rough chunks and pile into a bowl.
Venom's pet chickens, Sonny and Cher, who are not on the menu
Chicken thigh pieces dipped in egg and panko, baked at 220C for 15 minutes until golden, with honey mustard.
M: Venom trying to cook Eddie breakfast and wrecking the kitchen
Soft scrambled eggs, crisp bacon and buttered toast, with a square of dark chocolate on the side, because Venom insists.

Chicken thighs grilled with chipotle and lime, rolled in big flour tortillas with rice, black beans, cheese and salsa, toasted in a pan. Marinate 700g chicken thigh with 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, the juice of 1 lime, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 30 minutes. Grill 5 minutes a side and slice. Cook 1 cup rice and stir in coriander and lime. Warm 1 drained tin black beans. Lay out 4 large flour tortillas and fill with rice, beans, chicken, 150g grated cheese, salsa and sour cream. Roll up tightly and toast seam side down in a dry pan for 2 minutes a side.
W: Red velvet sponge of buttermilk, cocoa and red colouring baked at 175C for 30 minutes, stacked and covered in cream cheese frosting.
K: Chocolate ice cream blended thick with cold milk and cocoa, poured into glasses streaked with fudge sauce and topped with crumbled brownie. Warm 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream, stirring until smooth, and cool slightly. Drizzle a spoon of the fudge sauce down the inside of 4 tall glasses. Blend 8 scoops chocolate ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 2 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into the glasses, drizzle with the rest of the sauce and crumble a small brownie over each. Serve with wide straws.
T: Venom cooks breakfast. Good luck.
D: Eddie and Venom face the serial killer Cletus Kasady, who bonds with a symbiote called Carnage.
P: Serve the mains when Venom tries to cook Eddie breakfast.

title: Megamind
S: Metro City's best villain gets hungry too

Flour tortillas filled with shredded chicken, melting cheese and capsicum, toasted crisp in a dry pan and cut into wedges with salsa and sour cream. Mix 200g shredded cooked chicken with 200g grated cheddar and mozzarella, 1 diced red capsicum, 2 sliced spring onions and half a teaspoon smoked paprika. Spread over half of each of 4 large flour tortillas and fold over. Cook in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut each into 4 wedges and serve with tomato salsa and sour cream.
Minion, the fish in a robot suit
Cheese crackers cut into fish shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes, served in a round glass bowl like a fishbowl.
Metro City pretzel bites and honey mustard
the Metro Man museum in Metro City

Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with a honey mustard dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 30g melted butter and 250ml warm water and knead 5 minutes. Rest 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb and drop the bites in for 20 seconds. Drain onto a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayo to dip.
M: Megamind disguised as Bernard on a date with Roxanne

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and herbed rice. Mix 200g ricotta, 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket into 4 chicken breasts and stuff. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook 1.5 cups basmati with 20g butter and stir through chopped parsley and chives. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and 1 crushed garlic clove. Slice the chicken over the rice and spoon over the lemon butter.
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick, served with sour cream and cornbread.
W: Velvet cupcake batter of buttermilk and a little cocoa tinted blue, baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with cream cheese frosting.
K: Two scoops of vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with cold cola poured slowly over so it foams up high, topped with dark chocolate shavings. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream in each. Pour 300ml very cold cola slowly down the side of each glass, stopping to let the foam settle before topping up. Shave 30g dark chocolate over the foam with a peeler and serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw.
T: Presentation. Then dinner.
D: A blue supervillain finally beats his hero and finds out being on top is boring.
P: Serve the mains when Megamind, disguised as Bernard, takes Roxanne out to dinner.

title: Despicable Me 2
S: Gru's new legit business making jams and jellies
Shortcrust rounds pressed into a patty tin, filled with Gru-worthy homemade berry jam, baked at 190C for 15 minutes.
Eduardo's restaurant at the shopping mall
Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, topped with fresh salsa, guacamole and sour cream.
Agnes's fairy princess star fairy bread
Agnes's birthday party with a fairy princess

Soft white bread spread with butter and pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into stars with a cutter and piled high for the party. Soften 100g butter until very spreadable. Spread it right to the edges of 12 slices soft white bread. Tip 1 jar hundreds and thousands onto a plate and press each slice butter side down into them so the top is fully coated. Cut out stars with a large star cutter, or cut into triangles with the crusts off. Pile onto a platter and serve straight away so the colours don't run.
M: the Mexican restaurant run by Eduardo
Chicken thighs braised in a red chilli and tomato sauce, shredded, rolled in tortillas, covered in more sauce and cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes.
Gru's underground lab full of minions

Spaghetti and beef meatballs simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, a big pot for the whole household. Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves and salt. Roll into 20 meatballs and brown in olive oil. Soften 1 diced onion, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and a handful of basil and simmer 15 minutes. Add the meatballs, cover and simmer 40 minutes. Toss with 500g cooked spaghetti and serve with plenty of parmesan.
W: the purple minions on the loose
Grape jelly made up and set in clear cups for 3 hours, topped with whipped cream and banana slices like a minion's goggles.
K: Ripe bananas blended with cold milk, vanilla yoghurt, medjool dates and a pinch of cinnamon until thick, with a caramel drizzle in the glass. Peel 3 ripe bananas, slice and freeze for 2 hours. Blend with 500ml cold milk, 200g vanilla yoghurt, 4 pitted medjool dates and a pinch of cinnamon until thick and smooth. Drizzle 1 tbsp caramel sauce down the inside of each of 4 glasses, pour in the smoothie and top with a banana slice.
T: Gru makes jelly now. Mostly.
D: Gru has gone straight making jams and jellies until a secret agency recruits him to find a stolen formula.
P: Serve the mains when Gru and Lucy go undercover at Eduardo's Mexican restaurant in the mall.

title: Minions
S: Banana chunks dipped in a light soda water batter, fried golden and crisp, drizzled with honey and sprinkled with crushed peanuts. Whisk 100g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cornflour, 1 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt with 170ml cold soda water into a smooth batter. Cut 4 firm bananas into 4cm chunks. Heat oil to 180C. Dip the banana in batter and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Drain on paper towel, drizzle with honey and scatter with 50g crushed roasted peanuts. Eat while hot.

Grilled franks in soft buns loaded with quick beef chilli, melted cheddar, sticky fried onions and mustard, wrapped in paper. Fry 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp mild chilli powder, add 200g passata and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Grill 8 franks until they split. Split and toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over chilli, top with 100g grated cheddar, onions and mustard. Wrap in paper.
the minions stealing the Queen's crown in London
Puff pastry strips twisted with cheddar and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until golden as a crown.
M: Cold chicken in a curried mayonnaise with apricot and sultanas, served on rice or soft rolls.
Scarlet's castle roast beef and Yorkshires

Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 200C for 50 minutes for medium. Rest 15 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in hot oil for 50 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk into a batter. Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin at 230C, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes without opening the oven. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Bananas split lengthways with three scoops of ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and a cherry. Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring into hot fudge. Split 4 bananas lengthways into long dishes. Add three scoops of vanilla ice cream to each, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry.
K: Ripe bananas blended with vanilla ice cream, cold milk and salted caramel until thick, topped with whipped cream and a banana slice. Blend 3 ripe bananas with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp salted caramel sauce until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little more caramel inside 4 tall glasses and pour in the shake. Top each with a swirl of whipped cream, a banana slice and a final drizzle of caramel. Serve with wide straws.
T: Banana. Then more banana.
D: Three minions travel to 1968 Villain-Con looking for a new evil boss.
P: Serve the snacks when Kevin, Stuart and Bob arrive at Villain-Con.

title: The Aristocats
S: Wedges of blue cheese on a board with sliced pears, toasted walnuts, a pot of honey and crackers.

Choux pastry with gruyère piped into small balls, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until the dough comes away from the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Pipe walnut-size balls onto lined trays, top with a little more cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
the alley cats jamming in the Paris attic
Mini croque monsieurs of ham, gruyère, Dijon and béchamel on white bread, grilled until bubbling and cut into squares.
M: the cats lost in the French countryside
Chicken thighs browned and simmered with bacon, mushrooms and red wine for 90 minutes, with buttery mash.
Abigail and Amelia's chicken leek pie
Abigail and Amelia, the English geese

Chicken, leek and mushroom pie in a creamy sauce under puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 30g butter and set aside. Cook 1 sliced leek and 200g sliced mushrooms for 6 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken and thyme and season. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with buttered peas.
W: the bowl of cream Edgar serves the cats
Vanilla crème brûlée baked at 150C for 35 minutes in a water bath, chilled, sugar torched on top. Nothing added.
K: the cats riding in the back of the milk truck

Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, honey and a vanilla bean until frothy, poured into glasses with a pinch of nutmeg on top. Split 1 vanilla bean and scrape the seeds into a blender, or use 1 tsp vanilla bean paste. Add 600ml cold full cream milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and 2 tbsp honey and blend for 30 seconds until frothy. Pour into 4 glasses and dust with a little grated nutmeg. Serve straight away.
T: Crème de la crème. Hold the sleeping pills.
D: A family of pampered Paris cats is dumped in the countryside by the butler and finds its way home with an alley cat.
P: Serve dessert when Edgar the butler prepares the cream.

title: The Fox and the Hound
S: Scones of self-raising flour, cold butter and buttermilk, cut into rounds and baked at 220C for 14 minutes, with butter and honey.
Tod and Copper playing by the creek
Blackberries and blueberries tossed with honey and torn mint, spooned into cups over whipped cream.
Amos Slade and his hunting dogs

Beef topside sliced thin, marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and garlic, dried at 75C for 4 hours until chewy. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour so it slices easily, then cut across the grain into 3mm strips, trimming off fat. Mix 80ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp cracked black pepper. Marinate the beef overnight in the fridge. Pat dry, lay on wire racks over trays and dry at 75C for 4 hours with the oven door slightly open until chewy. Cool before serving.
M: Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and onion in stock, topped with herb dumplings and covered for the last 20 minutes.
Country beef pot roast and gravy
the farm on the edge of the forest

Beef chuck braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrots and potatoes in stock, gravy from the pot. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato paste, a few thyme sprigs and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 4 carrots and 800g potatoes in big chunks and braise 1 hour more. Lift out the meat and veg, simmer the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water until it thickens to gravy, and pour over the sliced beef.
W: the berry bushes on the farm
Blackberries tossed with sugar under a buttery cobbler topping, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, with vanilla ice cream.
K: Fresh strawberries blended with cold full cream milk, vanilla ice cream and honey until pink and frothy, poured into jars. Hull 250g strawberries and blend with 500ml cold full cream milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 1 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 glass jars and top each with a halved strawberry. Serve straight away.
T: Best friends forever. Snacks too.
D: A young fox and a hound puppy become best friends before growing up on opposite sides.
P: Serve the snacks when Tod and Copper play by the creek.

title: The Sword in the Stone
S: Thick slices of crusty bread with aged cheddar, pickled onions and apple wedges on a big wooden board.
Walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds tossed with honey and cinnamon, roasted at 170C for 15 minutes, cooled into clusters.
Wart turned into a fish in the castle moat

Flathead pieces dusted in seasoned flour, fried in hot oil until crisp, served with tartare sauce and lemon wedges. Cut 600g flathead fillets into bite-size pieces and pat dry. Season 100g plain flour with salt, pepper and a pinch of paprika. Dust the fish in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g panko. Shallow fry in 1cm of oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden. Mix 150g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, chopped dill and lemon juice. Serve hot with the tartare and lemon wedges.
M: Castle kitchen roast pork and crackling
Wart working in the castle kitchen

Pork shoulder roasted at 160C for 4 hours with crackling, with roast potatoes, apples and gravy. Score the skin of a 2kg pork shoulder, pat very dry and rub with oil and plenty of salt. Roast at 160C for 3.5 hours. Add 1kg potatoes in chunks tossed in oil for the last hour and 4 halved apples for the last 30 minutes. Turn the oven to 240C for 20 minutes to blister the crackling. Rest 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer into gravy. Carve and serve with the apples.
the New Year's tournament in London
Beef and ale pie simmered 3 hours, under a puff pastry lid baked at 200C, with mash and peas.
W: Suet-style pastry spread with raspberry jam, rolled, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, sliced with hot custard.
K: Merlin's spiced milk tea and sugar cubes
Merlin's sugar bowl that walks itself to the cup

Black tea simmered with milk, cinnamon, cardamom and ginger, strained into cups with a bowl of sugar cubes for everyone to help themselves. Bring 500ml water to the boil with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 crushed cardamom pods and 5 slices fresh ginger and simmer 5 minutes. Add 4 black tea bags and 500ml full cream milk and bring back to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes. Strain into 4 cups and serve with a bowl of sugar cubes on the side.
T: Pull the sword. Then do the dishes.
D: A young boy called Wart is tutored by the wizard Merlin and pulls the sword from the stone.
P: Serve the mains when Merlin magics the castle dishes into washing themselves.

title: The Great Mouse Detective
S: Mrs Judson's cheese crumpets at Baker Street
Crumpets toasted, spread with butter and topped with grated cheddar and a little mustard, grilled until bubbling.
Scotch eggs of soft-boiled eggs wrapped in pork sausage meat, crumbed and fried, with mustard.

Gingerbread cut into toy shapes, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, piped with white icing. Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 125ml golden syrup together. Sift 375g plain flour with 1 tsp bicarb, 3 tsp ground ginger and 1 tsp cinnamon, then stir in the butter mix and 1 beaten egg. Knead into a dough and chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm and cut into toy soldiers, teddies and tops. Bake on lined trays at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool, then pipe with icing of 150g icing sugar and a little egg white.
M: Lamb mince with onion, carrot and peas under buttery mash, baked at 200C until golden.

Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy made from the pan. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with oil, salt and mustard powder and roast at 200C for 50 minutes for medium. Rest 15 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in hot oil for 50 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 4 eggs and 200ml milk. Heat oil in a 12-hole muffin tin at 230C, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes without opening the door. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml beef stock and simmer into gravy.
W: Two vanilla sponges baked at 180C for 25 minutes, sandwiched with strawberry jam and whipped cream, dusted with icing sugar.
K: Basil and Dawson's rooms at Baker Street

Earl Grey brewed strong and chilled with lemon juice and honey, topped with sparkling water over ice and served with a shortbread finger. Steep 4 Earl Grey tea bags in 600ml boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 3 tbsp honey. Chill for 2 hours. Add the juice of 3 lemons. Fill 4 glasses with ice and lemon slices, pour in the tea to two thirds full and top with 300ml sparkling water. Serve with shortbread fingers.
T: Cheese crumpets at Baker Street.
D: A mouse detective in 1897 London takes on Professor Ratigan to rescue a kidnapped toymaker.
P: Serve the snacks when Mrs Judson brings in the cheese crumpets.

title: Atlantis: The Lost Empire
S: Cookie, the expedition's crusty old chuck wagon cook
Navy beans simmered slowly with bacon, onion, molasses and mustard for an hour until thick and smoky, served in tin cups.
the glowing blue crystals the Atlanteans wear

Blue jelly made with lemonade instead of water so it fizzes, set in shot glasses for 3 hours. Soak 4 gold-strength gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes. Warm 150ml lemonade with 2 tbsp caster sugar, squeeze out the gelatine and stir in until dissolved. Add 350ml cold lemonade, a squeeze of lime and 2 drops blue food colouring. Pour into 8 shot glasses and chill 3 hours. Top each with a few blueberries and a pinch of popping candy just before serving so they crackle.
the giant submarine Ulysses heading into the deep
Crackers, cubes of cheddar, sliced salami and pickled onions packed into small tins like rations.
M: Cookie feeding the crew in the caverns

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread from a cast iron pan. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes.
Kida and the Atlanteans welcoming the explorers
White fish grilled with lime and garlic, served with a mango and chilli salsa and coconut rice.
W: Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream, blueberries and passionfruit.
K: Cookie keeping the crew going through the caverns

Strong brewed coffee poured over sweetened condensed milk and plenty of ice, stirred until creamy and caramel coloured, served in tin mugs. Brew 500ml strong coffee in a plunger or stovetop pot and let it cool for 10 minutes. Spoon 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of 4 tin mugs or glasses. Fill with ice and pour the coffee over. Stir well until creamy. Add a pinch of cinnamon on top if you like.
T: Lost city. Found dinner.
D: A young linguist joins a 1914 expedition to find the lost city of Atlantis.
P: Serve the mains when Cookie dishes up dinner around the campfire.

title: Treasure Planet
S: Puff pastry squares filled with ham and cheddar, folded, egg washed and baked at 200C for 15 minutes until golden.
the barrel of purps in the galley
Purple plums, red grapes and figs cut and piled on a platter, with a little honey and lime.

Cream cheese and cheddar mixed and rolled into all sorts of little shapes, coated in paprika or chives, served with crackers. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 150g finely grated vintage cheddar, 1 small grated garlic clove and a pinch of cayenne. Chill 30 minutes until firm. Roll teaspoons of the mix into balls, logs and little blob shapes. Roll some in smoked paprika, some in chopped chives and some in crushed toasted pecans. Chill 15 minutes more and serve with 200g crackers and celery sticks.
M: John Silver's famous stew in the ship's galley
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots, potatoes and stout until thick, served in bowls with crusty bread.

Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and broccoli in a sticky soy and honey sauce. Slice 500g chicken thigh and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Loosen 400g fresh egg noodles in hot water. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil. Stir-fry the chicken in a very hot wok with oil for 4 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry 1 sliced red capsicum, 1 head broccoli in small florets and 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes. Add the noodles, chicken and sauce and toss until sticky. Top with sesame seeds.
W: Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into chests, topped with chocolate coins.
K: Blueberries simmered into a quick syrup with lime, poured over ice and topped with lemonade so it fades from deep purple to starry blue. Simmer 150g blueberries with 50g caster sugar and 60ml water for 5 minutes, crushing the berries, then strain and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a few fresh blueberries. Add the juice of half a lime to each, then pour 600ml cold lemonade between them. Slowly spoon the blueberry syrup over the top so it sinks through the glass in layers. Stir at the table.
T: Stew from a cyborg. Treasure from a planet.
D: A teenage space surfer finds a map to a legendary treasure and signs on as cabin boy aboard a solar galleon.
P: Serve the mains when Silver serves up his stew in the ship's galley.

title: Brother Bear
S: the bears catching salmon at the salmon run
Rye crispbread spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, dill and a squeeze of lemon, laid out on a wooden board.
Koda leading Kenai through the forest

Blueberries, raspberries and blackberries tossed with a little honey, spooned into bowls over whipped cream. Toss 150g blueberries, 150g raspberries and 150g blackberries with 2 tbsp honey and the zest of half a lemon and stand for 10 minutes so the juices run. Whip 300ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and a few drops of vanilla to soft peaks. Spoon the cream into 4 bowls, pile the berries and their juices on top and scatter with 40g crushed toasted hazelnuts.
Pecans and walnuts tossed with maple syrup and salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes and cooled into clusters.
M: Salmon fillets brushed with maple syrup and grainy mustard, roasted at 200C for 15 minutes, with dill-buttered baby potatoes. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, drain and toss with 30g butter, chopped dill and salt. Mix 3 tbsp maple syrup with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and a squeeze of lemon. Lay 4 salmon fillets on a lined tray, season and brush with half the glaze. Roast at 200C for 12 to 15 minutes, brushing with the rest halfway, until just cooked in the middle. Serve with the potatoes and lemon wedges.
the hunt before Kenai becomes a bear

Venison steaks seared rare and rested, sliced with a glossy blueberry, thyme and balsamic sauce and crisp rosemary roast potatoes. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, toss with oil, rosemary and salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Bring 4 venison steaks to room temperature, oil and season. Sear in a very hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side for rare and rest 5 minutes. Add 150ml beef stock, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 150g blueberries, 1 tbsp brown sugar and a thyme sprig to the pan and simmer 5 minutes until syrupy, then whisk in 20g butter. Slice the venison and spoon over the sauce.
W: the honey and berries the bears love
Mixed berries tossed with honey under an oat, butter and brown sugar crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes, with cream.
K: the spirits lighting up the sky as the northern lights

Fresh lemonade shaken with a blueberry and mint syrup, poured over ice and topped with soda so it swirls purple and green like the spirit lights. Simmer 150g blueberries with 80g caster sugar and 80ml water for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Mix the juice of 4 lemons with 2 tbsp of the syrup and 400ml cold water. Fill 4 glasses with ice, a few mint leaves and blueberries. Pour in the lemonade, then spoon the rest of the blueberry syrup over the top and finish with a splash of soda water.
T: Salmon run. Bring a bowl.
D: A young hunter is turned into a bear and travels with an orphaned cub to the place where the lights touch the earth.
P: Serve the mains when the bears gather at the salmon run.

title: Meet the Robinsons
S: Lewis's peanut butter and jelly bites
Lewis's peanut butter and jelly machine that explodes
Little sandwiches of white bread with peanut butter and strawberry jam, crusts cut off, cut into triangles and stacked high.
Science fair chicken nuggets and dips

Chicken breast nuggets in crunchy parmesan panko, baked golden and served with three test tube dips: honey mustard, barbecue and garlic aioli. Cut 600g chicken breast into nugget pieces. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 150g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan and 1 tsp paprika. Lay on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 15 minutes, turning once, until golden. Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp Dijon and 2 tbsp mayo. Serve with that, barbecue sauce and garlic aioli in small glasses.
Uncle Art, the intergalactic pizza delivery man
Pizza dough rolled thin, cut into rounds, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 220C for 10 minutes.
M: Uncle Gaston firing meatballs across the dinner table
Beef and pork meatballs browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato and basil sauce, piled over spaghetti for the whole wild family.
Todayland chicken tacos with lime slaw
the bright future city of Todayland

Chicken thighs grilled with lime and chilli, tucked into soft tortillas with slaw, avocado and crema. Marinate 700g chicken thigh with the juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 crushed garlic clove and oil for 30 minutes. Grill 5 minutes a side and slice. Toss a quarter of a red cabbage, finely shredded, with the juice of 1 lime, coriander and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with lime zest and a pinch of salt for crema. Warm 12 small flour tortillas and fill with chicken, slaw, sliced avocado and crema.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with bright buttercream and a little arrow on top.
K: the villain who never thought it through
Frozen red grapes blended with banana, grape juice and vanilla yoghurt until thick and purple.
T: Keep moving forward. Duck the meatballs.
D: An orphan inventor is whisked into the future by a boy called Wilbur and meets the very odd Robinson family.
P: Serve the mains when Uncle Gaston fires the meatball cannon at dinner.

title: Wish
S: the kingdom of Rosas on the Mediterranean
Crusty bread toasted, rubbed with cut garlic and ripe tomato, drizzled with olive oil and finished with sea salt.
Goat's cheese rolled into balls, coated in chopped parsley and crushed pistachios, served with a drizzle of honey.

Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C until crisp, tossed with smoked paprika and salt. Slice 600g washed potatoes 1 to 2mm thin on a mandoline. Soak in cold water for 20 minutes to remove starch, then dry very well on tea towels. Heat oil to 170C and fry in small batches for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until golden and the bubbling stops. Drain on paper towel. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp sea salt and a pinch of sugar and toss through while hot. Serve with a sour cream and chive dip.
M: Rice cooked in a wide pan with chicken, chorizo, capsicum, saffron and stock until the bottom crisps, with lemon.

Lamb leg rubbed with garlic, rosemary and lemon, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with potatoes. Cut slits in a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with the zest and juice of 1 lemon, olive oil and salt. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes for medium, adding 1kg potatoes in wedges tossed with oil, oregano and lemon juice for the last hour. Rest 15 minutes, carve and serve with the potatoes and a dollop of garlicky Greek yoghurt.
W: Shortbread cut into stars, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced yellow with a little edible glitter.
K: Fresh lemonade with orange blossom water and sparkling water over ice.
T: Make a wish. Make dinner.
D: A young woman in the kingdom of Rosas makes a wish on a star and stands up to the king who keeps everyone's wishes.
P: Serve dessert when Dahlia brings out her baking.

title: The Little Mermaid
S: Scuttle's dinglehopper, also known as a fork

Mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit cut and piled on a platter, squeezed with lime, scattered with chilli salt, with a dinglehopper each. Cut 2 mangoes, half a pineapple and half a papaya into wedges and pile on a platter with halved passionfruit. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a little salt mixed with chilli flakes. Serve in the Caribbean sun.

Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and cucumber rounds with cream cheese. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and a dill sprig. Cut 2 Lebanese cucumbers into thick rounds. Beat 150g cream cheese with lemon zest, chopped chives and pepper and pipe onto the cucumber. Top with a few capers. Arrange everything on a silver tray with lemon wedges.
the Caribbean island where Eric lives
Green plantains sliced thin, fried at 180C until crisp, salted and served with a lime and coriander dip.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in allspice, thyme, chilli, lime and spring onion, grilled until charred, with rice and peas.
Lagoon garlic lime prawns and coconut rice
Ariel and Eric's boat ride on the lagoon

Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime butter until charred, served over coconut rice cooked with a pinch of salt. Rinse 1.5 cups jasmine rice and cook with a 400ml tin coconut milk, 200ml water and half a teaspoon salt, covered on low for 15 minutes, then rest 10. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and the zest of 1 lime. Toss 1kg peeled green prawns with oil and grill on high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pour over the garlic butter and lime juice and serve on the rice with coriander.
W: the hidden grotto where Ariel keeps her treasures

Blue jelly set in clear glasses with fruit fish shapes inside, topped with whipped cream foam. Cut mango and kiwifruit into little fish shapes. Make up 2 packets of blue jelly and pour into clear glasses with the fruit fish suspended inside. Chill 3 hours, then top with whipped cream like sea foam.
K: the royal crab trying to keep Ariel out of trouble

Coconut water and pineapple juice with lime and mint over ice, served in shell-shaped glasses. Fill tall glasses with ice and mint leaves. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir and serve cold, the kind of drink you would trade your voice for.
T: Bring a fork. Don't comb your hair with it.
D: A mermaid princess trades her voice for legs to find the prince she rescued.
P: Serve the mains when Ariel sits down to dinner at the castle and finds the fork.

title: The Jungle Book
S: Mowgli climbing the cliff to get Baloo's honey
Thick sourdough toasted, spread with ricotta whipped with a little honey, drizzled with more honey and scattered with crushed walnuts.
Mango, pineapple and banana cut into chunks with lychees, squeezed with lime and sprinkled with chilli salt.
Peace Rock potato and pea samosas
the water truce at Peace Rock

Spiced potato and pea filling with garam masala folded into pastry triangles, fried at 180C until crisp, with mint yoghurt. Boil 600g diced potatoes until just tender. Fry 1 diced onion in oil, add 1 tsp cumin seeds, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp grated ginger and a green chilli. Add the potatoes and 1 cup frozen peas and crush lightly, then season and cool. Cut 6 sheets spring roll pastry into 3 strips each, fold spoonfuls into triangles and seal with flour paste. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with yoghurt mixed with mint and lemon.
M: Chicken thighs simmered in a tomato and coconut curry with ginger and garam masala, with basmati rice and naan. Fry 1 diced onion in oil for 8 minutes, add 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder for 1 minute. Add 800g diced chicken thigh and stir to coat. Pour in a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and a 400ml tin coconut milk and simmer 30 minutes until thick. Stir in coriander and lime. Serve with 1.5 cups basmati rice and 4 warm naan.
Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and garlic, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, with flatbread.
W: Sugar, golden syrup and honey boiled to 150C, bicarb whisked in so it foams, set and broken into chunks, dipped in chocolate.
K: Mango blended with yoghurt, milk and cardamom over ice.
T: Get the honey. Get the bear.
D: A boy raised by wolves journeys through the jungle with a panther and a bear as a tiger hunts him.
P: Serve dessert when Mowgli climbs the cliff to bring Baloo the honey.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
S: Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on crushed ice with a cocktail sauce.
London tavern beef and gravy pies
the London tavern where Jack finds Angelica

Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, 300ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tbsp tomato paste and simmer 20 minutes until thick, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with the mince, top with rounds cut from 2 sheets puff pastry, crimp and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
the Spanish fleet racing for the Fountain
Green and black olives marinated with orange peel, garlic, chilli and olive oil, with manchego.
M: the Spanish are racing for the fountain too

Saffron rice with chicken, chorizo, prawns and mussels, cooked in one wide pan and left alone so the rice on the bottom turns crisp. Brown 400g chicken thighs and 1 sliced chorizo, add an onion and capsicum, then 300g paella rice, saffron, paprika and 900ml stock. Simmer 15 minutes without stirring, add 300g prawns and 500g mussels and cook 6 minutes more.
the jungle island with the Fountain of Youth

Pork shoulder rubbed with jerk spices, slow cooked at 150C for 4 hours, pulled with rice and beans. Blitz 4 spring onions, 2 scotch bonnet or red chillies, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp allspice, 1 tbsp thyme leaves, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 tbsp soy and the juice of 2 limes into a paste. Rub over a 1.5kg pork shoulder and marinate overnight. Roast covered at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart, then shred with the juices. Simmer 1.5 cups rice with a tin of drained kidney beans, 400ml coconut milk and water for 18 minutes and serve together.
W: Jack eating the cream puffs at the palace
Choux pastry baked at 200C until puffed, filled with vanilla custard cream and dusted with icing sugar.
K: the waters of the Fountain of Youth

White rum, coconut water, pineapple and lime shaken with a little sugar syrup, poured over crushed ice and grated with nutmeg. Mix 160ml white rum, 400ml coconut water, 300ml pineapple juice, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar syrup in a jug and stir well. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the punch and grate a little fresh nutmeg over the top. Add a pineapple wedge. For a non-drinking version, leave out the rum and add an extra 150ml coconut water.
T: Cream puffs at the palace. Rum after.
D: Jack Sparrow is forced aboard Blackbeard's ship on a race to the Fountain of Youth.
P: Serve dessert when Jack helps himself to the cream puffs at King George's palace.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales
S: the whole bank dragged through the streets of Saint Martin
Parmesan and thyme spooned into coin shapes on baking paper, baked at 190C for 6 minutes until golden, served with fig jam.
Prawns dipped in a cold batter of flour, cornflour and soda water, fried at 180C until puffed and crisp, with sweet chilli and lime.
Carina reading the stars to find the Trident

Cheddar cracker dough rolled thin, cut into stars, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp. Rub 100g cold diced butter into 150g plain flour with half a teaspoon salt and a pinch of cayenne. Mix in 150g finely grated vintage cheddar and 2 tbsp cold water and press into a dough. Chill 20 minutes, roll out 3mm thick and cut into stars of different sizes. Bake on lined trays at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp. Cool and serve with a whipped feta and honey dip.
M: Snapper fillets simmered in coconut milk with tomato, chilli, garlic and lime for 10 minutes, served over rice.
Will and Elizabeth reunited at the very end

Pork belly scored and roasted at 160C for 3 hours, crackling blasted crisp at 240C, with apple sauce and roast potatoes. Score the skin of a 1.5kg pork belly, pat very dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Rub with oil and plenty of salt. Roast on a rack at 160C for 2.5 hours, then turn up to 240C for 20 to 30 minutes until the crackling blisters. Roast 1kg potatoes in the fat for the last hour. Simmer 3 peeled chopped apples with 2 tbsp sugar and a splash of water for 10 minutes for apple sauce. Rest the pork 10 minutes and cut into thick slices.
W: Soft rolled sponge filled with sticky guava, steamed until tender and sliced warm, with a whipped rum butter melting over the top. Make a soft dough of 250g self-raising flour, 60g butter, 60g sugar and 150ml milk. Roll out, spread with 250g guava paste, roll up, wrap in buttered foil and steam 1 hour. Serve with 80g butter, 100g icing sugar and 30ml rum beaten together.
K: Jack's rum, ginger and lime highball
the bottle of rum Jack trades his compass for

Dark rum over ice with fresh lime and spicy ginger beer, stirred once and finished with a lime wedge and a slice of fresh ginger. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each and drop in the wedge. Pour 180ml cold spicy ginger beer into each glass, then gently float 45ml dark rum over the top. Add a thin slice of fresh ginger and serve with a stirrer. For landlubbers, skip the rum and add an extra squeeze of lime.
T: Swap the compass for a bottle.
D: A young sailor and an astronomer team up with Jack Sparrow to find the Trident of Poseidon.
P: Serve the drinks when Jack trades his compass for a bottle of rum.

title: Jurassic World Dominion
S: the black market chase through Malta
Puff pastry filled with ricotta and pea and onion, folded into little parcels and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until flaky.
the giant locusts eating the crops
Corn cobs boiled 6 minutes, brushed with chilli lime butter and charred on a hot grill, cut into rounds.
Owen wrangling dinosaurs in the Sierra Nevada

Beef topside sliced thin, marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire and garlic, dried at 75C for 4 hours. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice across the grain into 3mm strips, trimming any fat. Mix 80ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry, lay on wire racks over trays and dry at 75C for 4 hours with the oven door slightly open until chewy but bendy. Cool fully before serving.
M: the Biosyn sanctuary in the Italian Dolomites
Creamy polenta stirred with butter and parmesan, topped with a mushroom and sausage ragù simmered an hour.

Chicken thighs braised with red wine, tomato, garlic, bay and peas for an hour, with crusty bread. Season 8 chicken thigh cutlets and brown in olive oil, then set aside. Soften 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves, add 250ml red wine and bubble for 2 minutes. Add a 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 3 bay leaves and 250ml chicken stock. Return the chicken, cover and simmer 50 minutes. Add 1 cup frozen peas for the last 5 minutes. Serve with crusty bread.
W: the dinosaur DNA trapped in amber
Sugar, golden syrup and honey boiled to 150C, bicarb whisked in so it foams, set and broken into amber shards.
K: Chilled Maltese almond milk scented with vanilla and a hint of clove, poured over ice with toasted flaked almonds on top. Soak 200g blanched almonds in water overnight, then drain. Blend with 1L cold water for 2 minutes and strain through a clean cloth, squeezing well. Stir in 3 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of ground cloves. Chill 1 hour. Toast 2 tbsp flaked almonds in a dry pan. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and scatter with the almonds.
T: Dinosaurs everywhere. Dinner anyway.
D: Dinosaurs now live alongside people, and a plague of giant locusts leads the heroes to a sanctuary in the Dolomites.
P: Serve the snacks when the raptors chase Owen through the streets of Malta.

title: Jurassic World Rebirth
S: Dolores, the little aquilops Isabella keeps

Pineapple, mango, papaya and passionfruit cut and piled on banana leaves, with lime and chilli salt. Lay banana leaves on a big platter. Cut a pineapple, 2 mangoes and half a papaya into wedges and pile on top with halved passionfruit. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a little salt mixed with chilli.
Delgado sailboat fish bites and lime mayo

Chunks of flathead in crunchy panko, shallow fried golden and served in paper with a zesty lime and chilli mayo for dipping. Cut 500g flathead fillets into bite-size chunks and season. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 120g panko. Shallow fry in 1cm oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Mix 150g mayo with the zest and juice of 1 lime and 1 tsp sriracha. Serve the fish in paper cones with the mayo and lime wedges.
Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime butter, piled on a platter with lime wedges.
M: the drug company paying for the whole trip

Snapper fillets rubbed with lime and chilli, grilled in banana leaves for 10 minutes, with coconut rice. Rub 4 snapper fillets with lime juice, chopped red chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill for 10 minutes. Cook jasmine rice in coconut milk with a pinch of salt. Serve the fish in its leaf on the rice.
the abandoned research facility on the island

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes for cornbread.
W: the clifftop nest where they take a sample

Dark chocolate mousse set in glasses for 3 hours, topped with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and a speckled chocolate egg. Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir yolks into the chocolate, then fold in cream and whites. Spoon into glasses and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits and a speckled egg.
K: Coconut water, pineapple juice and lime with mint over ice.
T: Back to the island. Bring snacks.
D: A team heads to a remote equatorial island to collect dinosaur DNA and picks up a stranded family on the way.
P: Serve the snacks when the team reaches the island.

title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
S: the Spenglers living in the old firehouse
Pizza dough topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 250C for 10 minutes and cut into squares, eaten straight from the tray.
Ray's occult shop brown butter shortbread

Butter, sugar and flour shortbread pressed into a round, scored and baked at 160C until pale golden. Melt 250g butter in a pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown, then chill until firm but soft. Beat with 110g caster sugar until pale. Mix in 330g plain flour, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 23cm round tin, mark into 12 wedges and prick with a fork. Bake at 160C for 35 to 40 minutes until pale golden. Sprinkle with caster sugar and cut along the lines while warm.
Phoebe's chess club pigs in blankets

Cocktail sausages wrapped in buttery puff pastry with sesame, baked until golden and lined up like chess pieces, with tomato sauce and mustard. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 24 strips and wrap one around each of 24 cocktail sausages, seam underneath. Lay on a lined tray, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Line them up on a board in rows and serve with tomato sauce and American mustard.
M: Rye bread layered with sliced corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and Russian dressing, grilled in butter until melting.
the deep freeze over New York

Chicken noodle soup simmered with carrot, celery and dill, served piping hot with crusty bread. Put 800g chicken thighs in a pot with 2L chicken stock, 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks, all diced, plus 2 bay leaves. Simmer 30 minutes, then lift out the chicken and shred it. Add 150g egg noodles and cook 6 minutes. Return the chicken, season well and stir in a handful of chopped dill and the juice of half a lemon. Serve piping hot with buttered crusty bread.
W: the tiny marshmallow men causing chaos
Marshmallows toasted over a flame until golden, squashed with a square of dark chocolate between two plain sweet biscuits.
K: Bright green lime cordial and soda over crushed ice with a scoop of lime sorbet slowly melting in.
T: Mini-Pufts. Big appetite.
D: The Spengler family moves into the old firehouse just as an ancient ghost threatens to freeze New York.
P: Serve dessert when the mini-Pufts turn up causing chaos.

title: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
S: the travelling wizard circus in Paris

Puff pastry triangles rolled around a stick of dark chocolate, egg washed and baked at 200C for 15 minutes. Cut 2 puff pastry sheets into long triangles. Lay a stick of dark chocolate at the wide end and roll up towards the point. Curve into crescents, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Yeasted doughnuts fried at 175C until golden, filled with plum jam and dusted with icing sugar.

Crisp golden choux puffs beaten with gruyère, nutmeg and black pepper, baked until hollow and served warm in a napkin-lined basket. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes until the dough comes away from the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper. Pipe walnut-size balls onto lined trays, top with a little more cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: Nicolas Flamel's old house in Paris

Chicken braised in red wine with bacon lardons, mushrooms, little onions and thyme until tender, spooned over buttery mash. Brown 1.2kg chicken pieces and 150g bacon lardons. Add 12 small onions and 250g mushrooms, then 500ml red wine, 250ml stock and thyme. Simmer covered 45 minutes and serve with 800g potatoes mashed with butter.
Hogwarts staff room chicken leek pie

Chicken and leek pie in a creamy sauce under puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 30g butter and set aside. Soften 2 sliced leeks in the same pan, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken, chopped thyme and a spoon of Dijon and season. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with buttered peas.
W: Queenie and her magic in the kitchen
Apples, sultanas, cinnamon and breadcrumbs rolled in buttered filo, baked at 190C for 35 minutes until crisp, dusted with icing sugar.
K: Paris café au lait with vanilla Chantilly

Strong coffee and steaming milk poured together into big bowl-sized cups, topped with vanilla whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and half a teaspoon vanilla to soft peaks. Brew 500ml strong coffee in a plunger or stovetop pot. Heat 500ml full cream milk until steaming and froth it with a whisk. Pour the coffee and milk into 4 big cups at the same time, half and half. Top with a spoon of the vanilla cream and a pinch of cocoa.
T: Paris, 1927. Pastries first.
D: Newt Scamander goes to Paris to find Credence while Grindelwald gathers followers.
P: Serve the snacks when Newt and Jacob arrive in Paris.

title: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
S: Soft pretzels shaped and boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with grainy mustard and butter.
Hog's Head sausage rolls and brown sauce

Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with brown sauce. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 tsp salt and plenty of pepper. Halve 2 sheets puff pastry lengthways. Lay a log of the filling down each strip, roll up and seal the seam with beaten egg. Cut each log into 4, brush with egg and score the tops. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot with brown sauce.
the ceremony in the mountains of Bhutan
Chicken and spring onion dumplings with ginger, steamed 10 minutes, with a chilli tomato dip.
M: Pork loin steaks pounded thin, crumbed in egg and panko, fried in butter until golden, with a warm potato salad and lemon.

Polish-style pierogi of potato and cheese, boiled then fried in butter with onions, with sour cream. Mix 300g plain flour, 1 egg, 125ml warm water, 2 tbsp sour cream and a pinch of salt into a soft dough, knead 3 minutes and rest 30 minutes. Mash 500g boiled potatoes with 100g grated cheddar and 1 onion fried in butter. Roll the dough thin, cut 7cm rounds, fill and pinch closed. Boil in batches until they float, then 2 minutes more. Fry 2 sliced onions in 60g butter until golden, add the pierogi to crisp and serve with sour cream and dill.
W: Vanilla sponge baked in three tins at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked with buttercream and raspberry jam, iced white.
K: Raspberries crushed with lemon and a little sugar, topped with cold sparkling wine in flutes. Sparkling apple juice for the non-drinkers. Crush 125g raspberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of half a lemon, then push through a sieve to remove the seeds. Spoon 1 tbsp of the purée into each of 4 flutes. Slowly top with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle, letting the foam settle as you pour. Drop a whole raspberry into each glass. For non-drinkers, use sparkling apple juice.
T: One wedding cake. Many beasts.
D: Dumbledore sends Newt and a small team to stop Grindelwald from taking over the wizarding world.
P: Serve dessert when Jacob and Queenie get married at the bakery.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
S: the apple trees at the ruins of Cair Paravel
Red and green apples sliced and fanned on a board around a dip of peanut butter loosened with honey, dusted with cinnamon.
Damper of self-raising flour, butter and milk baked at 200C for 30 minutes, torn and served with butter.
Reepicheep, the bravest mouse in Narnia

Little scones packed with vintage cheddar and chives, baked tall and golden with a cheesy crust, split and spread with cold butter. Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour with a pinch of salt and half a teaspoon mustard powder. Stir in 120g grated vintage cheddar and a handful of chopped chives, then 250ml milk to make a soft dough. Pat out 3cm thick and cut 12 small rounds. Brush with milk, top with 30g more cheese and bake at 220C for 12 to 14 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with butter.
M: the Narnians gathering at Aslan's How
Lamb shoulder, barley, carrots and leeks simmered 2 hours in stock with rosemary, with crusty bread.

Pork loin rubbed with fennel seed and garlic, roasted at 200C for an hour with apples and potatoes, sliced with pan juices. Score the skin of a 1.5kg boneless pork loin and pat dry. Crush 2 tsp fennel seeds with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp salt and pepper and rub into the meat, then rub the skin with oil and salt. Roast at 220C for 25 minutes, then 180C for 40 minutes. Add 800g potatoes in chunks for the last 60 minutes and 4 halved apples for the last 30. Rest 10 minutes, slice and spoon over the pan juices.
W: Apples cooked with butter and cinnamon under an oat crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes, with custard.
K: the Pevensies waiting on the Underground platform

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with malted milk powder, whisked frothy and topped with whipped cream and a sprinkle of malt. Heat 1L full cream milk until steaming. Whisk in 120g chopped dark chocolate, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp brown sugar until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, top each with a spoon of whipped cream and a pinch more malted milk powder.
T: Back to Narnia. Apples first.
D: The Pevensies return to Narnia, centuries later, to help Prince Caspian against his tyrant uncle.
P: Serve the snacks when the Pevensies find the apple trees at the ruins of Cair Paravel.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
S: Homemade oat and cheddar biscuits baked crisp like ship's rations, topped with sharp cheddar, tomato chutney and a slice of pickle. Rub 80g cold butter into 100g plain flour and 100g rolled oats with a pinch of salt. Stir in 80g grated vintage cheddar and 3 tbsp cold milk to form a dough. Roll 5mm thick, cut into 16 squares and prick with a fork. Bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden, then cool. Top each with a slice of cheddar from 150g, a spoon of tomato chutney and a slice of dill pickle.
the Lone Islands and their market
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with lemon peel, garlic and chilli, served with torn crusty bread.

Button mushrooms stuffed with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes. Remove the stalks from 20 large button mushrooms and chop the stalks finely. Mix 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, the chopped stalks, chopped parsley and salt. Fill the mushroom caps with the butter. Mix 40g breadcrumbs with 30g grated parmesan and press on top. Bake on a tray at 200C for 12 minutes until bubbling and golden. Serve hot with toothpicks.
M: Aslan's table roast chicken and grapes
the great table on Ramandu's island

Roast chicken with lemon and herbs, roast potatoes, grapes roasted on the vine, and crusty bread laid out on a long table. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, lemon zest, thyme and salt and stuff with the halved lemon. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Add 4 small bunches of red grapes on the vine to the chicken tray for the last 15 minutes until they blister. Rest the chicken 10 minutes and lay everything out on a board with torn crusty bread.
the long voyage to the edge of the world
Snapper fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, finished with lemon butter and capers, with crushed baby potatoes.
W: the sea of white lilies at the edge of the world
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream and sliced white peaches.
K: the sweet water near the edge of the world

Fresh lemon juice and elderflower cordial stirred with cold water and torn mint, poured over ice with cucumber ribbons. Mix the juice of 4 lemons with 100ml elderflower cordial and 700ml cold water in a jug. Peel 1 Lebanese cucumber into long ribbons. Tear a handful of mint into the jug and stir. Fill 4 glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons and pour the lemonade over. Top with a splash of soda water if you want bubbles.
T: Sail to the edge of the world. Pack lunch.
D: Lucy, Edmund and their cousin Eustace are pulled into Narnia aboard the Dawn Treader.
P: Serve the mains when the crew reaches the table on Ramandu's island.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
S: the Metkayina reef village built over the water
Prawns tossed in garlic, chilli, lime and melted butter, grilled 2 minutes a side until charred, served on skewers with lime wedges.
Lo'ak and his tulkun friend Payakan
Mango, pineapple and papaya cut into wedges with halved passionfruit, squeezed with lime and scattered with toasted coconut.
the kids riding ilu through the kelp

Nori sheets brushed with sesame oil, sprinkled with sesame seeds and salt, toasted in a dry pan until crisp and cut into strips. Brush 8 nori sheets lightly on one side with 2 tbsp sesame oil mixed with 1 tsp honey. Sprinkle with 2 tbsp sesame seeds, a pinch of chilli flakes and flaky salt. Stick 2 sheets together oiled sides out, then toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute a side, or bake at 150C for 8 minutes, until crisp. Cut into strips with scissors and serve straight away.
M: the reef clan's food from the sea
Snapper fillets simmered 10 minutes in coconut milk with lemongrass, chilli and lime, served over steamed rice with fresh herbs.
the Sully family settling in by the water

Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, grilled until charred, sliced over a salad of mango, mint and red onion. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh for 1 hour with the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp oil. Grill over high heat 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred and cooked through, then rest. Toss 2 diced mangoes with a thinly sliced red onion, mint, coriander, lime juice and a pinch of salt. Slice the chicken over the salad.
W: the clear blue lagoon of the reef
Coconut milk warmed with sugar and set with gelatine in glasses for 4 hours, topped with diced mango and passionfruit.
K: the warm ocean waters around the reef

Frozen pineapple blended with coconut water, coconut cream, lime and mint into a slushy crush, poured into tall glasses with a pineapple wedge. Blend 400g frozen pineapple chunks with 500ml chilled coconut water, 100ml coconut cream, the juice of 1 lime, a few mint leaves and 1 cup ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and finish each with a pineapple wedge and mint sprig.
T: Learn the way of water. Then eat.
D: Jake Sully's family flees the forest and takes shelter with the Metkayina reef clan.
P: Serve the mains when the Sully family is taken in by the reef clan.

title: Transformers
S: Mikaela, the girl who knows engines
Roasted paprika potato wedges topped with melted cheddar, crisp bacon, sour cream and spring onion.

Corn chips piled with shredded chicken, black beans and melted cheese, baked until bubbling and topped with tomato salsa and cool sour cream. Spread 300g corn chips on a tray. Top with 250g shredded cooked chicken, a drained tin of black beans and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Finish with salsa and sour cream.
Desert base lamb kofta with garlic yoghurt
the soldiers at the desert base in Qatar

Lamb mince with onion, cumin and parsley shaped onto skewers, grilled and served with garlic yoghurt. Mix 600g lamb mince with 1 grated onion squeezed dry, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, half a teaspoon cinnamon, chopped parsley and salt. Shape around 8 skewers into long sausages and chill 20 minutes. Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and mint. Serve with warm flatbread and sliced tomato.
M: Sam's dad Ron and his precious lawn
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, cooked at 150C for 3 hours wrapped in foil, glazed with barbecue sauce and charred, with coleslaw.
Hoover Dam beef chilli and cornbread
the secret base under the Hoover Dam

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, with sour cream and cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream.
W: Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into neat cubes and dusted with edible glitter.
K: Thick dark chocolate milkshakes, black and glossy like a fresh oil change, with chocolate topping dripping down the inside of the glass. Blend 1L chocolate ice cream, 400ml milk and 3 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into 4 glasses and drizzle with chocolate topping. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
T: Your car might be a robot. Eat anyway.
D: A teenager's first car turns out to be an alien robot, and he ends up in the middle of a war between Autobots and Decepticons.
P: Serve the snacks when the Autobots try to hide in Sam's backyard.

title: Tron: Legacy
S: Crisp oven fries smothered in quick beef chilli and hot cheddar sauce, finished with spring onion and pickled jalapeños, eaten straight from the tray. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp chilli powder, add 200g passata and simmer 10 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick and stir in 120g grated cheddar. Pile the fries on a tray, spoon over the chilli and cheese sauce, and scatter with spring onion and jalapeños.
the light cycle races on the Grid
Pretzel rods dipped in white chocolate and drizzled with neon blue icing lines, set on baking paper.
Smoked salmon on black rye with crème fraîche and dill, laid out on black slate.
M: the long white dinner table in Kevin's hideout

Chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme at 200C for 75 minutes, carved with roast potatoes and greens, served on white plates. Mix 40g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, lemon zest and thyme and rub over and under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Stuff with the halved lemon. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes alongside. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Steam 2 bunches green beans and toss in butter. Carve and serve on white plates with the pan juices.
the glowing city on the Grid
Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and broccoli in a sticky soy and honey sauce.
W: End of Line Club neon cookies
Castor's club at the end of the line
Crisp butter cookies iced in bright neon colours with sharp straight lines like the Grid.
K: Flynn's zen iced matcha with honey
Kevin Flynn meditating in his hideout on the Grid

Matcha whisked smooth with warm water and honey, poured over ice and cold milk so it settles in a green layer, calm as Flynn. Sift 4 tsp matcha powder into a bowl and whisk with 200ml water at about 80C and 2 tbsp honey until smooth and frothy, with no lumps. Fill 4 glasses with ice and add 150ml cold milk to each. Slowly pour the matcha over the top so it sits in a bright green layer. Stir before drinking.
T: Enter the Grid. Leave hungry.
D: Sam Flynn goes looking for his missing father and is pulled into the digital world his dad created.
P: Serve the snacks when Sam walks into his dad's old arcade.

title: Men in Black 3
S: J chasing Boris through 1969 Coney Island
Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and sauerkraut, wrapped in wax paper.
the Chinese restaurant full of aliens
Pork and prawn dumplings steamed in bamboo baskets for 8 minutes, with soy and chilli oil.

Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into a ball, coated in chopped walnuts, served with crackers. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely sliced spring onions, 1 tsp Worcestershire and a pinch of cayenne until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 2 hours until firm. Roll in 80g finely chopped toasted walnuts mixed with chopped parsley. Sit on a board and serve with 200g crackers and celery sticks.
M: Launch day cheeseburgers and crinkle fries
the Apollo 11 launch at Cape Canaveral

Beef patties grilled to medium, cheddar melted on, in toasted buns with lettuce, tomato and onion, with crinkle fries. Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties a little wider than the buns and season well. Grill on high heat 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute. Toast 4 burger buns. Spread with mayo and tomato sauce and build with lettuce, sliced tomato, thin onion rings, pickles and the patty. Serve with the fries.
Beef meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mash and peas.
W: young K's favourite pie at the diner
Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, served warm with ice cream.
K: the agents in their black suits

Vodka, fresh espresso and coffee liqueur shaken hard with ice until a thick crema forms, strained into chilled glasses with three coffee beans. Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer. Make 4 shots of strong espresso or 200ml very strong coffee and cool for 5 minutes. Shake 2 drinks at a time: 90ml vodka, 60ml coffee liqueur, 100ml espresso and 1 tbsp sugar syrup with a big scoop of ice, shaking hard for 20 seconds. Strain into the glasses and float 3 coffee beans on the foam. For non-drinkers, shake espresso with syrup and milk over ice.
T: 1969. Same suit. Better pie.
D: Agent J travels back to 1969 to save a young Agent K from an alien assassin.
P: Serve dessert when young K and J stop for pie at the diner.

title: Notting Hill
S: the Portobello Road market outside William's shop
Crusty bread with brie, ham and chutney cut into small sandwiches, with a bowl of olives.

Shortbread of butter, sugar, flour and rice flour, baked at 160C for 25 minutes, cut into fingers. Beat 250g soft butter with 110g caster sugar until pale. Sift in 280g plain flour, 70g rice flour and a pinch of salt and mix to a dough. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick all over with a fork and chill 15 minutes. Bake at 160C for 25 to 30 minutes until pale golden. Sprinkle with caster sugar and cut into fingers while warm, then cool in the tin. Serve with a pot of tea.
Thick white bread buttered and filled with cheddar, tomato and pickle relish, toasted in a pan until golden, cut into quarters.
M: Honey's birthday dinner at Max and Bella's
Chicken thighs braised with white wine, mushrooms and tarragon, finished with cream, served with mash and green beans.
Ritz lemon dill salmon and asparagus

Salmon fillets roasted on lemon slices with dill and butter at 200C for 12 minutes, with crushed potatoes and asparagus. Halve 600g baby potatoes and boil 15 minutes until tender, then crush lightly with 30g butter, salt and chopped dill. Lay 2 lemons' worth of slices on a lined tray and sit 4 salmon fillets on top. Dot with 20g butter, scatter with dill and season. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Add 2 bunches asparagus tossed in oil for the last 6 minutes. Serve with the crushed potatoes and a lemon wedge.
W: the last brownie at Honey's birthday dinner
Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into squares, the last one kept aside for the saddest story.
K: William spilling orange juice all over Anna

Freshly squeezed orange juice topped with cold sparkling wine in flutes, a twist of orange on the rim. Best kept in the glass. Squeeze 6 oranges to get about 400ml juice and strain. Chill the juice and a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine well. Pour 100ml orange juice into each of 4 flutes, then slowly top with sparkling wine. Twist a strip of orange peel over each and hang it on the rim. For non-drinkers, top with sparkling water instead.
T: Saddest story wins the brownie.
D: A London bookshop owner falls for the most famous film star in the world.
P: Serve dessert when the dinner party guests compete for the last brownie.

title: Love Actually
S: the Prime Minister and Natalie at Downing Street
Shortbread fingers baked at 160C for 25 minutes, half-dipped in dark chocolate, served on a plate next to a pot of tea.
the kid who plays a lobster in the school nativity
