Raw peanuts roasted with butter, honey, brown sugar and cayenne until glossy and crunchy, finished with flaky salt and served warm in paper bags. Heat the oven to 170C. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp brown sugar, half a tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Toss with 400g raw unsalted peanuts until coated. Spread on a lined tray and roast 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until deep golden. Sprinkle with flaky salt and leave to cool on the tray for 10 minutes so they crisp. Break up any clumps and scoop into paper bags.
Little cornmeal and onion fritters fried golden, the Southern side for every ballgame and fish fry.
M: Annie Savoy's house, where the season's lessons happen

Chicken drumsticks soaked overnight in spiced buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour and fried until crackling, with creamy mash and peppery gravy. Soak 8 drumsticks overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp hot sauce. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp pepper and 1 tsp salt. Dredge the chicken, pressing to coat. Fry in oil at 160C for 12 to 14 minutes until cooked through to 75C inside. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk. For gravy, whisk 2 tbsp of the frying flour into 2 tbsp butter, then 400ml chicken stock and plenty of pepper.
Pork shoulder slow cooked at 150C for 5 hours, pulled and tossed with a tangy vinegar and brown sugar sauce, piled into buns with slaw.
W: Annie's church of baseball, deep in the South

Layers of homemade vanilla custard, sliced banana and soft vanilla biscuits under a thick cap of whipped cream, chilled overnight. Whisk 4 egg yolks, 120g caster sugar and 50g cornflour in a saucepan, then whisk in 750ml milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring, for 6 to 8 minutes until thick. Off the heat, stir in 20g butter and 2 tsp vanilla. Cover the surface and cool. Layer 250g vanilla wafer biscuits, 4 sliced bananas and the custard in a dish, repeating twice. Whip 300ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar, spread on top and chill overnight.
K: Nuke's wild arm out of the bullpen

Strong black tea sweetened with brown sugar, cooled and poured over ice with bourbon, fresh lemon and mint, in big ballpark cups. Steep 4 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 80g brown sugar until dissolved. Cool, then chill for 1 hour. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml bourbon to each, top with 200ml of the tea and squeeze in a lemon wedge. Slap a mint sprig between your hands and drop it in. Leave out the bourbon for non-drinkers.
T: Ballpark franks. Minor league dreams.
D: A veteran catcher is brought in to train a wild young pitcher, and they both catch the eye of the same woman.
P: Serve the snacks when the Durham Bulls take the field.

title: As Good as It Gets
S: Melvin feeding bacon to Verdell the dog
Thick bacon rashers baked on a rack at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp, cut into pieces and served warm with maple syrup for dipping.
Melvin's usual breakfast at the café where Carol works
Mini toasts topped with soft scrambled egg and crispy bacon pieces, laid out on a plate.
the road trip to Baltimore with Simon and Carol

Chicken tenderloins crumbed in crushed pretzels and baked crunchy, with a honey mustard dip, packed in a box for the car. Heat the oven to 210C. Crush 150g salted pretzels to coarse crumbs. Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in 40g plain flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then the pretzel crumbs, pressing to coat. Lay on a lined, oiled tray, spray with oil and bake 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through. Mix 80g Dijon mustard, 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp mayo for dipping.
M: Melvin and Carol's dinner in Baltimore
Crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, shaped into cakes and pan-fried until golden, with lemon and a green salad.
Café meatloaf with brown sugar glaze
the New York café where Carol waits tables

Beef meatloaf with onion, garlic and herbs, baked under a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick with buttery mash and minted peas. Heat the oven to 180C. Mix 1kg beef mince, 1 grated onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 80g breadcrumbs, 2 eggs, 80ml milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp chopped parsley and 1 tsp salt. Shape into a loaf in a lined tray. Mix 80ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp cider vinegar and spread over. Bake 1 hour, rest 10 minutes and slice. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and milk, and 400g peas boiled with mint.
W: A crumb crust filled with vanilla custard and sliced banana, finished with a deep layer of whipped cream.
K: Carol keeping Melvin's coffee topped up at his usual table

Cold strong coffee blended with vanilla ice cream and milk until thick, poured into tall diner glasses and topped with whipped cream and cocoa. Brew 250ml strong coffee and chill it for at least 1 hour. Blend the coffee with 8 big scoops (about 500g) vanilla ice cream, 250ml cold milk and 1 tbsp caster sugar until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and dust with cocoa. Serve with long spoons and straws.
T: Same table. Same waitress. Bring your own cutlery.
D: A rude, obsessive author falls for the only waitress who'll put up with him.
P: Serve the mains when Melvin and Carol sit down to dinner in Baltimore.

title: The Princess Diaries
S: Queen Clarisse trying a corn dog
Cocktail franks dipped in a cornmeal batter, fried at 180C until golden, served with mustard and tomato sauce.
Baguette slices toasted, topped with blue cheese, thin slices of pear and a drizzle of honey.
Sourdough garlic bites with hot clam dip
Mia's home in an old San Francisco firehouse

Sourdough cubes tossed in garlic butter and toasted crisp, served with a bubbling dip of chopped clams, cream cheese, parmesan and lemon. Heat the oven to 190C. Cut half a sourdough loaf into 3cm cubes and toss with 60g melted butter mixed with 2 crushed garlic cloves and parsley. Bake 12 minutes until crisp. Beat 250g cream cheese with 2 tbsp mayo, 40g grated parmesan, the zest and juice of half a lemon and 2 sliced spring onions. Fold in 2 drained 140g tins of chopped clams. Spread into a small dish, top with more parmesan and bake 15 minutes until bubbling.
M: the state dinner where Mia learns about palate cleansers
Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and potato gratin.

Soda-battered white fish fried crisp in warm tortillas with lime slaw, pickled red onion and a chipotle crema, plenty of coriander on top. Slice 1 red onion thin and cover with 80ml lime juice and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Shred a quarter of a cabbage and toss with lime and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold soda water. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 8 tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, onion, crema and coriander.
W: the sorbet Mia eats before she knows it's a palate cleanser
Lemon sorbet scooped into small chilled glasses with a few poached pear slices and mint.
K: Pear juice topped with sparkling water and a squeeze of lemon, over ice.
T: Genovian pears. Palate cleansers. Corn dogs.
D: A shy San Francisco teenager finds out she's the heir to the throne of the small country of Genovia.
P: Serve dessert when the sorbet arrives at the state dinner.

title: A Goofy Movie
S: the father and son fishing move, Lake Destiny in Idaho
White fish strips dipped in flour, egg and panko, fried at 180C for 3 minutes until golden, with lemon wedges and a quick tartare of mayo, pickles and capers.
Goofy's plan to take Max fishing at Lake Destiny, Idaho

Thick potato wedges roasted crisp with paprika and garlic salt, loaded with melted cheddar, bacon bits and spring onion, sour cream for dipping. Heat the oven to 220C. Cut 1.2kg potatoes into thick wedges, toss with 3 tbsp oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic salt, and roast on lined trays for 35 minutes, turning once. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Pile the wedges onto one tray, scatter with 150g grated cheddar and the bacon and bake 5 minutes more until melted. Top with 2 sliced spring onions and serve with 200g sour cream.
Max telling everyone he'll be on stage at the Powerline concert

Corn chips layered with spiced beef mince, black beans and cheddar, baked until melted, then loaded with guacamole, sour cream and fresh tomato salsa. Heat the oven to 200C. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 2 tsp mild taco spice, 400g drained black beans and 125ml water and simmer 5 minutes. Spread 300g corn chips on a large tray, spoon over the mince and cover with 200g grated cheddar. Bake 8 minutes until melted. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Dice 2 tomatoes with coriander. Top the nachos with guacamole, salsa and 150g sour cream.
M: Pete and PJ's campsite, with the giant RV
Thick beef sausages grilled over coals until charred, in soft rolls with fried onions, mustard and tomato sauce, corn on the cob on the side.
Bigfoot camp chilli beef and beans
the night Bigfoot crashes Goofy and Max's campsite

Chunky beef slow cooked with kidney beans, tomato and smoked paprika until thick and rich, topped with cheddar and sour cream, cornbread or crusty bread alongside. Toss 1kg diced chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in a heavy pot. Fry 2 diced onions and 1 red capsicum for 5 minutes, then add 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp ground cumin and 1 tsp mild chilli powder. Pour in 800g tinned tomatoes and 500ml beef stock, return the beef, cover and simmer 2 hours. Add 2 drained 400g tins kidney beans and cook 20 minutes more. Serve with cheddar, sour cream and crusty bread.
W: Bigfoot helps himself to everything at the campsite
Toast marshmallows over a flame until golden and squash them between plain biscuits with a square of milk chocolate so it melts.
K: Max and Roxanne at the big concert in LA
Cherry cordial blended with lots of ice and a squeeze of lime until slushy, served in tall cups with a straw.
T: Road trip. Fishing rods. Snacks for the whole drive.
D: Goofy drags his teenage son Max on a cross-country fishing trip just as Max is trying to impress Roxanne.
P: Serve the mains when Goofy and Max finally make camp by Lake Destiny.

title: Chasing Amy
S: the late-night diner booth in Red Bank
Thick-cut chips fried crisp, smothered in hot brown gravy and melted mozzarella, the New Jersey diner way, eaten with a fork.
Jersey ham, egg and cheese sliders
a Jersey breakfast between comic deadlines

Thick-cut smoked ham fried until the edges curl, stacked with a soft fried egg and melted American cheese in buttered slider buns with ketchup. Cut 400g thick smoked ham into 8 slices about 5mm thick and nick the edges so they don't buckle. Fry in a buttered pan over medium heat 2 minutes a side until caramelised at the edges. Fry 8 small eggs until the whites set and yolks are jammy, adding a slice of American cheese to each for the last minute under a lid. Toast 8 buttered slider buns and stack ham, egg and cheese with a squeeze of ketchup.
Bluntman and Chronic on the convention floor
Toasted bagel halves spread with pizza sauce, topped with mozzarella and pepperoni and grilled until bubbling and golden.
M: a New Jersey classic for two comic artists
Franks fried in oil, stuffed into half a round of pizza bread with fried potatoes, peppers and onions, mustard on top.
the diner booth where the friendship gets tested

Thin beef patties with slow-cooked caramelised onions and Swiss cheese, pressed between buttered rye and griddled until crisp and oozing, pickles alongside. Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter with a pinch of salt over low heat for 30 minutes until jammy. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin oval patties and season. Sear in a hot pan 2 minutes a side. Butter 8 slices of rye on one side. On the unbuttered sides layer Swiss cheese (8 slices), a patty, onions and more cheese. Cook in a pan over medium heat, pressing, 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Halve and serve with pickles.
W: the dessert case by the register
Short-grain rice simmered slowly in milk with sugar and vanilla until thick, chilled and dusted with cinnamon.
K: the late-night diner booth in Red Bank

Ice cold root beer poured over big scoops of vanilla ice cream in frosted diner glasses until the foam spills over, whipped cream and a cherry on top. Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Drop 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream (about 400g total) into each glass. Tilt the glass and pour 250ml cold root beer slowly down the side so the foam rises without spilling, then top up once it settles. Finish with a swirl of whipped cream from 100ml cream and a maraschino cherry. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.
T: Comic book love, diner booth dinner.
D: A New Jersey comic book artist falls for a woman who doesn't fit the picture he's drawn of her.
P: Serve the mains when Holden and Banky argue it out in the diner booth.

title: Dogma
S: Loki and Bartleby's long exile in Wisconsin
Cheese curds dipped in a light beer batter, fried at 185C until puffed and golden, ranch for dipping.
the fast food empire built on a golden cow
Thin fries double fried until crisp and dusted with salt and a little paprika, served in paper cones.
the long train ride east toward New Jersey

Toasted triple-stack club sandwiches of roast turkey, crispy bacon, tomato, cos and herb mayo, cut into small triangles and pinned with toothpicks. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices of white bread. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped chives and a little Dijon. For each club, spread 3 slices of toast with mayo, then layer 300g sliced roast turkey and cos on the first, bacon and sliced tomato on the second, and close with the third. Press down, pin with 4 toothpicks and cut into 4 triangles. Serve with crisps.
M: the burger chain at the centre of it all
Thin beef patties smashed on a hot griddle, American cheese, pickles, onion and a sweet burger sauce on soft buns.
Bethany's chicken and leek pot pie
Bethany's quiet life in Illinois before the angels turn up

Chicken, leek, carrot and peas in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, baked until it bubbles up through the edges. Heat the oven to 200C. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 20g butter, remove. Cook 2 sliced leeks, 2 diced carrots and 2 celery sticks for 6 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken, 150g frozen peas, thyme, salt and pepper. Spoon into a pie dish, top with 1 puff pastry sheet, cut a vent, brush with egg and bake 25 to 30 minutes.
W: the golden cow on every Mooby's sign
Shortbread base, thick caramel of condensed milk and golden syrup, set with a layer of milk chocolate and cut into squares.
K: Vanilla ice cream blended with cold milk and a dash of vanilla until thick, poured into tall cups with a straw.
T: Angels, a muse and a fast food cow.
D: Two banished angels find a loophole back into heaven, and a clinic worker is sent to stop them.
P: Serve the burgers when the angels storm the Mooby boardroom.

title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
S: Jay and Bob thumbing a ride across the country

Sourdough toasties packed with cheddar, pepper jack and pickled jalapeños, grilled in garlic butter until crunchy, cut into fingers with a smoky tomato relish. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 crushed garlic clove. Grate 150g cheddar and 100g pepper jack or tasty cheese. Drain and chop 3 tbsp pickled jalapeños. Fill 8 slices of sourdough with the cheeses and jalapeños, spread garlic butter on the outsides and cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut into fingers and serve with 150g tomato relish stirred with a pinch of smoked paprika.
Craft service grilled fruit with chilli lime
the craft service table on the Hollywood studio lot

Pineapple, rockmelon and watermelon wedges charred on a hot grill, sprinkled with chilli lime salt, with a honey, lime and mint yoghurt dip. Cut half a pineapple, a quarter of a rockmelon and a wedge of watermelon into thick spears. Heat a grill pan or barbecue very hot and char the pineapple and rockmelon 1 to 2 minutes a side, leaving the watermelon raw. Mix 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp chilli powder and the zest of 1 lime. Stir 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey, lime juice and chopped mint. Arrange the fruit, sprinkle with chilli lime salt and serve with the dip.
Jersey smoked ham and cheese sliders
home turf in New Jersey before the road trip

Thick smoked ham slices fried until caramelised and curled, stacked on toasted slider buns with melted American cheese, yellow mustard and pickles. Cut 400g thick smoked ham into 8 slices about 5mm thick and nick the edges. Fry in a little butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until caramelised. Lay a slice of American cheese on each, add a splash of water and cover for 30 seconds to melt. Toast 8 slider buns cut side down in the pan. Spread with yellow mustard, add the ham and cheese and top with sliced pickles.
M: the fast food stop on the way west
Two smashed beef patties with cheese, pickles and sauce on toasted buns, wrapped in paper.
lunch on the Hollywood studio lot

Triple-decker toasted sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, tomato and cos with garlic mayo, cut into quarters and served with salted crisps. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Shred 500g roast chicken. Toast 12 slices of white bread. Mix 100g mayo with 1 crushed garlic clove. For each sandwich, spread 3 slices with mayo, layer chicken, avocado and cos on the first, bacon and tomato on the second, and top with the third. Pin with 4 toothpicks, cut into quarters and serve with 150g salted crisps.
W: Suzanne, the orangutan they bust out
Bananas split lengthways with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: the drinks machine at the Quick Stop
Raspberry cordial blended with plenty of ice and a squeeze of lemon until slushy, served in big cups with straws.
T: Road trip to Hollywood, snacks for the whole way.
D: Two slackers from New Jersey head to Hollywood to stop a movie being made about them.
P: Serve the banana splits when Suzanne the orangutan makes her escape.

title: Clerks II
S: the fryer at the new job
Thick onion rings dipped in buttermilk and seasoned flour, fried at 180C until crunchy, with a smoky ketchup.
Becky teaching Dante to dance on the roof

Buttery croissants filled with poached chicken, celery, grapes and toasted almonds in a lemon and tarragon mayo, with crisp cos leaves. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred. Mix with 2 finely diced celery sticks, 100g halved red grapes, 40g toasted flaked almonds, 120g mayo, the juice of half a lemon and 1 tbsp chopped tarragon. Season well. Split 4 large croissants, line with cos leaves and pile in the chicken salad. Wrap in baking paper and pack in a basket.
something hot off the fryer between orders
Halved jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
M: the burger Dante and Randal flip all day
Two thin smashed patties, double American cheese, pickles, onion and burger sauce on a toasted sesame bun.
Mooby's hot honey crispy chicken burger
the other thing on the Mooby's menu

Buttermilk-soaked chicken thighs fried until crackling, brushed with hot honey, in soft buns with shredded lettuce, pickles and a garlic mayo. Soak 4 chicken thigh fillets in 250ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for at least 2 hours. Mix 150g plain flour, 1 tsp paprika, half a tsp cayenne and salt. Dredge and fry in oil at 170C for 7 to 8 minutes until golden and cooked through. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and a dash of vinegar and brush over the chicken. Toast 4 burger buns, spread with garlic mayo and fill with lettuce, chicken and pickles.
W: Dante's going-away party at the counter
Vanilla sheet cake baked in a tray, covered in buttercream and piped with a goodbye message across the top.
K: the shake machine behind the counter
Chocolate ice cream blended with cold milk and chocolate syrup until thick, poured into tall paper cups.
T: Same counter, different job.
D: Dante and Randal trade the Quick Stop for a fast food counter on Dante's last day before he moves to Florida.
P: Serve the burgers when Randal starts the trilogy argument at the counter.

title: Clerks III
S: Cheddar melted slowly into evaporated milk with cornflour and a pinch of chilli, kept warm, corn chips for dunking.
Doctor's orders crudités with green goddess
Randal's new heart-healthy diet after the heart attack

Crisp carrot, celery, cucumber, capsicum and snow peas around a bright green goddess dip of herbs, yoghurt, avocado and lemon. Blitz 1 avocado, 150g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp mayo, a big handful each of parsley, basil and chives, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt until smooth and bright green. Chill. Cut 2 carrots, 3 celery sticks, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into batons and trim 150g snow peas. Stand the vegetables in iced water for 10 minutes, drain well and arrange around the dip.
the pastry case at the Quick Stop
Buttery vanilla cake under a thick layer of cinnamon crumb, baked in a tray and cut into squares, dusted with icing sugar.
M: RST Video pork roll, egg and cheese
Randal's old video store next door

Pork roll fried until the edges curl, fried egg and American cheese on a soft roll, salt, pepper and ketchup. Cut 400g pork roll into 8 slices, nick the edges and fry 2 minutes a side until curled and browned. Fry 4 eggs. Stack pork roll, egg and a slice of American cheese into 4 soft rolls, add tomato sauce, salt and pepper, and wrap in foil for 2 minutes to melt.
lunch while Dante and Randal shoot the movie in the store

Crumbed chicken fried golden, topped with marinara and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling and stuffed into toasted long rolls with basil. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm. Coat in flour, beaten egg and 120g breadcrumbs mixed with 30g grated parmesan. Shallow fry in oil 3 minutes a side until golden. Simmer 400g passata with 1 garlic clove and oregano for 10 minutes. Put the chicken on a tray, spoon over sauce, top with 200g grated mozzarella and grill 3 minutes until bubbling. Tuck into 4 toasted long rolls with basil leaves.
W: something with the coffee on the counter
Sour cream coffee cake with a cinnamon and walnut ripple, baked in a ring tin at 175C for 45 minutes.
K: Not even supposed to be here cold brew
Dante's oldest complaint behind the counter

Smooth overnight cold brew over ice with a splash of milk, topped with a whipped cinnamon and brown sugar cold foam. The night before, stir 100g coarsely ground coffee into 800ml cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours. Strain through a sieve lined with a paper towel. Whisk 150ml cream, 50ml milk, 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon until thick but pourable. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in 180ml cold brew and a splash of milk, then spoon the cinnamon foam on top.
T: Back behind the counter, camera rolling.
D: After a heart attack, Randal decides to make a movie about his life working at the Quick Stop.
P: Serve the snacks when Randal yells action for the first time.

title: Eagle vs Shark
S: Eagle and shark costume party cheerios
the animal costume party where it all starts

Little red cocktail sausages simmered for 5 minutes and served hot on toothpicks with a bowl of tomato sauce for dipping. Bring a pot of water to a simmer, add 500g cocktail frankfurts and heat for 5 minutes without boiling so the skins don't split. Drain, pile into a bowl with toothpicks and serve with 125ml tomato sauce for dipping.
the dip at every New Zealand party
Reduced cream stirred with French onion soup mix and a squeeze of lemon, chilled until thick, salted potato chips for dipping.
Kiwi mince and cheese pie bites
a feed from the hometown bakery when Lily visits Jarrod's family

Peppery beef mince in rich gravy with a slice of tasty cheese, baked in little shortcrust cases under flaky puff lids, tomato sauce for dunking. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 300ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and pepper, and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with mince, top each with a square of tasty cheese (6 slices), then a puff pastry round from 1 sheet. Brush with egg and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
M: Lily's job at the burger counter
Beef patties with cheese, beetroot, lettuce, tomato and tomato sauce on toasted buns, the Kiwi takeaway way.
takeaways wrapped in paper, the Kiwi way

Fresh white fish in a crisp beer batter with thick-cut double-fried chips, wrapped in paper with lemon, tartare sauce and tomato sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, soak 20 minutes and dry. Fry at 150C for 6 minutes, drain. Whisk 200g self-raising flour with 300ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Heat the oil to 180C, fry the chips again 3 minutes until golden and keep warm. Dip 4 hake or gurnard fillets in flour, then batter, and fry 5 to 6 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with chopped pickles and capers for tartare. Wrap in paper with lemon.
W: Cocoa biscuits crunchy with cornflakes, topped with chocolate icing and a walnut half, baked at 180C for 15 minutes.
K: Fight Man rematch lemon, lime and bitters
Lily taking Jarrod on at his favourite video game

Lime cordial and a few dashes of bitters topped with lemonade until it turns pink. Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 30ml lime cordial and 4 dashes aromatic bitters to each, top with 200ml lemonade and stir until it turns pink. Garnish with lemon and lime wedges.
T: Burgers, costumes and a grudge match.
D: A shy fast food cashier follows an awkward gamer back to his hometown for his long-planned revenge.
P: Serve the mains at the dress-as-your-favourite-animal party.

title: Boy
S: Paraoa parai: a soft yeasted dough cut into squares and fried until puffed and golden, with butter and golden syrup.

Creamed and whole corn kernels in a light batter with spring onion, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with sweet chilli sauce. Mix 420g creamed corn, 200g corn kernels, 150g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 3 sliced spring onions. Fry heaped tablespoons in oil for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain and serve hot with 125ml sweet chilli sauce.
Fish shop hot chips with garlic aioli
the fish and chip shop down the road from Waihau Bay

Thick-cut chips fried twice until crunchy outside and fluffy inside, salted hot, wrapped in paper with a garlicky aioli and tomato sauce. Cut 1.2kg floury potatoes into 1.5cm chips, soak in cold water for 30 minutes and pat dry. Heat oil to 150C and fry in batches for 6 minutes until soft but pale. Drain and rest 15 minutes. Heat the oil to 190C and fry again for 3 minutes until golden and crunchy. Salt straight away. Mix 150g mayo with 2 crushed garlic cloves and a squeeze of lemon. Serve in paper with the aioli and tomato sauce.
M: Alamein, who'd rather be called Shogun

Pork shoulder, kūmara, pumpkin and cabbage wrapped in foil and cabbage leaves, slow roasted at 160C for four hours until falling apart. Season 1.2kg pork shoulder well. Line a deep roasting tin with cabbage leaves, add the pork, 600g kūmara, 600g pumpkin and 400g potatoes in chunks, then cover with more cabbage and wrap tightly in foil. Roast at 160C for 4 hours until the pork falls apart.
Nan's savoury mince on buttered toast
what's in the pot at Nan's house

Beef mince simmered with onion, carrot, peas and a rich gravy until thick, spooned over thick buttered toast with grated tasty cheese on top. Brown 600g beef mince in a large pan, breaking it up. Add 1 diced onion and 1 grated carrot and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 400ml beef stock. Simmer 15 minutes until thick, adding 150g frozen peas for the last 5. Toast 8 thick slices of white bread and butter well. Spoon the mince over and top with 80g grated tasty cheese.
W: Vanilla ice cream folded with crushed honeycomb toffee made from sugar, golden syrup and bicarb.
K: A thick lime milkshake, the way the corner dairy makes them. Blend 600ml cold milk with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and 4 tbsp lime cordial until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and serve straight away with straws.
T: Waihau Bay, 1984. Fried bread's on.
D: An 11-year-old in rural New Zealand finally meets the dad he's been bigging up his whole life.
P: Serve the mains when Alamein rolls back into town.

title: What We Do in the Shadows
S: Nick's ill-advised attempt to eat a chip
Thick chips fried twice until crunchy, salted hot and served in a paper cone, with aioli for the humans.
Toasted baguette with whipped goat's cheese, roasted beetroot and blood orange segments, a drizzle of honey.
a snack the flatmates could actually stand

Grilled ciabatta piled with marinated cherry tomatoes and torn burrata, finished with basil, olive oil and flaky salt, not a clove of garlic in sight. Halve 400g mixed cherry tomatoes and toss with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, torn basil and salt. Leave 15 minutes. Slice 1 ciabatta into 12 thick slices, brush with olive oil and grill or chargrill 2 minutes a side until marked. Tear 2 burrata balls (about 250g) over the toasts, spoon the tomatoes and their juices on top, and finish with more basil, a drizzle of oil and flaky salt.
M: Stu's welcome dinner at the flat
Beef sirloin seared and roasted rare, rested, sliced thin and piled into soft rolls with horseradish cream and rocket.
Black pudding with mash and onion gravy
a properly dark supper for the flat

Thick slices of black pudding fried crisp, over buttery mash with caramelised onions, red wine gravy and a sharp apple and parsley salad. Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 25 minutes until golden. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock and simmer 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk. Slice 500g black pudding 1.5cm thick and fry in a little oil 2 minutes a side until crisp. Toss 1 thinly sliced green apple with parsley and lemon. Serve the pudding on the mash with the gravy and salad.
W: an old-world dessert for very old flatmates
Chocolate sponge soaked in cherry syrup, layered with morello cherries and whipped cream, then covered all over in dark chocolate shavings.
K: something red in a nice glass
Blood orange juice over ice topped with soda water and a slice of orange, alcohol-free.
T: Flat meeting. Dishes. Bloody dishes.
D: Vampire flatmates in Wellington deal with chores, rivals and a new recruit.
P: Serve the hot chips when Nick tries to eat one.

title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
S: Ricky out in the majestical bush

Self-raising flour, butter and milk mixed into a round, baked in a hot oven at 200C for 30 minutes, with butter and golden syrup. Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour with 1 tsp salt, then stir in 300ml milk to a soft dough. Shape into a round, cut a cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve warm, torn, with butter and golden syrup.
Pork sausage mince with apple, sage and onion rolled in puff pastry, egg washed and baked at 200C until golden.
lunch at the hut in the ranges

Soft white bread filled with chopped egg in a mild curry mayo with chives, packed with peppery watercress, cut into triangles and wrapped for the tramp. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel. Chop roughly and mash with 100g mayo, 1 tsp mild curry powder, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper. Butter 12 slices of soft white bread. Spread the egg over 6 slices, top with a good handful of watercress and close the sandwiches. Cut into triangles and wrap in baking paper.
M: the wild pig Bella brings home
Pork shoulder scored and salted, roasted slowly with apples and onions until the crackling blisters, with roast kūmara and gravy.
a feed for the whole search party

Lamb shoulder, kūmara, pumpkin and cabbage wrapped tight and slow roasted with garlic and rosemary until the meat falls apart, with the rich pan juices spooned over. Heat the oven to 160C. Rub a 2kg bone-in lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, 4 crushed garlic cloves and rosemary. Line a deep roasting tin with foil and cabbage leaves. Add the lamb, 800g kūmara and 600g pumpkin in big chunks and 250ml water. Cover with more cabbage leaves and seal tightly with foil. Roast 4 hours. Pull the lamb into chunks and spoon the juices over everything.
W: Chocolate cake with chocolate icing and candles, baked at 175C for 40 minutes, sung to badly.
K: Cocoa and sugar whisked into hot milk and poured into tin mugs around the fire. Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa powder and 4 tbsp sugar with a splash of milk into a paste. Whisk in 1L milk and heat until steaming without boiling. Pour into 4 tin mugs and drink around the fire.
T: Skux life. Bush tucker for the trip.
D: A city foster kid and his grumpy uncle become the target of a national manhunt in the New Zealand bush.
P: Serve the roast when Bella brings home the pig.

title: Jojo Rabbit
S: the kitchen in their little German town
Grated potato and onion squeezed dry, mixed with egg and flour, fried in small pancakes until crisp, apple sauce and sour cream.
Jojo's best friend Yorki, still on duty

Dark rye bread sliced thin, spread with salted butter and topped with sliced radishes, chives and flaky salt. Slice 1 dark rye loaf thin. Spread each slice with salted butter, about 100g in total, right to the crust. Top with 1 bunch thinly sliced radishes, snipped chives and a pinch of flaky salt, then cut into fingers.
Soft pretzels with Obatzda cheese dip
the little German town where Jojo and Rosie live

Warm salted soft pretzels with Obatzda, a Bavarian dip of camembert, butter, cream cheese, paprika and onion, with pickled cucumbers on the side. Make a dough with 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Heat the oven to 220C. Shape 8 pretzels, dip each in 2L simmering water with 70g bicarb for 30 seconds, brush with egg, add rock salt and bake 14 minutes. Mash 200g ripe camembert with 50g soft butter, 100g cream cheese, 2 tsp sweet paprika, half a finely diced onion and caraway. Serve with sliced dill cucumbers.
M: Smoked sausages simmered with cabbage, potatoes, onion, caraway and stock until thick, crusty bread on the side.
a proper German dinner for a better day

Chicken breast pounded thin, crumbed and fried golden in butter, with a warm Swabian potato salad, cucumber dill salad and lemon wedges. Boil 1kg waxy potatoes 20 minutes, slice warm and toss with 150ml hot chicken stock, 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 diced eschalot and chives. Slice 1 cucumber thin and toss with dill, sour cream and salt. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 5mm. Coat in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g breadcrumbs. Fry in 50g butter and 3 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve with lemon.
W: Captain Klenzendorf running the youth camp

A soft yeasted dough pressed into a tray, covered in halved plums, sprinkled with cinnamon sugar and baked at 190C. Mix 300g flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 150ml warm milk, 1 egg and 50g soft butter into a dough and prove 1 hour. Press into a lined tray, cover with 1kg halved plums cut side up, sprinkle with 50g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon, and bake at 190C for 35 minutes.
K: Elsa in the walls spiced apple punch

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange peel, sweetened with honey and served steaming in mugs with an apple slice. Pour 1.2L cloudy apple juice into a saucepan. Add 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise, 3 strips of orange peel and 2 tbsp honey. Bring just to a simmer, then turn the heat to low and steep for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and float a thin apple slice and a cinnamon stick in each. In summer, chill it and top with sparkling water over ice instead.
T: Rationing never tasted this good.
D: A lonely German boy discovers his mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their attic.
P: Serve the mains when Rosie sets the table and pretends to be Jojo's dad.

title: Next Goal Wins
S: the loss to Australia nobody forgets

Taro sliced paper thin, fried at 175C until crisp and salted, with a lime and chilli salt. Peel 600g taro and slice paper thin on a mandoline. Fry in batches at 175C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and pale golden. Drain and toss with 1 tsp salt mixed with the zest of 1 lime and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes.
raw fish salad, the island way
Fresh white fish cubed and soaked in lime juice, then mixed with coconut cream, cucumber, tomato and onion.
taro leaves baked in coconut cream, a Samoan feast staple

Silverbeet leaves wrapped around onion, garlic and seasoned coconut cream, baked in foil parcels until rich and soft, served with roast taro. Heat the oven to 180C. Peel 800g taro, cut into chunks, toss in oil and salt and roast 45 minutes. Strip the stalks from 1 bunch silverbeet. Mix 400ml coconut cream with 1 finely diced onion, 1 crushed garlic clove and 1 tsp salt. Stack 3 leaves into a cup in your hand, add a few spoons of coconut mix, fold closed and wrap tightly in foil. Make 8 parcels and bake 40 minutes. Open and serve with the taro.
M: Samoan chop suey for the whole squad

Glass noodles stir-fried with chicken, soy, ginger, garlic and vegetables, the dish at every Samoan feast. Soak 250g glass noodles in hot water for 10 minutes and drain. Fry 600g sliced chicken thighs with 3 garlic cloves and a thumb of ginger until browned, then add 2 sliced carrots and 1 onion. Add the noodles, 80ml soy sauce and 250ml water and toss until the noodles soak it all up.
Pisupo corned beef with fried rice
the tinned corned beef that turns up at every Samoan table

Tinned corned beef fried with onion, tomato and cabbage until crispy at the edges, over garlic fried rice with a squeeze of lime and soy. Cook 2 cups rice the day before and chill. Fry 1 sliced onion in oil for 3 minutes, add 2 diced tomatoes and a quarter of a cabbage, shredded, and cook 5 minutes. Break in 340g tinned corned beef and fry over high heat, stirring now and then, until browned in spots. In another pan, fry 3 crushed garlic cloves in oil, add the rice and 2 tbsp soy and toss until hot. Serve the beef over the rice with lime.
W: coconut buns baked in coconut cream
Soft sweet bread rolls baked in a tray of sweetened coconut cream until the sauce turns sticky and golden.
K: Grated Samoan cocoa or dark chocolate melted into hot water and milk with sugar, served hot or poured over ice. Melt 150g dark chocolate into 500ml hot water, then whisk in 500ml milk and 3 tbsp sugar and heat until steaming. Serve hot in mugs, or cool it down and pour over ice for a hot afternoon.
T: Worst team in the world. Best feed after the match.
D: A burnt-out Dutch coach is sent to American Samoa to turn around the worst football team on the planet.
P: Serve the mains when the team finally scores a goal.

title: Casablanca
S: the bar at Rick's Café Américain
Green olives warmed with preserved lemon, cumin and chilli, with smoked almonds roasted in olive oil and salt.
the two signed letters everyone wants

Filo triangles filled with beef mince spiced with cinnamon, cumin and coriander, brushed with butter and baked until crisp. Fry 400g beef mince with 1 onion, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin and salt until browned, then stir in chopped coriander. Cut 8 sheets filo into long strips, brush with 80g melted butter, add a spoonful of filling and fold into triangles. Bake at 190C for 15 minutes until crisp.
the days in Paris that Rick and Ilsa will always have

Light choux puffs beaten with gruyère, Dijon and black pepper, baked until hollow, crisp and golden, served warm from the oven. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 250ml water, 100g butter and half a tsp salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat until the dough pulls from the sides. Cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time, then 120g grated gruyère, 1 tsp Dijon and pepper. Pipe or spoon 24 small mounds onto lined trays, sprinkle with 30g more gruyère and bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
M: Renault rounding up the usual suspects

Chicken thighs braised with onion, ginger, saffron, preserved lemon and green olives until tender, couscous on the side. Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften 2 onions with a thumb of grated ginger and a pinch of saffron. Return the chicken with 375ml water, the chopped rind of 1 preserved lemon and 150g green olives and simmer 40 minutes. Pour 300g couscous into 375ml boiling stock, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Lamb and apricot tagine with couscous
the souk outside the doors of Rick's café

Lamb shoulder braised slowly with ras el hanout, cinnamon, dried apricots and honey, scattered with toasted almonds and coriander, over buttered couscous. Brown 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder in oil in batches. Fry 2 sliced onions for 5 minutes, add 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp ras el hanout and 1 cinnamon stick. Pour in 400g tinned tomatoes and 500ml stock, return the lamb, cover and simmer 1.5 hours. Add 150g dried apricots and 1 tbsp honey and cook 30 minutes more. Pour 300ml boiling stock over 300g couscous with 30g butter, cover 5 minutes, fluff. Top the tagine with 50g toasted flaked almonds and coriander.
W: a sweet from the Casablanca bakeries
Moist almond meal cake soaked in an orange and orange blossom syrup, served with thick yoghurt.
K: Here's looking at you mint tea
poured from a height at Rick's

Green tea brewed with a big handful of fresh mint and sugar, poured high into small glasses so it froths. Rinse 2 tbsp green tea in a teapot with a splash of boiling water and tip it out. Add a big bunch of mint, 4 tbsp sugar and 1L boiling water, brew 4 minutes, then pour from a height into small glasses so it froths.
T: Of all the gin joints, this one does dinner.
D: A cynical American nightclub owner in wartime Casablanca has to decide whether to help his old flame escape.
P: Pour the mint tea when Sam sits down at the piano in Rick's.

title: It's a Wonderful Life
S: George and Mary's bread, salt and wine for the Martinis' new house

Thick, airy focaccia dimpled with olive oil, rosemary and flaky salt, baked golden and served warm with good olive oil and balsamic for dipping. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 10g salt and 400ml warm water into a wet dough. Cover and rest 2 hours, folding it over itself twice. Pour 4 tbsp olive oil into a 23 x 33cm tin, tip in the dough and stretch to the corners. Rest 45 minutes. Heat the oven to 220C. Dimple deeply with oiled fingers, drizzle with more oil, scatter rosemary and flaky salt and bake 25 minutes. Serve warm with oil and balsamic.
coconuts from Tahiti, young George's big dream
Desiccated coconut mixed with condensed milk, egg white and vanilla, scooped into mounds and baked at 160C until golden on the edges.
Puff pastry layered with sharp cheddar, parmesan and a pinch of cayenne, twisted into straws and baked crisp.
M: roasted on a spit turned by the record player
Whole chicken rubbed with butter, garlic and thyme, roasted at 200C until the skin crackles, with roast potatoes.
Sunday dinner at the Bailey house in Bedford Falls

Beef chuck browned and braised for hours with onions, carrots and potatoes in red wine and stock until it falls apart, with thick gravy. Heat the oven to 160C. Season 1.5kg beef chuck and brown well in oil in a casserole. Remove. Fry 2 onions in wedges for 5 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp flour, then 200ml red wine and 600ml beef stock, thyme and bay. Return the beef, cover and cook 2 hours. Add 4 carrots and 800g potatoes in chunks and cook 1 hour more. Simmer the liquid on the stove to thicken into gravy.
W: Mary at the soda fountain, no coconut thanks
Chocolate ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge sauce, whipped cream and a cherry, served at the drugstore counter.
K: Milk and cream warmed with egg yolks, sugar, nutmeg and vanilla until thickened, served cold with more nutmeg on top.
T: Every time a bell rings, dessert's ready.
D: On Christmas Eve, a small-town man at the end of his rope is shown what Bedford Falls would be like without him.
P: Serve the chicken when George and Mary's honeymoon dinner turns on the record player.

title: Rear Window
S: Cucumber blended with yoghurt, dill, mint, garlic and lemon, chilled hard and poured into small glasses. Blend 2 cucumbers with 250g Greek yoghurt, a handful each of dill and mint, 1 small garlic clove and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth. Season well, chill for 2 hours and pour into 8 small glasses.
the nurse who keeps Jeff fed
Thick ham and Swiss cheese sandwiches with mustard on rye, cut into quarters and stacked on a plate by the window.
the neighbours' windows all lit up across the courtyard

Bocconcini marinated in chilli, lemon and basil oil with salami, chargrilled capsicum, olives and artichokes, crisp grissini on the side. Drain 250g bocconcini and toss with 3 tbsp olive oil, the zest of 1 lemon, a pinch of chilli flakes, torn basil and salt. Leave 30 minutes. Arrange on a board with 150g sliced salami, 150g chargrilled capsicum, 100g marinated artichokes and 100g mixed olives. Stand 1 packet of grissini in a glass alongside and drizzle any leftover marinade over the board.
M: the fancy dinner Lisa has sent up to the apartment
Lobster tails split and baked in a creamy mustard and cheese sauce, the thermidor way, with buttered potatoes and green beans.
dinner for two set for a guest who never comes

Chicken breasts pan-roasted golden, finished in a white wine, mushroom and cream sauce with thyme, served over buttered rice with a candle on the table. Cook 1.5 cups long-grain rice and stir through 20g butter. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in oil and 20g butter for 5 minutes a side, then cover and cook gently 6 minutes until done. Rest. Fry 300g sliced mushrooms and 1 diced eschalot in the pan for 5 minutes. Add 150ml white wine and reduce by half, then 200ml cream and thyme and simmer 3 minutes. Slice the chicken and spoon the sauce over.
W: Jeff's leg in plaster, stuck at the window

Biscuit crumb base, condensed milk and lemon filling, chilled until set and topped with whipped cream. Crush 250g plain biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a pie dish. Whisk 395g condensed milk with the juice of 4 lemons and the zest of 1 until it thickens, pour into the base and chill 4 hours. Top with 200ml whipped cream.
K: Heatwave iced coffee with ice cream
Jeff stuck by the open window through the New York heatwave

Strong chilled coffee poured over ice and milk, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 400ml strong coffee, stir in 2 tbsp caster sugar and chill for at least 1 hour. Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer. Fill each glass a third with ice, add 100ml coffee and 120ml cold milk. Drop in a scoop of vanilla ice cream (about 250g total). Whip 150ml cream, spoon on top and dust with cocoa. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.
T: One window, a heatwave and a lobster dinner.
D: A photographer stuck in a wheelchair becomes convinced a neighbour across the courtyard has committed murder.
P: Serve the mains when Lisa's dinner arrives with a waiter in tow.

title: North by Northwest
S: the Plaza bar where the mix-up starts
Choux pastry beaten with gruyère, piped into small puffs and baked at 200C until hollow and golden.
Celery sticks, radishes, olives, pickles and carrot curls on crushed ice with a little dish of cream cheese.
Crop duster corn fritters with chilli jam
the crop duster chasing Roger through the cornfields

Sweet corn kernels in a light batter with spring onion, coriander and chilli, fried golden in spoonfuls, with sour cream and sticky chilli jam. Cut the kernels from 3 corn cobs. Whisk 120g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 100ml milk into a thick batter. Stir in the corn, 3 sliced spring onions, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, 1 chopped red chilli and salt. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry heaped tablespoons for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Serve with 150g sour cream and 100g chilli jam.
M: Roger's order on the train with Eve
Whole trout dusted in flour, pan-fried in butter and finished with toasted almonds, lemon and parsley.
Mount Rushmore hot roast beef sandwich
the visitor centre cafeteria below the monument

Slow-roasted beef sliced thin on thick white bread, smothered in hot red wine gravy, with creamy mashed potato and buttered green beans. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub a 1kg beef blade or topside roast with oil, salt and pepper and roast 50 minutes for medium. Rest 15 minutes, then slice thin. Whisk 2 tbsp pan fat with 2 tbsp flour, then 100ml red wine and 400ml beef stock and simmer 5 minutes. Mash 800g potatoes with butter and milk. Boil 300g green beans. Lay the beef on 8 slices of thick white bread, pour over the gravy and serve with mash and beans.
W: a showpiece on the dining car menu
Sponge base topped with vanilla ice cream, covered in meringue and browned in a very hot oven just before serving.
K: Roger's drink in the dining car
Gin stirred with dry vermouth over ice, strained into a chilled glass with a cocktail onion. Sparkling water and onions for anyone off the gin.
T: Brook trout on the train, corn on the run.
D: A New York ad man is mistaken for a government agent and chased across the country.
P: Serve the trout when Roger meets Eve in the dining car.

title: Singin' in the Rain
S: Pitted prunes stuffed with almonds and wrapped in bacon, baked crisp and served on sticks.
the walk home in the downpour
Buttered white bread with cheddar toasted in a pan until golden, cut into soldiers for dunking in tomato soup.
lunch between takes at Monumental Pictures

Boiled eggs with yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and paprika, piped back in and topped with crispy bacon crumbs, chives and pickled mustard seeds. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 80g mayo, 2 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and a pinch of paprika until smooth. Pipe back into the whites. Fry 4 bacon rashers until very crisp and chop fine. Simmer 2 tbsp yellow mustard seeds in 3 tbsp vinegar and 1 tsp sugar for 5 minutes. Top each egg with bacon, mustard seeds, chives and paprika.
M: Diced chicken, mushrooms and red capsicum simmered in a creamy sherry sauce, then spooned into warm puff pastry cases.
Premiere night roast beef with Yorkshires
the big party after the Royal Rascal premiere

Beef sirloin roasted pink and carved thin, with puffed Yorkshire puddings, crunchy roast potatoes, horseradish cream and a rich red wine gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Parboil 1kg potatoes 8 minutes, rough up and roast in oil 50 minutes. Season a 1.2kg sirloin, sear and roast 30 to 35 minutes for medium rare, then rest 15 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 3 eggs and 200ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin until smoking, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices, 150ml red wine and 300ml stock. Mix 150ml whipped cream with 2 tbsp horseradish.
W: the cake Kathy jumps out of
A tall vanilla layer cake with pink buttercream and sprinkles, big enough to hide a chorus girl.
K: the toast at the studio party
Fresh lemon syrup topped with sparkling water and poured into old-fashioned coupe glasses with a lemon twist.
T: Talkies, a party cake and a very wet walk home.
D: A silent film star and a chorus girl help Hollywood make the jump to talking pictures.
P: Serve the cake when Kathy pops out of it at the party.

title: Chinatown
S: Orange segments with shaved fennel, red onion, black olives and mint, dressed with olive oil and flaky salt.

Pork, cabbage and carrot rolled in spring roll wrappers, fried crisp, with sweet chilli and soy for dipping. Fry 300g pork mince until browned, then add 2 cups shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot and cook until soft, seasoning with soy. Roll tablespoons into 16 spring roll wrappers, seal with water and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and soy.
the Albacore Club where Jake goes digging

Tuna seared hard and sliced thin over toasted baguette with lemon aioli, finished with fried capers, dill and cracked pepper. Slice 1 baguette into 20 rounds, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Rub a 400g tuna steak with oil, salt and pepper and sear in a smoking pan for 1 minute a side, leaving the middle raw. Rest and slice thin. Mix 100g mayo with lemon zest, lemon juice and a crushed garlic clove. Fry 2 tbsp drained capers in 2 tbsp oil until crisp. Spread toasts with aioli, top with tuna, capers and dill.
M: Noah Cross's lunch, served exactly how he likes it
Whole snapper scored, stuffed with lemon and herbs, grilled until the skin blisters and served head and all.
LA French dip with hot jus

Thin-sliced roast beef piled into crusty rolls with melted Swiss cheese, served with a cup of hot beef jus for dipping and hot English mustard. Heat the oven to 200C. Season a 1kg beef topside and roast 45 minutes for medium rare, rest 15 minutes and slice very thin. Deglaze the tray with 100ml red wine, add 600ml beef stock, 1 sliced onion and thyme and simmer 15 minutes, then strain. Split 4 long crusty rolls, dip the cut sides in the jus, pile in the beef, add 2 slices Swiss cheese each and grill until melted. Serve with cups of hot jus and mustard.
W: Noah Cross and his yacht club

Light chiffon sponge flavoured with orange zest and juice, baked in a tube tin and glazed with orange icing. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 125ml oil, 125ml orange juice, the zest of 2 oranges, 150g sugar and 200g self-raising flour. Whisk 5 egg whites stiff with 50g sugar and fold in. Bake in an ungreased tube tin at 165C for 50 minutes, cool upside down and glaze with 150g icing sugar mixed with orange juice.
K: the San Fernando Valley orange groves the whole fight is about

Fresh orange and lemon muddled with mint and brown sugar syrup, shaken with bourbon and poured over crushed ice with an orange wheel. Cut 2 oranges into small wedges. For each drink, muddle 3 orange wedges, 4 mint leaves and 15ml brown sugar syrup in a shaker. Add 50ml bourbon, 15ml lemon juice and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass and garnish with an orange wheel and a mint sprig. For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for 80ml fresh orange juice topped with soda.
T: Forget it, Jake. Pass the fish.
D: A private eye hired to follow a cheating husband uncovers a scheme over Los Angeles water.
P: Serve the fish when Noah Cross insists it comes with the head on.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
S: Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and butter baked in a hot pan at 210C for 20 minutes, cut into squares with butter.
the beach town Andy dreams about
Ripe avocado mashed chunky with lime, red onion, jalapeño, coriander and salt, with warm corn chips for scooping.
Prison library cheddar scones with chutney
the prison library Andy builds book by book

Fluffy scones packed with vintage cheddar and chives, baked golden with a cheesy crust, split warm and served with butter and apple chutney. Heat the oven to 220C. Rub 60g cold butter into 375g self-raising flour with half a tsp salt. Stir in 120g grated vintage cheddar and 2 tbsp chives, then 250ml milk to a soft dough. Pat out 3cm thick and cut 10 rounds. Place close together on a lined tray, brush with milk and sprinkle with 30g more cheddar. Bake 15 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with butter and 150g apple chutney.
M: Brooks Hatlen, carved into the beam

Beef chuck stewed with potatoes, carrots and onions in a thick gravy, ladled out with bread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches, then soften 2 onions. Return the beef with 2 tbsp flour, 750ml beef stock, 600g potatoes and 3 carrots in chunks. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Ladle into bowls with thick white bread.
the warm Pacific town Andy dreams about

White fish rubbed with chilli, cumin and lime, chargrilled and flaked into warm corn tortillas with cabbage, pineapple salsa and lime crema. Rub 600g firm white fish fillets with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, oil, salt and lime zest. Dice 200g pineapple with half a red onion, 1 chopped chilli, coriander and lime juice. Shred a quarter of a cabbage. Mix 150g sour cream with the juice of 1 lime. Grill the fish on a hot oiled plate for 3 minutes a side and flake. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.
W: the little rock hammer hidden in Andy's Bible

Milk chocolate melted with marshmallows, peanuts and broken biscuits, set in a tray and cut into rough rocks. Melt 400g milk chocolate gently. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted peanuts and 100g broken plain biscuits. Spread into a lined 20cm tin, chill 2 hours until set and cut into rough rocks.
K: Andy scoring the tarring crew cold beers on the roof

Ice-cold lager topped with spicy ginger beer, fresh lime and a few slices of ginger, served in frosted glasses in the sun. Put 4 glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Slice a 3cm knob of ginger into thin coins and cut 2 limes into wedges. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass, then top with 150ml cold ginger beer. Squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins to each glass. For anyone not drinking, use all ginger beer with extra lime.
T: Get busy cooking.
D: A banker wrongly jailed for murder spends two decades in Shawshank, quietly keeping hope alive.
P: Pour the beers when the tarring crew gets their cold ones on the roof.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
S: Chicken liver pâté with broad beans
the most famous line in the film, made edible
Chicken livers cooked with butter, shallot and thyme, blitzed smooth, with smashed broad beans on toast.
the Baltimore hospital where Lecter is kept

Sweet crab meat bound lightly with mayo, mustard and breadcrumbs, pan-fried into golden cakes, served with a caper and gherkin remoulade and lemon. Mix 400g crab meat gently with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp paprika, 2 sliced spring onions, 60g panko crumbs and lemon zest. Shape into 12 small cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in 30g butter and 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade, mix 120g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 chopped gherkins, 1 tsp Dijon, parsley and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges.
the moth that gives the killer away
Grated parmesan baked in small wing shapes at 200C until lacy and golden, with a pinch of black pepper.
M: Lamb shanks browned and braised in Chianti with tomato, garlic and rosemary until falling off the bone, over soft polenta.

Chicken pieces soaked in buttermilk, dredged in peppery flour and fried crackling crisp, with creamy coleslaw and warm buttermilk biscuits with honey. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with salt and hot sauce. Dredge in 250g plain flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and pepper. Fry at 160C for 12 to 15 minutes until 75C inside. For biscuits, rub 80g butter into 300g self-raising flour, add 200ml buttermilk, pat out, cut 8 rounds and bake at 220C for 14 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 100g mayo and vinegar.
W: a refined end to the meal
Pears poached in red wine with sugar, cinnamon and orange peel until deep red, with mascarpone.
K: the nice Chianti Lecter brings up

Chianti stirred with blood orange juice, brandy and a touch of honey, loaded with sliced oranges, apple and cinnamon, poured over ice. In a large jug, stir 750ml Chianti with 200ml blood orange juice, 60ml brandy and 2 tbsp honey until the honey dissolves. Add 1 sliced orange, 1 diced apple and 1 cinnamon stick. Chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice in wine glasses, spooning some fruit into each. For non-drinkers, make it with sour cherry juice and blood orange juice topped with soda.
T: Broad beans and a nice Chianti.
D: An FBI trainee asks an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist for help catching a serial killer.
P: Pour the Chianti when Lecter brings up the census taker.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
S: Granny's garden and the cold stream
Small cucumbers chilled in iced water, cut into spears and served with miso mixed with a little honey for dipping.
the corn Mei carries all the way to Mum
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with butter melted with soy sauce and a little sugar.
lunch on the porch of the old country house

Warm seasoned rice shaped into triangles around flaked grilled salmon or pickled plum, wrapped in crisp nori with toasted sesame. Rinse 2 cups short-grain rice until clear and cook with 2.5 cups water. Grill a 250g salmon fillet sprinkled with salt for 8 minutes and flake. With wet, salted hands, take a handful of warm rice, press a hollow, add salmon or a little pickled plum, close and press into a triangle. Make 12. Wrap the base of each in a strip of nori and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
M: the lunch Satsuki packs for everyone
Rice with peas, pink fish flakes and a pickled plum, with teriyaki chicken, rolled omelette and pickles in a box.
Satsuki and Mei waiting at the bus stop in the rain

Thick udon in a hot soy and dashi broth with fish cake, a jammy soft-boiled egg, wilted spinach and plenty of spring onion. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool and peel. Heat 1.2L water with 2 tsp dashi powder, 60ml soy, 60ml mirin and 1 tsp sugar until just simmering. Cook 4 packs (800g) fresh udon in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain. Divide between bowls with a handful of spinach, pour over the hot broth and top with sliced fish cake, a halved egg and sliced spring onion.
W: lending Totoro an umbrella in the rain

Little honey pancakes cooked golden in a pan, cooled, then sandwiched in pairs with sweet red bean paste. Whisk 3 eggs with 100g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then 150g flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 60ml water. Cook 16 small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan for 1 minute a side. Sandwich in pairs with 300g red bean paste.
K: Catbus iced barley tea with honey
the Catbus with its glowing eyes

Toasty roasted barley tea brewed strong, sweetened lightly with honey, chilled and poured over ice with thin slices of lemon. Bring 1.2L water to the boil, add 4 tbsp roasted barley tea (or 3 tea bags) and simmer 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp honey and steep 10 minutes more. Strain and chill for at least 2 hours. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add 2 thin lemon slices to each and pour in the tea.
T: Corn for Mum, cucumbers from the stream.
D: Two young sisters who move to the countryside befriend a giant forest spirit.
P: Serve the cucumbers when Granny pulls them out of the cold stream.

title: Fight Club
S: Support group shortbread with coffee glaze
the support group meetings the narrator crashes

Brown butter shortbread fingers baked pale and crumbly, drizzled with a strong coffee icing, set out next to the urn on a folding table. Melt 200g butter and cook until nutty brown, then chill until firm again. Heat the oven to 160C. Beat the butter with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 250g plain flour, 50g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick and bake 35 minutes until pale gold. Cut into fingers while warm. Mix 120g icing sugar with 2 tbsp strong cold espresso and drizzle over once cool.
Mixed nuts tossed with butter, brown sugar, cayenne and rosemary, roasted at 170C until glossy.
Tyler's night job waiting tables at banquets
Puff pastry cases filled with creamy chicken and mushroom, warmed and passed around on trays.
M: the narrator's single-serving life on planes
Chicken thighs braised with onion, garlic and stock, served with buttered rice and peas in neat portions.
Paper Street fried egg and bacon rolls
the falling-apart house on Paper Street

Crispy-edged fried eggs and thick bacon in toasted soft rolls with melted cheddar, hot sauce and a smear of chilli mayo. Fry 8 bacon rashers in a large pan until crisp. Remove and fry 4 eggs in the fat over high heat until the edges are lacy and brown but the yolks are runny. Lay a slice of cheddar on each egg for the last 30 seconds. Split and toast 4 soft rolls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp hot sauce and spread on the rolls. Fill with bacon and the egg, and add more hot sauce to taste.
W: Dark chocolate melted into hot sweetened cream, poured into small single-serve cups and chilled for three hours until set.
K: the beers upstairs at Lou's Tavern after the fights

An ice-cold lager served with a short glass of bourbon on the side, sipped together or dropped in, with salted peanuts on the bar. Chill 4 cans of lager until icy and 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Pour the lager into the frosted glasses. Pour 30ml bourbon into 4 shot glasses. Drink the shot and chase it with the beer, or drop the shot glass carefully into the beer. Serve with a bowl of salted peanuts. Ginger beer and a squeeze of lime for anyone not drinking.
T: First rule: nobody leaves hungry.
D: An insomniac office worker and a soap salesman start an underground fight club that grows into something worse.
P: Serve the mains when the narrator meets Tyler on the plane.

title: Knives Out
S: Benoit Blanc's theory of the donut hole
Small balls of yeasted dough fried at 175C until puffed and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar while hot.
Harlan's 85th birthday party at the mansion

Little French cheese puffs of choux pastry and gruyère, baked hollow, light and golden with a salty crust of extra cheese. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it pulls away from the sides, then cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy, then 120g grated gruyère, pepper and a pinch of nutmeg. Pipe 24 small mounds onto lined trays, top with 30g more gruyère and bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm.

Clams, smoky bacon, potato and onion simmered in a thick creamy broth with thyme, served in small cups with oyster crackers and chives. Fry 120g diced bacon until crisp. Add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml fish stock, 400ml milk, 400g diced potato and thyme. Simmer 15 minutes. Add 1kg vongole clams, cover and cook 5 minutes until open, then remove the shells. Stir in 150ml cream and season with pepper. Ladle into small cups and top with chives and oyster crackers.
M: the family dinner at the mansion
Beef rib roast seasoned with garlic and thyme, roasted pink and carved at the table with horseradish cream and roast potatoes.
a New England summer classic, Thrombey territory

Chunks of cooked lobster in a lemon, chive and celery mayo, piled into buttered, griddled brioche hot dog rolls with crisp lettuce and a pinch of paprika. Cut the meat from 2 cooked lobsters, about 500g, into chunks. Mix with 80g mayo, 1 finely diced celery stick, 1 tbsp chopped chives, the zest and juice of half a lemon, salt and pepper. Chill 15 minutes. Butter the sides of 4 brioche hot dog rolls and toast in a pan until golden. Line with shredded cos, pile in the lobster and finish with a pinch of paprika and more chives.
W: Rich chocolate layer cake covered in dark chocolate fudge frosting, with candles lit for an 85th birthday.
K: Maple bourbon coffee with whipped cream
the 'my house, my rules, my coffee' mug

Strong hot coffee stirred with maple syrup and a shot of bourbon, poured into big mugs and topped with cold whipped cream and a grating of nutmeg. Brew 800ml strong coffee. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tsp maple syrup to soft peaks. Into each of 4 big mugs pour 1 tbsp maple syrup and 30ml bourbon, then 200ml hot coffee and stir. Spoon the cream on top so it floats and grate over a little nutmeg. Leave out the bourbon for non-drinkers. Make sure everyone gets the right mug.
T: Donut holes, birthday cake and one very nice sweater.
D: A detective investigates the death of a crime novelist after his 85th birthday party, with the whole family as suspects.
P: Serve the donut holes when Blanc starts on his donut theory.

title: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
S: the welcome spread on Miles Bron's island
Hummus, tzatziki and taramasalata with olives, cucumber, tomatoes and warm pita, laid out on a big board.
Miles and his old crew of disruptors

Crisp baked chicken wings tossed in a sticky homemade chilli hot sauce, with celery and a cooling blue cheese dip. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Blitz 6 red chillies with 3 garlic cloves, 80ml vinegar and 2 tbsp honey, simmer 5 minutes and toss through the wings. Serve with celery and 150g blue cheese stirred into 150g sour cream.
Glass onion petals with whipped feta
the giant glass onion at the centre of Miles Bron's island

Red onions roasted until sweet, separated into glossy petals and filled with whipped feta, topped with honey, crushed pistachio and oregano. Heat the oven to 200C. Halve 4 red onions through the root, keep the skins on, brush the cut sides with oil and roast cut side down for 30 minutes until soft. Cool, peel and separate into 20 to 24 petals. Blitz 200g feta with 80g Greek yoghurt, lemon zest and 1 tbsp oil until smooth. Spoon or pipe into each petal, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and scatter with 30g crushed pistachios and dried oregano.
M: Lamb marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, skewered and grilled, in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato and onion. Cut 800g lamb leg into cubes and marinate 2 hours with the juice of 1 lemon, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and 3 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Serve in 4 warm pitas with 250g Greek yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber, plus tomato and onion.
a Greek seaside lunch on Miles Bron's island

Octopus simmered until tender, charred hard on the grill and dressed in lemon, oregano and olive oil, with crispy lemon potatoes, capers and red onion. Simmer 1.2kg cleaned octopus in salted water with a bay leaf for 50 minutes until tender, then cool in the liquid. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 800g halved chat potatoes with oil, the juice of 1 lemon and oregano and roast 40 minutes. Cut the octopus into legs, oil and char on a very hot grill 2 minutes a side. Toss with the potatoes, 1 tbsp capers, sliced red onion, lemon juice, olive oil and parsley.
W: the pineapple juice slipped into Duke's drink

Buttery vanilla cake baked over brown sugar caramel, pineapple rings and glacé cherries, turned out warm and served with whipped cream. Heat the oven to 180C. Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar in a 23cm cake tin and lay 8 pineapple rings on top with a glacé cherry in each. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, turn out and serve warm with whipped cream.
K: Chilled ginger kombucha over ice with lime and mint, with a shot of vodka for anyone who wants it spiked like the guests got. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, mint leaves and a squeeze of lime. Pour 250ml cold ginger kombucha into each and add 30ml vodka to the glasses of anyone who wants it spiked. Stir once and serve straight away.
T: A murder mystery weekend, Greek island catering.
D: Detective Benoit Blanc joins a tech billionaire's murder mystery weekend on a private Greek island.
P: Serve the mezze when the guests arrive by boat.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
S: Mini bagels halved and toasted, spread with scallion cream cheese and showered in everything seasoning.
Hot dog fingers in puff pastry
the universe where everyone has hot dog fingers

Long thin frankfurts wrapped in strips of puff pastry with cheddar, baked golden and flaky, with mustard and tomato sauce for dunking. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 thawed puff pastry sheets into 1.5cm strips. Halve 8 thin frankfurts lengthways if thick, or use 16 cocktail franks. Lay a little grated cheddar (60g total) along each strip and wind it around a frank. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake on lined trays for 15 to 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
Pork and cabbage dumplings pleated by hand, pan-fried until crisp underneath, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
M: Beef, prawns and vegetables seared on a smoking hot plate with garlic butter and soy, with fried rice.
Longevity noodles with chicken and shiitake
the New Year party Evelyn is trying to throw at the laundromat

Long egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, shiitake, bok choy and oyster sauce, kept whole and never cut for a long life. Slice 400g chicken thigh and toss with 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tbsp soy. Soak 450g fresh long egg noodles in hot water 1 minute and drain. Mix 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp sesame oil. Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok 4 minutes. Add 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger and 150g sliced shiitake for 2 minutes, then 3 halved bok choy. Add noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes without cutting.
W: Glutinous rice dough filled with red bean paste, rolled in sesame seeds and fried until puffed and golden.
K: Black tea with milk and brown sugar syrup over chewy tapioca pearls and ice.
T: Everything, everywhere, including the bagel.
D: A laundromat owner drowning in tax paperwork finds she can jump between universes to save the multiverse.
P: Serve the bagel bites when the everything bagel shows up.

title: Barbie
S: Cold king prawns and crisp cos in little glasses, smothered in a pink Marie Rose sauce, finished with avocado, paprika and a lemon wedge. Peel and devein 600g cooked king prawns, leaving a few tails on for the tops. Mix 120g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a few drops of hot sauce and the juice of half a lemon until pink and smooth. Shred 1 cos heart and divide between 8 small glasses. Add diced avocado (1 total) and the prawns, spoon over the sauce, dust with paprika and add a lemon wedge.
Beach Ken watermelon and feta skewers
the beach where Ken's job is just beach

Chunks of icy watermelon threaded with feta, cucumber and mint, drizzled with lime and olive oil and dusted with chilli salt. Cut a quarter of a watermelon into 3cm cubes and chill well. Cut 200g firm feta and 1 continental cucumber into similar cubes. Thread onto 12 skewers in the order watermelon, mint leaf, feta, cucumber, watermelon. Lay on a platter, squeeze over the juice of 1 lime and drizzle with 2 tbsp olive oil. Mix 1 tsp salt with half a tsp chilli flakes and sprinkle over just before serving.
Girls' night beetroot pink devilled eggs
the big girls' night at the Dreamhouse

Boiled egg whites soaked hot pink in beetroot pickling liquid, filled with whipped mustard yolks and topped with chives and crispy shallots. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Mix 250ml liquid from a jar of sliced beetroot with 125ml white vinegar and 1 tbsp sugar, add the whole eggs and soak in the fridge for 2 to 4 hours until bright pink. Halve and pop out the yolks. Mash with 80g mayo, 2 tsp Dijon and salt until smooth, then pipe back in. Top with snipped chives and 2 tbsp fried shallots.
M: Pasta tossed in a sauce of roasted beetroot blended with ricotta, garlic and parmesan, topped with goat's cheese.

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, baked low until tender, then glazed with a sticky homemade barbecue sauce until charred at the edges. Heat the oven to 150C. Mix 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap tightly in foil and bake 2.5 hours. Simmer 200ml tomato sauce, 60ml cider vinegar, 60g brown sugar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tsp smoked paprika for 10 minutes. Unwrap the ribs, brush with sauce and roast at 220C for 15 minutes, basting twice, until sticky.
W: Fluffy golden waffles piled with fresh strawberries, whipped cream and a bright pink strawberry sauce poured over the top.
K: pink, cold and actually in the cup this time

Fresh strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream and cold milk until thick and pink, in glasses rimmed with white chocolate and sprinkles. Melt 50g white chocolate and dip the rims of 4 tall glasses in it, then into 3 tbsp sprinkles. Chill the glasses 10 minutes. Blend 300g hulled strawberries with 500g vanilla ice cream, 300ml cold milk and 1 tbsp honey until thick and pink. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream (100ml whipped) and a halved strawberry.
T: Every night is girls' night.
D: Barbie's perfect life in Barbieland starts to crack, sending her and Ken into the real world.
P: Serve the waffles when Barbie's perfect morning starts to go wrong.

title: Oppenheimer
S: Blue corn chips with red chile salsa
Blue corn chips with a smoky salsa of dried red chillies, tomato, garlic and lime.
Los Alamos green chile cheeseburger sliders
the town built on the mesa at Los Alamos

Smashed beef sliders topped with roasted green chillies and melted cheddar, in soft toasted buns with pickles and a smoky chipotle mayo. Char 4 long green chillies over a flame or under a grill until blackened, sweat in a bowl, peel, seed and chop. Roll 500g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash flat in a very hot pan, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top with the chillies and a slice of cheddar each, cover 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Toast 8 slider buns and build with mayo, patties and pickles.
Cambridge apple, cheddar and walnut toasts
the apple young Oppenheimer leaves on his tutor's desk at Cambridge

Toasted sourdough with melted vintage cheddar, thin slices of crisp apple, toasted walnuts and a drizzle of honey and thyme. Slice 1 small sourdough into 12 thin slices and toast under the grill until golden on one side. Turn, lay on 200g sliced vintage cheddar and grill 2 minutes until bubbling. Core 2 crisp red apples and slice very thin. Top each toast with a fan of apple, scatter with 50g chopped toasted walnuts, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and finish with thyme leaves and pepper.
M: the first test out in the desert

Pork, potatoes and roasted green chillies simmered with onion, garlic and stock until thick, with warm tortillas. Brown 1kg diced pork shoulder, then soften 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves. Char 6 large green chillies, peel, chop and add with 600g diced potatoes and 1L chicken stock. Simmer 90 minutes until the pork is tender. Serve with 8 warm flour tortillas.
New Mexico red chile pork posole
a New Mexico feast near the Los Alamos site

Pork shoulder simmered with hominy in a deep red chilli broth until tender, topped with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano and crisp tortilla strips. Soak 4 dried ancho chillies in boiling water 20 minutes, then blend with 3 garlic cloves and 250ml of the soaking water. Brown 1.2kg pork shoulder chunks in a pot. Add 1 diced onion, the chilli purée, 1.5L chicken stock, 2 tsp oregano and 1 tsp cumin and simmer 2 hours. Add 2 drained 800g tins of hominy and simmer 20 minutes. Serve topped with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, lime and fried tortilla strips.
W: Small squares of rolled dough fried until they puff up hollow, then torn open at the table and filled with honey.
K: the martinis Oppie mixed for his guests

Gin stirred with a splash of vermouth over ice, glass rim touched with lime and honey. Touch the rim of 4 chilled glasses with a little honey and lime. For each drink, stir 60ml gin with a splash of dry vermouth over ice and strain in. Serve iced lime soda the same way for anyone off the gin.
T: Trinity site, green chile on the stove.
D: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer and the race to build the atomic bomb at Los Alamos.
