P: Serve the stew when the team settles in at Los Alamos.

title: Dune: Part Two
S: Chickpeas tossed with oil, cumin, smoked paprika, cinnamon and salt, roasted at 200C until crunchy.
bread in the deep desert sietch

Soft yoghurt flatbreads blistered in a dry pan, brushed with butter whipped with Medjool dates, cardamom and flaky salt. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 250g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and rest 15 minutes. Divide into 8 and roll thin. Cook in a very hot dry pan 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Blitz 100g soft butter with 4 pitted Medjool dates, a pinch of ground cardamom and a pinch of salt until smooth. Brush over the hot breads, sprinkle with flaky salt and tear to share.
a sweet bite back at Stilgar's sietch

Medjool dates split and stuffed with a toasted almond and a little goat's cheese, then drizzled with warm honey. Split 16 medjool dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a little goat's cheese (100g total) and a toasted almond. Lay on a plate and drizzle with 2 tbsp warm honey just before serving.
M: Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin, coriander, cinnamon and chilli, slow roasted, with golden saffron rice. Rub a 1.5kg lamb shoulder with 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp cinnamon, chilli and salt. Roast covered at 160C for 3.5 hours until it pulls apart. Steep a pinch of saffron in hot water and cook 300g basmati rice with it until golden and fluffy.
the Fremen making every drop of water count

Red lentils simmered thick with onion, garlic, tomato, cumin and turmeric, finished with lemon, a sizzle of chilli butter and fresh coriander. Fry 1 diced onion in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp coriander for 1 minute. Stir in 300g rinsed red lentils, 400g tinned tomatoes and 1L vegetable stock and simmer 25 minutes, stirring, until thick. Add the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Melt 40g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes and cumin seeds until sizzling, pour over and top with coriander. Serve with flatbread.
W: the great sandworm Paul learns to ride

Cardamom, cinnamon and ginger cake baked with honey until dark and moist, glazed while warm and cut into thick slices. Melt 150g butter with 150g honey and 100g brown sugar. Mix with 250g self-raising flour, 2 tsp cardamom, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp ginger, 2 eggs and 125ml milk. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes and brush with warm honey.
K: Cardamom spice coffee with date syrup
the spice coffee shared in the sietch

Strong coffee brewed with crushed cardamom, cinnamon and a pinch of clove, sweetened with date syrup and topped with frothed milk. Lightly crush 8 cardamom pods. Put them in a saucepan with 600ml water, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 cloves and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 6 tbsp finely ground coffee, take off the heat and steep 4 minutes, then strain through a fine sieve or plunger. Stir in 3 tbsp date syrup. Froth 200ml hot milk and spoon over 4 small cups of the coffee, with a pinch of cinnamon on top.
T: Spice in every dish. Water, carefully.
D: Paul Atreides unites with the Fremen of Arrakis to take revenge on those who destroyed his family.
P: Serve the mains when Paul rides his first sandworm.

title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
S: Green Place garden veg with whipped feta
the Green Place of Many Mothers where Furiosa grew up

Radishes, baby carrots, snow peas and cucumber from the garden around a whipped feta and herb dip, finished with olive oil and lemon zest. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of half a lemon and a handful each of mint and dill until smooth and green flecked. Spread into a bowl and drizzle with oil. Trim 1 bunch radishes and 1 bunch baby carrots, string 150g snow peas and cut 1 cucumber into spears. Soak the vegetables in iced water 10 minutes, drain and arrange around the dip.
Bullet Farm chorizo with smoky honey
the Bullet Farm, all smoke and noise

Thick coins of chorizo blistered in a smoking pan, glazed with honey, smoked paprika and sherry vinegar, served on picks with charred bread. Slice 4 chorizo sausages (about 500g) into 1.5cm coins. Heat a heavy pan over high heat and fry without oil for 4 minutes, turning, until blistered and the fat runs. Add 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp sherry vinegar and toss for 1 minute until sticky. Grill 8 slices of sourdough until charred. Serve the chorizo on toothpicks with the bread to mop up the pan juices.
bread cooked on hot steel out in the Wasteland

Yoghurt flatbreads slapped onto smoking hot steel until blistered and charred, brushed with garlic and parsley butter and sprinkled with salt. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 250g Greek yoghurt and half a tsp salt into a soft dough and knead 1 minute. Rest 10 minutes, divide into 8 and roll thin. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Heat a heavy pan or barbecue plate until smoking and cook each bread 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered. Brush with garlic butter straight away and sprinkle with flaky salt.
M: the long haul across the Wasteland
Lamb chops marinated in rosemary, garlic and lemon, grilled hot on the barbecue with charred corn.
Gastown, where everything is black with fuel

Chicken thighs coated in a dark spice rub of smoked paprika, garlic, cumin and pepper, seared until blackened, with a sharp lime and chilli slaw. Mix 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp brown sugar, half a tsp cayenne and 1 tsp salt. Rub over 8 chicken thigh fillets with a little oil. Sear in a very hot cast-iron pan or on the barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side until blackened and cooked through. Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot and coriander with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp oil and a sliced chilli.
W: the peach seed Furiosa carries all the way
Peaches halved and grilled cut side down until caramelised, drizzled with honey and thyme and served with vanilla ice cream.
K: the precious milk stored in the Citadel

Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, malted milk powder and honey until thick, poured into tall glasses with a drizzle of honey. Chill 4 tall glasses. Blend 500g vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp honey until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little honey down the inside of each glass, pour in the shake and sprinkle with 1 tbsp more malt powder. Serve straight away with straws.
T: The Green Place grows peaches. The Wasteland grills.
D: Young Furiosa is taken from the Green Place and has to fight her way back across the Wasteland.
P: Serve the peaches when Furiosa plants the seed.

title: The Fall Guy
S: Cooked king prawns on ice with lemon wedges, bread and butter and a quick cocktail sauce.
the set of Jody's space epic, Metalstorm

Thick beef snags grilled until snapping, in buttered bread with sticky caramelised onion and beer relish, mustard and plenty of tomato sauce. Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden. Add 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp balsamic and 60ml beer and simmer 5 minutes until jammy. Grill 8 thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Butter 8 slices of white bread, wrap each round a sausage and top with the onion relish, mustard and tomato sauce.
a pie between takes on set

Little beef and gravy pies in shortcrust with flaky puff lids, baked golden and served hot with plenty of tomato sauce for the crew. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, 300ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tbsp tomato paste and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with the mince, top with rounds cut from 1 puff pastry sheet, press the edges, brush with egg and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
M: the dog who only takes orders in French

Flathead fillets in a crisp beer batter fried golden with thick-cut chips, lemon wedges and homemade tartare sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager into a batter, dip 600g flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 125g mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.
the catering trays on a long shoot

Slow-cooked beef ragù layered with fresh pasta and nutmeg béchamel, topped with mozzarella and parmesan and baked until bubbling and crisp at the edges. Brown 800g beef mince, add 1 diced onion, 1 carrot and 2 garlic cloves, then 700g passata and 125ml red wine. Simmer 45 minutes. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g plain flour, whisk in 750ml milk and cook until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan. Heat the oven to 180C. Layer ragù, 375g fresh lasagne sheets and béchamel three times in a deep dish. Top with 200g mozzarella and bake 45 minutes. Rest 15 minutes.
W: an Aussie classic on the wrap party table
Crisp meringue shell with a soft marshmallow middle, cooled in the oven and topped with whipped cream, passionfruit and berries.
K: Colt, the stuntie who takes the hits

Cold coffee and milk poured over ice with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and whipped cream on top. Brew 500ml strong coffee from 50g ground coffee and chill. Pour into 4 tall glasses with ice and 400ml cold milk, then top each with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a spoon of whipped cream.
T: Stunts all day, prawns by the harbour.
D: A battered stuntman is pulled back onto a film set in Sydney to find the movie's missing star.
P: Serve the prawns when Colt lands the record-breaking cannon roll.

title: Paddington in Peru
S: the emergency marmalade sandwich Paddington keeps under his hat

Thick white bread layered with sharp cheddar, ham and bitter orange marmalade, toasted in butter until golden and melting, cut into squares. Butter 8 slices of thick white bread on one side. On the unbuttered sides of 4 slices spread 1 tbsp thick-cut marmalade each, then add 150g sliced ham and 150g grated vintage cheddar. Close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese melts. Cut into squares.
Home for Retired Bears causa bites
Aunt Lucy's home in the Peruvian jungle

Mashed yellow potato seasoned with lime and chilli paste, layered with chicken and avocado, cut into squares. Boil 800g potatoes, mash smooth with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp ají amarillo paste, 3 tbsp oil and salt. Mix 300g cooked shredded chicken breast with 3 tbsp mayonnaise. Layer potato, chicken, sliced avocado and more potato in a tin, chill 1 hour and cut into squares.
Choclo with queso fresco and ají sauce
the corn of the Peruvian Andes

Fat corn cobs boiled and charred, served with slabs of grilled fresh white cheese and a creamy, mild yellow chilli and lime sauce. Boil 4 corn cobs (or Peruvian choclo if you can get it) for 8 minutes, then char on a hot grill pan for 4 minutes, turning. Slice 250g haloumi or queso fresco and grill 1 minute a side. Blend 2 tbsp ají amarillo paste with 100g feta, 80ml evaporated milk, 2 crackers and the juice of half a lime until smooth. Cut the cobs in thirds and serve with the cheese and sauce.
M: Hunter Cabot's river boat lomo saltado
the boat trip up the river with Captain Cabot

Beef strips stir-fried with onion, tomato, soy and vinegar, tossed through chips, served with rice. Bake 500g frozen fries until crisp. Sear 600g sliced beef rump in a smoking wok, add 1 sliced red onion and 2 tomatoes in wedges, then 3 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp vinegar. Toss through the chips and serve with 300g cooked rice.
Ají de gallina with rice and egg
a creamy Peruvian chicken dish for the family

Shredded chicken in a creamy yellow chilli, walnut and parmesan sauce thickened with bread, over rice with boiled egg, black olives and a sprinkle of coriander. Poach 700g chicken breast in 1L stock for 15 minutes and shred, keeping the stock. Soak 3 slices of white bread in 250ml evaporated milk. Fry 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 3 tbsp ají amarillo paste and 1 tsp turmeric. Blend with the soaked bread and 50g walnuts, return to the pan with 300ml stock and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the chicken and 40g parmesan. Serve over rice with halved boiled eggs and olives.
W: Soft, crumbly cornflour biscuits sandwiched with thick dulce de leche, then rolled around the edges in desiccated coconut.
K: Purple corn simmered with pineapple, cinnamon and cloves, strained, sweetened and served cold with lime.
T: Marmalade for the jungle.
D: Paddington and the Browns head to Peru to find Aunt Lucy, who has gone missing from the Home for Retired Bears.
P: Serve the marmalade sandwiches when Paddington pulls one from under his hat.

title: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl
S: Wallace and his favourite crumbly cheese

Thick toast topped with crumbly Wensleydale and a little cheddar, grilled until bubbling, finished with apple chutney and fresh apple slices. Toast 8 slices of thick white bread on one side under the grill. Turn and spread the untoasted sides lightly with butter. Crumble over 200g Wensleydale mixed with 80g grated cheddar, pressing it to the edges. Grill 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling and golden in spots. Top each with a spoon of apple chutney (150g total) and a few thin slices of green apple. Cut into triangles.
Wallace's contraptions that make breakfast at the press of a button

Thick bread fingers soaked in vanilla egg custard, fried golden in butter, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with strawberry jam for dipping. Whisk 3 eggs with 150ml milk, 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp vanilla. Cut 6 thick slices of white bread into 3 fingers each. Dip each finger in the egg for a few seconds a side. Fry in batches in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden. Toss straight away in 50g caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Serve warm with 150g strawberry jam.
Gromit's garden pea and courgette fritters

Grated courgette, peas, spring onion and feta in a light batter, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with a cool minted yoghurt dip. Grate 2 courgettes, squeeze out the liquid in a tea towel. Mix with 150g thawed peas, 2 sliced spring onions, 100g crumbled feta, 2 eggs, 100g self-raising flour and pepper. Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry heaped tablespoons for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Stir chopped mint and lemon juice into 200g Greek yoghurt for dipping.
M: a Northern English dinner at 62 West Wallaby Street
Pork sausages browned slowly in the pan, served on creamy buttered mash with a rich onion gravy poured over.
a hot pasty for a day in the garden shed

Golden shortcrust pasties crimped full of cheddar, diced potato and sweet onion with white pepper, served hot with brown pickle chutney. Heat the oven to 200C. Boil 300g diced potato for 6 minutes and drain. Soften 1 diced onion in 20g butter for 5 minutes. Mix the potato, onion, 200g grated cheddar, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and white pepper. Cut 4 shortcrust sheets into 20cm rounds. Spoon the filling onto one half, fold over, crimp the edges and brush with beaten egg. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden. Serve with pickle chutney.
W: Soft suet-style pastry spread with strawberry jam, rolled up, baked until golden and served in slices with hot custard.
K: Gromit putting his feet up at 62 West Wallaby Street

Rich hot chocolate made with melted milk chocolate, cocoa and malted milk powder, topped with whipped cream and a sprinkle of grated chocolate. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming. Whisk in 100g chopped milk chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp sugar until smooth and frothy, about 3 minutes. Do not let it boil. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour into 4 big mugs, spoon the cream on top and grate over a little more chocolate.
T: Cheese, crackers and one very suspicious penguin.
D: Wallace's helpful robot gnome goes rogue, and Gromit suspects an old feathered enemy is behind it.
P: Serve the cheese when Wallace calls for crackers.

title: A Minecraft Movie
S: the baked potatoes crafted in the Overworld

Potatoes baked until the skins crackle, split and loaded with butter, melted cheddar, crispy bacon, sour cream and chives. Heat the oven to 200C. Prick 4 large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 to 70 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and add 15g butter each. Top with 120g grated cheddar and return to the oven for 5 minutes. Finish with bacon, 150g sour cream and chives.
Melon block skewers with mint sugar

Watermelon, rockmelon and honeydew cut into perfect cubes, stacked onto skewers like blocks and sprinkled with lime and mint sugar. Cut a quarter of a watermelon, half a rockmelon and half a honeydew into neat 2.5cm cubes, trimming them square. Thread onto 12 skewers in alternating colours, or stack into little towers on a board. Pound 2 tbsp caster sugar with 6 mint leaves and the zest of 1 lime in a mortar until green. Squeeze lime juice over the melon and sprinkle with the mint sugar just before serving.
Choc chip cookie dough pressed into a tray, baked until just golden and cut into neat square blocks while warm.
M: the chicken jockey, a moment everyone remembers
Chicken drumsticks glazed with honey, chilli flakes and smoked paprika, roasted at 200C until sticky and charred at the edges.
Crafted mushroom stew with cheesy toast
the stew crafted from red and brown mushrooms

Mixed mushrooms browned in butter and simmered with onion, garlic, thyme, stock and cream until rich and thick, with cheesy garlic toast for dunking. Brown 800g mixed sliced mushrooms in batches in 40g butter over high heat. Remove. Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then stir in 1 tbsp plain flour and thyme. Add 500ml vegetable stock and the mushrooms and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and season. Top 8 slices of baguette with garlic butter and 80g grated cheddar and grill until bubbling. Serve the stew in bowls with the toast.
W: Spiced pumpkin custard in a shortcrust case, baked until just set and served with whipped cream.
K: Cold milk blended with chocolate ice cream, malted milk powder and chocolate syrup until thick, served in tall glasses with crushed malt balls on top. Drizzle chocolate syrup inside 4 tall glasses. Blend 500g chocolate ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp chocolate syrup until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses. Roughly crush 80g chocolate malt balls in a bag with a rolling pin and scatter over the top. Serve with straws.
T: Baked potatoes, mushroom stew and a chicken jockey.
D: Four misfits are pulled through a portal into the blocky Overworld and need Steve's help to get home.
P: Serve the drumsticks when the chicken jockey shows up.

title: KPop Demon Hunters
S: Rumi, Mira and Zoey's snack between shows

Rice, egg, carrot, spinach, pickled radish and ham rolled in seaweed and sliced into rounds. Season 300g cooked sushi rice with sesame oil and salt. Lay rice on 4 nori sheets, add strips of omelette from 2 eggs, sautéed carrot, blanched spinach and pickled radish, then roll tightly and slice into rounds.
refuelling between shows to keep the Honmoon strong

Chewy rice cakes and fish cake simmered in a sticky gochujang and anchovy broth, blanketed in melted mozzarella with spring onion and sesame. Soak 500g rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes. Bring 500ml water with 1 tsp dashi powder to the boil. Stir in 3 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp gochugaru, 1 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Add the rice cakes and 2 sliced fish cakes and simmer 10 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy. Add 3 chopped spring onions, scatter 150g grated mozzarella over, cover for 2 minutes to melt and finish with sesame seeds.
the street food stall in the city square
Korean hot dogs on a stick: sausage wrapped in mozzarella and a thick batter, fried crisp, rolled in sugar and finished with ketchup and mustard.
M: the noodle break the girls live for
Spicy instant-style noodles upgraded with a soft egg, spring onion, kimchi and a slice of cheese.
the three of them sharing a comfort meal

Milky beef bone broth simmered for hours, with sliced brisket, rice and noodles, seasoned at the table with salt and spring onion, radish kimchi alongside. Soak 2kg beef marrow bones and 600g brisket in cold water for 1 hour. Boil the bones 10 minutes, drain and rinse. Cover with 4L fresh water, boil hard with the lid off for 3 hours, topping up, until milky. Add the brisket for the last 90 minutes, then slice it thin. Cook 100g somyeon noodles. Serve bowls of broth with brisket, noodles, cooked rice, sliced spring onion, salt and pepper to season, and 300g radish kimchi.
W: Derpy, the big blue tiger in the hat

Yeasted dough filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts, pan-fried until crisp and molten inside. Mix 300g flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm milk into a sticky dough and prove 1 hour. Fill 8 balls with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 40g chopped walnuts, flatten in an oiled pan and fry 2 minutes a side until crisp.
K: Rumi fighting to hold on to her voice before the big show

Sweet and sour yuja citron marmalade stirred into hot water with fresh ginger and honey, served steaming in glasses or poured over ice with lemon. Simmer 1L water with a 3cm knob of ginger, sliced thin, for 5 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in 6 tbsp yuja citron tea (the honey citron marmalade from Asian grocers) and 2 tbsp honey until dissolved. Pour into 4 heatproof glasses, making sure each gets some citron peel, and add a thin lemon slice. For an iced version, cool it and pour over ice.
T: Concert night, then ramyeon.
D: A K-pop girl group who secretly hunt demons face a rival boy band with a dark secret.
P: Serve the ramyeon when the girls finally get their noodle break.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
S: White fish strips crumbed in panko and fried golden, with lemon and a herby yoghurt dip.
Stoick's skillet bread with honey butter
Stoick the Vast's table in the Great Hall

Crusty seeded bread baked in a blazing hot skillet, torn at the table and slathered with whipped honey and sea salt butter. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 10g salt, 2 tbsp mixed seeds and 350ml warm water and knead 8 minutes. Rest 1 hour. Shape into a round and put in an oiled 26cm ovenproof skillet, slash the top, brush with water and scatter more seeds. Rest 30 minutes. Bake at 230C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Beat 125g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and flaky salt and serve with the warm bread.
the forge where Hiccup works for Gobber
Thick smoked sausages charred over the fire until the skins split, cut into chunks and served with grainy mustard for dipping.
M: Lamb shoulder stewed slowly with carrots, parsnips, pearl barley, thyme and stock for two hours until thick and tender.
Toothless lighting up the sky over Berk

Chicken marylands rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and rosemary, roasted until charred, then lacquered with smoky honey and served with roast carrots. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub 4 chicken marylands with 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary and salt. Roast on a tray with 6 halved carrots for 40 minutes. Warm 3 tbsp honey with half a tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Brush over the chicken and roast 10 minutes more until sticky and charred at the edges. Rest 5 minutes and spoon the pan juices over.
W: a sweet for the dragon riders
Small honey and spice cakes baked in a muffin tin and glazed with warm honey.
K: Berk, where it snows nine months of the year

Mixed berries simmered with apple juice, cinnamon, star anise and orange peel, strained and served steaming in mugs with a few whole berries. Put 300g frozen mixed berries, 1L cloudy apple juice, 1 cinnamon stick, 1 star anise, 3 strips of orange peel and 1 tbsp honey in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook 10 minutes, pressing the berries. Strain through a sieve into a jug. Pour into 4 mugs and drop in a few fresh blueberries. Serve hot, or chill and pour over ice in summer.
T: Fish for the dragon, stew for the Vikings.
D: A young Viking who can't fight befriends the dragon he was meant to kill.
P: Serve the fish bites when Hiccup offers Toothless a fish.

title: Kung Fu Panda 2
S: the radish crate Mr Ping found baby Po in

Steamed daikon and rice flour cakes studded with Chinese sausage and shiitake, pan-fried until crisp, with oyster sauce and chilli oil. Grate 800g daikon and simmer in its juice for 10 minutes. Fry 2 diced Chinese sausages, 4 soaked chopped shiitake and 2 spring onions for 3 minutes. Mix into the daikon with 200g rice flour, 200ml water, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar. Press into an oiled 20cm square tin and steam 45 minutes. Cool completely, then slice into squares and fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with oyster sauce and chilli oil.
the bean bun challenge, how many fit at once
Soft steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste, steamed for 12 minutes until puffy and pillowy.
Lord Shen's fireworks over Gongmen City

Prawns dusted in cornflour and fried crisp, tossed with garlic, chilli, spring onion and a five spice salt that crackles like fireworks. Peel 600g green prawns leaving the tails on and pat dry. Toast 1 tsp Sichuan pepper, crush with 2 tsp salt and half a tsp five spice. Toss the prawns in 60g cornflour. Fry in oil at 180C for 1 to 2 minutes until crisp and drain. Pour off most of the oil and fry 3 sliced garlic cloves, 2 sliced red chillies and 2 spring onions for 30 seconds. Toss in the prawns and 2 tsp of the salt.
M: the noodle shop where Po grew up
Fresh egg noodles in a rich chicken broth with bok choy, spring onion, shiitake and a soft egg on top.
Lord Shen and his fireworks cannon

Crisp chicken stir-fried with dried chillies, Sichuan pepper, garlic and roasted peanuts in a sweet, tingly soy and black vinegar glaze, with steamed rice. Cut 700g chicken thigh into 2cm pieces and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp cornflour. Mix 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Chinkiang black vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour and 3 tbsp water. Fry the chicken in a hot wok with oil for 5 minutes until crisp, remove. Fry 15 dried chillies and 1 tsp Sichuan pepper for 30 seconds, then 3 garlic cloves and ginger. Return the chicken with the sauce and 60g roasted peanuts and toss. Serve with rice.
W: for the peaches of the Valley of Peace
Steamed buns shaped like peaches and tinted pink at the tip, filled with sweet lotus or red bean paste.
K: Gongmen City, the city Shen took over

Chinese sour plum drink brewed with smoked plums, hawthorn and osmanthus, sweetened with rock sugar and served icy cold, sweet, sour and smoky. Rinse 6 dried smoked plums (wumei) and 15g dried hawthorn slices and soak in 1.5L water for 30 minutes. Bring to the boil and simmer 40 minutes. Add 80g rock sugar and stir until dissolved, then take off the heat and stir in 1 tsp dried osmanthus. Steep 10 minutes, strain and chill well. Serve over ice with a little extra osmanthus on top.
T: Inner peace, then noodles.
D: Po faces a peacock warlord with a deadly new weapon and finally learns where he came from.
P: Serve the buns when Po tries to fit them all in his mouth.

title: Happy Feet
S: Colony crumbed sardines with lemon mayo
the fish the whole colony depends on

Butterflied sardine fillets crumbed in panko and lemon zest, fried golden and crunchy, with a lemon and herb mayo and wedges for squeezing. Pat 500g butterflied sardine fillets dry. Toss in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 100g panko mixed with the zest of 1 lemon and salt. Shallow fry in 1cm oil over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain. Mix 120g mayo with lemon juice, chopped parsley and dill. Serve hot with the mayo and lemon wedges.
Iceberg lettuce cut into wedges with creamy blue cheese dressing, crispy bacon and chopped tomato.
the blizzard the emperor penguins huddle through

Light choux puffs beaten with cheddar and parmesan, piped into balls and baked until hollow, then dusted snowy white with finely grated parmesan. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it pulls away from the pan, then cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated cheddar and 40g grated parmesan. Pipe 24 small balls onto lined trays. Bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden. While warm, dust heavily with 30g very finely grated parmesan.
M: the fish Mumble brings back to the colony
White fish and prawns in a parsley white sauce, topped with buttery mash and baked until golden.
the giant fishing trawlers taking the colony's fish

A thick creamy chowder of white fish, prawns, potato, corn and bacon with dill, ladled into hollowed crusty cob loaves. Fry 100g diced bacon and 1 diced onion for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml fish stock, 400ml milk and 400g diced potato. Simmer 15 minutes. Add 400g diced white fish, 200g peeled raw prawns and 200g corn kernels and simmer 4 minutes until just cooked. Stir in 100ml cream and chopped dill. Cut the tops off 4 small cob loaves, hollow them out and ladle in the chowder.
W: snow-white and pink, like the Antarctic sky
Desiccated coconut mixed with condensed milk and icing sugar, half tinted pink, pressed in layers and set.
K: Gloria, the best singer in the colony, and the pink krill penguins live on

Strawberries blended with vanilla ice cream and cold milk until thick and pink, topped with whipped cream and a shower of pink sprinkles. Hull 250g strawberries and blend with 750g vanilla ice cream and 400ml cold milk until thick and pink. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and scatter with pink sprinkles and a halved strawberry. Serve straight away with wide straws.
T: Fish for the colony, dancing shoes optional.
D: An emperor penguin who can't sing but can tap dance sets out to find out why the fish are disappearing.
P: Serve the fish when Mumble brings food back for the whole colony.

title: Top End Wedding
S: the Mindil Beach sunset markets in Darwin
Coconut curry laksa broth with chicken, rice noodles, tofu puffs and bean sprouts, served in small cups.
Darwin mango and prawn rice paper rolls

Rice paper rolls packed with cooked prawns, ripe mango, vermicelli, mint and Vietnamese mint, with a sweet, sour and chilli nuoc cham for dunking. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool. Peel and halve 400g cooked prawns. Slice 2 mangoes and 1 cucumber into strips. Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat, add prawns, mango, cucumber, noodles, mint and Vietnamese mint and roll tightly. Make 12. Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water, 1 chopped chilli and 1 garlic clove.
Road trip damper with golden syrup butter
Lauren and Ned's road trip through the Top End to find her mum

Golden crusted damper with a soft, fluffy middle, torn hot and loaded with whipped golden syrup butter and a pinch of sea salt. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour with 1 tsp salt. Stir in 300ml milk to a soft dough, knead lightly and shape into a round on a floured tray. Cut a deep cross on top, dust with flour and bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden and hollow sounding. Beat 125g soft butter with 3 tbsp golden syrup and flaky salt. Tear the damper hot and spread thickly.
M: tracking Lauren's mum down on the Tiwi Islands

Barramundi fillets grilled skin down until crisp, with lime, chilli and a green mango salad. Score 4 barramundi fillets (about 180g each) and season. Grill skin down over high heat for 5 minutes, flip for 2. Toss 1 shredded green mango with mint, 1 sliced chilli, the juice of 2 limes and 1 tbsp fish sauce and pile on top.
Lemon myrtle roast lamb for the wedding
the wedding on the Tiwi Islands

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rubbed with lemon myrtle and pepperberry, roasted pink over potatoes and pumpkin, carved for the whole family with salsa verde. Heat the oven to 200C. Make 12 small cuts in a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves. Rub with 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp ground lemon myrtle, 1 tsp ground pepperberry and salt. Roast on 1kg potatoes and 800g pumpkin in chunks for 1 hour 20 minutes for medium. Rest 20 minutes. Blitz parsley, mint, 1 tbsp capers, 1 anchovy, lemon juice and 100ml olive oil into salsa verde.
W: the wedding they've got ten days to pull off

Crisp pavlova with a soft marshmallow middle, piled with whipped cream, sliced fresh mango and passionfruit pulp. Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Shape a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 2 sliced mangoes and 3 passionfruit.
K: a steaming Darwin afternoon before the wedding

Ripe mango blended with white rum, fresh lime and plenty of ice until slushy, poured into chilled glasses with a lime wheel and chilli salt rim. Freeze the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes in chunks for at least 2 hours. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli flakes, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip. Blend the frozen mango with 160ml white rum, 80ml lime juice, 40ml sugar syrup and 2 cups ice until thick and slushy. Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel. Leave out the rum and add 100ml coconut water for non-drinkers.
T: Ten days to find Mum and get married.
D: A Darwin lawyer and her fiancé have ten days to find her missing mum before their wedding.
P: Serve the pavlova when the wedding finally happens on the Tiwi Islands.

title: Ladies in Black
S: Salami, Hungarian sausage, pickled cucumbers, rye bread and soft cheese, the European spread that wowed 1959 Sydney.
lunch break upstairs at Goodes department store

Soft white bread with egg, mayo and cress, crusts off, cut into neat fingers for the ladies' tea. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Spread over 4 slices white bread, scatter with cress and top with 4 more slices. Trim the crusts and cut into fingers.
Magda introducing Lisa to continental food

Soft cheese whipped with butter, sweet paprika, capers, gherkin, onion and caraway into a bright orange spread, piled on dark rye with radish and chives. Beat 250g cream cheese (or quark) with 80g soft butter until smooth. Mix in 2 tsp sweet paprika, half a tsp caraway seeds, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 finely chopped gherkins, half a very finely diced small onion and 1 tsp Dijon. Season and chill 30 minutes. Spread thickly on 12 slices of dark rye, top with thinly sliced radish and chives and dust with a little more paprika.
M: the Hungarian cooking Fay falls for
Chicken thighs braised with onion, sweet paprika and capsicum, finished with sour cream, over buttered noodles.
Rudi, the Hungarian who wins Fay over

Red capsicums stuffed with beef and pork, rice, onion and smoked paprika, baked in a rich tomato sauce until soft, with sour cream and dill. Heat the oven to 180C. Cut the tops off 4 large red capsicums and seed them. Mix 300g beef mince, 200g pork mince, 150g cooked rice, 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 egg and salt. Pack into the capsicums and replace the lids. Stand in a dish with 700g passata mixed with 250ml stock and 1 tsp sugar. Cover and bake 1 hour, uncover for 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream and dill.
W: Lemon and poppy seed butter cake baked in a loaf tin and glazed with lemon icing. Beat 180g butter with 180g sugar, add 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in 220g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp poppy seeds and 80ml milk. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.
K: Magda's New Year's Eve champagne punch

Cold sparkling wine poured over brandy, peach liqueur, orange and fresh peaches in a big punch bowl, a continental party trick for 1959 Sydney. In a large punch bowl, mix 60ml brandy, 60ml peach liqueur, 250ml fresh orange juice and 2 sliced ripe peaches. Chill 1 hour. Just before serving add a big block of ice and pour in a chilled 750ml bottle of sparkling wine and 250ml soda water. Stir once gently. Ladle into coupes with a slice of peach in each. For non-drinkers, use peach nectar and sparkling apple juice.
T: Sydney, 1959. Continental food comes to the party.
D: A bookish teenager takes a summer job at a Sydney department store and is taken under the wing of its European staff.
P: Serve the mains when Magda welcomes everyone to her New Year's Eve party.

title: Gladiator II
S: Medjool dates stuffed with toasted almonds and pepper, fried in butter, then glazed in hot honey and sea salt, the old Roman way. Toast 24 whole almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes. Slit and pit 24 Medjool dates, push an almond and a grind of black pepper into each and press closed. Melt 30g butter in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the dates 2 minutes, turning, until warm and glossy. Add 3 tbsp honey and let it bubble for 1 minute, turning the dates to coat. Tip onto a plate and sprinkle with flaky salt.
Macrinus's baked feta with figs and honey
Macrinus, the dealer who buys Lucius

A block of feta baked in olive oil with oregano and chilli, topped with roasted figs, thyme and honey, with warm olives and crusty bread. Heat the oven to 200C. Put a 200g block of feta in a small baking dish with 150g mixed olives around it. Halve 4 fresh figs and nestle them in. Drizzle with 3 tbsp olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano, chilli flakes and thyme sprigs. Bake 15 minutes until the feta is soft. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and serve with torn crusty bread.

Thin flatbreads blistered in a hot pan, brushed with garlic and rosemary oil, sprinkled with sea salt and served with labneh for dipping. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 250g Greek yoghurt and half a tsp salt into a dough and rest 10 minutes. Warm 4 tbsp olive oil with 2 sliced garlic cloves and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary for 3 minutes. Divide the dough into 8, roll thin and cook in a hot dry pan 1 to 2 minutes a side until charred in spots. Brush with the rosemary oil and sprinkle with flaky salt. Serve with 250g labneh drizzled with oil.
M: Whole chicken roasted with honey, garlic, thyme and lemon until sticky and golden, with roast vegetables.
Numidian lamb, apricot and chickpea stew

Lamb shoulder braised with chickpeas, tomato, cumin, cinnamon and dried apricots, spooned over fluffy couscous with harissa yoghurt and mint. Brown 1kg diced lamb shoulder in batches in oil. Fry 2 onions for 5 minutes, add 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp paprika. Add 400g tinned tomatoes, 500ml stock and the lamb, cover and simmer 1.5 hours. Add 400g drained chickpeas and 120g dried apricots and cook 30 minutes. Pour 300ml boiling stock over 300g couscous, cover 5 minutes. Swirl 1 tbsp harissa through 200g yoghurt. Serve with mint.
W: Ricotta mixed with honey, egg and lemon zest, baked until set and drizzled with more honey.
K: the twin emperors Geta and Caracalla at their banquet

Red wine warmed gently with honey, black pepper, cinnamon, bay and orange peel, the spiced wine of ancient Rome, served warm in heavy cups. Pour a 750ml bottle of red wine into a saucepan with 4 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick, 6 black peppercorns, 2 bay leaves and 3 strips of orange peel. Warm gently over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring until the honey dissolves. Do not let it boil. Strain into 4 heavy cups. For non-drinkers, make it the same way with red grape juice and less honey.
T: Bread, circuses and a proper Roman feast.
D: Years after Maximus, Lucius is captured in North Africa and forced to fight in the Colosseum.
P: Serve the mains when the emperors throw their banquet.

title: Wicked: For Good
S: the Emerald City, green from top to bottom
Pistachios blitzed with butter, sugar and flour into crumbly shortbread rounds, tinted green and dusted with sugar.

Light choux puffs baked hollow and crisp, filled with pink strawberry whipped cream and dusted with icing sugar and edible glitter like floating bubbles. Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it pulls away from the pan and cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time. Pipe 24 rounds onto lined trays and bake 25 minutes, then pierce each and dry in the turned-off oven for 10 minutes. Blitz 150g strawberries with 2 tbsp icing sugar, fold into 300ml whipped cream and pipe into the cooled puffs. Dust with icing sugar.
Small shortcrust cases filled with a gruyère, chive and cream custard, baked until puffed and golden on top.
M: Whole chicken roasted with butter, lemon and tarragon under the skin, with green beans, peas and creamy potatoes.
Kiamo Ko spiced lamb with green couscous
Kiamo Ko, Elphaba's castle out in Winkie Country

Lamb shoulder rubbed with smoked paprika and cumin, slow roasted until it pulls apart, over a bright green herb couscous with pomegranate and minted yoghurt. Heat the oven to 160C. Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp cumin, 3 crushed garlic cloves and salt. Put in a tin with 250ml water, cover tightly with foil and roast 4 hours until it pulls apart. Pour 300ml boiling stock over 300g couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff. Blitz parsley, coriander and mint with lemon juice and 4 tbsp oil and stir through until green. Top with pomegranate seeds and mint yoghurt.
W: the shoes Elphaba enchants for her sister

Sweet pastry tarts filled with cold vanilla custard and topped with raspberries glazed bright ruby red. Bake 8 small tart cases cut from 2 sheets sweet shortcrust at 180C for 12 minutes. Make custard from 3 tbsp custard powder, 2 tbsp sugar and 500ml milk, cool and fill the cases. Top with 250g raspberries brushed with warm raspberry jam.
K: Glinda floating in on her bubble

Fresh mint and lime muddled with sugar, topped with soda water over ice. Muddle a handful of mint leaves with the juice of 3 limes and 3 tbsp sugar in a jug. Add ice and top with 1L soda water, stir and pour into 4 glasses with a mint sprig each.
T: Pink and green, for good.
D: Elphaba and Glinda face the fallout of their choices as the Emerald City turns against the Wicked Witch.
P: Serve the banquet when the Emerald City celebrates Glinda's engagement.

title: Jerry Maguire
S: Laurel's caramelised onion dip with chips
the divorced women's group in Laurel's living room

Onions cooked down slowly until jammy and dark, folded into sour cream and cream cheese with chives, served with salted kettle chips and celery. Slowly cook 3 thinly sliced onions in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until deep brown. Add 1 tsp balsamic and cool. Chop roughly and mix with 250g sour cream, 100g soft cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp chives, salt and pepper. Chill 1 hour. Serve with 200g salted kettle chips and celery sticks.
Show me the money street corn
Rod's phone call, at full volume

Grilled corn cobs brushed with mayo, rolled in crumbly cheese and chilli, with a squeeze of lime. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Brush each with mayonnaise (4 tbsp total), roll in 80g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder. Squeeze over lime to serve.
Monday night chorizo pigs in blankets
Rod's big Monday Night Football game

Mini chorizo wrapped in flaky puff pastry with a smear of chipotle mayo, baked golden and served with a honey mustard for dunking. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 thawed puff pastry sheets into 3cm by 8cm strips. Mix 2 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo and spread a little on each strip. Cut 4 chorizo into 6 pieces each and roll each piece in a strip, seam side down. Brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon with 2 tbsp honey for dipping.
M: Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and orange, grilled hot and sliced, with tortillas, salsa and beans.
a family dinner with plenty of kwan

Shredded chicken rolled in corn tortillas, smothered in a smoky chilli and dark chocolate mole sauce and cheese, baked bubbling, with pickled onion and crema. Soak 3 dried ancho chillies in boiling water 15 minutes. Blend with 400g tinned tomatoes, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon, 30g dark chocolate and 300ml stock, then simmer 15 minutes. Mix 600g shredded roast chicken with a third of the sauce. Fill and roll 8 corn tortillas, lay in a dish, cover with the rest of the sauce and 150g grated cheese. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Top with pickled red onion, sour cream and coriander.
W: Had me at hello wedding cupcakes
Dorothy's answer to Jerry's big speech

Light vanilla cupcakes topped with swirls of white buttercream and a sugared flower, stacked up like a small wedding cake. Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 150g self-raising flour and 60ml milk. Bake in 12 cases at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 125g butter with 250g icing sugar and pipe on top.
K: Tequila shaken with prickly pear purée, fresh lime and agave until bright magenta, poured over ice in glasses rimmed with chilli salt. Peel 6 prickly pears (or use 200ml prickly pear purée), blend and strain out the seeds. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli powder, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip. For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 50ml purée, 30ml lime juice and 15ml agave syrup hard with ice. Strain over fresh ice. For non-drinkers, skip the tequila and top with soda water.
T: Help me help you to seconds.
D: A sports agent loses everything after writing a mission statement and starts again with one client and one loyal colleague.
P: Serve the mains when Rod finally gets his big night on Monday Night Football.

title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
S: Champ's fried chicken shop, which is not really chicken
Sticky fried chicken wings tossed in a sweet and spicy glaze, which Champ swears are chicken this time.
Ron's lighthouse and his pet shark Doby
Crumbed white fish bites fried golden, with lemon and a quick tartare, from Ron's lighthouse days.
M: the 24-hour news desk in New York
New York strip steaks seared hard in a cast-iron pan with garlic butter, sliced and served with fries and creamed spinach.
W: Dark chocolate melted with cream for dipping strawberries, marshmallows and chunks of sponge, very seventies, very Ron.
K: Ron Burgundy's drink of choice, still

Blended Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and aromatic bitters until icy, strained into a chilled coupe with a brandied cherry. Stays classy. Chill 4 coupes in the freezer. For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add 60ml blended Scotch, 25ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the chilled coupe and drop in a brandied or maraschino cherry. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and discard it.
T: Yes, the news is now open 24 hours. So is the kitchen.
D: Ron Burgundy and his old news team land jobs at the first 24-hour news channel in New York.
P: Serve the snacks when the news team gets back together.

title: Blades of Glory
S: Warm soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, with mustard and a cheese dip for the stands.
Chilli garlic prawns, hot off the grill, served on a bed of crushed ice with lime for the cold side.
M: the big night at the championships
Crumbed chicken breast topped with tomato sauce, ham and melted cheese, with chips and salad, a proper competition dinner.
W: the Iron Lotus, the move nobody survives
Coconut-coated vanilla ice cream balls rolled through white chocolate, frozen hard and served like little snowballs.
K: thawing out after practice on the ice

Thick hot chocolate made with dark chocolate and milk, a hint of peppermint, topped with whipped cream and crushed candy canes. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth and thick, about 4 minutes without boiling. Stir in half a tsp peppermint essence. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour the chocolate into 4 mugs, top with the cream and scatter with 2 crushed candy canes.
T: Two men, one pair of skates, plenty of snacks.
D: Two rival figure skaters banned from singles competition team up as the first all-male pairs team.
P: Serve the snacks when Chazz and Jimmy first take the ice together.

title: Semi-Pro
S: Flint, Michigan, home of the Tropics
Hot dogs in soft buns topped with a dry, finely ground spiced beef coney sauce, mustard and diced onion, the Flint way.
the Flint Tropics and their very tropical uniforms

King prawns crumbed in coconut and panko, fried until crunchy, with a sticky mango, lime and chilli dipping sauce. Peel 600g green king prawns, leaving tails on. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 60g desiccated coconut mixed with 60g panko. Fry in oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and drain. Simmer the flesh of 1 mango with 3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, the juice of 1 lime and 1 chopped red chilli for 3 minutes, then blitz smooth. Serve the prawns hot with the sauce.
M: the owner, coach and power forward
Sticky barbecue pork ribs basted until glossy, with buttered corn and coleslaw, a big seventies cookout plate.
W: Light orange butter sponge layered with whipped vanilla mascarpone cream, finished with orange glaze and zest, the colour of a Tropics jersey. Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 200g butter and 200g caster sugar, add 4 eggs one at a time and the zest of 2 oranges, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 60ml orange juice. Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake 25 minutes. Cool. Whip 250g mascarpone, 200ml cream, 2 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla. Sandwich and top the cakes with the cream and drizzle over 100g icing sugar mixed with 2 tbsp orange juice.
K: Hot espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and brown sugar syrup into a thick crema, strained into chilled coupes with an orange twist. Chill 4 coupes. Pull 4 shots of espresso and cool 5 minutes. For each drink, shake 45ml vodka, 30ml coffee liqueur, 30ml espresso and 10ml brown sugar syrup with lots of ice for 15 seconds until foamy. Strain into the glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top. For non-drinkers, shake the espresso with syrup, milk and ice instead.
T: Everybody love everybody. Everybody eat everything.
D: Jackie Moon owns, coaches and plays for the Flint Tropics, a 1976 basketball team fighting to survive the merger.
P: Serve the snacks at the Tropics' tip-off.

title: The Other Guys
S: Desk pop smoked salmon bagel bites
the paperwork desk where Allen is happiest

Toasted mini bagels spread with whipped caper and dill cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, pickled red onion and a crack of pepper. Slice 1 red onion thin and cover with 80ml white vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Beat 200g cream cheese with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped dill and lemon zest. Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread each half with the cream cheese, fold on smoked salmon (200g total), top with drained pickled onion and dill and grind over pepper.
Terry wants to be a peacock, so let him fly
Crisp spiced onion and spinach fritters in a chickpea batter, with mint yoghurt, as colourful as a peacock.
M: Lion versus tuna sesame tuna bowls
Allen's theory on who wins, a lion or a tuna

Sesame-crusted tuna seared rare and sliced over sushi rice with avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger, finished with a soy and wasabi dressing. Cook 2 cups sushi rice and season with 3 tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tbsp sugar. Coat 4 tuna steaks (600g) in 60g mixed sesame seeds. Sear in a very hot oiled pan 45 seconds a side and slice. Whisk 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil and half a tsp wasabi. Boil 200g frozen edamame 3 minutes. Build bowls with rice, tuna, sliced avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and spoon over the dressing.
W: Dense fudgy brownies cut into neat squares, the stash a by-the-book accountant cop keeps in his drawer.
K: Gator, the alter ego Allen would rather forget

Bourbon shaken hard with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white into a silky foam, served over ice with a cherry and a few drops of bitters. For each drink, put 50ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 20ml sugar syrup and half an egg white (2 egg whites total) in a shaker. Shake without ice for 10 seconds to build the foam, then add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds more. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass. Add 3 drops of aromatic bitters on the foam and a cherry. For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for cold black tea.
T: The desk cops get the case. And the takeaway.
D: Two mismatched New York desk detectives finally get a real case and try to prove they are more than paperwork.
P: Serve the snacks when Allen and Terry leave the desk for the street.

title: Kicking & Screaming
S: the oranges every kids' team eats at halftime

Crispy chicken bites tossed in a sticky fresh orange, soy and ginger glaze, finished with sesame, spring onion and plenty of orange zest. Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces, toss with 1 tbsp soy, then in 60g cornflour. Fry in batches in oil at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp. Simmer the juice of 3 oranges with the zest of 1, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove for 5 minutes, then thicken with 1 tsp cornflour in water. Toss the chicken through and top with sesame and spring onion.
Phil's vitamin shop, health first, until the coffee

Chewy oat bars packed with almonds, pepitas, cranberries and dark chocolate, bound with honey and peanut butter and cut into thick bars. Heat the oven to 170C. Toast 250g rolled oats, 80g chopped almonds and 50g pepitas on a tray for 10 minutes. Warm 120g honey, 100g peanut butter, 50g butter and 50g brown sugar until smooth. Stir into the oats with 80g dried cranberries and a pinch of salt. Press firmly into a lined 20 x 30cm tin and bake 20 minutes. Cool, scatter with 80g melted dark chocolate and cut into 12 bars once set.
M: the two Italian kids Phil recruits from the butcher shop

Grilled fennel Italian sausages in toasted rolls with charred capsicum and onion, melted provolone and a spoon of hot giardiniera. Slice 2 red capsicums and 2 onions and cook in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 12 minutes until soft and charred. Grill 8 Italian fennel sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through. Split 8 long rolls, toast, and lay a slice of provolone in each. Add a sausage, the capsicum and onion and a spoon of chopped hot giardiniera or pickled chillies.
W: the coffee shop where it all starts
Crunchy almond biscotti twice-baked for dunking, the perfect thing to have with far too much coffee.
K: Phil discovers coffee and never looks back

Four shots of espresso whisked with dark chocolate and steamed milk, topped with whipped cream, chocolate shavings and a few chocolate-coated coffee beans. Melt 80g chopped dark chocolate with 2 tbsp sugar in a saucepan with 100ml milk, whisking until smooth. Add 700ml more milk and heat until steaming, whisking until frothy. Pull 8 shots of espresso. Pour 2 shots into each of 4 big mugs and top with the chocolate milk. Whip 100ml cream and spoon on, then add chocolate shavings and 3 chocolate-coated coffee beans each. Decaf is allowed.
T: Coffee for the coach. Orange slices for the team.
D: A mild vitamin salesman coaches his son's under-10 soccer team and gets badly hooked on coffee along the way.
P: Serve the coffee when Phil takes his first sip and the season turns.

title: A Night at the Roxbury
S: Little beef sliders with cheese and pickles on soft buns, the kind of thing you eat standing up in a club.
A real garden of crisp raw vegetables standing up in a jar, with a green herb dip, nothing fake about it.
M: Chipotle and lime chicken thighs chargrilled and sliced into soft tortillas with smashed avocado, pickled red onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime. Mix 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp oil. Marinate 800g chicken thigh fillets for 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes. Grill the chicken on a hot barbecue for 5 minutes a side and slice. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Warm 12 small tortillas and fill with avocado, chicken, onion and coriander.
W: the neon of the Roxbury dance floor

Buttery biscuit crumb under a whipped no-bake cream cheese filling swirled with raspberry, topped with fresh raspberries and white chocolate shavings. Crush 150g plain sweet biscuits and mix with 60g melted butter. Press into 6 glasses. Blitz 150g raspberries with 2 tbsp icing sugar and strain. Beat 250g cream cheese with 80g icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 200ml whipped cream. Fold half the raspberry sauce through to turn it pink. Spoon into the glasses, swirl the rest of the sauce on top and chill 2 hours. Finish with raspberries and grated white chocolate.
K: Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime shaken and served up, pink and very nineties. Cranberry soda for the kids.
T: Head bobbing optional. Snacks mandatory.
D: Two brothers who work in their dad's fake plant shop try every night to get into the hottest club in LA.
P: Serve the snacks when the Butabi brothers finally make it past the door.

title: Stranger than Fiction
S: Harold's life run to the second
Ham and cheese toasties cooked for exactly three minutes a side and cut into precise triangles.
Harold turning up at Ana's bakery with a box of flours

Crisp-edged, chewy butter cookies made with plain, spelt and rye flour and browned butter, rolled in demerara sugar and finished with flaky salt. Brown 150g butter until nutty and cool 10 minutes. Whisk with 100g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 100g plain flour, 60g spelt flour, 40g rye flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Chill 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 180C. Roll into 16 balls, roll in demerara sugar and bake 11 to 12 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm.
M: a night in after another audit
Chicken and leek pot pie under puff pastry, the kind of dinner a careful man counts the bites of.
W: Ana's warm skillet cookie with ice cream
the warm cookies Ana bakes for Harold, little did he know

A giant chocolate chip cookie baked in a cast-iron pan until golden at the edges and gooey in the middle, topped with vanilla ice cream and hot fudge. Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 125g soft butter with 100g brown sugar and 50g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 180g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chopped dark chocolate. Press into a buttered 23cm ovenproof frying pan and bake 18 to 20 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, top with 4 scoops of vanilla ice cream and drizzle with hot fudge sauce.
K: a cold glass of milk to go with Ana's cookies

Ice-cold full cream milk whisked with malted milk powder, vanilla bean and a little honey until frothy, poured into tall frosted glasses. Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Scrape the seeds from half a vanilla bean into a jug. Add 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 1 tbsp honey and 100ml milk and whisk into a smooth paste. Add 900ml very cold full cream milk and whisk hard, or blend for 20 seconds, until frothy. Pour into the frosted glasses and dust with a little more malt.
T: Little did he know, there would be cookies.
D: A tax auditor starts hearing a voice narrating his life and learns he is about to die.
P: Serve the sweets when Ana brings Harold the cookies.

title: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga
S: Icelandic-style hot dogs with crispy fried onions, raw onion, sweet mustard and remoulade in soft buns.
Smoked trout on rye crispbread with crème fraîche, dill and pickled cucumber, a fishing village plate.
M: Lars's dad Erick at the family table in Húsavík

Lamb shoulder slow roasted with thyme and garlic until it falls apart, with Icelandic sugar-glazed baby potatoes, buttered peas and a red wine gravy. Heat the oven to 160C. Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, thyme and 4 crushed garlic cloves and roast covered for 3 hours, uncovering for the last 30 minutes. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender and peel. Melt 80g sugar in a pan until golden, add 40g butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml stock. Serve with buttered peas.
W: the little elf houses Sigrit leaves gifts at

Tangy skyr whipped with cream cheese and honey over a crunchy oat and butter crumble, topped with a warm blueberry and crowberry-style compote. Mix 80g rolled oats, 60g plain flour, 50g brown sugar and 60g melted butter, spread on a tray and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden. Cool and crumble. Beat 400g skyr or thick Greek yoghurt with 150g cream cheese and 3 tbsp honey until smooth. Simmer 250g blueberries with 2 tbsp sugar and lemon juice for 5 minutes. Layer crumble, skyr and compote in 4 glasses and chill 1 hour.
K: Sparkling wine topped up with elderflower and soda, for when everyone joins in the sing-along.
T: Play the hit song. Then dinner.
D: Two small-town Icelandic musicians get the chance of a lifetime to represent their country at Eurovision.
P: Serve the snacks when Fire Saga takes the stage in Edinburgh.

title: Daddy's Home
S: Brad doing everything by the stepdad book

Rice paper rolls packed with carrot, capsicum, cucumber, avocado, vermicelli and mint, with a peanut and hoisin dipping sauce. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool. Cut 1 carrot, 1 red capsicum and 1 cucumber into thin strips and slice 1 avocado. Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat and add the vegetables, noodles and mint, then roll up tightly. Make 12. Whisk 3 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp lime juice and 3 tbsp warm water for dipping.
Loaded corn chips with beef, cheese, salsa and sour cream, the cool dad's party move.
M: Brad and Dusty fighting over the grill

Double smashed beef patties with melted cheese, caramelised onion, pickles and a tangy burger sauce in toasted potato buns. Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. On a very hot barbecue plate, smash each flat, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 potato buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties each with onion and pickles.
W: the father-daughter dance Brad and Dusty both want

Fluffy vanilla cupcakes with a raspberry jam centre, piped high with pink buttercream and finished with sprinkles and a tiny bow. Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Divide between 12 paper cases and bake 18 minutes. Cool. Cut a small cone from the top of each, fill with raspberry jam (120g total) and replace. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and pink colouring and pipe on top. Finish with sprinkles.
K: Fresh lemon juice shaken with strawberry and basil syrup, topped with chilled soda over ice, with sliced strawberries and a basil leaf. Simmer 100g caster sugar, 100ml water and 150g sliced strawberries for 5 minutes. Take off the heat, add a handful of basil and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill. Squeeze 5 lemons for about 200ml juice. Fill a jug with ice, add the syrup, lemon juice and 800ml cold soda water and stir. Pour into glasses with sliced strawberries and a basil leaf.
T: Two dads. One barbecue.
D: A mild radio exec tries to win over his stepkids when their cool, motorbike-riding real dad comes home.
P: Serve the mains when Brad and Dusty go head to head.

title: Get Hard
S: Crispy hot wings from the corner, tossed in a buttery hot sauce with ranch on the side.

Warm blinis with chive crème fraîche, smoked salmon ribbons and glossy salmon roe, a squeeze of lemon and dill, the millionaire's party snack. Warm 16 small blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with 1 tbsp chopped chives and lemon zest. Top each blini with a spoon of the cream, a ribbon of smoked salmon (150g total) and half a teaspoon of salmon roe (50g total). Finish with a tiny dill sprig and a squeeze of lemon and arrange on a platter.
M: Barbecue chicken thighs with mac and cheese and greens, the family dinner James gets invited to.
W: James getting ready for his stretch in San Quentin

Silky dark chocolate pudding set in cups under salted cookie crumb, whipped cream and chocolate curls, canteen dessert done properly. Whisk 600ml milk, 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 3 tbsp cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan over medium heat until it thickens, about 6 minutes. Off the heat, stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Pour into 4 cups, cover the surface and chill 2 hours. Top with whipped cream (150ml), crushed chocolate biscuits (60g) with a pinch of flaky salt and chocolate curls.
K: James King's millionaire mornings by the pool

Fresh cucumber juice shaken with tequila, lime, agave and a slice of jalapeño, poured over ice in a salt-rimmed glass with cucumber ribbons. Blitz 1 continental cucumber with 50ml water and strain. Rim 4 glasses with lime and salt. For each drink, muddle 2 slices of jalapeño in a shaker, add 45ml tequila, 45ml cucumber juice, 25ml lime juice and 15ml agave, shake with ice and strain over fresh ice. Garnish with a cucumber ribbon. For non-drinkers, top the cucumber, lime and agave with soda instead.
T: Prison training starts at dinner.
D: A millionaire facing prison hires the man who washes his car to toughen him up before he goes inside.
P: Serve the mains when Darnell starts the training.

title: Friendship
S: Craig's first night hanging out with Austin

Thick slices of haloumi seared golden and squeaky, drizzled with chilli hot honey and lemon, scattered with mint and toasted sesame. Slice 2 blocks of haloumi (500g) 1cm thick and pat dry. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for 2 minutes. Heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat with 1 tbsp oil and sear the haloumi 1 to 2 minutes a side until deep golden. Arrange on a platter, drizzle with the hot honey and a squeeze of lemon, and scatter with torn mint and toasted sesame seeds.
From-scratch French onion dip and chips
hanging out back at Austin's place

Onions cooked down until deep golden, folded through sour cream with garlic, chives and a splash of Worcestershire, served with thick-cut salted chips. Slowly cook 2 thinly sliced onions in 30g butter for 25 minutes until deep golden. Cool and chop. Mix with 300g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, half a tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper. Chill 1 hour so the flavours settle. Serve with 200g thick-cut salted potato chips.
M: the dinner party Craig plans to win Austin back

Thick rump steak chargrilled and sliced, with a sharp parsley and chilli chimichurri, crispy smashed potatoes and a green salad. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Chop a bunch of parsley, 2 garlic cloves and 1 red chilli and mix with 100ml olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and dried oregano. Season 1kg rump steak and grill on a very hot barbecue 4 minutes a side for medium rare. Rest 8 minutes, slice and spoon the chimichurri over. Serve with the potatoes and a dressed green salad.
W: Big puffy meringue clouds with crisp shells and marshmallow centres, piled with whipped cream, passionfruit and berries, with a lemon curd drizzle. Heat the oven to 120C. Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp white vinegar. Spoon 8 tall cloud shapes onto lined trays and bake 50 minutes, then cool in the turned-off oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 150g berries, the pulp of 2 passionfruit and a drizzle of lemon curd.
K: trying to keep up with the cool neighbour

Hoppy pale ale topped with fresh pink grapefruit soda and a squeeze of lime, poured into frosty glasses with a grapefruit wedge. Chill 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Mix the juice of 1 pink grapefruit with 1 tbsp sugar syrup and 400ml cold soda water. Pour 200ml cold pale ale into each glass, then top with the grapefruit soda. Add a squeeze of lime and a grapefruit wedge. For non-drinkers, use ginger beer in place of the ale.
T: New mates, same snacks.
D: A lonely suburban dad becomes obsessed with his cool new neighbour after one great night out.
P: Serve the snacks when Craig and Austin first hang out.

title: BASEketball
S: Squeaky cheese curds (or bocconcini) in a light beer batter, fried until puffed and golden, with a garlicky buttermilk ranch for dipping. Pat 400g cheese curds or halved cherry bocconcini dry and freeze 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, half a tsp garlic powder, 1 egg and 200ml cold lager into a smooth batter. Dust the cheese in flour, dip in batter and fry in batches at 185C for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. For ranch, mix 100g sour cream, 60ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayo, chives, dill and garlic.
Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese
the psych-out at the free throw line

Chewy pretzel bites dipped in a bicarb bath, salted and baked deep brown, with a hot cheddar and lager cheese sauce for dunking. Heat the oven to 220C. Roll 500g pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Simmer 2L water with 60g bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds. Drain, place on lined trays, brush with egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 150ml milk and 100ml lager, then 200g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard until smooth.
M: the Milwaukee Beers, Coop and Remer's team

Bratwurst simmered in lager with onions, then charred on the grill and stuffed into toasted rolls with the beer onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard. Put 8 bratwurst in a wide pan with 2 sliced onions, 2 x 375ml cans of lager and 20g butter. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Lift out the sausages and grill on a hot barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes until charred. Boil the onions in the beer until most of it evaporates and they're sticky. Toast 8 long rolls and fill with a bratwurst, onions, warmed sauerkraut (300g) and hot mustard.
W: the driveway game where BASEketball was born

Vanilla ice cream under homemade hot fudge sauce, salted peanuts, whipped cream and a cherry, with crushed pretzels for a salty crunch. Heat 150ml cream, 100g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp golden syrup and 20g butter in a saucepan, stirring until smooth and glossy, about 3 minutes. Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over the warm fudge sauce. Top each with salted peanuts (60g total), crushed pretzels (40g total), a swirl of whipped cream (150ml) and a maraschino cherry.
K: the Denslow Cup, the trophy the Beers are chasing

Brandy muddled with orange, sugar, bitters and a cherry the Wisconsin way, topped with lemon-lime soda over ice. In each of 4 rocks glasses, muddle 1 orange slice, 1 maraschino cherry, 1 tsp sugar and 3 dashes of aromatic bitters until the sugar dissolves. Fill with ice, add 50ml brandy and top with 60ml lemon-lime soda. Stir gently and garnish with another cherry and an orange slice. For non-drinkers, swap the brandy for cold black tea.
T: Psych! Dinner's ready.
D: Two slackers invent a backyard game that becomes a pro league, then fight to keep it pure.
P: Serve the snacks when the Milwaukee Beers take the court.

title: Super Troopers
S: the troopers' patch of Vermont highway

Sourdough toasties of sharp aged cheddar and thin crisp apple, brushed with maple butter and grilled until golden, with a sharp wholegrain mustard. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 tbsp maple syrup. Core 2 crisp apples and slice very thin. Fill 8 slices of sourdough with 250g sliced aged cheddar and the apple, spreading a little wholegrain mustard inside. Brush the outsides with the maple butter. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut into triangles.
the troopers calling shenanigans on the highway

Crunchy oven fries smothered in hot cheddar sauce, crispy bacon, pickled jalapeños and spring onion, with sour cream on the side. Bake 1kg frozen thick-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in 150g grated cheddar until smooth. Pile the fries on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and top with bacon, sliced pickled jalapeños and spring onion. Serve with 150g sour cream.
M: Farva's run-in at the fast food counter

Two smashed beef patties with cheddar and crispy bacon in a toasted bun with burger sauce, pickles and onion, served with a stack of napkins. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls and smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top each with cheddar and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Toast 4 burger buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties, bacon, pickles and diced onion in each.
W: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked with crispy bacon and whipped butter, drowned in warm maple syrup for pouring, not chugging. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 40g melted butter into a thick batter. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Cook ladles of batter in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden and risen. Beat 80g soft butter until fluffy. Stack 3 pancakes per plate with bacon and a spoon of butter, and pour over warm maple syrup (200ml total).
K: Farva and his litre of cola

A homemade cola syrup of citrus, cinnamon, vanilla and caramelised sugar, topped with soda water and served by the litre jug over ice with lime. Put the zest of 1 orange, 1 lime and 1 lemon in a saucepan with 1 cinnamon stick, half a tsp coriander seeds, 1 star anise and 250ml water. Simmer 10 minutes. Melt 200g sugar until dark amber, carefully pour in the spiced water and stir until smooth. Add 1 tsp vanilla and the juice of the lime. Strain and cool. Mix 150ml syrup with 850ml soda water in a 1 litre jug full of ice.
T: Meow. Pass the syrup.
D: Five prank-loving Vermont state troopers try to save their station from budget cuts and the local police.
P: Serve the sweets when the maple syrup chugging starts.

title: Beerfest
S: Wolfhouse giant pretzels with mustard butter
Jan and Todd's trip to Oktoberfest in Munich

Huge chewy pretzels with a deep brown crust and coarse salt, served warm with whipped mustard butter and pickled radish. Heat the oven to 220C. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and roll into 80cm ropes. Twist into pretzel shapes. Simmer 3L water with 90g bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Lay on lined trays, brush with egg, scatter with rock salt and bake 15 to 18 minutes until deep brown. Beat 125g soft butter with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard and 1 tsp honey. Serve with sliced radishes tossed in vinegar and salt.

Ripe camembert mashed with butter, cream cheese, sweet paprika, caraway and a splash of lager, spread thick on rye with red onion rings and chives. Mash 250g ripe camembert with a fork until mostly smooth. Beat in 60g soft butter, 100g cream cheese, 2 tsp sweet paprika, half a tsp caraway seeds, half a very finely diced red onion and 2 tbsp lager. Season with salt and pepper and chill 30 minutes. Spread on 12 slices of dark rye and top with thin red onion rings, chives and a dusting of paprika.
M: Great Gam Gam and the Wolfhouse family secret

Pork steaks pounded thin, crumbed and fried until golden and puffed, with warm bacon potato salad, lemon and a dollop of lingonberry or cranberry jam. Boil 1kg waxy potatoes 20 minutes and slice. Fry 100g diced bacon, add 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp mustard, 100ml stock and 2 tbsp oil and toss through the warm potatoes with chives. Pound 4 pork steaks to 5mm. Coat in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g breadcrumbs. Fry in 50g butter and 4 tbsp oil for 3 minutes a side, shaking the pan so the crumb puffs. Serve with lemon and cranberry jam.
W: Flaky pastry rolled around spiced apple and sultanas, dusted with icing sugar and served with cream.
K: Das Boot, the glass boot of the final round

Crisp German lager topped half and half with homemade lemon soda, poured into big steins or a glass boot if you have one. Make lemon syrup by simmering 100g sugar, 100ml water and the zest of 2 lemons for 3 minutes, then add the juice of 3 lemons and chill. Mix the syrup with 600ml cold soda water. Pour 250ml cold German lager into each of 4 steins and top with 200ml of the lemon soda. Add a lemon wheel. For non-drinkers, serve the lemon soda on its own over ice.
T: Prost to dinner.
D: Two American brothers discover a secret beer games tournament at Oktoberfest and train a team to win it.
P: Serve the mains when the team enters the Beerfest tent.

title: Hot Rod
S: Cool beans loaded black bean dip
cool beans, Rod's favourite thing to say

Warm smoky black beans mashed with cumin and lime, baked under melted cheddar, then topped with salsa, sour cream, jalapeño and coriander, with corn chips. Fry 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil for 5 minutes, add 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika, then 2 drained 400g tins black beans and 100ml water. Simmer 5 minutes and mash roughly with lime juice and salt. Spread in a baking dish, cover with 150g grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Top with 150g salsa, 100g sour cream, sliced jalapeño and coriander. Serve with 250g corn chips.
Rod's stunt crew out at the jump ramp

Grilled franks in toasted buns smothered in beefy chilli, melted cheddar, diced onion and mustard, eaten fast between stunts. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 200ml passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts until blistered. Toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over the chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 1 minute to melt, then finish with diced white onion and yellow mustard.
M: Rod's jump over the public pool

Juicy beef patties with melted American cheese, dill pickles, shredded lettuce and a pickle-flecked burger sauce in toasted sesame buns. Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns and season well. Grill on a hot barbecue 4 minutes a side, adding 2 slices of American cheese each for the last minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 2 tbsp chopped dill pickles. Toast 4 sesame buns, spread with sauce, add shredded lettuce, the patty and sliced pickles.
W: Fifteen bus jump choc chip cookies
the fifteen bus jump Rod builds up to

Fifteen chewy brown sugar cookies loaded with dark chocolate chunks and a sprinkle of sea salt, lined up in a row like buses waiting for the jump. Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar and 50g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 200g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chopped dark chocolate. Roll into 15 balls and bake on lined trays for 10 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle. Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool on the trays. Line up in a row to serve.
