K: Rod and the crew between stunt practice runs

Homemade sour cherry syrup and fresh lime topped with soda water over crushed ice, with a cherry and a lime wedge, sweet, sharp and fizzy. Simmer 250g pitted frozen cherries with 100g sugar and 100ml water for 10 minutes, mashing them. Strain and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 50ml cherry syrup and 20ml lime juice to each and top with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and garnish with a cherry and a lime wedge.
T: Cool beans.
D: An amateur stuntman tries to jump fifteen buses to raise money for his stepdad's heart operation.
P: Serve the snacks when Rod lines up the big jump.

title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
S: the farm in Springberry, Alabama, where Dewey grew up

Raw peanuts in the shell boiled for hours in a salty, spicy Cajun brine with chilli and garlic until soft, served warm in paper cones. Rinse 500g raw peanuts in the shell. Put in a large pot with 3L water, 80g salt, 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tbsp chilli flakes and 1 halved head of garlic. Weigh down with a plate so they stay under. Simmer 3 hours, topping up with water, until the nuts are soft like cooked beans. Leave in the brine 30 minutes more, then drain and serve warm in paper cones.
Pa Cox's favourite thing to say

Crisp shoestring fries smothered in melted cheddar sauce and spring onion, a diner basket from Dewey's early days on the road. Bake 1kg frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 250ml milk until thick, then 150g grated cheddar. Pour over the fries and scatter with sliced spring onion.
M: Mama Cox's kitchen back in Springberry

Chicken pieces soaked in hot sauce buttermilk, fried crackling crisp, with creamy mashed potatoes and peppery cream gravy. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces overnight in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt. Dredge in 250g plain flour mixed with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp pepper. Fry at 160C for 12 to 15 minutes until 75C inside. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. For gravy, whisk 2 tbsp frying oil with 2 tbsp flour, then 400ml milk, simmer until thick and season with lots of pepper.
W: Mama Cox's sweet potato meringue pie
Mama Cox's kitchen, before the music took over

Silky spiced sweet potato custard in a crisp pastry case, piled with a cloud of torched meringue and served with a spoon of cream. Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23cm tart tin with 1 shortcrust sheet and blind bake 15 minutes. Mash 500g cooked sweet potato with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs plus 2 yolks, 200ml evaporated milk, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp nutmeg until smooth. Pour into the case and bake 40 minutes until just set. Cool. Whisk 2 egg whites with 100g caster sugar until glossy, pile on top and torch or grill until golden.
K: Dewey Cox Show peach sweet tea

Strong black tea brewed with ripe peach and brown sugar syrup, cooled and poured over plenty of ice with fresh peach slices, lemon and mint. Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 100g brown sugar and 100ml water for 10 minutes, then strain. Steep 5 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in the peach syrup. Chill 2 hours. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add fresh peach slices and a lemon wedge, pour in the tea and top with mint.
T: Walk hard. Eat big.
D: A rock star's whole wild life story, from a farm in Alabama to the top of the charts and back.
P: Serve the mains when Dewey makes it big.

title: Wet Hot American Summer
S: Gene the camp cook and his talking can of vegetables

Corn, peas, carrot and spring onion in a crisp chickpea flour batter with cumin and chilli, fried golden, with a lime and coriander yoghurt. Mix 150g besan (chickpea flour), 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp salt and about 180ml water into a thick batter. Stir in 150g corn kernels, 100g peas, 1 grated carrot and 3 sliced spring onions. Heat 3cm oil to 180C and fry heaped tablespoons for 3 minutes, turning, until crisp. Drain. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lime juice and chopped coriander for dipping.
the Camp Firewood campfire on the last night of summer, 1981

Marshmallows toasted golden over the flame, squashed between graham-style biscuits with milk chocolate and a spoon of salted caramel. Make the caramel: melt 100g sugar until amber, whisk in 80ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp salt and cool. Lay 16 digestive or wheatmeal biscuits on a board and top 8 with a square of milk chocolate (100g total). Toast 16 large marshmallows on skewers over a fire or gas flame until golden. Push 2 onto each chocolate biscuit, spoon over caramel and squash with a second biscuit.
M: the Camp Firewood mess hall, summer of 1981

Saucy beef mince cooked down with capsicum, onion, tomato and brown sugar, piled into toasted slider buns with cheddar and crunchy pickles. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 8 minutes. Add 2 garlic cloves, 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp mustard and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Toast 12 slider buns, add a slice of cheddar to each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced pickles.
W: Last day bug juice ice blocks

Strawberry, watermelon and orange blended into a bright red fruit punch with lime, frozen into ice blocks with chunks of fresh fruit inside. Blend 300g watermelon, 150g strawberries, the juice of 2 oranges, the juice of 1 lime and 2 tbsp honey until smooth. Dice a few extra strawberries and drop them into 8 ice block moulds. Pour in the punch, add sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours. Run the moulds under warm water for a few seconds to release.
K: the classic camp drink on every Camp Firewood table

A big jug of red fruit punch made with fresh orange, pineapple and cranberry juice, raspberry cordial and lemonade, floating with orange and berries. In a large jug, mix 400ml cranberry juice, 300ml pineapple juice, the juice of 2 oranges and 60ml raspberry cordial. Chill 1 hour. Just before serving, add plenty of ice, 600ml cold lemonade, a sliced orange and a handful of frozen berries. Stir once and ladle into plastic cups.
T: Last day of camp. First night of snacks.
D: The counsellors at a 1981 summer camp try to sort out their love lives on the last day before everyone goes home.
P: Serve the snacks when the last day at Camp Firewood begins.

title: Role Models
S: the LAIRE battle in the park and the court of King Argotron

Chicken drumsticks rubbed with garlic, rosemary and smoked paprika, roasted until crisp, then glazed with honey mustard to be eaten by hand like a medieval feast. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub 12 chicken drumsticks with 2 tbsp oil, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 2 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Roast on a lined tray for 35 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard, brush over and roast 10 minutes more until sticky. Wrap the bones in baking paper and serve on a board.
Sturdy Wings honey soy chicken wings
Sturdy Wings, the mentoring programme Danny and Wheeler are sentenced to

Chicken wings baked crisp and tossed in a sticky honey, soy, garlic and ginger glaze with sesame seeds and spring onion. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt and bake on a rack for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Simmer 4 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 tbsp rice vinegar for 3 minutes until syrupy. Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.
M: Wheeler finally getting through to Ronnie

Two thin smashed patties with melted cheese, onion, pickles and a tangy burger sauce in toasted buns, with crunchy seasoned fries. Bake 750g frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with salt and paprika. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and chopped pickles. Toast 4 buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties with diced onion and pickles.
W: Kingdom of LAIRE honey spice cakes

Little honey and mixed spice cakes baked golden, soaked with warm orange honey syrup and topped with a spoon of thick cream and toasted almonds. Heat the oven to 175C. Melt 125g butter with 150g honey, cool slightly, then whisk in 2 eggs. Fold in 200g self-raising flour, 1 tsp mixed spice and 80ml milk. Divide between 12 greased muffin holes and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Warm 4 tbsp honey with the juice of 1 orange and spoon over the hot cakes. Serve with thick cream and toasted flaked almonds.
K: the Minotaur energy drink Danny and Wheeler sell to schools

Fresh ginger and lime syrup with a pinch of chilli, topped with soda over crushed ice, sharp and fiery with a lime and mint garnish. Simmer 100g sliced ginger, 120g sugar, 150ml water and a pinch of chilli flakes for 10 minutes. Cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 40ml ginger syrup and 25ml lime juice to each and top with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and garnish with a lime wheel and mint.
T: Mentoring starts with snacks.
D: Two energy drink salesmen get sentenced to community service mentoring a medieval role-playing teen and a foul-mouthed kid.
P: Serve the snacks when the battle at LAIRE begins.

title: I Love You, Man
S: Beer-battered white fish fried crisp in warm tortillas with lime slaw, pickled red onion and chipotle mayo, finished with coriander. Slice 1 red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes. Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt. Mix 120g mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Whisk 120g flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 180ml cold beer. Cut 500g white fish into strips, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 8 tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, onion, mayo and coriander.
Sydney's man cave in the garage

Corn chips layered with smoky pulled pork, black beans and cheddar, baked until melted, loaded with jalapeños, sour cream and a lime crema drizzle. Toss 400g pulled pork with 3 tbsp barbecue sauce. Spread 300g corn chips on a big tray and scatter with the pork, 400g drained black beans and 200g grated cheddar. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until melted. Mix 150g sour cream with the juice of 1 lime and drizzle over. Top with sliced pickled jalapeños, diced tomato, coriander and spring onion.
M: Peter's open house, where he meets Sydney

Crusty baguettes piled with rare roast beef, horseradish cream, rocket, pickled red onion and crispy shallots, cut into share-size pieces. Slice 1 red onion thin and soak in 80ml red wine vinegar with 1 tsp sugar for 20 minutes. Mix 100g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish and salt. Split 2 baguettes lengthways, spread with the horseradish cream and layer with 400g sliced rare roast beef, a handful of rocket, the drained onion and 2 tbsp fried shallots. Press down and cut each into 4 pieces.
W: Peter and Zooey's lemon wedding cupcakes
Peter and Zooey's wedding, best man sorted

Lemon butter cupcakes filled with tangy lemon curd and topped with whipped cream cheese icing, a sugared lemon zest curl on each. Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar with the zest of 2 lemons, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in 12 cases for 18 minutes and cool. Cut a small hole in each and fill with lemon curd (150g total). Beat 150g cream cheese with 80g soft butter and 300g icing sugar, pipe on top and finish with lemon zest.
K: Peter and Sydney's big night at the rock gig

Tequila with fresh pink grapefruit, lime and a touch of agave, topped with soda over ice in a salt-rimmed glass with a grapefruit wedge. Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip in salt. Fill with ice. To each add 45ml tequila, 60ml fresh pink grapefruit juice, 15ml lime juice and 10ml agave syrup and stir. Top with 100ml soda water and add a grapefruit wedge. For drivers, skip the tequila and add more grapefruit and soda.
T: Slappin' da snacks.
D: A friendless groom-to-be goes on a series of man-dates to find a best man and meets the one guy who gets him.
P: Serve the snacks when Peter and Sydney head to the gig.

title: Pineapple Express
S: Charred pineapple salsa with lime chips

Pineapple charred on a hot grill and chopped with red onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime, served with corn chips dusted in lime salt. Cut half a pineapple into thick slices and char on a very hot grill pan for 3 minutes a side. Cool and dice. Mix with half a finely diced red onion, 1 chopped jalapeño, a handful of chopped coriander, the juice of 2 limes and salt. Rest 10 minutes. Toss 250g corn chips with the zest of 1 lime and half a tsp salt and serve with the salsa.

A cob loaf cut into a crosshatch and stuffed with garlic butter, mozzarella and parmesan, baked until crisp and stringy, for pulling apart on the couch. Heat the oven to 190C. Cut a cob loaf in a crosshatch pattern, 2cm apart, without cutting through the base. Melt 100g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Spoon into all the cuts, then stuff with 200g grated mozzarella and 40g parmesan. Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 minutes until golden and melted.
M: Red, the middleman who keeps getting back up

Chicken thighs glazed in homemade teriyaki and chargrilled with thick pineapple slices, served over rice with sesame, spring onion and pickled chilli. Simmer 100ml soy, 60ml mirin, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove for 5 minutes until syrupy. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in half the sauce for 30 minutes. Grill on a hot barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side, brushing with more sauce. Grill 8 pineapple slices 2 minutes a side. Cook 1.5 cups rice. Slice the chicken and serve with pineapple, sesame, spring onion and sliced chilli in vinegar.
W: Dale's dinner from hell with Angie's parents

Buttery cake baked over fresh pineapple and a dark rum brown sugar caramel, turned out warm with coconut cream for pouring. Heat the oven to 180C. Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 2 tbsp dark rum in a 23cm tin and lay 8 fresh pineapple rings on top. Beat 125g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and turn out. Serve warm with 200ml chilled coconut cream.
K: Fresh pineapple muddled with lime, mint and brown sugar, shaken with white rum and poured over crushed ice with a chilli salt rim. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli powder and rim 4 glasses. For each drink, muddle 4 pineapple chunks, 4 mint leaves, 15ml brown sugar syrup and 20ml lime juice in a shaker. Add 45ml white rum and 60ml pineapple juice, shake with ice and pour over crushed ice. For non-drinkers, skip the rum and top with soda.
T: Pineapple, everything.
D: A process server and his dealer go on the run after witnessing a murder, armed with nothing but a rare strain called Pineapple Express.
P: Serve the snacks when Dale and Saul hit the road.

title: Knocked Up
S: Pete's secret nights out, not what Debbie thought

Corn chips layered with spiced refried beans, chorizo and cheddar, baked bubbling, then loaded with guacamole, sour cream and pickled jalapeño. Fry 2 diced chorizo until crisp. Warm 400g refried beans with 1 tsp cumin. Spread 300g corn chips on a big tray, spoon over the beans and chorizo and cover with 200g grated cheddar. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime, salt and coriander. Top the nachos with guacamole, 150g sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion.

Chicken bites soaked in dill pickle brine, fried crunchy and tossed in dill salt, with a pickle ranch dip and extra pickle chips on the side. Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces and soak in 250ml dill pickle brine for 2 hours. Drain, dip in 1 beaten egg with 100ml buttermilk, then 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and salt. Fry at 175C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and toss with dried dill and salt. Mix 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp chopped pickles and dill for dipping.
M: takeaway nights in LA while Ben and Alison work it out

Chicken simmered in a fragrant green curry with coconut milk, Thai basil, snake beans and makrut lime, with jasmine rice and fresh chilli. Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in 2 tbsp of the thick top of 400ml coconut milk until fragrant. Add 800g sliced chicken thigh and stir 3 minutes. Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, 100ml stock, 4 torn makrut lime leaves, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp palm sugar. Simmer 12 minutes, adding 150g snake beans for the last 5. Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice and sliced chilli.
W: counting down to the baby's arrival

Lemon butter cupcakes with a raspberry centre, piped with pale pink and blue buttercream and finished with freeze-dried raspberry crumbs. Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar with lemon zest, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in 12 cases for 18 minutes and cool. Fill each centre with raspberry jam (120g total). Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and 2 tbsp milk, split in two and tint pale pink and pale blue. Pipe on and crumble over freeze-dried raspberries.
K: Debbie and Alison turned away at the club door

Sparkling grape juice with lime and mint, a mocktail for the mum-to-be. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml grape juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water and mint. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
T: One night out. Nine months of snacks.
D: A slacker and a rising TV journalist find out a one-night stand has left them expecting a baby.
P: Serve the snacks when Ben and Alison find out.

title: The 40-Year-Old Virgin
S: Andy's careful morning routine, egg salad included

Jammy boiled eggs chopped with Japanese mayo, Dijon, chives and celery, piled thick on soft milk bread with crunchy lettuce and cracked pepper. Boil 8 eggs for 9 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Chop roughly and fold with 100g Japanese mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon, 1 finely diced celery stick, 2 tbsp chives, salt and plenty of pepper. Butter 8 slices of soft milk bread. Lay iceberg lettuce on 4 slices, pile on the egg salad and close. Cut off the crusts, slice in half and press lightly.
Smart Tech poker night queso dip
poker night with the guys from Smart Tech

A hot, silky cheese dip of cheddar, chorizo, roasted capsicum and jalapeño, kept bubbling in a skillet, with corn chips and salted peanuts. Fry 1 diced chorizo until crisp. Add half a diced onion and 1 chopped jalapeño for 3 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp cornflour, then 375ml evaporated milk, and simmer until it thickens. Over low heat, stir in 250g grated cheddar a handful at a time until smooth, then 80g chopped roasted capsicum and a pinch of cumin. Serve hot in a skillet with 250g corn chips and 150g salted peanuts.
M: dinner at Trish's with her kids

Whole chicken roasted over lemon, garlic and thyme until the skin crackles, with crispy potatoes, roast carrots and a punchy pan gravy. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 30g soft butter, salt and pepper and stuff with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and thyme. Toss 1kg potatoes and 4 carrots in chunks with oil and salt around it. Roast 1 hour 15 minutes, turning the vegetables once. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml stock and simmer 3 minutes for gravy.
W: the speed dating night, three minutes a date

Rich dark chocolate ganache truffles rolled three ways, in cocoa, crushed hazelnuts and freeze-dried raspberry, with a pinch of flaky salt. Heat 120ml cream until just simmering and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Stand 2 minutes, then stir until smooth with 20g butter and a pinch of salt. Chill 2 hours until firm. Scoop into 20 balls and roll quickly in your hands. Roll a third in cocoa, a third in 40g crushed toasted hazelnuts and a third in crushed freeze-dried raspberries. Chill until serving.
K: Andy's careful routine, and his action figure collection

Chocolate ice cream blended with cold milk and malted milk powder until thick, served in a tall glass with whipped cream and crushed malt balls. Blend 500g chocolate ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses. Whip 100ml cream to soft peaks and spoon on top. Crush 60g chocolate malt balls and scatter over. Serve with straws.
T: Breakfast routine, sorted.
D: A shy electronics store worker is pushed by his workmates into finally getting out there at 40.
P: Serve the snacks when Andy makes his famous egg salad sandwich.

title: Hot Tub Time Machine
S: the Kodiak Valley ski lodge, back in 1986

Gruyère and emmental melted into white wine with garlic and a splash of kirsch, kept bubbling for dunking bread, boiled potatoes and cornichons. Rub a heavy pot with a halved garlic clove. Heat 300ml dry white wine until just simmering. Toss 200g grated gruyère and 200g grated emmental with 1 tbsp cornflour and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure eight until smooth. Stir in 1 tbsp kirsch or lemon juice and nutmeg. Keep warm over a burner and serve with 1 cubed baguette, 500g boiled baby potatoes and cornichons.

Pizza dough rolled with tomato sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella, sliced into scrolls and baked golden, brushed with garlic butter and served with hot marinara. Heat the oven to 200C. Roll 500g pizza dough into a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 100ml pizza sauce and scatter 100g sliced pepperoni and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Place in a lined tin, bake 20 to 25 minutes and brush with 30g butter melted with 1 garlic clove. Warm 200ml marinara for dipping.
M: warming up at the lodge after a day on the slopes

Beef mince and kidney beans simmered with chipotle, cumin and dark chocolate until thick and smoky, topped with sour cream, cheddar and pickled jalapeño. Brown 800g beef mince in a heavy pot. Add 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then 2 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp chilli powder and 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Stir in 800g tinned tomatoes, 300ml beef stock and 20g dark chocolate and simmer 45 minutes. Add 2 drained 400g tins kidney beans for the last 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar, pickled jalapeños and crusty bread.
W: the snowy slopes of Kodiak Valley

Dense fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a crackly top, dusted thickly with icing sugar like fresh powder and served with vanilla ice cream. Heat the oven to 170C. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g caster sugar, then 3 eggs one at a time until glossy. Fold in 100g plain flour, 30g cocoa and a pinch of salt. Pour into a lined 20 x 30cm tin and bake 25 minutes so the middle is still soft. Cool completely, cut into squares and dust heavily with icing sugar. Serve with vanilla ice cream.
K: the Russian energy drink spilled on the hot tub controls

A sharp fizz of fresh ginger syrup, lemon and lime topped with soda, with a vodka option, glowing green with a lime wheel and mint. Simmer 80g sliced ginger with 100g sugar and 120ml water for 10 minutes, cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 30ml ginger syrup, 15ml lemon juice and 15ml lime juice to each, plus 30ml vodka if you like. Top with 180ml soda water, stir and add a lime wheel and mint sprig.
T: Back to 1986, snacks included.
D: Four friends get sent back to a 1986 ski weekend by a hot tub and try not to change the future.
P: Serve the drinks when the hot tub sends them back to 1986.

title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
S: Jersey gravy fries with melted cheese
the long night drive across New Jersey

Crunchy crinkle-cut fries smothered in hot beef gravy and melted mozzarella, finished with pepper and spring onion, eaten with a fork. Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour for 1 minute, then whisk in 500ml beef stock and 1 tsp Worcestershire and simmer 5 minutes until thick. Pile the chips onto a tray, scatter with 150g grated mozzarella and grill 2 minutes until melted. Pour over the hot gravy and top with pepper and sliced spring onion.
the stop at Freakshow's house, the strangest of the night

Dill pickle spears in a crunchy cornmeal batter, fried hot and dusted with smoked paprika salt, with a cool buttermilk ranch. Pat 16 dill pickle spears very dry. Whisk 1 egg and 125ml buttermilk. Mix 75g plain flour, 75g fine polenta, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Dip the spears in buttermilk, then the flour mix. Fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and drain. Mix 100g sour cream, 60ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill, chives and a crushed garlic clove for dipping.
M: Harold and Kumar riding a cheetah through the woods

Tiny beef patties steamed on a bed of diced onion, then stacked with cheese and pickles in soft square buns. Press 600g beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into 16 squares. Spread 2 finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes. Add cheese and serve in 16 small soft buns with pickles.
W: the neighbours on their own late-night quest

Vanilla ice cream blended with malted milk powder, cold milk and salted caramel, poured into tall glasses streaked with caramel and topped with whipped cream. Make salted caramel: melt 100g sugar until amber, whisk in 80ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp salt, and cool. Drizzle some inside 4 tall glasses. Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp of the caramel until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a drizzle more caramel.
K: the drive through the night in Harold's car

Ice-cold cola with homemade sour cherry syrup and vanilla, poured over crushed ice with fresh lime and a cherry on top. Simmer 200g frozen pitted cherries with 80g sugar and 80ml water for 10 minutes, mashing them, then strain and stir in 1 tsp vanilla. Cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 40ml cherry syrup and a squeeze of lime to each, then top with 250ml cold cola. Stir gently and add a cherry and a lime wedge.
T: One craving. One very long night.
D: Two room-mates set out for late-night sliders and end up on an all-night odyssey across New Jersey.
P: Serve the sliders when Harold and Kumar finally reach the counter.

title: Dude, Where's My Car?
S: Sweet and Dude pork spring rolls
the matching Dude and Sweet tattoos

Crisp pork, cabbage and carrot spring rolls fried golden, with a sweet chilli and lime dipping sauce and fresh coriander on the side. Fry 300g pork mince until browned, add 2 cups finely shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp soy, and cook 3 minutes. Cool completely. Roll 2 tbsp of filling in each of 16 spring roll wrappers, sealing the edge with a little water. Deep fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden, then drain on paper towel. Stir the juice of 1 lime into 150ml sweet chilli sauce and serve with coriander.

Popcorn coated in crunchy butter caramel, drizzled with blue-tinted white chocolate and scattered with popping candy for that out-of-this-world crackle. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil and tip into a big bowl, picking out any unpopped kernels. Boil 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup for 4 minutes, take off the heat and stir in 1/2 tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Pour over the popcorn, toss and spread on a lined tray. Bake at 120C for 20 minutes, stirring once. Melt 100g white chocolate with 2 drops blue colouring, drizzle over and scatter with 2 packets popping candy.
M: And then? Lemon chicken and fried rice
the Chinese drive-thru speaker that keeps saying and then

Crisp battered chicken in a glossy fresh lemon sauce, with egg fried rice, peas and spring onion and a side of garlicky stir-fried broccoli. Cook 300g jasmine rice the day before and chill. Cut 700g chicken thigh into strips, dip in 1 beaten egg, then toss in 100g cornflour. Shallow fry at 180C for 5 minutes until crisp. Simmer the juice of 3 lemons, 80g caster sugar, 150ml water and 1 tbsp cornflour until glossy, and pour over. Fry the cold rice in a hot wok with 2 scrambled eggs, 100g peas, 2 tbsp soy and 3 spring onions. Stir-fry 1 head broccoli with 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes.
W: Fridge full of chocolate pudding pots
the fridge stacked with nothing but pudding

Silky homemade chocolate pudding set in little jars, topped with salted caramel, whipped cream and crushed chocolate biscuit crumbs for crunch. Whisk 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan, then slowly whisk in 600ml milk. Stir over medium heat until it boils and thickens, about 6 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in 100g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla. Pour into 4 jars, press cling film on top and chill 2 hours. Top each with a spoon of caramel sauce, whipped cream from 200ml thickened cream and 4 crushed chocolate biscuits.
K: Frozen lychees blitzed with lime juice and lemonade into an icy slushie, served in big cups with a lime wheel and a straw. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup, and freeze the fruit flat on a tray for at least 3 hours. Blend the frozen lychees with 100ml of the syrup, the juice of 3 limes and 2 cups of ice until smooth and slushy. Add 600ml cold lemonade and pulse twice to mix without losing the fizz. Pour into 4 big cups and finish each with a lime wheel and a straw.
T: And then? And then dinner.
D: Two stoners wake up with no memory of the night before and no idea where they parked the car.
P: Serve the mains at the Chinese drive-thru scene. And then?

title: Kingpin
S: the bowling alleys on the road to Reno

Crisp oven fries smothered in smoky beef and bean chilli and melted cheddar, topped with sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once. Meanwhile brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder, 400g tin crushed tomatoes and a drained 400g tin kidney beans, and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Pile the chips into a baking dish, spoon over the chilli, scatter with 150g grated cheddar and grill 3 minutes until melted. Top with 100g sour cream, sliced jalapeños and spring onion.
Amish farm soft pretzels with apple butter

Warm, chewy soft pretzels with a deep brown crust and flaky salt, served with spiced apple butter and a hot mustard dip. Divide 500g pizza dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 50cm rope and twist into pretzels. Bring 2L water and 60g bicarb to a simmer and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Lay on a lined tray, brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. For the apple butter, simmer 4 peeled diced apples with 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 100ml apple juice for 25 minutes and mash smooth. Serve with American mustard.
M: Amish chicken and noodles over mash

Tender chicken thighs simmered with thick egg noodles in a rich, peppery broth, spooned over buttery mashed potato with parsley. Simmer 800g chicken thighs in 1.5L chicken stock with 1 diced onion, 2 diced carrots and 2 celery sticks for 35 minutes. Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot. Add 300g wide egg noodles and simmer 8 minutes until the broth thickens. Season well with salt and plenty of white pepper. Meanwhile boil 1kg peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Ladle the chicken and noodles over the mash and scatter with chopped parsley.
W: A wet-bottomed molasses pie under a buttery brown sugar crumble, served warm with lightly whipped cream to cut through the sticky richness. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry. Rub 150g plain flour, 100g brown sugar and 60g cold butter into crumbs. Whisk 150ml molasses, 1 egg and 180ml hot water with 1 tsp bicarb. Pour into the pastry case, then scatter the crumbs evenly over the top. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes, then drop to 180C for 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool 30 minutes and serve with 200ml whipped cream.
K: Roy's very wrong trip to the milking shed

Thick vanilla milkshakes blended with malt powder and ice cream, poured into chilled glasses with whipped cream and a sprinkle of extra malt. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 600ml cold full cream milk with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla extract until thick and smooth. Pour into the cold glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and sprinkle each with a little more malt powder. Serve straight away with thick straws.
T: Don't get Munsoned. Get fed.
D: A washed-up one-handed bowler takes a talented Amish man on the road to win a million-dollar tournament in Reno.
P: Serve the mains when Roy and Ishmael hit the road to Reno.

title: Black Sheep
S: Cocktail frankfurts wrapped in flaky puff pastry with a mustard brush and sesame seeds, baked golden and served with a honey mustard dip. Cut 2 sheets thawed puff pastry into 24 strips. Brush each strip with a little Dijon mustard and wrap around 24 cocktail frankfurts. Lay seam-side down on a lined tray, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Stir 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard into 2 tbsp honey and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for dipping and serve warm.
the governor's race in Washington State

Crisp baguette toasts topped with sharp cheddar, thin red apple slices and toasted walnuts, finished with a drizzle of honey and cracked pepper. Slice 1 baguette into 20 thin rounds, brush with 3 tbsp olive oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes until crisp. Toast 50g walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes and chop. Thinly slice 2 red apples and toss with the juice of half a lemon so they stay white. Top each toast with a slice of 200g vintage cheddar and a slice of apple. Scatter with walnuts, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and finish with cracked pepper.
M: Hideout cabin salmon with dill butter
Mike and Steve hiding out at the cabin

Salmon fillets baked in foil parcels with lemon and dill butter, served with crushed garlic potatoes and charred green beans. Mash 60g soft butter with 2 tbsp chopped dill, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 crushed garlic clove. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, crush lightly and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Lay 4 salmon fillets on squares of foil, top each with a slice of the butter and a lemon slice, then seal. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Fry 300g green beans in a hot pan with a splash of oil for 4 minutes until charred.
W: Small-town apple crumble with oat crunch

Cinnamon-spiced Granny Smith apples under a crunchy oat and brown sugar crumble, baked bubbling and served with thick vanilla custard. Peel and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and toss with 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and the juice of half a lemon. Tip into a 2L baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 60g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar until clumpy. Scatter over the apples. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Warm 600ml ready-made custard and pour over each bowl.
K: Seattle cold brew with maple cream
the long campaign in the Pacific Northwest

Smooth overnight cold brew over ice, topped with a pour of maple-sweetened cream that slowly swirls down through the glass. The night before, stir 100g coarsely ground coffee into 1L cold water in a jug, cover and leave in the fridge for 12 hours. Strain through a fine sieve lined with paper towel. Whisk 150ml thickened cream with 2 tbsp maple syrup until just thickened but still pourable. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the cold brew and slowly pour the maple cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.
T: Rock slide! Then dinner.
D: A clumsy younger brother keeps wrecking his older brother's campaign for governor of Washington.
P: Serve the snacks when the campaign hits the road.

title: Billy Madison
S: Grade one ham and cheese pinwheels
Billy's first day back in grade one

Soft tortilla pinwheels rolled with leg ham, cream cheese, cheddar and baby spinach, sliced into rounds and served with cherry tomatoes and pickles. Mix 150g soft cream cheese with 1 tbsp mustard. Spread thinly over 4 large flour tortillas right to the edges. Layer each with 2 slices of leg ham, a handful of baby spinach and 30g grated cheddar. Roll up tightly, wrap in cling film and chill for 30 minutes so they hold their shape. Trim the ends and cut each roll into 6 pinwheels. Serve on a platter with 250g cherry tomatoes and a few cornichons.

Triple-decker toasted club sandwiches with roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise, cut into bite-size squares and pinned with toothpicks. Grill 6 rashers bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread. Spread with 4 tbsp mayonnaise. For each of 4 sandwiches, layer toast, 50g sliced cooked chicken, lettuce and tomato, then toast, bacon and lettuce, then the last toast. Press down gently and pin with 4 toothpicks. Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 squares. Serve with a handful of salted potato crisps on the side.
M: the pool party at the Madison mansion

Grilled frankfurts in toasted buns loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, diced white onion and yellow mustard, with plenty of napkins. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 200g tomato passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes, turning. Toast 8 split hot dog buns. Fill each bun with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 2 minutes until melted, then add diced white onion and a squeeze of mustard.
W: Smooth homemade chocolate pudding set in cups, topped with whipped cream, crushed chocolate biscuits and rainbow sprinkles. Whisk 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan. Slowly whisk in 600ml milk, then stir over medium heat for 6 minutes until it boils and thickens. Take off the heat and stir in 80g chopped milk chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Pour into 4 cups, press cling film on the surface and chill 2 hours. Top with whipped cream from 200ml thickened cream, 4 crushed chocolate biscuits and sprinkles.
K: Back to school chocolate malt shake
Billy going back to school, grades one to twelve

Thick chocolate milkshakes blended with malt and ice cream, topped with whipped cream and a drizzle of chocolate sauce. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Drizzle 2 tbsp chocolate sauce down the inside of each glass. Blend 600ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp cocoa until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and finish with an extra drizzle of chocolate sauce and a sprinkle of malt.
T: Back to school, back to lunch.
D: A rich man-child has to repeat grades one to twelve in six months to inherit his father's hotel empire.
P: Serve the snacks when Billy starts first grade.

title: The Waterboy
S: Bayou hush puppies with Cajun remoulade

Golden cornmeal hush puppies with spring onion and a pinch of cayenne, fried crisp and served with a tangy Cajun remoulade for dipping. Mix 200g fine cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp cayenne. Whisk in 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk, then fold in 3 sliced spring onions. Rest 10 minutes. Drop heaped teaspoons into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain on paper towel. For the remoulade, mix 150g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 1 tbsp chopped pickles, 1 tsp Cajun seasoning and a squeeze of lemon.

Green prawns seared hot and fast in garlic and Cajun spiced butter, finished with lemon and parsley and served with crusty bread to mop the pan. Peel and devein 800g green prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 2 tsp Cajun seasoning. Heat a large frying pan over high heat with 1 tbsp oil. Add the prawns in one layer and cook 90 seconds a side. Drop the heat, add 60g butter and 3 crushed garlic cloves and swirl for 1 minute until foaming. Squeeze over 1 lemon and scatter with chopped parsley. Serve straight from the pan with a sliced baguette.
M: Mama Boucher's chicken and sausage gumbo
Mama's kitchen out on the bayou

A dark roux gumbo of chicken thigh, smoked sausage, okra and the holy trinity, ladled over steamed rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Stir 80g plain flour into 80ml oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until it turns dark brown like chocolate. Add 1 diced onion, 2 celery sticks and 1 green capsicum and cook 5 minutes. Add 600g diced chicken thigh, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun seasoning and 1.2L chicken stock, and simmer 1 hour. Add 200g sliced okra for 10 minutes. Serve over 300g steamed long grain rice with sliced spring onion and hot sauce.
W: Creamy, fudgy New Orleans pecan pralines made with brown sugar, butter and toasted pecans, set into rounds that snap then melt in the mouth. Toast 200g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes. In a heavy saucepan, combine 200g brown sugar, 100g caster sugar, 120ml thickened cream and 40g butter. Stir over medium heat until it boils, then cook without stirring until it reaches 115C on a sugar thermometer, about 8 minutes. Take off the heat, add 1 tsp vanilla and the pecans and beat with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes until it thickens and turns cloudy. Quickly spoon rounds onto baking paper and leave 30 minutes to set.
K: High quality H2O cucumber lime cooler
Bobby's water, the high quality stuff

Ice-cold sparkling water muddled with cucumber, lime and mint, lightly sweetened with honey syrup and served in tall glasses over crushed ice. Stir 3 tbsp honey into 3 tbsp hot water until dissolved and cool. Slice 1 Lebanese cucumber into thin ribbons with a peeler. In a jug, muddle the juice of 3 limes, a handful of mint leaves and the honey syrup. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice and cucumber ribbons. Add 1L chilled sparkling water to the jug, stir gently and pour over. Garnish with lime wheels and mint sprigs.
T: High quality H2O. Then gumbo.
D: A sheltered Louisiana waterboy discovers he can tackle like nobody else and becomes a college football star.
P: Serve the drinks when Bobby hands out the water.

title: Grandma's Boy
S: Grandma's cheddar and chive cheese ball
moving in with Grandma and her housemates

An old-school cheese ball of sharp cheddar, cream cheese and chives rolled in toasted pecans, served with water crackers and celery sticks. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 150g finely grated vintage cheddar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp garlic powder and 2 tbsp chopped chives until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 1 hour. Toast 80g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes, chop finely and mix with 2 tbsp more chives. Roll the cheese ball in the nuts until coated. Serve with 200g water crackers and 4 celery sticks cut into batons.
Alex's job testing games at Brainasium

Soft pizza dough scrolls rolled with tomato sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano, baked golden and served with warm marinara for dunking. Roll 500g pizza dough on a floured bench into a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 100ml pizza sauce, then scatter with 100g sliced pepperoni, 150g grated mozzarella and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin, brush with 20g melted butter and 1 crushed garlic clove, and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden. Warm 300ml marinara sauce for dunking.
M: A juicy beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky brown sugar tomato glaze, served in thick slices with creamy mash and buttered peas. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 80ml milk. Mix with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 2 tsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp cider vinegar and spread over the top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Cook 300g peas and toss with butter.
W: A soft, buttery tea cake brushed with melted butter while warm and finished with a crunchy cinnamon sugar crust, served with whipped cream. Beat 100g soft butter and 150g caster sugar until pale, then beat in 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla. Fold in 200g self-raising flour alternately with 150ml milk. Spread into a lined 20cm round tin and bake at 180C for 30 to 35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. While still hot, brush with 20g melted butter and sprinkle with 2 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Serve warm in wedges with whipped cream.
K: Lilly, Bea and Grace's peach iced tea

Black tea brewed strong, chilled and shaken with peach nectar and lemon, poured over ice with fresh peach slices and mint. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 3 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes. Remove the bags and cool, then chill for 1 hour. Stir in 400ml peach nectar and the juice of 1 lemon. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a few slices of fresh peach or tinned peach. Pour over the tea and garnish each glass with a mint sprig and a lemon wheel.
T: Move in with Grandma. Eat like it.
D: A video game tester gets evicted and moves in with his grandma and her two housemates.
P: Serve the snacks when Alex moves in with Grandma.

title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
S: Classic devilled eggs piped with a creamy mustard yolk filling, dusted with smoked paprika and topped with crisp bacon crumbs and chives. Lower 8 eggs into boiling water and cook 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel. Halve lengthways and scoop out the yolks. Mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp white vinegar and salt until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Grill 3 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble finely. Dust the eggs with smoked paprika and top with bacon and snipped chives.

Cubes of sharp cheddar, fresh pineapple, cocktail onions and cabana on toothpicks, stuck into half a rockmelon like a retro party hedgehog. Cut half a rockmelon in two and place one quarter cut-side down on a platter as the hedgehog body, with two cloves pushed in for eyes. Cut 250g vintage cheddar and half a fresh pineapple into 2cm cubes. Slice 150g cabana into rounds. Thread toothpicks with a cube of cheese, a cube of pineapple and either a cocktail onion or a slice of cabana. Push them all over the rockmelon until it is covered in spikes.
M: Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak Diane
Dr. Evil's one million dollar demand

Thin sirloin steaks flashed in a hot pan with a creamy mushroom, brandy and Dijon sauce, served with crisp shoestring fries and watercress. Bake 1kg frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Bat out 4 sirloin steaks to 1cm thick, season and sear in a very hot pan with oil for 90 seconds a side. Rest on a plate. In the same pan, melt 30g butter and fry 200g sliced mushrooms and 1 diced shallot for 3 minutes. Add 40ml brandy and let it bubble off, then add 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp Dijon and 150ml cream and simmer 2 minutes. Pour over the steaks and serve with fries and watercress.
W: Sherry-soaked jam sponge layered with thick vanilla custard, raspberries and whipped cream, topped with a Union Jack of strawberries and blueberries. Slice a 300g jam rollette into rounds and line a large glass bowl. Drizzle with 60ml sweet sherry. Scatter over 200g raspberries. Pour over 600ml thick vanilla custard and chill 1 hour. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar to soft peaks and spread over the top. Lay halved strawberries in a cross and diagonals across the cream, then fill the gaps with 125g blueberries to make a Union Jack.
K: An ice-cold dry gin martini stirred with a splash of dry vermouth, strained into chilled glasses and finished with a lemon twist or olive. Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Fill a large jug with ice, add 240ml gin and 40ml dry vermouth, and stir steadily for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the chilled glasses. Peel 4 thin strips of lemon zest, twist each over a glass to spray the oils and drop it in, or add a green olive on a pick for those who like it briny.
T: Groovy, baby. Dinner's served.
D: A swinging sixties secret agent is thawed out in 1997 to stop his old enemy Dr. Evil.
P: Serve the snacks when Austin is unfrozen in the nineties.

title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
S: Safari camp beef samosas with mint yoghurt

Crisp East African style samosas filled with spiced beef mince, onion and coriander, served with a cool mint yoghurt dip and lemon wedges. Fry 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves until browned. Add 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 grated carrot and 100g peas and cook 5 minutes. Stir through chopped coriander and cool. Cut 6 spring roll wrappers into 3 strips each, place a spoon of filling at one end and fold into triangles, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped mint and a pinch of salt for dipping.
Monastery momos with chilli tomato sauce
the mountain monastery where the film begins

Steamed Tibetan dumplings filled with pork, ginger and spring onion, served with a fiery tomato and chilli dipping sauce. Mix 400g pork mince with 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 3 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Place a teaspoon in the centre of each of 24 round dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Steam in a lined steamer over boiling water for 10 minutes. For the sauce, blitz 2 tomatoes, 2 red chillies, 1 garlic clove, a pinch of salt and 1 tbsp vinegar and simmer 5 minutes.
M: Chilli, lemon and garlic marinated chicken thighs grilled with char, served with soft pan-fried chapati and a fresh tomato and red onion kachumbari. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets with the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. For chapati, mix 300g plain flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil and 180ml warm water, knead and rest 20 minutes, then roll into 8 rounds and dry-fry 1 minute a side. Grill the chicken 6 minutes a side. Toss 3 diced tomatoes, 1 red onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari.
W: Fluffy East African doughnuts made with coconut milk and cardamom, fried golden and dusted in sugar, with a little bowl of honey for dipping. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp ground cardamom and a pinch of salt. Stir in 200ml coconut milk and 1 egg to make a soft dough, knead 2 minutes and rest 15 minutes. Roll out to 1cm thick and cut into 16 triangles. Fry in oil at 170C for 2 minutes a side until puffed and golden. Drain and toss in 60g caster sugar. Serve warm with honey.
K: the hunt for the sacred white bat

Fresh passionfruit pulp shaken with lime, a little sugar syrup and ginger, topped with soda water over crushed ice with mint. Heat 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and a few slices of fresh ginger until dissolved, then cool and strain. Scoop the pulp from 6 passionfruit into a jug. Add the juice of 3 limes and the ginger syrup and stir well. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice, divide the passionfruit mix between them and top each with 200ml soda water. Stir and finish with mint sprigs.
T: Alrighty then. Dinner.
D: Ace Ventura travels to Africa to find a sacred white bat and stop a war between two tribes.
P: Serve the mains when Ace lands in Africa.

title: Wayne's World 2
S: Warm homemade cinnamon sugar doughnut holes, a tribute to the doughnut shop Wayne and Garth always end up at.

Corn cobs charred on the grill and slathered in chilli lime butter, rolled in grated parmesan and finished with coriander and a lime wedge. Mash 60g soft butter with the zest of 1 lime, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt. Grill 4 husked corn cobs over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Brush the hot cobs all over with the chilli lime butter, then roll in 40g finely grated parmesan. Scatter with chopped coriander and serve with lime wedges.
M: the basement studio in Aurora, Illinois

A thick Chicago-style deep-dish pizza layered with mozzarella, Italian sausage and a chunky garlic and oregano tomato sauce on a buttery crust. Press 500g pizza dough into a well-oiled 26cm cast iron pan or cake tin, pushing it 4cm up the sides. Layer 250g sliced mozzarella over the base, then 300g Italian sausage meat torn into small pieces. Simmer a 400g tin crushed tomatoes with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of sugar for 10 minutes and spread over the top. Scatter with 40g grated parmesan and bake at 220C for 30 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before cutting.
W: Backstage choc cookie ice cream sandwiches

Soft, chewy double chocolate cookies sandwiched around thick vanilla ice cream, with the edges rolled in rainbow sprinkles. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg. Mix in 180g plain flour, 30g cocoa, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 100g chocolate chips. Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool completely. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes, then sandwich a thick scoop between 2 cookies and press together. Roll the edges in sprinkles and freeze for 30 minutes before serving.
K: a hot day at the Waynestock festival

Fresh lemon juice blitzed with frozen raspberries, sugar syrup and ice into a tangy pink slushie, served in big cups with a lemon wheel. Heat 120g caster sugar with 120ml water until dissolved, then cool. Blend the syrup with the juice of 5 lemons, 150g frozen raspberries, 400ml cold water and 3 cups of ice until smooth and slushy. Taste and add a little more syrup or lemon if needed. Pour into 4 big cups and garnish with lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries.
T: Party time. Excellent. Again.
D: Wayne and Garth try to put on a giant rock festival in Aurora after a vision tells them to.
P: Serve the snacks when Waynestock kicks off.

title: Major League
S: Potato and cheese pierogi boiled then pan-fried in butter until crisp, piled with golden caramelised onions, sour cream and chives. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes until deep golden. Boil 24 frozen potato and cheese pierogi for 4 minutes until they float, then drain well. Heat 40g butter in a large frying pan and fry the pierogi for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and golden. Pile onto a platter, top with the onions and serve with 200g sour cream and snipped chives.

Raw peanuts roasted with honey, butter, brown sugar and a kick of chilli and sea salt, cooled into crunchy, sticky clusters. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Toss 400g raw unsalted peanuts in the mix with 1/2 tsp chilli flakes until coated. Spread on a lined tray and bake at 170C for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until deep golden. Sprinkle with 1 tsp sea salt flakes and 1 tbsp caster sugar while hot. Cool completely and break into clusters.
M: Cleveland Polish boy with fries and slaw

Cleveland's ballpark favourite: grilled kielbasa in a soft roll piled with hot chips, smoky barbecue sauce and tangy coleslaw. Bake 800g frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tsp sugar. Score 4 kielbasa sausages and grill for 8 minutes, turning, until charred. Split 4 long soft rolls. Lay a kielbasa in each, pile on a handful of hot chips, drizzle generously with 150ml smoky barbecue sauce and top with the slaw.
W: A deep cherry pie with a golden sugared lattice top, the filling sweet, sharp and bubbling, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Drain 2 x 680g jars pitted cherries, keeping 150ml juice. Simmer the juice with 100g caster sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick, then stir in the cherries and a squeeze of lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill. Cut 2 sheets into strips and weave a lattice over the top. Brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar and bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Rest 20 minutes and serve with ice cream.
K: Jobu's dark rum and ginger punch

Dark rum, ginger beer, fresh lime and a dash of bitters over ice, with a little shot poured for Jobu first. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml dark rum and the juice of half a lime to each glass. Top each with 150ml cold ginger beer and add 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Stir once and garnish with a lime wedge. Pour one extra small shot of rum into a glass and set it aside for Jobu before anyone takes a sip.
T: Juuust a bit outside the menu.
D: A ragtag Cleveland baseball team sets out to win the pennant after the owner tries to tank the season.
P: Serve the drink for Jobu when Cerrano steps up to bat.

title: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
S: Tour rider tropical fruit with chilli salt

A big platter of chilled mango, pineapple, watermelon and papaya, sprinkled with chilli lime salt and served with lime wedges. Peel and slice 2 mangoes, half a pineapple, a quarter watermelon and half a papaya into long wedges. Chill on a big platter for 30 minutes. Grind 1 tbsp sea salt flakes with 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp caster sugar and the zest of 2 limes. Just before serving, squeeze over the juice of 1 lime and sprinkle with the chilli salt. Serve with extra lime wedges.

Buttermilk fried chicken pieces in soft brioche slider buns with crunchy slaw, pickles and a sriracha mayonnaise. Soak 500g chicken tenderloins in 200ml buttermilk with salt for 30 minutes. Toss in 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Shallow fry at 180C for 4 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp sriracha. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with 1 tbsp vinegar. Fill 8 toasted brioche slider buns with chicken, slaw, pickles and the mayo.
M: Style Boyz fish tacos with mango salsa
getting the Style Boyz back together

Chilli and lime grilled white fish in warm corn tortillas with fresh mango salsa, shredded cabbage, avocado crema and coriander. Rub 600g firm white fish fillets with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, the zest of 1 lime and 1 tbsp oil. Grill 3 minutes a side and flake. Dice 1 mango, half a red onion and 1 red chilli and toss with lime juice and coriander. Blend 1 avocado with 100g sour cream and lime juice. Warm 12 small corn tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with shredded cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.
W: Round vanilla bean butter cookies flooded with grey and silver icing, piped with record grooves and a little label in the middle. Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, then add 1 egg yolk, 1 tsp vanilla bean paste and 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm and cut 16 rounds with a 8cm cutter. Bake at 170C for 12 minutes and cool. Mix 300g icing sugar with 3 tbsp water and a drop of black colouring to make grey. Flood each cookie, let it set, then pipe thin circles for grooves and a small coloured label in the centre.
K: Gin muddled with cucumber, mint and lime, topped with sparkling water over ice for a crisp backstage spritz. Leave out the gin for a mocktail. Thinly slice 1 Lebanese cucumber. In a jug, muddle 8 cucumber slices with a handful of mint leaves, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar syrup. Add 160ml gin and stir. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and the rest of the cucumber slices. Strain the gin mix into the glasses and top each with 120ml sparkling water. Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.
T: Never stop never snacking.
D: A huge pop star's second album flops, and a camera crew films every moment of the fall.
P: Serve the snacks when Conner's tour kicks off.

title: MacGruber
S: MacGruber taking his car stereo everywhere

Cashews, almonds and peanuts roasted with chilli, honey, rosemary and sea salt, served warm with strips of beef jerky. Toss 400g mixed raw nuts with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring twice, until golden. Sprinkle with 1 tsp sea salt flakes while hot and cool for 10 minutes so the coating crisps. Serve in a bowl next to 150g sliced beef jerky.
Emergency celery with blue cheese dip

Crisp celery and carrot sticks with a chunky blue cheese and buttermilk dip and a drizzle of buffalo hot sauce on top. Mash 100g blue cheese with a fork, then mix in 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 3 tbsp buttermilk, 1 tsp lemon juice and black pepper, leaving some chunks. Chill for 30 minutes. Trim 1 bunch celery and 2 carrots into long sticks and keep them in iced water until serving so they stay crisp. Spoon the dip into a bowl, drizzle with 1 tbsp hot sauce and serve with the drained sticks.
M: Action hero rib eye with onion rings

Chargrilled rib eye with garlic herb butter, a stack of crunchy soda-battered onion rings and a peppery rocket salad. Mash 60g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold soda water into a batter. Slice 2 large onions into thick rings, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Season 4 x 300g rib eye steaks and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes, top with the butter and serve with rings and rocket.
W: racing the clock on the stolen X-5

Rich dark chocolate and cream pots that set fast in the fridge, topped with whipped cream, flaky salt and crushed honeycomb. Heat 300ml thickened cream with 2 tbsp caster sugar until just steaming. Pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate, leave 1 minute, then stir until smooth and glossy. Whisk in 1 egg yolk and a pinch of salt. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill for at least 1 hour until set. Top each with a spoon of whipped cream, a pinch of sea salt flakes and 30g crushed honeycomb.
K: Vicki, MacGruber's partner in the field

Ice-cold lager mixed with lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire in a chilli salt rimmed glass. Mix 1 tbsp sea salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a saucer. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 pint glasses and dip into the salt. Fill with ice. Add the juice of half a lime, 60ml tomato juice, 2 dashes hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire to each glass. Top each with a 330ml bottle of cold lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.
T: Ninety seconds to dinner.
D: A former special ops hero comes out of retirement to stop his nemesis from stealing a nuclear warhead.
P: Serve the snacks when MacGruber puts the team together.

title: Spy
S: Cat lady cover croque monsieur bites
Susan's first cover, the frumpy cat lady

Ham and gruyère toasties smothered in nutmeg béchamel and grilled until bubbling, cut into fingers and served with cornichons and Dijon. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp plain flour for 1 minute, then whisk in 200ml milk and simmer until thick. Season with nutmeg and stir in 40g grated gruyère. Spread 8 slices of white bread thinly with Dijon mustard. Make 4 sandwiches with 150g sliced leg ham and 80g gruyère. Fry in butter for 2 minutes a side, then spread the béchamel on top, scatter with 40g more gruyère and grill 3 minutes until bubbling. Cut into fingers.
Budapest garlic lángos with sour cream
the Budapest leg of the mission

Hungarian fried flatbread brushed with garlic oil, topped with cool sour cream, grated cheese and a sprinkle of paprika and dill. Divide 500g pizza dough into 4 balls and rest 15 minutes. Stretch each by hand into a 15cm round, thinner in the middle. Fry in 3cm of oil at 180C for 90 seconds a side until puffed and golden, then drain. Mix 2 crushed garlic cloves with 3 tbsp olive oil and brush over the hot bread. Spread each with 3 tbsp sour cream, scatter with 120g grated tasty cheese and finish with sweet paprika and chopped dill.
M: Rome cacio e pepe with toasted pepper

Spaghetti tossed in a glossy sauce of pecorino, toasted cracked black pepper and starchy pasta water, finished with extra cheese at the table. Cook 400g spaghetti in well-salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Meanwhile toast 2 tsp coarsely cracked black pepper in a large dry frying pan for 1 minute, then add 30g butter and a ladle of the pasta water. Finely grate 150g pecorino and mix to a paste with 4 tbsp cool pasta water. Move the pasta into the pepper pan with a splash more water and toss 1 minute. Off the heat, toss in the cheese paste until glossy and serve with extra pecorino.
W: A moist chocolate sheet cake with thick fudge icing and chopped toasted hazelnuts, cut into big squares for the office crowd. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 300g caster sugar, 60g cocoa and 1 tsp bicarb. Whisk in 2 eggs, 250ml milk, 125ml vegetable oil and 250ml hot coffee to a thin batter. Pour into a lined 23 x 33cm tin and bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Cool. For the icing, melt 100g butter and 150g dark chocolate, then beat in 250g icing sugar and 3 tbsp milk. Spread over the cake and scatter with 60g chopped toasted hazelnuts.
K: Rayna and her very big hair in Rome

A bitter orange aperitif topped with prosecco and soda over ice, with a fat wedge of blood orange and a green olive on the side. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice. Pour 60ml bitter orange aperitif into each, then add 90ml chilled prosecco and 30ml soda water. Stir gently once. Slide a thick wedge of blood orange, or regular orange, into each glass and serve with a small bowl of green olives on the side. For anyone not drinking, mix blood orange juice with soda and a dash of bitters.
T: Undercover, overfed.
D: A desk-bound CIA analyst goes undercover across Europe to stop an arms deal.
P: Serve the snacks when Susan goes into the field.

title: The Heat
S: Boston clam chowder with oyster crackers

Creamy New England clam chowder with smoky bacon, potato and fresh clams, served in mugs with crisp oyster crackers and chives. Fry 3 diced rashers bacon until crisp, then add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml fish stock and 300g diced potato and simmer 12 minutes. Add 1kg cleaned clams or vongole, cover and cook 4 minutes until open, then pick out the shells. Stir in 300ml thickened cream and heat through. Season with pepper and serve with oyster crackers and chives.
Mullins stopping a runner with a watermelon

Oven-crisped chicken wings tossed in buttery buffalo hot sauce, served with a chunky blue cheese dip and cold celery sticks. Pat 1.2kg chicken wings dry and toss with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and toss the wings through it. For the dip, mash 100g blue cheese with 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with celery sticks.
M: Mullins family roast beef and gravy

Garlic and mustard crusted roast beef sliced pink, with crunchy roast potatoes, honey carrots and a rich pan gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt. Parboil 1.2kg quartered potatoes for 8 minutes, drain, rough up and toss in 3 tbsp oil. Roast the beef at 200C for 1 hour for medium rare with the potatoes on a separate tray. Add 4 halved carrots tossed in 1 tbsp honey for the last 35 minutes. Rest the beef 15 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 400ml beef stock and simmer to a gravy.
W: a Boston classic for a Boston film

Two layers of light butter sponge filled with thick vanilla pastry cream and covered in a glossy dark chocolate glaze. Whisk 3 egg yolks, 60g caster sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, then whisk in 300ml hot milk. Return to the pan and stir until thick, add 1 tsp vanilla and chill. Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in a 20cm tin at 180C for 30 minutes and cool. Split in half and fill with the custard. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream and pour over the top.
K: two cops who can't stand each other, at first

Irish whiskey shaken hard with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until frothy, served over ice with a cherry and a dash of bitters. For each drink, add 60ml Irish whiskey, 30ml fresh lemon juice, 20ml sugar syrup and 1 egg white to a shaker or jar. Shake hard without ice for 15 seconds, then add ice and shake again for 15 seconds. Strain into a short glass over fresh ice. Top the foam with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters and drop in a cocktail cherry. Repeat for 4 drinks.
T: Boston's finest. Boston's food.
D: An uptight FBI agent and a foul-mouthed Boston detective team up to take down a drug lord.
P: Serve the mains at the Mullins family dinner.

title: Horrible Bosses
S: the bar where they hire a murder consultant

Corn chips layered with spiced beef and black beans, melted cheddar, guacamole, sour cream, salsa and pickled jalapeños. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp chilli powder, 3 tbsp tomato paste and 150ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in a drained 400g tin black beans. Layer 300g corn chips in a baking dish with the beef and 200g grated cheddar, and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top with guacamole, 150g sour cream, 200g salsa and jalapeños.

Soft homemade doughnuts fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and piped full of warm raspberry jam. Mix 300g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Add 150ml warm milk, 1 egg and 40g melted butter and knead 8 minutes. Prove 1 hour until doubled. Roll 12 balls and prove 30 minutes more. Fry at 170C for 2 minutes a side and drain. Toss in 100g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Poke a hole in each and pipe in 250g warmed raspberry jam.
M: Swap your boss double bacon cheeseburgers
the plan to trade horrible bosses

Two smashed beef patties with melted cheese, crisp bacon, pickles, onion and burger sauce on a toasted milk bun, with fries. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Grill 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash each flat onto a very hot greased pan, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, top with a cheese slice and cook 1 minute. Stack 2 patties in each toasted bun with bacon, pickles, sliced onion and sauce.
W: a long night of very bad planning

Fudgy dark chocolate brownies swirled with salted caramel and baked until just set, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g caster sugar, then 3 eggs one at a time. Fold in 100g plain flour, 30g cocoa and a pinch of salt. Spread into a lined 20cm square tin. Drop 6 tbsp thick caramel sauce over the top and swirl with a knife. Sprinkle with 1 tsp sea salt flakes and bake at 170C for 25 to 28 minutes until just set. Cool 20 minutes and serve warm with ice cream.
K: Harken's early morning glass of Glengoolie Blue

Scotch whisky shaken with fresh lemon, honey syrup and egg white, strained over ice with an orange twist. Stir 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp hot water and cool. For each drink, shake 60ml scotch whisky, 30ml lemon juice, 20ml honey syrup and 1 egg white in a jar without ice for 15 seconds. Add ice and shake hard for another 15 seconds. Strain into a short glass over a large ice cube. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in. Repeat for 4 drinks.
T: Three bad bosses. One good dinner.
D: Three friends with unbearable bosses come up with a very bad plan to get rid of them.
P: Serve the snacks when the three friends start plotting at the bar.

title: 22 Jump Street
S: My name is Jeff crab cakes

Golden crab cakes bound with mayonnaise, spring onion and lemon, pan-fried crisp and served with smoky chipotle mayonnaise and lime. Mix 400g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 2 sliced spring onions, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tsp Dijon and 60g panko crumbs. Shape into 12 small cakes and chill 30 minutes. Roll in 60g more panko. Fry in 3 tbsp oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime. Serve the cakes with the mayo and lime wedges.

Crisp baked wings glazed in a sticky honey barbecue sauce with soy and smoked paprika, scattered with sesame and spring onion. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for 3 minutes until sticky. Toss the hot wings in the glaze and return to the oven for 5 minutes. Scatter with 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.
M: spring break, with the captain hot on their heels

Crisp beer-battered flathead in warm tortillas with lime slaw, pickled red onion, chipotle crema and fresh coriander. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold lager to a batter. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tsp chipotle sauce. Fill 12 warm tortillas with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.
W: Dining hall skillet choc chip cookie

One giant choc chip cookie baked in a cast iron pan until gooey in the middle, topped with vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce. Melt 125g butter and beat in 150g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 200g plain flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chocolate chips. Press into a greased 25cm ovenproof frying pan. Bake at 180C for 18 to 20 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the centre. Rest 5 minutes, then top with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and drizzle with chocolate sauce. Serve with 4 spoons.
K: Tequila, fresh lime and frozen mango blended icy smooth with a splash of orange liqueur, poured into salt-rimmed glasses. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 glasses and dip in sea salt flakes. Blend 400g frozen mango, 160ml tequila, 60ml orange liqueur, the juice of 4 limes, 2 tbsp sugar syrup and 2 cups of ice until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels. For an alcohol-free version, swap the tequila and liqueur for 200ml orange juice.
T: Do the same thing as last time. Snacks included.
D: Schmidt and Jenko go undercover at college to find who is supplying a new drug.
P: Serve the crab when the crab people gag kicks in.

title: Neighbors
S: Frat party pork and fennel sausage rolls

Flaky puff pastry rolls filled with pork, fennel seed and apple, sprinkled with sesame and served with a smoky tomato relish. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, 2 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 30g breadcrumbs and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath. Brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut each into 4. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 200g tomato relish stirred with 1/2 tsp smoked paprika.
Baby Stella date night baked brie
Mac and Kelly at home with baby Stella

A whole brie baked until molten, topped with honey, toasted walnuts and thyme, served with crunchy toasts and grapes for dunking. Unwrap a 200g brie wheel, score the top in a criss-cross and sit it in a small ovenproof dish. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until soft and molten. Meanwhile toast 50g walnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes and warm them with 2 tbsp honey and a few thyme leaves. Spoon over the hot brie. Slice 1 baguette thinly, brush with oil and bake 8 minutes. Serve with the toasts and 300g grapes.
M: Mac and Kelly trying to make friends next door

Chargrilled rump steak and pork sausages with a sharp herb chimichurri, served with grilled corn and a crunchy apple slaw. Blitz 1 bunch parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning. Grill 8 pork sausages for 12 minutes. Season 800g rump steak and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice. Toss shredded cabbage and 1 julienned apple with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and lemon. Spoon chimichurri over the steak.
W: Teddy and Pete's funfetti sheet cake
the Delta Psi president and his right-hand man

A soft vanilla sheet cake baked with rainbow sprinkles through the crumb, covered in thick cream cheese frosting and more sprinkles. Beat 200g soft butter with 250g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 3 eggs and 2 tsp vanilla, then fold in 300g self-raising flour and 200ml milk. Fold through 60g rainbow sprinkles. Spread into a lined 23 x 33cm tin and bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Cool. Beat 250g cream cheese with 80g butter and 300g icing sugar until fluffy, spread over the cake and finish with more sprinkles.
K: White rum, pineapple and passionfruit juice with lime and lemonade, poured over ice with orange slices and fresh mint. In a big jug or punch bowl, mix 1L pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit, the juice of 2 limes and 200ml white rum. Chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, add 1L cold lemonade, 2 sliced oranges and plenty of ice. Stir gently and scatter with mint. Make a second jug without rum for anyone not drinking.
T: The frat's next door. So are the snacks.
D: A young couple with a baby go to war with the fraternity that moves in next door.
P: Serve the snacks when the frat throws its first party.

title: This Is the End
S: Grilled sourdough rubbed with garlic, piled with marinated cherry tomatoes, basil and torn buffalo mozzarella, finished with balsamic glaze. Quarter 400g cherry tomatoes and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 crushed garlic clove, torn basil and salt, then leave 15 minutes. Slice 1 sourdough loaf into 12 slices, brush with oil and grill or toast until charred. Rub each warm slice with a cut garlic clove. Top with the tomatoes and pieces of 2 buffalo mozzarella balls. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and add a basil leaf.
Rationed pretzels with beer cheese dip
rationing the supplies in Franco's house

Warm soft pretzel bites with a smooth cheddar and beer cheese dip spiked with mustard and paprika. Cut 500g pizza dough into 32 bite-size pieces. Simmer 2L water with 60g bicarb and drop in the pieces for 20 seconds. Drain, lay on a lined tray, brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. For the dip, melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then whisk in 150ml lager and 100ml milk. Add 200g grated cheddar, 1 tsp mustard and a pinch of paprika and stir until smooth.
M: Danny's end of days breakfast fry-up
Danny cooking through the food supplies

A full apocalypse fry-up: crispy bacon, sausages, fried eggs, hash browns, garlic mushrooms and grilled tomatoes with buttered toast. Bake 8 frozen hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 pork sausages over medium heat for 12 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Halve 4 tomatoes, season and fry cut-side down for 3 minutes. Fry 250g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove for 5 minutes. Fry 8 eggs in the bacon fat. Toast 8 slices of bread and butter well. Load up 4 plates and serve with tomato sauce.
W: The last chocolate caramel nougat bar
the fight over the last chocolate bar

Homemade bars of fluffy malted nougat and soft caramel, coated in milk chocolate, so there are enough for everyone. Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla, and press into a lined 20cm square tin.
